### [1] [Beyond the Last Layer: Global Inter-Layer Aggregation for AI-Generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00017)
*Wenbin Shen,Zhichao Lian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GILA 从冻结预训练编码器的多个深度提取全局表示，用层间自注意力建模跨层交互并自适应聚合，用于提升 AI 生成图像检测与跨数据集泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型快速迭代导致检测器面临生成器更新快、数据分布漂移大、跨数据集泛化差等挑战；现有基于预训练视觉编码器的方法只用最后一层全局特征，忽视了中间层信息。

Method: Global Inter-Layer Aggregation：在冻结编码器不同深度取全局表征，通过层间自注意力建模层间交互，再自适应加权聚合上下文化后的表示；与预训练目标解耦，无需微调编码器。

Result: 在 3 种预训练目标不同的视觉骨干、10 个已见生成器、3 个外部数据集上验证，GILA 更好地利用多层信息，提升了检测性能与跨数据集泛化能力。

Conclusion: 多层全局特征聚合是一种轻量、与预训练范式无关的生成图像检测改进方案。

Abstract: The rapid development of generative models has made AI-generated images increasingly close to real images. It has also brought several challenges to detectors, including rapid generator updates, large changes in data distribution, and limited cross-dataset generalization. Many existing methods based on pretrained vision encoders primarily use the global representation from the last layer, potentially leaving useful information from intermediate layers underexplored. To address this issue, we propose Global Inter-Layer Aggregation (GILA). GILA extracts global representations from different depths of a frozen encoder, models interactions among layer representations through inter-layer self-attention, and adaptively aggregates the resulting contextualized representations. The method is not tied to a single pretraining objective and does not require fine-tuning the pretrained encoder. We evaluated GILA on three vision backbones with different pretraining objectives, ten seen generators, and three external datasets. The experimental results show that GILA makes better use of multi-layer information in pretrained encoders and improves detection performance and cross-dataset generalization.

</details>


### [2] [Intervenable Concept Dynamics for Video Activity Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00020)
*Patrick Knab,David Steinmann,Giovanni De Felice,Felix Divo,Udo Schlegel,Wolfgang Stammer,Sascha Marton,Christian Bartelt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRACE-CBM 将概念瓶颈模型扩展到视频活动预测：用稀疏时空图精炼观测概念，递归预测未来概念状态（以先前活动分布为条件），共享分类器解码观测与预测状态，并支持推理期无参数编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）仅将概念锚定于观测输入，不具备对概念未来演化的建模能力；而将 CBM 用于预测任务需要刻画概念激活随时间（物体、动作及其交互变化）的演化，以保持可解释性与可编辑性。

Method: 提出 TRACE-CBM：(1) 用稀疏时空图对观测到的概念激活做精炼；(2) 递归预测未来概念状态，每次状态转移以先前活动分布为条件；(3) 用共享活动分类器解码观测态与预测态；(4) 推理时可编辑概念取值、活动激活与学到的图边，无需更新参数，从而显式暴露用于预测的关系型时空依赖。

Result: 在多个数据集上，观测活动 Top-1 较概念类方法提升 1.2–8.5 个百分点；H3 预测 Top-1 与同配黑盒预测器相差 1.9–2.2 个百分点。干预实验：概念节点编辑纠正了 25.6–34.4% 的初始错误 H3 预测且未翻转原本正确的预测；概念引导最多在 90.0% 的情况下达到指定目标活动。

Conclusion: 概念级时序演化建模可在接近黑盒预测器精度的同时保持可解释与可干预性，并为视频活动预测提供可编辑的概念状态接口。

Abstract: Concept bottleneck models route predictions through human-understandable concepts, making their intermediate states inspectable and editable. Extending this model family to forecasting requires modeling how concept activations evolve over time as objects, actions, and their interactions change, yet existing CBMs ground concepts only in observed inputs and do not forecast their future evolution. We study this problem using videos of ongoing activities and forecast future activities through a named-concept state. We propose TRACE-CBM (Temporal Relational Activity Concept Evolution), which first refines observed concept activations with sparse spatio-temporal graphs. It then recursively predicts future concept states, conditioning each transition on the prior activity distribution, and decodes both observed and predicted states with a shared activity classifier. At inference time, the model supports editing concept values, activity activations, and learned edges without parameter updates, exposing the relational spatio-temporal dependencies used for forecasting. Across multiple datasets, TRACE improves observed-activity Top-1 accuracy over concept-based methods by 1.2-8.5 percentage points and attains H3 forecast Top-1 accuracy within 1.9-2.2 points of matched black-box forecasters. Intervention experiments show concept-node edits correct 25.6-34.4% of initially incorrect H3 forecasts without flipping initially correct ones, and concept steering achieves the requested target activity in up to 90.0% of cases.

</details>


### [3] [Diagnosing Prototype Estimation in Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning: Training-Free Geometry Selection and Unlabeled-Query Prototype Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00022)
*Md Tanvir Hossain Saikat,Md Akib Haider,Md. Tahmid Islam Tomal,Md Hasanul Kabir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在冻结视觉特征的FSCIL中，通过匹配反事实实验证明新类原型均值噪声是线性探针差距的主因，提出ShrinkSel选择器与QPR批式直推修正方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结编码器使原型头在少样本类增量学习中具竞争力，但不清楚残余差距究竟来自新类均值的小样本噪声，还是来自分类器重拟合引入的变化，缺乏因果化归因。

Method: 构造回顾性匹配反事实：固定余弦评分下将每个五样本新类均值替换为全数据均值，再拟合线性探针，分离两个因素；提出ShrinkSel，在仅用支持集的条件下选择原型半径与协方差收缩系数，其搜索族以共享LDA为精确退化解；进一步提出QPR（Query Prototype Rectification），用门控无标签查询以批式直推方式更新新类方向，同时保持已选几何。

Result: 16个强编码器-数据集组合上，均值替换解释了该有序差距的主要部分，样本量与类间诊断支持有限样本机制；弱基座编码器不满足同一判据。ShrinkSel在其中15个组合上超过LDA 0.04–1.52点，并在Aircraft上选中精确LDA端点。CLIP ViT-B/16上QPR提升1.21–2.03点，严格排除自样本仍保留增益；更新以可测量的基类代价修复稀缺新类原型，在支持样本充足或类群极小时收益减弱。

Conclusion: 原型估计可用的证据量是冻结特征FSCIL的核心瓶颈；诊断与改进均围绕小样本均值噪声展开。

Abstract: Frozen visual encoders make prototype heads competitive in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), but it remains unclear how much of the residual head gap is sensitive to noisy novel-class means rather than to the subsequent changes introduced by classifier refitting. On identical features, we construct a retrospective matched counterfactual: first replace each five-shot novel mean with its complete-data counterpart under fixed cosine scoring, then fit a linear probe. Across sixteen strong encoder dataset pairs, mean replacement accounts for the majority of this ordered gap. Shot and classwise diagnostics support a finite-sample mechanism, whereas a weaker base-only encoder does not satisfy the same criterion. This diagnosis motivates ShrinkSel, a support-only selector over prototype radius and covariance shrinkage whose family contains shared LDA as an exact fallback. Across sixteen evaluated pairs, it improves LDA on fifteen by 0.04-1.52 points and selects the exact LDA endpoint on Aircraft. We further introduce Query Prototype Rectification (QPR), a batch-transductive extension that uses gated unlabeled queries to update novel directions while preserving the selected geometry. On CLIP ViT-B/16, QPR adds 1.21-2.03 points; exact query-wise self-exclusion retains the benefit, showing that the gains do not require self-inclusion. The update repairs scarce novel prototypes at a measurable base-class cost and weakens with plentiful supports or very small cohorts. Thus, the evidence available for prototype estimation is a central constraint in frozen-feature FSCIL.

</details>


### [4] [FORCE: Factorized Object Relations for Counterfactual Editing in Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00023)
*Suraj K. Sood,Yugyung Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FORCE 是一种无监督的世界模型，将成对物体交互表示为每个物体对的显式隐变量，并让该隐变量在 rollout 期间保持固定，从而支持“移除/改变/迁移/引入”关系的一次性反事实编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型难以被“提问”：无法轻易查询“若两物体某次交互不同会怎样”。希望交互显式化、可编辑，且编辑直接作用于模型自身量，无需映射回模拟器参数。

Method: 用冻结自监督特征上的 slot attention 抽取物体；关系编码器从短观测窗口推断每个物体对的隐变量，交互头把该隐变量转成力；latent 在 rollout 中固定，使编辑持续生效而非被重算。

Result: 在可提供编辑真值的仿真环境中，基于效果的评分下：从视频做编辑与模拟器响应一致度为 0.19–0.37；若改用精确物体位置训练与评分，同架构可达 0.57–0.85。

Conclusion: 差距不在学到的关系动力学，而在感知：编辑质量受限于从视频精确定位物体的精度，而编辑所需精度略高于当前物体中心化感知的能力；提升感知是让视频反事实世界模型可行的具体目标。

Abstract: World models predict how scenes evolve, but they are difficult to interrogate: given a model that forecasts a video, one cannot easily ask what would have happened had a particular interaction between two objects been different. We present Factorized Object Relations for Counterfactual Editing (FORCE), a world model that infers pairwise interactions from raw video without supervision and represents each as an explicit latent per object pair, so that a relation can be removed, changed, transferred or introduced directly. Objects are extracted by slot attention over frozen self-supervised features; a relation encoder infers each pair latent from a short observation window, and an interaction head turns it into a force. The latent is held fixed across the rollout, so an edit persists rather than being recomputed, and every edit acts on the model's own quantities with no mapping to simulator parameters. We evaluate in a simulated environment where the true outcome of an edit is available, scoring the change each edit induces against the change the simulator produces under the same operation. On held-out clips, FORCE's edits made from video agree with the simulator's response at 0.19 to 0.37 on our effect-based score; trained and scored on exact object positions instead, the same architecture reaches 0.57 to 0.85. The gap therefore lies not in the learned relational dynamics but in perception: what bounds an edit is how precisely objects can be located from video, and the precision editing needs lies just beyond what current object-centric perception delivers. Closing that gap is a concrete target for making counterfactual world models work from video.

</details>


### [5] [Covariance-aware Scoring: A Geometric Correction for Vision-Language Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00024)
*Lakpa Tamang,Saman Forouzandeh,Kamal Berahmand,Wei Shao,Hamid Beigy,Mahdi Jalili*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CARe，用目标域特征二阶矩诱导的Mahalanobis几何替代CLIP测试时适配中的各向同性余弦相似度打分，理论证明其等价于共享协方差高斯模型下的Bayes最优线性判别方向，实验显示各向异性越强增益越大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CLIP测试时适配（TTA）方法虽在缓存、原型、在线统计量上各有改进，但决策规则仍是环境嵌入空间中的余弦相似度打分。在特征分布各向异性时，得分会被高方差但非判别性的方向主导，构成共享决策规则的瓶颈。

Method: CARe以目标域特征二阶矩构造Mahalanobis度量，替换环境几何进行类别打分；在共享协方差高斯模型下给出理论分析，将环境空间打分视为各向同性特例，并推导收益随各向异性增强而增大的关系；在两个骨干网络、标准与细粒度分布偏移基准上与其余弦打分基线对比。

Result: 在标准与细粒度分布偏移基准、两种骨干上，CARe相比余弦基线一致提升适配精度；增益在特征最各向异性的数据集上最大，在接近各向同性时趋于消失，与理论分析一致。

Conclusion: 用协方差感知的Mahalanobis打分替换环境空间余弦打分，是一种理论有据、实现轻量的TTA决策规则改进，可作为通用即插即用模块。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables vision--language models such as CLIP to adapt to distribution shifts without labels or access to source data. Existing methods adapt through feature caching, prototype estimation, or the online accumulation of feature statistics, but most ultimately score a test feature against a class representative in the ambient embedding space, typically through cosine similarity. We identify this shared decision rule as a limitation under anisotropic feature distributions, which means when a small number of directions account for a large fraction of feature variance, the score can be dominated by high-variance directions that are not necessarily discriminative. In light of this, we propose CARe, a covariance-aware scoring for TTA that replaces the ambient geometry with a Mahalanobis geometry induced by the target feature second moment. Theoretically, we show that under a shared-covariance Gaussian model the covariance-aware decision direction coincides with that of the Bayes-optimal linear discriminant, with ambient-space scoring as the isotropic special case, and establish that the potential benefit of covariance-aware scoring grows with feature anisotropy. Empirically, we show that CARe improves adaptation accuracy over its base cosine scoring on both standard and fine-grained distribution-shift benchmarks across two backbones. Consistent with our analysis, the gains are largest on datasets whose features are most anisotropic and vanish as the features approach isotropy.

</details>


### [6] [Edge-Optimized YOLOv11n Architecture for Offline Recognition of Nigerian Sign Language Alphanumeric Gestures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00025)
*Adeleke Adeniyan,Abimbola H. Afolayan,Olanrewaju V. Johnson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级 YOLO11n 框架，在 1–4GB RAM 的低端安卓手机上实现尼日利亚手语实时识别（33 类静态手势），并建立 11,208 张原始图像、按签署人划分的数据集，配合量化感知压缩与遮挡复杂度指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 撒哈拉以南地区听障人士融入社会存在障碍，且当地普遍使用的手机内存仅 1–4GB，现有手语识别模型对算力要求过高，难以离线部署。

Method: 以 YOLO11n 目标检测为骨干；数据集含 11,208 张原始手势图（33 静态类、5 位签署人），S1–S3 训练 / S4 验证 / S5 测试，空间增强仅用于训练集（扩展至 23,509 张），验证与测试各 1,681 张；引入量化感知压缩目标，损失函数叠加平方 Frobenius 范数惩罚约束权值失真；提出空间密度遮挡指数（Spatial-Density Occlusion Index）量化背景复杂度与自遮挡；给出关联 FLOPs、内存带宽与芯片主频的延迟建模方程；在真实安卓设备上以 FP32 权重实测。

Result: 平均推理延迟 405.5–1,759.4 ms；测试集 Precision 0.9975、Recall 0.9991、mAP 0.9942；通过 CameraX 构建移动端应用，实现实时采集与文字即时显示，支持离线运行。

Conclusion: 轻量检测器结合量化压缩可在受限移动硬件上实现高精度离线手语识别，具备实际部署可行性；但属领域 CV + 数据集/工程实践，缺乏通用方法学洞见。

Abstract: Deaf inclusion across sub-Saharan society faces regional hurdles, with Nigeria as the core empirical focus. Existing recognition models demand heavy computational infrastructure. However, standard mobile phones used locally rarely exceed 1 GB to 4 GB of RAM. This study addresses constraints through a lightweight YOLO11n object-detection framework. The system provides real-time Nigerian Sign Language recognition for low-resource hardware. A benchmark dataset containing 11,208 raw gesture images was established. The data spans 33 static classes collected from five signers. Partitioning isolates signers S1 through S3 for training. Signer S4 provides validation data. Signer S5 is reserved for testing. Spatial augmentations are restricted strictly to the training set. This yields 23,509 training images. The validation and test sets each maintain 1,681 images across varied environments. The framework integrates a quantization-aware compression objective. Loss functions merge with squared Frobenius-norm penalties to govern weight distortion. A Spatial-Density Occlusion Index quantifies background complexity and self-occlusion. A latency-profiling equation relates floating-point operations and memory bandwidth to chipset clock speed. Performance testing on physical Android hardware utilizes unquantized FP32 weights. Mean inference latencies span 405.5 ms to 1,759.4 ms. Measured against test data, the algorithm attains a Precision of 0.9975. Recall reaches 0.9991. Mean Average Precision is 0.9942. Outcomes support offline functionality on constrained mobile devices. Practical deployment operates through a mobile utility using CameraX. The application captures gestures in real time. Recognized signs display as text instantly.

</details>


### [7] [The Margin Knows the Background: Uneven Abstention in Frozen Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00026)
*Satwik Sai Prakash Sahoo,Bibhor Puhan,Shubhankar Mahanta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究冻结视觉-语言模型（CLIP/SigLIP）中选择性预测的置信度分数如何造成群体覆盖偏差，证明逐阈值群体覆盖相等等价于分数与群体标签独立，并提出用随机化margin基线检验覆盖差距缩减的真实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一置信度阈值在拒答不确定样本时会不成比例地拒答特定群体，但现有工作不清楚是哪种分数设计、分数的哪个分量导致了这种不均衡，也缺乏判断"改进"是否有意义的对照基线。

Method: 将margin、max-logit等分数统一表示为最高两类logit的均值项与差值项之和，分析哪一项携带群体信息；以群体覆盖相等⟺分数与群体成员独立作为理论判据；在Waterbirds上做配对的背景替换实验检验背景因果作用；在Waterbirds与NICO++上以固定分数选择、对比随机化margin基线；用"分数将群体沿排序下压的幅度"与覆盖差距做Spearman相关分析。

Result: 效应依数据集而变：Waterbirds上80%覆盖率时margin造成的覆盖差距是max-logit的2.5–5.5倍，群体信号位于差值分量，背景替换会使其移动；NICO++上max-logit反而使最差上下文误差上升5.4–6.6个点，且对OpenAI CLIP相对随机基线无增益。跨两个数据集，排序下压幅度与覆盖差距的相关（Spearman 0.88/0.92）优于单纯的群体可识别性（0.61/0.65）。

Conclusion: 某一个数据集上拒答更均衡的分数在另一数据集上可能更差，不应单独追求群体覆盖，而应结合选择性风险、并以随机化基线为参照共同评估。

Abstract: Selective prediction allows a model to abstain on uncertain inputs, but a single confidence threshold can disproportionately reject examples from particular groups. We study how confidence scores produce this imbalance in frozen vision-language models (OpenAI CLIP, LAION CLIP, SigLIP). We express a family of scores, including the margin and maximum logit, through the average and the difference of the two highest class logits, and ask which carries group information. We show that equal group coverage at every threshold is equivalent to independence between the score and group membership. A randomized margin baseline tests whether a reduction in coverage disparity beats what adding noise achieves. With score choices fixed before testing, the effect of choice depends on the dataset. On Waterbirds, the margin creates coverage gaps 2.5 to 5.5 times larger than maximum logit at 80% coverage, its group signal is in the difference component, and paired background swaps show the background moves it, although maximum logit increases overall error. On NICO++, maximum logit instead increases worst-context error by 5.4 to 6.6 points and offers no improvement over the randomized baseline for OpenAI CLIP. Across both datasets, how far a score pushes a group down its ranking tracks the coverage gap (Spearman 0.88, 0.92) better than plain group identifiability (0.61, 0.65). These results explain why a score that abstains more evenly on one dataset may be less effective on another and motivate judging group coverage and selective risk together against randomized baselines.

</details>


### [8] [SFA: A Statistical Physics-Inspired Diffusion Transformer for Efficient and High-Quality Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00027)
*Zixuan Huang,Tianhao You,Guozhang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Scale-Free Attention（SFA），用mean pooling+token计数校正+共享softmax构建无标度空间层级，实现O(N log N)的注意力，在262k token时相对FlashAttention达357.3×/265.6×加速，且PixelFlow上FID-50k优于全注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer在高分辨率下注意力开销大，需要在不损失生成质量的前提下加速注意力。

Method: 借鉴统计物理中的无标度律，构建多尺度空间层级：局部保留细粒度交互，远处区域逐级粗化汇总；配合mean pooling、token计数校正与跨尺度共享softmax，得到前向/反向均O(N log N)的复杂度，并用Triton实现。

Result: 262,144 token下前向357.3×、反向265.6×于FlashAttention；ImageNet 256×256从头训练PixelFlow 40 epoch，FID-50k由13.25降至12.51（五种注意力中最佳），80 epoch仍保持优势；FFHQ上优于其他高效注意力；替换SD 3.5 Medium注意力后在同预算微调下保持质量；预训练PixelFlow微调结果类似。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers have achieved remarkable success in image generation, but accelerating attention while preserving generation quality remains a major challenge at high resolutions. Inspired by statistical physics and the widespread occurrence of scale-free laws in nature, we introduce Scale-Free Attention (SFA), which preserves fine local interactions while summarizing distant regions at progressively coarser scales. For $N$ tokens, mean pooling, token-count correction, and a shared softmax over a scale-free spatial hierarchy give SFA $O(N\log N)$ complexity in both forward and backward passes. Fréchet inception distance evaluated on 50,000 generated samples (FID-50k) improves from 13.25 for full attention to 12.51, and the advantage over full attention persists through 80 epochs. SFA also achieves the best generation quality among the compared efficient-attention methods on Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ). Beyond training from scratch, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium with attention replaced by SFA retains the generation quality of its full-attention counterpart under matched fine-tuning budgets. We obtain similar results when fine-tuning pretrained PixelFlow on ImageNet. SFA establishes scale-free structure as an effective design principle for efficient, high-quality diffusion transformers.

</details>

*Arda Mamur,Matthias Seibold,Christoph Laux,Florian Wanivenhaus,Philipp Fürnstahl*

TL;DR: 分析13例内镜腰椎减压手术(13.2h)术中德语音频，构建无标注流水线(词级ASR+术语纠错+语句融合+LLM英译+相关性过滤)，将实时解说转为带时间戳、实体与言语行为标签的过程线索，并刻画其密度、噪声与时序偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术视频理解中人工标注是主要瓶颈；术者术中实时解说可免标注、可规模化，但其信息含量与可用性尚未被系统刻画。

Method: 双资深脊柱外科医生视角下采集近距离麦克风同步音频；无标注流水线：词级语音识别→确定性手术术语纠错→语句融合→LLM英译→相关性过滤→标注所指手术实体与言语行为（如指令）；再人工核验器械请求与术野出现时间的时序关系。

Result: 3,171条语句中1,201条(37.9%)保留为过程线索，57.6%为非过程性被剔除；保留线索提及器械60.7%、解剖48.0%、动作57.1%，98.5%至少含其一；39%(472条)为指令，主要为器械请求；467条人工核验的器械请求全部先于器械入镜，中位提前8.2s；18.0%保留线索存在领域术语转写错误。

Conclusion: 术中实时解说是稠密、免标注的监督信号，可表征器械、解剖、动作与团队协同；但噪声大且与被指事件存在时间偏移，下游安全使用前必须对该偏移建模。

Abstract: Manual annotation remains the principal bottleneck in surgical video understanding. Live intraoperative narration by the operating surgeon is a scalable alternative that requires no manual annotation, but the information it contains has not been characterized. An annotation-free pipeline (word-level speech recognition, deterministic correction of surgical-term errors, utterance fusion, LLM-based translation to English, and relevance filtering) converted speech into time-stamped procedural cues labelled with the surgical entities they reference and their speech act. Of 3,171 utterances, 1,201 (37.9%) were retained as procedural cues, while 57.6% were non-procedural and removed. Retained cues referenced instruments (60.7%), anatomy (48.0%) and surgical actions (57.1%), and 98.5% carried at least one of these. 39% of cues (472 of 1,201) were directives, mainly instrument requests and commands. All 467 manually verified instrument requests preceded the instrument's appearance in the field, by a median of 8.2 s. Domain-term transcription corruption affected 18.0% of retained cues. Live narration is thus a dense, annotation-free supervisory signal describing instruments, anatomy, actions and team coordination, but it is noisy and temporally displaced from the events it names, and this displacement must be modelled before safe downstream use.

</details>


### [10] [DiA: Directional Adapter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00029)
*Ashish Kumar Singh,Prakash Chandra Chhipa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DiA（Directional Adapter）在 CLIP 之上加入参数高效适配器，将时序专业化拆分为因果与反因果两个方向，用深度可分离时序卷积在紧凑瓶颈空间中分别建模过去→现在与未来→现在的线索，并通过可学习融合结合，单视频模态即可在七个基准上取得 SOTA，仅约 3.6M 可调参数，吞吐更高、延迟更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度动作识别的判别信息常体现在动作的展开过程（准备/执行/完成阶段），类间外观相似但时序结构不同；现有方法对时序上下文做均匀聚合，弱化了这种阶段差异。作者希望在满足三个实际约束下解决该问题：可调参数少、计算高效、仅使用视频模态（不引入光流/音频等额外模态）。

Method: 在 CLIP 骨干上构建轻量适配器，把时序建模显式分解为因果（past-to-present）与反因果（future-to-present）两条方向分支；两条分支均在压缩的瓶颈特征空间中使用 depth-wise 时序卷积以控制参数与算力；最后以可学习融合模块聚合双向表示，实现方向敏感的时序专业化。

Result: 在七个公开基准上，于仅使用单一视频输入模态的方法中达到 SOTA；可调参数约 3.6M；相较已有方法具有更高吞吐量与更低推理延迟；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 显式区分时序方向并在瓶颈空间中高效实现，可在极小参数预算下显著提升细粒度动作识别，同时满足精度—算力效率—单模态的三重目标；该方向分解思路对时序敏感的视频表示适配具有通用参考价值，但方法面向视频理解而非具身控制。

Abstract: Fine-grained action recognition often depends on how an action unfolds over time rather than on appearance alone. Visually similar classes may differ in preparation, execution, or completion phases, making uniformly aggregated temporal context suboptimal. We study this problem under a practical objective: i) improving recognition performance with few tunable parameters, ii) being compute efficient, and iii) using only the readily available video modality. Motivated by this missing temporal observation and the accuracy--compute efficiency--unimodality objective, we propose Directional Adapter (DiA), a parameter-efficient adapter on top of CLIP. DiA formulates temporal specialization into causal and anti-causal directions, allowing past-to-present and future-to-present cues to be modeled differently. To keep this directional modeling parameter- and compute-efficient, both directions use depth-wise temporal convolutions in a compact bottleneck space and are combined through a learnable fusion. DiA achieves state-of-the-art performance among methods using a single video input modality across seven public benchmarks, with only $\sim$3.6M tunable parameters, while also delivering higher throughput and lower inference latency than prior methods. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [11] [Monocular Badminton Speed Estimation with Air Drag and Court Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00031)
*Diwen Huang,Sarvesh Madullapalli,Ishan Pendyala,Oliver Chen,Kevin Li,William Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用智能手机单目视频，结合重力-空气阻力轨迹模型与球场几何（网平面约束）进行标定与鲁棒非线性最小二乘拟合，从而更准确地估计羽毛球出球速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单相机存在尺度与速度歧义：难以区分"近处慢速"与"远处快速"物体；羽毛球受空气阻力强烈减速，可作为附加约束，并结合已知球场几何来消除歧义。

Method: 以球场线标定相机内参与姿态；提取羽毛球观测位置与帧时间戳；用鲁棒非线性最小二乘拟合含重力与二次阻力的三维轨迹；对比"自由单目拟合"与"约束轨迹穿越网平面"两种方案。

Result: 在两次录制、51 个球（吊球、平抽、半杀、杀球）上，网平面约束将相对基于阻力的立体参考的中位绝对速度误差从 13.3% 降至 8.6%；对无阻力模型三角化差分参考也得到更小的中位误差。

Conclusion: 将场地几何与飞行动力学结合，可有效支持单相机羽毛球速度估计，为低成本运动分析提供可行路径。

Abstract: A single camera cannot distinguish between a slowly moving object nearby and a rapidly moving object in the distance without additional information. For a shuttlecock, air drag provides a strong deceleration cue that can be combined with known court geometry. We fit a gravity-and-drag trajectory to smartphone video and compare a free monocular fit with a fit constrained to cross the net plane. Camera calibration uses court lines, and the trajectory is fitted to observed shuttle positions and frame timestamps by robust nonlinear least squares. We evaluated 51 badminton shots from two recording sessions, spanning drop shots, drives, half-smashes and smashes. The net-plane fit reduced the median absolute speed difference from a drag-based stereo reference from 13.3% to 8.6%. A second reference, obtained by differentiating triangulated positions without a drag model, also gave a smaller median difference for the net-plane fit. The results support combining court geometry with flight dynamics for badminton speed estimation from a single camera.

</details>


### [12] [Gaussifier: Fast 2D Gaussian Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00032)
*Yunlai Zhou,Yu Yin,Michael W. Jenkins,Yehe Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Gaussifier：轻量前馈框架，从单图拟合数据学习高斯中心密度图，用等质量Voronoi划分放置2D高斯，再由无状态可复用网络迭代精修，实现60+ FPS、Kodak-24 40.73 dB 的2D高斯分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D高斯泼溅渲染可达数千FPS，但逐图优化拟合需数秒，限制其离线使用；现有前馈方法虽快，但精度不足且依赖逐图微调。作者希望兼顾速度与精度，使2D高斯图像可用于实时场景。

Method: 1) 从逐图拟合数据中学习高斯中心的密度图（density map）；2) 采用等质量Voronoi（equal-mass Voronoi）放置高斯，使每个Voronoi单元所含密度大致相等，实现高效非均匀采样；3) 用一个无状态、可复用（不依赖逐图优化）的小型网络对初始输出做少量迭代精修；4) 提供代码、权重与WebGPU浏览器演示。

Result: Kodak-24/DIV2K 上达到 40.73/38.61 dB PSNR，速度超过60 FPS。相同高斯数量下，PSNR 比所有前馈基线高 3.0–15.6 dB；即使高斯数少于任何基线，仍比最强基线高 2.5–3.5 dB；相同数量下，需逐图拟合的基线达到其PSNR需多花 26–326 倍时间。

Conclusion: 以密度学习 + 等质量Voronoi采样 + 轻量无状态精修网络替代逐图优化，可显著提升2D高斯图像表示的前馈精度与实时性，适合实时、轻量应用；但评测限于图像重建类基准，未涉及3D/机器人场景泛化。

Abstract: 2D Gaussians render images at thousands of frames per second. However, fitting an image takes seconds of optimization. This confines 2D Gaussians to offline use. Feedforward methods are faster but less accurate without per-image fine-tuning. We present Gaussifier, a lightweight feedforward framework for 2D Gaussian decomposition. We learn a density map of Gaussian centers from per-image fitting data. Equal-mass Voronoi places Gaussians so that each Voronoi cell holds approximately equal density. A stateless, reusable network then refines the output in a few iterations. Gaussifier reaches 40.73/38.61\,dB PSNR on Kodak-24/DIV2K at over 60 FPS. At the same Gaussian count, it exceeds every feedforward baseline by 3.0 to 15.6\,dB in PSNR. With fewer Gaussians than any baseline, it still leads the strongest one by 2.5 to 3.5\,dB. At the same count, baselines with their own per-image fitting need 26 to 326 times longer to reach its PSNR. Gaussifier makes high-fidelity 2D Gaussian images fast and light enough for real-time applications. We release code, weights and a browser-based WebGPU demo at this https URL .

</details>


### [13] [Multimodal Cross-Condition Learning for Temporal Sentence Grounding in Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00033)
*Allen He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多模态交叉条件学习MCCL：用Video Prefix Adapter把池化视觉上下文转成连续token条件化冻结的DistilBERT，并与Sentence Conditioned Adapter构成视觉→语言→视觉的有序双向条件回路，用于时序句子定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端时序句子定位只做句子条件化的视觉适配（视觉向语言单向对齐），语言表示始终与视频无关，无法反映句子被解释时所处的视觉上下文。

Method: MCCL包含VPA与SCADA两个模块：VPA将池化视觉上下文映射为连续prefix token，注入冻结的DistilBERT编码器以实现视频→文本条件；SCADA实现文本→视觉条件，二者串联形成双向有序交换。系统比较LSTM与Mamba两种时序模块、I3D与C3D两种视频骨干，以及四种条件模式。

Result: 在Charades-STA的四个设置中，双向条件比更强的单向模式高1.6–2.3 mIoU；ActivityNet Captions上模式不同：I3D+Mamba受益于双向，而C3D下视频到文本单向更强。

Conclusion: 将单向视觉适配扩展为可配置的多模态条件框架，相对基线给出描述性提升；但最佳条件配置依赖骨干与数据集，需按设置选择。

Abstract: Temporal sentence grounding requires a video representation that preserves query-relevant evidence and a sentence representation that reflects the visual context in which it is interpreted. Prior end-to-end grounding addresses the first requirement through sentence-conditioned visual adaptation, but leaves the language representation independent of the video. This work proposes Multimodal Cross-Condition Learning (MCCL). Its Video Prefix Adapter (VPA) converts pooled visual context into a sequence of continuous tokens that condition a frozen DistilBERT encoder. Combined with the Sentence Conditioned Adapter (SCADA), VPA supports an ordered exchange from vision to language and back to vision. A comprehensive study examines two video backbones, LSTM and Mamba temporal modules, and four conditioning modes on two datasets. Bidirectional conditioning exceeds the stronger one-way mode by 1.6--2.3 mIoU points in all four Charades-STA settings. ActivityNet Captions exhibits a different pattern: bidirectionality helps I3D--Mamba, whereas video-to-text conditioning is stronger with C3D. The study extends one-way visual adaptation into a configurable multimodal framework and reports descriptive gains over the corresponding baselines.

</details>


### [14] [A Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support Framework for Brain Tumor MRI Classification: Integrating Attention-Guided Learning, Explainable AI, and Out-of-Distribution Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00034)
*Arjun Kumar Gupta,Harminder Pal Monga*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 脑肿瘤MRI四分类框架：InceptionResNetV2+CBAM，Grad-CAM可视化，两阶段OOD筛选（灰度检查+马氏距离/softmax置信度/预测熵），并封装为实时Web应用NeuroScan AI；测试准确率96.73%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像深度学习模型不能只看分类准确率，还需可解释预测、识别不适用输入（OOD）以及可落地的临床系统集成。作者希望把分类、可解释性、输入校验与部署整合到一个框架中。

Method: 以InceptionResNetV2为主干并嵌入CBAM注意力模块；用Grad-CAM生成预测热力图；两阶段OOD检测：先用灰度通道初筛，再用Mahalanobis距离、softmax置信度与预测熵联合判定；整体部署为实时Web应用NeuroScan AI。

Result: 在Mendeley脑肿瘤MRI数据集（12,064张）上取得验证准确率98.70%、测试准确率96.73%、宏平均AUC 0.9965；OOD流水线在100张初步基准上达99%检测准确率；Grad-CAM可视化在四类中与临床公认肿瘤位置定性对应。

Conclusion: 工作将分类、可解释性、输入校验与部署整合为统一框架，但作者承认仍需更广泛的临床验证与更大规模OOD评估。属于领域CV（医学）应用型工程整合，方法组件均为成熟技术组合，缺乏可迁移到物理AI/机器人领域的新见解。

Abstract: Deep learning models for brain tumor diagnosis need to do more than achieve high classification accuracy. For practical use, they should also provide understandable predictions, recognize unsuitable inputs, and work within a usable clinical system. This paper presents a framework for classifying brain MRI into four categories: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no tumor. The model uses InceptionResNetV2 with a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), while Grad-CAM provides visual explanations of its predictions. A two-stage out-of-distribution (OOD) mechanism screens unsuitable inputs using an initial grayscale check followed by Mahalanobis distance, softmax confidence, and predictive entropy. These components are brought together in NeuroScan AI, a real-time web application. Evaluated on a Mendeley brain tumor MRI dataset of 12,064 images, the framework achieved 98.70% validation accuracy, 96.73% test accuracy, and a macro-average AUC of 0.9965. The OOD pipeline achieved 99% detection accuracy on a preliminary 100-image benchmark. Grad-CAM visualizations showed qualitative correspondence with clinically established tumor locations across all four classes. Overall, the work brings classification, explainability, input validation, and deployment into one framework, while recognizing that broader clinical and OOD validation is still required.

</details>


### [15] [Selective Positional Allocation for Noise-Robust Query Retrieval in Small-Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00035)
*Yangchen Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPAR将位置先验视为可分配资源：在语义有意义处增强、在背景杂波处衰减，用无额外标注的热图监督改进航空遥感小目标检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空/遥感影像中小目标检测的瓶颈不在骨干网络表征能力，而在位置先验在前景-背景界定模糊区域的分布方式。

Method: 提出SPAR框架：核心为可解释的选择性位置嵌入SPE（配激活条可视化便于调参）；编码端MOHFE将热图调制的位置信号与类别、框级证据融合；解码端HIDQ用前景门控在query解码前剔除背景主导候选；DPSConv以双路径互补采样增强检索表征；热图监督全部由现有检测目标推导，仅训练期使用。

Result: 在DOTA、DIOR、VisDrone、PASCAL VOC、NWPU VHR-10、AITOD上相较基线最高提升9.1个百分点，解码器由8层减至3层，参数量减少59.4%（66.3M vs 163M）。

Conclusion: 以位置先验重分配替代单纯堆叠容量，可在显著轻量化的同时提升遥感小目标检测性能且不增加推理开销。

Abstract: In aerial and remote-sensing imagery, detecting tiny targets is frequently hampered less by the representational capacity of the backbone network than by the manner in which positional priors are distributed across ill-defined foreground and background regions. We introduce SPAR (Selective Positional Allocation and Retrieval), a detection framework that re-conceptualizes positional cues as an allocatable resource: they are intensified at semantically meaningful locations while responses driven by scene clutter are actively attenuated. At the heart of SPAR lies Selective Positional Embedding (SPE), an interpretable embedding mechanism paired with an activation-bar visualization that facilitates direct inspection and hyper-parameter tuning. The encoder branch, termed MOHFE, fuses heatmap-modulated positional signals with category-specific and box-level evidence to yield more compact multi-scale features; the decoder branch, termed HIDQ, employs a foreground gating operation to discard background-dominated candidates prior to query decoding. To cope with the extreme sparsity of small-object evidence, we additionally design DPSConv (Dual-Path Sampling Convolution), which augments retrieval-oriented representations through two geometrically complementary sampling routes. Notably, all heatmap supervision is derived from existing detection objectives and consumed exclusively during training, requiring no auxiliary heatmap annotations and leaving inference as an ordinary forward pass with no additional gradient overhead. Comprehensive evaluations on DOTA, DIOR, VisDrone, PASCAL VOC, NWPU VHR-10, and AITOD demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design: relative to the baseline, SPAR attains an improvement of up to 9.1 percentage points, shortens the decoder from eight layers to three, and reduces model parameters by 59.4% (66.3M versus 163M).

</details>


### [16] [From Single-Shot QA to Continuous Perception: Revisiting the Energy Composition and Optimization Boundary of Edge VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00036)
*Yiting Duan,Miaoxin Wang,Aoqing Guo,Bo Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在Jetson AGX Thor/Orin上对9个边缘VLM（3类架构，4508条记录）做持续感知负载剖析，发现两条独立能耗规律：解码每token能耗随规模单调上升，而视觉prefill能耗由视觉编码器架构效率主导、与规模无关；持续感知稀疏输出下visual-prefill占总能耗92–97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Clinicians rarely localize a finding from one image alone. They compare current and prior scans, follow structures across slices, and match regions across views or modalities. Yet vision-language models for sequential medical grounding usually learn only from bounding boxes. Boxes show where the target is, but they do not explain why that region in that image answers the question. We study whether explicit, image-grounded reasoning can improve localization, and which tasks benefit from it. We introduce method, whose core is MedChain, a corpus of 182,573 filtered rationales spanning eight sequential grounding tasks and ten imaging modalities. A medical VLM (FlemingVL-38B) first drafts a caption-like rationale, and a multimodal refiner (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) then re-examines the images, question and annotated box to write a box-conditioned explanation with explicit cross-image reasoning. In a paired comparison using fixed 4B checkpoints, dCoT-SFT improves over answer-only SFT by 3.56 mIoU (95% CI 3.13--4.00). The gains mainly come from change detection and object tracking, while performance drops on three appearance-matching tasks. Replacing a model's own rationale with a rationale from another task reduces mIoU by 12.2 points, showing that localization depends strongly on the reasoning context. *Ruize Xia*

TL;DR: 研究能否用微调时已获得的未标注目标图像来预判CLIP微调造成的零样本遗忘。比较注意力熵、线性CKA、嵌入漂移与相对权重变化四种信号：CKA跨配置排序保持率ρ=0.960且首轮即稳定，注意力熵仅在单一配置内ρ=0.860且符号不定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP在下游任务微调通常会降低其在其他任务上的零样本精度，而量化这种遗忘一般需要带标签的迁移基准。作者希望探究能否利用微调过程中已可得的无标签目标图像来预判遗忘程度，从而免去昂贵的有标签评估。

Result: 固定配置内，注意力熵变化与遗忘强相关（平均|ρ|=0.860），但其符号随数据集、适配方法和骨干网络变化，混合后相关降至0.361；分块分解显示符号几乎完全由第7至12层决定。CKA以ρ=0.960排名各次运行的保持率，且在六轮训练的第一轮后即已确定（ρ=0.959）。在留出目标上CKA达到ρ=0.95，分块分析对两个数据集的注意力变化符号均预测正确。

Conclusion: 提出简单决策规则：CKA适用于跨配置比较，注意力熵仅在单一配置内具信息量。证据受限于单一模型家族与较短训练调度，属初步可靠的诊断工具性结论。

Abstract: Fine-tuning CLIP on a downstream task typically reduces its zero-shot accuracy on other tasks, and quantifying this loss ordinarily requires a labeled transfer benchmark. We study whether the loss can be anticipated from unlabeled target images that are already available during fine-tuning. Four signals are compared: the entropy of CLS token attention, linear centered kernel alignment (CKA) with the pretrained model, embedding drift, and relative weight change. ViT-B/32 is adapted by full fine-tuning (Full FT) and by LoRA on EuroSAT and Oxford-IIIT Pets over four learning rates and three seeds, with an additional ViT-B/16 grid; DTD and GTSRB are held out as confirmation targets, and forgetting is measured as zero-shot retention on CIFAR-100, Food-101, and ImageNet-R. Within a fixed configuration, the change in attention entropy is strongly associated with forgetting (mean $|\rho|=0.860$). Its sign, however, depends on the dataset, the adaptation method, and the backbone, and the pooled correlation falls to 0.361. A block decomposition shows that this sign is determined almost entirely by blocks 7 to 12. CKA ranks runs by retention at $\rho=0.960$, and the ranking is already established after the first of six epochs ($\rho=0.959$). On the held-out targets, CKA reaches $\rho=0.95$, and the block account correctly predicts the sign of the attention change for both datasets. These results support a simple decision rule: CKA is suited to comparisons across configurations, whereas attention entropy is informative only within a single configuration. The evidence is limited to one model family and short training schedules.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器在分布外（OOD）条件下性能崩溃：训练集未包含的生成器往往导致检测失效。作者认为根源在于"取证偏差"——检测器过度依赖与特定生成器绑定的相关噪声指纹，从而丧失泛化性。

Conclusion: 噪声残差的空间白化是一种简单有效的正则/预处理手段，可显著缓解生成器特定指纹带来的取证偏差，为提升AI生成图像检测的跨生成器泛化提供可行方向。

Abstract: Current AI-generated image detection methods struggle in out-of-distribution testing conditions because detectors are usually not robust when evaluated on generators not included in the training set. This work explores a way to mitigate the forensic bias between sources of images -whether real or generated -by removing generator-specific fingerprints. This new training process can be approximated by pre-processing involving a deconvolution operation designed to remove correlated noise patterns inducing loss of generalization. Indeed, we show that whitening the spatial distribution of the image noise residuals can significantly improve the performance of detectors on images coming from generators unseen during training. In particular, an end-to-end CNN model trained on whitened image residuals improves detection by 12.6% on average compared to a training involving original images.

</details>

*Yixiang Yang,Lizhong Zhang,Xingyu Zhang,Zhiwen Chen,Jie Ling,Qiankun Yu,Xingliang Liu,Yang Lei,Zhipeng Zhang*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成式世界动作模型（WAM）推理时需生成稠密未来视频，延迟过高；高效变体又在部署时丢弃世界分支、失去测试时想象能力。即使用 patch 级 DINO/JEPA 特征替换稠密视频 latent，序列仍过长且包含大量决策无关信息。因此需要一个既紧凑又保留想象能力的预测空间。

Result: NAVSIM v1 上 PDMS 92.6，NAVSIM v2 上 EPDMS 90.1，NavHard 39.6，推理延迟仅 164 ms，约为 DriveVA 的 1/5。

Conclusion: 稀疏 register 空间可在保留世界模型式想象推理的同时大幅降低推理成本，是高效 WAM 规划的可行方向；但验证仅限 NAVSIM 仿真基准，缺少真实车辆部署证据，代码尚未发布。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) transfer scene-dynamics priors to planning by jointly forecasting future scenes and ego trajectories. However, WAMs built on video generators must generate dense future videos at inference, incurring prohibitive latency, while efficient variants discard the world branch at deployment and thus forgo test-time imagination. Even when dense video latents are replaced with patch-level DINO or JEPA features, these representations still involve long token sequences and encode decision-irrelevant information. We therefore propose SparseWAM, which forecasts in a sparse register space of only 16 tokens per frame, compressed from frozen DINOv2 features and shaped by joint planning-and-scoring pretraining to concentrate decision-relevant information. Within this space, SparseWAM employs a modality-decoupled Mixture-of-Transformers with a causal attention mask that lets action tokens condition on imagined future registers, retaining explicit imagine-then-act reasoning at deployment. Its compactness further enables low-cost multimodal sampling. As a result, our SparseWAM achieves 92.6 PDMS on NAVSIM v1, 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, and 39.6 on NavHard at only 164 ms latency, roughly 1/5 that of DriveVA, demonstrating the efficiency of the sparse register space. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [24] [Faces or Models? Where the Age Gap in Facial Expression Recognition Comes From](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00045)
*Jessica Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Five open-source FER models on the FACES database (2,052 posed photos, 171 adults aged 19-80) lose 11.7-15.2 pp accuracy on older faces; humans lose 8.6 pp, and refitting only the final classification layer reduces the gap to ≤4 pp, implicating the output layer's training rather than the learned features.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FER systems are increasingly deployed in elder care, but their accuracy on older faces is rarely audited, creating a fairness/robustness blind spot in an application where errors matter.

Method: Cross-factor audit: 5 FER models spanning 3 architectures (ResNet-18, POSTER++, QCS) × 2 training sets (RAF-DB, AffectNet), evaluated on FACES aged 19-80. Controls for age-related geometry (geometric-only classifier), image quality, cropping, and expression intensity; diagnostic linear-probe style refit of the final layer on older faces.

Result: Consistent age-linked accuracy loss of 11.7-15.2 pp across all models; humans 8.6 pp, geometry-only 8.3 pp; AffectNet models mislabel older neutral faces as sad/angry 62% of the time, RAF-DB models lose fear/disgust/anger; refitting the final layer shrinks the gap from 11-21 pp to ≤4 pp.

Conclusion: Penetration gap persists after controlling for architecture, data source, and image factors, and is largely attributable to the trained classifier head; the backbone features already encode older-face expression identity, so lightweight head adaptation or age-balanced head training is a viable mitigation.

Abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) systems are increasingly used in elder care, yet their accuracy on older faces is rarely measured. This study evaluated five open-source FER models on the FACES database, which holds 2,052 posed photographs of 171 adults aged 19 to 80. The models cross three architectures (ResNet-18, POSTER++ and QCS) with two training datasets (RAF-DB and AffectNet). All models lost accuracy on older faces by 11.7 to 15.2 percentage points. Older faces were harder for people too: human raters lost 8.6 points, a classifier using only facial geometry lost 8.3, and for anger, fear, and happiness older adults differed more from one another when posing. On specific expressions the models fell much further than people did. AffectNet-trained models misread older neutral faces as sad or angry 62% of the time. RAF-DB-trained models lost fear, disgust, and anger instead. The gap persisted after controlling for architecture, image quality, cropping, and expression intensity. When only the final classification layer was refitted on older faces, the gap shrank from 11 to 21 points to 4 points or less, suggesting that the models' learned features can represent older faces and that the deficit lies in how the final layer was trained.

</details>


### [25] [Circumpolar Wall-to-Wall Detection of Retrogressive Thaw Slumps with Scarce Labels and Extreme Class Imbalance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00046)
*Yili Yang,Heidi Rodenhizer,Robb Young,Brendan M. Rogers,Marlena Bartkus,Stefano Potter,Greg Fiske,Scott Zolkos,Wenwen Li,Chia-Yu Hsu,Luigi Marini,Todd C. Nicholson,Benjamin C. Maglio,Jennifer Watts,Anna Liljedahl,Susan M. Natali*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用深度学习在4116万张PlanetScope影像瓦片上绘制环北极多年冻土区融冻滑塌（RTS）分布图，并将其作为稀有目标检测问题系统评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTS是多年冻土退化中最剧烈的地表形变之一，其突变融化可能使冻土融化对气候变暖的贡献近乎翻倍，且已威胁北极三分之一的基础设施；现有环北极RTS清单仅覆盖部分冻土区，而RTS仅占影像瓦片的0.1–0.5%、标注成本高，需按稀有目标范式设计并评估检测器。

Method: 构建深度学习检测系统：训练用22,259个瓦片（其中1,718个含2,609个RTS实例），通过172组受控实验调参；对比卷积网络与多模态融合、基础模型编码器、掩码自编码器预训练等方案；提出针对稀有目标的评测协议，在真实先验0.1–0.5%下用留出生态区做单次测试。

Result: 卷积网络在所有对比方案中表现最佳（其他方案算力更高但效果相当或更差）；标注数据对性能提升最大，基础模型优势仅在标签稀缺时显现。留出生态区测试PR-AUC为0.812–0.855，目标精度0.854、F1 0.644；全域部署产出19,068个高置信检测，按尺寸类别的抽样精度为0.54–0.90。

Conclusion: 给出了稀有目标检测的评测协议、标签稀缺条件下精度决定因素的受控分析，以及经检验模型生成的环北极RTS地图。

Abstract: Retrogressive thaw slumps (RTS) are among the most dynamic ground deformations caused by permafrost thaw. Abrupt thaw processes such as RTS could roughly double the contribution of permafrost thaw to climate warming, and already threaten a third of Arctic infrastructure. Circumpolar RTS mapping has advanced quickly, yet released inventories together cover only part of the permafrost region. RTS occupy only 0.1-0.5% of image tiles and labels are costly, so a detector must be designed and evaluated as a rare-target problem. We therefore developed a deep learning system and mapped 20.68 M square kilometres of circumpolar permafrost using 41.6 M tiles of 4.8 m PlanetScope imagery. Training used 22,259 tiles with 2,609 RTS instances in 1,718 of them, and the model was tuned through 172 controlled experiments. A convolutional network matched every alternative tested, including multimodal fusion, foundation-model encoders and masked-autoencoder pretraining, each at far more compute for similar or worse results. Labelled data moved performance most, and a foundation model's advantage appeared only when labels were scarce. Tested once on held-out ecoregions at the real-world prevalence of 0.1-0.5%, the final model achieved an area under the precision-recall curve of 0.812-0.855, an object precision of 0.854 and F1 of 0.644. Deployed wall-to-wall, the model produced a circumpolar map of 19,068 high-confidence detections whose sampled precision ranges from 0.54 to 0.90 by size class. We present an evaluation protocol for rare targets, a controlled account of what governs accuracy under scarce labels, and the circumpolar RTS map the validated model produced.

</details>


### [26] [TopoMix: Continuous Spatial Mixing for Long-Tailed Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00047)
*Yefan Wang,Yusen Wu,Zihui Ling,Jianyuan Ni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TopoMix：一种免训练的数据增强方法，用低分辨率随机控制网格+双三次插值+随机非线性整形生成平滑空间变化的掩码，实现逐像素的连续空间混合与标签重加权，用于长尾识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Mix的增强（Mixup、CutMix等）采用固定全局混合比例或硬性空间替换，缺乏局部变化空间；在长尾识别中少数类对增强样本质量尤为敏感，这种刚性混合成为明显瓶颈。

Method: TopoMix为training-free方法：(1) 由低分辨率随机控制网格经双三次插值上采样，得到空间平滑的随机场；(2) 施加随机非线性整形（如sigmoid/幂次等）调整掩码分布；(3) 用该连续掩码对两幅图像逐元素混合，并按掩码权重对标签做连续重加权。不引入可训练参数或辅助网络。

Result: 在标准长尾识别基准上，相较代表性mix-based基线（Mixup、CutMix类）取得一致性提升，验证平滑空间混合的有效性。

Conclusion: 平滑的连续空间混合是长尾识别中一种简单有效的增强策略；空间自适应的软掩码比全局固定比例或硬替换更灵活，且无需额外训练成本。

Abstract: Most mixing-based augmentation methods improve generalization through a simple idea: combine two training samples with a fixed global ratio or a hard spatial replacement. While effective, this design leaves little room for local variation, which becomes a more visible limitation in long-tailed recognition, where minority classes are especially sensitive to the quality of augmented samples. We propose TopoMix, a training-free augmentation method that replaces fixed mixing with continuous spatial mixing. TopoMix constructs a smooth spatially varying mask from a low-resolution random control grid, bicubic interpolation, and stochastic non-linear shaping, and uses this mask for element-wise image mixing and label reweighting. Without introducing trainable parameters or auxiliary networks, TopoMix offers a simple way to make mixing more flexible in the input space. Experiments on standard long-tailed benchmarks show that it consistently improves over representative mixing-based baselines, indicating that smooth spatial mixing is an effective augmentation strategy for long-tailed recognition.

</details>


### [27] [Keyframes First, Motion Second: Revisiting Compressed-Domain Video Captioning under Limited Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00048)
*Asok B K,Ashim Nepal,Loknath Regmi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在固定SigLIP 2关键帧编码器与GPT-2解码器的受控实验中，从零训练的运动编码器（CoCap式动作token）对压缩域视频描述无可测收益；改用预训练运动模型也仅在关键帧冻结时带来不显著的约+1.3 CIDEr；而微调SigLIP 2的attention-pooling头可提升5.4 CIDEr，且解码仅需7.3 ms（对比44-114 ms）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 压缩域视频描述器（如CoCap）需额外训练运动/残差编码器来读取H.264运动矢量和残差，这在边缘设备上带来解码耗时与监督成本。作者希望厘清在监督有限的情况下，运动分支是否值得付出这些成本。

Method: 控制变量研究：在2,500条VATEX训练片段上固定冻结的SigLIP 2关键帧编码器、GPT-2描述解码器与训练计划，仅改变解码器接收的视觉token（34种配置），共3个随机种子，报告留出测试集CIDEr并配以配对bootstrap置信区间；对比从零训练的运动编码器、以48倍描述样本预训练模型热启动的运动分支，以及微调SigLIP 2注意力池化头；并在MSVD全集及CoCap自身视频编码设置下复验。

Result: 从零训练的运动编码器无显著收益：CoCap式动作token使CIDEr变化-0.55（95% CI [-2.3, +1.2]），其余六种运动用法同样无收益；热启动版本平均+1.3 CIDEr但跨种子不显著，且仅当关键帧token保持冻结时成立。微调SigLIP 2注意力池化头增加5.4 CIDEr，1-8个该token在每个种子上均优于16个CoCap式token，仅解码I帧耗时7.3 ms而非44-114 ms。MSVD上读出方案领先14.2 CIDEr，动作token无可靠增益，即使使用干净的单参考运动矢量亦然。

Conclusion: 在监督有限条件下，压缩域视频描述应优先提升关键帧读出（微调视觉编码器池化头），运动信息的边际收益小且不稳定；"关键帧优先、运动其次"是更高效的资源分配原则。

Abstract: Compressed-domain video captioners such as CoCap read the H.264 bitstream directly: a pretrained encoder reads the keyframes (I-frames), while motion and residual encoders, trained from scratch, turn the codec's motion vectors and residuals into action tokens. This motion branch costs decoding time and supervision, both scarce on edge devices. We ask when it pays off under limited supervision. In a controlled study on 2,500 VATEX training clips, we fix a frozen SigLIP 2 keyframe encoder, a GPT-2 caption decoder and the training schedule, vary only the visual tokens the decoder receives (34 configurations), and report held-out test CIDEr with paired bootstrap intervals and three seeds. Motion encoders trained from scratch bring no measurable benefit: CoCap-style action tokens change CIDEr by -0.55 (95% CI [-2.3, +1.2]), and six other uses of motion do not help. Warm-started from a model trained on 48x the caption samples, they add +1.3 CIDEr on average, though not significantly across seeds, and only while the keyframe tokens stay frozen. Reading the keyframes better matters more: fine-tuning SigLIP 2's own attention-pooling head adds 5.4 CIDEr, and one to eight such tokens beat the 16 CoCap-style tokens on every seed while decoding only I-frames (7.3 ms instead of 44-114 ms per clip). The same holds on MSVD's full split in CoCap's own video encoding, where the readout leads by 14.2 CIDEr and action tokens bring no reliable gain, also with clean single-reference motion vectors. Under limited supervision, keyframes come first and motion second.

</details>

*Majed Molhi,Nishi Gupta,Ali Algumaei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 


<details>

Motivation:

Abstract: Plant disease detection using deep learning has achieved remarkable accuracies exceeding 99% on benchmark datasets. However, these metrics may mask a critical vulnerability: models may be taking advantage of false background correlations instead of learning real pathological features. This study presents a systematic investigation of background bias in plant disease detection through a two-stage training framework with quantitative validation. We propose a three-condition evaluation protocol testing models on original, leaf-only, and background-only images to directly measure background dependency. Our approach combines standard transfer learning using EfficientNet-B0 and manipulation of background information during optimization. Experimental results on the PlantVillage dataset (20,638 images, 15 disease classes) show that while our model achieves 98.97% accuracy on the original images and maintains 96.62% accuracy on leaf-only images, the performance drops to 23.58% on background-only images. The calculated background bias (BBC) coefficient of 0.762 indicates that a large part of the model's predictive performance depends on leaf-related features rather than background distortions. This research offers clear evidence that even with the most advanced models, environmental shortcuts can be leveraged, and this highlights the importance of bias evaluation. The approach that has been used has laid a foundation for the development of agricultural AI that is ready for deployment. The implementation, models, and evaluation process are all publicly available.

</details>


### [29] [ReactionBench: A Human-Anchored Benchmark for Modeling Reactions to Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00050)
*Yibo Zhao,Ao Qu,Xuan Jiang,Jiahao Xu,Keane Ong,Hang Jiang,Zhaofeng Wu,Dingyi Zhuang,Yihong Tang,Kaichen Zhou,Jinhua Zhao,Paul Pu Liang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReactionBench：面向"观看者反应"的多模态视频理解基准，评估反应强度排序、反应-刺激时间对齐匹配、反应归因解释三项能力，7个多模态模型表现均不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频基准多评估事件、时序推理或视频中的人物，而情感/观众反应数据集多聚焦情绪标签、聚合统计或仅从刺激本身做预测；核心问题——多模态模型能否将观察到的观看者反应锚定到对应刺激语境——尚未被系统评估。

Method: 构建同步的刺激-反应片段候选池（31,834条，433小时，8个领域），人工标注14,894条评分覆盖3,257个时刻；冻结评测集包含250个强度画像、112个匹配题、200个理由题及447条盲写人类参考，从强度排序、时间对齐匹配、线索解释三方面评测7个多模态模型。

Result: 反应特定grounding仍具挑战：四选一刺激-反应匹配最佳模型仅50.9%；GPT-5在"反应替换"扰动下无可检测性能下降；结果对评测协议敏感。

Conclusion: 反应中心视频理解是开放难题，现有模型缺乏真正的反应-刺激因果grounding能力；基准设计与评测协议需谨慎，为后续多模态人本视频理解研究提供诊断工具。

Abstract: Understanding what happens in a video is not sufficient for socially responsive multimodal systems: such systems also aim to relate what a person observes to how that person responds. Existing video benchmarks largely evaluate events, temporal reasoning, or people depicted in the video, while affective and viewer-response datasets often focus on emotion labels, aggregate responses, or prediction from the stimulus alone. This leaves an underexplored question: can current multimodal models ground an observed viewer reaction in the stimulus context associated with it? We introduce ReactionBench, a human-anchored benchmark for reaction-specific video understanding. Built from a candidate pool of 31,834 synchronized stimulus-reaction clips spanning 433 hours and eight domains, ReactionBench evaluates three complementary abilities: ranking the intensity of a viewer's reactions within a video, matching a reaction to its temporally aligned stimulus, and explaining the concrete stimulus cues linked to that reaction. Human annotation provides 14,894 ratings over 3,257 moments, and the frozen evaluation comprises 250 intensity profiles, 112 matching items, and 200 rationale items with 447 blind-written human references. Across seven multimodal models, reaction-specific grounding remains challenging: the best model reaches 50.9% accuracy on four-way stimulus-reaction matching, while GPT-5 shows no detectable loss under reaction substitution. Performance is also sensitive to evaluation protocol. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [30] [SIMIT: Self-Improving Vision-Language Models via Imagination at Test-Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00053)
*Mehmet Onurcan Kaya,Desmond Elliott,Dim P. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SIMIT：测试时自我改进框架，VLM先指定答案再生成对应图像，合成(问题,答案,图像)三元组作为自建训练数据，经多阶段验证与难度过滤后用于in-context或权重微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时方法要么只增加推理/采样而不改模型，要么用多数投票或自评判作为奖励更新模型，容易强化已有错误。目标是无需标注与外部模型地提升特定测试集性能。

Method: 答案先行生成：先指定答案再实现对应图像，配合原生图像生成+可扩展技能库（文档、图表、示意图）；多阶段验证确保图像支持其答案；难度过滤保留有信息量样本；自适应预算按模型置信度给低置信查询分配更多样本。产物支持SIMIT-ICL（in-context）与SIMIT-FT（in-weight）两种用法。

Result: 17个多模态基准上优于现有自改进方法；最佳配置较BAGEL-7B平均相对提升+7.20%，无训练的SIMIT-ICL达+6.98%。

Conclusion: 以"可控答案的自合成多模态练习数据"替代不可靠自奖励，是提升测试时自改进的有效范式；但目前为通用VLM基准评测，缺乏具身/机器人场景验证。

Abstract: We introduce SIMIT, a test-time self-improvement framework in which a vision-language model creates its own query-specific training data before answering an unlabeled test query. Our goal is to improve performance on a given target test set without annotations or external models. To pursue this goal, some test-time methods improve answers through longer reasoning or repeated sampling but leave the model unchanged. Others update the model using rewards based on majority agreement among multiple candidate answers or the model's own judgments of correctness, but such rewards can reinforce existing mistakes. SIMIT instead imagines similar problems whose solutions it controls: a model need not correctly solve the target query to construct useful practice examples. It synthesizes diverse (question, answer, image) triplets by specifying each answer before realizing its image. To support diverse multimodal tasks, SIMIT combines native image generation with an extensible skill library for structured visuals, including documents, charts, and diagrams. Within this pipeline, multi-stage verification checks that images support their assigned answers, while difficulty filtering retains informative examples. Adaptive budgeting further targets this practice by allocating more samples to queries the model is less confident in answering. The resulting data can improve the model in-context (SIMIT-ICL) or in-weight (SIMIT-FT). Across 17 diverse benchmarks, SIMIT outperforms existing self-improvement methods. Its best configuration achieves a +7.20% mean relative gain over BAGEL-7B, while training-free SIMIT-ICL achieves +6.98%.

</details>


### [31] [Auditing GeoFM Evaluation for Field-Extent Segmentation: Label Proxies, Baselines, and When Frozen Features Match Fine-tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00054)
*Santosh Pant*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究用同一批 Sentinel-2 单期影像，系统检验 GeoFM 农田地块分割基准中“标签代理”与“基线选择”对结论的影响，发现用 ESA WorldCover 替代地块标签会显著抬高 RF 的 AUROC，且冻结解码器在许多情况下不劣于全量微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有农业地块范围分割的遥测基础模型基准通常使用耕地覆盖度代理标签，并与逐像素光谱基线比较，但这些实验设计选择可能扭曲对 GeoFM 性能的结论。作者希望量化这些选择带来的偏差，并检验冻结骨干 vs. 全量微调的常见假设。

Method: 固定同一批单期 Sentinel-2 像素（六国）；对比多边形地块标签与 ESA WorldCover 耕地标签下随机森林的表现；以真实地块标签评估从零训练的 U-Net 与 Prithvi 冻结线性探针；再用相同解码器对 Prithvi 与 TerraMind 做冻结骨干 vs. 全量微调对比，10 个配对随机种子，采用 TOST 等效性检验（ε=0.02 AUROC），并构建 30 组跨区域迁移矩阵。

Result: 代理标签使 RF AUROC 由 0.55–0.82 升至 0.79–0.96；真实标签下 U-Net 达 0.89–0.98 AUROC，在 6 个区域中 5 个点估计 AUROC 高于 Prithvi 冻结线性探针；12 个 region×model 单元中 9 个在 ε=0.02 下 TOST 等效；肯尼亚为共同失败案例（正样本约占 0.1% 像素），全量微调更优；跨区域迁移中 U-Net 在 AUROC/AP 上领先整个 30 组矩阵；剔除肯尼亚后冻结解码器反超微调版本，且冻结 TerraMind 与 U-Net 无显著 AUROC 差异；Prithvi 冻结解码器参数量约为全量微调的 1/110。

Conclusion: 在解释 GeoFM 排序前应先审计标签与基线；不应默认全量微调优于冻结解码器。结论仅限单期、逐像素地块范围分割，不涉及地块边界或实例级勾绘。

Abstract: Geospatial foundation-model (GeoFM) benchmarks for agricultural field-extent segmentation often rely on cropland land-cover proxies and compare against per-pixel spectral baselines. We measure how these choices affect conclusions using identical single-date Sentinel-2 pixels from six countries. Replacing polygon-derived field labels with ESA WorldCover cropland raises random-forest AUROC from 0.55-0.82 to 0.79-0.96, showing that the proxy creates a more spectrally separable task. On the actual field-extent labels, a from-scratch U-Net reaches 0.89-0.98 AUROC and has higher point AUROC than a Prithvi frozen linear probe in five of six regions. We then compare a frozen backbone and full fine-tuning using the same decoder for Prithvi and TerraMind, with ten matched seeds. At $\varepsilon=0.02$ AUROC, 9 of 12 region$\times$model cells are TOST-equivalent. Kenya is the common failure case: positives cover roughly 0.1% of pixels, and full fine-tuning performs better for both models. Cross-region results are less favorable to frozen models. On AUROC and average precision (AP), the U-Net leads the full 30-transfer matrix, while an exploratory analysis excluding Kenya finds that both frozen decoders outperform their fine-tuned counterparts; no AUROC difference is detected between frozen TerraMind and the U-Net in that subset. For Prithvi, a frozen decoder trains about $110\times$ fewer parameters than full fine-tuning. These results argue for auditing labels and baselines before interpreting GeoFM rankings, and for testing a frozen decoder before assuming that full fine-tuning will help. Our conclusions are limited to single-date, per-pixel field-extent segmentation, not parcel-boundary or instance delineation.

</details>


### [32] [From Clips to Streams: A Unified Framework for Streaming Sign Language Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00055)
*Hoang Quan Dang,Xin Shen,Yanbin Liu,Xin Yu,Ling Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Streaming SLT 任务（从未裁剪连续视频中联合发现并翻译手语句段），并给出首个端到端框架 StreamSLST：基于可变形 Transformer 的并行解码，单次同时完成时序分割与翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手语翻译研究多基于预先切分好的片段，脱离真实连续沟通场景；而级联式"先分割再翻译"存在误差传播。

Method: StreamSLST：可变形 Transformer 并行解码，联合优化时序分割与翻译；句子感知滑窗采样器将长视频裁剪为可训练单元；三模态视觉-语言预训练（姿态动态与文本语义对齐）后再联合优化。

Result: 在 BOBSL、How2Sign 两个真实流式数据集及新构建的 Streaming-Phoenix-2014T、Streaming-CSL-Daily 合成基准上，持续优于匹配的级联分割-翻译流水线；分析发现联合优化学到更宽、更具翻译有效性的时序支撑，简单扩增或重标定注跨度无法复现。

Conclusion: 建立了连续手语理解的首个稳健基准，推动面向真实场景的无障碍沟通接口。

Abstract: Sign Language Translation (SLT) research has typically focused on pre-segmented clips, a constraint that disconnects models from the continuous reality of real-world communication. To bridge the gap from clips to streams, we formally define Streaming SLT, a realistic task demanding the joint discovery and translation of linguistic events from continuous, untrimmed video inputs. To address this challenge, we propose StreamSLST, the first end-to-end framework for Streaming Sign Language Segmentation and Translation via Deformable Transformer architecture. Unlike cascaded approaches that suffer from error propagation, StreamSLST employs a parallel decoding strategy to jointly optimize temporal segmentation and translation in a single pass. To enable scalable training on long-form videos, we incorporate a Sentence-aware Sliding Window Sampler that crops continuous streams into trainable units. We further design a Tri-modal Visual-Language Pretraining stage that aligns pose dynamics with textual semantics before joint optimization. To support comprehensive evaluation, we conduct experiments on two real-world streaming datasets, BOBSL and How2Sign, together with two newly constructed synthetic streaming benchmarks, Streaming-Phoenix-2014T and Streaming-CSL-Daily. The results demonstrate that StreamSLST consistently outperforms a matched cascaded segmentation-then-translation pipeline. Interestingly, our analysis reveals that joint optimization learns wider, translation-effective temporal support that simple expansion or rescaling of the annotated spans fails to reproduce. Our work establishes the first robust benchmark for continuous sign language understanding and paves the way for accessible real-world communication interfaces. The source code and data are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [33] [SemaNorm: Stain Normalization via Semantic and Morphology Alignment for Robust Cross-Hospital Computational Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00056)
*Subhankar Chattoraj,Sawon Pratiher,Arijit Ghosh,Prashant Khare,Writankar Kundu,Karan Vishwakarma,Preha Handa,Kirti Rashmi,Hubert Konik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SemaNorm：自监督染色标准化器，从强扰动输入恢复干净切片，结合冻结病理基础模型一致性损失与可微细胞核结构损失，在保持形态与语义的前提下归一化染色，OOD 准确率较最强基线提升 5.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 染色差异是计算病理域偏移的主要来源，但现有归一化方法只优化颜色一致性，未显式保持形态学与诊断语义，因此需要一个能同时保证颜色规范化、语义与细胞结构稳定的归一化方案。

Method: 提出 SemaNorm，自监督"染色规范化"：以强扰动输入重建干净切片，规避配对迁移、对抗训练不稳定与恒等坍缩；损失由冻结病理基础模型的特征一致性项与可微的细胞核结构损失项组成，以保持语义与细胞组织形态。在 Camelyon17-WILDS 与 NCT-CRC-HE-100K 上用跨医院肿瘤分类、细胞图形态指标及独立留出基础编码器度量语义稳定性进行评估。

Result: OOD 准确率较最强归一化基线提升 5.9%、较无归一化提升 13.5%，并获得最佳形态保持；独立基础模型与细胞图分析进一步确认语义与结构稳定性提升。

Conclusion: 以形态与语义为约束的优化是"仅颜色"染色归一化的有原则替代方案，强调目标函数设计而非仅颜色统计对齐。

Abstract: Stain variability remains a major source of domain shift in computational pathology, yet existing normalization methods largely optimize color consistency without explicitly preserving morphology or diagnostic semantics. We propose SemaNorm, a self-supervised stain canonicalization stain normalizer to recover clean patches from strongly perturbed inputs, avoiding paired transfer, adversarial instability, and identity collapse. It further combines a frozen pathology foundation-model consistency loss with a differentiable nuclei-structure loss to preserve semantic and cellular organization. SemaNorm is evaluated across Camelyon17-WILDS and NCT-CRC-HE-100K using cross-hospital tumor classification, cell-graph morphology metrics, and semantic stability measured with an independent held-out foundation encoder. SemaNorm improves out-of-distribution accuracy by 5.9% over the strongest normalization baseline and by 13.5% over no normalization, while achieving the best morphology preservation. Independent foundation-model and cell-graph analyses further confirm improved semantic and structural stability. These results establish morphology- and semantics-aware optimization as a principled alternative to color-only stain normalization.

</details>


### [34] [CausalPrune: Counterfactual Causal Token Pruning for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00058)
*Pengcheng Zheng,Chaoning Zhang,Ya Wen,Jiaxin Huang,Jiaquan Zhang,Caiyan Qin,Kuien Liu,Sheng Zheng,Pietro Liò,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CausalPrune：将LVLM推理建模为结构因果模型，提出反事实因果token重要性分数CTIS（一阶近似+后门调整），并用逐层因果中介分解实现渐进式视觉token剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM过多的视觉token带来大量计算开销，现有视觉token剪枝方法基于相关性统计估计token重要性，无法区分真正因果决定输出的token与仅虚假相关的token。

Method: 将LVLM推理表述为结构因果模型（SCM），定义CTIS为对每个视觉token施加干预的平均处理效应（ATE）；推导CTIS的高效一阶近似以降低计算成本；引入后门调整以缓解潜在跨模态混杂；利用逐层因果中介分析将token重要性分解为直接与间接效应，实现跨Transformer层的渐进剪枝。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2.5-VL等多种架构上实验，多模态性能相当甚至更优，同时显著降低FLOPs与prefill延迟，一致优于现有剪枝方法。

Conclusion: 因果/反事实视角为token重要性估计提供了比相关性统计更有原则的框架，可作为LVLM推理加速的通用插件式方案。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal understanding, but their practical deployment is still limited by the substantial computation introduced by excessive visual tokens. Visual token pruning offers an effective solution by removing redundant visual tokens during inference. However, existing methods typically estimate token importance from correlational statistics, which cannot distinguish tokens that causally determine the model output from those spuriously associated with it. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{CausalPrune}, a counterfactual causal token pruning framework for efficient LVLMs. We formulate LVLM inference as a Structural Causal Model and introduce the Causal Token Importance Score (CTIS), which estimates the Average Treatment Effect of intervening on each visual token. To make causal estimation practical, we derive an efficient first-order approximation of CTIS and incorporate backdoor adjustment to mitigate latent cross-modal confounding. Within this causal formulation, layer-wise causal mediation decomposes token importance into direct and indirect effects through intermediate hidden states, enabling progressive pruning across transformer layers in a principled manner. Extensive experiments on various LVLM architectures, such as LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL, demonstrate that CausalPrune maintains comparable or even superior multimodal performance while achieving substantial reductions in FLOPs and prefill latency, consistently outperforming existing pruning methods.

</details>


### [35] [Not All Minorities Are Equal: Fairness Outcomes in Private Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00059)
*Cohen Archbold,Usman Hassan,Sen-ching Samson Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究隐私保护训练（差分隐私DP）对生成式人脸模型群体公平性的影响：更强隐私会不成比例地降低部分弱势群体的生成质量，但该效应无法仅用数据表示比例解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DP在AI系统中提供了形式化隐私保障，但其对生成模型公平性的影响尚不清楚，需要明确隐私与公平之间的权衡关系。

Method: 在两个人脸图像数据集、多档隐私预算（DP强度）下训练生成模型，量化比较不同人群属性组与视觉属性在生成质量与可用性上的退化程度，并检验退化是否与群体在训练数据中的表示比例相关。

Result: 更强隐私对若干弱势群体的质量/可用性退化更为严重，说明隐私可能放大既有差异；然而表示充分的部分属性同样显著退化，而部分低表示属性相对稳健，表明表示比例不能单独解释效应。

Conclusion: 隐私保护学习的影响取决于所学信息的特性及其交互，而非仅由数据表示决定；评估生成模型时需同时考虑隐私与公平。

Abstract: Differential privacy (DP) provides formal guarantees for protecting individuals in artificial intelligence systems, but its consequences for fairness in generative models remain poorly understood. We investigate how privacy-preserving training affects the representation of demographic groups and visual attributes in generative models of human faces. Across two facial image datasets and multiple privacy levels, we find that stronger privacy can disproportionately degrade the quality and utility of some underrepresented groups, suggesting that privacy can amplify existing disparities. However, representation alone does not explain these effects: several well-represented attributes also experience substantial degradation, while some underrepresented attributes remain comparatively robust. These findings show that the impact of privacy-preserving learning cannot be explained solely by data representation and may depend on the characteristics and interactions of the information being learned. Our results highlight the need to consider both privacy and fairness when evaluating generative models.

</details>


### [36] [DDEL: Closed-Loop Mutual Enhancement of Dataset Distillation and Ensemble Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00061)
*Weiqi Zhang,Yongquan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DDEL框架，将集成学习（EL）行为反馈进数据集蒸馏（DD）闭环，用同质三模型集成在源数据上的损失与预测分歧指导下一轮数据更新，并在三个医学数据集上做初步验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集蒸馏与集成学习通常串联使用：蒸馏出的子集在整个集成学习期间固定不变，无法依据集成的实际学习行为调整蒸馏数据。作者希望让集成训练结果反向指导蒸馏数据更新。

Method: DDEL闭环框架：每轮先训练集成模型，在源数据上测量损失与预测分歧等信号，再用这些信号指导下一轮蒸馏数据更新；具体实现采用分布匹配（distribution matching）加同质三成员集成，并在相同"每类图像预算"下与开环基线对比。

Result: 在ISIC 2019、I-SPY1、NSCLC-Radiomics三个医学任务上：ISIC平衡准确率0.3471；I-SPY1平均ROC-AUC 0.5120；NSCLC平均ROC-AUC 0.5597。I-SPY1与开环基线差异很小，ISIC结果显示增加轮数并不稳定提升性能。

Conclusion: 初步结果表明DD-EL反馈值得进一步研究，但增益有限且不稳定；计算开销与鲁棒性仍缺乏受控评估，医学小样本场景下的实际价值尚未证实。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) reduces a training set to a small set of examples, while ensemble learning (EL) combines predictions from several models. When applied in sequence, the distilled set remains fixed as the ensemble learns. We introduce DDEL, a framework that feeds ensemble behavior back into distillation. Each round trains the ensemble, measures loss and prediction disagreement on the source data, and uses these signals to guide the next data update. We implement this loop with distribution matching and a homogeneous three-member ensemble. Preliminary experiments cover skin lesion classification (ISIC 2019), treatment-response prediction (I-SPY1), and binary two-year prognosis classification (NSCLC-Radiomics). With the same images-per-class budget as the open-loop comparison, DDEL reaches balanced accuracy 0.3471 on ISIC and mean ROC-AUC 0.5120 and 0.5597 on I-SPY1 and NSCLC. The I-SPY1 difference is small, and the ISIC trajectory shows that more rounds do not consistently improve performance. These results offer initial evidence for studying DD-EL feedback, with its computational cost and robustness still requiring controlled evaluation.

</details>


### [37] [CarDiff: Anatomically Aware Dental Caries Synthesis using Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00062)
*Sanyam Jain,Bruna Neves de Freitas,Alexandros Iosifidis,Ruben Pauwels*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CarDiff：半监督扩散框架用于全景牙片龋齿合成，结合配对掩码-图像学习、增强掩码自监督生成与解剖学感知条件，并以分割引导监督和对抗式解剖对齐保证语义一致；MLUA-DC1000 上 FID 90.76、LPIPS 0.48，5倍增强使七种分割架构平均 Dice 最高提升 6.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 牙科影像标注数据稀缺，稀有龋齿类别样本不足；现有语义图像合成方法缺乏对病灶与周边解剖结构关系的建模，生成结果在解剖与语义上不一致，难以直接用于下游分割增强。

Method: 提出 CarDiff 半监督龋齿合成框架：(1) 配对掩码-图像监督学习；(2) 对增强掩码进行自监督生成，利用无标注数据；(3) 病灶区域与周围结构间的解剖学感知条件注入；(4) 语义一致性通过分割引导监督与对抗式解剖对齐实现；生成影像用于下游分割训练增强。

Result: 在 MLUA-DC1000 上，FID 90.76、LPIPS 0.48，均为对比基线中最佳；在 7 种分割架构上以 5 倍增强训练集评估，平均 Dice 最高提升 6.5%，中等与组合病灶类别增益更大。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 解剖一致的扩散式医学图像合成在有限监督下可作为有效的牙科放射影像数据增强手段，且对下游分割任务有可量化收益；但评测限于单一数据集与指标层面，尚无临床验证。

Abstract: Synthetic medical image generation can help address limited annotated data in dental imaging, particularly for under-represented caries classes. In this work, we present CarDiff, a semi-supervised framework for dental caries synthesis in panoramic radiographs. The method combines paired mask-image learning with self-supervised generation from augmented masks, while incorporating anatomy-aware conditioning between lesion regions and surrounding structures. Semantic consistency is enforced through segmentation-guided supervision and adversarial anatomical alignment. Experiments on the MLUA-DC1000 dataset show that CarDiff achieves improved synthesis quality compared with existing semantic synthesis baselines, obtaining the best Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) (90.76) and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) (0.48) scores among evaluated methods. We further assess the generated radiographs for downstream segmentation augmentation across seven architectures. Using a 5x augmented training set improves average Dice score by up to 6.5%, with larger gains observed for medium and combined lesion classes. These results suggest that anatomically consistent diffusion synthesis may be useful for dental radiograph augmentation under limited supervision. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [38] [Where Generated Floor Plans Stop: Encoding Practice Acceptance Rules to Evaluate Machine Learning Floor Plan Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00063)
*Yiliang Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将建筑事务所的户型平面验收规则编码为六项按序执行的检查（含两项校准过的房间形状上限），用于评测生成式平面图生成器；结果显示标准邻接指标（Compatibility）与实际可接受性脱节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有平面图生成器的评价主要依赖房间邻接匹配度，缺少建筑专业知识；作者希望引入来自实际生产软件的验收规则，构建更贴近实践的评估方式。

Method: 从某建筑事务所的户型排版软件中提取验收规则，编码为固定顺序的六项检查，报告每个平面在首个不通过检查处失败；对两条无规范依据的房间形状限值进行校准，使各自单独拒绝5%的建成公寓。设计"迁移规范"标注哪些检查可由公开数据承载；在四个公开生成器与RPLAN、MSD两个建成语料上评测，并做三项测量控制。

Result: 仅房间比例检查一项就拒绝House-GAN++可读可建平面的33.7%，而RPLAN仅5.0%，该差距在三种测量控制下依然存在；在5%拒绝率设定下，MSD公寓通过全部六项检查的比例比House-GAN++高5.5–23.5个百分点。邻接指标（Compatibility）得分最好的两个生成器通过率反而最低，原因在于其平面表示方式；而在通过率最高的两者中，Compatibility几乎无法预测具体哪些平面通过。

Conclusion: 该检查器揭示了标准邻接指标的盲区，并已开源；但通过检查并不等同于实践中被接受，评估有效性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Machine learning floor plan generators are proposed as aids to design decisions, yet they are judged mainly by how closely a generated plan's room adjacencies match the request, a measure without architectural knowledge. We encode an architecture practice's floor plan acceptance rules, taken from its production layout software, as six checks applied in a fixed order, report each plan at the first check it fails, and calibrate the two room-shape limits, which no building code states, so that each alone rejects 5 per cent of built apartments. A transfer specification records which checks public data can carry. Applied to four published generators and two built corpora, RPLAN and Modified Swiss Dwellings (MSD), the checks stop the generators at different points. A room proportion check alone refuses 33.7 per cent of the House-GAN++ plans the checker can read and build, against 5.0 per cent of RPLAN, a gap that survives three measurement controls. At the 5 per cent rate, MSD apartments pass all six checks 5.5 to 23.5 points more often than House-GAN++, depending on the plans counted. The two generators that score best on the adjacency measure, Compatibility, pass least, because of how they represent plans, and within the two that pass most it barely predicts which plans pass. The checks thus expose what the standard measure misses; the checker is released. Passing is not shown to mean acceptance in practice.

</details>


### [39] [OpenMidnight: Closing the Performance Gap Between Open and Proprietary Pathology Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00064)
*Ratna Sagari Grandhi,Anis Chihoub,Ryan Kim,Daniel Z. Kaplan,Chao Feng,Anish Dulal,Leema Krishna Murali,Rohitkumar Datchanamourty,Nevasini Sasikumar,Debojyoti Das,Ahmed Hassayoune,Rhizo Nymph,Anas Zafar,Connor Lane,Benjamin Warner,Hassan Muhammad,Tanishq Mathew Abraham,Paul S. Scotti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 开源复现病理基础模型 Midnight，用约1.2万张TCGA全切片、DINOv2初始化、约320 H100小时（较原版降低34倍算力）完成预训练，在THUNDER的16个分类与4个分割任务上平均分割Dice达69.7，14个模型中排名第4且超过Midnight，并公开代码、预处理流程与权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有病理基础模型依赖私有数据、算力需求高、训练代码与预处理流程不公开，导致独立验证困难、方法学发展受阻。作者希望以低成本、全开源方式复现并改进Midnight，降低可复现研究与后续开发的门槛。

Method: 仅使用公开的TCGA约12,000张WSI做病理预训练；编码器以预训练DINOv2权重初始化；预训练总算力约320 H100 GPU小时（相对Midnight报告算力减少34倍）；在THUNDER的16个分类与4个分割数据集上评估；消融考察初始化、数据规模、模型大小与组织构成对下游性能的影响；开源训练代码、预处理流水线和模型权重。

Result: 在THUNDER的20个数据集上取得最高平均分割Dice 69.7；在14个模型中综合排名第4，优于Midnight；在若干任务上性能与使用显著更大数据集训练的模型相当或更优。消融显示初始化方式、数据量、模型规模与组织分布均影响下游表现。

Conclusion: 以公开数据和大幅降低的算力可以复现并超越同类病理基础模型，且开源全部训练资源；所得经验性结论可为未来训练配方设计提供依据。

Abstract: Pathology foundation models offer transferable representations for a range of downstream tasks in computational pathology, but reliance on proprietary data, substantial compute requirements, and limited availability of training code and preprocessing pipelines hinder independent validation and further methodological development. We present OpenMidnight 1.1, an open-source replication and refinement of Midnight trained on approximately 12,000 publicly available whole-slide images from The Cancer Genome Atlas. Using an encoder initialized with pretrained DINOv2 weights, OpenMidnight 1.1 uses approximately 320 H100 GPU-hours for pathology pretraining, a 34-fold reduction relative to the compute reported for Midnight. Across 16 classification and four segmentation datasets in THUNDER, OpenMidnight 1.1 achieves the highest mean segmentation Dice (69.7) and ranks fourth among 14 models, ahead of Midnight, with performance that matches or exceeds models trained on substantially larger datasets in several tasks. Our ablation studies additionally examine how initialization, data volume, model size, and tissue composition affect downstream performance, providing empirical evidence to inform the development of future training recipes. Our release of the training code, preprocessing pipeline, and model weights lowers barriers to reproducible research and further development of competitive pathology foundation models.

</details>


### [40] [BreastXAgent: A lightweight agentic explainability framework for breast density classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00065)
*Muhammad Turab,Raja Vavekanand,Knooz Fatima*

Main category: cs.CV

Because 3D ground truth is unavailable, we evaluate both with reference-free criteria relevant to intersection analysis: pedestrian coverage, anthropometric plausibility, walking-speed distributions, computational cost, and failure modes. The two strategies exhibit complementary trade-offs. The learned pipeline is simpler to deploy and covers more pedestrians, but suffers from scale ambiguity and systematic height compression; the geometric pipeline yields metric reconstructions more efficiently, but requires calibration, discards pedestrians seen by only one camera, and can produce severe outliers in dense crowds. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Diffusion models have made high-fidelity visual generation widely accessible, while also lowering the barrier to producing convincing visual forgeries and complicating content provenance.
