Therefore, robust watermarking requires adapting both the embedding strength during denoising and the optimization priority across watermark dimensions. To address this problem, we present SAMP, a self-adaptive framework consisting of global margin regulation and vulnerability-sensitive allocation. Global margin regulation adjusts the embedding strength according to the separation between the target codeword and competing codewords, together with the estimated effects of common attacks. Vulnerability-sensitive allocation identifies watermark dimensions that are more easily weakened by local perturbations and gives them higher optimization priority. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMP achieves an average information recovery accuracy of 0.993. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, SAMP improves PSNR by 16.8% and reduces LPIPS by 47.1%. These results validate the effectiveness of SAMP for reliable and high-quality diffusion watermarking.

</details>

Abstract: Autonomous driving perception systems must maintain reliable object detection under diverse environmental conditions, not only in clear daytime scenes. However, the cross-weather robustness of modern detectors remains insufficiently characterised under source-only evaluation. This study evaluates representative object detection architectures trained exclusively on clear daytime driving scenes and tested without adaptation under unseen fog, rain, snow, and night conditions. The evaluation covers lightweight and medium-scale one-stage, two-stage, and transformer-based detectors within a unified protocol. Robustness is assessed using performance Drop (%), a Weather Robustness Index (WRI), and class-level sensitivity analysis for critical road participants, including cars, buses, trucks, and persons. Prediction confidence reliability under environmental domain shift is measured using Expected Calibration Error (ECE). Results reveal consistent performance degradation in adverse conditions, reaching 62.90% at night. Buses show the highest sensitivity to environmental variability, while cars remain comparatively stable across weather transitions. Comparisons indicate that YOLO-based detectors exhibit the lowest calibration mismatch, reflecting stronger agreement between predicted confidence and empirical detection correctness. In contrast, DETR achieves the lowest robustness score, with a WRI of 0.6859, indicating greater vulnerability to cross-weather domain shift. These findings offer deployment-oriented insights into detector robustness and confidence reliability for safety-critical intelligent vehicle perception systems.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Automated prohibited item detection in X-ray security imagery is fundamentally constrained by severe object overlap, scanner-dependent domain shifts, and spurious correlations induced by cluttered baggage composition. Existing detectors largely rely on appearance-driven supervision, limiting their robustness and cross-scanner generalisation. We introduce CRaFT-XDet, a causality-grounded and physics- motivated detection framework that reformulates X-ray threat detection as invariant representation learning under attenuation-driven modality variation. Our approach is grounded in a Scanner-Invariant Causal Detection formalisation (Theorem 1), which establishes that minimising the proposed Causal Invariance Regularisation (CIR) objective across partitioned scanner environments approximates the interventional distribution P (Y | do(Xobj)) under standard identifiability assumptions, providing a principled causal formulation for dual-energy X-ray detection. CRaFT-XDet integrates: (i) causal feature disentanglement to suppress context-induced shortcuts; (ii) physics-motivated regularisation to enforce material-consistent embeddings; and (iii) transformer-based cross-energy interaction modelling for structured reasoning in cluttered scenes. With 29.2 M parameters, 89.5 GFLOPs, and 345 FPS (1.7 ms inference), CRaFT-XDet is real-time deployable. Trained on SIXray with five-fold cross-validation, the framework achieves 0.9389 mAP@0.5 and 0.8021 mAP@0.5:0.95. Without domain adaptation, CRaFT-XDet maintains strong cross- dataset performance on OPIXray and HiXray, indicating robust generalization across heterogeneous scanner distributions. In category-agnostic binary threat detection, the model attains 93.92% recall and 0.9031 mean IoU, highlighting reliability in safety-critical screening where missed detections are costly.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Modern image classification models largely rely on local characteristics and feature extraction for their predictions. This focused approach works well in the spatial domain, but reportedly falls short in the frequency domain, even though both representations contain the same information. This study demonstrates that the significant reduction in accuracy in the frequency domain stems from the lack of local features. Locally swapping data in the frequency domain significantly decreases its inverse spatial domain accuracy, even below that of the frequency domain; however, the frequency domain accuracy remains relatively constant. Moreover, the use of datasets containing global features in the spatial domain yields higher accuracy in the frequency domain. Using these results, a hybrid model is constructed, combining one model trained only in the frequency domain and another trained only in the spatial domain to achieve higher classification accuracy. The proposed visual geometry group (VGG) and vision transformer (ViT) architectures are trained on the ImageNet-100, WikiArt, DTD, FMD, PSVRT, and KTH-TIPS2-b datasets and evaluated.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Face image quality assessment (FIQA) estimates the utility of a face image for automated face recognition and has been proposed as a morphing attack detection (MAD) signal that requires no morph-specific training. We evaluate 17 FIQA methods from all current FIQA categories on 20 morphing attack sets from two datasets, FRLL and FEI, including five diffusion-based attack sets. Each quality score is used directly as a MAD decision score. Unlike prior work, which inverted a quality measure when this lowered its error, we fix the score direction of each method in advance from its definition, so that cases in which morphs receive higher quality than bona fide samples remain visible. On FRLL, DifFIQA(R) achieves a mean D-EER of 11.42%, and together with CLIB-FIQA and eDifFIQA(L) clearly outperforms all other FIQA methods. A strong separation of bona fide and morph scores does not imply good detection performance: on the diffusion-based attacks, up to 11 of 17 methods assign higher quality to morphs than to bona fide samples, and the largest reversed separation in the study coincides with the worst detection result of the study. Performance also depends strongly on the attack: GraFIQs(L), the best detector of DCMorph and Arc2Morph on FRLL, performs poorly on the landmark-based and GAN-based attacks. On FEI, the lowest mean D-EER is 39.75%, and a threshold set on the bona fide data of one dataset does not transfer to the other.

</details>

Method: 以JSON中间表示为中枢贯穿生成全程以保留符号参数表达式；分层多智能体流程包含语义理解、参数规划、编译、渲染、自纠错与组件级验证，并利用多视角视觉反馈检测与修复几何错误。

Result: 在NopSCADlib、ABC、Slice-100K上与直接零样本基线在感知与几何质量上相当，但输出暴露的可编辑参数结构显著更多。

Conclusion: 多智能体+中间表示的自纠错范式可在零训练条件下兼顾生成质量与参数可编辑性，属于智能体驱动生成与迭代精修的典型思路。

Abstract: Text-to-CAD generation has the potential to make mechanical CAD more accessible, but existing approaches face a trade-off between data dependence and output fidelity. Supervised methods rely on large paired text-model datasets, while zero-shot prompting strategies are often brittle and tend to lose the parametric structure needed for downstream editing and customization. We present CRAFT, a corrective and robust multi-agent framework that produces parametric OpenSCAD programs from natural language without task-specific training. At its core is a JSON intermediate representation that carries symbolic parametric expressions throughout the generation process, so the resulting models remain editable and retain their parametric structure. CRAFT combines semantic understanding, parametric planning, compilation, rendering, self-correction, and component-level verification within a layered recovery process, using multi-view visual feedback to detect and repair geometric errors. Across NopSCADlib, ABC, and Slice-100K, CRAFT is competitive with direct zero-shot baselines in perceptual and geometric quality while exposing substantially more editable parametric structure.

</details>


### [49] [AegisBench: Auditing Aerial Search-and-Rescue Person Detection Under the Conditions It Is Deployed In](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00077)
*Amogh Vinaykumar,Prem Kamasani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AegisBench 在 HERIDAL 与 SARD 两个航拍搜救数据集上施加 4 类灾害共 9 种物理动机的腐蚀（每类 3 个单调递增严重度），用统一评测器在 168 种条件下评测 Faster R-CNN、YOLOv11、RT-DETR 三种检测器，阈值冻结于干净验证集。发现鲁棒性极不均衡：4.5 档曝光损失使三检测器在双数据集上召回率降为 0，且 mAP 与 3 个训练种子下结果一致，在 300 张真实夜间无人机影像上仅检出 2/759 人。错误呈"静默"形态——空帧与被遮蔽帧无法区分。轻度低光微调在留出严重度上回升 0.06–0.19 召回，但存在架构相关的跨条件代价，且不能迁移至真实夜间图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机人员检测正被应急管理部门部署用于快速搜寻失踪人员，但其依据的基准数据全部采集于平静、晴朗的白昼；真正的触发场景却是洪水、野火、风暴与夜间。这一"训练-部署分布鸿沟"缺乏系统性量化，尤其缺少对失效形态（是否会静默失败）与跨架构一致性、真实数据可迁移性的证据。

Method: 构建基准 AegisBench：从 4 个灾害族（低光、气象、模糊/噪声、空间几何类等）设计 9 种物理动机腐蚀，每族 3 级严重度，且严重度在声明的图像统计量或物理量上单调；在 HERIDAL 与 SARD 两数据集上评测架构相异的三类检测器（两阶段 Faster R-CNN、单阶段 YOLOv11、端到端 RT-DETR），由同一评测器在 168 种条件（含干净基线）下打分；置信度阈值在干净验证集上冻结以模拟实际部署；辅以无阈值 mAP、3 个训练种子复现，以及 300 张真实夜间无人机图像的验证；并实验轻度低光微调的可恢复性与负迁移。

Result: 鲁棒性高度不均。低光为极端情形：4.5 档曝光损失使三检测器在两数据集上召回恰为 0，该结论在免阈值 mAP 与 3 个训练种子下稳健，并在 300 张真实夜间图像上得到印证（759 人中仅检出 2 人）。残余检出大多仍定位在目标上，故失效是"静默"的：空帧与被看不见目标占据的帧表现相同。轻度低光微调在留出严重度上恢复 0.06–0.19 召回，但带来架构相关的其他条件退化，且不迁移到真实夜间图像。空间类腐蚀在两数据集上排序不一致，作者指出不能仅归因于飞行高度，因其参数按帧尺寸而非人体尺寸缩放。

Conclusion: 现有航拍人员检测基准严重低估了灾害/夜间场景下的失效风险，且失效以静默方式出现，对实际应急部署构成直接隐患。原文微调并非有效补救。作者以审计工具定位发布腐蚀引擎、评测流水线与逐条件结果，供第三方复现与评测；同时提示空间腐蚀的参数标定应以人体尺度而非帧尺度为基准。

Abstract: Drone-based person detection is being adopted by emergency-management agencies to find missing people faster than ground teams can. The benchmarks behind that adoption were collected in calm, clear daylight, while the missions that trigger deployment happen in floods, wildfires, storms, and at night. AegisBench measures that gap. It applies nine physically motivated corruptions from four disaster families, each at three severities monotone in a declared image statistic or physical quantity, to two aerial search-and-rescue datasets, HERIDAL and SARD. Three architecturally distinct detectors (Faster R-CNN, YOLOv11, RT-DETR) are scored across 168 conditions by one shared evaluator, at confidence thresholds frozen on clean validation data as a fielded system would run. Robustness is highly uneven. Low light is the extreme case: a 4.5-stop exposure loss drives recall to exactly zero for all three detectors on both datasets, a result that holds under threshold-free mAP and across three training seeds, and is mirrored on 300 real night drone images, where 2 of 759 people are found. Surviving detections largely stay on target, so the failure is silent: an empty frame looks the same as one whose occupants the system cannot see. Fine-tuning on milder low-light levels recovers 0.06 to 0.19 recall at the held-out severity, at an architecture-dependent cost on other conditions, and does not transfer to real night imagery. Spatial corruptions rank differently on the two datasets, which we cannot attribute to altitude alone because their parameters scale with frame size rather than person size. We release the corruption engine, evaluation pipeline, and all per-condition results as an audit instrument for anyone evaluating these systems.

</details>


### [50] [From Zero to OCR: A Data-Centric Framework for Unsupported Low-Resource Scripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00078)
*Faizan Iqbal,Haq Nawaz Malik,Hafsah Pervaiz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以数据为中心的框架，仅用无标注文本语料与数字字体即可为低资源文字（如克什米尔语 Nastaliq）构建端到端OCR：合成数据引擎渲染词/行/页并自动生成标签，YOLOv8检测词框、CRNN+CTC识别，配分阶段评估协议。合成词CER 0.39%，合成页10.0%，浏览器渲染页13.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源文字缺乏标注文档图像，且现成OCR引擎（六种主流引擎均不支持克什米尔语）无法覆盖；此前的行级识别CER高达41%–79%，需要可行的无标注构建路径。

Method: 纯合成数据管线：字体渲染保证复杂文字成形正确、标签自动派生；YOLOv8词级检测 + CRNN+CTC识别；阶段门控评估将识别误差与检测误差解耦；关键改进为渲染保真度、保留变音符号的裁剪边距与调优NMS。

Result: 合成留出词CER 0.39%；合成页10.0%；浏览器渲染数字页13.5%；排印书籍页参考值18.45%，退化历史文献49.8%。发布模型、推理代码及285,864幅合成克什米尔语文本行数据。

Conclusion: 证明零人工标注、纯字体合成即可为无支持文字搭建可用端到端OCR，并给出可复用的分步建设流程；主要收益来自渲染保真与后处理细节而非模型结构。

Abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) remains inaccessible to many low-resource scripts because annotated document images are unavailable and synthetic training data can fail to preserve script-specific visual structure. We present a data-centric framework that builds end-to-end OCR for such scripts from only an unannotated text corpus and digital fonts, without manually annotating a single training image. A synthetic data engine renders word, line and page images with correct complex-script shaping and automatically derived labels; a YOLOv8 word detector and a convolutional recurrent recognizer trained with connectionist temporal classification learn from these images; and a stage-gate evaluation protocol isolates recognition error before detection is introduced. We demonstrate the framework on Kashmiri, a Perso-Arabic Nastaliq script with approximately 6.8 million speakers that none of six widely used OCR engines supports. Three line-level recognizers, including one transferred from Arabic, stalled between 41% and 79% character error rate (CER), motivating a word-level formulation; subsequent improvements came primarily from rendering fidelity, diacritic-preserving crop margins and tuned non-maximum suppression. The resulting system achieves 0.39% CER on held-out words, 10.0% on synthetic pages and 13.5% on browser-rendered digital pages, and establishes reference results of 18.45% on typeset book pages and 49.8% on degraded historical documents. We publicly release the trained models, the inference code and a synthetic dataset of 285,864 Kashmiri text-line images, and we describe a step-by-step procedure for building OCR for other unsupported scripts.

</details>


### [51] [Faithful Where You Look: Anchor-Based Evaluation Hides Text Fabrication in Image-Conditioned Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00079)
*Yujia Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文在48张东京街面参考图上测试4个图像条件视频模型，显示现有以"锚点"（标注招牌）评估文本保真的基准会掩盖主要失败：模型在锚点上接近无模型对照（0.90–0.94 vs 0.996），而周边区域36–54%的生成文本在参考中无对应（对照仅1.6%）；双盲评分者一致性kappa=0.83–0.96，VBench-I2V的参考一致性分数未能捕捉该现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像条件视频模型被用于呈现真实地点，"输出是否忠实于所示地点"是实际关切。现有文本保真基准只在锚点（标注区域，通常是任务相关的招牌）上评测，作者认为这一评测选择掩盖了大部分失败，因此需要检验锚点之外的周边区域文本是否被虚构。

Method: 以48张东京街面店铺参考图为条件，测试来自3家厂商的4个模型。分别在标注锚点和周边区域测量文本保真度，并统计生成文本区域中在参考里无对应的比例（虚构率），设无模型对照。使用两名盲评者对哪些区域属虚构进行标注并计算kappa一致性；在两家中立厂商视频上做预注册复核；对比VBench-I2V参考一致性分数；并在伦敦做拉丁字母场景的预注册复现（两轮：首轮未达标、独立第二轮达标）。

Result: 锚点处4个模型的文本保真为0.90–0.94，对照为0.996，模型间无法可靠区分。周边区域中36–54%的生成文本区域在参考中无对应（对照1.6%），尽管所有提示词均禁止新增可读文本。盲评者一致性kappa=0.83–0.96；在两家中立厂商上复现为42%和56%；VBench-I2V参考一致性分数在本样本中未显示能追踪该失败。多数虚构文本为"似可读"文本，位于参考无文本或不可辨处——字符串匹配类指标会将其丢弃，作者的初始指标也因此漏检。伦敦拉丁字母复现首轮未达标、第二轮达标。

Conclusion: 锚点式文本保真评测系统性低估了图像条件视频模型的地点不忠实：虚构文本主要存在于周边、以不可被字符串匹配捕捉的"似可读"形式出现。作者发布代码、标注、逐视频分数、评分与全部预注册，为视频生成的地点保真评测提供更严格的协议。

Abstract: Image-conditioned video models are used to show real places, so whether their output stays faithful to the place they were shown is a practical question. The text benchmarks we found that check fidelity against a reference do so at an anchor - an annotated region, typically the sign the task is about. We show that this choice hides most of the failure. We conditioned four models from three vendors on 48 street-level references of Tokyo storefronts and measured text fidelity at the annotated sign and in the periphery, the other text the reference covers. At the anchor, all four models are close to a no-model control (anchor text fidelity 0.90-0.94 against 0.996) and are not reliably separated from one another. In the periphery, 36-54% of generated text regions have no counterpart in the reference, against 1.6% for the control, although every prompt forbade new readable text. Two blinded raters agree on which regions are fabricated (kappa = 0.83-0.96), the result held in preregistered rounds on two vendors whose videos the measure had never seen (42% and 56%), and VBench-I2V's reference-based consistency scores show no evidence of tracking it in our sample. Most fabricated text is legible-looking text where the reference shows none or cannot be read - a form that string-matching metrics discard, which is why our own first measure missed it. A preregistered Latin-script replication in London missed its bar in a first round and met it in an independent second round. We release code, annotations, per-video scores, ratings and every preregistration. Code and data: this https URL

</details>

*Ropkathaa Choudhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用轻量MobileNetV2+CBAM在核桃→腰果→咖啡→芒果上做序贯迁移，再在六作物基准ABCGMP上验证，测试迁移后精度提升但异质多作物下存在性能上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证已学得的病害识别表示能否在多种多年生作物域之间渐进复用，并刻画随目标域异质性上升预测行为的变化。

Method: MobileNetV2 + CBAM 注意力模块；核桃基线加权后序贯迁移至腰果、咖啡、芒果，每阶段复用前一模型表示并在独立测试集上评估；最后在ABCGMP六作物异质基准上验证。

Conclusion: 序贯迁移可保留显著预测能力，但多作物异质性带来可测量的性能约束；贡献为跨作物域序贯知识复用的经验性刻画，属领域CV（农业）应用研究。

Abstract: Purpose: This study investigates whether a learned disease-recognition representation can be progressively reused across distinct perennial crop domains and how its predictive behaviour changes as target-domain heterogeneity increases. Design/methodology/approach: A lightweight MobileNetV2 framework enhanced with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) was evaluated through sequential transfer from Walnut to Cashew, Coffee and Mango, followed by validation on the heterogeneous ABCGMP six-crop benchmark. Each stage used the preceding model representation and was evaluated on an independent test set using complementary classification measures. Findings: Test accuracy increased from 75.76% for the Walnut baseline to 84.85% after CBAM integration, followed by 90.67% on Cashew, 100.00% on Coffee and 99.50% on Mango. The final ABCGMP evaluation achieved 88.44% accuracy, 81.49% Balanced Accuracy and 0.9949 ROC-AUC. The results show that substantial predictive capability was retained through successive crop transfers, while broader multi-crop heterogeneity introduced a measurable performance constraint. Originality: The study provides an empirical characterisation of sequential knowledge reuse across multiple perennial crop domains using a common lightweight attention-enhanced representation, extending evaluation beyond isolated source-to-target transfer.

</details>


### [53] [HistGramBench: Measuring Structural Recovery When Multimodal Models Redraw Historical Mathematical Diagrams as TikZ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00081)
*Minh Quang Tran,Carter He,Cameron Bloch,Zitai Huang,Thien Truong Vo,Trong Nguyen Tran,Isaac Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HistGramBench 是一个包含 2,507 幅历史数学图（1551–1933 年，95 部著作，8 种语言）的基准，用"多模型事实共识+自绘图校验"的方式评估 AI 能否把线刻示意图重绘为可检索的矢量/程序化图形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字图书馆中的早期印刷数学著作只有扫描图像，图中的点线关系（平行、相切、相交）无法被检索；将其重绘为"短绘图程序"可显式记录几何关系，但历史印刷图没有可对照的源程序，缺乏评测手段。

Method: 构建跨 8 种语言、95 部著作、1551–1933 年的 2,507 幅图基准；对每幅图由来自不同厂商的两个 AI 模型就其可读出的几何事实（如哪些线平行、两线何处相交）达成一致作为评测真值；模型需生成绘图程序，并在其自身渲染出的图上核验这些事实；对 6 个低成本模型进行评测。

Result: 最佳模型仅恢复约 3/5 的几何事实；未通过的主要原因在于程序未能成功产出图形；平行与相切关系最难复现。

Conclusion: HistGramBench 为历史学家和图情人员提供量化手段，用于判断此类工具何时可使古代数学图形变得可检索；同时揭示当前廉价模型在"程序化重绘+几何关系保持"上的明显不足。

Abstract: Digital libraries preserve mathematical books printed from the sixteenth to the twentieth century, but the lettered diagrams in them, the figures on which Euclidean proofs depend, remain scanned images whose content cannot be searched. Redrawing such a diagram as a short drawing program would record which points lie on which lines and circles. But a printed plate offers no source code against which the redrawing could be checked. We introduce HistGramBench, a benchmark of 2,507 diagrams from 95 works printed between 1551 and 1933 in eight languages. For each diagram, two AI models from different providers agree on the facts a reader takes from the figure, such as which lines are parallel or where two lines meet, and every redrawing is checked against those facts on the model's own drawing. We evaluate six affordable AI models. The best recovers about three fifths of these facts, and most of what the models miss comes from programs that never produce a drawing. Parallels and tangencies are the hardest relations to reproduce. HistGramBench gives historians and librarians a way to measure when such tools can make old mathematical diagrams searchable.

</details>


### [54] [AdaptAD: Foundation Model Adaptation with Missing Modality Robustness for Alzheimer's Disease Staging Across the Disease Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00084)
*Dawa Chyophel Lepcha,Sophie A. Martin,Pierrick Coupé,Shabbir Syed Abdul*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaptAD用16张解剖定位的2.5-D切片（穿过内侧颞叶）输入冻结的ImageNet预训练ViT-B/16，仅用LoRA训练3.5M/89M参数，并将FreeSurfer形态学以token形式（缺失时用[MISSING]）融合，实现CN/MCI/AD三分类分期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一结构MRI跨AD连续谱分期困难：3-D网络在小队列上易过拟合，且形态学特征（FreeSurfer）常不可得，需要参数高效、可缺失模态的轻量方案。

Method: 将配准后的T1加权像表示为16张解剖定位的2.5-D切片，LoRA微调冻结ViT-B/16；形态学特征以token注入或学习[MISSING] token，由缺失感知堆叠器融合两个专家；预注册协议下10种方法在相同5折划分的597名ADNI受试者（29%无FreeSurfer）上比较，Holm校正配对bootstrap检验；锁定模型在993名OASIS-3受试者上单次测试。

Result: ADNI三分类macro-AUC 0.745（95% CI 0.709–0.781），排名第一并显著超过全量微调、ShaSpec和3-D CNN；OASIS-3上0.780（0.748–0.814），基于CDR标签时0.804并显著优于所有3-D与图像-表格方法。LoRA以1/25可训练参数达到全量微调水平；去除形态学使外部AUC变化<0.003；疾病评分在诊断组内与MMSE、CDR-SB相关，并按log-rank p<0.001分层MCI向痴呆进展；显著性集中于内侧颞叶与脑室周围区域。

Conclusion: 参数高效的2-D基础模型可在无形态学条件下仅凭常规T1扫描完成全AD连续谱分期，具有向记忆门诊部署的可扩展性。

Abstract: Staging Alzheimer's disease (AD) across its continuum, from cognitively normal (CN) through mild cognitive impairment (MCI) to dementia from a single structural MRI remains difficult because 3-D networks overfit small cohorts, and FreeSurfer morphometry is often unavailable. We present AdaptAD, which reads a registered T1-weighted scan as 16 anatomically placed 2.5-D slices through the medial temporal lobe and adapts a frozen ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), training 3.5 M of 89 M parameters. Morphometry enters as tokens when present, or as a learned [MISSING] token, and a missing-aware stacker fuses both experts. Under a pre-registered protocol, ten methods were compared for three-class CN/MCI/AD staging on identical 5-fold splits of 597 ADNI participants, 29% without FreeSurfer, with Holm-corrected paired bootstrap tests. The locked model was tested once on 993 OASIS-3 participants (988 scored by every method). On ADNI, AdaptAD achieved a three-class macro-AUC of 0.745 (95% CI 0.709 to 0.781), ranking first and significantly exceeding full fine-tuning, ShaSpec and a 3-D CNN. On OASIS-3 it reached 0.780 (0.748 to 0.814), and on the CDR-based label (0.804) it significantly outperformed every 3-D and image-tabular method. LoRA matched full fine-tuning with 25 times fewer trainable parameters, and removing morphometry changed external macro-AUC by less than 0.003. The disease score tracked MMSE and CDR-SB within diagnostic groups and stratified MCI-to-dementia progression (log-rank p < 0.001), while saliency concentrated in medial temporal and periventricular regions. A parameter-efficient 2-D foundation model can therefore stage the full AD continuum from a routine T1 scan without morphometry, offering a scalable route to memory-clinic deployment.

</details>


### [55] [Rethinking Feature Perturbation for Single-Source Domain Generalization: A Representation-Space Analysis and Spectral Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00091)
*Badr-Eddine Benelmostafa,Sohaib Baroud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出四维表示空间描述子（特征位移、关系位移、任务区域比、子空间偏离）用于刻画特征扰动机制，并给出可显式控制相位幅度、通道耦合与频域支持的DISP（对偶不变谱扰动）案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单源域泛化(SSDG)中特征扰动多以任务性能而非其引起的表征变化来评估，缺乏可度量的扰动比较方式，且希望在不访问目标域的前提下定位有利于OOD性能的扰动区域。

Method: 定义$D_F$、$D_R$、$\Theta_{\mathrm{Task}}$、$\Theta_{\mathrm{Subspace}}$四项表示空间描述子作为经验分析框架；在风格与天气偏移两种目标检测设置下刻画既有扰动机制；案例研究为非学习式傅里叶相位扰动DISP，带相位幅度$\rho$、通道耦合$\kappa$、频率支撑$\mathcal{M}$三个显式控制。

Result: 观察到不同扰动机制呈各异几何轮廓，较强OOD配置集中在描述子空间的有界区域内；DISP在实验中取得较强OOD性能，且其显式控制与描述子的关系可被经验性分析。

Conclusion: 不主张普适几何或普适最优，而是提供一个可解释、可控、可检验的视角来看待SSDG特征扰动；后续可探索在无目标域条件下识别与更强SSDG性能关联的描述子区域。

Abstract: Feature perturbation is widely used in single-source domain generalization (SSDG), yet it is typically evaluated by task performance rather than by the representation changes it induces. We investigate whether perturbations can be compared through measurable descriptors of these changes. We introduce a four-dimensional representation-space description comprising feature displacement $D_F$, relational displacement $D_R$, a task-region ratio $\Theta_{\mathrm{Task}}$, and subspace deviation $\Theta_{\mathrm{Subspace}}$. We use these descriptors as an empirical analysis framework, not as a universal geometry, to characterize existing perturbation mechanisms. Across two object-detection settings involving style and weather shifts, we observe distinct geometric profiles and a concentration of relatively strong out-of-domain (OOD) configurations within a bounded region of the descriptor space. These findings do not establish a universal optimum but motivate investigating whether regions associated with stronger SSDG performance can be identified without target-domain access. As a case study, we introduce Dual-Invariant Spectral Perturbation (DISP), a non-learned Fourier-phase perturbation with explicit controls over phase magnitude $\rho$, channel coupling $\kappa$, and frequency support $\mathcal{M}$. We empirically examine how these controls affect the proposed descriptors. DISP achieves strong OOD performance in our experiments, illustrating how explicit perturbation controls can be analyzed through a representation-space description. We hope this viewpoint can contribute to more interpretable, controllable, and ultimately testable approaches to feature perturbation in SSDG.

</details>


### [56] [OCRia-1 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00092)
*Aman Rangapur,Antonio Jimeno Yepes,Daniel Bustamante,Nutchapol Dendumrongsup,Sebastián G. Acosta,Pierre-Loïc Doulcet,Simon Suo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OCRia-1：4B 文档解析 VLM，强化表格结构、图表数据抽取与文本格式保真；通过高质量数据策展＋维度化可验证奖励＋SFT→RLVR 训练，ParseBench 均值 0.87（次优 0.75），单 B200 单请求约 4700 tok/s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档解析系统在合并单元格/跨行表头、上千单元格大表、图表数据、粗斜体/上下标等格式细节上表现不佳，而这些细节对商业级文档分析至关重要；同时开源小模型希望在精度与推理速度上同时超越更大模型与商用 OCR。

Method: 4B VLM；数据侧以合成页面提供长表与富格式的精确真值，真实页面经以 PDF 文本层为锚的转写 pipeline 生成标注，强调质量与多样性优于规模；训练采用 SFT 后接 RLVR，并设计面向表格重建、图表数值抽取、格式保真的维度专属可验证奖励；推理侧结合 block-diffusion speculator（投机解码）、量化与自定义 kernel 实现加速。

Result: 在表格、图表、文本格式三项上取得所评估系统（含 35B 模型与 Mistral OCR 4.1）中的最高分；四维 ParseBench 平均 0.87 vs 次优 0.75；单卡 B200 单请求解码约 4700 tokens/s，约为 stock vLLM 下基线的 9 倍。

Conclusion: 文档解析的性能提升主要来自重视质量与多样性的数据策展和维度化可验证奖励设计，而非模型规模；小模型配合 RLVR 与推理加速可在结构化文档理解上同时实现 SOTA 精度与高吞吐。

Abstract: We introduce OCRia-1, a 4B vision-language model (VLM) for document parsing that excels at preserving table structure, extracting chart data and retaining text formatting. OCRia-1 handles content that has traditionally been challenging in document parsing: merged cells and spanning headers, tables with thousands of cells, chart data, and meaningful text formatting such as bold, italics, subscripts and superscripts, preserving details needed for business-critical document analysis. At the time of this report, it achieves the highest scores on tables, charts and text formatting among the systems evaluated, including a 35B model and Mistral OCR 4.1. Its mean ParseBench score over the four dimensions we evaluate is 0.87, against 0.75 for the next-best system. We emphasize data quality and reward design in training OCRia-1. Synthetic pages provide exact ground truth for long tables and rich formatting, while real pages are transcribed using a pipeline grounded in the PDF text layer. We attribute OCRia-1's performance primarily to careful data curation that prioritizes quality and diversity over quantity. Dimension-specific rewards evaluate table reconstruction, chart-data extraction and text-formatting fidelity. We train the model on the curated data using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then refine it through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). To our knowledge, OCRia-1 is the fastest published document-parsing VLM in its class, decoding at about 4,700 tokens per second with a single request on one B200 GPU, about nine times faster than the base model on stock vLLM. This is achieved through a block-diffusion speculator, quantization and custom kernels.

</details>


### [57] [Pano2BIM: A Geometry-Constrained Vision-Language Agent for As-Built BIM Generation from a Floor Plan and a Single 360$^\circ$ Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00097)
*Juan Diego Castaño Molina,Borja García de Soto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Pano2BIM 是一个几何约束的 VLM agent，从已知尺寸的平面图加单张 360° 照片生成 LOD 200 的近似 IFC4 建筑信息模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生需要反映实际物理状态的 as-built BIM，但现有人工建模成本高、周期长；图像方法缺少结构化 BIM 输出，VLM 本身又难以可靠地做度量级空间定位。

Method: VLM 负责识别地标与物体，确定性工具链完成相机位姿估计、射线投射度量定位与空间约束校验，通过"Measure"工作流生成 IFC4 模型；可选第二阶段用渲染-对比反馈丰富表现层，但不改动主要家具几何。

Result: 单实验室初步评测：Measure 流程家具足迹 IoU 均值 0.53（单次响应基线 0.44）；7 个固定家具中平均命中 4.0 个（基线 2.3，三次运行）；两者均稳定识别的 4 个元素质心偏差相近。测量阶段约 3.8 分钟/次、API 费用 1.63 美元；完整流程约 42 分钟、11 美元。

Conclusion: 验证了低成本、快速生成 as-built BIM 的可行性，可用于持续更新建筑数字孪生；但仅在单一场景初步验证，鲁棒性与泛化性待考察。

Abstract: Digital twins require accurate, up-to-date building information models (BIM) that reflect physical conditions, yet generating and maintaining as-built models remains costly and labor-intensive. Emerging image-based methods can capture visual appearance without inherently producing structured BIM information, while vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with reliable metric object placement. This paper presents Pano2BIM, a geometry-constrained VLM agent that generates approximate IFC4 models at Level of Development (LOD) 200 from a floor plan with known room dimensions and a single 360-degree photograph. The VLM identifies landmarks and objects, while deterministic tools estimate camera pose, compute metric positions through ray casting, and check spatial constraints. An optional second stage enriches the presentation model through render-and-compare feedback without modifying the primary furniture geometry. In a preliminary evaluation on one laboratory, the proposed Measure workflow achieved a mean furniture-footprint intersection over union (IoU) of 0.53, compared with 0.44 for a single-response baseline using identical modeling instructions, and matched an average of 4.0 versus 2.3 of seven fixed furniture elements across three runs. Centroid disagreements were similar for the four elements consistently identified by both approaches. The measurement stage averaged 3.8 minutes and USD 1.63 in API costs per run, while the complete demonstrated workflow required approximately 42 minutes and USD 11. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of rapid, low-cost as-built BIM generation, with potential applications in maintaining digital twins that reflect changing physical conditions.

</details>


### [58] [A Novel Lightweight Multi-Scale Branching Encoder for Few-Shot Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00099)
*Oriod Malo,Alexandre Xavier Falcão,Laurent Najman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Sum12多尺度分支编码器，用7个并行卷积分支（卷积核尺寸之和为12）为Prototypical Networks提供轻量多尺度特征嵌入，在Omniglot、CIFAR-FS、FC100、miniImageNet及MedMNIST 2D上验证，低样本精度普遍提升且模型保持紧凑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Few-shot分类任务中每类仅有极少标注样本，而原始Prototypical Network的嵌入骨干（四层Conv4）感受野与尺度表达单一，限制了类原型（prototype）的判别力；同时面向资源受限的智能成像平台，需要在不显著增加算力与参数的前提下提升嵌入质量。

Method: 设计Sum12编码器：7条并行卷积分支，各分支卷积核尺寸按"和为12"的预算约束组合（如1×1/3×3/5×5等组合），在统一的多尺度特征空间内融合局部与较宽空间结构；与原始ProtoNet编码器及Inception式分支变体对比；并做消融：融合方式（拼接/相加/加权）、空洞卷积、分支构成、感受野预算；额外在MedMNIST 2D上做常规监督医学图像分类测试以考察编码器的通用性。

Result: 在Omniglot、CIFAR-FS、FC100、miniImageNet的统一few-shot协议下，Sum12相对基础ProtoNet编码器在低样本（low-shot）设置中总体取得性能提升，同时模型尺寸保持紧凑；消融显示性能对融合策略、是否使用空洞卷积、分支组合及感受野预算敏感。MedMNIST 2D上的结果用于评估其在标准监督分类任务中的行为表现，而非few-shot任务。

Conclusion: Sum12是一种低成本、可即插即用的多尺度编码器改进，适用于低数据视觉识别与资源受限成像场景；但研究仍停留在学术基准阶段，缺少目标嵌入式平台的完整端到端验证，且存在已观察到的实现差异需澄清，故其实用价值尚未闭环。

Abstract: Few-Shot Learning (FSL) addresses classification scenarios in which only a small number of labeled examples are available for each class. This paper presents the Sum12 Multi-Scale branching encoder, a lightweight convolutional architecture designed to improve the embedding stage of Prototypical Networks without substantially increasing computational cost. The encoder uses seven parallel convolutional branches whose kernel-size combinations sum to 12, allowing local and broader spatial structures to be represented within a unified Multi-Scale feature space. The proposed architecture was evaluated on Omniglot, CIFAR- FS, FC100, and miniImageNet under controlled few-shot learning protocols and compared with the original Prototypical Network encoder and Inception-inspired branch variants. Additional ablation studies have investigated fusion strategies, dilated convolutions, branch compositions, and receptive field budget. Beyond few-shot learning, the encoder was also tested on the MedMNIST 2D benchmark to assess its behavior in conventional supervised medical image classification. Across these experiments, Sum12 generally improved the low-shot classification performance with respect to the basic ProtoNet encoder while preserving a compact model size. These properties suggest that the proposed encoder may be suitable for low-data visual recognition and resource-constrained intelligent imaging applications. However, complete end-to- end validation on the target embedded platform, including resolution of the observed implementation discrepancies, remains future work.

</details>


### [59] [Demystifying Prompt Stealing Attacks against Synthetic Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00102)
*Junyan Huang,Sanskar Agmain,Chen Gong,Yan Pang,FNU Suya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 V-PSA：用恢复的caption结合DDIM反演在独立生成器上构造参考轨迹，再用Null-Text Inversion优化逐步无条件嵌入以缩小重建偏差，实现单视频"提示窃取"下的高保真重建与可控编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 创作者公开展示生成内容用于售卖，但示例可能被攻击者反向利用。作者探究：仅凭一个公开视频（无原始prompt、无原始生成器），攻击者能否导出可复用输入以忠实重建并受控编辑该视频。

Method: 将captioning与prompt优化适配到视频PSA，发现仅恢复prompt保真度有限；提出V-PSA：用恢复的caption + DDIM inversion在独立生成器上构造参考轨迹，再用Null-Text Inversion优化每步无条件嵌入，使重建轨迹贴近参考轨迹；所得输入在caption被修改时亦可引导生成，实现选择性内容编辑并保持布局与运动。构建含3个受害生成器、4类prompt来源的12,000视频-prompt对基准。

Result: 目标与重建视频相似度约0.9，显著优于仅prompt基线的约0.6；支持多种保持结构不变的可控变体；在图像PSA中加入反演导出输入亦可提升重建。

Conclusion: 仅以prompt恢复为评价标准会低估攻击者重建公开生成输出的能力；需将反演级输入还原纳入安全评估。

Abstract: Creators publicly showcase generated content to advertise and sell their work, but these examples may also enable unauthorized reproduction and customization. We study whether an adversary can derive reusable inputs from a single public video for faithful reconstruction and controlled editing, without access to the original prompt or generator. We adapt captioning and prompt optimization approaches to video prompt stealing attacks (PSAs) and find that prompt recovery alone provides limited reconstruction fidelity. Even the original prompt produces different spatial and temporal realizations when the initial noise changes. Using an independent generator enlarges the reconstruction gap, as reusing the original prompt and seed can still produce substantially different videos. We propose V-PSA, which uses a recovered caption and DDIM inversion to construct a reference trajectory under an independent generator. Null-Text Inversion then optimizes per-step unconditional embeddings to reduce deviations from this trajectory during reconstruction. The resulting inputs also guide generation when the caption is modified, supporting edits that change selected content while preserving the target's layout and motion. We construct a benchmark containing 12,000 video-prompt pairs from three victim generators and four prompt sources. V-PSA achieves video-to-video similarity around 0.9 between target and reconstructed videos, substantially improving over prompt-only baselines with similarity score of 0.6, and supports multiple controlled variations that preserve the target's structure. Additional experiments show that augmenting prior image PSAs with inversion-derived inputs also improves reconstruction. Our results show that evaluations restricted to prompt recovery can underestimate an attacker's ability to reconstruct public generative outputs.

</details>


### [60] [Detector-Integrated Multi-Cue Association for Occlusion-Aware UAV Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00105)
*Shu-Hung Chou,Trong-An Bui,Wei-Ming Chen,Hsin-Piao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在YOLOv8n颈部挂轻量投影头，经ROIAlign单次前向同时输出检测框与ReID嵌入，配合运动/IoU/外观多线索加权关联及低分召回与记忆保护，实现UAV小目标多目标跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机影像中车辆目标小、外观相似且频繁遮挡，导致身份切换（IDSW）严重；DeepSORT类方法依赖独立ReID网络，逐目标推理拖慢速度，而小目标/被遮挡目标的外观特征本身不可靠。

Method: 检测器集成式多线索跟踪框架：1) 在YOLOv8n检测器neck上附加轻量投影头，通过ROIAlign提取目标嵌入，检测与嵌入共享一次前向；2) 关联代价融合运动、IoU与外观距离，权重由消融实验确定；3) 附加低分检测救援机制与外观记忆保护策略以抑制IDSW。

Result: 在UAVDT基准上达到MOTA 28.33、HOTA 31.16、IDF1 38.18，运行速度82.59 FPS，三项指标均优于对比跟踪器；相较DeepSORT，IDSW降低58.4%。

Conclusion: 将ReID嵌入内嵌进检测器并辅以多线索关联，可在不牺牲实时性的前提下显著缓解UAV小目标遮挡导致的身份切换，但外观度量依赖嵌入质量，极端遮挡下的关联鲁棒性仍受限。

Abstract: Multi-object tracking (MOT) in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenging because vehicles are small, visually similar, and frequently occluded, which leads to identity switches (IDSW). Appearance-based trackers such as DeepSORT rely on a standalone re-identification (ReID) network, whose per-target inference limits runtime speed, while the appearance of small or occluded vehicles remains unreliable. This paper proposes a detector-integrated multi-cue tracking framework. Lightweight projection heads are attached to the neck of the YOLOv8n detector to extract target embeddings through ROIAlign, producing detections and embeddings in a single forward pass. A multi-cue association cost then combines motion, IoU, and appearance distances with weights determined through ablation, complemented by low-score rescue and appearance-memory protection. On the UAVDT benchmark, the proposed method achieves a MOTA of 28.33, a HOTA of 31.16, and an IDF1 of 38.18 at 82.59 FPS, the best among the compared trackers in all three metrics, and reduces IDSW by 58.4\% compared with DeepSORT.

</details>


### [61] [Dynamic Merging Mutually-Distilled Multi-View Networks for RGB-Event-based Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00107)
*Futian Wang,Fan Zhang,Xiao Wang,Yuhe Ding,Shiao Wang,Jingxi Huang,Jin Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多视图教师网络的互蒸馏方法融合多种事件表征，并在参数层面动态层级合并，得到统一RGB-Event多模态模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RGB-Event融合把事件流转成帧/体素/张量后学习，只利用事件数据的有限表征能力；且标准训练流程未充分利用训练过程中产生的多样模型参数。

Method: 多编码器分别提取不同事件表征，在特征级与logit级进行互知识蒸馏；随后对第一阶段的模型参数执行动态层级模型合并，形成统一多模态RGB-Event模型。

Result: 在多个事件相机数据集上实验，框架取得显著性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 以参数级融合替代单纯的输入表征转换，是融合事件与帧图像的有效思路。

Abstract: Multi-modal fusion algorithms combining conventional frame-based cameras and event cameras have recently attracted substantial research attention. Typically, existing approaches convert event streams into frames, voxels, or tensors, and then learn the required spatiotemporal information from these transformed event representations for fusion with conventional frame-camera data. Obviously, such paradigms only exploit the limited representational capacity of event data. Moreover, standard training pipelines fail to fully leverage diverse model parameters obtained throughout the learning process. In this paper, we propose a novel mutual distillation method leveraging multi-view teacher network weights to better integrate multiple event representations and achieve model-parameter level fusion. Specifically, we employ multiple encoders to extract different types of event representations and perform mutual knowledge distillation at both the feature-level and logit-level in this process. Afterwards, we perform a dynamic hierarchical model merge strategy on the model parameters from the first stage to yield a unified multi-modal RGB-Event representation model. Experimental results across multiple event-based datasets demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves significant performance improvements.

</details>


### [62] [A New Formulation of the Elastica Model with Application to Image Inpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00110)
*Zuoqiang Shi,Xue-Cheng Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于二值表示(±1 水平集)的 Euler 弹性能新公式：用径向核 R_ε 与 φ 的卷积直接给出曲率 −(R_ε∗φ)/(C_0ε)+O(ε)，无需对 φ 求导，可经 FFT 计算；所得能量化为加权全变分（ROF 推广），结合 split Bregman/ALM 得到高效算法，并在二值图像修补上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弹性能（Euler elastica）是建模曲线/界面的经典工具，但其曲率项在 level-set 或 phase-field 表示下非线性、非凸，level-set 情形还不可微，导致极小化非常困难。作者希望构造一种避免显式曲率导数、又能高效优化的等价公式。

Method: 1) 二值表示：φ∈{±1}，沿曲线 Γ 有 κ = −(1/(C_0ε))(R_ε∗φ)+O(ε)，R_ε 为半径 ε 球内支撑的径向核，C_0 为显式常数；卷积用 FFT 计算。2) 由此能量成为加权总变分，形式上推广 ROF 模型；同样曲率公式亦可导出 phase-field 型模型。3) 优化：FFT + split Bregman（此处等价于增广拉格朗日 ALM），子问题为共轭梯度求解的线性系统或逐点显式更新。4) 实验：二值图像 inpainting。

Result: 给出无导数、仅需 FFT 的曲率估计，得到一个加权 TV 型弹性能；配套 split Bregman/ALM 算法子问题高效可解；二值图像修补实验表明算法有效（摘要未给出定量指标）。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种简洁的弹性能二值化重构范式，把非凸、不可微的曲率项转化为可快速卷积计算的加权 TV 项，为曲线/界面的变分建模与快速求解提供了新的算法工具；但验证局限于低层图像处理任务。

Abstract: Curves and interfaces play a central role in computer vision and image processing, and Euler's elastica energy is one of the most successful tools to model and manipulate them. The elastica energy is usually computed through a level-set or a phase field representation of the curve, in which the curvature term makes the energy nonlinear, non-convex and, in the level-set case, non-differentiable, so that its minimization is notoriously difficult. In this paper, we propose a new formulation of the elastica model based on a binary representation of curves. The key ingredient is a very simple formula for the curvature: if $\phi$ is the $\pm1$ binary function associated with a curve $\Gamma$, then along $\Gamma$ the curvature is given by $-\frac{1}{C_0\epsilon}\left(R_\epsilon *\phi\right)+O(\epsilon)$, where $R_\epsilon$ is a radial kernel supported in a ball of radius $\epsilon$ and $C_0$ is an explicit constant. No derivative of $\phi$ is involved and the convolution is evaluated by FFT. The resulting energy is a weighted total variation, so that formally the new formulation is a generalization of the well-known ROF model; a phase field type model is obtained from the same curvature formula. Combining FFT with the split Bregman iteration, which for the present problem coincides with an augmented Lagrangian method (ALM), we obtain efficient algorithms whose subproblems are either linear systems solved by conjugate gradient or explicit pointwise formulas. Numerical experiments on the inpainting of binary images are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

</details>


### [63] [SpatialVec: A Unified Representation Learning Framework for Geospatial Objects with Boundary-Aware Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00111)
*Samya Acharja,Kanchan Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpatialVec：边界感知的空间表征学习框架，自适应采样几何边界及邻域，用Transformer编码-解码器经几何重建训练，输出点/折线/多边形统一嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间编码方法难以保留细粒度拓扑信息，对折线、多边形等复杂几何的边界结构与局部空间上下文刻画不足，导致边界附近拓扑敏感关系在嵌入空间中欠表达。

Method: 自适应采样几何边界及其周边区域以捕获细粒度几何结构；采用Transformer编码器-解码器，通过几何重建任务自监督训练，得到紧凑、几何感知的统一表示，覆盖点、折线、多边形三类实体。

Result: 在两个真实世界数据集上，多边形交互相关的困难拓扑关系保持度显著提升；下游预测与分类任务显著优于SOTA基线。

Conclusion: 边界感知采样+重建式训练可有效改善拓扑敏感的空间表征，为GeoAI下游空间推理提供统一编码方案。

Abstract: Spatial representation learning is essential for Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) applications, enabling machine learning models to capture the geometry, location, and spatial relationships of geographic entities such as points, polylines, and polygons. Existing spatial encoding methods often struggle to preserve fine-grained topological information, particularly for interactions involving complex geometries such as polylines and polygons. These approaches inadequately capture boundary structure and local spatial context, causing topology-sensitive relationships near geometry boundaries to be underrepresented in the learned embedding space. Consequently, accurately modeling complex spatial interactions remains a significant challenge for downstream spatial reasoning tasks. To fill the gap, we introduce SpatialVec, a boundary-aware spatial representation learning framework that adaptively samples geometry boundaries and their surrounding regions, capturing fine-grained geometric structures critical for topology-aware spatial reasoning. A transformer-based encoder-decoder trained through geometry reconstruction produces compact, geometry-aware, and unified representations for points, polylines, and polygons. Empirical evaluation on two real-world datasets shows that SpatialVec substantially improves the preservation of challenging topological relationships involving polygonal interactions and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines significantly on downstream prediction and classification tasks.

</details>


### [64] [Predicting Cognitive Profiles from Structural MRI using Spatial Graph Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00113)
*Taslima Ferdaus Shuva,Md. Tanvir Rahman,Risala Tasin Khan,Mohammad Ali Moni,ASM Ashraf Mahmud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ST-GNN将区域形态学投影到群体标准化空间图，限制消息传递于K近邻区域，融合空间形态与系统协变量，在四类儿童认知表型上超越线性与无拓扑深度模型，并用Integrated Gradients给出与神经解剖证据一致的特征归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构MRI预测认知能力受困于脑形态的高维性与几何复杂性；常规做法将区域形态学展平为表格特征，丢失了区域间显式空间关系。

Method: 构建群体级标准化空间图，将区域形态学嵌入该图；用空间-拓扑图神经网络在该稀疏几何拓扑（KNN）上做消息传递，并与全局协变量融合；采用保留绝对形态尺度的全局特征缩放而非区域归一化；消融对比全连接网络与区域归一化；用Integrated Gradients做特征归因。

Result: 在N=2,378–2,424的大型儿科队列上预测四种认知表型，ST-GNN优于线性基线与无拓扑深度模型；消融显示稀疏几何拓扑+全局特征缩放优于全连接与区域归一化；归因发现小脑体积对应工作记忆、上额叶表面积对应执行功能，符合神经解剖证据。

Conclusion: 标准结构MRI可提供任务特异的认知预测信息；稀疏几何拓扑与绝对尺度缩放是可迁移的架构归纳偏置，为基于MRI的神经发育评估奠定基础。

Abstract: Predicting cognitive abilities from structural neuroimaging remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and geometric complexity of brain morphology. Conventional models typically flatten regional morphometry into tabular features, failing to explicitly represent spatial relationships. We propose a Spatial-Topological Graph Neural Network (ST-GNN) to predict four distinct cognitive phenotypes across large pediatric cohorts (N = 2,378 to 2,424). By projecting regional morphometry onto a population-level standardized spatial graph, ST-GNN restricts message passing to defined neighboring regions. Evaluations demonstrate that ST-GNN effectively fuses spatial morphology with systemic covariates, outperforming linear baselines and topology-free deep models. Ablations reveal that imposing a sparse geometric topology (K-nearest neighbors) and utilizing global feature scaling - which preserves absolute morphometric scale - outperform fully connected networks and region-normalized approaches. These choices provide transferable architectural inductive biases, revealing differences between computational routing and morphometric feature attribution. Integrated Gradients analysis identified distinct morphological features consistent with neuroanatomical evidence, such as cerebellar volume for working memory and superior frontal surface area for executive function. These findings suggest standardized structural MRI provides useful information for task-specific cognitive prediction, establishing a foundation for MRI-based neurodevelopmental assessment.

</details>


### [65] [Brain-Behavior Modeling from Multimodal MRI using Opportunistic Pretraining and Common-Cohort Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00114)
*Md. Tanvir Rahman,Taslima Ferdaus Shuva,Nabil Anan Orka,Asaduzzaman Khan,Mohammad Ali Moni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 利用ABCD队列的模态不完整数据，提出两阶段"机会式"深度集成（各模态预训练→公共队列适配→Ridge融合），在5折家庭感知交叉验证下小幅提升流体/晶体/总体认知预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态MRI与认知预测受限于样本量：要求所有模态齐全的受试者很少，导致可用训练样本骤减。作者希望利用大量"部分观测"队列扩大有效样本，从而在模态齐全的公共队列上获得更好的融合预测性能。

Method: 数据为ABCD基线。三路神经模型分别处理结构/弥散、静息态、任务态MRI并纳入协变量；先在各自可用的模态子队列（最多9,686人）上预训练，再适配到公共训练队列，最后用Ridge回归进行后期融合（三模态队列4,216人）。采用家庭感知的5折交叉验证，与单模态模型及仅协变量基线对比；并做消融（考察扩展预训练贡献）与基于梯度的输入重要性归因。

Result: 两阶段训练在24/27组比较中提升平均测试R^2（中位增益0.0081）；融合相比最强单模态提升平均R^2 0.0051–0.0333，MAE降低0.0067–0.0976。任务+静息融合在流体（R^2=0.2222）与总体认知（0.3665）最优，结构+静息在晶体认知（0.3706）最优，相对仅协变量基线分别提升0.0805、0.1180、0.0890。消融显示性能提升主要来自预训练规模扩大；梯度归因显示目标依赖的输入模式。

Conclusion: 在覆盖不完整的多模态队列上做两阶段预训练+后期融合可带来"适度但一致"的增益，支持将部分观测队列用于模型开发；该框架有望用于MRI辅助的认知表型刻画，但尚需外部验证。

Abstract: Incomplete imaging coverage limits sample sizes for multimodal cognitive prediction. We evaluated a two-stage opportunistic deep ensemble using baseline Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study data to predict fluid, crystallized, and total cognition. Separate neural models processed structural/diffusion, resting-state, and task-based MRI data with covariates. Models were pretrained on eligible modality cohorts (up to 9,686 participants), adapted to common training cohorts, and fused via Ridge regression (trimodal cohort: 4,216 participants). Five-fold family-aware cross-validation compared this approach against constituent and covariate-only models. Two-stage training increased mean test coefficient of determination (R^2) in 24 of 27 comparisons (median gain: 0.0081). Fusion increased mean R^2 by 0.0051-0.0333 over the strongest constituent and reduced mean absolute error by 0.0067-0.0976. Task-plus-resting-state and trimodal ensembles reduced absolute error across all targets (nominal p <= 0.0108). Task-plus-resting-state fusion achieved the highest mean R^2 for fluid (0.2222) and total cognition (0.3665), while structural-plus-resting-state led for crystallized cognition (0.3706), yielding R^2 gains of 0.0805, 0.1180, and 0.0890 over covariate-only references. Ablations showed expanded pretraining drove most improvements. Gradient-based attribution identified target-dependent input patterns. These findings support using partially observed cohorts for model development to achieve modest fusion gains. Pending external validation, this approach may support MRI-informed cognitive phenotyping.

</details>


### [66] [DTP-OPSD: Reinforcement Learning with Distractor-Aware Temporal-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation for Temporal Video Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00120)
*Zhaoyu Chen,Yongwei Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DTP-OPSD：面向时序视频定位的 GRPO 强化学习框架，通过干扰感知的"时间特权"在线自蒸馏，在学生 rollout 全零 tIoU、组内优势为零时提供密集 token 级 JS 散度监督；仅 300 条困难干扰样本即刷新三个 TimeLens 基准的 8B 开源模型最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当视频中存在重复、相似或相反事件时，GRPO 采样的所有响应可能都未命中目标，tIoU=0 导致组内相对优势全为零，策略梯度信号消失（奖励稀疏/坍塌问题）；需要一种在 GRPO 无梯度时仍能提供有效监督的机制。

Method: DTP-OPSD 框架：学生模型看原始视频并在线生成响应；共享权重教师模型看"特权视频"（目标窗口用红色全帧边框标注、同视频干扰窗口用蓝色全帧边框标注）。教师对学生生成的前缀做评估，给出密集的 token 级 Jensen-Shannon 散度蒸馏损失。蒸馏强度自适应门控：教师不优于学生时抑制，教师更优且学生组全零 tIoU 时加强。另外通过 VLM 筛选 + 人工校验构建 300 条紧凑困难干扰训练集。

Result: 在 Charades-TimeLens、ActivityNet-TimeLens、QVHighlights-TimeLens 上 mIoU 分别达 55.93、54.77、66.71，为对比的 8B 开源模型最高；相比同数据训练的 Pure GRPO，12 项指标全部提升，其中 R1@0.7 分别提升 1.28、1.62、1.78 点。

Conclusion: 视觉特权信息 + 在线自蒸馏可作为 GRPO 稀疏奖励崩溃时的补充信号，配合少量高质量困难样本即可显著提升视频时序定位鲁棒性；对视频/多模态 RL 训练范式有可迁移价值，但不属于具身智能核心方法。

Abstract: Temporal Video Grounding (TVG) aims to localize the start and end times of an event described by a language query in a video. The task becomes particularly challenging when the same video contains multiple repeated, similar, or opposite events. On these hard examples, all responses sampled by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) may miss the target and receive zero temporal Intersection-over-Union (tIoU). Their group-relative advantages are then all zero, leaving no useful policy gradient signal. To address this, we propose DTP-OPSD, a reinforcement learning framework with distractor-aware temporal-privilege on-policy self-distillation. The student observes the clean video and generates responses on-policy, while a shared-weight teacher observes a privileged video in which the target window is marked by red full-frame borders and same-video distractor windows by blue full-frame borders. For the distillation loss, the teacher evaluates student-generated prefixes and provides dense token-level Jensen-Shannon divergence supervision. This supervision remains informative even when GRPO provides no policy gradient signal. We suppress distillation when the teacher does not outperform the student and strengthen it for groups where the teacher performs better but all student rollouts receive zero tIoU. We also construct a compact hard-interference training set through VLM screening and human verification. With only 300 additional post-training examples, DTP-OPSD achieves the highest mIoU among the compared open-source 8B models on Charades-TimeLens, ActivityNet-TimeLens, and QVHighlights-TimeLens, reaching 55.93, 54.77, and 66.71, respectively. Compared with Pure GRPO trained on the same data, DTP-OPSD improves all 12 reported metrics, with R1@0.7 gains of 1.28, 1.62, and 1.78 points on the three benchmarks. Code will be released at this https URL

</details>


### [67] [CDBM: Complexity-Diversity Framework for Building Morphology Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00122)
*Evgenii Maslov,Alexandra Vabnits,Denis Karpov,Alexey Morozov,Anastasia Antsiferova,Art Prosvetov,Valentin Khrulkov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CDBM——12个可解释的建筑体量描述子（垂直挤出表示），分别度量几何细节表达强度（复杂度）与在一维/二维元素上的分布不均性（多样性），在4.82亿OSM建筑上计算，并在多任务上对比3DBM与LION形状隐变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有建筑形状度量指标（如3DBM）对生成体量的细粒度几何表达及其空间异质性的刻画不足，缺少可解释、可大规模计算、且能作为生成目标的描述子。

Method: 构建12个可解释描述子，将建筑体量表示为垂直挤出；在482,241,306栋OpenStreetMap建筑上批量计算；以梯度提升与逻辑回归在函数、区域、上下文相关性、真实/生成判别、人类偏好、几何条件生成六类任务上与3DBM及LION形状隐变量对比。

Result: 梯度提升下CDBM在真实/生成判别与人类偏好匹配上最优；逻辑回归下在真实性上与3DBM持平；3DBM在其余三项任务领先。作为生成目标时，现有模型难以产出表达强烈且异质的形态。

Conclusion: CDBM与现有指标互补，提供可解释、可扩展的建筑形态复杂度与多样性度量，并揭示生成模型在几何表达强度与异质性上的不足。

Abstract: We introduce Complexity-Diversity Building Metrics (CDBM), twelve interpretable descriptors for building massings represented as vertical extrusions. They measure how strongly geometric detail is expressed (complexity) and how unevenly it varies across one- and two-dimensional elements (diversity). Computed for 482,241,306 OpenStreetMap buildings and compared with 3D Building Metrics (3DBM) and the LION shape latent on task-specific samples, CDBM is tested on function, region, contextual relevance, real-generated discrimination, human preference and geometry-conditioned generation. With gradient boosting, CDBM best separates generated from mapped massings and best matches human preference; with logistic regression it matches 3DBM on realism. 3DBM leads on the other three tasks. As generation targets, the descriptors show that models struggle to produce strongly expressed and heterogeneous forms. CDBM complements existing indicators.

</details>


### [68] [SketchBloom: Training-Free Vector Sketch Outpainting with Stroke-Level Style Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00245)
*Quang-Thinh Nguyen,Duy-Khang Do,Tam V. Nguyen,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SketchBloom：免训练框架，用预训练栅格外绘+风格迁移引导+逐实例矢量优化，将稀疏草图外绘为可编辑SVG贝塞尔笔画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏草图外绘中同时保持轮廓连贯性与笔画风格一致很困难，且缺乏可直接编辑的矢量输出结果。

Method: 免训练流程：自适应潜空间混合平衡内容轮廓与参考纹理；由参考风格构造笔画词表并初始化轮廓/DINO注意力引导笔画；结构项与纹理项分别优化后经轮廓强调的乘法融合，输出SVG贝塞尔笔画。

Result: 在LineArtOut-1K（1024组输入+风格组合）上，对同一外绘栅格进行矢量化时，感知、语义、结构保真度优于所比较的矢量基线；单对约6分钟（单张H200）。

Abstract: Outpainting sparse sketches while preserving contour coherence and stroke style remains challenging. We present SketchBloom, a training-free framework that combines pretrained raster outpainting and style-transfer guidance with per-instance vector optimization. Given a sketch, a scene prompt, and an optional reference style, it produces an editable Scalable Vector Graphic (SVG) composed of Bezier strokes. Adaptive latent blending balances content contours and reference texture without model retraining. A reference-derived stroke vocabulary initializes contour- and DINO-attention-guided strokes, which are optimized separately for structure and texture before contour-emphasizing multiply fusion. As in prior optimization-based vector sketching, no task-specific network is trained; our contribution is the synthesis design specialized to sketch outpainting. On LineArtOut-1K, comprising 1,024 input and style combinations, SketchBloom improves perceptual, semantic, and structural fidelity over the evaluated vector baselines when all methods vectorize the same outpainted raster. This protocol evaluates vector synthesis rather than end-to-end outpainting or reference-style superiority. Runtime is approximately six minutes per pair on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [69] [SketchForge: Training-Free Scene-to-Vector Sketching via Decoupled Structure and Texture Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00253)
*Quang-Thinh Nguyen,Duy-Khang Do,Hien Trinh,Tam V. Nguyen,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SketchForge：免训练、逐实例测试时优化贝塞尔曲线的光栅图像→可编辑SVG素描框架，解耦结构轮廓笔画与自由纹理笔画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光栅渲染管线难以做笔画级编辑，而从零生成式矢量化难以忠实于任意输入图像；需兼顾结构轮廓与色调纹理的保真、且可编辑的分辨率无关矢量素描。

Method: 训练无关框架：基于轮廓与注意力引导初始化贝塞尔笔画；采用矢量原生可微分渲染管线，在独立目标下将结构轮廓笔画与自由形态纹理笔画解耦优化，并以正片叠底（multiply）图层合成；仅需逐实例测试时优化，无需额外训练或微调。

Result: 在结构保真度与生成质量上一致优于现有基于矢量的基线方法。

Conclusion: 逐实例测试时优化+可微矢量渲染是获得忠实且笔画可编辑矢量素描的有效路径；提供项目页面。

Abstract: Converting a raster image into a resolution-independent, stroke-editable vector sketch while faithfully preserving both structural contours and tonal texture remains challenging: raster-space rendering pipelines are difficult to edit at the stroke level, while generation-from-scratch vectorization methods struggle to remain faithful to an arbitrary input image. We present SketchForge, a training-free framework that converts an input raster image into a resolution-independent SVG sketch through per-instance test-time optimization of Bezier curves, requiring no additional training or fine-tuning. Strokes are seeded via a contour and attention-guided initialization, then refined by a vector-native differentiable rendering pipeline that decouples structural contour strokes from free-form texture strokes under dedicated objectives, composited via multiply-blend layering. Extensive experiments show that SketchForge consistently outperforms existing vector-based baselines in structural fidelity and generation quality. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [70] [Seeing Less in a Sparse World: Cross-View Geolocalization from Limited Field-of-View Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00288)
*Fahimul Aleem,Shruti Vyas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CVW500k大规模全球分布地-卫星图像配对数据集（>50万对，采用有限视场地面图像），并给出基于CLIP+LoRA与可学习查询token跨视角对齐模块的GeoQueryNet融合Transformer，用于GNSS拒止环境下的跨视角地理定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法受限于训练数据与基准地理分布单一，且多数基准使用全景地面视图，与真实相机有限视场不符，导致评测与部署场景脱节。

Method: CVW500k：覆盖多地理区域与环境、>500k地-卫星图像对、有限视场地面图；GeoQueryNet：CLIP视觉编码器+LoRA参数高效微调，跨视角对齐模块用可学习query token提取跨视角地理一致特征，实现查询式融合。

Result: 摘要未给出量化指标；主要成果为构建更真实、更具挑战性的全球分布基准，并提出相应跨视角融合框架（代码已开源）。

Conclusion: 面向GNSS拒止场景的跨视角定位需要全球多样数据与有限视场设定；查询式跨视角融合是缓解视角差异的有效思路，但缺乏与现有方法的具体对比数据。

Abstract: Cross-view geolocalization aims to determine the geographic location of a ground-level image by retrieving its corresponding satellite image, offering a promising alternative for localization in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied or degraded environments such as urban canyons, dense forests, and disaster scenarios. Despite recent progress, existing approaches remain limited by the lack of globally diverse training datasets and benchmarks that are often geographically restricted. Furthermore, most benchmarks rely on panoramic ground views, which do not reflect the limited field-of-view imagery captured by real world cameras. To address these challenges, we introduce Cross-View World 500k (CVW500k), a large-scale globally distributed dataset containing over 500,000 ground-satellite image pairs collected across diverse geographic regions and environments. Unlike previous datasets, CVW500k uses limited field-of-view ground images, providing a more realistic and challenging setting for cross-view geolocalization. In addition, we propose GeoQueryNet, a query-based cross-view fusion transformer framework designed to bridge the viewpoint gap between ground and satellite images. The model leverages a CLIP-based visual encoder with parameter-efficient LoRA adaptation and introduces a Cross-View Alignment Module that uses learnable query tokens to extract geographically consistent features across viewpoints. Our code can be found here: this https URL .

</details>


### [71] [Seeing the Unseen: Unified Visible--Invisible Motion for Physically Consistent Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00293)
*Mingyang Bao,Fangda Ye,Xihao Chen,Bobo Li,Jason Li,Shengqiong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"Seeing the Unseen"框架：先用轻量化的基于粒子的图动力学模拟器(PGDS)从数据学习可泛化的物理交互并预测3D运动轨迹，再用可见-不可见运动场(VIMF)同时表达输入帧中可观测运动与由物体动力学随时间涌现的运动，将轨迹注入扩散视频生成器，得到视觉连贯且物理一致的视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型视觉质量高但物理动力学不一致，原因在于缺乏对底层物理过程的显式建模；已有方案或依赖强假设的模拟器，或仅用粗粒度语义引导，难以有效把物理先验注入生成模型。

Method: 两阶段解耦：(1) Particle-based Graph Dynamics Simulator，粒子-图结构从数据学习通用物理交互并预测合理3D运动轨迹；(2) Visible–Invisible Motion Field，显式区分输入帧可直接观测的运动与因物体动力学后续产生的不可见运动，形成更完整、结构化的运动表征；(3) 将轨迹作为控制信号注入基于扩散的视频生成器，实现物理接地生成。

Result: 大量实验显示，相比强基线在运动准确性、交互一致性和物理伪影抑制上均有提升（摘要未给出量化指标）。

Conclusion: 以"先学物理动力学、再注入视频合成"的统一范式，用图粒子模拟器+可见/不可见运动场为扩散生成器提供细粒度物理先验，是物理一致视频生成的可行路线；其轨迹接口对世界模型与机器人视频预测具备潜在迁移价值。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have achieved impressive visual quality, yet they often fail to produce physically consistent dynamics due to the lack of explicit modeling of underlying physical processes. Existing approaches either rely on simulators with strong assumptions or use coarse semantic guidance, and further struggle to effectively inject physical priors into generation models. In this work, we propose Seeing the Unseen, a unified framework for physics-grounded video generation. Our approach decomposes the problem into two stages: learning physical dynamics and injecting them into video synthesis. First, we introduce a lightweight Particle-based Graph Dynamics Simulator (PGDS) that learns generalizable physical interactions from data and predicts plausible 3D motion trajectories. Second, we propose a Visible--Invisible Motion Field (VIMF) that captures both motion observable in the input frame and motion that emerges over time due to object dynamics. This representation enables more complete and structured motion guidance compared to conventional physical signals. By integrating these trajectories into a diffusion-based generator, our method produces videos that are both visually coherent and physically consistent. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved motion accuracy, interaction consistency, and reduced physical artifacts compared to strong baselines.

</details>


### [72] [Déjà Vu: Cycle-Consistent Re-ranking for Semantic Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00328)
*Xiaoran Zhang,Huidong Liu,Yang Liu,Chien-Chih Wang,Jinfa Huang,Lingkai Kong,Bryan Wang,Yan Gao,Hongdong Li,Alex Wong,James S. Duncan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出测试时解码模块 Déjà Vu，将语义对应重构为"先召回后重排"：自适应候选集 + 分级循环一致性打分，仅作用于已有相似度矩阵，即在多个基线上稳定提升 PCK。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练大模型特征的零样本对应能力很强，但现有方法最终只做贪心 top-1 最近邻，把瓶颈错误地归因于表征能力。作者发现正确匹配大量落在 top-30 候选内（超过监督模型的 top-1），说明真正瓶颈在解码而非表示。

Method: 1) 按相似度分布的模糊度自适应确定候选集大小（歧义大则大、置信高则小）；2) 对每个候选做反向匹配，用反向落点与原关键点的距离构造分级循环一致性分数进行重排；3) 模块完全复用基方法已计算的相似度矩阵，无需重新训练或额外特征。

Result: 在 SPair-71k、其几何子集与 PF-Pascal 上，无监督与弱监督设定下一致提升三个代表性基线，SPair-71k 最高 +1.8 PCK@0.10，PF-Pascal 最高 +3.4 PCK@0.15，关键点平均精度（KAP）最高 +4.9。

Conclusion: 语义对应的性能瓶颈更多来自解码策略而非特征表示；轻量、即插即用的召回-重排解码可显著提升现有方法，提示后续工作应在匹配后处理而非仅堆叠表征。

Abstract: We propose \emph{Déjà Vu}, a test-time decoding module for semantic correspondence. Matching semantically equivalent keypoints across images of the same object category is challenging due to variations in appearance, viewpoint, and scale. While features from large pretrained vision models carry strong zero-shot correspondence ability, existing methods reduce final matching to greedy top-$1$ nearest-neighbor selection. We show that the correct correspondence appears among the top-ranked candidates far more often than top-$1$ matching achieves: with $30$ candidates, zero-shot features exceed the top-$1$ accuracy of a supervised model. This reveals a \textit{decoding bottleneck} rather than a limit of the representation. Motivated by this observation, we formulate semantic correspondence as a \textit{recall-then-rerank} problem. Our method first nominates an adaptive candidate set, larger when the similarity distribution is ambiguous and smaller when it is confident, then re-ranks the candidates with a graded cycle-consistency score: each candidate is matched back to the source image and penalized by how far its reverse match lands from the original keypoint. The module operates entirely on the similarity matrix already computed by the base method. It consistently improves three representative baselines on SPair-71k, its geometric subset, and PF-Pascal under both unsupervised and weakly supervised settings, with gains of up to $+1.8$ PCK@0.10 on SPair-71k and $+3.4$ PCK@0.15 on PF-Pascal, and $+4.9$ under Keypoint Average Precision.

</details>


### [73] [SIEVE: Preserving Cross-Image Evidence via Depth-Aware Token Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00351)
*Nitish Shukla,Surgan Jandial,Nhat-Tan Bui,Arun Ross*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SIEVE: a training-free single-pass framework that jointly allocates visual tokens across images and decoder depth by spatial-grid pooling, per-image quota prompt-attention selection with same-image aggregation, and a closed-form retention schedule.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Multi-image VLMs face heavy computation on long visual sequences; compression must preserve complementary cross-image evidence and keep tokens from different images separate. Global selection underrepresents question-relevant images, and early-layer pruning risks dropping relevant content before sufficient multimodal processing, while existing methods spend most budget on early layers.

Method: Training-free, single-pass pipeline: (1) pool each image into a compact spatial grid to cut early processing cost; (2) progressively select representatives via prompt attention under equal per-image quotas; (3) aggregate unselected tokens into similar representatives from the same image; (4) a closed-form schedule sets per-layer retention counts to hit a prescribed average token budget across decoder layers.

Result: On four VLM backbones, SIEVE achieves the highest average at 6.25% budget on five multi-image and four single-image benchmarks, and best mean on two video benchmarks. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B it beats the strongest baseline by 9.96/9.03 points at 6.25%/12.5% budgets, and at 12.5% surpasses the uncompressed model by 2.01 points with 6.6x fewer prefill FLOPs.

Conclusion: Per-image-quota attention selection combined with depth-aware allocation yields efficient, robust multi-image token compression, even improving over the uncompressed model.

Abstract: Multi-image vision-language models (VLMs) incur substantial computation when processing long visual sequences. Compressing these sequences must preserve complementary evidence across images and keep tokens from different images separate. Global selection can underrepresent question-relevant images, and pruning in early decoder layers risks removing relevant content before sufficient multimodal processing, yet existing methods spend most of the budget on these early layers. We propose SIEVE, a training-free, single-pass framework that jointly allocates visual tokens across images and decoder depth. SIEVE first pools each image into a compact spatial grid to reduce early processing cost. It then progressively selects representatives using prompt attention under equal per-image quotas and aggregates unselected tokens into similar representatives from the same image. These operations keep every image represented and its tokens separate from other images, while refining the retained representations. A closed-form schedule sets retention counts to target a prescribed average token budget across decoder layers. Across four VLM backbones, SIEVE achieves the highest average at a 6.25% budget on five multi-image benchmarks and four single-image benchmarks, and the highest mean on two video benchmarks. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, it outperforms the strongest baseline by 9.96 and 9.03 points at 6.25% and 12.5% budgets, and at 12.5% it exceeds the uncompressed model by 2.01 points with 6.6x fewer prefill FLOPs.

</details>


### [74] [MoRE-GS: Motion-Regime Experts for Future Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00375)
*Shima Salehi,Joshua Peeples*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoRE-GS: 冻结由观测时间前缀重建的3D高斯表示，用四个互补专家（持久性、系数空间Transformer、图卷积网络、带刚/非刚约束的结构化Transformer）预测控制关键点运动，并由软运动组×预测时域的路由表和持久性门控组合，实现因果、渲染感知的动态高斯场景外推。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来动态新视角合成需在同一场景内同时外推多种运动机制（静止、协同运动、局部交互、关节轨迹），单一动力学模型难以统一表征，故需按机制组合互补预测器。

Method: 因果式框架：冻结仅由观测前缀重建的高斯表示；四个专家分别负责持久性基线、系数空间Transformer、图卷积网络、结构化Transformer（刚性与非刚性运动约束）；紧凑路由表在软运动组与预测时域分箱上分配专家混合权重；持久性门控抑制不可靠外推；以渲染损失校准组合。

Result: 在D-NeRF与HyperNeRF场景上优于对比方法，性能提升表明渲染器校准的互补运动预测器组合能改善异构运动机制下的因果动态高斯预测。

Conclusion: 按运动机制进行专家路由 + 渲染校准是提升动态高斯forecast的有效范式；但仅在合成/规范数据集上验证，缺少真实场景泛化与代码发布说明。

Abstract: Future dynamic novel-view synthesis requires extrapolating multiple motion regimes within the same scene. A single dynamics model may not simultaneously represent stationary regions, coordinated motion, local interactions, and articulated trajectories. We introduce Motion Regime Expert Routing for Gaussian Splatting (MoRE-GS), a causal, render-aware framework for forecasting dynamic 3D Gaussian scenes. MoRE-GS freezes a Gaussian representation reconstructed exclusively from the observed temporal prefix and forecasts its control-keypoint motion using four complementary experts: persistence, a coefficient-space Transformer, a graph convolutional network, and a structured Transformer with rigid and non-rigid motion constraints. A compact routing table assigns expert mixtures across soft motion groups and forecast-horizon bins, while a persistence gate suppresses unreliable extrapolation. Across D-NeRF and HyperNeRF scenes, MoRE-GS achieves improved performance against other methods, and these results demonstrate that renderer-calibrated composition of complementary motion predictors improves causal dynamic Gaussian forecasting across heterogeneous motion regimes. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [75] [LF-VideoQA: Evaluating Long-Video Understanding with Long-Form Theory-of-Mind Questions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00383)
*Shaden Shaar,Bradon Thymes,Majd Aldaye,Claire Cardie,Bharath Hariharan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LF-VideoQA：基于心理理论（角色信念依赖其全部所见所闻）构建的长叙事影片开放式问答数据集，94部电影、6300+问题，平均需跨23分钟剧情推理，配问题级rubric评分；全流程由剧本自动标注生成，人类研究验证质量；实验显示现有开源VLM表现远低于剧本oracle，瓶颈在召回率，且字幕不敌视频本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长视频QA数据集多为短答案或选择题，把长视频理解简化为检索；真正难点在于跨长时间内容整合证据并说明证据如何拼合。

Method: 以剧本为源，自动标注场景事件与角色一阶信念/元信念，再用LLM生成并验证（问题, 答案, rubric）三元组；每问附rubric以支持召回与精确率打分。

Result: 评测四类开源VLM、三种设置：(i) 有剧本的oracle仍远未答全；(ii) 最佳非oracle模型召回率仅约oracle一半；(iii) 字幕/文本描述不及视频本身，说明需视觉证据；(iv) 召回是主要瓶颈，答案遗漏大量rubric要点。

Conclusion: 将长视频开放问答作为对LLM/VLM评测与推理能力的严格压力测试，并公开数据集与rubric协议，指明后续改进方向集中于多证据整合的召回。

Abstract: The hardest part of understanding a long video is not pinpointing any one moment but synthesizing many, e.g., answering a question that requires tracking what develops across hours of content and articulating how the pieces fit together. To date, most long-video QA datasets require only a short answer or a multiple-choice selection, oversimplifying the long-video understanding task to retrieval. We introduce LF-VideoQA, a dataset for long-form, open-ended question answering over long narrative videos built on theory-of-mind questions: a character's belief depends on everything they have seen or been told, so each question demands assembling and reasoning from evidence distributed across the video. The dataset contains more than 6,300 questions on 94 recent films; each requires reasoning over scenes spanning an average of 23 minutes and comes with a question-specific rubric for recall and precision scoring. The dataset is created entirely automatically by annotating screenplays with scene events and each character's first-order beliefs and meta-beliefs, then generating (question, answer, rubric) triples through LLM-based question generation and verification; human studies validate their quality. We evaluate four families of state-of-the-art open-source VLMs across three settings and find the task highly challenging: (i) even an oracle with access to the screenplay falls well short of complete answers; (ii) the best non-oracle model attains barely half of the recall level of the oracle; (iii) unlike on prior long-video benchmarks, captions and subtitles underperform the video itself, indicating that the questions need visual evidence; and (iv) recall is the predominant bottleneck, with answers omitting many required rubric claims.

</details>


### [76] [Evaluating SAM-based and Convolutional Architectures in Thin Retinal Vessel Segmentation: Model Capacity, Computational Cost and Foundation Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00396)
*Carlos Eduardo Fontaneli,Cesar Henrique Comin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 系统性对比预训练纯ViT（MedSAM）、混合Transformer（LiteMedSAM）与三种CNN在细血管中心线召回/精度上的表现，发现预训练纯ViT的细血管召回与最佳CNN无显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献普遍认为纯ViT因粗粒度patch分词、弱局部性偏置和依赖大规模训练数据，在细血管分割上劣于CNN，但这一预期缺乏系统量化验证。

Method: 在DRIVE、HRF、FIVES三个视网膜数据集及跨域显微数据集VessMap上，比较纯ViT编码器模型MedSAM、混合Transformer LiteMedSAM与三种不同规模CNN；以细血管中心线召回率和精确率为指标，并纳入计算成本和所需训练轮数。

Result: 预训练MedSAM的细血管中心线召回在四个数据集上均与最佳CNN无显著差异（-0.6至+2.5个百分点）；而通过架构搜索从头训练的紧凑纯ViT未能保持该性能。

Conclusion: 对预训练纯ViT而言，结果不支持"其遗漏细血管"的预期，但同等细血管性能可由小得多的模型达成；性能优势主要来自预训练而非纯ViT架构本身。

Abstract: In retinal vessel segmentation, plain Vision Transformers (ViTs) are commonly expected to perform worse than convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on thin vessels, for reasons such as their coarse patch tokenization, their weak locality bias and their need for large training sets. Although this expectation is widely shared in the literature, how plain ViTs actually compare with CNNs on thin vessels has not been systematically quantified. We address this question by comparing a model with a plain ViT encoder (MedSAM), a hybrid Transformer (LiteMedSAM) and three CNNs of different sizes on three retinal datasets (DRIVE, HRF, FIVES) and, as a second-domain check, a microscopy dataset (VessMap). We measured the centerline recall and precision of thin vessels and compared the models while also considering their computational cost and how many epochs they needed to train. We found that the pre-trained MedSAM had a centerline recall of thin vessels that was not significantly different from that of the best CNN on all four datasets (-0.6 to +2.5 percentage points). A compact plain ViT obtained through architecture search but trained from scratch did not retain this performance. For pre-trained plain ViTs, our results do not support the expectation that they miss thin vessels, although similar thin-vessel performance can be obtained with much smaller models.

</details>


### [77] [TAP-Out: Tracking Any Point in 360° via Outpainting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00406)
*Finlay G. C. Hudson,James A. D. Gardner,William A. P. Smith*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TAP-Out 用生成式视频外扩作为世界模型先验，把窄视场视频补成 360° 全景，再经视频目标分割与以物体为中心的透视裁剪，使现成的帧内跟踪器能够跟踪离开视野的点，在 TAPVid360 上把出视野跟踪精度提升约 3 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跟踪离开相机视场的点需要推理未被观测的场景动态，这与跟踪可见对应点本质不同。已有方法缺少显式的出视野（OOV）推理机制，因此需要一个能把"看不见的部分"显式补全并据此定位目标的方案。

Method: 离线三段式解耦流程：(1) 以生成式视频外扩（outpainting）将窄视场输入扩展为完整 360° 等距柱状投影视频，作为世界模型先验；(2) 在全景场景中用视频目标分割（VOS）定位目标物体；(3) 合成以物体为中心的透视裁剪图，交给标准帧内跟踪器处理。全程组合现成基础模型，无需任务特定的架构修改。

Result: 在 TAPVid360 基准上取得 SOTA，OOV 跟踪精度较最佳先前方法提升约 3 倍；并展示方法可迁移到出画框的物体分割与检测；还给出按运动模式、静态/动态内容、幻觉质量划分的详细诊断分析，刻画成功与失败的条件。

Conclusion: 把"出视野推理"显式化为生成式外扩 + 分割 + 透视重跟踪的模块化流水线，是可行且效果显著的路线；方法继承所依赖生成模型的能力，其性能上限取决于外扩内容的保真度（幻觉质量）。

Abstract: Tracking points that leave the camera's field of view (FoV) requires reasoning about unobserved scene dynamics, a fundamentally different problem from tracking visible correspondences. We present TAP-Out, an offline method that makes this out-of-view (OOV) reasoning explicit by leveraging generative video outpainting as a world-model prior. Given a narrow-FoV input video, TAP-Out outpaints a complete 360° equirectangular video, locates target objects within the panoramic scene via video object segmentation, and synthesises object-centred perspective crops on which standard in-frame trackers operate. This decoupled design composes off-the-shelf foundation models without requiring task-specific architectural modifications. On the TAPVid360 benchmark, TAP-Out achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving OOV tracking accuracy by approximately 3x over the best prior method. We demonstrate its flexibility on out-of-frame object segmentation and detection and we provide detailed diagnostic analyses across motion regimes, static versus dynamic content, and hallucination quality, characterising when and why the approach succeeds or fails.

</details>


### [78] [PAM-Mamba - Efficient Dense Action Detection using Mamba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00423)
*Dhruvraj Singh Rawat,Faegheh Sardari,Armin Mustafa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PAM-Mamba 用线性复杂度 Mamba 多分支时序编码器替代 Transformer 自注意力，实现稠密动作检测，参数比 PAT 少约 61-63%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 类稠密动作检测精度高，但 O(T^2) 自注意力难以扩展到长未裁剪视频，需要线性时间、可扩展的替代架构。

Method: 在 Mamba 基础上构建多分支时序编码器：(1) GLPE 门控可学习位置编码，用零初始化的标量门控制位置信号注入；(2) Hub-and-Spoke Funnel 在 PAT 非层级多尺度结构上增加从全分辨率输入到各粗分支的直接残差；(3) Bi-TemBa 先用浅层时序卷积提取局部运动线索，再级联双向 Mamba 扫描，反向扫描精修前向表示以线性时间获得双向上下文；(4) Uncertainty-Based Mixup 用预测熵引导 mixup 配对选择。

Result: 采用 PAT 评测实现，mAP 为 Charades I3D 26.82、Charades CLIP 34.59、MultiTHUMOS I3D 46.56、MultiTHUMOS CLIP 46.92，参数量 26.1-27.9M，较 PAT 减少 61-63%。

Conclusion: 线性复杂度 Mamba 时序主干可在稠密动作检测上取得与 Transformer 相当或更优的精度，同时大幅降低参数与计算开销，为长视频多尺度时序建模提供可行方案。

Abstract: Dense action detection requires precisely localising multiple overlapping actions in long untrimmed videos. Transformer-based methods achieve strong accuracy but their $O(T^2)$ self-attention cost limits scalability. We present PAM-Mamba, a linear-time $O(T)$ architecture built on Mamba with a multi-branch temporal encoder. Gated Learnable Positional Encoding (GLPE) controls positional signal injection via a scalar gate initialised to zero, starting training without added positional signal. A Hub-and-Spoke Funnel extends the non-hierarchical multi-scale design of PAT with a direct residual from the original full-resolution input to each coarse branch, providing each coarse branch with a projection of the input features.
