Category counts reveal a critical safety asymmetry: routine perception gains (+5.93 pp) mask a regression in safety-critical hazard prediction (-1.82 pp), demonstrating that unweighted outcome rewards can trade off rare edge cases for aggregate accuracy. Reward saturation describes sampled training dynamics rather than an architectural ceiling. A separate archived Gemma-31B thinking comparison yields no detected average improvement, with uncertainty that does not establish equivalence. These results support a modest answer-selection gain for the recorded tuning configuration and a reproducible diagnostic accounting, without attributing corrected labels to specific grounding mechanisms or claiming superiority over matched supervised tuning.

</details>


### [112] [Fewer Tokens, More Answers: Verifiable-Reward Tuning of an Ornith-Style VLM for Multi-View Driving QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00833)
*T N Rickesh,Pranav Vinodh,Sowmya Kamath S*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 分析一个经GRPO强化学习适配到多摄像头驾驶问答的Ornith推理模型，发现在256 token预算下答案可提取率与准确率显著提升，但收益主要来自基础模型不可提取答案的"答案交付"问题，512 token下增益几乎消失，全量开发集上仅显著缩短输出长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理增强模型需在部署预算内把中间推理转化为可用答案；作者想量化GRPO适配对"推理→答案交付"这一转换环节的真实贡献，并厘清收益来源与适用条件。

Method: 在Ornith检查点上用可验证奖励做GRPO适配，针对多摄像头驾驶问答；在400题开发筛选集上以256 token上限做配对归档对比，错误→正确转移按首轮响应类型归因；又在相同问题上做检查点验证的512 token重建，并单独分析后期"答案提示续写"阶段；最后在2,511题全量开发集统计生成token数与配对准确率区间。

Result: 256 token上限下答案提取率78.25%→90.25%，准确率55.50%→63.75%；39个错误→正确转移中33个始于基础模型不可提取的回答，且基础模型87条不可提取回答全部触及token上限。512 token下首轮准确率增益仅+0.75pp（256时为+8.25pp）。答案提示续写对基础模型帮助更大，缩小了适配器差距。全量集上平均生成token 108.6→47.1，准确率配对区间包含零增益。

Conclusion: 本文将结果定位为"有限预算下的答案交付适配"：增益是长度敏感且非普遍性的，并明确说明仅针对Ornith单模型，不构成共享架构机制或跨模型迁移的结论，同时声明了筛选与数据溯源方面的局限。

Abstract: Reasoning-enabled model derivatives must turn intermediate deliberation into a usable answer within a deployment budget. We study that transition in an Ornith checkpoint adapted to multi-camera driving question answering with verifiable rewards. Paired archived outputs show that, on a selected 400-question development screen with a 256-token cap, GRPO increases answer extraction from 78.25% to 90.25% and accuracy from 55.50% to 63.75%. Of 39 wrong-to-correct transitions, 33 begin with an unextractable base response. The base's 87 unextractable responses all reach the token cap. Checkpoint-verified reconstruction on those same questions gives a much smaller first-pass accuracy gain at 512 tokens: +0.75 percentage points, versus +8.25 at 256. A later answer-cued continuation is analyzed separately; it helps the base more and narrows the adapter difference. On the full 2,511-question development set, this recovery-enabled pipeline reduces mean generated tokens from 108.6 to 47.1, while the paired accuracy interval includes zero gain. We frame these findings as adaptation of answer delivery under finite budgets, with explicit selection and provenance limits. Ornith's self-scaffolding lineage and newer reasoning-enabled derivatives such as Bonsai motivate the problem, but our measured results concern Ornith alone and do not establish a shared architectural mechanism or cross-model transfer.

</details>


### [113] [Running a 20B Video Diffusion Transformer on Consumer Hardware: A Deployment and Measurement Report for MiniMax H3 on Apple Silicon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00843)
*Luke Shi,Steven Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Report deploying MiniMax H3 (20.38B-param video DiT) fully on a Mac mini M5 Pro / 64 GiB unified memory via official bf16→Q8 MLX quantization; a 15.08 s 576x1024 clip took 4838 s at 27.47 GiB peak; 17 clips in 26.5 h with zero failures; blind human review ~3.0/5.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Show that a large open video diffusion transformer can be quantized and run locally on consumer Apple Silicon without cloud dependency, documenting feasibility, blockers, and measured costs rather than proposing new modeling ideas.

Method: Systems/empirical study: local bf16-to-Q8 (group size 64) quantization, end-to-end text-to-video pipeline, deployment write-up including two blockers and fixes, measurements of build time, peak memory and per-clip latency across four resolution tiers (384x640 to 768x1344), unattended production run, and blind human rating of 17 clips.

Result: Working local pipeline; 576x1024 15.08 s clip = 4838.49 s, MLX peak 27.467 GiB; 17 clips in 26.49 h, zero render failures; blind scores 3.12 / 3.18 / 2.94 for structural integrity, temporal consistency, artifacts; render speed on the order of ~5 min per generated second.

Conclusion: Consumer Apple Silicon can host a 20B-parameter open video DiT locally with acceptable reliability for batch production, though latency is far from interactive; the authors explicitly claim no model innovation.

Abstract: We report the end-to-end deployment and measurement of MiniMax H3, a 20.38-billion-parameter video diffusion transformer (DiT) - the count measured from the safetensors headers of the Q8 checkpoint as deployed locally (Section 3.2) - running entirely on consumer Apple Silicon hardware: an Apple Mac mini with M5 Pro chip and 64 GiB of unified memory. Using the official bf16-to-Q8 (8-bit, group size 64) quantization path executed locally on the machine, we produced a working text-to-video pipeline with no cloud dependency. We document the full deployment procedure, including two non-trivial blockers and their fixes, and report measured figures for build time, peak memory, and per-clip render latency across four resolution tiers (Draft 384x640 through Native 768x1344). A 15.08-second 576x1024 clip rendered in 4838.49 seconds with a measured MLX peak of 27.467 GiB. We further operated the system as an unattended production pipeline, completing 17 clips in 26.49 hours with zero render failures. A blind human review of the 17 production clips (generation prompts withheld) averaged 3.12, 3.18, and 2.94 out of 5 for structural integrity, temporal consistency, and visible artifacts. All figures in this report are our own measurements except where explicitly labeled as third-party data. This is a systems/empirical report; we make no claim of model innovation.

</details>


### [114] [Toward Counterfactual Learning for Selective Re-Examination in Agentic Visual Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00848)
*Ao Chen,Shengchao Chen,Yan Luximon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReSee基准（3227条高分辨率视觉搜索轨迹、8827个显式"提交或再检查"决策，含反事实裁定）与CARE方法：在决策层用同一搜索状态下commit/re-examine成对续写的代价感知回报差估计"再观察的反事实价值"，将信用仅分配给对应裁决token，实现局部化信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率图像视觉搜索要求VLM既决定"看哪里"，也要决定"是否还需要再看一次"再作答。现有prompting、示范与结果级RL只在轨迹末端给稀疏奖励，无法直接监督某一搜索状态下"再检查是否值得"，导致VLM再检查选择性差、无谓视觉请求多。

Method: 1) 构建ReSee：3227条视觉搜索轨迹、8827个commit-or-re-examine显式决策，通过反事实裁定区分"应继续检查"与"宜立即提交"的状态；2) 提出CARE决策级RL：从同一状态采样配对续写，分别强制commit与re-examine裁决，比较代价感知回报差作为额外观察的反事实价值估计；3) 将该优势仅赋给裁决token，形成关于"是否继续搜索"的局部化信用分配，与GRPO对照。

Result: 实验显示现有VLM的再检查选择性有限；CARE在两个骨干模型上相较GRPO显著提升准确率与决策选择性，并在六个未见OOD基准上以更高准确率、更少视觉请求取得优势。

Conclusion: 将"是否继续观察"建模为可监督的决策级问题、并以反事实配对优势提供局部信用，是提升VLM高分辨率搜索效率与准确性的有效路径，且具备跨骨干与分布外泛化能力。

Abstract: Visual search over high-resolution images requires a vision-language model (VLM) not only to determine where to inspect, but also whether another observation is warranted before committing to an answer. Existing prompting, demonstrations, and outcome-based reinforcement learning can encourage re-examination, yet do not directly supervise whether it is beneficial at a particular search state. We introduce ReSee, a benchmark of re-examination decisions comprising 3,227 visual-search trajectories and 8,827 explicit commit-or-re-examine decisions, with counterfactual adjudication that distinguishes states where additional inspection is warranted from those where commitment is preferable. Building on this formulation, we propose CARE (Counterfactual Advantage for Re-Examination), a decision-level reinforcement learning method that compares paired continuations under commit and re-examine verdicts from the same search state. Their cost-aware return difference estimates the counterfactual value of an additional observation and is assigned only to the corresponding verdict tokens, providing localized credit for whether search should continue. Experiments expose limited re-examination selectivity in existing VLMs and show that CARE significantly improves accuracy and decision selectivity over GRPO across two backbones, with higher accuracy and fewer visual requests on six unseen OOD benchmarks.

</details>


### [115] [Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00859)
*Yijie Jin,Yuxuan Liu,Jiajun Xu,Ye Huang,Chuzhi Wang,Jiayang Li,Ruiyang Chen,Chenling Hong,Xu Wang,Zhijie Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Wave Forcing (WF) 通过协同设计生成、训练与执行流程，实现支持多步去噪的实时长视频连续生成：分块因果注意力可访问更早、更干净的块，错峰流水线在满模型副本间分配去噪与缓存刷新，达到 1F1C；三阶段训练引入混合噪声、运动监督与因果自适应；Wave Runtime 提供 K/V 提前传输、通信计算重叠与流水线 VAE 解码。八卡 H200 上 4 步 WF 达 147.6 DiT FPS / 134.8 端到端 FPS（单卡 7.07 倍），Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上质量与 Rolling Forcing 相当且动态度更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分块自回归视频生成在效率与长视频质量上双重受限：序列化去噪与历史缓存刷新即使单步去噪也需两次前向；长时 rollout 质量衰减并出现镜头漂移。目标是实现外观一致、运动自然且实时的连续长视频输出。

Method: 1) 分块因果注意力允许访问尚未去噪完成但更早、更干净的块；2) 将交错去噪与缓存刷新阶段分布到多个完整模型副本，形成流水线，填充后每轮并发前向产出一个块（1F1C）；3) 三阶段训练：混合噪声去噪→运动监督→使用自生成历史的因果自适应；4) Wave Runtime (WaveRT)：Wave Parallelism 提前 K/V 投递与通信—计算重叠、优化算子与流水线 VAE 解码。

Result: Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 上 5 步 WF 整体质量与 Rolling Forcing 相当，长短视频 Dynamic Degree 更高；八卡 H200 上 4 步 WF 达 147.6 DiT FPS、134.8 端到端 FPS，为单卡端到端吞吐的 7.07 倍；在匹配 SageAttention+W8A8、去噪步数与卡数的 DiT-only 对比中，WP 在 1.3B–14B 六个规模上吞吐最高为 Ulysses/Ring 上下文并行较优者的 2.53 倍。

Conclusion: WF 以算法—训练—系统协同设计解决了分块自回归长视频生成的效率与漂移问题，在保持质量的同时显著提升动态表现与并行吞吐，具备实时连续视频生成的实际部署价值。

Abstract: Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion. Existing chunk-wise autoregressive methods face challenges in both generation efficiency and long-video quality: serialized denoising and history-cache refresh require two forward passes even with one-step denoising, and longer rollouts can degrade quality and cause camera drift. We propose Wave Forcing (WF), which co-designs generation, training, and execution for continuous video output with multi-step denoising. WF uses chunk-wise causal attention to access earlier, cleaner chunks before their denoising is complete, and distributes staggered denoising and cache-refresh stages across full-model replicas to achieve 1F1C: one output chunk per concurrent forward round after pipeline fill. To adapt the model to this continuous generation process, we develop a three-stage training procedure that successively introduces mixed-noise denoising, motion supervision, and causal adaptation using self-generated history. To execute this process efficiently, Wave Runtime (WaveRT) uses Wave Parallelism (WP) for early K/V delivery and communication-computation overlap, together with optimized kernels and pipelined VAE decoding. Experiments on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B show that 5-step WF maintains overall quality comparable to Rolling Forcing while achieving higher Dynamic Degree on both short and long videos. Our system efficiency experiments show that 4-step WF achieves 147.6 DiT FPS and 134.8 end-to-end FPS on eight H200 GPUs, yielding 7.07x the single-GPU end-to-end throughput. In DiT-only tests with matched SageAttention+W8A8 backends, denoising steps, and GPU counts, WP delivers up to 2.53x the throughput of the faster of the Ulysses and Ring context-parallel baselines across six model scales (1.3B-14B).

</details>


### [116] [Learning to Group and Order: Cross-Instance Self-Supervised RL for Vision-Centric MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00892)
*Songming Yang,Hong-Tao Yu,Xiu-Shen Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GO-SSL: 视觉中心的MLLM后训练框架，将两个无标签样本的局部元素混合，训练模型按来源分组并恢复组内顺序，从而将跨实例比较与空间/时间/几何结构恢复耦合为可验证奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督视觉 pretext 任务多利用实例内结构（within-instance），对跨实例判别与细粒度比较监督不足；同时希望在不需人工标注的前提下获得可自动验证的 RL 奖励。

Method: 跨实例拼图（cross-instance jigsaw）：给定两个视觉实例，混合其局部元素，模型需按来源实例分组（grouping）并恢复每组内顺序（ordering）。同一无标签数据通过多样配对、打乱方式及「随机到困难」课程产生丰富可验证监督。主要实例化为跨图像拼图，并扩展到3D深度排序与视频时间顺序。

Result: 在多个基准上稳定优于基座MLLM与先前自监督后训练基线，细粒度感知与空间理解提升明显；跨模型规模与模型族验证了通用性。

Conclusion: 跨实例比较可作为有效的自监督RL信号，提升MLLM可迁移的视觉理解能力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become an important paradigm for improving multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially with automatically verifiable rewards. Self-supervised visual pretext tasks provide such rewards without human annotations. However, existing methods mainly exploit within-instance structure, offering limited supervision for cross-instance discrimination and fine-grained comparison. We introduce Group-and-Order Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning (GO-SSL), a cross-instance jigsaw framework for vision-centric MLLM post-training. Given two visual instances, GO-SSL mixes their local elements and trains the model to group them by instance of origin while recovering the order within each group, coupling instance-level comparison with spatial, temporal, or geometric structure recovery. This paired formulation turns the same unlabeled data into richer verifiable supervision through diverse pairings, shuffles, and a random-to-hard curriculum. We instantiate GO-SSL mainly on cross-image jigsaw tasks and further extend it to 3D depth and video temporal ordering. Across diverse benchmarks, GO-SSL consistently improves over the base MLLM and prior self-supervised post-training baselines, with clear gains in fine-grained perception and spatial understanding. Further evaluations across model scales and families support its generality. These results suggest that cross-instance comparison provides a useful self-supervised RL signal for improving transferable visual understanding in MLLMs. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [117] [FilmTogether: Cinematic Video Generation from Low-Cost Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00899)
*Shiying Zhang,Xiaobin Hu,Qianchi Zhang,Jiaqi Zhao,Xiaoda Yang,Bo Yin,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CineCraft-120K 大规模低成本/高成本成对视频数据集（5 大类、23 子类，含成对感知编辑提示与元素级映射），并设计双记忆特征适配器（文本记忆扩展 low2high 语义、提示记忆提供逐层视觉特征修正），实现保持布局/身份/运动的视频"电影化"升级编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动设备拍摄的低成本视频与高成本电影级素材存在显著美学鸿沟；直接升级（光照、服装、材质等异质制作元素）而不破坏原始布局、身份与时序运动很困难，瓶颈在于缺乏针对复杂 low-to-high 外观迁移的成对训练数据，且现有视频编辑模型未充分利用多维度低成本构成的感知与增强能力。

Method: 构建 CineCraft-120K 对齐的高低成本视频对数据集，按 5 大类/23 细粒度子类分类，并提供元素级映射与成对感知的丰富文本提示（刻画美学变换并锚定结构布局）；架构上提出简单有效的双记忆特征适配器：文本记忆扩展语义容量以适配 low2high 外观变化，提示记忆在上下文注入前提供逐层高成本元素的视觉特征修正。

Result: 大量实验与消融验证了 CineCraft-120K 在 low-to-high 成本视频编辑上的优越性，以及双记忆适配器的有效性。

Conclusion: 配对数据+元素级提示与双记忆适配器可有效弥合低成本与电影级视频的美学差距，为可控视频风格/制作升级编辑提供数据与方法基础。

Abstract: The widespread adoption of mobile devices has democratized video recording, but a stark aesthetic divide persists between casual, low-cost captures and high-cost cinematic productions. Bridging this gap requires upgrading heterogeneous production elements, such as lighting, specialized costumes, and materials, without altering the core layout, identity, and temporal motion of the original footage. However, this task is heavily bottlenecked by two important challenges: 1) Lacking a high-quality paired training data specifically designed to handle complex low-to-high appearance shifts. 2) Ignoring the capacity of current video editing models to perceive and enhance the multiple low-cost compositions. To address these issues, we present CineCraft-120K, a large-scale dataset of aligned low- and high-cost video pairs annotated with pair-aware editing prompts. CineCraft-120K features a diverse, high-resolution and high-cost Cinematic Crafting bank spanning decades of media production, meticulously taxonomized into 5 broad domains and 23 fine-grained sub-categories. It also provides element-level mapping between low- and high-cost counterparts, offering pair-aware rich textual prompts that precisely detail the required aesthetic transformations while anchoring structural layout. Architecturally, we propose a simple yet effective dual-memory feature adapter, where a text-memory expands semantic capacity for low2high appearance changes, and a hint memory supplies layer-wise visual feature corrections of high-cost element before context injection. Extensive experiments and ablation studies demonstrate the superiority of CineCraft-120K for low-to-high-cost video editing, alongside the effectiveness of our dual-memory adapter.

</details>


### [118] [ZOPGA-KD: Zeroth Order PGA Guided Data Free Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00908)
*Tuhin Subhra Mukherjee,Tiya Rose Pulikunnel,Vaidhav Adit,Devanand Thanissery,S.H. Shabbeer Basha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出仅依赖教师输出logits的无数据知识蒸馏方法：从平滑随机噪声出发，用以零阶梯度估计（代替反向传播）获得梯度的投影梯度上升（PGA）生成合成样本，再训练学生网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始训练数据因隐私问题常不可得；既有无数据KD方法或依赖白盒教师参数（需架构/梯度），或依赖计算昂贵的生成器训练，黑盒方案同样计算量大。目标是仅用教师logits实现低成本、黑盒兼容的合成数据生成。

Method: 黑盒设定下仅访问教师输出logits：以平滑随机噪声为初始化，通过零阶梯度估计（zeroth-order gradient estimation）获取梯度信号，执行投影梯度上升（PGA）最大化教师响应以合成样本；随后用合成样本对学生网络进行常规KD训练。不访问教师架构、参数或梯度。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上与可访问教师参数的蒸馏方法对比，蒸馏性能相当，说明零阶梯度估计驱动的PGA合成数据足以支撑有效蒸馏。

Conclusion: 零阶梯度估计可替代对教师的反向传播，实现纯logits黑盒、无需生成器的无数据KD，计算开销低于生成式方案，为隐私受限场景下的模型压缩提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) enables the transfer of learned representations from a large teacher network to a small student network. In foundational KD, the student network uses the original training data of the teacher model to accomplish this task. However, due to privacy concerns, the original training data is often not available. To overcome this reliance on original training data, several data-free knowledge distillation methods have been developed. Some of these methods operate in the white-box setting, and a few methods generate synthetic data by training a generator network. White-box methods use the teacher model's parameters to obtain a synthetic dataset. To avoid relying on teacher parameters, some methods use computationally expensive generative approaches to obtain such a dataset. There also exist certain black-box methods that generate the synthetic data without accessing teacher parameters. These methods are also computationally intensive. We propose a data-free knowledge distillation method that utilizes just the teacher's output logits and does not require access to its architecture, parameters, or gradients. We generate synthetic data via Projected Gradient Ascent (PGA) starting from smooth random noise signals. Required gradients are obtained through zeroth-order gradient estimation rather than backpropagating through the teacher's parameters. The student is then trained on these synthetically generated samples. We evaluate the proposed method on several benchmark datasets and show that the distillation performance is comparable with approaches that have access to the teacher model parameters.

</details>


### [119] [UI-UG 2: Advancing Mobile UI Understanding and Generation with Fine-Grained Supervision and Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00926)
*Hao Yang,Shuoyang Liu,Xiaoyu Lin,Zhou Fang,Maji Huang,Zhaosong Huang,Ruichao Mao,Teng Guo,Hai Rao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UI-UG 2：4B 多模态大模型统一移动 UI 理解与生成，采用前端对齐的 80 类两级 UI 分类法，生成端用 Playwright 在线渲染 + LLM-as-Judge/对比偏好排序驱动的 GRPO 替代离线 DPO；在 80 类基准上取得最强指代与密集定位（dense grounding）结果，并在 4B 规模下取得最佳生成综合分，且观察到理解→生成的稳定迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动 UI 理解与生成同时需要细粒度组件感知与可靠的结构化合成，前作 UI-UG 在任务覆盖、分类体系与生成优化方式（离线 DPO 偏好对齐）上仍有不足，缺少与前端组件语义对齐的标注体系以及可感知渲染结果的在线优化信号。

Method: 构建多源理解语料（RICO、VINS、Android in the Wild、Android Control），按 80 类两级前端对齐分类法标注；配套 5000+ 需求-截图-JSON 三元组，通过 DSL 实现渐进式结构化 UI 生成。理解端引入分解奖励（类别预测、OCR 保真、颜色识别、密集定位、GUI 定位）；生成端用端到端在线 GRPO：采样 DSL 输出经 Playwright 服务端管线渲染，再由 LLM-as-a-Judge 与对比偏好排序给出奖励。

Result: 在自建 80 类基准上取得所评估模型中最佳的指代与密集定位性能；在 4B 紧凑规模下取得最佳生成综合分；固定训练预算下加入细粒度 UI 感知监督可提升生成质量，呈现一致的理解→生成迁移。

Conclusion: 组件级语义为 UI 理解与生成提供共享表征基础，渲染感知的在线 RL 与前端对齐分类法是小模型上统一 UI 理解-生成的有效路径。

Abstract: Mobile UI understanding and generation require both fine-grained component perception and reliable structured synthesis. Inspired by the unified direction introduced by UI-UG, we present UI-UG 2, a compact 4B-parameter multimodal large language model (MLLM) that advances mobile UI Understanding and Generation with broader task coverage, a front-end-aligned taxonomy, and online render-aware reinforcement learning. UI-UG 2 constructs a multi-source understanding corpus from RICO, VINS, Android in the Wild, and Android Control, annotated with an 80-category two-level UI taxonomy aligned with front-end component semantics, and pairs it with over 5,000 requirement-screenshot-JSON tuples for progressive structured UI generation through a domain-specific language (DSL). For understanding, UI-UG 2 introduces decomposed rewards for category prediction, OCR fidelity, color recognition, dense grounding, and GUI grounding. Unlike the offline Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)-style generation optimization in UI-UG, UI-UG 2 optimizes generation through end-to-end online Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO): sampled DSL outputs are rendered with a Playwright-based server-side pipeline and evaluated using LLM-as-a-Judge and contrastive preference ranking. Experiments show that UI-UG 2 achieves the strongest referring and dense-grounding results among the evaluated models on our 80-category benchmark, and achieves the best composite generation score among compared models at a compact scale (4B). More importantly, we observe a consistent understanding-to-generation transfer: adding fine-grained UI perception supervision improves generation quality under a fixed training budget, suggesting that component-level semantics provide a shared representational foundation for both tasks.

</details>


### [120] [What Helps Denoising Can Hurt Memory: Rethinking History in Long Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00937)
*Yubin Jing,Ziyang Zhang,Meng Chen,Yuyao Li,Haofan Wang,Yichen Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Commit Forcing：自回归视频生成在撰写 KV 时只读取前一 block 的 KV，形成链式传递，避免旧历史上下文在 committing 阶段造成的一致性衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成中，历史上下文既作为去噪条件又作为 committing（写 KV）输入；作者发现过旧的历史在 committing 阶段被读取时会损害后续生成，且在同一上下文尺寸下旧上下文会降低 clip 间主体一致性。

Method: 分析 committing 上下文的规模与时间位置对一致性的影响；提出免训练规则 Commit Forcing，将 committing 组织为链式结构，每个 block 只读取前一个 block 存储的 KV，旧历史只能经链传递；在 6 个预训练生成器上直接应用。

Result: 5 种支持更长上下文的生成器配置中，一致性随 committing 上下文扩展呈先升、后平台、再下降；在 60 秒 VBench 上全部 6 个生成器 Quality 与 Total 提升，最多 +1.27 Quality、+1.10 Total；增益延伸至 240 秒视频；120 秒 LongLive 盲测中主体/场景一致性胜率 83.5%，总体偏好 82.9%（不计平局）。

Conclusion: 区分「去噪上下文」与「committing 上下文」是自回归长视频生成的关键设计点，简单链式读取即可在无需重训的情况下显著提升长程一致性与整体质量。

Abstract: Autoregressive video generators produce long videos block by block, using historical context to maintain temporal consistency. After denoising, a committing pass encodes each clean block into keys and values (KV) that later blocks read, and the same clean block can be encoded into different KV depending on the history it reads. We therefore study historical context not only as a condition for denoising but also as an input to committing. Older historical context that supports denoising can harm subsequent generation when read during committing. At fixed context size and temporal positions, older historical context lowers mean clip-to-clip Subject Consistency. Across 5 generator configurations supporting longer contexts, consistency rises, plateaus, and then declines as committing context expands. Motivated by these findings, we propose Commit Forcing, a training-free rule that organizes committing into a chain. During committing, each block reads only the preceding block's stored KV, so older historical context reaches new entries only through the chain. We apply this rule to 6 pretrained generators. On 60-second VBench, Commit Forcing improves Quality and Total on all 6 generators, by up to 1.27 Quality points and 1.10 Total points. Long-range consistency gains extend to 240-second videos. In a blinded comparison on 120-second LongLive videos, Commit Forcing achieves win rates of 83.5% for subject and scene consistency and 82.9% for overall preference against the base generator, excluding ties.

</details>


### [121] [PSF-Informed Reconstruction: An Enhanced 2D Directional Filtered Backprojection Method for Cone-Beam Rotary Computed Laminography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00953)
*Chengxiang Wang,Wei Yu,Baodong Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于点扩散函数的2D方向滤波反投影(DFBP)，将CL重建的3D滤波近似转移到2D投影空间，显著抑制层间叠加伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 锥束旋转计算层析(CL)适合高长宽比物体成像，但传统CL-FBP/CL-FDK仅沿探测器行做一维滤波，导致严重的层间叠加伪影、对比度下降与边缘模糊。

Method: 1) 推导重建像素与探测器投影点的精确对应关系，得到投影过程的解析表达；2) 在反投影中引入两个加权因子以抵消非线性，简化PSF形式；3) 在傅里叶空间线性化坐标关系，将3D滤波近似转移到2D投影空间，得到由2D von Hann窗与2D sinc窗构成的简洁方向滤波器。

Result: 实验表明，相较CL-FBP与CL-FDK，所提方法重建对比度更高、边界更锐利、叠加伪影更少，并能更准确恢复气泡缺陷、电子元件等内部结构。

Conclusion: 2D方向滤波反投影在保持计算效率的同时显著提升CL重建质量，是高长宽比物体X射线层析成像的有效替代方案。

Abstract: Cone-beam rotary computed laminography (CL) presents a viable alternative to cone-beam CT for imaging objects with high aspect ratios. Conventional reconstruction techniques, such as CL-FBP and CL-FDK, often yield suboptimal results charac?terized by pronounced superimposition artifacts, reduced contrast,and blurred edges, primarily due to their reliance on 1D row-wise filtering along detector rows. To address these limitations and improve reconstruction quality, we proposed a novel 2D directional filtered backprojection (DFBP) method based on the point spread function (PSF). First, an exact expression for the projection process is derived by establishing the relationship between a reconstructed pixel and its corresponding projection point on the detector. Second, a revised backprojection process incorporating two weighting factors is introduced to counteract the nonlinearity inherent in conventional backprojection, leading to a simplified PSF formulation. Third, to circumvent the computational burden of 3D image space filtering,an approximate method by linearizing the coordinate relationship in Fourier space under some assumptions is developed that transfers the 3D filtering operation to the 2D projection space. This approach facilitates the derivation of a formally simple yet effective 2D direc?tional filter, which integrates a 2D von Hann window and a 2D sinc window. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method produces reconstructions with superior contrast, sharper boundaries,and fewer superimposition artifacts compared to CL-FBP and CL?FDK. Moreover, it enables more accurate recovery of internal structures, such as bubble defects and electronic components.

</details>


### [122] [4K Image Super-Resolution on Mobile NPUs: Mobile AI 2026 Challenge Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00963)
*Andrey Ignatov,Georgy Perevozchikov,Radu Timofte,Fubin Ren,Shihao Wang,Liwen Zhang,Zhe Xu,Zhipei Lei,Minjian Zhang,Kailing Tang,Dingyong Gou,Yanlin Wu,Cong Li,Xiaohui Cui,Kihwan Yoon,Ganzorig Gankhuyag,Heo MyeongCheol,Yonghyun Park,Juho Jung,Sungjei Kim,Phuong-Nam Nguyen-Pham,Nam-Tien Le,Tinh-Anh Nguyen-Nhu,Matin Fazel,Abdelhak Bentaleb,Xinrui Li,Xusheng He,Jianlong Wu,Mohsin Ikram,Dmitry Ignatov,Hao Chen,Long Sun,Jiangxin Dong,Jinshan Pan,Jinhui Tang,Siyue Teng,Yuxuan Jiang,Fan Zhang,David Bull,Zhe Xiao,Jun Xiao,Zhi-Song Liu,Jiayi Pei,Songtao Wu,Hong Shang,Kuanhong Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Mobile AI挑战赛总结：面向高通骁龙8 Elite Gen 5与联发科天玑9500 NPU的3×图像超分（FHD→4K），分INT8全量化与浮点两条赛道，最优方案在5ms内重建4K、PSNR约30dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动与IoT设备需在NPU上高效部署超分模型，而现有高性能深度学习模型难以在多数芯片的NPU上高效运行，故需探索兼顾性能与可部署性的高效网络设计。

Method: 以DIV2K为训练数据开展3倍上采样竞赛；Track 1要求模型完全INT8量化，在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 NPU上测速；Track 2为浮点方案，在天玑9500 NPU上评测；参赛方案多为轻量CNN/注意力结构配合NPU友好的算子与量化策略。

Result: 顶尖方案可在5毫秒以内完成4K图像重建，PSNR达30dB量级，兼顾低延迟与重建质量；论文汇总并描述了各参赛模型的架构与部署细节。

Conclusion: 验证了在主流移动NPU上实现实时4K超分的可行性，为移动端高效超分模型设计（量化友好、NPU友好）提供了方案集合与基线参考。

Abstract: Image super-resolution is widely used on mobile devices for upscaling various types of image data. This creates a need for efficient deep learning-based models that are not only performant but can also be deployed on neural processing units (NPUs) present in the majority of mobile and IoT chipsets. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose the participants to design fast solutions that can upsample images from Full HD to 4K resolution while running on popular mobile NPUs from Qualcomm and MediaTek. For this, the participants were provided with the DIV2K dataset and trained models to do an efficient 3X image upscaling. The competition had two tracks: in the first track, the models had to be fully quantized (INT8), and the runtime of all models was evaluated on the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 NPU. In the second track, the participants were developing floating-point solutions that were evaluated on the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 NPU. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to reconstruct 4K images under 5 milliseconds while reaching a PSNR score of 30 dB. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.

</details>


### [123] [Efficient Image Denoising on Smartphone GPUs: Mobile AI 2026 Challenge Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00974)
*Andrey Ignatov,Georgy Perevozchikov,Radu Timofte,HaoDong Wu,Desheng Cai,Nikolay Falaleev,Faraz Kayani,Sarmad Kayani,Asad Ahmed,Dmitry Ignatov,Kihwan Yoon,Ganzorig Gankhuyag,Yoonsuk Kang,Van Le,Jin Young Lee,Sunzhe Yang,Qiuhai Yan,Kang Chen,Tingting Wang,Faming Fang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Mobile AI 挑战赛：面向智能手机 GPU 的实时（<100ms）全高清图像去噪方案与真实噪声数据集综述


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动摄影中去噪是基础问题，但现有方法多依赖合成噪声数据训练，且计算量过大，难以在手机端处理全分辨率图像，因此需要兼顾性能与移动硬件可部署性的高效模型。

Method: 以竞赛形式征集方案：提供大规模真实拍摄的 noisy-clean 图像对数据集；在 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5（Adreno GPU）与 Dimensity 9500（Mali GPU）上进行运行时评测，并汇总各参赛模型的完整描述。

Result: 优胜方案在两大平台上均实现高质量去噪，单帧全高清处理延迟低于 100 ms，PSNR 超过 37 dB。

Conclusion: 该挑战赛提出了可在主流手机 GPU 上实时运行的全高清去噪模型，并给出了面向移动端高效去噪的工程化方案集合，为真实场景移动摄影去噪提供参考。

Abstract: Image denoising is a fundamental problem in mobile photography. Despite a large number of solutions proposed for this task, the majority of them are trained on synthetically produced noisy images, and are additionally too computationally heavy for processing full-resolution images on mobile devices. This creates a need for efficient deep learning-based models that are not only performant but can also be deployed on constrained mobile hardware. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose the participants to design fast solutions that can denoise Full HD resolution photos while running on popular smartphone GPUs from Qualcomm and Arm. For this, the participants were provided with a large-scale dataset consisting of noisy-clean image pairs captured in the wild. The runtime of all models was evaluated on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno and Mali GPUs, respectively. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to perform high-quality image denoising under 100 milliseconds on both platforms while reaching a PSNR score of over 37 dB. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.

</details>


### [124] [Robust Pixel-wise Digital Image Correlation under Large Motions and Illumination Variations via a Global-to-Local Hybrid Neural Field](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01018)
*Xianglong Guo,Jianyang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出全局-局部混合神经DIC框架：第一阶段用粗旋转搜索、相位相关与掩膜精化估计主导刚体变换以获得可靠初值；第二阶段用KAN+MLP表示残差位移，并以有效重叠、光照鲁棒的结构损失优化，显式建模乘性与加性灰度扰动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动深度学习DIC推理快但对未见散斑、变形模式、噪声和光照泛化差；经典优化DIC与图像约束神经DIC虽免标注，却对初始化、大刚体运动、精细非均匀变形和灰度扰动敏感。

Method: 两阶段混合神经DIC：Stage 1 通过粗旋转搜索、相位相关和掩膜精化估计主导面内刚体变换，为大平移/大旋转提供初始化；Stage 2 以KAN与MLP混合网络表征残差位移，用有效重叠且光照鲁棒的结构损失优化，局部灰度模型显式容纳乘性与加性强度变化，实现逐像素全局-局部联合估计。

Result: 仿真与真实实验显示，在噪声、非均匀变形、大旋转、光照变化及退化成像条件下均可实现准确、稳定的位移恢复。

Conclusion: 将刚体全局估计与残差局部神经表示解耦，可显著改善神经DIC的初始化鲁棒性和对灰度扰动的抗性，是一种面向鲁棒逐像素测量的可行混合范式。

Abstract: Digital image correlation (DIC) is a widely used non-contact technique for full-field displacement measurement. Data-driven deep-learning DIC offers rapid inference but may generalize poorly to unseen speckle patterns, deformation modes, noise levels, and illumination conditions. Classical optimization-based DIC and recent image-constrained neural formulations avoid labeled displacement data, yet their convergence and accuracy remain vulnerable to initialization, large rigid-body motion, fine non-uniform deformation, and gray-value disturbances. This paper presents a global-to-local hybrid neural DIC framework for robust pixelwise measurement. Stage 1 estimates a dominant in-plane rigid transformation through coarse rotation search, phase correlation, and masked refinement, providing a reliable initialization under large translation and rotation. Stage 2 represents the residual displacement with a hybrid Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) and multilayer perceptron (MLP), and optimizes it using a valid-overlap, illumination-robust structural loss. The local gray-value model explicitly accommodates multiplicative and additive intensity changes. Simulated and real experiments demonstrate accurate and stable displacement recovery under noise, non-uniform deformation, large rotation, illumination variation, and degraded imaging conditions.

</details>


### [125] [Grounding Across Views: Cross-View Referring Reasoning for Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01074)
*Hao Gan,Liuqian Wang,Shuang Li,Yufei Gao,Wentao Chao,Chong Fu,Chengming Liu,Lei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出跨视角视觉定位新任务CVVG，用指代表达+视觉示例联合引导卫星图实例定位，并给出视角感知框架GAV与CVOGL-Text基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角目标地理定位（CVOGL）仅用点击点或框提示，浪费了自然语言的语义属性与关系；且指代表达常依赖查询视角，难以直接在卫星图中落地。

Method: 形式化CVVG任务：以指代表达与视觉示例联合做实例级定位。GAV框架核心是"视角感知指代推理"——从标注的查询图像生成以目标为中心的描述，校验目标类别一致性，并加入方向无关的角色线索；再通过示例提示、跨视角对齐与场景级判别，把语义证据锚定到卫星实例。

Result: MoP-UAV上达62.55% Acc@0.5，SOTA；新基准CVOGL-Text上，街景与无人机视图分别较点击点基线提升7.09与6.79 Acc@0.25，显示对大视角差的鲁棒性。代码与标注将开源。

Conclusion: 语言+示例提示的多模态查询可替代单点/框提示，显著提升大视角差下的跨视角实例定位，并贡献了可复用的文本引导基准。

Abstract: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to localize a target in a satellite image from an observation captured under another viewpoint. Existing methods typically specify the query with a click point or bounding box, marking the target region but underusing the semantic attributes and relations conveyed by natural language. Moreover, referring expressions are often viewpoint-dependent, making query-view descriptions difficult to ground directly in the satellite image. In this paper, we formulate cross-view visual grounding (CVVG), extending conventional point- or box-prompted CVOGL to instance grounding jointly guided by a referring expression and a visual exemplar. We present GAV (Grounding Across Views), a view-aware framework for selectively transferring visual and linguistic evidence across views. Its core is view-aware referring reasoning: target-centered descriptions are derived from the marked query image, checked for target-category consistency, and augmented with a direction-free role cue. Exemplar prompting, cross-view alignment, and scene-level discrimination ground this semantic evidence in a satellite instance. GAV achieves a new state of the art on MoP-UAV with 62.55% Acc@0.5. We also introduce CVOGL-Text, a benchmark for text-guided grounding from street- and drone-view queries to satellite images. GAV outperforms the click-point baseline by 7.09 and 6.79 Acc@0.25 points on the street- and drone-view splits, respectively, demonstrating robustness to larger viewpoint gaps. The code and annotations will be publicly released.

</details>


### [126] [CuPH: Parallel Cubical Persistent Homology via Level-Synchronous Component Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01078)
*Guangyu Meng,Pengfei Gu,Erin Wolf Chambers,Danny Z. Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CuPH：面向2D图像的GPU并行立方持续同调算法，直接作用于像素而非立方胞，将并行深度从Θ(n)降至O(L log n)，比GPU基线CMP快18.6–99.6倍，并可作为即插即用PH后端加速拓扑感知分类与分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准立方持续同调（PH）需按过滤顺序对胞做归约，串行深度为Θ(n)（n为像素数），严重限制单图内GPU并行度，使其难以嵌入拓扑感知深度学习流程；因此需要在保持结果等价的前提下实现像素级并行PH。

Method: 提出CuPH：1）直接以像素为单位处理，而非顶点/边/方块立方胞；2）按过滤值（灰度级）对像素分桶，采用level-synchronous扫描逐层激活；3）用无锁union-find追踪连通分量，实现并行的0维持久同调计算；4）将整个层级扫描实现为单个CUDA kernel以消除跨层kernel启动开销；5）给出与整数输入下标准立方PH持久图完全一致的理论证明，并给出浮点输入下的稳定性界。

Result: 并行深度由Θ(n)降至O(L log n)（L为强度级数）；实测比现有GPU基线CMP快18.6–99.6倍；作为drop-in PH后端，拓扑感知分类加速4.2–16.7倍、分割加速8.3–44倍且精度不降；支持高分辨率图像全图PH损失，分割Dice提升2.2–4.6点，训练加速25–31倍（相对patch-local PH基线）。

Conclusion: CuPH使立方持续同调在GPU上真正并行化且保持理论等价性，显著降低拓扑特征计算成本，使全图拓扑损失在高分辨率场景下可行，为拓扑感知深度学习提供了实用的高效基础组件。

Abstract: Persistent homology (PH) is a mathematically principled multi-scale topological descriptor of shape and connectivity in data. It is widely applied in image classification, segmentation, and shape analysis across medical and aerial imaging, providing structural information that pixel-wise deep learning may overlook. Standard cubical PH decomposes an image into cubical cells (vertices, edges, and squares) and reduces them sequentially in filtration order. This sequential reduction has $\Theta(n)$ parallel depth for an $n$-pixel image, limiting within-image GPU parallelism and constraining its use in topology-aware deep learning. We introduce CuPH, a GPU-based parallel algorithm for computing cubical PH on 2D images that operates directly on pixels rather than cubical cells. CuPH buckets pixels by filtration values, activates them with a level-synchronous sweep, and tracks connected components with a lock-free union-find method. We prove that CuPH produces persistence diagrams identical to standard cubical PH on integer inputs, with a stability bound for floating-point inputs. CuPH reduces parallel depth from $\Theta(n)$ to $O(L\log n)$ for an image with $L$ intensity levels. We implement the level sweep as a single CUDA kernel, eliminating cross-level kernel-launch overhead. Empirically, CuPH is $18.6$--$99.6\times$ faster than the existing GPU baseline (CMP). As a drop-in PH backend, CuPH accelerates topology-aware classification ($4.2$--$16.7\times$) and segmentation ($8.3$--$44\times$) while preserving accuracy. It also enables computing full-image PH losses on high-resolution images, improving segmentation Dice by $2.2$--$4.6$ points over patch-local PH baselines and accelerating training by $25$--$31\times$.

</details>


### [127] [QVR3D: Query-Guided Visual Reasoning for Training-Free 3D Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01084)
*Jung-Hao Kao,Jing-En Huang,Jia-Wei Liao,Tzuhsuan Huang,Yu-Lun Liu,Cheng-Fu Chou,Jun-Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QVR3D 是一个免训练、查询引导的 3D 视觉定位框架，用现成基础模型在 RGB-D 观测上做推理：通过 Query-Guided Maximum Coverage (QGMC) 选取与查询相关且互补的视角，并用 Grounding Probability Estimation (GPE) 融合实例置信度、属性一致性与关系一致性完成单/多目标定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练 3D 视觉定位方法依赖显式场景变换或场景级帧选择，把有限的视觉容量浪费在与查询无关的区域上。作者认为有效定位应优先挑选能为主要查询提供证据的观测，而非均匀表征整个场景，因此需要查询引导的视角选择。

Method: 在 RGB-D 观测上使用 off-the-shelf 基础模型：QGMC 以最大覆盖思想挑选对查询互补且相关的视图；GPE 将实例置信度、属性一致性、关系一致性整合为定位概率估计；同一框架无需任务特化即可支持单目标与多目标定位。

Result: 在 ScanRefer 与 Nr3D 上取得 zero-shot 最先进性能；QGMC 在多个 3D 视觉-语言任务上提升帧效率；代码开源。

Conclusion: 查询相关的证据视图选择比场景全覆盖更高效，可作为免训练 3D 视觉定位的可组合框架，并提升多任务帧效率。

Abstract: 3D visual grounding localizes objects in 3D scenes from natural language descriptions, requiring reasoning over semantics, spatial relationships, and multi-view observations. Training-free approaches avoid costly annotations but often rely on explicit scene transformation or scene-level frame selection, which may waste limited visual capacity on query-irrelevant regions. We observe that effective grounding should prioritize observations that provide evidence for the query rather than uniformly represent the entire scene. Based on this insight, we introduce QVR3D, a query-guided visual reasoning framework that operates on RGB-D observations using off-the-shelf foundation models. QVR3D combines Query-Guided Maximum Coverage (QGMC) for selecting complementary query-relevant views with Grounding Probability Estimation (GPE) that integrates instance confidence, attribute consistency, and relationship consistency. The framework supports both single- and multi-object grounding without task-specific adaptation. Experiments on ScanRefer and Nr3D achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, while QGMC also improves frame efficiency across multiple 3D vision-language tasks. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [128] [StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01120)
*Zixian Gao,Penghao Luo,Xiangcheng Cao,Lixin Xiu,Ziqi Cai,Zhen Li,Erwin Wu,Kaipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出StreamDuo：可训练解说器+冻结"研究智能体"（读所玩游戏wiki）双模块框架，研究跨游戏流式解说——时序能力可迁移但游戏知识不可迁移；仅在单一游戏上分两阶段训练解说器（信息增益标注决定何时提问、on-policy自蒸馏学会用噪声答案）。BG3训练，10款未见游戏测试，实体召回0.082→0.116，源游戏泄漏9.9%→1.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频LLM只能在训练/测试同款游戏上做实时解说，缺乏对未见游戏的"世界知识"，因而无法解释画面中的具体实体；作者想验证并解决跨游戏迁移问题，把"知识缺口"外置为可检索的wiki查询。

Method: StreamDuo = 可训练解说器 + 冻结研究智能体。解说器遇到无法命名的画面时，把当前帧发给研究智能体，约2秒后返回数条wiki条目，直播不中断。仅训练解说器且只用单一游戏，两阶段：(1) 信息增益标签，学习仅在"答案有助于复现人类解说词"时才发起提问；(2) 从"看到理想答案的自身副本"做on-policy自蒸馏，学习在检索到的噪声答案下稳健使用。

Result: BG3训练、10款未见游戏测试：实体召回0.082→0.116（对比同数据训练的Proact-VL），源游戏泄漏9.9%→1.0%，在流式模型中时序准确性最佳，人工评判的生动度与整体质量最高。

Conclusion: 跨游戏流式解说的瓶颈不在时序而在游戏世界知识，可通过"冻结检索智能体+带信息增益提问策略的轻量解说器"解耦解决；该范式可推广到其他需要外部知识实时注入的流式多模态智能体。

Abstract: Streaming video LLMs can now commentate live gameplay, but they are trained and tested on the same games. We study cross-game streaming commentary, in which a model trained on one game commentates games it has never seen, and find that current commentators transfer their timing but not their knowledge of the game world. We propose StreamDuo, which pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that reads the wiki of the game being played. When the commentator sees something it cannot name, it sends the current frames, and the research agent returns a few wiki entries two seconds later while the stream continues. We train only the commentator, on a single game, in two stages. Information-gain labels teach it to ask only where an answer would help it say what the human caster said, and on-policy self-distillation from a copy of itself that sees the ideal answer teaches it to use noisy answers. Trained on Baldur's Gate 3 and tested on ten unseen games, StreamDuo raises entity recall from 0.082 to 0.116 over Proact-VL trained on the same data, cuts source-game leakage from 9.9% to 1.0%, and achieves the best timing and the highest judged liveliness and overall quality among streaming models.

</details>


### [129] [What Does a Safety Label Measure? Auditing Situational-Safety Benchmarks for Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01125)
*Wayner Barrios,Kenneth Barrios*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文质疑情境安全基准中SAFE/UNSAFE标签到底度量了什么，提出“Benchmark Card”（七个实测字段）区分标签来自场景、请求还是基准自身文件，并对六个基准填表；进一步提出Spot-Stop分解，将标签与排序之间的差距分解为阈值、分数重叠、成对内顺序三部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情境安全基准的标签分数被用于指导MLLM部署决策，但标签评分可能源自场景本身、请求文本或基准自带的文件（如信息泄漏、固定分区），并不一定反映模型对场景的安全理解能力，因此需要实证检验标签究竟度量了什么。

Method: 1) 提出Benchmark Card，含七个可测量字段，逐个诊断六个情境安全基准；2) 图像层面探针：MSSBench chat的图像尺寸单独即可达到82.3%准确率，超过七个商业模型中六个，修正划分后降至随机水平；3) 设计层面归因：MOSSBench条目划分决定标签，HoliSafe仅凭请求即可获得与场景相当的配对排序；4) 提出Spot-Stop分解，在“一安全一不安全”场景对上对比排序与打标签，将超出标签置换零假设的差距拆为阈值项、安全/不安全分数重叠项和仅成对成立的排序项，并在14个开源MLLM上分析。

Result: 仅MSSBench chat存在图像文件泄漏标签（图像尺寸82.3%），其余基准的场景外信号多源于设计缺陷；修正划分后尺寸规则失效。14个开源MLLM多数“排序优于打标签”，且超出AUROC预测；chat场景上共享阈值可修复三分之一至一半的超额差距，无标签重定心可在平衡批次上完全恢复，在VSCBench上以同情境未标注场景重定心使13/14模型排序提升。

Conclusion: 情境安全基准的标签分数常被非场景因素污染，不能直接作为部署能力证据；应采用Benchmark Card审计基准，并用Spot-Stop分解区分排序能力与阈值/校准缺陷，后者可通过阈值与无标签重定心低成本修正。

Abstract: Situational-safety benchmarks label each scene SAFE or UNSAFE and score a multimodal large language model (MLLM) against that label, usually by judging its free-form answer, and these scores guide deployment. We ask what such a label measures. A label score can come from the scene, the request or the benchmark's own files. We propose the Benchmark Card, seven measured fields that tell them apart, and fill it for six benchmarks. Only MSSBench chat leaks the label through its image files: image size alone reaches 82.3% accuracy, matching or beating six of seven commercial models. Elsewhere the signal outside the scene comes from design. In MOSSBench the item partition fixes the label, and on HoliSafe the request alone ranks pairs about as well as the scene. On our corrected chat split, the size rule falls to chance. We then introduce the Spot-Stop decomposition, which compares ranking with labelling on pairs of a safe and an unsafe scene. It splits the gap above a label-swap null into three parts: a threshold part, overlap between safe and unsafe scores, and order that holds only within a pair. Most of fourteen open MLLMs rank better than they label, beyond what their AUROC predicts. On chat, one shared threshold repairs a third to a half of the excess, and label-free recentering recovers it on balanced batches. Recentering on unlabelled scenes of the same situation improves ranking on VSCBench for 13 of 14 models.

</details>


### [130] [GESTALT: Fast, Generalizable Histopathology Image Synthesis from Gene Expression with Pretrained Pathology Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01141)
*Felix Ho,Alexandros Graikos,Dimitris Samaras*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GESTALT将"基因表达→组织图像"合成重构为预测病理基础模型的图像嵌入：轻量基因token transformer从多细胞表达预测嵌入，再由冻结/LoRA适配的扩散解码器(PixCell)渲染图像，从而复用而非重学视觉知识，显著降低训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间转录组学只做了"图像→表达"的正向测量，"表达状态呈现何种形态"这一逆向问题探索不足；而现有SOTA GeneFlow需对每个新数据集从头训练，成本高昂。

Method: 以病理基础模型嵌入作为中间监督目标；基因token transformer由多细胞基因表达预测该嵌入；冻结或LoRA微调的扩散解码器PixCell将嵌入解码为1024×1024图像；并结合空间表达统计模型实现细胞级转录组场与组织图像的配对合成，可显式控制细胞类型、密度与组成。

Result: 在多细胞与单细胞设定下，于全部三个Xenium数据集上感知指标超越SoTA；原生支持1024×1024分辨率；在跨基因面板/数据集零样本迁移、留出患者与疾病状态、跨研究与组织来源三类泛化设置下评估；实现首个具显式细胞属性控制的配对合成。

Conclusion: 通过复用预训练病理视觉基础模型的表征，基因表达到图像的逆向合成可大幅降低训练开销并提升生成质量与泛化性，为分子判读提供可对照的真实组织结构可视化工具。

Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics measures gene expression while preserving where each cell sits in the tissue. The inverse, what a given transcriptomic state looks like, is less explored but equally useful: it lets researchers visualize the morphological consequence of a molecular state and interpret a spatial assay's molecular calls against real tissue structure. GeneFlow, the current state of the art on the Xenium gene expression-to-image benchmark, trains a model from scratch, incurring a high cost on every new target dataset it is applied to. We instead propose GESTALT, which reformulates gene expression-to-image synthesis as predicting a pathology foundation model's image embedding. A lightweight gene-token transformer predicts this embedding from multi-cell gene expression, and a frozen or LoRA-adapted diffusion decoder (PixCell) renders it as an image. Because this visual knowledge is reused rather than relearned, GESTALT trains in a fraction of the time. In both multi-cell and single-cell settings, our method outperforms the SoTA on perceptual metrics across all three Xenium datasets. Beyond improved image quality, GESTALT natively synthesizes at 1024 x 1024, and is evaluated in three generalization settings: zero-shot transfer across gene panels and datasets, held-out patients and disease states, and transfer across studies and tissue sources. Coupled with a statistical model of spatial expression, GESTALT also provides, to our knowledge, the first paired synthesis of cell-resolved transcriptomic fields and tissue images with explicit control over cell type, density, and composition. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [131] [SHield: Watermarking 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spherical Harmonic Coefficient Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01162)
*Kunal Bhosikar,Prajas Wadekar,Venkata Sai Pranav Bachina,Ankit Gangwal,Charu Sharma,Nicole Meng,Yingjie Lao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SHield 是首个面向 4D Gaussian Splatting 文件的非盲、无需解码器水印方法，将全分辨率 RGB 图像原生嵌入 SH 系数，可在闭式算术下恢复版权载荷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4DGS 训练代价高但以参数文件形式轻易被复制分发；现有水印需针对神经解码器微调场景、从渲染视频抽取比特串，过程沉重且受动态场景时序扰动影响。若威胁模型针对的是被再分发的文件本身，验证可以大幅简化。

Method: 利用 4DGS 规范球谐(SH)系数在时间与视角上不变的性质，将零均值载荷分块嵌入由密钥选定的高斯子集的 SH 系数中，并用短时锚定优化保持视觉保真；验证时以规范高斯中心几何重建密钥关联以抵抗文件篡改，再闭式解出载荷。

Result: 在 D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DyNeRF 共 30 个场景、150 个模型上，载荷恢复近乎完美(Pearson r ≥ 0.991)，平均渲染损失 ≤ 0.13 dB；留出评估中 400 次真阳性全部检出，1600 次错误子集零试验零误报；图像载荷可抗 INT8 量化与 30% 不透明度剪枝，SH 1 阶截断下比特载荷仍可解码。

Conclusion: 针对再分发文件的威胁模型，参数空间、闭式、免解码器的水印是 4DGS 资产版权保护的高效可行方案，且鲁棒性边界被明确界定。

Abstract: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) models are computationally expensive to train but distributed as easily copied parameter files. Existing watermarks protect these assets by fine-tuning the scene against a neural decoder to extract bit strings from rendered video, a heavy process vulnerable to the temporal dynamics of dynamic scenes. However, if the threat model targets the redistributed file itself, verification can be vastly simplified. Because the canonical Spherical-Harmonic (SH) coefficients of 4DGS are time- and view-invariant, parameter-space perturbations can be recovered via deterministic arithmetic. We propose **SHield**, the first non-blind, decoder-free watermarking approach that natively embeds full-resolution RGB images into 4DGS files. SHield tiles a zero-mean payload across the SH coefficients of a key-selected Gaussian subset, applying a brief anchored optimization to preserve visual fidelity. To verify ownership, it geometrically re-associates the key using canonical Gaussian centres to survive file tampering and recovers the payload in closed form. Across 30 scenes (D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, DyNeRF), SHield guarantees near-perfect payload recovery (Pearson $r \geq 0.991$) on all 150 tested models with a mean rendering penalty of $\leq 0.13$~dB. Held-out evaluation yields perfect detection on 400 true trials and zero false positives across $1{,}600$ wrong-subset null trials. We also strictly bound the method's robustness: SHield survives INT8 quantization and $30\%$ opacity pruning for the image payload, and on aggressive SH-degree-1 truncation bit payloads are still decodable.

</details>


### [132] [Modeling Fat-shift for Improved Head Segmentation from MRI Scans using a Probabilistic Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01222)
*Merle Diedrichsen,Koen Van Leemput,Douglas N. Greve,Oula Puonti,Axel Thielscher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FLOW方法，用变分推断的概率模型在T1w MRI全头分割中显式建模脂肪化学位移伪影（化学位移），恢复颅骨与皮下脂肪真实解剖，减少电场仿真偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T1w MRI中致密骨近乎无信号，且脂肪组织（板障内海绵骨、皮下脂肪）存在化学位移伪影，通常在上下方向位移，使颅骨显得比实际薄。现有分割方法不建模该伪影，导致颅骨与头皮标注错误，进而给生物物理仿真（如电场刺激）带来系统性偏差；而位移方向和幅度可从扫描参数推得，因此可显式建模并还原真实解剖。

Method: 构建概率模型，用变分推断在T1w扫描上同时分割头部与脑内结构并联合估计脂肪位移；位移参数由扫描参数（频率编码方向）先验约束，实现伪影无关的解剖重建（FLOW：Fat-shift-informed Label Optimization of the Whole head）。

Result: FLOW对颅外解剖（颅骨、头皮）的重建比不考虑位移的分割更准确，同时其余结构分割精度保持高水平；基于FLOW校正后的分割进行电场仿真，相比未建模位移的分割显著降低了偏差。

Conclusion: 显式建模MRI化学位移伪影可提升全头分割的解剖保真度，并显著改善下游生物物理仿真的无偏性；作者建议在个性化头部建模流程中纳入伪影感知分割。

Abstract: Personalized computational head models for biophysical simulations rely on accurate whole-head segmentations from T1-weighted (T1w) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. While T1w scans provide excellent contrast for intracranial anatomy, extracerebral tissues have partly almost no signal (compact bone) and also suffer from the so-called chemical shift artifact, which affects the fatty tissues in MRI and causes them to spatially shift in the frequency encoding direction of the scan. This artifact occurs primarily in two structures of the head: the spongy bone, a fatty compartment inside the compact bone, and the subcutaneous fat, located directly underneath the skin. The frequency-encoding direction is often set in the superior-inferior direction, causing the fatty tissues to shift down and, as a result, making the skull appear thinner than it actually is. Existing segmentation methods do not model this artifact, consequently leading to inaccurate labeling of the skull and scalp, which introduces a bias in biophysical simulations. The direction and magnitude of the fat-shift can be determined from the scan parameters, thus making it possible to explicitly model the shift and to recover the correct anatomy. This study introduces a probabilistic model that uses variational inference to segment head and brain structures from a T1w scan while accounting for the fat-shift artifact. The proposed Fat-shift-informed Label Optimization of the Whole head (FLOW) method reconstructs extracerebral anatomy more accurately than a fat-shift-agnostic segmentation approach while maintaining high segmentation accuracy in all other structures. FLOW-based fat-shift corrected segmentations significantly reduce bias in electric field simulations compared to a segmentation method that does not model the shift.

</details>


### [133] [Reproducing INP-Former: Reconstructing Intrinsic Normal Prototypes for Industrial Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01230)
*Yunfei Liang,Juan Pablo Osorio Rivera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 复现INP-Former（无memory bank的内在正态原型引导重建式多类工业异常检测），在MVTec AD/VisA复现性能并扩展到MVTec AD 2，发现默认原型数量等结论在更难数据上不成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证INP-Former核心主张的可复现性，并检验其在更难数据分布（MVTec AD 2）上的泛化能力，澄清各组件贡献与默认超参的适用范围。

Method: 使用作者开源代码复现MVTec AD与VisA性能；在MVTec AD 2上扩展评测；五种子消融分析INP机制与两项辅助损失贡献；禁用两项损失做配对比较；扫描原型数量；并测量分辨率、骨干规模、训练时长、LoRA适配等实际权衡，按缺陷尺寸、光照条件与更严格AU-PRO阈值分析性能。

Result: MVTec AD/VisA复现结果与原文一致；MVTec AD 2默认设置图像AUROC仅63.4，远低于MVTec AD的99.7；性能主要由INP机制贡献，辅助损失影响小且方向依指标而变；原型数量超过4后进入平台期在AD/VisA成立，但AD 2上单原型在AU-PRO上优于六原型（公开拆分与两个隐藏测试拆分均如此）。

Conclusion: 原论文基于简单基准的若干结论（尤其默认六原型）不能迁移到更难数据；INP机制本身仍是主要增益来源，但超参默认值需针对数据难度重新校准。

Abstract: We reproduce the central claims of INP-Former, a reconstruction-based method for multi-class industrial anomaly detection. INP-Former extracts Intrinsic Normal Prototypes (INPs) from each test image and uses them to guide a decoder that reconstructs normal features, without a stored memory bank. Using the authors' released code, we reproduce the reported performance on MVTec AD and VisA and extend the evaluation to MVTec AD 2, where image AUROC with the default settings is 63.4, compared with 99.7 on MVTec AD. On MVTec AD, a five-seed ablation shows that most of the performance comes from the INP mechanism, while the two auxiliary losses add small changes whose direction depends on the metric. A paired comparison with both losses disabled confirms the benefit of INP on MVTec AD 2. The default of six prototypes transfers less well: the plateau beyond four prototypes reproduces on MVTec AD and VisA, but on MVTec AD 2 a single prototype outperforms six in AU-PRO on the public split and on both hidden test splits. We also measure practical trade-offs in resolution, backbone size, training length, and LoRA adaptation, and examine performance by defect size, lighting condition, and a stricter AU-PRO limit. Several conclusions from the original benchmarks, including the default prototype count, do not carry over to harder data. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [134] [Context-Shielded Backdoor Attack against Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01252)
*Zhifang Zhang,Qiang Huang,Chenpeng Wang,Weitong Chen,Olaf Maennel,Wei Emma Zhang,Lei Feng,Lei Zhang,Miao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StripWake：一种仅训练projector的LVLM后门，利用"上下文剥离"现象——全token推理时干净视觉token抑制触发器，而推理期token剪枝移除上下文后激活后门；在全token审计下ASR仅0.4%，在五个主要未见压缩器上ASR 94.0%–99.7%，且无CIDEr损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM后门在触发图像出现时即激活，全token推理下ASR近100%，部署前审计极易暴露；而此前的"部署触发式"攻击仅依赖量化/剪枝权重变化。作者发现推理期视觉token压缩本身可作为一种隐蔽触发面，现有方法未利用这一安全缺口。

Method: 核心发现为"上下文剥离"：干净视觉token在全长度下抑制嵌入触发器，token剪枝剥除上下文则激活后门。据此提出StripWake，仅修改projector：将干净监督的全token视图与目标监督的随机压缩视图配对训练，使模型在全token下保持良性、在压缩下输出目标；同时用冻结的良性教师对齐早期视觉注意力以保持干净效用，并随机化压缩器以泛化到未见压缩器。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B与九个未见压缩器上评测：全token ASR 0.4%（处于休眠），五个主要压缩器上压缩ASR 94.0%–99.7%，且干净任务CIDEr无下降。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了推理期token压缩是LVLM中未被重视的后门触发面，表明"全token审计即安全"的假设不成立，为多模态模型供应链安全与红队评估提出了新的审计维度（需在多种压缩预算下评测）。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) routinely use inference-time visual-token compression to prune hundreds of patch tokens down to a compact budget. Existing LVLM backdoors fire whenever a triggered image appears, whereas prior deployment-triggered attacks activate only when model weights are quantized or pruned. However, conventional LVLM backdoors exhibit nearly 100% attack success rate (ASR) under full-token inference, immediately exposing compromised checkpoints during pre-deployment auditing. We reveal context stripping: surrounding clean visual tokens suppress an embedded trigger at full length, whereas token pruning strips this context away and activates the backdoor. Motivated by this finding, we propose StripWake, a projector-only backdoor that remains dormant under full-token auditing yet activates across unseen compressors. Specifically, StripWake pairs clean-supervised full-token views with target-supervised randomized compressed views, and aligns early visual attention with a frozen benign teacher to preserve clean utility. On LLaVA-1.5-7B across nine unseen compressors, StripWake stays dormant at 0.4% full-token ASR yet achieves 94.0%-99.7% compressed ASR across five primary compressors without CIDEr loss.

</details>


### [135] [StreamClarify: Proactive Clarification for Grounded Streaming Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01263)
*Zhuchen Shao,Bo Chen,Klara Nahrstedt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StreamClarify: training-free streaming video QA framework combining entropy-based pre-answer uncertainty gating with temporal-pyramid KV cache + CPU semantic retrieval for grounded clarification and re-answering; contributes StreamClarify-QA benchmark (1,837 QA pairs).


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Streaming video QA demands real-time reasoning under latency and active-context budgets; current streaming VLMs answer confidently but ungrounded when queries are ambiguous, have false premises, or when evidence has evicted from context. Proactive clarification is a natural fix but must respect the same memory/latency constraints, and no existing approach jointly addresses uncertainty gating and bounded-context evidence recovery.

Method: Training-free framework. (1) Uncertainty check: entropy of a binary pre-answer judgment (answer directly vs. request clarification) serves as a lightweight trigger signal. (2) Hierarchical memory: temporal-pyramid KV cache keeps a bounded active visual context; a CPU-side semantic retrieval archive gives access to evicted historical frames to support re-answering after clarification. (3) Diagnostic benchmark StreamClarify-QA built from StreamBench and OVO-Bench: 1,837 QA pairs across standard, referential-ambiguity, and unanswerable scenarios; plus an oracle-assisted Qwen3-VL simulation with generated clarifying questions and referent-only replies.

Result: Across three VLM backbones: +8.2 Macro accuracy over backbone-matched baselines; at comparable trigger rates, entropy-based selection exceeds random selection by >18 points precision in detecting initially incorrect answers; with oracle user guidance, clarification adds up to +3.5 Macro accuracy; in the oracle-assisted Qwen3-VL ambiguity simulation, entropy gating yields +8.3 points.

Conclusion: Cheap pre-answer uncertainty (binary-judgment entropy) is an effective clarification trigger, and a bounded KV cache plus offloaded semantic archive suffices to re-ground answers after clarification, enabling grounded, latency-budgeted streaming QA without training. Evaluation remains largely oracle-assisted and simulation-based, so real interactive user studies and tighter latency/memory characterizations are open gaps.

Abstract: Streaming video question answering (QA) requires real-time reasoning over continuous video streams under strict latency and active-context budgets. Current streaming vision-language models (VLMs) often give confident yet ungrounded answers when queries are ambiguous or have false premises, or when relevant visual evidence is no longer in the active context. Proactive clarification can help, but must satisfy the same latency and memory constraints. We present StreamClarify, a training-free framework for grounded streaming QA that combines a pre-answer uncertainty check with hierarchical memory. The check uses the entropy of a binary pre-answer judgment as a lightweight uncertainty score to decide whether to answer directly or request clarification. To support re-answering, a temporal-pyramid KV cache maintains a bounded active visual context, while a CPU-side semantic retrieval archive provides access to historical frames. We further construct StreamClarify-QA, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,837 QA pairs from StreamBench and OVO-Bench, spanning standard, referential ambiguity, and unanswerable scenarios. Across three VLM backbones, StreamClarify improves Macro accuracy by up to 8.2 points over backbone-matched baselines. At comparable trigger rates, entropy-based selection achieves more than 18 points higher precision than random selection in identifying initially incorrect answers. Under oracle user guidance, clarification improves Macro accuracy by up to 3.5 points. We also report a controlled, oracle-assisted Qwen3-VL simulation on Ambiguous QA with generated questions and referent-only user replies, where the entropy-gated condition improves accuracy by 8.3 points.

</details>


### [136] [DriftingPlanner: Drifting Generative Models for One-Step Trajectory Planning in End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01283)
*Ziming Liu,Yizhan Qu,Leichen Wang,Hao Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DriftingPlanner用drifting损失（无坐标回归项）训练端到端轨迹规划器：按场景计算吸引-排斥场，推理时用对偶噪声批量解码并平均以消除"壳层"偏移，NAVSIM navtest达93.75 PDMS，单步推理仅比十步扩散/流匹配差0.13 PDMS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 坐标回归快但会把多种可行机动混合成一条可能都不可行的轨迹；扩散/流匹配建模分布但需多步推理。Drifting把迭代移入训练以支持单步生成，但原方法针对类条件图像生成（每类多个正样本），规划中每个场景自成一条件：合并场景会错误吸引，按场景计算场又只有一条专家轨迹作为唯一正样本，互相排斥使生成轨迹落在其周围的"壳"上而偏离真值。

Method: 端到端规划器仅用drifting损失训练，不含坐标回归项；按场景计算吸引-排斥场。推理时去除壳层效应：将每个噪声向量与其取负配对批量解码，对反演对（antithetic pair）取平均以抵消壳层中心的线性位移项，实现单步生成。

Result: NAVSIM navtest上达93.75 PDMS，为当前最优；单步推理的drifting解码器与需十步推理的最佳扩散/流匹配设置仅差0.13 PDMS。

Conclusion: 将drifting生成学习适配到单正样本的按场景条件规划，并通过反演对平均消除壳层偏差，可在单步推理下获得SOTA规划性能，说明训练期演化的场学习可替代多步采样。

Abstract: End-to-end planners decode the ego trajectory either by coordinate regression, which is fast but blends plausible maneuvers into one trajectory that may follow none of them, or by diffusion and flow matching, which model the trajectory distribution but need several inference steps. Drifting models move this iteration into training: a one-step generator learns to follow an attraction--repulsion field between generated and ground-truth samples. Drifting was developed for class-conditional image generation, where every class supplies many positive samples. In planning, every scene is its own condition. Pooling scenes would attract the generated trajectories of one scene to the ground truth of unrelated scenes, whereas computing the field per scene leaves a single positive, the expert trajectory. Mutual repulsion then holds the generated trajectories on a shell around it, so any single generated trajectory deviates from the ground truth. We present DriftingPlanner, a trajectory planner trained with the drifting loss alone, without any coordinate regression term. It computes the field per scene and removes the shell at inference: it decodes every noise vector together with its negation in one batched pass, and averaging each antithetic pair cancels the linear part of the displacement from the shell center. On NAVSIM navtest, DriftingPlanner reaches a state-of-the-art 93.75 PDMS, and with single-step inference its drifting decoder comes within 0.13 PDMS of the best diffusion or flow matching setting, which needs ten inference steps.

</details>


### [137] [[Re] Pure Noise to the Rescue of Insufficient Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01295)
*Seungjae Ryan Lee,Seungmin Brian Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文复现了Zada et al. (2021)关于用纯噪声增强少数类样本（OPeN）的四项主张，并补充实验分析其增益来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原论文声称"纯噪声图像"能提升不平衡分类中的少数类准确率，并配合独立BN层，且对数据增强水平鲁棒；该结论若成立颇具启发性，故需独立复现验证。

Method: 用PyTorch重建训练流程，整合作者提供的纯噪声采样与"噪声/自然图像分离BN"代码，在不平衡与平衡数据上复现四项主张，并追加网络规模、数据增强复杂度等消融实验。

Result: 四项主张均被复现：噪声过采样提升少数类准确率、专用BN优于基线、增益对增强水平鲁棒、平衡数据上亦有效；但增益与更大网络或更强增强带来的增益近似正交。

Conclusion: OPeN的效果可复现但偏弱且与容量/增强增益相对独立，作为正则化技巧的实用价值有限，主要贡献是为原结论提供独立验证。

Abstract: We examine the main claims of Zada, Benou, and Irani (2021), which states that in an image classification task with imbalanced training data, (i) using pure noise to augment minority-class images encourages generalization by improving minority-class accuracy. This method is paired with (ii) a new batch normalization layer that normalizes noise images using affine parameters learned from natural images, which improves the model's performance. Moreover, (iii) this improvement is robust to varying levels of data augmentation. Finally, the authors propose that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification even on balanced training data. We implemented the training pipeline from the description of the paper using PyTorch and integrated authors' code snippets for sampling pure noise images and batch normalizing noise and natural images separately. We reproduced the main claims that (i) oversampling with pure noise improves generalization by improving the minority-class accuracy, (ii) the proposed batch normalization (BN) method outperforms baselines, (iii) and this improvement is robust across data augmentations. Our results also support that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification on balanced training data. However, additional experiments suggest that the performance improvement from OPeN may be more orthogonal to the improvement caused by a bigger network or more complex data augmentation.

</details>


### [138] [IMPACT: Image-Conditioned Motion with Physics-Aware Collision and Trajectory Guidance for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01372)
*Shiwei Yang,Yunlong Yu,Zhao Wang,Jungong Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IMPACT：以显式物理状态（含碰撞响应）驱动图像到视频生成，并从同一物理 rollout 派生稀疏轨迹+稠密区域先验的双重引导，减少预测-生成不一致，提升物理合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉逼真的视频生成不保证物理一致：碰撞响应/回弹缺乏能量耗散，且即使物理预测正确，合成阶段也可能未忠实实现，存在预测-生成失配。

Method: 可学习标定的 Physics State Generator 统一连续自由飞行动力学与离散碰撞响应（撞击时刻、撞后速度、回弹衰减、静止收敛）形成物理状态序列；再由同一物理 rollout 导出稀疏轨迹约束全局位移、稠密区域级运动先验在扩散采样中约束物体区域运动并抑制背景变化。

Result: 在 100 个受控球-平面碰撞场景（不同材料与视觉环境）上，物理合理性优于通用、物理接地及运动可控的基线。

Conclusion: 将物理状态预测与生成采样通过共享物理基耦合，是缓解物理预测与视频合成失配的有效路径；但评测局限于受控球-平面场景，真实复杂交互泛化性待验证。

Abstract: Visually realistic video generation does not guarantee physically consistent motion. Generated objects may exhibit implausible collision responses or rebounds without energy dissipation, while even physically valid motion predictions may not be faithfully realized during synthesis. We propose \textbf{IMPACT}, a physics-state-driven image-to-video framework that addresses these challenges by coupling explicit dynamics prediction with complementary sparse--dense physical guidance. A learnably calibrated Physics State Generator unifies continuous free-flight dynamics with discrete collision responses, linking impact timing, post-impact velocity, rebound attenuation, and eventual settling within a coherent physical-state sequence. To translate this evolution into effective generative constraints, IMPACT derives sparse trajectories and dense region-level motion priors from the same physical rollout. Sparse trajectories constrain global object displacement, while dense priors guide diffusion sampling to encourage coherent object-region motion and suppress unwanted background changes. Their shared physical basis coordinates global and local motion guidance to reduce prediction--generation mismatch. Experiments on 100 controlled sphere--plane collision scenes spanning different material combinations and visual environments demonstrate improved physical plausibility over representative general-purpose, physics-grounded, and motion-controllable baselines. The project repository is available at this https URL

</details>


### [139] [Vocabulary Aligned Explanations for Computer Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01391)
*Erfan Mirhaji,Nikhil Krishnaswamy,Jill Zarestky,Lisa Mason,Nathaniel Blanchard,Sarath Sreedharan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FLUENT是一个事后解释框架，用领域专家编写的逻辑规则（联合必需/可选/缺失概念的组合）、遮挡式视觉证据与检索到的参考图定位样例来解释图像分类结果，并通过经验估计的似然与概念先验融合预测标签与概念状态，给出规则级支持度与归一化置信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅优化分类精度并不保证模型学到并使用人类可理解、领域特定的概念与规则；需要以应用领域术语给出可核验的解释。

Method: 事后（post-hoc）框架：对专家撰写的规则进行排序，规则由必备、替代与缺失概念构成；结合预测标签与概念状态的经验似然及概念先验以容忍预测误差；对每条规则在其所涉概念的满足赋值上计算支持度，再归一化为候选解释间的相对置信度；正概念提及在查询图上用遮挡式显著性高亮，负概念提及在检索参考图中给出局部样例。

Result: 摘要未给出定量结果；方法层面提供了规则级支持度评分、归一化置信度与概念可视化（遮挡高亮 + 参考图局部示例），用于向非领域用户展示概念外观。

Conclusion: FLUENT结合领域知识与模型精度，以应用领域词汇输出视觉概念高亮与显式规则置信度来解释图像分类，属于可解释视觉/概念瓶颈类工具的相邻工作。

Abstract: Optimizing vision models for accuracy does not force the model to learn and utilize human-understandable and domain-specific concepts and rules. We propose explaining image classifications through domain-specific concepts, visual evidence, and expert knowledge expressed as logical rules. We introduce FLUENT (Framework for Localized, Uncertainty-Aware Explanations in Normative Terminology), a post-hoc framework that ranks expert-authored rules combining jointly required, alternative, and absent concepts. To account for prediction errors, FLUENT combines predicted labels and concept states with empirically estimated likelihoods and concept priors. It scores each rule by calculating support over satisfying assignments to the concepts mentioned in that rule, then normalizes these scores to express relative confidence among candidate explanations. The selected rule is illustrated through occlusion-based highlights for positive concept mentions in the query image and localized examples in retrieved reference images for negative mentions. These illustrations are intended to show end users unfamiliar with the domain what the concepts named in an explanation look like. FLUENT combines domain knowledge and model accuracy, and delivers visual concept highlights and explicit rule confidence to explain an image in the vocabulary of an application domain.

</details>


### [140] [SpecUltra: A Unified Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Spectral Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01396)
*Weili Kong,Baisen Liu,Xiaojun Bi,Jiaming Pei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpecUltra：将高光谱/多光谱图像视为连续光谱的不同采样，构建统一遥感光谱基础模型（3D卷积分词+波长感知3D RoPE+MultiHyper-200K预训练+SKT实现HSI→MSI知识迁移）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HSI与MSI在波段数、波长、光谱分辨率上差异巨大，导致无法统一建模与跨传感器迁移；作者从成像物理出发，把异构观测视为同一连续光谱的不同离散采样，从而建立统一坐标系统一表征。

Method: 1) 3D卷积tokenization + 波长感知3D RoPE编码相对波长与空间位置，实现共享坐标系下的细粒度空谱建模；2) 构建MultiHyper-200K多传感器大规模HSI数据集；3) 辅助token（level token标记辐射产品类型，register token吸收传感器/采集差异）的掩码图像建模MIM预训练；4) 光谱核变换SKT：由细粒度HSI预训练卷积核切片构造MSI嵌入核，在参数空间完成光谱粒度桥接。

Result: 在多个异构传感器的HSI与MSI分类、分割基准上取得SOTA或具竞争力性能，验证跨传感器、跨任务迁移有效性。

Conclusion: 以"连续光谱采样"视角统一异构光谱影像建模是可行且有效的，波长感知位置编码与参数空间谱核变换能保留预训练光谱先验并兼容主干网络，为光谱基础模型提供可扩展范式。

Abstract: Spectral imagery, including hyperspectral image (HSI) and multispectral image (MSI), exhibits substantial heterogeneity in band numbers, wavelengths, spectral resolutions, hindering unified modeling and cross-sensor transfer. From the perspective of imaging physics, these heterogeneous observations can be regarded as discrete measurements of an underlying continuous spectrum acquired through different sampling processes. Motivated by this perspective, we propose SpecUltra, a unified foundation model for heterogeneous spectral images. Specifically, SpecUltra employs 3D convolutional tokenization and wavelength-aware 3D RoPE to encode relative wavelength and spatial relationships, enabling fine-grained spatial-spectral modeling within a shared coordinate system. We further construct MultiHyper-200K, a large-scale multi-sensor HSI dataset, and pretrain SpecUltra using auxiliary-token-assisted mask image modeling (MIM), where a level token indicates the radiometric product type and register tokens absorb sensor- and acquisition-dependent variations. To bridge the spectral-granularity gap between HSI and MSI, we introduce Spectral Kernel Transformation (SKT), which transfers pretrained knowledge in parameter space by constructing MSI embedding kernels from fine-grained HSI-pretrained kernel slices. This design preserves pretrained spectral priors while maintaining compatibility with the pretrained backbone. Experiments on HSI and MSI classification and segmentation benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art or competitive performance across disparate sensors and downstream tasks.

</details>


### [141] [RadPose: ISAC-based RF 3D Human Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01400)
*Geo Jie Zhou,Kunzhe Song,Ruxin Lin,Huacheng Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RadPose 提出一种基于单站全双工 ISAC 的 3D 人体姿态估计框架，从标准 OFDM 通信信号中提取 CIR 生成 3D 射频点云，并用跨帧 Transformer 与图卷积逆运动学细化实现鲁棒姿态推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摄像头与 LiDAR 在不良光照和遮挡下失效；毫米波雷达虽鲁棒但依赖专用硬件与授权频谱，难以规模化部署。作者希望复用通信设备实现无额外传感硬件的感知能力。

Method: 利用单站全双工架构从 OFDM 通信信号提取 CIR，构建 3D 射频点云；设计跨帧 Transformer 姿态推断网络，包含语义引导的空间注意力与目标驱动的时序注意力；再叠加基于图卷积的关节感知逆运动学细化模块，约束骨骼拓扑、骨长一致性与解剖合理性。

Result: 大量实验表明，RadPose 在精度上可与 SOTA 雷达方法竞争，并在未见场景与遮挡场景下保持鲁棒性能；数据集与代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通信信号可替代专用雷达实现人体姿态感知，具备可扩展性；但验证规模与真实部署成熟度仍需进一步考量，属于感知层面的相邻工作。

Abstract: Human pose estimation under adverse lighting and occlusion conditions remains challenging for camera- and LiDAR-based systems. Although mmWave radars provide robustness to illumination and occlusion, they rely on dedicated hardware and licensed spectrum, limiting scalability. In this paper, we present RadPose, a learning-based monostatic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that enables mmWave communication devices to perform 3D human pose estimation. Unlike specialized radars, RadPose leverages monostatic full-duplex operation to extract channel impulse responses (CIRs) directly from standard OFDM communication signals, generating 3D radio point clouds without additional sensing hardware. To address the sparsity and noise of RF observations, RadPose employs a cross-frame transformer-based pose inference network with semantic-guided spatial attention and target-driven temporal attention for robust spatio-temporal aggregation. It further adopts a joint-aware inverse kinematics refinement module based on graph convolution to enforce skeletal topology, bone-length consistency, and anatomical plausibility. Extensive experiments demonstrate RadPose achieves competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art radar-based approaches while maintaining robust performance in unseen and occluded scenarios. The dataset and source code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [142] [ContactCut: A Partition-Aware Contact Selection Framework for False-Merge Correction in Connectomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01457)
*Byunghyun Ko,Won-Ki Jeong,Chaoli Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将连接组学中的局部错误合并校正建模为"3D原生分割感知的接触选择"问题：以候选接触所诱导的完整3D分割质量来挑选源-汇约束，提出CC-Auto（学习单接触选择）与CC-Search（有界成对接触搜索+学习式面板排序）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连接组学中已识别的错误合并需转化为可执行的原生3D分割，但中间校正预测或种子图求解器都无法单独决定哪些原生源-汇约束应定义该分割；需按分割结果而非局部接触质量来做选择。

Method: 形式化为3D原生分割感知接触选择问题；CC-Auto用学习式单接触选择；CC-Search做有界成对接触搜索、生成紧凑候选并在候选面板上做学习排序；MICrONS训练的排序器可迁移到FlyWire。

Result: 在MICrONS与FlyWire历史双向错误合并校正数据上，CC-Auto的FA-3D Part. mIoU较最强图方法基线提升5.9/3.4点，较最佳学习基线提升12.5/10.0点；跨数据集迁移掉点可忽略；CC-Search扩大了oracle可达性并优先给出近oracle备选。

Conclusion: 以完整3D分割为评价单元的接触选择优于局部预测或图求解器直接修正，且学习式排序具备跨数据集泛化性；代码已开源。

Abstract: Localized false-merge correction in connectomics requires converting an identified error into an executable native 3D partition. Still, neither intermediate correction predictions nor seeded graph solvers alone determine which native source-sink constraints should define that partition. We formulate this problem as a 3D-native partition-aware contact selection problem: selecting candidate contacts based on the complete partitions they induce. Our solution comprises two components: ContactCut (CC)-Auto, which uses learned single-contact selection, and ContactCut (CC)-Search, which enables bounded paired-contact search, generates compact alternatives, and applies learned panel ranking. On historical two-way false-merge corrections from MICrONS and FlyWire, CC-Auto improves failure-aware 3D partition (FA-3D Part.) mIoU by 5.9 and 3.4 points over the strongest graph-based controls and by 12.5 and 10.0 points over the best learned baselines. A MICrONS-trained ranker transfers to FlyWire with negligible degradation. CC-Search expands oracle reachability and prioritizes near-oracle alternatives. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [143] [Resolve, Clear, or Defer: Training-Free Active Prototype Triage for Ecological Detection Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01466)
*Anirudh Potlapally,Brijesh Nanda Brunda Yogananda,Jianyang Gu,Maanav Jajodia,Luke Meyers,Wei-Lun Chao,Hari Subramoni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的"主动原型分流"（active prototype triage）方法：把已审阅的相机陷阱/航拍检测结果作为可复用证据，用原型相似度决定"自动确认前景类""清除背景误检"或"转人工复核"，并发现前景证据用BioCLIP2、背景证据用DINOv3的组合效果最好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高召回动物检测器虽能大规模定位候选动物，但输出包含大量误检、模糊样本和难辨物种，全面人工审阅成本过高；现有主动学习/不确定性采样只关注"发现新类"，未解决"证据如何复用、何时拒绝自动决策"的问题。

Method: 免训练原型分流：以人工审阅过的检测构成原型库，对未审阅检测按原型相似度分流为(a)确认受支持前景类、(b)清除疑似背景误检、(c)证据不足则转人工。对比基线为置信度阈值化多类k-NN与不确定性采样逻辑回归；并分别评估不同预训练表征（BioCLIP2用于前景、DINOv3用于背景）的证据传播可靠性，强调原型选择策略对证据传播的影响。

Result: 在相机陷阱与航拍数据集上，前景识别与背景误检剔除依赖不同预训练表征，BioCLIP2供前景证据、DINOv3供背景证据，可减少错误清除前景并提升自动前景回收；延迟不确定样本比强制分类显著降低错误率；相比阈值化多类k-NN与不确定性采样逻辑回归，在保持相当或更低复核负担下提升前景回收率；且类别已被覆盖后，原型选择仍决定证据传播可靠性。

Conclusion: 当动物定位已达高召回后，核心问题从"找到动物"转向"决定审阅哪些样本、如何复用审阅证据、以及证据何时不足以支持自动决策"；免训练原型分流提供了可复用的证据积累与拒绝机制，属生态监测人机协同的高效数据筛选范式。

Abstract: Ecological monitoring increasingly relies on camera traps and aerial surveys that generate large image collections. High-recall animal detectors can localize candidate animals at scale. However, they also produce many detections that still require expert review, including false positives, ambiguous cases, and animals difficult to identify at the species level. Since exhaustive review requires substantial effort, we propose training-free active prototype triage, where reviewed detections become reusable evidence to (1) Resolve supported foreground classes, (2) Clear likely background false positives, or (3) Defer insufficiently supported cases for expert review. Across camera-trap and aerial datasets, foreground recognition and false-positive rejection benefit from different pretrained representations: BioCLIP2 provides foreground evidence while DINOv3 provides background evidence, reducing erroneous foreground clearing while improving automatic foreground recovery. Deferring unsupported cases avoids the higher error rates caused by forced decisions. Compared with confidence-thresholded multiclass k-NN and uncertainty-sampling logistic regression, prototype triage improves foreground recovery while maintaining competitive or lower review burden. Acquisition goes beyond class discovery: even after classes are represented, prototype choice determines how reliably evidence propagates through the remaining detections.
