Our results suggest that once animal localization reaches high recall, the challenge shifts from finding animals to deciding which examples to review, how to reuse them, and when evidence does not support an automatic decision.

</details>


### [144] [See, Think, Use: Diagnosing Perception and Reasoning Failures in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01467)
*Jiacheng Ding,Yanliang Qi,Cong Guo,Peihua Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"See, Think, Use"协议，通过定位探针、文本替换探针和反事实图像对的"使用率"三个指标，将VLM每个答案归因到感知、推理或"对感知的使用"阶段，无需访问权重与答案标签，并据此进行阶段定向的测试时算力分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只评估最终答案，无法区分答案究竟来自图像感知、推理还是记忆先验/猜测；开发者因此不知道该改进哪个环节，测试时算力的投入也缺乏针对性。

Method: 每项问题额外问模型两个问题：(1) 定位探针——要求对每个实例给出边界框，度量"看"；(2) 文本替换探针——用描述替代图像回答问题，度量"想"；(3) "用"——在反事实图像对上，答案跟随模型自身感知的比例，因两幅图像的问题与先验相同故无需答案标签。基于测得的阶段成绩分配测试时算力。

Result: 在两个模型家族、六个数据集上，有效调控手段随任务族而变；除图像与常见先验相矛盾的样本外答案均跟随感知，且先令模型定位可修复该失败（前提是框正确）；按阶段分配的算力在更低成本下接近最优均匀策略，并在调控手段确实提升短板阶段时优于等算力的随机分配。

Conclusion: 该协议提供了无需权重、无需标签的因果式阶段诊断，可指导模型改进方向与测试时算力调度；作者将开源代码、提示词及逐题输出。

Abstract: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers follow the model's perception except on images that contradict a common prior, and asking the model to localize first repairs this failure when its boxes are right. Allocating compute by the measured stages comes close to the best uniform policy at lower cost and beats a random allocation of the same compute wherever a knob raises the short stage. We will release the code, the prompts and the per-question outputs.

</details>


### [145] [Label-Free Localization and Test-Time Suppression of CLIP's Typographic Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01513)
*Bohan Liu,Wenqian Ye,Guangzhi Xiong,Zhenghao He,Sanchit Sinha,Aidong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 head-decomposed Sparse Dictionary Learning (SDL) 架构，将 CLIP 注意力头显式分解为可解释的头部特征，配合无标签的 Clarity Score 与归一化 Text Attribution Score 定位承载排版(字面)信息的"词法头"，并在测试时对其实施注意力重加权干预，从而在排版攻击下恢复物体分类；进一步提出测试时自适应注意力头路由以逼近鲁棒性-感知权衡的帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 视觉编码器同时具备"看物体"和"读文字"两种能力，导致词法形状与语义形状编码纠缠，产生排版攻击脆弱性（图中渲染文字覆盖图像语义）。而编码器的黑盒特性阻碍了对该纠缠的机制性解释。

Method: (1) head-decomposed SDL：按设计将单个注意力头分解为头部专属的可解释 latent，形成归纳式解耦；(2) 复用车 Clarity Score 并提出归一化 Text Attribution Score，均为无标签，用于识别携带排版信息的注意力头；(3) 因果验证：测试时对已识别词法头的 patch token 注意力重新加权（机制性干预）；(4) 扩展为测试时自适应注意力头路由。

Result: 干预有效恢复排版攻击下的物体分类；在 5 个 CLIP 变体、4 个排版基准上最高提升 46.9%，通用图像感知精度损失最多 1%，优于先前的有监督与免训练方法；自适应头路由在同等鲁棒性下进一步降低感知性能损失，突破现有鲁棒性-感知权衡的帕累托前沿。

Conclusion: 通过注意力头的可解释分解实现词法/语义电路的分离，并以测试时机制干预与自适应路由，在几乎不损通用感知的前提下显著提升 CLIP 对排版攻击的鲁棒性。

Abstract: CLIP-based Vision-Language Models have become cornerstones of modern multimodal systems. The cross-modal contrastive objective equips the CLIP vision encoder to both see objects and read text. These two abilities induce an entanglement between the encoding of lexical and semantic shapes, creating a distinctive vulnerability to typographic attacks, in which rendered text overrides an image's semantic content with its literal meaning. The black-box nature of these encoders has prevented a mechanistic interpretation of such entanglement. We introduce a head-decomposed Sparse Dictionary Learning (SDL) architecture that, by design, decomposes individual attention heads into interpretable, head-specific latents. Based on this inductive disentanglement, we re-purpose Clarity Score and propose normalized Text Attribution Score, which are both label-free, to identify attention heads that carry typographic information. As a causal validation of successful circuit separation, we perform a mechanistic intervention that reweighs attention away from the patch tokens in the identified lexical heads at test-time. Experiments show that the intervention effectively recovers object classification under typographic attack and, across five CLIP variants and four typographic benchmarks, achieves up to 46.9% improvement while incurring up to 1% accuracy loss in general image perception, outperforming prior supervised and training-free methods. Expanding on the mechanistic intervention, we propose a test-time adaptive attention head routing to further reduce the impact on performance at matched robustness, pushing beyond the Pareto frontier of current robustness-perception tradeoff.

</details>


### [146] [VLMs Read Aloud: The Gap Between Recognizing and Using Visual Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01517)
*Zhiyun Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"读用差距"(read-use gap)：VLM 能逐字转写图像中的文本却无法据此作答，差距源于"识别"与"使用"的分辨率需求不同；提出 ALOUD，用视觉分辨率找证据、用语言 token 重用证据，在 5x/10x 压缩长文档上将冻结 Qwen3-VL-8B 精度从 27.7% 提升到 54.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉文本压缩(把长上下文渲染成图像)现有工作只以"VLM 能恢复多少文本"为指标，但可恢复的文本不等于可用文本：VLM 能逐字转录却答不出问题。作者要揭示并量化这一"读用差距"，并据此重新设计压缩范式。

Method: 1) 系统测量 read-use gap：比较"原图直接作答"与"把模型自己的转写文本喂回作答"的差距；2) 分析分辨率饱和曲线（Qwen3-VL-8B 识别在 15 px/字符饱和，使用需 24 px/字符），并比较 2B→32B 规模效应；3) 提出 ALOUD：将视觉分辨率预算集中用于"定位+识别证据"，再把证据以语言 token 形式输出供模型使用；4) 预注册留出集检验 gap 对 8 个 VLM "自有文本相对像素增益"的排序预测能力（Spearman ρ=0.86）。

Result: 在长文档 5x 与 10x 压缩下，ALOUD 使冻结 Qwen3-VL-8B 精度翻倍：5x 时 27.7%→54.8%，接近原文的 58.5%，且上下文比压缩页面本身更短；不保留原文的条件下，在等预算下于所有层级领先所有不使用原文的方法，并优于回贴原文的 AGAR、VERA 以及保留原文的 LensVLM-9B（5x）。

Conclusion: 视觉文本压缩的瓶颈不在"能恢复多少文本"，而在"能使用多少文本"；识别与使用具有不同的分辨率需求，用语言 token 承载证据可弥合差距。该结论对多模态长上下文压缩的评测与设计具有方法论意义。

Abstract: Visual-text compression renders long contexts as images and is engineered around how much of the text a vision-language model (VLM) can recover. Yet recovered text is not usable text. VLMs can transcribe the text in an image word for word and still fail to answer from it; given back their own transcript, they answer nearly as well as from the original text. We call this difference the read-use gap. Recognizing and using visual text have different resolution requirements: Qwen3-VL-8B's recognition saturates at 15-pixel characters while use catches up only at 24 pixels, and scaling from 2B to 32B raises recognition without narrowing the gap. Putting the evidence into words closes it: thinking VLMs recite the evidence in their thinking, and their own transcript, written without seeing the question, recovers most of what thinking adds. In a preregistered held-out test, the gap ranks how much eight VLMs gain from their own words over pixels (Spearman $\rho$ = 0.86), which recognition rates do not. We propose ALOUD, which spends visual resolution on finding and recognizing evidence and language tokens on using it. Without keeping the source text, it doubles the accuracy of a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B on long documents compressed 5x and 10x: at 5x, from 27.7% to 54.8%, near the original text's 58.5%, with a context smaller than the compressed pages themselves. For less than the cost of reading the original text, it leads at equal budget every method that does without it, at every level, and beats AGAR and VERA, which paste the original text back; at 5x it also beats LensVLM-9B, which is trained and keeps the original text. Visual-text compression is limited not by how much text a model can recover, but by how much it can use.

</details>


### [147] [AR-RRG: Anatomy-Guided Retrieval-Driven Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01529)
*Xiang Zhang,Shijie Song,Wanqing Zhao,Wei Zhou,Rui Cao,Dekui Wang,Qiyao Hu,Xianlin Peng,Hangzai Luo,Sheng Zhong,Jianping Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AR-RRG：以解剖结构引导的检索驱动放射报告生成框架，含解剖感知自训练病灶检测网络（ASLDNet）与检索驱动报告生成器（RRRG），通过双粒度检索与邻域共识抑制幻觉、补全漏检。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型仅捕捉全局视觉线索，缺乏解剖区域与诊断文本的细粒度对齐；多数检索增强方法检索完整历史报告，引入冗余噪声与严重图文错配，导致临床风险性幻觉与病灶漏诊。

Method: 两模块：ASLDNet 用解剖感知空间校验（ASV）与类别自适应动态阈值（CDT）自训练实现病灶定位；RRRG 作为生成分支，用双粒度检索（DR）消除幻觉、邻域共识（NC）机制补全漏检病灶；并行连续视觉感知（PCVP）流通过固定医学编码与重采样将X线转成视觉token；多尺度文本-视觉特征融合后以 LoRA 高效微调大语言模型。

Result: 在 MS-CXR、MIMIC-CXR、IU X-Ray 上，AR-RRG 在主流指标上一致优于SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 解剖引导+细粒度检索是提升报告生成临床忠实度与视觉接地性的有效路径；代码将开源。

Abstract: Radiology report generation (RRG) streamlines clinical workflows and alleviates the burden of radiologists' documentation. Standard vision-language models capture global visual cues and lack fine-grained alignment between anatomical regions and diagnostic text. Most retrieval-augmented methods retrieve complete historical reports, introducing redundant noise and severe vision-text mismatches that trigger clinically risky hallucinations and missed lesions. In this paper, we introduce AR-RRG, an anatomy-guided retrieval-driven method for the generation of radiology reports. AR-RRG consists of two core modules: the anatomy-aware self-training lesion detection network (ASLDNet) and the retrieval-driven radiology report generation (RRRG). ASLDNet leverages anatomy-aware spatial verification (ASV) and class-adaptive dynamic thresholding (CDT) via self-training, delivering accurate lesion localization to support subsequent generation. As the generative branch of AR-RRG, RRRG eliminates clinical hallucinations through dual-granularity retrieval (DR) and complements missing lesions with a neighborhood consensus (NC) mechanism. A parallel continuous visual perception (PCVP) stream converts radiographs into visual tokens through fixed medical encoding and resampling. Multi-scale text and visual features are fused, followed by LoRA-efficient large language model tuning to generate clinically consistent, visually grounded radiology reports. Extensive evaluations on MS-CXR, MIMIC-CXR, and IU X-Ray demonstrate that AR-RRG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across mainstream metrics. Our code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [148] [AbacusGS: Gaussian Splatting without Per-Splat Sorting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01534)
*Jiacheng Ding,Yanliang Qi,Cong Guo,Peihua Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AbacusGS 将 3DGS 的深度排序顺序预存进场景结构：把 splats 按八叉树分组（每盒 ≤128 个），每个盒子按写时选定轴向有序存储；渲染时仅排序可见盒子，每盒一次点积决定正/反向读取，配合简短 order-aware 微调保持渲染质量，CPU 端排序开销大幅下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件光栅化 + CPU 排序的 web/移动端 3DGS 查看器中，逐 splat 深度排序占据大部分帧时间，成为端侧实时渲染的主要瓶颈。

Method: 1) 八叉树分盒（≤128 splats/盒）；2) 每盒按写时选定轴做有序存储；3) 帧内仅对可见盒排序，单次点积判定正向或反向遍历；4) order-aware 微调将已有 3DGS 模型迁移到该布局，over 合成算子保持不变；5) 额外给出 17 字节/splat 紧凑格式与复用同序的 CUDA tile 渲染器。

Result: 13 个标准场景上平均 PSNR 相对同等微调的 3DGS 仅下降 0.13 dB；OpenGL（CPU 排序）查看器中较逐 splat 排序快 4.5 倍。

Conclusion: 以场景布局编码混合顺序是对逐帧排序的可扩展替代方案，兼顾质量与端侧实时性能，对 web/移动端 3DGS 部署有直接实用价值；但属渲染效率工程改进，对重建精度与泛化无突破。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting sorts every splat by depth in every frame. Viewers that draw splats with the hardware rasterizer and sort them on the CPU, as most web and mobile viewers do, spend most of the frame time in this sort. We present AbacusGS, which stores the blending order of a 3DGS scene in the scene layout. AbacusGS groups the splats into octree boxes of at most 128 splats and stores each box in order along an axis chosen at write time. In each frame, AbacusGS sorts only the visible boxes, and one dot product per box decides whether the box is read forward or backward. A short order-aware fine-tuning converts an existing 3DGS model, and the over operator of 3DGS stays unchanged. On 13 standard scenes, AbacusGS loses 0.13 dB PSNR on average against an equally fine-tuned 3DGS model. In an OpenGL viewer that orders splats on the CPU, AbacusGS renders frames 4.5 times faster than per-splat sorting. We also present a compact format of 17 bytes per splat and a CUDA tile renderer that use the same order. The code will be released.

</details>


### [149] [CUFormer: Modality-Aware CT-Ultrasound Point Cloud Registration for Orthopedic Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01536)
*Lixing Tan,Qing Xia,Yuting Guo,Shuai Li,Aimin Hao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CUFormer：模态感知 Transformer 框架，将术中超声骨骼点云配准到术前 CT，通过模态身份嵌入、模态专属适配器和可见性加权对应，实现部分覆盖下的跨模态配准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声无辐射、可用于骨科导航，但其与 CT 成像物理差异导致表面采样模式不同；超声受骨骼强反射与声影限制，仅能采集面向探头的骨面，造成大量 CT 点无对应，且近对称骨骼上对应关系高度歧义。

Method: 提出 CUFormer：1）Modality-Aware Transformer（MAT），用身份嵌入编码输入模态，并在共享几何匹配器中通过模态专属 adapter 更新特征；2）显式建模成像可见性，用预测的参考侧可见性对粗、细粒度对应进行加权。

Result: 在 UltraBones100k、UltraBonesHip 两个 CT-US 数据集及 CT-RGB-D 的 SpineDepth 上，平均配准误差最低；UltraBones100k 上旋转误差 4.53°、平移误差 3.19 mm、RMSE 2.54 mm，RMSE 相对最佳基线降低 65.8%。

Conclusion: 模态感知特征与可见性加权能有效处理部分观测骨面的跨模态配准，且在多种解剖部位与跨模态组合上具泛化性。

Abstract: Registering intraoperative Ultrasound (US) bone-surface point clouds to preoperative Computed Tomography (CT) models can support radiation-free orthopedic navigation. Differences in imaging physics produce distinct surface sampling patterns, complicating cross-modal feature matching. Bone strongly reflects ultrasound and casts an acoustic shadow, so US captures only the probe-facing bone surface and leaves most CT points unmatched. This partial coverage makes correspondences ambiguous on near-symmetric bones. We propose CUFormer, a modality-aware registration framework. We introduce a Modality-Aware Transformer (MAT) that encodes input modality through identity embeddings and updates features through modality-specific adapters within a shared geometric matcher. We model imaging visibility and use predicted reference-side visibility to weight coarse and fine correspondences. CUFormer achieves the lowest mean registration errors among evaluated methods on two CT-US datasets, UltraBones100k and UltraBonesHip, and the CT-RGB-D dataset SpineDepth. On UltraBones100k, it reaches mean rotation error 4.53$^\circ$, translation error 3.19\,mm, and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) 2.54\,mm, reducing RMSE by 65.8\% relative to the best-performing baseline by this metric. These results demonstrate CUFormer's effectiveness in aligning partial bone surfaces with preoperative CT across anatomical sites.

</details>


### [150] [MoPort: A View-Aware 2D Interface for Motion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01541)
*Lixing Tan,Qing Xia,Yuting Guo,Shuai Li,Aimin Hao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoPort 提出一个视角感知的 2D 接口，通过配对视角对齐（PVA）与相机调制编码（CME），把单目 2D 姿态序列映射为与 3D 训练一致的语义隐表示，使运动语言模型可直接以 2D 观测推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoLM 训练用 3D 运动离散 token，而实际部署只有单目视频得到的 2D 关节序列，存在维度鸿沟；且 2D 观测随相机视角变化、投影丢失深度导致跨视角歧义。

Method: 构建 view-aware 2D 接口 MoPort：Paired View Alignment 让同一运动的两个视角共享 3D 教师目标，并直接约束两路 latent 一致性；Camera-Modulated Encoding 从 2D 序列估计相机外参并用于调制编码，为 2D latent 注入视角几何信息；可移植到多个下游 MoLM。

Result: HumanML3D R@1=0.5674、KIT-ML R@1=0.3286，优于所有对比基线；HumanML3D 上分布式内视角 0.5763、分布外视角 0.5585，退化很小；三个下游 MoLM 上验证可移植性；真实 RGB 数据集 Fit3D 上达 80.36% 准确率。

Conclusion: 将 2D 观测通过视角对齐与相机调制编码桥接到 3D 运动语言模型是可行且视角鲁棒的，且具备跨模型可移植性与真实视频可用性。

Abstract: Motion language models (MoLMs) encode 3D human motion as discrete tokens for language-based understanding. Deploying them on monocular video raises two problems. Pose detection yields 2D joint sequences, leaving a dimensional gap from the 3D motion used in training. Moreover, the 2D observation changes with the camera viewpoint, while the depth lost in projection makes the 2D pose ambiguous across viewpoints. We propose MoPort, a view-aware 2D interface that enables MoLMs to take 2D observations as input. We introduce Paired View Alignment (PVA), which gives two views of the same motion a shared 3D teacher target and directly constrains the consistency of their latents, so that 2D observations from different viewpoints are mapped to a consistent semantic representation. Camera-Modulated Encoding (CME) estimates the camera extrinsics from the 2D sequence and uses them to modulate encoding, providing the 2D latents with geometric information about the viewpoint. MoPort achieves R@1 of 0.5674 on HumanML3D and 0.3286 on KIT-ML, outperforming all evaluated baselines. On HumanML3D, its R@1 decreases only from 0.5763 on in-distribution viewpoints to 0.5585 on out-of-distribution viewpoints. We validate portability on three downstream MoLMs. Furthermore, on the real-world RGB video dataset Fit3D, MoPort achieves 80.36\% accuracy. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [151] [GSExplorer: Interactive World Generation with a Persistent 3D Gaussian World State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01543)
*Sicheng Yu,Liu Liu,Xinjie Wang,Xinjiang Wang,Taojun Ding,Wenhao Hu,Beizhen Zhao,Puxin Yan,Zhizhong Su,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GSExplorer：以持久3D高斯世界状态为核心的生成-重建框架，通过复用3DGS多模态渲染条件、独立相对射线编码注入相机几何、SLAM后端+不一致性过滤+跨块BA，实现长程交互式世界生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界生成需要精确局部控制与长时程场景一致性。现有方法用相机/几何条件或记忆机制扩展上下文，但长程探索中目标视角引导不完整、重复场景更新导致误差累积。

Method: 1) 持久3DGS世界状态，每步提供多模态渲染条件给条件驱动视频生成器；2) 独立的Relative Ray Encoding分支注入相机几何；3) 生成视频回馈至基于SLAM的重建后端，含不一致性过滤防止冲突内容污染场景；4) 跨chunk bundle adjustment提升跨步空间对齐；5) 构造数据流水线模拟场景外推中的真实3DGS退化，生成293K退化多模态渲染-真实目标视频训练对。

Result: 在WorldScore单步与三步评测中综合性能最优，两种设置下相机控制与一致性均强，单步外推Camera Control达99.07；481帧leave-and-return rollout显示强重访一致性。

Conclusion: 维护可靠的三维世界状态对持续探索具有明确价值，生成-重建闭环是缓解长程漂移的有效范式。

Abstract: Interactive world generation requires both accurate local control and stable scene consistency over long rollouts. Existing methods improve local generation through camera or geometry conditioning and extend historical context with memory mechanisms. However, long-horizon exploration remains challenging as target-view guidance becomes incomplete and inconsistencies accumulate across repeated scene updates. We present \textbf{GSExplorer}, a generation--reconstruction framework built around a persistent 3D Gaussian world state. At each step, the current 3DGS scene provides multimodal rendering conditions for a condition-driven video generator, while camera geometry is injected through a separate Relative Ray Encoding branch. Generated videos are then fed back to a SLAM-based reconstruction backend, where inconsistency filtering prevents conflicting content from corrupting the scene and cross-chunk bundle adjustment improves spatial alignment across generation steps. We further design a data-construction pipeline that reproduces realistic 3DGS degradation during scene extrapolation, yielding 293K training pairs of degraded multimodal renderings and real target videos. GSExplorer achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods on both single-step and three-step WorldScore evaluation, with strong camera control and consistency across both settings, including a Camera Control score of 99.07 in single-step extrapolation. On 481-frame leave-and-return rollouts, it also shows strong revisit consistency, demonstrating the value of maintaining a reliable 3D world state for continued exploration.

</details>


### [152] [Band2Net: Frequency-to-Network Transport Distillation for fMRI-Privileged, EEG-Only Session-Condition Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01548)
*Nishi Kanta Paul,Md Shihabul Islam Shovo,Dwarikanath Mahapatra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Band2Net将fMRI作为训练期特权信息，把EEG编码为5个频段特异连接图、fMRI编码为7个冻结教师网络token，并求解熵正则平衡传输问题为每个EEG频段分配专属fMRI目标；仅用EEG即可实现0.801 ROC-AUC的会话条件解码，较纯EEG学生提升5.0 AUC点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: fMRI空间定位好但昂贵且需静止，EEG便携但空间分辨率差；希望在不部署fMRI的情况下把fMRI的网络级先验蒸馏进EEG模型。同一被试在同条件但非同步采集，形成训练/部署信息不对称的特权信息设定。

Method: 特权信息蒸馏框架：EEG映射为五个频段特定连接图，fMRI通过冻结教师映射为七个典型网络token；在两组token之间求解平衡熵正则最优传输，为各EEG频段获得独立的对齐目标。PsiConnect裸盖菇素数据上按被试分组交叉验证，对比单共享传输方案、KL松弛方案、无标签网络描述子，以及logit/全局特征/对比/池化目标蒸馏等基线。

Result: EEG-only会话条件解码达0.801 ROC-AUC，比EEG-only学生高5.0 AUC点（95% CI 1.8–8.2）。但相对单一共享传输方案、KL松弛方案和无标签网络描述子的优势不显著；次要比较显示频段特异传输目标优于logit、全局特征、对比与池化目标蒸馏，但经Holm校正后不再显著。

Conclusion: 频段特异的最优传输式跨模态蒸馏能有效利用fMRI特权信息提升便携EEG解码，但消融与统计校正显示核心增益来源（传输结构还是简单对齐）尚未厘清，结论偏初步。

Abstract: Functional MRI resolves large-scale brain networks but is expensive and stationary, whereas EEG is portable but poorly localised. We treat fMRI as privileged information, available during training and absent at deployment, with EEG and fMRI acquired from the same participants under matched conditions but not simultaneously. Band2Net encodes EEG into five frequency-specific connectivity graphs and fMRI into seven canonical network tokens from a frozen teacher, and solves a balanced entropic transport problem between the two token sets that gives each EEG band its own fMRI target. In subject-grouped cross-validation on the PsiConnect psilocybin data set, Band2Net reaches 0.801 ROC-AUC for EEG-only session-condition decoding, 5.0 AUC points (95% CI 1.8-8.2) above an EEG-only student. Although its margins over a single shared plan, a KL-relaxed plan and label-free network descriptors remain unresolved, secondary comparisons favour band-specific transported targets over logit, global-feature, contrastive and pooled-target distillation, though not after Holm correction.

</details>


### [153] [TopoDPO: Dense Preference Alignment for Structure-Sensitive Aerial Referring Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01551)
*Huaiyuan Peng,Jisheng Dang,Wencan Zhang,Jingwen Zhao,Hong Peng,Wenjun Ma,Bin Hu,Qi Tian,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TopoDPO：面向结构敏感航空指代分割的拓扑感知稠密偏好对齐框架，用连通域差异与宏角点召回挖掘偏好对，并将偏好惩罚施加到每个局部空间边界后再聚合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态分割偏好优化存在粒度失配：稠密掩码包含空间异质偏好信号，而图像级DPO只给所有空间边界分配同一个非线性权重，无法针对结构错误（如连通域数量错误）做局部修正。

Method: 提出TopoDPO框架：Topo-Prior用连通域差异与宏角点召回筛选信息量高的偏好对；稠密目标在空间聚合前对每个局部margin施加偏好惩罚，以冻结的监督参考模型为基线做参考相对加权；并用匹配监督对照与完整因子实验分离三类组件贡献。

Result: 在4590实例的结构压力集Topo-RS-Hard上，IoU从图像级DPO的50.91%提升到51.24%，Betti-0误差从1.34降至0.90；图像簇配对bootstrap区间在全部5项指标上均排除零；在39,244条验证记录的无过滤分层中，组件数预对齐误差中等或严重的样本上结构增益最明显。

Conclusion: 将偏好优化从图像级非线性加权下沉到稠密边界局部聚合，能有效改善结构敏感分割的拓扑正确性；增益幅度在IoU上有限（约0.3pt），主要体现在连通域计数误差度量上，且对特定误差区间的样本更有效。

Abstract: Preference optimization for multimodal segmentation faces a granularity mismatch: dense masks contain spatially heterogeneous preference signals, whereas image-level objectives assign one shared nonlinear weight to all spatial margins. We introduce TopoDPO, a topology-aware dense preference alignment framework for structure-sensitive aerial referring segmentation. Topo-Prior mines informative preference pairs using connected-component discrepancy and macro-corner recall, while the dense objective applies the preference penalty to each local margin before spatial aggregation against a frozen supervised reference. On Topo-RS-Hard, a 4590-instance structural stress set, TopoDPO improves intersection over union (IoU) from 50.91% to 51.24% over image-level direct preference optimization (DPO) and reduces Betti-0 error from 1.34 to 0.90; paired image-cluster bootstrap intervals against image-level DPO exclude zero for all five reported metrics. Matched supervised controls and a complete factorial analysis separate the effects of topology-aware pair mining, localized correction, and dense reference-relative preference weighting. An unfiltered stratification over all 39,244 validation records further shows the clearest structural gains on samples with moderate or severe pre-alignment component-count errors. The code is publicly available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [154] [Text-Assisted Event Stream Visual Place Recognition via Multi-Scale Spatiotemporal Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01558)
*Lan Chen,Xingxing Xiong,Xiao Wang,Ziyan Zhang,Zikang Yan,Yuanhao Zheng,Bo Jiang,Yonghong Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MSTOT-EPR：用多尺度空间-时间最优传输实现事件相机视觉位置识别（VPR），并融合自然语言文本以增强语义对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机事件流稀疏、缺乏丰富结构纹理信息，现有引入自然语言描述的VPR方法仍难以有效编码事件流并与文本模态做语义对齐。

Method: 视觉编码器+文本编码器分别提取特征；采用最优传输约束做跨模态对齐；设计跨模态瓶颈融合模块融合双模态特征；提出多尺度空间最优传输与帧间时间最优传输模块挖掘高质量时空事件特征。

Result: 在NYC-Event-VPR与EPRBench数据集上实验验证框架有效性。

Conclusion: 跨模态最优传输融合可有效提升事件相机视觉位置识别性能。

Abstract: Benefiting from the high dynamic range, high temporal resolution, and low energy consumption of event cameras, low-altitude economic research leveraging event cameras has become a popular topic. Several existing attempts introduce natural-language descriptions into visual place recognition (VPR) to mitigate the sparsity of structural spatial information inherent to event cameras. Nevertheless, these methods still fail to fully address two core challenges: effectively encoding event streams and semantically aligning event streams with text. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale spatial-temporal optimal transport approach, MSTOT-EPR, to address these challenges. Specifically, given event streams and scene text information, we first adopt a visual encoder and a text encoder to extract respective feature representations. We then apply optimal-transport constraints to achieve cross-modal alignment. We then design a cross-modal bottleneck fusion module to further fuse bimodal features. Furthermore, we develop multi-scale spatial optimal transport and inter-frame temporal optimal transport modules to mine high-quality spatial-temporal event features for scene recognition. Extensive experiments on the NYC-Event-VPR and EPRBench datasets fully validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework for event-based VPR. The source code of this paper will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [155] [Spend the Bits Where the Tiny Objects Are: Rate-Utility Region Coding for Aerial Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01573)
*Yanliang Qi,Jiacheng Ding,Cong Guo,Peihua Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 rate-utility region coding (RUO)：按“期望检测效用 vs. 实测字节开销”决定每块区域丢弃或按低/高质量发送，无需训练模型、用标准编解码器，对微小目标比调优阈值式 ROI 编码省 42.4% 比特。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带宽受限的航拍相机必须在传输前压缩图像，供远端检测器寻找大量微小目标。阈值式 ROI 编码只发送高置信区域，而微小目标视觉证据有限、置信分数低，常导致真正含目标的区域被丢弃。

Method: 以速率–效用权衡替代阈值判定：对每个候选区域估计检测效用并测量其编码字节成本，仅当效用能抵消成本时才发送，且可在“丢弃/低质量/高质量”三档中选择；三个决策共用同一个跨图像共享的乘子（rate-utility 乘子）进行调节，不训练任何模型，依赖标准图像编解码器，解码仅需数毫秒。

Result: 在 VisDrone-DET test-dev 全部 1,610 张图上，于两者共享的微小目标 AP 区间内平均比调优阈值 ROI 编码少用 42.4% 比特；对微小目标所需比特数也低于 AVIF、HEVC 及三种已发表的学习式编解码器；发送端与接收端使用不同检测器时相对阈值 ROI 的优势仍保持。但在全尺度 AP 上 RUO 比调优 ROI 多需 25.4% 比特，因其在低码率下优先丢弃大区域。

Conclusion: RUO 是一种免训练、极低解码延迟的前端编码策略，适用于以微小目标检测为核心的任务；对大目标占主导的场景并不占优。作者计划开源代码。

Abstract: Bandwidth-limited aerial cameras must compress their images before a remote detector can find the many tiny objects in them. Threshold-based region-of-interest (ROI) coding sends only confidently detected regions, and because tiny objects provide limited visual evidence and often score low, it can discard the regions that contain them. We propose rate-utility region coding (RUO), which sends a region when its expected detection utility justifies its measured byte cost, choosing to drop it or to send it at low or high quality with one multiplier shared across images. RUO trains no model, uses a standard image codec and decodes in a few milliseconds. On all 1,610 VisDrone-DET test-dev images, RUO uses 42.4% fewer bits than a tuned threshold-based ROI coder, averaged over their shared tiny-object average precision (AP) range. RUO also needs fewer bits for tiny objects than the AV1 Image File Format (AVIF), High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) and three published learned codecs, and its advantage over threshold-based ROI coding persists when the sender and receiver use different detectors. For AP over all object sizes RUO needs 25.4% more bits than the tuned ROI coder, because its allocation drops large regions first at low rates, so it suits tasks that target tiny objects. We plan to release the code.

</details>


### [156] [Recoverability-Aware Evaluation of Diffusion Video Inpainting and Object Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01578)
*Yanliang Qi,Jiacheng Ding,Cong Guo,Peihua Mai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出“可恢复性分层评估（recoverability-stratified evaluation）”，用干净视频上的点跟踪器按孔洞像素的可观测性分层打分，并提出无需训练的“证据引导采样（EGS）”将跟踪到的颜色融合进视频扩散去除器的干净潜变量预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物体去除的视频修复按整块孔洞评分，混合了“复制已观测内容”与“凭空生成”两种能力，无法揭示去除模型究竟擅长哪一种。

Method: 在干净视频上运行点跟踪器，为每个孔洞像素标注其被观测的帧距离，据此按层报告保真度与时间稳定性，并以复制参考为基准；同时提出免训练 EGS，把跟踪颜色混入扩散模型的干净潜变量预测。

Result: DAVIS 上三个扩散去除器相对流传播的感知优势在“数帧外可见”区域缩小（对 E2FGVI-HQ 的 LPIPS 双重差分 +0.046~+0.056），其孔洞 warp 误差为 ProPainter 的 2–4 倍；沿干净视频轨迹复制可将其可恢复区域 LPIPS 降低 1/4~2/5。EGS 在留出 DAVIS 上弥合了通往复制参考 43% 和 56% 的差距；但用掩码输入上跟踪的颜色时，预注册验证在 MiniMax-Remover 上无增益、在 ROSE 上有损失。

Conclusion: 扩散式去除器在 DAVIS 上未能利用已观测内容；免训练复用虽然方向有效，但依赖可靠跟踪证据，用掩码输入跟踪时还不能成立。

Abstract: Video inpainting for object removal is scored over the whole hole, although the background behind the object is visible in other frames of the shot for some hole pixels and in no frame for others. A whole-hole score therefore mixes copying with generation and cannot show which of the two a remover does well. To separate the two, we propose recoverability-stratified evaluation, in which a point tracker run on the clean video labels each hole pixel by whether and how far away it is observed, so that fidelity and temporal stability can be reported per stratum against a copy reference. To reuse the observed content, we also propose evidence-guided sampling (EGS), which blends tracked colors into the clean-latent prediction of a video diffusion remover without training. On DAVIS, the perceptual advantage of three diffusion removers over flow propagation shrinks where the content is visible a few frames away (LPIPS difference-in-differences +0.046 to +0.056 against E2FGVI-HQ), and real paired captures show the same pattern for two of them. Their DAVIS hole warping error is two to four times that of ProPainter, and copying along clean-video tracks lowers their recoverable LPIPS by a quarter to two fifths. EGS closes 43% and 56% of the gap to this copy reference on held-out DAVIS when its colors come from clean-video tracks. With colors tracked on the masked input, a pre-registered confirmation finds no gain on MiniMax-Remover and a loss on ROSE. Diffusion removers thus leave observed content unused on DAVIS, and training-free reuse does not yet hold with tracked evidence.

</details>


### [157] [Accurate automated photo-identification of Near Eastern and European fire salamanders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01601)
*Maayan Yesharim,Hava Goldstein,Gabi Kolodny,Assaf Ben-Levy,Tamar Kis-Papo,Dor Gavish,Rotem Vidan,Nirit Lavie-Alon,Olga Rybak,Yoav Ram*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无需物种训练的零样本局部特征匹配（SuperPoint+LightGlue）流水线，用于两栖类黄斑图案的非侵入式photo-ID重识别与数据库审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两栖类photo-ID依赖人工识别，参考库扩大后变慢且易错；希望用无需训练的通用工具替代/辅助人工。

Method: 隔离黄色斑点图案；以高置信关键点匹配数作为相似度并对斑点数量混杂做归一化/校正；两级聚类完成全库身份分配；再用专家复核纠错。

Result: 2,440张野外照片；held-out个体top-1 95.2%、ARI 0.958；跨物种零改动迁移到欧洲火蝾螈达95.1%/91.7% top-1、93.7%再捕获识别（五个现有程序38–77%，人工目检93.9%）；专家复核后身份数减少近四分之一。

Conclusion: 零样本局部特征匹配可作为可迁移、可扩展（千级个体）、免标注的两栖类重识别与既有数据库审计工具，但本质是现成特征匹配的领域应用，非核心研究方向。

Abstract: Photo-identification underpins non-invasive capture-recapture monitoring of amphibians, but manual identification becomes slow and error-prone as reference libraries grow. Focusing on the Near Eastern fire salamander (Salamandra infraimmaculata), we developed a pipeline based on zero-shot local-feature matching (SuperPoint and LightGlue) without species-specific training and evaluated it on $2{,}440$ field photographs from Haifa and Tel Dan in northern Israel. We isolated the yellow spot pattern, scored image similarity by the number of high-confidence keypoint matches, which reduced a confound whereby many-spotted individuals accumulate spurious matches, and assigned identities across the database by two-tier clustering. Pipeline-assisted expert review corrected misidentifications, reducing the number of identities by almost a quarter. On held-out individuals, the pipeline ranked the correct individual first for $95.2\%$ of queries and recovered identities with an ARI of $0.958$. Without modification, it reached $95.1\%$ and $91.7\%$ top-1 accuracy on two datasets of the European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) and recognised $93.7\%$ of recaptures in one of them, compared with $38$-$77\%$ for five established programs and $93.9\%$ for visual inspection. Zero-shot local-feature matching thus offers amphibian monitoring a re-identification tool that needs no training data, transfers between related species, scales to databases of over a thousand individuals, and can audit existing databases before capture-recapture analysis.

</details>


### [158] [MedNet and U$^2$-ViT: A Nested Vision Transformer Diffusion Framework for Diverse Medical Images Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01605)
*Lakshmikar R. Polamreddy,Jialu Li,Youshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MedNet：61类疾病、160类别的多模态文本-图像医学数据集，配嵌套ViT-U-Net扩散生成架构U²-ViT，FID最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像数据稀缺、类别不平衡、疾病覆盖有限、成像条件变化不足，制约稳健可泛化的医学AI模型发展。

Method: 构建大规模多模态文本-图像数据集MedNet（61个疾病大类、160个子类，涵盖人类与动物，来源可信公开库）；提出U²-ViT，将ViT以嵌套U-Net结构组织的扩散式文本到图像生成架构。

Result: 大量实验表明，相较SOTA模型取得最佳FID分数；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 数据集与嵌套ViT扩散架构可提升医学图像生成的多样性与保真度，缓解医学数据瓶颈。

Abstract: The scarcity of diverse, high-quality medical images remains a significant bottleneck in advancing AI-driven medical diagnostics and treatment planning. Traditional datasets often suffer from class imbalances, limited disease coverage, and insufficient variations in imaging conditions - challenges that hinder the development of robust, generalizable models. To address this, we introduce MedNet, a large-scale, multi-modal text-to-image dataset spanning 61 disease categories with 160 classes, covering both humans and animals. We built this with images from trusted public repositories, ensuring data diversity, quality, and ethical compliance. Additionally, we propose U$^2$-ViT, a novel diffusion-based text-to-image generation architecture arranging Vision Transformers (ViTs) in a nested U-Net structure to enhance the generation of diverse, and high-fidelity medical images. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our model achieves the best Fr'echet Inception Distance (FID) score compared to state-of-the-art models. The source code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [159] [NatureFusion: Rethinking Infrared and Visible Image Fusion as Natural Complementary Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01607)
*Jianfeng Ding,Linfeng Tang,Hao Zhang,Han Xu,Xunpeng Yi,Yibing Zhang,Meiqi Gong,Zhongyuan Wang,Jiayi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NatureFusion redefines红外-可见光图像融合为"自然互补增强"而非源保真，用生成式基础模型作教师+条件流匹配微调轻量融合适配器，并加检测器监督的任务适配器，生成自然风格融合图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有融合方法追求对源图像保真，红外目标呈"热辐射亮斑"贴片，颜色纹理被遮蔽，视觉不自然且偏离可见光预训练模型的数据分布。作者主张融合应生成自然、可见光风格的清晰图像。

Method: 1) 无GT情况下用生成式基础模型作为教师直接生成视觉自然融合图作监督；2) 通过轻量融合适配器以条件流匹配微调预训练生成模型，降低计算成本；3) 冻结融合适配器，引入检测器监督的任务适配器增强红外互补贡献。

Result: 与7种多模态融合方法及7种单模态增强方法对比，NatureFusion在感知质量上最优；在可见光预训练检测与分割模型上取得显著更高精度。

Conclusion: 以"自然互补增强"为目标的生成式融合范式可兼顾视觉自然性与下游任务性能，为红外-可见光融合提供了新评测导向。

Abstract: In the absence of ground truth, most existing infrared and visible image fusion methods pursue fidelity to the source images and directly superimpose two physically distinct modalities. As a result, salient infrared targets appear as bright patches of thermal radiation pasted onto the scene. These patches obscure the original color and texture of the targets, so the fused images look unnatural to human observers and deviate from the data distribution learned by vision models pretrained on visible images. Therefore, we redefine infrared and visible image fusion as natural complementary enhancement rather than source fidelity, and propose NatureFusion, which exploits cross-modal complementary cues to infer a clear and natural visible-style image from low-quality visible and infrared image pairs. Specifically, to address the lack of ground truth, we employ a generative foundation model as the teacher to directly generate visually natural fused images for supervision. Furthermore, to fully distill the teacher's generative capability while reducing computational cost, we fine-tune a pretrained generative model with conditional flow matching through a light-weight fusion adapter. Last but not least, to further improve downstream performance without sacrificing natural appearance, we freeze the fusion adapter and introduce a detector-supervised task adapter that strengthens the complementary contribution of infrared. Extensive comparisons with seven multi-modal fusion and seven single-modality enhancement methods demonstrate that NatureFusion generates visually natural fused images with the best perceptual quality. Detection and segmentation models pretrained on visible images achieve substantially higher accuracy on our fused images than on those of any competing method.

</details>


### [160] [Special and General Computational Aesthetics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01626)
*Ganqing Luo,Chuan Li,Liaoruxing Zhang,Xin Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文分析计算美学（computational aesthetics）的内部结构与邻接概念关系，提出"特殊计算美学（SCA）"与"一般计算美学（GCA）"两层范围界定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算美学横跨计算机科学、AI、美学等学科，与计算艺术、AI艺术、AI美学、AIGC、计算创造力、情感计算、神经美学等形成包含、交叉或支撑关系。若不加区分范围、目标与方法，易被窄化为图像美学质量评价，或被泛化为"AI介入艺术"的伞形术语。作者意在厘清边界。

Method: 概念分析/立场论文：梳理计算美学内部结构及其与邻近概念的关系，提出两层范围框架。SCA聚焦"美学测量"（计算识别与表示美学属性、预测人类美学评价）与"美学过程建模"（描述、检验并解释人类审美感知与判断的形成机制）。GCA将核心扩展至"美学生成"，即受计算美学模型引导的艺术生成。使用AI算法的该范围研究定义为AI美学。借用封鹏关于美、审美经验与艺术之可计算性的论述作理论参照。

Result: SCA对应"审美感知"与"审美理解"两个子问题；部分计算美学任务亦可用非AI方法完成；"美学生成"与AIGC、AI艺术、计算创造力存在交叉，但只有计算美学模型实质性地约束、引导或优化作品生成时，才归属GCA扩展。

Conclusion: 以SCA/GCA两层框架明确了计算美学与AI美学、AIGC、AI艺术、计算创造力等概念的边界，强调"实质约束/引导"作为归属判据的可操作性。

Abstract: Computational aesthetics is a field at the intersection of computer science, artificial intelligence, aesthetics, and other disciplines. As AI has developed, the field has formed relations of inclusion, intersection, or support with computational art, AI art, AI aesthetics, AI-generated content (AIGC), computational creativity, affective computing, and neuroaesthetics. Without distinguishing scope, objectives, and methods, it may be narrowed to image aesthetic quality assessment or expanded into an umbrella term for AI's involvement in art. We analyze its internal structure and its relations with neighboring concepts, and propose a two-level scope: special computational aesthetics (SCA) and general computational aesthetics (GCA). SCA centers on aesthetic measurement and aesthetic process modeling. The former primarily corresponds to "Aesthetic Perception": computationally identifying and representing aesthetic attributes and predicting human aesthetic evaluations; the latter primarily to "Aesthetic Understanding": computationally describing, testing, and explaining how human aesthetic perception and judgment are formed. GCA extends this core to include "Aesthetic Generation," namely artistic generation guided by computational aesthetic models. Some computational aesthetic tasks can also use non-AI methods. Research in this scope using AI algorithms and models we define as AI aesthetics, which may involve the special core and the general extension. "Aesthetic Generation" intersects with AIGC, AI art, and computational creativity, but belongs to the general extension defined here only when computational aesthetic models substantively constrain, guide, or optimize artwork generation. We also draw on Feng Peng's discussion of the computability of beauty, aesthetic experience, and art as a theoretical reference for clarifying boundaries between computational aesthetics and related concepts.

</details>


### [161] [EgoMo3R: Joint Egocentric Motion and Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01627)
*Chaitanya Patel,Yusuke Kato,Rin Takahira,Kazuki Kozuka,Juan Carlos Niebles,Ehsan Adeli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoMo3R：无需惯性传感器的第一人称视频联合优化框架，交替优化场景几何重建与扩散人体运动先验，重建度量尺度、重力对齐的人体运动与场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称视频中的3D人体运动重建与场景理解本质耦合，但现有方法分开处理，且运动重建方法普遍依赖专用惯性传感器提供的度量、重力对齐相机轨迹；从单目第一人称视频恢复此类轨迹在快速头部运动与运动模糊下极为困难。

Method: 以单目深度、光流、点轨迹等低层视觉几何基元提供鲁棒约束，结合扩散式人体运动先验，用一阶优化求解；提出交替优化方案形成协同反馈：场景重建为运动先验提供物理落地与轨迹条件，运动先验反过来正则化相机轨迹、并把场景锚定到度量、重力对齐的世界坐标系。整体为联合优化框架。

Result: 在EgoExo4D与Nymeria的高动态序列上评估，3D场景重建与第一人称人体运动估计两项均优于专用基线方法。

Conclusion: 耦合的交替优化可有效替代惯性传感器，实现无标记单目第一人称的度量级人体-场景联合重建，为AR/VR与机器人应用提供基础。

Abstract: Understanding holistic 3D human motion and the surrounding environment from egocentric video is fundamental for applications in AR/VR and robotics. Although these tasks are inherently coupled, existing methods treat them separately. In particular, egocentric motion reconstruction methods typically assume access to metric, gravity-aligned camera trajectories from specialized inertial sensors. Recovering such trajectories from monocular egocentric video remains a significant challenge due to rapid head movements and motion blur. We present EgoMo3R, a joint optimization framework that simultaneously reconstructs 3D human motion and scene geometry from casual egocentric video. It leverages the robustness of low-level visuo-geometric primitives, including monocular depth, optical flow, and point tracks, integrated with a diffusion-based human motion prior via first-order optimization. We propose an alternating optimization scheme that establishes a synergistic feedback loop: scene reconstruction provides physical grounding and trajectory conditioning for the motion prior, while the motion prior regularizes the camera trajectory and anchors the scene in a metric, gravity-aligned world frame. We evaluate EgoMo3R on the highly dynamic sequences of the EgoExo4D and Nymeria datasets and show that it outperforms specialized baselines in both 3D scene reconstruction and egocentric motion estimation.

</details>


### [162] [Zero-shot evaluation of open vision-language models as System 1 decision models on radiology tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01631)
*Bradley J Erickson,Sara Salehi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 比较 System 1 多模态决策模型 Clef 27B、d1 3B 与常规 LLM（Qwen3.8-27B）在 7 项放射学任务（文本、X 线、CT、MRI）上的 AUROC 表现，均不做微调。文本类任务所有模型 AUROC>0.95；Clef 在部分影像任务优于 Qwen 主干，d1 在 7 项中 6 项低于 Clef，且无人能做好运动伪影分级；System 1 模型算力/能耗更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估"System 1"式（单步、低计算）多模态决策模型能否在放射学多任务上替代以常规方式使用的通用 LLM，并在精度与推理成本（时延、能耗）之间取得更优权衡。

Method: 三模型横评：Clef 27B、Qwen3.8-27B（Clef 主干）、d1 3B。7 项任务：3 项报告文本解读（CT-RATE、PadChest 报告找征象；AccessGUDID 器械 MR 安全性），4 项影像检出（CT-RATE 3D 体积 18 征象、RANZCR CLiP 管线位置、MR-ART 运动伪影分级、BraTS 2021 序列识别）。主终点 AUROC；无任务级微调；另统计单请求时延与能耗。

Result: 所有请求均成功。报告类征象检索近乎完美（AUROC>0.95）。Clef 在 CT-RATE 3D 体积、RANZCR 优于 Qwen 主干，在 MR-ART 更差；BraTS、GUDID、PadChest 无差异，CT-RATE 报告差 0.002。BraTS 上 Clef 正确识别 90/100 例 FLAIR，Qwen 从未选中该序列。d1 在 7 项中 6 项低于 Clef。运动伪影分级全模型失败。多问题/单输入场景下 Clef 单请求更快；d1 单请求能耗为 Clef 的 1/3~1/9。

Conclusion: System 1 模型可在放射学重要任务上以更低算力达到高精度；当 LLM 被约束为单 token 输出时，其成本与性能接近 System 1，除非需一次回答多问题。3B 模型在报告文本上接近 27B，但影像任务仍落后；伪影严重度分级尚不可解。

Abstract: Purpose: We compared two multimodal System 1 decision models, Clef 27B and d1 3B, with a traditional LLM (Qwen 3.8-27B) on seven radiology tasks covering text, radiographs, CT and MRI. Methods: Three models were compared: Clef, Qwen3.8-27B and d1. Three tasks were interpretation of text and 4 were detection of finding in images. The tasks were: 1. finding presence of finding in CT-RATE chest CT reports; 2. Presence of finding in PadChest chest radiograph reports; 3. the same 18 findings on CT-RATE chest CT but 3D volumes; 4. MR safety status of devices from AccessGUDID device records; 5. line and tube position on RANZCR CLiP chest radiographs; 6. motion-artifact severity on MR-ART T1-weighted brain MRI and 7. sequence identification on BraTS 2021 brain MRI. The primary endpoint was AUROC. There was no fine-tuning of the models on the tasks. Results: All models completed all tests without a failed request. All retrieved findings from reports almost perfectly (AUROC >0.95). Clef ranked higher than its Qwen backbone on CT-RATE volumes and RANZCR lower on MR-ART. The two did not differ on BraTS, GUDID or PadChest, and differed by 0.002 on CT-RATE reports. On BraTS, Clef correctly identified 90 of 100 FLAIR volumes while Qwen never chose it. d1 ranked lower than Clef on six of seven tasks. No model performed well on motion severity. Clef was faster per request than Qwen on tasks with many questions per input. d1 used 3 to 9 times less energy per request than Clef. Conclusions: System 1 models can perform important tasks in radiology with high accuracy, at lower compute cost than LLMs used in the usual way. When an LLM is constrained to a single answer token, its cost and performance is similar to System 1 models unless multiple questions are asked. A 3B System 1 model was close to the 27B models on report text but not on images. No model performed well on motion severity.

</details>


### [163] [Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Urdu Nastaliq Handwriting Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01635)
*Haseeb Yaqoob,Fatima Azfar,Emaan Arif Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 零样本基准：六个系统在UNHD乌尔都语手写体上评估；商业VLM错误率最低，但VLM作为OCR纠错器时收益依赖输入文本可读性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乌尔都语Nastaliq手写体因连写、无固定基线、无清晰字符边界而难识别，需要厘清现有OCR系统与通用VLM的零样本能力边界，以及VLM作为后处理纠错模块的实际增益。

Method: Part A：在UNHD的2,465张单行图像上零样本对比六系统（Tesseract默认配置、印刷体专用UTRNet-Large、两个开源VLM、两个商业VLM），统一固定提示词，可配置时温度设为0。Part B：VLM同时接收源图像与另一OCR的噪声文本进行纠错，将纠错收益与模型自身识别能力解耦。

Result: 两个商业VLM错误率低于印刷体识别器与开源VLM；归纳出三类失败模式，其中商业模型会显式拒识极难样本而非臆测。纠错增益：对Tesseract输出仅0.7%–7.4%；对UTRNet输出，两个商业纠错器达17.9%与21.9%。增益与输入文本可读性相关，弱纠错器可使较清晰文本变差。

Conclusion: 工作是零样本行为刻画而非SOTA对比（未含手写训练识别器）；VLM纠错可视为受限增益的级联模块，需谨慎选型。

Abstract: Handwritten Urdu is hard to recognize because the cursive Nastaliq script has no fixed baseline and no clear character boundaries. We benchmark six systems on the Urdu Nastaliq Handwritten Dataset (UNHD): Tesseract (default configuration), a script-specific recognizer trained on printed Urdu (UTRNet-Large), two open-source vision-language models (VLMs), and two commercial VLMs. All six systems are evaluated without fine-tuning on 2,465 single-line images (Part A), and the four VLMs receive the same fixed prompt (decoding uses temperature 0 where configurable, except for Claude Sonnet 5, whose decoding cannot be configured). Both commercial VLMs reach lower error than the printed-Urdu recognizer and the open-source VLMs. We do not compare against handwriting-trained recognizers, which would likely do better in-domain; we characterize zero-shot behavior, not state of the art. We also describe three distinct failure modes among the ranked systems. In one of them, a commercial model explicitly declines to transcribe a few very hard-to-read images instead of guessing. In a second study (Part B), VLMs correct the output of a separate OCR system using both the source image and the noisy text. Once separated from each model's own reading ability, the benefit is small on Tesseract's output (0.7% to 7.4%) and larger (17.9% and 21.9%) only for the two commercial correctors given UTRNet's text. It appears to depend on how legible the supplied text already is, and a weaker corrector can make a more legible text worse.

</details>


### [164] [UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01645)
*Rui Cao,Jia-Hui Pan,Yin Zhang,Qiwei Meng,Jiapeng Li,Gang Wang,Runsong Zhu,Wei Chen,Chi-Wing Fu,Jiangliu Wang,Yun-Hui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UA-Depth：利用冻结深度基础模型先验与不确定性门控的迭代协同精炼框架，恢复透明/反射/半透明物体的度量深度，并提供像素级不确定性用于6D位姿与抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商品RGB-D相机在非朗伯表面上失效（空洞、结构化噪声、深度偏置）；现有修复方法只输出单张深度图，均匀对待噪声与可靠区域，忽略区域不确定性，且零样本泛化弱。

Method: 迭代协同精炼深度与像素级不确定性，用不确定性门控特征抑制不可靠线索以保证稳定更新；以冻结深度基础模型为先验初始化缺失/不可靠深度；两阶段MAD加权对数深度尺度归一化，降低相对到度量对齐的外点偏置；构建八数据集零样本基准。

Result: 在八个数据集跨场景、材质、传感器的零样本评测中平均排名最佳，在透明/反射主导数据集上增益显著；在下游类别级6D位姿估计与6D抓取生成上带来改进。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知的深度修复可作为机器人操作的可靠感知前端，且不确定性本身对位姿与抓取具实用价值；代码模型将开源。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth. Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty. We present UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, and uses uncertainty-gated features to suppress unreliable cues for stable updates. To strengthen zero-shot behavior, UA-Depth leverages a frozen depth foundation model as a prior to initialize missing or unreliable depth, and applies two-stage MAD-weighted log-depth scale normalization to reduce outlier bias in relative-to-metric alignment. We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors. Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects. Beyond depth metrics, we demonstrate downstream improvements in category-level 6D pose estimation and 6D grasp synthesis by exploiting the predicted uncertainty. \emph{Code, models, and data for training and evaluation will be released upon publication.}

</details>


### [165] [dKV Forcing: Separating Generation and Memory Representations through a Differentiable KV Cache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01648)
*Zhiqi Li,Bo Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: dKV Forcing 通过可微分 KV 页式缓存，让视频生成器的"记忆写入"状态直接从未来读取中获得梯度，实现写入端与生成端的解耦并提升长视频一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果视频生成器为每段产生的"生成用 KV"与"写入缓存供后续读取的 KV"本质不同，后续段对二者注意力方式不同，直接混用会损害续写质量；而要让写入 KV 按其未来用途学习，需要梯度穿越缓存，但常用可变缓存不支持反向传播。

Method: 1) 在共享骨干上为写入方加一个低秩残差分支，把"记忆写入"与"生成"分离，并按其未来被读取的方式训练；2) 用持久化可微分页式缓存替代训练期可变缓存，配合局部重算（rematerialization），在单次时间遍历中精确复现两遍式重建的梯度。

Result: 单次遍历即可获得完整记忆梯度，相比 detached-write 训练仅增 7% 更新开销，常驻内存减少 28%，训练周期缩短 20.8%；相比同目标同遍历的 SGF，VBench-Long 美学质量在 60s 提升 6.6 分、240s 提升 8.5 分，主体与背景一致性最优；对残差做 rollout dropout 仍保留大部分增益并恢复运动性。

Conclusion: 显式学习"写入记忆"的表征是提升长时程因果视频生成一致性的有效方向，且可通过可微分缓存以低开销实现。

Abstract: A causal video generator produces two key--value (KV) states for every segment: the KV it uses while denoising that segment, and the KV it writes into the cache for later segments to read. In a pretrained generator the two already differ substantially, later segments attend to them differently, and replacing the written KV with the generation KV degrades the continuation. We propose dKV Forcing (dKV denotes differentiable KV) to learn a dedicated memory representation from its future use: a writer-specific low-rank residual on the shared backbone separates memory writing from generation and is trained through the future reads of what it writes. Learning a write from its future use needs gradients through the cache, which the mutable cache in common use cannot provide. dKV Forcing replaces the training-time cache by persistent differentiable pages with local rematerialization and, in one temporal traversal, computes exactly the gradient that a two-pass reconstruction of the same objective computes. One traversal computes the full memory gradient at $7\%$ generator-update overhead over detached-write training, with $28\%$ less resident memory and $20.8\%$ shorter training cycles than the two-pass reconstruction. Over Self Gradient Forcing (SGF), the same objective trained with the same traversal, writer adaptation raises VBench-Long aesthetic quality by $6.6$ points at 60\,s and $8.5$ points at 240\,s with the highest subject and background consistency, and rollout dropout of the residual keeps most of this gain while restoring the motion of training without write gradients.

</details>


### [166] [GatedVLA with Camera-Based Emergency Braking: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01663)
*Kaneyoshi Hiratsuka,Naoki Takada,Makoto Kawano*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GatedVLA：Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B 驱动预训练 VLM + 逐层 flow-matching 动作专家，输出 2.5s 加速度/曲率序列，并在动作专家交叉注意力上加软视觉掩码；闭环评测配合规则式 AEB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向 Physical AI AV（PAI-AV）赛道，提升 VLA 驾驶策略的闭环表现与安全性，并验证视觉掩码门控对横向转向精度的作用。

Method: 驾驶预训练 VLM（Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B）作主干；layer-wise flow-matching 动作专家生成 2.5 s 时域加速度与曲率控制；在专家 cross-attention 上施加软视觉掩码；部署时叠加规则式自动紧急制动（AEB）。

Result: 开环误差整体相当、左转误差下降；150 场景闭环（每场景 2 次 rollout）平均分 0.479→0.517（配对差 +0.038，95% CI [-0.018,+0.093]，37胜/26负，符号检验 p=0.21）；加 AEB 后升至 0.599（+0.082，CI [+0.023,+0.143]），有责碰撞场景数 34.0→11.0。

Conclusion: 视觉掩码带来一致但非显著的提升；显著的安全增益主要来自规则式 AEB，属工程堆叠而非学习策略单独贡献。

Abstract: This report presents GatedVLA, our entry for the Physical AI AV (PAI-AV) track. Our learned vision-language-action (VLA) policy pairs the driving-pretrained Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B vision-language model with a layer-wise flow-matching action expert that outputs a 2.5 s horizon of acceleration and curvature controls, augmented with a soft visual mask applied to the expert's cross-attention. Compared to an identically trained baseline, the masked policy achieves comparable overall open-loop error while reducing error on left turns. In local closed-loop evaluation across the same 150 scenes (two rollouts per scene), the visual mask increases the mean scene score from 0.479 to 0.517 (paired difference +0.038, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.018, +0.093], wins/losses 37/26, sign test p = 0.21). Incorporating a rule-based automatic emergency braking (AEB) module at deployment further increases the mean score to 0.599 (+0.082, CI [+0.023, +0.143]) and reduces the mean number of scenes with at-fault collisions from 34.0 to 11.0.

</details>


### [167] [MMCoT$^3$: Empowering 3D Scene Understanding with 3D-Text Interleaved Multi-Modal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01676)
*Yongqi Shan,Yifan Wang,Yunzhi Zhuge,Lijun Wang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MMCoT³：首个3D-文本交错思维链框架，将文本推理与任务相关3D证据显式交错，并用量化歧义的跨注意力证据聚合缓解多实例指代歧义，配套176.2K规模PointCoT指令微调数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D大语言模型存在两大瓶颈：(i) 复杂3D场景中缺乏grounded多步推理能力；(ii) 以文本为中心的推理范式使文本推理与视觉证据缺乏有效交互，导致无法校验中间推断、难以区分相似实例、幻觉频发。

Method: 提出3D-Text Interleaved CoT框架：推理过程中显式交替插入任务相关的3D证据（点云观测），使模型可在推理全程查询场景。针对"一个文本指代对应多个候选物体"的多实例歧义，设计ambiguity-aware证据聚合机制，以query-guided cross-attention融合候选物体token，并将证据与歧义线索同时注入推理；此外构建PointCoT——约176.2K实例的3D专用CoT指令微调数据集，覆盖captioning、VQA、对话与规划四类任务。

Result: 在六个基准上一致提升，取得SOTA结果，验证了歧义感知的3D-文本交错推理对3D场景理解的有效性。摘要未给出具体数值与消融规模。

Conclusion: 以"证据交错+歧义感知聚合+3D CoT数据"三者协同，可作为3D场景推理与具身多模态推理链构建的可复用范式；但其为3D场景理解/VQA方向，非VLA或真实机器人闭环，落地到具身导航与操作仍需验证。

Abstract: Understanding and reasoning over 3D scenes from point clouds is essential for a broad range of AI applications. Recent 3D large language models have shown promising results, yet they still face two fundamental limitations: (i) insufficient capability for grounded multi-step reasoning in complex 3D scenes, and (ii) a text-centric inference paradigm that lacks effective interaction between textual reasoning and visual evidence. As a result, these models often fail to verify intermediate inferences, disambiguate similar object instances, and avoid hallucinations. To address these limitations, we propose MMCoT$^3$, the first 3D-Text Interleaved Chain-of-Thought (CoT) framework for 3D scene understanding. The core idea is to explicitly interleave textual reasoning with task-relevant 3D evidence, enabling the model to consult scene observations throughout the reasoning process. In addition, since a textual mention in 3D scenes may correspond to multiple candidate objects, naive object-mention alignment can inject incorrect evidence and mislead subsequent reasoning. To mitigate this multi-instance ambiguity, we design an ambiguity-aware evidence aggregation mechanism that uses query-guided cross-attention to fuse candidate object tokens and inject both evidence and ambiguity cues into the reasoning process. To better equip the model with multi-step reasoning capability, we further develop PointCoT, a large-scale 3D-specific CoT instruction tuning dataset with approximately 176.2K instances spanning captioning, question answering, dialogue, and planning tasks. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that our method consistently improves performance and achieves state-of-the-art results, validating the effectiveness of our proposed ambiguity-aware 3D-text interleaved reasoning for 3D scene understanding.

</details>


### [168] [Leveraging 2D Foundation Priors for Generalized Category Discovery under Test-Time Adaptation in 3D LiDAR Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01682)
*Hanqi Chen,Chaoqi Chen,Tian Ji,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出两阶段GCD-TTA框架用于3D LiDAR语义分割：第一阶段按几何密度自适应聚合局部3D特征并在全局类别原型一致性约束下生成可靠伪标签；第二阶段将新类发现建模为最优传输分配以实现全局一致聚类，并融合2D视觉基础模型语义特征以缓解特征坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶要求LiDAR分割能适应环境变化并识别未见类别，但现有工作将广义类别发现（GCD）与测试时自适应（TTA）分开研究；3D点云语义信息有限，在域偏移下同时做GCD与TTA易发生特征坍缩。

Method: 1）几何密度自适应的局部3D特征聚合 + 全局类别原型一致性约束下的伪标签；2）将类别发现转化为最优传输分配，实现新类全局一致分组；3）融合2D视觉基础模型语义特征与3D点云特征以丰富语义、提升特征可分性。

Result: 在Synth4D→SemanticKITTI、SynLiDAR→SemanticKITTI、Synth4D→nuScenes上验证；统一评测协议下，10个基准划分中9个取得最佳overall mIoU，相对最强复现基线最高提升12.21个点。

Conclusion: 联合建模GCD与TTA并结合2D基础模型语义先验，可有效缓解3D点云域偏移下的特征坍缩，实现跨域新类发现与分割的稳定提升。

Abstract: In autonomous driving, 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation is expected to adapt to evolving environments and recognize previously unseen categories, making generalized category discovery under test-time adaptation (GCD-TTA) an important problem. However, existing works treat GCD and TTA separately, while the limited semantic information in 3D point clouds makes GCD-TTA under domain shift more prone to feature collapse when combining GCD with TTA. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage framework for GCD-TTA in 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation. Specifically, in the first stage, we adaptively aggregate local 3D features according to geometric density variations and obtain reliable pseudo labels under a global class-wise prototype consistency constraint. In the second stage, we cast category discovery as an optimal transport assignment process for globally consistent grouping of novel categories. Meanwhile, semantic features from 2D vision foundation models are fused with 3D point cloud features to enrich 3D semantic information and promote a more separable feature space. Extensive experiments on Synth4D to SemanticKITTI, SynLiDAR to SemanticKITTI, and Synth4D to nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our method achieves the best overall mIoU on 9 out of 10 benchmark splits and improves the overall mIoU by up to 12.21 points over the strongest re-implemented baseline.

</details>


### [169] [GaitFM: A Cross-Modal Foundation Model for Wearable Gait Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01684)
*Yize Cai,Zhiqing Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GaitFM：跨模态步态评估基础模型，将视觉大模型知识迁移到IMU传感器数据，在约4000名参与者、123万个步态窗口上自监督预训练，覆盖18项步态相关任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于可穿戴IMU的深度学习步态评估受限于数据集规模小、设备配置与佩戴位置差异大，模型鲁棒性和跨场景泛化能力差；需要借助大规模无标注数据和跨模态知识迁移缓解传感器/医疗领域的数据稀缺。

Method: 构建跨模态基础模型：从大规模视觉模型迁移知识（视觉-IMU表征对齐），并在多样化临床与日常条件、多种传感器模态与身体部位的无标注IMU数据上自监督预训练；在18个下游任务上做微调/线性探测评估。

Result: 在3个步态参数估计、14个疾病与步态异常检测、1个临床结局预测任务上取得强性能；并能泛化到不同传感器配置与身体部位，包括临床常用配置和日常可穿戴设备。

Conclusion: 视觉知识迁移可有效提升基于传感器的步态评估性能，为传感器与医疗领域的数据稀缺问题提供了新路径；但整体属医疗健康领域的传感器时间序列建模，非机器人/三维视觉核心方向。

Abstract: Gait assessment supports the diagnosis, monitoring, and prognosis of diverse movement-related conditions, such as neurological and musculoskeletal disorders. Recent advances in deep learning using everyday wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs) offer an accessible and low-cost approach to automated gait assessment. However, IMU measurements vary substantially across individuals, body locations, and device configurations, while existing deep learning models are typically developed using small, homogeneous datasets for specific clinical tasks, limiting their robustness and generalizability in diverse real-world contexts. Here we present GaitFM, a cross-modal foundation model for gait assessment using IMU sensors. GaitFM improves the generalizability of gait assessment by transferring knowledge from large vision models and pretraining on unlabeled IMU sensor data. We pretrain GaitFM on a large curated dataset comprising about 4,000 participants and 1.23 million gait windows across diverse clinical and daily conditions, sensor modalities, and body locations. GaitFM demonstrates strong performance across 18 gait-related tasks, including 3 gait parameter estimation tasks, 14 disease and gait abnormality detection tasks, and 1 clinical outcome prediction task. Furthermore, GaitFM generalizes across different sensor configurations and body locations, including those commonly used in clinical settings and everyday wearable devices. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of transferring visual knowledge in improving sensor-based gait assessment performance, offering a new promising pathway for addressing data scarcity in the sensor and medical domains.

</details>


### [170] [SEALECT: Scene-Conditioned Pose Priors for Plausible Maritime Vessel Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01688)
*Faisal Mohammad,Mohamed Younis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SEALECT: 场景条件化的海事目标检索框架，联合建模视觉相似度、场景条件化位姿先验与观测位姿一致性，用于生成式组合增强中的物理合理插入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海事图像中强几何约束（水面、地平线）使纯外观检索产生物理上不合理的船只插入，需在检索阶段显式建模场景几何与位姿兼容性。

Method: 构建海事场景-位姿库；以无参数核函数对位姿与尺度先验做非参数化场景条件建模；统一得分融合神经相似度、场景条件位姿先验与观测位姿一致性三项；训练场景条件检索器。

Result: 七个海事基准上召回率较 SigLIP 2 提升 +0.14；无训练先验以极小召回代价将约束违反减半以上，优于 GALA-style、DiscoFOS 等学习式前景搜索基线；端到端合成盲评（BootPlace + DiffHarmony）中六方法排名第一，与 CLIP/DINO 统计持平。

Conclusion: 将场景几何与位姿先验以非参数方式注入检索评分，可在几乎不牺牲召回的前提下显著提升组合增强的几何合理性，为受限域数据增强提供可复用范式。

Abstract: We address scene-conditioned object retrieval for compositional augmentation in maritime imagery, where strong geometric constraints make appearance-only retrieval produce physically implausible vessel insertions. We propose SEALECT, a retrieval framework that jointly models visual compatibility, vessel pose, scale, and scene geometry through a unified score combining neural similarity, scene-conditioned pose priors, and observed-pose consistency. We construct a maritime scene-pose library and model the pose and scale priors nonparametrically, as a kernel that conditions each prior continuously on the scene with no learned parameters. Across seven maritime benchmarks, our trained scene-conditioned retriever exceeds the strongest appearance encoder (SigLIP 2) in recall (+0.14), and the training-free prior raises geometric plausibility further at negligible recall cost, more than halving the constraint violations of appearance retrieval and outperforming learned foreground-search baselines (GALA-style, DiscoFOS). In a blind study of end-to-end composites (BootPlace placement, DiffHarmony harmonization), SEALECT ranks first among six methods, ahead of random and GALA-style selection and statistically tied with CLIP, DiscoFOS, and DINO.

</details>


### [171] [Restoring Semantic Fidelity for Training-Free High-Resolution Image Generation in Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01696)
*Junjie Li,Zengbin Wang,Gaoxiang Li,Muyi Sun,Yixin Zhang,Man Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的高分辨率文生图框架：用文本-视觉尺度解耦注意力（TVSDA）修复DiT超分辨生成时的语义退化，并用结构-细节引导（SDG）在尺度与时间维度显式建模结构与细节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT文生图模型超出训练分辨率时出现严重语义退化（语义内容消失），已有免训练高分辨率方法只能缓解、无法解决细粒度细节退化；同时常用结构引导方法缺乏对中间轨迹结构与细节的建模。

Method: 1) TVSDA：保持文本token全局感受野，将图像token感受野对齐到训练分辨率，从而在高分辨率下恢复语义生成能力；2) SDG：在尺度维度与时间维度对潜变量轨迹进行显式结构与细节引导，替代传统低分辨率引导。

Result: 大量实验表明，相比现有免训练DiT高分辨率生成方法，在结构一致性与细节保真度上均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 通过对注意力感受野的尺度解耦与轨迹级结构-细节引导，可在无需训练的情况下显著改善DiT超训练分辨率生成的语义退化问题。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based text-to-image models have recently achieved remarkable success in image synthesis. However, when directly applied beyond their training resolution, these models often suffer from severe semantic degradation, where meaningful semantic content disappears. Although existing training-free high-resolution generation methods can mitigate this issue, the inherent semantic degradation at high resolutions remains largely unresolved, leading to degraded fine-grained details. Furthermore, widely used structural guidance methods lack modeling of the structure and details in the intermediate trajectory, which degrades the quality of the generated results. In this paper, we propose a training-free framework for high-resolution image generation to address these challenges. First, we propose a text-visual scale-decoupled attention (TVSDA) module, which restores the model's ability to generate semantically meaningful content at high resolutions by preserving the global receptive field of text tokens while aligning the receptive field of image tokens with the training resolution. Second, we propose a structure-detail guidance (SDG) strategy that explicitly models structural information and fine details through scale-wise and temporal-wise guidance, overcoming the limitations of conventional low-resolution guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves both structural coherence and detail fidelity over existing training-free DiT-based high-resolution generation approaches. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [172] [Fréchet Oral Distance: A Coordinate-Free Metric and Benchmark for Speech-Driven Oral Animation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01705)
*Jaehong Myung,Seungho Eum,Hyunjung Chung,Unsang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Fréchet Oral Distance (FOD)，用 Oral Motion Encoder (OME) 嵌入与 TIMIT-Vis 参考分布计算 Fréchet 距离，作为语音驱动口部/面部动画的客观评价指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音驱动的面部与口部动画已广泛用于教育、言语治疗与医疗等场景，但生成质量缺乏客观、可复现的评价手段，现有方法依赖昂贵设备或主观打分。

Method: 训练 Oral Motion Encoder 提取口部运动嵌入，构建 TIMIT-Vis 参考分布，按 FID 式 Fréchet 距离度量生成结果与真实分布差异。

Result: FOD 复现了与 Lip Vertex Error (LVE) 相近的模型排序，并与用户偏好趋势一致；框架可扩展至多种 2D/3D 模型比较。

Conclusion: FOD 提供无需昂贵设备与主观评估的客观、可复现基准，可推广为通用口部动画评价工具。

Abstract: Recently, speech-driven facial and oral animation technologies have been used in various fields such as education, speech therapy, and healthcare. But methods to objectively evaluate the quality of generated results are still limited. Accordingly, we propose the Fréchet Oral Distance (FOD), which uses embeddings from an Oral Motion Encoder (OME) and a TIMIT-Vis reference distribution. In experiments, FOD reproduced model rankings similar to the coordinate-based metric, Lip Vertex Error (LVE), and showed trends consistent with user preference. Our framework provides objective and reproducible benchmarking without relying on expensive equipment or subjective evaluation, and it can be extended to compare a variety of 2D/3D models.

</details>


### [173] [Deep Learning for Cervical Cytology Screening: Methods, Algorithms, Challenges and Prospects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01730)
*Jiang Yangbo,Zheng Nenggan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于深度学习用于宫颈细胞学筛查的综述：沿数据规模、功能任务、监督方式三轴梳理文献，比较CAISHI等细胞学数据集与公开数据集，指出指标不可比与数据泄漏问题，提出五大挑战与部署决策矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宫颈癌死亡90%以上发生在中低收入国家，细胞病理学医师短缺使传统细胞学筛查受限；深度学习自动化筛查虽日益可行，但文献分散在细胞、图块、全切片等尺度及不同任务与监督范式上，缺乏可比性与临床转化路径。

Method: 叙述性/系统性综述：以数据规模、功能任务、监督方式为三轴组织文献；区分两条临床路线（全切片置信度聚合 vs 细胞级检测+Bethesda分级）；梳理16个公开或有公开文档的细胞学数据集及CAISHI组织病理数据集；对比量化性能并揭示指标不可比与数据泄漏；评估商业系统、监管状态、HPV时代筛查路径与低资源部署。

Result: Herlev与SIPaKMeD上的单细胞准确率已趋于饱和，但这反映基准饱和而非临床就绪；前瞻性与随机对照证据开始出现但仍有限。

Conclusion: 归纳出五大挑战领域（数据与基准、架构与标签高效学习、可信AI、临床转化与卫生经济学、评估与可复现性），给出证据—议程映射与部署决策矩阵；未来进展取决于多中心基准、外部验证的标签高效方法、校准且公平的预测以及务实临床试验，而非在饱和单细胞基准上的继续刷分。

Abstract: Cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer death among women, with more than 90\% of deaths occurring in low- and middle-income countries, where cytology screening is constrained by a shortage of trained cytopathologists. Deep learning has made automated cytology screening increasingly feasible, but the literature is fragmented across cell, patch and whole-slide-image scales, task formulations and supervision regimes, hindering comparison and clinical translation. This Review synthesizes the deep learning literature for cervical cytology screening, organizing the field along three axes---data scale, functional task and supervision---and distinguishing two clinical roadmaps: whole-slide-image confidence aggregation and cell-level detection with Bethesda classification. We examine 16 publicly available or publicly documented cytology datasets alongside the CAISHI histopathology dataset, compare quantitative performance while exposing incomparable metrics and data leakage, and assess commercial systems, regulatory status, HPV-era screening pathways and low-resource deployment. Single-cell accuracy on Herlev and SIPaKMeD has plateaued, but this reflects benchmark saturation rather than clinical readiness; prospective and randomized evidence is emerging but remains limited. We consolidate the evidence into five challenge areas---data and benchmarks, architecture and label-efficient learning, trustworthy AI, clinical translation and health economics, and evaluation and reproducibility---and provide an evidence-to-agenda map and a deployment decision matrix. Progress now depends on multi-center benchmarks, externally validated label-efficient methods, calibrated and fair predictions, and pragmatic clinical trials rather than further gains on saturated single-cell benchmarks.

</details>


### [174] [RSI-Env: An Open-Ended Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01736)
*Wanying Qu,Zhiyuan Fan,Jiyao Liu,Jiang Zhou,Jianghan Shen,Yanwei Fu,Dongrui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RSI-Env 提出一个持久化环境，支持"模型+harness"协同的递归自我改进：独立 Host Controller 负责服务、评测与版本管理，被接受的版本接管下一轮改进；在三种目标设定下与固定外部 Teacher 对比七个任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有递归自我改进（RSI）研究常限制优化目标、可编辑组件或评测流程，导致开放式探索受限、跨代连续性不足。

Method: 构建 RSI-Env 持久环境：支持自主训练、harness 修改与研究状态保留；外部 Host Controller 管理服务/评测/版本；每个被接受的模型-harness 版本接管下一轮（Self）。设定 Open-General、Capability-Directed、Benchmark-Guided 三种目标具体度与基准反馈可得性不同的设置，与两个固定外部 Teacher 在七个任务上比较，初始模型 Qwen3-27B 配极简 harness。

Result: Open-General Self 在无基准反馈下将 GPQA Diamond 从 65.2% 提到 73.2%、AIME 2026 从 53.3% 提到 56.7%；三个 Capability-Directed Self 运行均获得目标对齐增益；Knowledge Self 跨版本持续提升，SimpleQA 由 82.0%→85.0%→88.0%；基准引导与 Teacher 的收益随任务而异。

Conclusion: RSI-Env 在所研究的运行中支持开放式探索与持续递归改进，但跨能力保持增益仍是挑战。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) envisions agent systems that autonomously improve their own models and harnesses, with each updated system continuing to improve itself. Existing approaches typically restrict optimization objectives, editable components, or evaluation procedures, limiting open-ended exploration and continuity across generations. We introduce RSI-Env, a persistent environment for coordinated model-harness improvement, supporting autonomous training, harness modification, and retention of research state. An independent Host Controller manages services, evaluation, and versioning. Under Self, each accepted model-harness version takes over the next improvement round. We define three settings that vary goal specificity and access to benchmark feedback: Open-General, Capability-Directed, and Benchmark-Guided. Across these three settings, we compare Self with two fixed external Teachers on seven tasks, starting from Qwen3.8-27B with a minimal harness. Without benchmark feedback, Open-General Self raises GPQA Diamond accuracy from 65.2% to 73.2% and AIME 2026 accuracy from 53.3% to 56.7%. All three Capability-Directed Self runs achieve target-aligned gains. Knowledge Self demonstrates continued improvement across system updates, with SimpleQA accuracy rising from 82.0% to 85.0% and then 88.0%. Benchmark guidance and Teacher benefits vary by task. These results demonstrate RSI-Env's support for open-ended exploration and sustained recursive improvement within the studied runs, while highlighting challenges in preserving gains across capabilities.

</details>


### [175] [Teleoperation System for Service Robots using Virtual Reality Headset and Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01759)
*Eduardo Fernandes,Tiago Ribeiro,Antonio Ribeiro,Carolina Lopes,Gil Lopes,Fernando Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 整合Mediapipe 2D姿态估计与RealSense D455 RGB-D数据实现3D人体姿态估计，映射至CHARMIE服务机器人运动学，并通过VR界面实现沉浸式遥操作与抓取任务验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务机器人需要直观、低门槛的遥操作方式；传统手柄/示教方式不自然且缺乏情境感知，故希望以人体自身动作为控制信号并结合VR提供第一人称沉浸视角。

Method: Mediapipe做2D关键点检测，融合RGB-D深度恢复3D人体姿态；设计实时关节角计算算法，将人体关节角映射到机器人关节空间/运动学；搭建VR头显界面提供机器人视角的沉浸反馈。

Result: 在CHARMIE服务机器人上完成真实物体操作实验，验证系统可行性；但腕部偏航等关节角估计不准，人-机器人运动映射精度有限，需要IMU补充旋转跟踪。

Conclusion: RGB-D+Mediapipe+VR的遥操作框架对服务机器人具有实用潜力，但需引入IMU与更先进控制算法提升旋转跟踪与映射精度。

Abstract: This paper presents a teleoperation system for service robots that integrates human pose estimation with virtual reality (VR) to enable intuitive remote control. By using the Mediapipe framework for 2D pose detection and extending it with RGB-D data from the Intel RealSense D455 camera, a comprehensive 3D human pose estimation is achieved. This data is then mapped to the robot's kinematics, allowing the operator to control the robot's movements naturally. A VR interface was developed to provide an immersive perspective, enhancing the operator's situational awareness. Real-world experiments were conducted using the CHARMIE service robot to validate the system's effectiveness in tasks involving object manipulation. While the current system successfully demonstrates the potential of VR-based teleoperation, challenges remain in accurately capturing certain joint angles (e.g., wrist yaw) and ensuring precise mapping between human and robot movements. Future work includes the integration of inertial measurement units (IMUs) for improved rotational tracking and the implementation of more advanced control algorithms. Overall, this research contributes to the development of more intuitive and effective teleoperation systems for service robots, facilitating their deployment in complex and dynamic environments. This work further introduces a novel approach to teleoperation by combining RGB-D sensing with an innovative algorithm for real-time joint angle computation using Mediapipe, enhancing the precision of human-robot motion mapping and enabling immersive control through a VR interface. These contributions represent significant advancements in the field of human-robot interaction, particularly for service robot applications.

</details>


### [176] [FinishStrong: Learning to End Well after Imperfect Start in Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01765)
*Yuda Zou,Boxiang Zhou,Xin Zhou,Yibo Chen,Dejia Song,Xu Tang,Yao Hu,Yongchao Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现自回归视频时序定位模型存在"端点性能不对称"（尾点预测明显弱于起点），将劣质起点视为不可逆的"sunk loss"，提出两阶段后训练框架 FinishStrong：Online-start SFT 暴露模型自身生成的起点上下文，Conditional-tree GRPO 在同一首帧分支内隔离末端奖励以度量条件最优性；在 TimeLens-Bench 上达 61.7% 整体 IoU，SOTA，且在不完美起点接续时末端误差降低 36.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频时序定位中模型系统性出现"端点不对称"：结尾预测质量显著差于起始预测。一旦起点预测有偏差（实际不可回溯），可达重叠上限被永久压低，形成 sunk loss；此时模型真正应学的是"最小化剩余条件后悔"。然而标准后训练范式无法教会这种适应：teacher-forcing SFT 存在严格前缀暴露偏差，标准 GRPO 的整条轨迹奖励会因起点误差而连带惩罚"条件最优"的结尾选择，产生错误梯度信号。

Method: 两阶段后训练框架 FinishStrong：(1) Online-start SFT——使用模型自回归生成的（而非 ground-truth）起点作为上下文来监督结尾预测，缓解前缀暴露偏差；(2) Conditional-tree GRPO——重构采样拓扑为以同一首帧为根的树形分支，将末端奖励限定在同一首帧分支内做组内归一化，从而在数学上把"条件结尾质量"与"继承的起点惩罚"解耦，使策略梯度只反映在后继条件下的最优性。

Result: FinishStrong-9B 在 TimeLens-Bench 上取得 61.7% 总体 IoU 的 SOTA，超过 Gemini-3.8-Flash、Qwen3.8-Max 等旗舰闭源模型；在被迫从非完美起点续接时，后续末端预测误差下降 36.5%，验证了"劣质起点后仍能收尾良好"的能力。代码将开源。

Conclusion: 将时序定位的端点误差分解为不可逆起点损失与可优化的条件结尾损失，是更合理的优化目标；通过在线起点 SFT 与条件树 GRPO 分别解决暴露偏差与奖励错配，可显著提升结尾质量，并具备向其他自回归结构化输出任务迁移的潜力。

Abstract: A poor start lowers the ceiling, but does not negate the value of finishing well. In autoregressive video temporal grounding, models systematically exhibit an endpoint performance asymmetry, predicting ends significantly worse than starts. A committed flawed start acts as an immutable physical constraint, irreversibly capping the attainable overlap as a sunk loss. While models should minimize the remaining conditional regret, standard post-training paradigms fail to teach this adaptation. Specifically, teacher-forced SFT suffers from strict prefix exposure bias, and holistic trajectory evaluation in standard GRPO inadvertently penalizes conditionally optimal ends if they follow a poor start. To address this, we introduce FinishStrong, a novel two-stage post-training framework explicitly designed to teach optimal continuations. First, Online-start SFT exposes the end prediction to the model's own generated contexts. Second, Conditional-tree GRPO restructures the sampling topology, centering end rewards exclusively within the same-start branch to mathematically isolate the conditional end quality from the inherited start penalty. FinishStrong-9B achieves a state-of-the-art 61.7\% overall IoU on TimeLens-Bench, remarkably outperforming flagship closed-source models like Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-Max. Crucially, when forced to continue from imperfect starts, it reduces the subsequent end prediction error by 36.5\%, proving its exceptional ability to end well after flawed starts. Code will be open.

</details>


### [177] [OCBI: Order-Sensitive Cross-Branch Interaction for Image Manipulation Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01783)
*Zhouli Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OCBI，在 Co-Transformers 骨架上用交叉注意力与自注意力算子的对易子建模两种组合顺序的特征差异，以可学习符号校正增强篡改定位，多个数据集上 PixelF1 小幅优于重训基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像篡改定位需同时利用语义结构与取证痕迹。同一分支内的空间混合与 RGB 引导的跨分支混合在交换组合顺序时会产生不同信息，这一顺序不一致性此前未被显式建模利用。

Method: 在 Co-Transformers 扩展框架 OCBI 中：(1) 局部跨分支融合模块以 RGB 引导交叉注意力与取证自注意力的对易子（交换子）为输入，为特征迁移加上可学习的带符号修正项；(2) 像素级自适应多尺度聚合在预测前融合空间上下文；(3) 沿用 Co-Transformers 主干与监督方式。

Result: 在仅用 CASIA 训练、50 epoch、末轮评估的设定下，五个干净测试集的宏平均 PixelF1 为 0.5773，比重训 Co-Transformers 基线高 0.43 个百分点；在三个数据集上施加 JPEG 压缩、高斯模糊与缩放共 21 种条件，平均 PixelF1 提升 0.95 个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式建模跨分支算子非交换性可带来稳定但幅度有限的定位增益，且在常见后处理扰动下更为明显；属图像取证专用方法，与机器人/3D 生成方向关联较弱。

Abstract: Image manipulation localization combines semantic structure with forensic traces to identify modified pixels. Within-branch spatial mixing and RGB-guided cross-branch mixing can produce different messages when composed in opposite orders. We propose OCBI, an extension of Co-Transformers that models the discrepancy between these two composition orders for localization. A local cross-branch fusion module uses the commutator of RGB-guided cross-attention and forensic self-attention to add a learnable signed correction to feature transfer. Pixelwise adaptive multiscale aggregation then combines spatial contexts before prediction. OCBI uses the Co-Transformers backbone and supervision. We compare OCBI with retrained Co-Transformers using CASIA-only task training, a 50-epoch budget, and final-epoch evaluation. Across five clean test datasets, OCBI achieves a macro PixelF1 of 0.5773, exceeding the baseline by 0.43 percentage points. Under JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resizing on three datasets, its average PixelF1 over 21 dataset-transformation conditions exceeds the baseline by 0.95 percentage points.

</details>


### [178] [Detection Instead of Inversion: T1-T2 Microstructure Quantification With Detection Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01790)
*Sebastian Endt,Fatih Özkan,Marion I. Menzel*

Main category: cs.CV
