TL;DR: 将T1-T2相关MRI的体素谱反演重构为"目标检测"任务：用DETR从64个TI/TE信号直接预测一组(T1, T2, signal fraction)组分，避免病态且耗时的逆拉普拉斯变换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统逐体素T1-T2全谱重建依赖病态、耗时的逆拉普拉斯变换（ILT），既慢又不稳定；作者希望绕开显式生物模型与ILT，直接获得稀疏的微结构组分描述。

Method: 把组分集合视为"被检测对象"：输入64维TI/TE衰减信号，用DETR式集合预测（解码器输出固定长度的组分查询，配合匈牙利匹配做置换不变监督）直接回归每个组分的T1、T2与信号占比，并自然处理组分数量可变；与正则化NNLS和先前自研模型对比。

Result: 仿真数据上mAP@10达76.8%，优于先前模型（53.8%）与正则化NNLS（66.1%）；在组分数量、组分信号占比、SNR的几乎全部设置下均优于NNLS；重建速度比NNLS快数个数量级；代码公开可复现。

Conclusion: 集合预测式检测框架可作为ILT的高效替代，用于无模型约束的T1-T2微结构定量；目前证据仅限仿真，尚需体内/实测数据验证。

Abstract: T1-T2 correlation MRI has strong potential to quantify microstructural compartments without imposing a biological model. Traditionally, full T1-T2 spectra per voxel are reconstructed with an ill-conditioned and time-consuming Inverse Laplace Transform. We propose to view this challenge as an object detection task: A Detection Transformer (DETR) takes 64 TI/TE signals and directly predicts a set of compartments specified by T1, T2, and signal fraction. We achieve a mean average precision mAP@10 of 76.8% on simulated data, outperforming both our previous model design (53.8%) and regularized NNLS (66.1%). We show that our DETR approach outperforms NNLS in almost every setting across compartment count, compartmental signal fraction, and SNR. Reconstruction is orders of magnitude faster than NNLS. The results are fully reproducible from our public code: this http URL

</details>


### [179] [RIFT: Residual-Informed Flow Transfer for One-Step Generative Video Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01791)
*Qizhe Wang,Jiaye Fu,Feng Ye,Haocheng Tang,Zetian Song,Chuanmin Jia,Siwei Ma,Jiaqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RIFT：利用"残差几何诱导器"将预训练流匹配预测转化为内容自适应的一步式复原更新，显式对齐压缩残差的方向与幅度，实现单步生成式视频压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式视频压缩直接用退化强度标定流匹配的时间步，但压缩导致的退化与预训练流模型的扰动轨迹存在方向性失配：不同码率下的压缩潜变量高度对齐，而其复原残差在幅度和方向上差异显著，仅靠时间步标定无法弥合该 gap。

Method: 提出 Residual Geometry Inducer (RGI)，利用解码器可见的编解码线索学习全频带残差强度估计，并将流时间步条件与内容条件的方向/增益调制结合，把预训练流预测改写为内容自适应的复原更新；整体框架支持一步生成式解码。

Result: 在三个公开视频压缩基准上优于现有生成式视频压缩方法，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 指出压缩依赖的方向性失配这一关键问题，并以残差几何对齐的方式修正流匹配先验，为一步式生成式视频压缩提供了有效且可复用的思路；对物理 AI / 3D 重建等核心方向属间接相关。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generation have enabled generative video compression to reconstruct details lost during coding using pretrained spatiotemporal priors. However, a substantial gap remains between codec-induced degradation and the perturbation trajectories learned by flow-matching models. In this paper, we identify a compression-dependent directional mismatch that degradation-strength-based timestep calibration alone cannot resolve. Compressed latents remain strongly aligned across codec operating points, while their reconstruction residuals vary substantially in magnitude and direction. To bridge this gap, we propose RIFT, a Residual-Informed Flow Transfer framework for one-step generative video compression. At its core, RIFT introduces a Residual Geometry Inducer (RGI) that converts the pretrained flow prediction into a content-adaptive restoration update using decoder-visible codec cues. RGI integrates flow-timestep conditioning with a learned full-band residual-strength estimate and content-conditioned direction and gain modulation, aligning the orientation and magnitude of the update with the compression-dependent residual geometry. Extensive experiments on three public video compression benchmarks show that RIFT outperforms competing generative video compression methods. The code is publicly available on RIFT.

</details>


### [180] [When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01815)
*Anton Hristov,Aleksandar Slavov,Vasil Vasilev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出评估框架，区分冻结表征所含信息、表征几何组织方式、以及模型自身预测误差的变化，用IntPhys2/Physion++/Kubric检验视频世界模型的"物理surprise"，发现原生预测误差不能可靠度量物理违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作把视频世界模型的预测误差直接当作"物理惊讶"信号，但误差同样可能来自外观、静态内容、运动或普通的预测难度，缺乏对表征内容与误差来源的解耦评估。

Method: 构建三层评估框架：(1)冻结表征线性探测（潜空间预测、掩码像素重建、简单视觉统计），(2)潜空间几何分析（外观变化相对视频间差异的幅度、跨场景方向一致性、与物理变化的子空间重叠随层深变化），(3)干预式误差测试（错误动作、单帧重复、全片改色、不可能事件）。数据：IntPhys2、Physion++、Kubric渲染。

Result: 外观信息始终易解码，V-JEPA2仅含中等程度的"可能/不可能"信息；深层中外观变化幅度相对视频间差异变小、方向更一致、与物理变化重叠降低；动作条件模型中错误动作增大误差，但外观变化同样显著抬升误差；Physion++中重复单帧误差高于原视频、全片改色可降低误差；Kubric中不可能事件误差可低于可能事件；固定误差阈值误判大量可能事件。

Conclusion: 模型可以编码物理信息并响应错误动作，但其原生预测误差并非可靠的物理惊讶度量；直接以误差阈值做物理合理性判定不可行，需分离表征与误差诊断。

Abstract: Prediction errors from video world models are often treated as physical surprise, but they can also reflect appearance, static content, motion, or ordinary prediction difficulty. We present an evaluation framework that separates what frozen representations contain, how they organize appearance and physical differences, and what changes a model's own prediction error. On IntPhys2, a benchmark of physically possible and impossible events, we compare representations from latent prediction, masked pixel reconstruction, and simple visual statistics. Appearance remains easy to decode, while V-JEPA2 exposes modest information about whether events are possible or impossible. Looking at the latent geometry, appearance changes become smaller compared with differences between videos, their directions line up more consistently across scenes, and their overlap with physical changes decreases in deeper layers. Across action-conditioned models, incorrect actions raise prediction error, while appearance changes also produce substantial responses. In Physion++ video clips, repeating a single frame can produce higher error than the original clip, while changing color throughout the clip can lower it. Using Kubric, a simulation and rendering framework, we find that impossible events can produce lower error than possible events. A fixed error threshold also incorrectly flags many possible events as impossible. A model can therefore represent physical information and respond to incorrect actions without its native prediction error reliably measuring physical surprise.

</details>


### [181] [RCFormer: Reliability-aware Context Transformer for Occlusion-Robust Facial Landmark Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01822)
*Ashish Kumar,Prashant Kumar,Mallika Garg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RCFormer，用三个可靠性导向组件（可见性条件化VCC、可见性引导聚合VGCA、空间残差校正SRC）增强遮挡场景下的隐空间patch恢复，将恢复的heatmap作为结构线索供现有人脸关键点网络使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遮挡、弱光和大姿态下人脸局部证据不完整或误导性强，现有上下文引导的隐空间patch恢复方法在上下文弱适配、邻域patch被污染、融合破坏局部空间一致性时仍不可靠。

Method: RCFormer：可见性加权的全局人脸摘要来条件化上下文表示；在attention中按可见性降低不可靠源patch的权重；用邻域patch信息残差校正融合后的隐特征；恢复的heatmap作为结构线索接入已有landmark检测网络。

Result: 在WFLW、COFW、300W上heatmap恢复质量提升，关键点定位结果良好；摘要未给出具体数值或与SOTA的定量对比。

Conclusion: 可靠性感知的上下文恢复是提升遮挡鲁棒人脸关键点检测的有效路径，且可作为即插即用模块增强现有检测器。

Abstract: Facial landmark detection has advanced substantially under regular imaging conditions, yet occlusion, poor illumination, and large pose changes remain major sources of error because local facial evidence can become incomplete or misleading. Context-guided latent patch recovery offers a promising way to address this issue by inferring unreliable patch representations from surrounding facial context before heatmap prediction. However, the recovered context can itself be unreliable when it is weakly adapted to the input face, influenced by corrupted neighboring patches, or blended without preserving local spatial coherence. We propose RCFormer, a Reliability-aware Context Transformer for occlusion-robust facial landmark detection. RCFormer strengthens latent patch recovery with three reliability-oriented components: visible-context conditioning (VCC), which adapts the context representation using a visibility-weighted global facial summary; visibility-guided context aggregation (VGCA), which reduces the influence of unreliable source patches during attention; and spatial residual correction (SRC), which refines blended latent features using neighboring patch information. The recovered heatmaps are then used as reliability-aware structural cues for existing landmark detection networks. Experiments show that RCFormer improves heatmap recovery and achieves strong landmark localization results on the WFLW, COFW, and 300W datasets.

</details>


### [182] [LUMEN: Geometry-Guided Diffusion Model for Spatially-Varying HDR Illumination Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01823)
*Hongze Chen,Fangyu Lin,Runze Zhang,Lingting Zhu,Weikai Chen,Zeyu Hu,Yingda Yin,Keyang Luo,Xin Wang,Zehong Lin,Jun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LUMEN：以扩散式生成框架替代回归，从单/多视图图像在任意空间位置合成HDR环境图，实现空间一致的光照估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间变化光照估计方法依赖回归或参数化模型，先求局部环境图/探针表示再拟合，导致光照过度平滑、真实感不足，难以刻画由几何、遮挡和光源造成的剧烈空间变化。

Method: 从输入图像重建粗3D场景，在任意位置渲染部分环境图以编码可见性与空间结构；将这些几何信号与多视图图像特征融合，输入Diffusion Transformer直接生成完整HDR环境图。同时构建含700个室内场景的合成数据集，提供多视图RGB、深度及多采样位置HDR光照的稠密空间监督。

Result: 实验表明相较既有方法，LUMEN在视觉保真度和空间一致性上均有显著提升，缓解了过度平滑问题。

Conclusion: 将空间变化光照估计重构为几何条件化的生成任务，配合稠密空间监督数据，可获得更真实且空间自洽的HDR光照估计；可作为逆向渲染、场景合成与具身仿真中光照先验的组件。

Abstract: Estimating scene illumination from images is challenging as lighting is inherently spatially varying, depending on geometry, occlusion, and light sources. Existing methods incorporate geometric cues by deriving local environment maps or probe-based representations, but largely rely on regression or parametric models, resulting in over-smoothed lighting and limited realism. We revisit spatially-varying illumination estimation from a generative perspective and introduce LUMEN, a geometry-conditioned diffusion framework for synthesizing high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps at arbitrary spatial locations from single or multi-view images. Specifically, we reconstruct a coarse 3D scene from input images and render partial environment maps at arbitrary locations to encode visibility and spatial structure. These signals are fused with multi-view image features and fed into a diffusion transformer to generate full HDR environment maps. To train the model, we build a synthetic dataset of 700 indoor scenes with dense spatial supervision, including multi-view RGB images, depth, and HDR illumination at multiple sampled locations. This dataset enables the model to learn spatially consistent lighting distributions across diverse scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LUMEN significantly improves visual fidelity and spatial coherence compared to prior approaches.

</details>


### [183] [Z-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers via Self-Reflection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01846)
*Zegang Cheng,Zhikai Wang,Jiacheng Liu,Xiaobing Tu,Chang Zou,Junjie Chen,Yue Ma,Zhiyuan Ma,Jinkui Ren,Likai Zou,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Z-Cache：基于"自反思"的特征缓存加速扩散Transformer。先预测未来缓存步特征，再执行一次全计算，然后回到缓存步用之前和当前计算步重新预测以修正特征，实现质量无损加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer是视觉生成最强模型但计算开销巨大；现有特征缓存复用历史步特征可大幅加速，却导致生成质量下降。观察发现缓存误差在每次全计算后会急剧减小，可借此设计纠错机制。

Method: 提出Z-Cache特征缓存：在缓存阶段先预测未来步特征并执行一次全计算（"自反思"），再返回缓存步，利用前后两次计算步的参考重新预测特征，从而对缓存特征进行校正。

Result: 在扩散Transformer上达到与原模型相当的生成质量，同时推理更快，例如FLUX-dev文生图实现6.22倍加速；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过"预测-全计算-回退重预测"的自反思调度，可显著降低特征缓存误差，实现高质量、高效率的扩散模型推理加速。

Abstract: Diffusion transformers have become the most powerful models for visual generation, but still suffer from massive computation costs. To solve this problem, feature caching has been proposed to cache the features of diffusion models in the previous computation steps and then reuse them in the following caching steps, which brings significant acceleration but also degradation in generation quality. To address this problem, this paper proposes Z-cache as a feature caching method that can maintain high-quality generation through self-reflection. Concretely, we observe that the error from feature caching tends to be sharply reduced after each full computation. Based on this observation, Z-Cache is designed to first predict the features in the future caching steps and then perform a full computation. After that, Z-Cache returns to the caching steps and re-predicts them based on the previous and the current computation steps, which brings correction in features. Experiments demonstrate that with Z-Cache, diffusion transformers achieve comparable generation quality to the original model but with faster inference speed, for instance, 6.22X acceleration on FLUX-dev for text-to-image generation. Our code is released on GitHub.

</details>


### [184] [Biological Congruence: Evaluating Microscopy Generation Across Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01850)
*Duway Nicolas Lesmes-Leon,Shumpei Takezaki,Fabian Schmeisser,Ryoma Bise,Gillian Lovell,Bianca Migliori,Andreas Dengel,Sheraz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"生物一致性"(biological congruence)评价原则，用文本条件扩散模型联合生成显微图像与实例掩码，在提示-掩码、提示-图像、图像-掩码及群体层面检验生成数据中生物信息是否跨表征自洽且与真实生物语境一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成显微图像的评估主要刻画视觉保真度与分布覆盖度，无法反映合成数据所承载的生物学信息是否真实、自洽；缺乏一个衡量"科学信息层面"生成质量的评价视角。

Method: 构建文本条件扩散框架，同时生成显微图像与实例掩码，使同一"生成生物状态"通过文本条件、视觉外观、实例结构三种表征暴露；随后做四类分析：prompt–mask、prompt–image、image–mask 一致性，以及群体级分布保真度；并做"越来越缺乏真实支持的表型组合"压力测试。

Result: 表现强烈依赖于具体特征：密度与汇合度(confluency)被一致保留；形态学(morphology)反复出现不一致；最近邻距离分析显示图像–掩码高度一致可与较弱条件控制、较弱群体保真度并存。压力测试中发现目标属性可控性上升，但同时非目标表型发生重组，整体生成状态向真实数据更支持的构型偏移。

Conclusion: 生成质量、可控性、跨表征一致性与群体保真度是互补而非可替代的性质，应将"生物一致性"作为关系型评价视角用于科学生成模型的评估。

Abstract: Generative models increasingly produce realistic microscopy images, yet conventional evaluation primarily characterizes visual fidelity and distributional coverage rather than the biological information represented by synthetic data. We introduce biological congruence as an evaluation principle describing whether biologically relevant information forms a coherent description across representations and remains consistent with its empirical biological context. To study this principle, we develop a text-conditioned diffusion framework that jointly generates microscopy images and instance masks, exposing the same generated biological state through conditioning, visual appearance, and instance structure. Across prompt--mask, prompt--image, image--mask, and population-level analyses, we find strongly feature-dependent behavior: density and confluency are consistently preserved, morphology exhibits recurrent disagreement, while nearest-neighbor distance reveals that strong image--mask agreement can coexist with weaker conditioning and population fidelity. Stress testing increasingly unsupported phenotype combinations further shows that target controllability can increase while untargeted phenotypes reorganize and the complete generated state moves toward configurations better supported by real data. These findings demonstrate that generative quality, controllability, cross-representation agreement, and population fidelity capture complementary properties, motivating biological congruence as a relational perspective for evaluating scientific generative models.

</details>


### [185] [Learning-to-Memorize: Dynamic Context Management for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01858)
*Haowei Zhu,Qijie Wang,Jia Li,Xing Wang,Tianyu Zhao,Jiexi Wang,Xurui Peng,Xinglong Wu,Junhai Yong,Bin Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Learning to Memorize (L2M)，一个可学习的自回归视频生成上下文记忆管理框架，通过重要性路由、退化感知训练和 EMA 演化的动态记忆，在固定 KV-cache 预算下动态保留/淘汰/更新历史帧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成长程生成受误差累积困扰，现有静态上下文管理（滑动窗口丢弃早期帧、固定 sink 帧永久保留初始内容）要么丢失长程上下文，要么把生成锚定在过时信息上，导致保真度下降、运动停滞和多样性退化。

Method: 重要性预测路由估计每个历史帧的相关性；退化感知训练提升对噪声/损坏上下文的鲁棒性；基于 EMA 重要性分数的动态记忆初始化与演化机制，使高质量帧替换陈旧锚点；采用教师-学生蒸馏目标与稀疏正则化训练，在固定 KV-cache 预算下高效利用上下文。

Result: 大量实验表明 L2M 在长时程视频生成质量与时间一致性上优于现有基线（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

Conclusion: L2M 为长序列自回归视频生成的上下文记忆管理提供了一种可学习策略，替代静态缓存规则并适配场景演化，但属通用生成方法，与具身/3D 重建核心区关联较弱。

Abstract: Autoregressive video generation has achieved impressive results on short clips, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to error accumulation over extended horizons, where each predicted frame depends on potentially imperfect previous frames. Existing approaches typically rely on static context management strategies, such as sliding-window caches that discard early frames or fixed sink frames that permanently preserve initial content. These designs either lose critical long-range context or anchor generation to outdated information, which can lead to degraded fidelity, motion stagnation, and reduced diversity. In this paper, we propose Learning to Memorize (L2M), a learned context memory management framework that dynamically retains, evicts, and evolves historical frames according to predicted importance. The framework consists of an importance prediction router that estimates the relevance of each historical frame, degradation-aware training that improves robustness to noisy or corrupted context, and a dynamic memory initialization and evolution mechanism that updates long-term memory using exponential moving average (EMA) importance scores. This allows high-quality frames to replace stale anchors and enables memory to adapt naturally to scene evolution. Trained with a teacher-student distillation objective and sparsity regularization, L2M makes efficient use of a fixed KV-cache budget while preserving the most informative contextual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that L2M improves long-horizon video generation quality and temporal consistency over existing baselines, providing a learned strategy for context memory management in long autoregressive video generation.

</details>


### [186] [Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01860)
*Hengyu Liu,Jihyeon Je,Ruiqi Wang,Mingxuan Wu,Haven Feng,Qixing Huang,Georgios Pavlakos,Hao Zhang,Jiajun Wu,Maneesh Agrawala,Leonidas Guibas,R. Kenny Jones,Shangzhe Wu,Guandao Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 agentic graphics 领域的统一分类体系，并构建一个 agentic 文献分析系统以大规模辅助研究者梳理论文；进而总结研究趋势与开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体可生成并迭代改进图形代码，催生"智能体图形学"新范式；该方向任务繁多、术语不统一，人工综述难以跟上进展。

Method: 1) 构建跨图形任务的智能体系统统一分类法（taxonomy）；2) 开发基于智能体的文献分析系统，自动/半自动地大规模解析新旧论文。

Result: 据所给摘要，未报告定量实验或性能结果；产出为分类框架与文献分析系统，以及趋势分析与开放挑战讨论（智能体—工具协同、人机协作接口与表示、长程规划与精化、交互式图形系统的可靠评测）。

Conclusion: 该报告定位为综述/框架类工作，为 agentic graphics 提供系统化梳理工具与研究方向指引，但无具体方法创新与实证验证。

Abstract: Computer graphics is built on code. Large language model (LLM) agents can now generate graphics code and iteratively refine it through various feedback. This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks. Over the past years, research on agentic graphics has expanded rapidly across a diverse range of tasks. This rapid growth makes it increasingly difficult for manual literature reviews to keep pace with new developments. At the same time, similar ideas are often described using different terminology across these tasks, further complicating efforts to develop a systematic understanding of the field. In this report, we address these challenges through two contributions. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy for characterizing agentic systems across diverse computer graphics tasks. Second, we develop an agentic literature system that can assist human researchers in analyzing existing and newly published papers at scale. Building on these contributions, we analyze emerging research trends and discuss open challenges in coordinating agents and tools across graphics tasks, designing interfaces and representations for human-agent collaboration, sustaining long-horizon planning and refinement, and reliably evaluating interactive graphics systems.

</details>


### [187] [Prior-Guided Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Fast 4D MRI Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01888)
*Mojtaba Safari,Parag J. Parikh,Shansong Wang,Mingzhe Hu,Philip Connell,Stanley L. Liauw,Ralph R. Weichselbaum,Zhen Tian,Xiaofeng Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PGPI4MR：一种先验引导、物理信息驱动的展开式深度网络，用初始化扫描（setup scan）或相邻呼吸相位信息重建4D MRI（16个呼吸相位）和亚秒级单帧3D MRI，无需额外扫描时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D MRI在MR引导放疗中需要运动监测与治疗计划，但现有重建（压缩感知、已有4D网络）在短扫描时间下误差大、重建慢，且不能在不增加扫描时间的前提下提升精度。

Method: 展开式（unrolled）网络，结合物理数据一致性模型与先验引导；用setup scan（同一扫描前30 s）或跨相位耦合作为先验；从60/30/15 s数据重建16个呼吸相位，及从0.29–0.49 s数据重建单帧3D体积；在志愿者外部数据上一次性训练，不针对新志愿者重训。

Result: 在三家数据集（1.5T MR-linac自由呼吸、3T腹部、1.5T大腿加压）实测k空间上，4D MRI在所有扫描时长下留出误差最低；16相位联合重建使60 s数据误差较逐相位重建降低9.1%；0.49 s亚秒重建误差比最佳对比方法（同先验的经典重建）低15.5%；较快GPU上0.29 s窗口可在0.5 s内完成采集+重建；未重训时在3T腹部匹配最佳方法、大腿数据不佳，重训后误差降低6.6%。

Conclusion: 先验引导的物理信息展开网络可在数秒内、无额外扫描时间下比压缩感知和已发表4D网络更准确地重建4D与亚秒MRI，有望支撑MR引导放疗中的4D成像与3D运动监测；但域外泛化（大腿扫描）需重训。

Abstract: Background and purpose: We propose PGPI4MR (prior-guided, physics-informed 4D MRI reconstruction), a deep learning method that leverages information from other respiratory phases or a setup scan, the first 30 s of the same scan, to improve 4D MRI reconstruction without extra scan time. Materials and methods: PGPI4MR is an unrolled network that reconstructs 16 respiratory phases from 60, 30, or 15 s of data, and single 3D volumes, each from 0.29-0.49 s of data, using a setup-scan image. The networks were trained once, on other volunteers, and were not retrained for new volunteers. We evaluated PGPI4MR on measured k-space from three datasets: free-breathing MR-linac (1.5T) and abdominal (3T) scans, and thigh scans with cuff compression (1.5T). All methods, including comparative models, received identical samples and were scored similarly. Results: In vivo, PGPI4MR had the lowest held-out error for 4D MRI at every scan time, and its 16 phases were ready a median of 7.5-13 s after the scan on the 2 GPUs tested. Coupling the 16 respiratory phases reduced the error at 60 s by 9.1% compared with reconstructing each phase alone. For sub-second MRI, the error at 0.49 s was 15.5% lower than that of the best comparison method, classical reconstruction toward the same prior, and on the faster GPU, every 0.29 s window was acquired and reconstructed within 0.5 s. Without retraining, PGPI4MR matched the best methods on the 3T abdominal scans but not on the thigh scans; after retraining on thigh data, it reduced the held-out error by 6.6% relative to the best comparison method. Conclusion: Prior information allowed PGPI4MR to reconstruct 4D and sub-second MRI more accurately than compressed sensing and a published 4D network, within seconds and without extra scan time. This could support 4D MRI for treatment planning and 3D motion monitoring during MR-guided radiotherapy.

</details>


### [188] [Systematic Evaluation of Robustness in Fine-tuned Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01900)
*Angela John,Hamayoon Behmanush*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 系统评估不同预训练模型（ResNet50/DenseNet/MobileNet）经不同数据集微调后，在多种攻击下的鲁棒性差异，并给出选型参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帮助研究者在图像分类任务中选择预训练模型时，权衡鲁棒性、算力、内存与干净数据精度。

Method: 用权重微调多个预训练模型，在MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100、SVHN上分别评估攻击前与多种攻击后的表现。

Result: 微调后模型的鲁棒性随数据分布与样本规模变化；ResNet50、DenseNet、MobileNet 在各数据集上抗攻击表现存在明显差异。

Conclusion: 需按具体任务需求定制化选择预训练模型，研究为真实场景图像分类选型提供经验性参考。

Abstract: Our study systematically evaluates the robustness of fine-tuned pre-trained models across different datasets and attack types, aiming to provide insights for researchers in selecting pre-trained models for image classification tasks while prioritizing robustness against potential attacks. Our work explores the influence of fine-tuning pre-trained models with different datasets and attack types on their robustness and overview of the appropriate pre-trained model for image classification based on factors such as computation resources, memory usage, and accuracy on clean data. We fine-tune the models with weights. Evaluate the models on data before any attack and after different attack cases. The study utilizes publicly available image datasets such as MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and SVHN to assess the robustness of pre-trained models. The results indicate that the robustness of fine-tuned models varies across different data distributions and sample sizes, emphasizing the need for tailored selection based on specific task requirements. The findings also highlight the varying performance of ResNet50, DenseNet, and MobileNet in defending against attacks on different datasets. Overall, this research provides valuable insights into the robustness of fine-tuned pre-trained models and their suitability for real-world applications in image classification.

</details>


### [189] [Training-Free Motion-Corrected 3D Brain MRI Reconstruction via Event-Guided References](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01902)
*Wei Jiang,Hongli Chen,Tianyi Ding,Feng Liu,Nan Ye,Hongfu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出训练-free的EventMC，通过检测运动事件并用稳定区间重建的参考图估计运动，再由低到高空间频率迭代细化图像与运动，用于交错笛卡尔采样的3D脑MRI运动伪影校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 头动导致3D脑MRI伪影并偏置结构测量。基于模型的校正交替进行图像与运动估计，但重建参考图中的伪影会强化运动误差；学习式先验虽能减轻伪影，却需预训练并增加测试时计算。

Method: EventMC为免训练方法：迭代检测运动事件，仅在稳定区间重建参考图并据此估计运动参数；随后以由低频到高频的顺序联合细化图像与运动估计，适配交错笛卡尔采集。

Result: 同等重建条件下的仿真对比中，运动估计使平均PSNR较学习式MotionTTT最高提升4.0 dB；单次运行最快为MotionTTT的7.5倍，GPU显存占用不到一半；在体运动破坏扫描上，无需任何训练即可达到与MotionTTT相近的平均图像质量。

Conclusion: 事件引导的稳定区间参考重建+频率渐进细化是一种有效的免训练运动校正策略，在精度、速度与显存上优于学习式基线，适用于临床MRI后处理。

Abstract: Head motion causes artefacts in 3D brain MRI and can bias structural measurements. Model-based correction alternates between image and motion estimation, but artefacts in the reconstructed reference can reinforce motion errors. Learned priors can reduce these artefacts but require pretraining and may add test-time computation. We propose EventMC (event-guided motion correction), a training-free method for interleaved Cartesian acquisitions. It iteratively detects motion events and estimates motion using reference images reconstructed from stable intervals. It then refines the image and motion from low to high spatial frequencies. In a fair comparison in simulation (same reconstruction), EventMC's motion estimates improve mean PSNR by up to 4.0 dB over those of the learning-based MotionTTT. A single run of EventMC is up to 7.5 times faster than MotionTTT with less than half the GPU memory. On in vivo motion-corrupted scans, EventMC achieves similar mean image quality to MotionTTT without any training. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [190] [Online Active Learning Architecture for Safety-Critical Control Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01907)
*Shuiwen Shen,Jinhua Zhang,Yan Wang,Huanqiang Zeng,Yueyun Xu,Song Gao,Haifeng Xiang,Yifu Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Control AI 架构：受生物"预测-评估-纠正"回路启发的在线主动学习（OAL）框架，融合深度网络分层表征与自适应控制的实时误差反馈，以预测残差作为内部学习信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离线训练范式在开放世界环境中难以支撑信息型 AI 进入安全关键应用，缺乏在线、实时的误差反馈自适应能力。

Method: 构建"预测模型（感知→潜流形）+ 可选潜空间转移模型 + 重构模型（潜状态→可观测信号）"三元结构；以预测-测量的残差作为内部学习信号；采用空间与时间交叉重构结构避免退化到恒等映射；提供耦合、对偶、局部化三类变体以缩短误差传递路径；以 guidance-backpropagation 与 target-backpropagation 实现局部化预测编码式 OAL，并给出混合与规模化变体以支持高维部署。

Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅给出架构论证与从概念反馈回路到大规模实用配置的演进路径。

Conclusion: 该文属概念性/架构性论述，核心价值在于为在线主动学习提供局部化预测编码的统一设计原则；缺乏实证验证，可迁移性待补。

Abstract: The transition of information-centric artificial intelligence to safety-critical applications is impeded by the limitations of conventional offline-training paradigms in open-world environments. This paper presents Control AI, an architecture for Online Active Learning (OAL) inspired by the continuous Prediction-Evaluation-Correction process of biological intelligence. The framework combines the hierarchical representation capacity of deep neural networks with the real-time error-feedback adaptation of adaptive control. A prediction model maps sensory input into a latent manifold, an optional latent model represents transitions in that space, and a reconstruction model maps the latent state back to observable signals. Residuals between predictions and measurements provide the internal learning signal. Spatial and temporal cross-reconstruction architectures prevent OAL from collapsing to a trivial identity mapping, while coupled, dual, and localized variants shorten error-transmission paths. Localized predictive coding style OAL is implemented through guidance-backpropagation and target-backpropagation architectures, and hybrid and scaled variants support high-dimensional deployment. The paper focuses on the architectural rationale and the progression from a conceptual feedback loop to practical large-scale configurations.

</details>


### [191] [SurgQ-VLM: Question-Conditioned Dual-Stream Compression and Answer-Type-Aware Reinforcement for Surgical Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01913)
*Dhruv Makwana,Ananya Mantravadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurgQ-VLM：两阶段手术视频问答模型，阶段一用问题条件化的慢/快双流压缩器（视觉 token 压缩 49x），阶段二用答案类型感知奖励的 GRPO 后训练，统一处理五类异构答案结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术视觉问答多基于单帧与封闭标签，无法表达时长、顺序、计数；视频模型对所有片段做统一压缩、忽略问题条件性，丢失时间证据；且答案结构异构（二分类/分类/多标签/计数/句-时间），缺乏统一训练信号。

Method: Stage 1：LoRA 微调的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上接问题条件化双流（slow/fast）压缩器，交叉注意力使两路均以问题为条件，clip 视觉 token 从原始 ViT patch 压缩 49x（相对 post-merge backbone token 为 11x）。Stage 2：GRPO 后训练，采用答案类型感知奖励——标签集用 micro-F1、计数用归一化误差、时间窗用内容-时间混合分。

Result: 在 Cholec80 与 CholecT50 的 21,840 题密封测试集上达 0.779 keyword accuracy，BLEU-4 较 zero-shot 提升 10x；GRPO 带来 +2.5pp K-Acc（其中 2.0pp 归因于答案类型感知奖励），增益集中在结构困难类型，答案格式（ROUGE-L）不变。

Conclusion: 问题条件化压缩 + 答案类型感知的 GRPO 奖励能有效统一异构答案结构的手术视频问答，显著优于零样本基线，为手术文档、流程分析与技能评估提供可行方案。

Abstract: Reasoning about surgical video -- which phase is underway, which instruments act, and when events occur -- underpins operative documentation, workflow analysis, and skill assessment. Yet surgical visual question answering is still largely built on single frames and closed labels that cannot express a duration, an ordering, or a count, and the video models that lift the frame limit typically compress every clip the same way regardless of the question, discarding the temporal evidence the answer needs. Worse, the answers are structurally heterogeneous, spanning five incompatible structures -- binary, classification, multi-label, counting, and sentence-temporal -- that no single training signal scores uniformly well. We propose SurgQ-VLM, a two-stage model for surgical video question answering. Stage 1 trains a question-conditioned dual-stream (slow/fast) compressor for a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B: cross-attention conditions both streams on the question, and each clip's visual tokens shrink 49x from the raw ViT patches (11x vs. post-merge backbone tokens). Stage 2 post-trains with GRPO under an answer-type-aware reward that scores each question on the metric matching its answer structure (micro-F1 for label sets, normalised error for counts, a content-timing blend for temporal windows). On a sealed 21,840-question test split over Cholec80 and CholecT50, SurgQ-VLM reaches 0.779 keyword accuracy and a 10x BLEU-4 gain over zero-shot; GRPO adds 2.5 pp K-Acc (2.0 pp attributable to the answer-type-aware reward), concentrated in the structurally hard types, with answer format unchanged (ROUGE-L). Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [192] [Vision-language classification of Torsades de Pointes risk from pseudo-coloured ECG images: do T-wave morphology and colour context help or hinder?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01921)
*Dario Labrador Alonso,Alaa Alahmadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在BiomedCLIP上将ECG渲染为彩色增强图像，交叉四种上下文提示策略与四种T波形态标签集，零样本不可用，彩色渲染显著优于无色（MCC 0.437 vs 0.311），且增益来自图像渲染而非提示词中的颜色描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有"上下文提示提升视觉模型性能"的证据多来自属性同时出现在提示与图像中的混淆型基准，无法区分两个通道的贡献；作者要在语义复杂的生物医学信号分类任务上厘清上下文（提示）与渲染方式各自的真实作用。

Method: 基于先前工作将ECG信号用QT-nomogram与伪彩色渲染为彩色增强图像以标记尖端扭转型室速风险；以领域适配的视觉语言模型BiomedCLIP为骨干，将4种上下文策略×4种T波形态标签集交叉组合，在9,789张图像上以五折分层交叉验证，分别评估零样本与类别平衡线性探针。

Result: 零样本推理不可用；训练后彩色增强图像在所有指标上优于无色图像：平衡准确率0.903 vs 0.825、敏感度0.914 vs 0.827、特异度0.892 vs 0.823、ROC-AUC 0.955 vs 0.888、MCC 0.437 vs 0.311。交叉设计可分离混淆通道：图像贡献+0.126 MCC（+0.078平衡准确率、+0.067 ROC-AUC），与提示是否提及颜色无关；提示提及颜色在任何指标下均无影响。上下文是双刃剑：最佳提示集在有颜色时增益0.008 MCC、无颜色时0.016；最差提示集分别损失0.017与0.013。

Conclusion: 对以图像呈现的信号而言，性能杠杆在于信号如何被绘制（渲染/伪彩色编码）而非如何被文字描述；当终点是区间型测量时，用T波形态命名的提示实际上描述了错误的量，提示设计需与任务目标量对齐。

Abstract: Contextual prompting is widely presented as a cheap route to better performance from vision models, but the evidence comes largely from benchmarks in which an attribute named in a prompt is also present in the image, confounding the two channels. We investigate the significance of context for a semantically complex biomedical signal classification task using a domain-adapted vision-language model, BiomedCLIP. Building on our previous work that renders electrocardiogram (ECG) signals as colour-enhanced images to flag Torsades de Pointes risk using the QT-nomogram and pseudo-colouring technique, we cross four context strategies with four T-wave morphology label sets, evaluated zero-shot and with a class-balanced linear probe, under five-fold stratified cross-validation on 9,789 images. Zero-shot inference is unusable. Once trained, the colour-enhanced images outperform the colourless ones on every metric: balanced accuracy 0.903 versus 0.825, sensitivity 0.914 versus 0.827, specificity 0.892 versus 0.823, ROC-AUC 0.955 versus 0.888 and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) 0.437 versus 0.311. Crossing colour-in-image with colour-in-prompt separates the confounded channels: the image contributes +0.126 MCC (+0.078 balanced accuracy, +0.067 ROC-AUC) whether or not the prompt names colour, whereas naming it changes nothing under any metric. Context is two-sided: the best prompt set gains 0.008 MCC where colour is present and 0.016 where it is not, while the worst loses 0.017 and 0.013. For a signal rendered as an image, the leverage lies in how the signal is drawn rather than in how it is described - and where the endpoint is an interval measurement, prompts naming T-wave morphology describe the wrong quantity.

</details>


### [193] [Spade-SLAM: Sparse Correspondence Anchors for Dense Self-Supervised Visual SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01937)
*Julian Philipp Schmitt,Weirong Chen,Ganlin Zhang,Felix Wimbauer,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Spade-SLAM：自监督稠密视觉SLAM框架，通过"稀疏-稠密"互补训练机制（光度warping损失提供稠密监督 + 特征匹配稀疏对应损失抑制漂移），在零样本设置下大幅缩小与监督方法的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督稠密视觉SLAM长期落后于依赖真值位姿与深度标签的监督方法，而标签获取成本高；作者希望证明无需显式GT位姿/深度也能实现高保真跟踪，从而提供标签高效且有效的替代方案。

Method: 核心为互补的稀疏到稠密训练范式：稠密侧使用基于warping的光度损失提供稠密训练信号；稀疏侧引入由图像特征匹配导出的稀疏对应损失，用于稳定优化并抑制歧义区域的漂移。

Result: 大量实验显示Spade-SLAM相比现有自监督基线在鲁棒性与精度上显著提升，性能接近使用显式位姿与深度监督训练的SLAM系统。

Conclusion: 提出自监督稠密SLAM的有效训练策略，验证了无GT位姿/深度标签条件下高保真跟踪的可行性，缩小了与监督方法在零样本场景下的性能差距，且承诺开源。

Abstract: We introduce Spade-SLAM, a self-supervised dense visual SLAM framework that substantially narrows the long-standing performance gap to supervised methods in a zero-shot setting. By demonstrating that high-fidelity tracking can be achieved without explicit ground-truth pose and depth labels, our approach offers a highly effective and label-efficient alternative to fully supervised pretraining. Our core contribution is a complementary sparse-to-dense training regime: While a warping-based photometric loss provides a dense training signal, we stabilize the optimization and suppress drift in ambiguous regions using a sparse correspondence loss derived from image feature matches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Spade-SLAM significantly improves robustness and accuracy compared to existing self-supervised baselines, closely rivaling SLAM systems trained with explicit pose and depth supervision. The code will be made publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [194] [VLSplat: Vision-Language Guided Object-Centric 3D Gaussian Splatting via Scene Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01939)
*Yuntae Jeon,Younho Jeon,Sujin Jin,Sungho Jo,Seunghee Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VLSplat：利用视觉-语言模型提供对象级语义先验，并通过对象组场景图上的组内精化与组间获取两个语言引导模块，改进3D高斯泼溅中基于掩码的对象级语义提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有2D到3D语义提升主要依赖2D分割监督，缺乏对象级先验，导致学到的语义表征由局部掩码证据驱动，而非整体对象结构，语义一致性与结构完整性不足。

Method: 在掩码提升基础上引入VLM导出的对象级语义先验；构建对象组场景图，包含两个语言引导模块：组内精化（抑制对象组内语义噪声）与组间获取（从结构相关的邻接组扩充对象支撑区域）。

Result: 在室内场景数据集上的实验表明，VLSplat提升了对象级类别的语义一致性与结构完整性；代码与模型已开源。

Conclusion: 结合视觉-语言先验与场景图结构先验可有效改善3DGS对象级语义场的质量，对机器人场景理解等下游任务具有潜在价值。

Abstract: Learning semantic representations for 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising direction for 3D scene understanding. However, existing 2D-to-3D semantic lifting approaches rely primarily on 2D segmentation supervision and lack object-level priors, causing the learned representation to be driven by local mask evidence rather than holistic object structure. In this paper, we present VLSplat, a vision-language guided approach for object-centric semantic lifting in 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method augments mask-based lifting with object-level semantic priors derived from vision-language models and refines Gaussian representations using an object-group scene graph. The refinement is performed through two language-guided modules: intra-group refinement suppresses semantic noise within object groups, while inter-group acquisition expands object support regions by incorporating structurally relevant candidates from neighboring groups. Extensive experiments on indoor scene datasets demonstrate that VLSplat improves the semantic consistency and structural completeness of object-level categories. Our code and models are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [195] [Event-Based Optical Flow Constraint via Time-Sliced Plane Fitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01960)
*Masaki Koike,Yusuke Kameda,Shunichi Sato,Takayuki Hamamoto*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将平面近似扩展到时间轴，提出可建模时变运动的事件光流约束，配合子区间两步近似、空间补偿与时域正则，提升事件光流精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于事件的平面/平面近似光流方法假设速度恒定，会把时间上的速度变化平均掉，限制了对真实动态运动的建模能力。

Method: 沿时间轴扩展平面近似：将时空体划分为子区间，采用两步平面近似以保持边缘跟踪一致性；提出事件光流约束使变分光流框架可建模时变运动；并引入空间补偿机制与时域正则项分别补偿边缘位移和稳定估计。

Result: 实验表明建模时间运动变化相比常规方法提升了光流估计精度。

Conclusion: 通过在时空维度上的平面近似扩展，事件光流可有效刻画时变运动，为事件相机变分光流提供更准确的约束形式。

Abstract: Event-based optical flow estimation using spatiotemporal planar approximation inherently assumes constant velocity and tends to average out temporal velocity variations. In this paper, we propose a flow estimation method that extends this planar approximation along the temporal axis. The resulting event-based optical flow constraint allows existing variational optical flow formulations to model temporal motion variation. Specifically, we partition the space-time volume into sub-intervals and apply a two-step planar approximation to track object edges consistently. Moreover, a spatial compensation mechanism and a temporal regularization term are incorporated to compensate for edge displacements and temporally stabilize the flow estimation, respectively. The experimental results show that modeling temporal motion variation improves flow estimation accuracy over conventional methods.

</details>


### [196] [Object-Only Is Not Context-Free: A Counterfactual Diagnostic for Context Removal in Object Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01962)
*Boaz Meivar,Shai Avidan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Keyhole Aperture Probe (KAP) 反事实诊断，固定池化物体区域、仅改变区域外像素来量化骨干网络的上下文依赖；发现"纯物体描述子"仍内嵌场景信息，并可借轻量适配器降低该依赖、提升检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以掩码抹除背景后再池化特征、构建"物体专属"描述子，是物体检索流水线的常见做法，但该描述子是否真正与场景无关极少被检验。

Method: 利用现成分割数据集（COCO、ADE20K）的 GT 掩码构造反事实探针：保持池化物体区域不变，仅替换外部上下文（中性填充、其他真实场景），以单一指标刻画骨干的上下文依赖；并在 10 个现代骨干（含 Transformer 与卷积）上评测；进一步设计轻量适配器使描述子对上下文移除保持稳定，并与匹配的对比式微调对照实验比较。

Result: 池化物体区域已整合周边信息，替换上下文即改变描述子；空白填充导致检索失败时，描述子更匹配纯背景图像而非自身物体。十个骨干的物体专属描述子仅保留全图精度约 1/4 至 2/3；卷积骨干同样存在该依赖。适配器降低依赖并在 INSTRE 提升全图实例检索，迁移到 ILIAS 亦提升或保持精度，而对比式微调对照未复现此增益。

Conclusion: "物体专属"并非"上下文无关"；KAP 作为骨干无关的评测协议，可在部署前度量并降低该依赖，同时提供了可迁移的缓解方法。

Abstract: Object-centric retrieval pipelines often mask the background before pooling backbone features, aiming for a descriptor that reflects the object rather than its scene. Whether this truly yields an object-only descriptor, however, is rarely tested. We introduce the Keyhole Aperture Probe (KAP), a counterfactual diagnostic that repurposes the ground-truth masks of existing panoptic segmentation datasets (COCO, ADE20K) for retrieval: it holds the pooled object region fixed and varies only the pixels outside it, summarizing a backbone's context dependence in a single number. We find that the pooled object region has already integrated its surround. Replacing the context, with a neutral fill or even a different real scene, changes the descriptor, and when retrieval fails under a blank fill, the descriptor matches plain-background images rather than its own object. Object-only is not context-free. Across ten modern backbones, object-only descriptors retain only about a quarter to two-thirds of their full-image accuracy, and the effect is not unique to Transformer self-attention: a convolutional backbone shows it too. The dependence is also reducible: a lightweight adapter that encourages the descriptor to stay stable as context is removed lowers it and improves full-image instance retrieval on INSTRE, transferring to ILIAS with accuracy improved or preserved. A matched contrastive-fine-tuning control does not reproduce those gains. We release KAP as a simple, backbone-agnostic evaluation protocol to measure and reduce this dependence before deployment.

</details>


### [197] [Knowledge-Guided Floodwater Level Reasoning for Cloud-Edge Collaborative Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01970)
*Zhengshu Zhou,Shaoyu Wang,Ziyi Geng,Lu Tao,Qian Long*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 HydroReasoner：将积水水位检测重构为显式视觉推理任务，基于 Qwen2.5-VL + GRPO 训练，用领域知识图谱 HydroKG 的路径奖励做细粒度推理监督；4-bit 量化实现云边协同部署，并提出置信度路由机制，构建 HydroLevel 数据集（3000 张）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市积水威胁智能交通系统安全与效率。现有视觉检测方法缺乏显式推理，导致性能差、可解释性弱，且难以泛化到不同视角的复杂道路场景。

Method: 以 Qwen2.5-VL 为基座，用 GRPO 强化学习训练推理链；构建积水领域知识图谱 HydroKG，通过确定性图遍历设计知识图谱路径奖励，对推理过程做细粒度监督；边缘端采用 4-bit 量化；提出基于置信度的云边路由机制；自建 HydroLevel 基准数据集（3000 图）。

Result: 域内与域外检测精度分别比常规视觉基线高 4.0 和 13.6 个百分点，域外性能仅下降 4.4 个百分点；4-bit 量化使显存降低 57%、推理延迟降低 43%，域外精度仅损失 0.2 个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式推理 + 知识图谱奖励可显著提升积水水位检测的可解释性与跨域泛化，量化与云边路由使系统具备实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Frequent urban floodwater poses a serious threat to the safety and efficiency of intelligent transportation systems. Existing vision-based methods for floodwater level detection face two main limitations. First, the lack of explicit reasoning leads to poor detection performance and little interpretability. Second, these methods struggle to generalize to the complex and varied real-world road scenes seen from different viewpoints. To address this, we reformulate the task as an explicit visual reasoning problem and propose HydroReasoner, a floodwater level reasoning framework designed for cloud-edge collaboration. HydroReasoner builds on Qwen2.5-VL and is trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization. To address the scarcity of reasoning process annotations, we build a floodwater domain knowledge graph HydroKG and design a novel KG path reward. Through deterministic graph traversal over HydroKG, this reward supervises the model's reasoning process at a fine granularity, which improves both reasoning and generalization. For edge deployment, we apply 4-bit quantization to the model, cutting GPU memory usage by 57% and inference latency by 43% while out-of-domain accuracy drops by only 0.2 percentage points. We also propose a confidence-based cloud-edge routing mechanism, which improves system safety and eases the computational load on the cloud. In addition, we build HydroLevel, a floodwater benchmark dataset of 3,000 images, for training and evaluating the model. Experimental results show that HydroReasoner achieves detection accuracy 4.0 and 13.6 percentage points higher than conventional vision baselines in the in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations respectively, with performance dropping by only 4.4 percentage points out of domain.

</details>


### [198] [MUPA${}^2$S: Multimodal Unified Perception with Asymmetric Attention for Stress Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01974)
*Stefanos Gkikas,Thomas Kassiotis,Yu Fang,Christian Arzate Cruz,Miao Cheng,Zongyi Jiang,Zacharias Kamarianakis,Houshyar Asadi,Randy Gomez,Raul Fernandez Rojas,Giorgos Giannakakis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MUPA²S多模态压力评估框架，将面部视频与ECG信号映射到共享token表示，用分段局部交叉注意力+全局自注意力的非对称注意力处理，在58人数据集上视频69.44%、统一融合69.58%且仅约特征级融合一半参数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 压力是长期身心健康衰退的主要诱因，自动压力评估可支持持续监测并减少人工主观偏差；但生理与行为信号异质性强，多模态系统开发困难，且现有特征级融合未必有效。

Method: 统一感知架构：无模态专属模块地将面部视频与ECG映射为共享token表示；采用非对称注意力，即段内局部交叉注意力与跨段状态全局自注意力；在新采集58人压力数据集上按分层被试级协议评测，并对比特征级融合与单模态基线。

Result: 面部视频测试准确率69.44%；仅ECG在该表示下接近随机水平；统一Video-ECG融合达69.58%，参数量约为特征级融合的一半且计算开销几乎不增；特征级融合不超过视频单模态基线。

Conclusion: 输入级统一token融合是参数高效、计算低廉的联合处理框架，优于特征级融合；但ECG单独判别力弱，融合增益有限，主要贡献在架构与效率层面。

Abstract: Stress is a leading contributor to long-term physical and mental health decline. The automatic assessment of stress is a promising approach for continuous monitoring and mitigating human biases. However, the development of automated systems remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of physiological and behavioral signals. This paper presents MUPA${}^2$S, a multimodal framework for automatic stress assessment that combines facial video and ECG signals within a unified perception architecture. Both modalities are mapped into a shared token representation without modality-specific components, and processed through asymmetric attention comprising segment-local cross-attention and global self-attention across segment states. Experiments on a newly collected 58-subject stress dataset, evaluated under a stratified subject-level protocol, show that facial video achieves 69.44% test accuracy, while ECG-only performance remains close to chance under the proposed representation. Unified Video-ECG fusion achieves a test accuracy of 69.58% at approximately half the number of parameters of feature-level fusion, with negligible additional computational cost. Feature-level fusion does not exceed the video-only baseline, while unified input-level integration provides a parameter-efficient mechanism for jointly processing the two modalities.

</details>


### [199] [Multimodal BVP and Respiration for Automated Pain Recognition with Hankel-FCN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01978)
*Valentina Becchetti,Muhammad Umar Khan,Stefanos Gkikas,Alessandro Giuseppi,Raul Fernandez Rojas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于AI4Pain数据集的多模态生理信号疼痛识别框架：用Hankel矩阵嵌入将BVP与呼吸信号转为轨迹表示，经模态专属全卷积网络处理并后期融合，实现三分类疼痛评估（准确率67.09%，F1 66.41%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疼痛的主观性与动态性使自动化疼痛识别困难；希望借助自主神经对伤害性刺激的互补响应（血容量脉冲与呼吸）实现无需手工特征的客观评估。

Method: 对BVP与RESP信号做Hankel矩阵嵌入以显式建模时序动态，形成结构化轨迹表示；分别输入模态特定的全卷积网络，输出经late fusion整合，完成No/Low/High三分类。

Result: 准确率67.09%、F1 66.41%，与现有方法相当；多模态融合显著优于单模态，Hankel嵌入呈现进一步提升趋势；无手工特征工程。

Conclusion: 方法在受限数据集上取得竞争性结果，但泛化到更广泛人群与临床场景仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Automated pain recognition is a fundamental challenge for the advancement of clinical care and empathetic human-computer interaction, due to the subjective and dynamic nature of pain. In this study, we propose a deep learning framework for objective pain assessment based on multimodal physiological signals from the AI4Pain dataset. The approach focuses on Blood Volume Pulse (BVP) and Respiration (RESP), capturing complementary aspects of autonomic responses to nociceptive stimulation. To explicitly model their temporal dynamics, the signals are transformed into structured trajectory representations using Hankel matrix embeddings, enabling the learning of dynamical patterns beyond conventional time-series representations. These embeddings are processed by modality-specific Fully Convolutional Networks, and their outputs are integrated through a late fusion strategy for three-class classification (No Pain, Low Pain, High Pain). Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an accuracy of 67.09% and an F1-score of 66.41%, providing competitive performance compared to existing approaches, while relying on no handcrafted feature engineering. Multimodal fusion significantly outperformed either modality alone, and the Hankel embedding showed a trend towards further improvement. Further validation is required to establish generalisability to broader populations and clinical settings.

</details>


### [200] [SurgStream: A Workflow-Anchored Proactive Streaming Framework and Benchmark for Real-Time Surgical Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01982)
*Ruipeng Ma,Qing Xu,Jie Liang,Zhen Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurgStream：面向实时手术视频理解的工作流锚定主动流式框架，含结构化记忆模块WAM、截止期感知的转移学习DTL及11.7K交互基准SurgStream-Bench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以在流式手术视频中同时保留过程证据并决定何时响应，实时辅助需要在临床关键时点前主动输出。

Method: Workflow-Anchored Memory（WAM）记录器械-动作-目标的结结构化观测并折叠为阶段级摘要，形成紧凑可查询记忆；Deadline-aware Transition Learning（DTL）在临床时间窗内监督响应状态，实现截止期前的及时响应；构建SurgStream-Bench（11.7K流式交互，覆盖实时感知、回溯记忆查询、前向主动QA、主动告警、字幕记忆）。

Result: 在SurgStream-Bench上相对SOTA取得提升，尤其在记忆与前向主动QA任务上表现突出。

Conclusion: 工作流锚定+截止期感知监督为流式手术视频的主动理解提供了可行范式，但缺少真实临床部署与开源验证。

Abstract: Surgical video understanding is essential for intraoperative assistance such as workflow monitoring, instrument preparation and procedural documentation. Delivering such assistance in real time requires a model to jointly perceive the ongoing scene, remember past surgical events, and respond before clinically relevant moments pass. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly retaining procedural evidence and deciding when to respond in streaming surgical video. In this work, we propose SurgStream, a workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework for real-time surgical video understanding. We first introduce Workflow-Anchored Memory (WAM) to record structured instrument-action-target observations and fold them into phase-level summaries, providing compact and queryable surgical memory. Deadline-aware Transition Learning (DTL) is then devised to supervise response states within clinical windows, enabling timely responses before procedural deadlines. We further introduce SurgStream-Bench, comprising 11.7K streaming interactions across various tasks covering real-time perception, backward memory queries, forward proactive QA, proactive alerts and caption memory. Experiments on SurgStream-Bench show gains over state-of-the-art methods, especially in memory and forward proactive QA. The source code will be available.

</details>


### [201] [Synthetic Realities: Evaluating Human Ability to Distinguish AIGenerated Videos from Real Footage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01990)
*Danyal Sarfraz,Raja Mubashar Karim,KwanMyung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究系统比较三种 AI 视频生成方式（文生视频、图生视频动画、视频外扩）在三个主题语境（历史影像、影视内容、自然环境）下的人类辨识准确率，揭示检测成功率取决于"生成方式×内容主题"的联合效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式 AI 已使高保真视频合成具备多条路径，但缺乏未经训练的普通观众对各类合成视频与真实素材的并排感知与辨别能力的系统性实证评估。

Method: 构建均衡刺激集：真实与 AI 视频各 18 条，AI 片段在三种生成方法间均分（Veo 3、LTX Video、Wan VACE），全部在 ComfyUI 中统一生成与标准化以控制质量与时长；87 名被试对全部片段做二选一强制判断（真实 vs. AI 生成）；采用准确率统计与逻辑回归（技术×主题及其交互）分析。

Result: 平均正确识别率 60%；图生视频最易识破（79%），其次为真实素材（64%）、外扩（49%）、文生视频（43%）；影视与历史场景检测率高于自然场景（后者常被误判为 AI）；逻辑回归确认生成方式、主题及其交互均显著（p<0.001）。

Conclusion: 受众存在偏向假设内容为合成的系统性偏差；AI 视频的感知真实性更多由语境而非模型类型决定，强调媒介素养教育与语境感知型评测工具的必要性。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative AI have enabled multiple pathways for high-fidelity video synthesis: text-to-video, image-to-video animation, and video outpainting. Empirical side-by-side evaluations of how untrained viewers perceive and distinguish these outputs from real footage remain scarce. In this study, we systematically compare human detection accuracy across these three AI generation techniques within three thematic contexts: historical footage, film and media content, and natural environments. We constructed a balanced stimulus set comprising equal amounts of real and AI-generated videos (18 each). The AI clips were evenly distributed across the three generation methods using Google's Veo 3, Lightricks LTX Video, and Wan VACE. All videos were produced and standardized within the ComfyUI framework to ensure consistent quality and duration. 87 participants judged every clip in a binary forced-choice task ("real" vs. "AI-generated"). Participants correctly identified videos 60% of the time on average. Image-to-video clips were recognized most accurately (79%), followed by real footage (64%), outpainting (49%), and text-to-video (43%). Accuracy also varied by theme: film and historical scenes yielded higher detection rates than environmental clips, which were frequently mistaken for AI. Logistic regression confirmed significant effects of both technique and theme as well as their interaction (p < 0.001), indicating that detection success depends jointly on how the content was generated and what it depicts. Findings reveal a consistent bias toward assuming synthetic origins and highlight that perceptual realism in AI video is shaped more by context than by model type, underscoring the importance of media-literacy approaches and context-aware evaluation tools for navigating increasingly synthetic visual media.

</details>


### [202] [NAS-PO: Native Attention-Strategy Policy Optimization for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02008)
*Ke An,Shizhe Xiang,Yue Liu,Liang Chen,Pei Fu,Shaojie Zhang,Xiaoxing Hu,Yupei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NAS-PO：用模型原生注意力作为路由信号来做RLVR的信用分配与损失对齐，替代图像扰动/掩码等间接视觉依赖代理，提升VLM视觉根基化推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RLVR对所有权重相同的结果奖励，忽略感知相关性；现有感知感知方法依赖图像扰动或掩码间接估计视觉依赖，需额外扰动分支，且"对损坏敏感"未必等于"实际用于推理的视觉证据"。

Method: 提出NAS-PO框架：（1）Visual Mass Policy量化视觉注意力分配；（2）Conditional Visual Policy刻画视觉token上的空间路由，使优化良定义；（3）NAS-AS利用visual-mass policy为视觉参与度高的rollout重分配带符号的策略梯度信用；（4）自适应注意力耦合（AAC）损失在全部响应token上对齐visual-mass策略、在视觉活跃token上对齐条件视觉策略，固化成功轨迹的视觉路由模式。

Result: 在7个域外推理与感知基准上显著超越领先的RL微调VLM，8B与32B规模均验证有效；Visual-Routing Sensitivity分析显示优化后的注意力更集中于视觉承载区域。

Conclusion: 原生注意力可作为内在、无需扰动分支的信用分配信号用于RLVR后训练，注意力策略化可兼顾可解释性与优化目标。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training paradigm for vision-language models (VLMs). Standard RLVR, however, assigns identical outcome-derived credit to all generated tokens regardless of their perceptual relevance. Recent perception-aware methods estimate visual reliance through image perturbation or masking. These indirect proxies require perturbation branches, while corruption sensitivity does not necessarily identify the visual evidence used for reasoning. We instead shape model perception through native attention, an intrinsic model signal. Rather than treating attention as a post-hoc explanation, we formulate it as a reward-anchored, token-aligned routing signal that encourages attention patterns supporting visually grounded reasoning. To this end, we propose NAS-PO, a Native Attention-Strategy Policy Optimization framework. NAS-PO analyzes native attention with a visual mass policy that quantifies visual allocation and a conditional visual policy that captures spatial routing over visual tokens, making the optimization well-posed. Based on this, Native Attention-Strategy Advantage Shaping (NAS-AS) draws on the visual-mass policy to redistribute signed policy-gradient credit for visually engaged rollouts. The Adaptive Attention-Coupled (AAC) loss then aligns the visual-mass policy on all response tokens and the conditional visual policy on visually active ones, consolidating the visual-routing patterns that drive successful trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that NAS-PO substantially surpasses leading RL-tuned VLMs across 7 out-of-domain reasoning and perception benchmarks, with its effectiveness consistently validated across 8B and 32B. Visual-Routing Sensitivity (VRS) analysis further indicates that the optimized attention prioritizes visually load-bearing regions.

</details>


### [203] [Reconstruction as Spatial Evaluation: Diagnosing Cross-View Spatial Intelligence in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02026)
*Junfei Wu,Qiuyue Wang,Xuhong Huang,Qihang Peng,Mingsheng Li,Jian Guan,Qiang Liu,Shu Wu,Liang Wang,Shuai Bai,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RECONSPATIAL 多视角3D场景重建基准，要求LVLM在共享相机锚定坐标系中联合预测带朝向3D包围盒，分Structure与Metric两轴评估，并辅以9个原子空间QA与离线导航；18个前沿模型显示结构与度量重建存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态空间基准只测孤立的空间判断（方向、距离），交互式具身评测又把感知与探索、规划、控制、仿真器执行混在一起，无法单独刻画"把局部视觉观测整合为几何一致世界表示"这一核心能力，需一个居中的、可诊断的评测桥梁。

Method: 构建RECONSPATIAL基准：覆盖室内、桌面、室外场景的真实多视角图像与目标物体查询，LVLM需在相机锚定度量坐标系中预测带朝向3D包围盒；按Structure（相对布局）与Metric（物理尺度与相机锚定放置）两轴评测；设计9个原子空间QA任务分几何感知与空间关系两组；附加离线导航路径规划评测；并做3D地图注入与空间微调消融/迁移实验。

Result: 18个前沿LVLM评测显示相对结构与度量重建存在系统性差距（GPT-6-Astra Structure 81.4% vs Metric 58.7%）；诊断分析表明关系一致性不保证度量精度；3D地图注入实验分离了场景构建与路径规划，揭示几何误差如何限制导航成功率；空间微调在空间及通用视觉语言基准上均取得广泛迁移。

Conclusion: 空间智能的关键瓶颈在度量级几何重建而非相对关系推理；需要显式结构化几何监督与诊断性评测才能推进LVLM的空间能力。

Abstract: The spatial intelligence of large vision-language models (LVLMs) requires the ability to combine local visual observations into a geometrically consistent representation of the physical world. Many static benchmarks assess isolated spatial judgments, such as relative direction or distance, while interactive embodied evaluations combine perception with exploration, planning, control, and simulator-specific execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce RECONSPATIAL, a benchmark centered on multi-view 3D scene reconstruction across indoor, tabletop, and outdoor environments. Given real multi-view images and target-object queries, LVLMs are required to jointly predict oriented 3D bounding boxes in a shared, camera-anchored metric coordinate frame. Reconstructions are evaluated along two complementary axes: Structure for relative layout and Metric for physical scale and camera-anchored placement. Nine atomic spatial QA tasks, grouped into Geometric Perception and Spatial Relations, probe spatial capabilities involved in joint reconstruction. Offline navigation extends evaluation to path planning. Evaluation of 18 frontier LVLMs reveals a consistent gap between relative scene structure and metric reconstruction; even GPT-6-Astra scores 81.4% on Structure but only 58.7% on Metric. Tracing this gap, diagnostic analyses link atomic spatial capabilities to reconstruction quality and show that relational consistency alone does not ensure metric accuracy. Experiments with 3D map injection further separate scene construction from path planning, revealing how these geometric errors limit navigation success. Finally, spatial fine-tuning yields broad transfer across both spatial and general vision-language benchmarks.

</details>


### [204] [4D Triangle Splatting Reconstruction of Dynamic Endoscopic Scenes from Monocular Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02034)
*Laura Salort-Benejam,Stamatia Giannarou,Antonio Agudo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurgicalTS：基于四元数形变与对称三角形表示的自监督动态内窥镜场景4D重建框架


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目内窥镜视频下软组织非刚性形变、光照变化、遮挡与未知相机轨迹使动态4D重建困难；可靠重建可提升微创手术的可视化、诊断精度与术中导航。

Method: 以规范三角形集合（triangle splatting）为场景表示，与形变网络联合自监督优化；引入四元数形变模型、改进的颜色参数化、时空先验以及重定义的初始化策略以提升遮挡下的重建完整性。

Result: 在多种术式的在体（in-vivo）内窥镜视频上验证，可建模软组织形变与器械-组织交互，几何与光度精度持续优于SOTA，同时减少训练时间。

Conclusion: 带物理一致性的四元数形变建模可实现稳健高效的动态内窥镜4D重建，但属医学领域专用方法。

Abstract: Robust 4D reconstruction of deformable endoscopic scenes from monocular videos remains challenging due to non-rigid tissue deformation, illumination changes, occlusions, and unknown camera trajectories. Reliable dynamic reconstruction of endoscopies could significantly enhance visualization, diagnostic accuracy and intraoperative guidance of minimally invasive procedures. We propose SurgicalTS, a self-supervised triangle-splatting framework for dynamic endoscopic scene reconstruction from static monocular cameras. The scene is represented by a canonical set of triangles jointly optimized with a deformation network. We introduce a quaternion-based deformation model, an improved color parametrization, spatio-temporal priors, and a redefined initialization strategy that improves completeness under occlusions. Extensive evaluation on challenging in-vivo endoscopy videos from diverse procedures shows that SurgicalTS successfully models soft-tissue deformations and tool-tissue interactions over time, while consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our method also reduces training times while maintaining competitive geometric and photometric accuracy results, highlighting the effectiveness of quaternion-based deformation modelling with physical consistency for robust and efficient 4D reconstruction of endoscopic scenes.

</details>


### [205] [Unified Loss-Aware Density Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02044)
*Tae-Young Kim,Jiwoo Chung,Jae-Pil Heo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将3DGS的自适应密度控制重构为逐高斯局部损失下降决策：用Taylor二阶代理预测split/clone/opacity decay引起的目标变化，提出归一化联合位置-尺度空间的二阶分裂、代理最小化的复制克隆、以及选择性软不透明度衰减，在可比或更少高斯预算下提升渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准3DGS密度控制依赖视空间梯度、尺度阈值和全局不透明度重置等启发式，未显式评估每次split、clone、opacity更新对损失的降低效果，导致高斯基元被分配到已充分重建区域、遗漏欠重建结构，并因全局重置而不稳定。

Method: 基于Taylor展开推导逐高斯高效代理函数，预测split、clone、opacity decay三种操作对目标函数的变化量，形成统一损失感知框架：(1) 将二阶分裂扩展到归一化的联合位置-尺度空间，使子高斯同时自适应位置与各向异性尺度；(2) 将重复克隆表述为代理最小化问题，仅选择复制贡献可改善重建的高斯，并给子高斯赋有依据的不透明度；(3) 以选择性软不透明度衰减替代全局重置。

Result: 在标准3DGS基准上实现更精准的基元分配，渲染质量优于基线，且高斯预算相当或更小。

Conclusion: 以局部损失下降为原则的密度控制可替代启发式规则，使高斯分配更有效、训练更稳定，且不增加预算。

Abstract: The efficiency and fidelity of 3D Gaussian Splatting critically depend on adaptive density control, which grows and suppresses Gaussian primitives throughout optimization. However, the standard pipeline still relies on heuristic view-space gradients, scale thresholds, and global opacity resets, rather than explicitly assessing the loss-reducing effect of each split, clone, or opacity update. This mismatch can allocate primitives to already-sufficient regions, miss under-reconstructed structures, and destabilize training through blanket opacity changes. In this work, we recast adaptive density control as a collection of local loss-reduction decisions. We derive efficient Taylor-based per-Gaussian surrogates that predict the objective change caused by three primitive-level operations: splitting, cloning, and opacity decay. This yields a unified loss-aware framework with three components. First, we extend second-order splitting to a normalized joint position-scale space, enabling children to adapt not only their locations but also their anisotropic extents. Second, we formulate duplicate cloning as a surrogate minimization problem, selecting only Gaussians whose duplicated contribution is predicted to improve reconstruction and assigning each child a principled opacity. Third, we replace global opacity reset with selective soft opacity decay that weakens harmful primitives while preserving useful ones. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, our method produces more targeted primitive allocation and achieves improved rendering quality with comparable or smaller Gaussian budgets compared to baselines.

</details>


### [206] [UniGS-SLAM: Monocular Gaussian SLAM with Enhanced Geometry and Open-Vocabulary Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02051)
*Xingyuan Ding,Sicheng Yu,Kaiyong Zhao,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniGS-SLAM 提出纯 RGB 单目语义 SLAM 框架，将开放词汇语义与高斯重建解耦，语义观测融合进带来源溯源的独立稀疏体素图，并在几何更新后回溯修正历史语义证据，语义结果反向引导高斯滤波与局部表面细化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高斯方法把语义标签/特征直接挂在高斯原语上，语义融合难以维护且重建开销大；混合高斯-体素方案虽语义支撑更稳定，但多依赖 RGB-D 或已知位姿，且几何更新后不修正历史语义证据。

Method: RGB-only 流程：用基础模型先验增强单目深度与位姿估计；开放词汇语义观测写入带观测溯源的独立稀疏体素图，随重建演化回改历史贡献；融合语义再用于高斯滤波与局部表面细化，保持语义与几何双向交互。

Result: 在 Replica、ScanNet、KITTI-360 上，跟踪、渲染与几何重建在代表性 RGB-only 方法中领先，并在 Replica/ScanNet 上取得较强开放集语义建图效果；相比最快的对比语义 SLAM 基线实现 2.37 倍重建加速。

Conclusion: 验证了"语义表征与高斯几何解耦 + 历史观测可修正 + 双向引导"这一设计在纯单目语义 SLAM 中的有效性，兼顾精度与效率。

Abstract: Monocular semantic SLAM aims to reconstruct scene geometry and build semantic maps from RGB observations. Existing Gaussian-based methods often attach semantic labels or features to evolving Gaussian primitives, making semantic fusion difficult to maintain and increasing reconstruction overhead. Hybrid Gaussian--voxel representations provide more stable semantic support, but often rely on RGB-D input or known poses and do not revise historical semantic evidence after geometry updates. We present UniGS-SLAM, an RGB-only framework that decouples open-vocabulary semantics from Gaussian reconstruction while preserving bidirectional interaction. Foundation priors enhance monocular depth and pose estimation, while semantic observations are fused into an independent sparse voxel map with observation provenance, enabling historical contributions to be revised as reconstruction evolves. The fused semantics further guide Gaussian filtering and local surface refinement. Experiments on Replica, ScanNet, and KITTI-360 show leading tracking, rendering, and geometric reconstruction performance among representative RGB-only methods, together with strong open-set semantic mapping on Replica and ScanNet. We also achieve a 2.37-fold reconstruction speedup over the fastest compared semantic SLAM baseline. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [207] [Learning to Look: A Foundation for Visual Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02053)
*Wenshuai Zhao,Yihao Wang,Benjamin Robson,Juho Kannala,Arno Solin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出LOOK任务：让VLM自监督地判断其视觉输入中哪部分区域是可见的，揭示现有VLM无法定位可见区域，并证明在该任务上微调可提升模型对视觉输入的感知意识，从而缓解视觉幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM存在视觉幻觉（描述图中不存在的物体）。作者提出更基础的问题：模型是否在理解语义前就知道自己“看的是哪里”，即感知自身可见视觉输入范围的能力。

Method: 将问题形式化为LOOK任务——识别视觉输入中哪些部分对模型可用；以自监督方式构建训练数据，无需人工标注可见区域；在此任务上对现有VLM进行微调。

Result: 实验显示现有VLM无法定位可见区域；在LOOK任务上微调后，模型对视觉输入的感知意识显著提升。

Conclusion: 可见区域自感知是VLM的基础能力且当前普遍缺失，通过自监督LOOK任务微调可作为一种改善视觉幻觉的新方向。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from visual hallucination, such as saying an object that is not present in an image. We ask a more fundamental question: whether a VLM is even aware of where it is looking before understanding the semantic meaning in the image. We formulate this question as a LOOK task: identifying which parts of its visual input were available to the model. We construct the task in a self-supervised way without manually labeling the available region to the model. Our experiments show that existing VLMs fail to localize the visible region. We further show that fine-tuning VLMs on the proposed LOOK task improves a model's awareness of visual input.

</details>


### [208] [Scene-Adaptive Readout and Decoding in Diffusion Driving VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02076)
*Seungjun Yu,Jiho Choi,Inha Kang,Hojun Choi,Seungwook Kim,Hyunjung Shim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出场景自适应的读出与解码框架：单次骨干前向传播后，用场景条件化的 MoE 融合多层晚期特征做轨迹读出，并仅在需要时执行额外扩散精化，实现端到端最高 6.0× 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式 VLA 在每个去噪阶段都重复执行骨干，推理开销巨大；而"是否所有场景都需要相同的解码计算量"尚不清楚。作者试图分离两个问题：轨迹何时变得可用（可读性）与还需要多少细化（解码深度）。

Method: 分析网络深度与解码进度下的轨迹读出，发现"深度-解码解耦"现象：首轮前向后晚期层表征即可支撑有用读出，早期层则更受益于持续解码；且最优读出层与解码深度随场景变化。据此设计：(1) 场景条件化的读出 MoE，对单次骨干 sweep 后多个晚期层的轨迹预测自适应加权融合；(2) 自适应解码策略，仅当场景需要时施加原生精化。

Result: 在 Waymo E2E 与 nuScenes 上跨两个扩散式驾驶 VLA 评测：验证集 RFS 最高提升 0.56，测试性能亦提升；Waymo E2E 端到端最高 6.0× 加速，nuScenes 上轨迹误差持续降低。

Conclusion: 场景级读出层与解码算力的自适应分配可在避免冗余去噪的同时提升规划质量，说明"计算按场景分配"是扩散 VLA 提效的有效切入点。

Abstract: Diffusion driving vision-language-action models repeatedly execute the backbone at every denoising stage, incurring substantial inference cost, while it remains unclear whether all scenes require the same decoding computation. To distinguish when a trajectory becomes readable from how much further refinement it requires, we analyze trajectory readout across network depth and decoding progress. We identify a depth-decoding dissociation in which late-layer representations already support useful trajectory readout after the first forward sweep, whereas early-layer representations benefit more from continued decoding. We further find that both the preferred readout layer and decoding depth vary across scenes. Based on these observations, we propose a scene-adaptive readout and decoding framework. A scene-conditioned readout MoE adaptively weights and combines trajectory predictions from layer-specific late-layer representations after a single backbone sweep, while an adaptive decoding policy applies additional native refinement only when required by the scene. We evaluate our framework on two diffusion driving VLAs across the Waymo E2E and nuScenes benchmarks. Our method improves validation RFS by up to 0.56 while also improving test performance, and achieves an end-to-end speedup of up to $6.0\times$ on Waymo E2E, while consistently reducing trajectory error on nuScenes. These results demonstrate that scene-level readout and decoding allocation improves planning quality while avoiding unnecessary decoding. Our code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [209] [EarthJev: Calibrated, Non-Generative Answers to Natural-Language Questions about Sentinel-2 Land Cover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02096)
*Domenico Benfenati,Antonio Maria Rinaldi,Cristian Tommasino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EarthJev：0.8B 的免生成遥感 VQA 模型，把 12 波段 Sentinel-2 输入进 Qwen3.5-0.8B 视觉编码器，直接在单个位置读取选项字母 logits 得到答案与校准概率；单题 19.9 ms，36,028 测试题准确率 86.0%，ECE 0.006。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感视觉语言模型靠自回归解码生成文本答案：每题一次解码循环、需把文本解析回选项、且没有可用概率。作者希望用"判别式读出"替代生成式解码，同时保留多光谱输入，降低延迟并获得校准置信度。

Method: 以 Qwen3.5-0.8B 为骨干，将 12 个 Sentinel-2 波段通过一个加宽的输入层（由 RGB 卷积核初始化）送入视觉编码器；遵循 OneJev 开放配方，在单个位置从选项字母的 logits 直接读出答案，用交叉熵 + Brier score 联合训练。在预设分析计划下与同骨干生成式微调模型、三个 LoRA 微调的多模态语言模型对比，统一在 5% BigEarthNet v2.0 的 70,890 个问题上训练、同 GPU 单作业计时；并报告固定答案词表式 VQA 分类器作为成本参照。附消融：非 RGB 波段置均值、全视觉编码器可训练。

Result: 单题 19.9 ms，比多模态语言模型快 4.3–8.7 倍，比同骨干生成式用法快 6.8 倍；整图全部问题批量提问 42.8 ms，比批量生成式快 3.7–10.1 倍。36,028 测试题 86.0%（三随机种子），落后两个 2B 模型 0.6 与 1.2 个百分点，落后遥感专用 EarthDial-4B 3.5 个百分点；答案结构上必然合法，概率校准良好（ECE 0.006）。移除 9 个非 RGB 波段损失 4.5 个百分点，说明确实利用了多光谱信息；全量训练视觉编码器在同成本下提升至 88.4%。

Conclusion: 判别式单点读出可在不牺牲精度的前提下大幅降低推理成本，并天然提供校准概率与合法答案，是遥感 VQA 的实用替代路线；较小骨干 + 多光谱输入 + 可训练编码器仍有精度提升空间。

Abstract: Vision-language models for remote sensing answer questions about satellite images by generating text: every answer costs a decoding loop, has to be parsed back to an option, and comes without a usable probability. We present EarthJev, a 0.8B-parameter model that answers typed questions about multispectral Sentinel-2 patches without generating any token. All 12 bands enter the vision encoder of Qwen3.5-0.8B through a widened input layer initialised from the RGB kernels, and, following the open OneJev recipe, the answer is read from the logits of the option letters at a single position and trained with cross-entropy plus Brier score. Under a pre-specified analysis plan, we compare it with the same backbone fine-tuned to generate the answer and with three multimodal language models fine-tuned with LoRA, all trained on the same 70,890 questions from 5% of BigEarthNet v2.0 and timed in one job on the same GPU; VQA models that classify over a fixed answer vocabulary are reported as a reference for the cost of answering only the questions seen in training. EarthJev answers a question in 19.9 ms, 4.3 to 8.7 times faster than the multimodal language models and 6.8 times faster than its own backbone used generatively; when all the questions about an image are asked together, it answers them in 42.8 ms, 3.7 to 10.1 times faster than the batched generative models. On 36,028 test questions it reaches 86.0% accuracy (three seeds), 0.6 and 1.2 points below the two 2B multimodal models and 3.5 points below the remote-sensing EarthDial-4B, with answers that are valid by construction and calibrated probabilities (ECE 0.006). Replacing the nine non-RGB bands with their mean costs 4.5 points, so the model uses the multispectral input, and in an ablation training the whole vision encoder raises accuracy to 88.4% at the same cost. Code and model: this https URL

</details>


### [210] [CNN-Based Retinal OCT Classification: Research Gap Analysis and a From-Scratch Baseline, ED126-A](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02114)
*Shkelqim Sherifi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文对基于CNN的视网膜OCT分类进行聚焦综述，并提出ED126-A——一个124万参数的从零训练四类CNN基线，在Kermany OCT数据集上达到95.03%准确率（macro-F1 0.9205），主要错误集中在Drusen类（精确率0.7493），并提供混淆矩阵、Grad-CAM、t-SNE等完整诊断分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OCT图像中诊断相关形态模式类间相似度高，跨研究比较受异构评估协议限制，且从随机初始化训练的紧凑CNN基线表征不足，缺乏可控基准参考。

Method: 一是对CNN视网膜OCT分类的聚焦文献综述并梳理受控基准测试的方法学考量；二是构建ED126-A轻量四类CNN，在文档化协议下于Kermany标注数据集从零训练，采用训练动态、类级指标、混淆矩阵、置信度、t-SNE、Grad-CAM、层级特征图及OvR ROC/PR分析进行评估。

Result: 图像级留出测试集准确率95.03%，macro-F1 0.9205，weighted-F1 0.9521；Drusen类召回0.9605但精确率仅0.7493、F1 0.8419；混淆矩阵显示Normal→Drusen与CNV→Drusen为主要错误通道。

Conclusion: ED126-A可作为文档化的从零训练参考基线，为后续迁移学习、加深网络、注意力、多尺度特征融合与置信度校准的受控评估提供实证基础。

Abstract: Automated classification of retinal pathologies from Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images remains challenging because diagnostically relevant morphological patterns may exhibit substantial inter-class similarity. Although high classification accuracies have been reported on benchmark OCT datasets, cross-study comparison is limited by heterogeneous evaluation protocols and by the limited characterization of compact convolutional neural network (CNN) baselines trained from random initialization. This study addresses this gap through two contributions. First, it provides a focused review of CNN-based retinal OCT classification and identifies methodological considerations relevant to controlled benchmarking. Second, it presents ED126-A, a purpose-built four-class CNN baseline trained from scratch under a documented experimental protocol on the Kermany labeled OCT dataset. The model contains 1,241,380 total parameters, including 1,239,460 trainable parameters, and is evaluated using training-dynamics analysis, class-wise performance metrics, confusion-matrix analysis, confidence analysis, t-SNE representation-space visualization, Grad-CAM, hierarchical feature-map analysis, and one-vs-rest ROC/Precision-Recall analysis. On the image-level held-out test set, ED126-A achieved 95.03% accuracy, with a macro-F1 of 0.9205 and a weighted-F1 of 0.9521. The principal class-conditional limitation occurred for Drusen, which attained a recall of 0.9605 but a precision of 0.7493 and an F1-score of 0.8419. The confusion matrix identified Normal to Drusen and CNV to Drusen as major error channels. These results support the use of ED126-A as a documented from-scratch reference baseline and provide an empirical basis for controlled evaluation of transfer learning, increased depth, attention, multi-scale feature fusion, and calibration in subsequent studies.

</details>


### [211] [Testing concept-level audits of melanoma classifiers with diffusion counterfactuals and matched positive controls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02119)
*Md. Shohanoor Rahman,Md. Hasibul Islam,Md Kishor Morol,Moinul Hossain,Dip Nandi,Liew Tze Hui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建基于扩散模型、以7项7点checklist概念为条件的反事实审计框架，并用已知目标的对照与零假设分类器验证概念解释的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念解释方法（concept activation vectors等）很少在已知目标的对照条件下被检验，缺乏对"概念是否真的可控且特异性"的实证判别手段。

Method: 训练以七个7点checklist概念为条件的扩散生成模型，用颜色校准的起始噪声消除颜色离群；做逐概念扫描（sweep）反事实实验，比较目标概念响应与其他概念响应；引入伪标签匹配对照、第二评估者标注对照、18个置换标签的零假设分类器及标准化效应边际作为判据。

Result: 颜色校准将颜色离群从78.5–84.8%降至6.6–13.3%；7个旋钮中4个目标占优但同时改变其他概念；四分位正对照存在混杂，预设规则未通过；对三个概念成功恢复16/16与12/12对照目标，优于CAV的11/16；色素扫描使ISIC 2020全部15个分类器黑素瘤logit上升（平均+3.12）、HAM10000全部6个上升（+4.01），约为零假设响应四倍，但回归效应不可迁移；探索性分解显示旋钮串扰部分掩盖了血管相关响应。

Conclusion: 匹配对照与零假设分类器是可操作的概念审计检验手段；概念可控性与特异性需同时验证，单靠显著性易产生假阳性。

Abstract: Concept-based explanations of melanoma classifiers are rarely tested against controls with known targets. We built a counterfactual audit from a diffusion model conditioned on seven 7-point checklist concepts and tested it with such controls. Colour-calibrated start noise reduced colour outliers from 78.5-84.8\% to 6.6-13.3\%. Four of seven knobs were target-dominant but also changed other concepts. Quartile-based positive controls were confounded, and the audit failed its pre-specified rule. It recovered the targets of all 16 controls matched on the generator's pseudo-labels and of 12 of 12 controls labelled by a second evaluator, for three concepts; concept activation vectors recovered fewer (11 of 16). In 18 permuted-label classifiers, significant sweep responses and target rankings also arose, whereas standardised effect margins separated the controls from these null classifiers. The pigmentation sweep raised the melanoma logit in 15 of 15 ISIC 2020 classifiers (+3.12 on average) and 6 of 6 HAM10000 classifiers (+4.01), about four times the null response in scale-free units; the regression effect did not transfer. An exploratory decomposition, evaluated against the controls, suggested that knob cross-talk partly hides vascular responses. Matched controls and null classifiers are practical checks of concept audits.

</details>


### [212] [Refining Roadside 4D Radar Vehicle Classification Using Point-Cloud Dispersion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02147)
*Mohammed Alsakabi,Andreia Figueiredo,António Almeida,John Dolan,Miguel Luís,Pedro Rito,Ozan Tonguz,Susana Sargento*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出4D雷达+立体深度相机的路侧同步采集平台并构建真实数据集，发现模态间类别分布差异，尤其雷达对乘用车/摩托车混淆严重，进而用Neyman-Pearson二分类器对点云簇二维位置标准差时序平滑特征进行分类，误差从52.1%降至42.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路侧相机与传统传感器在探测距离、恶劣天气鲁棒性和深度精度上受限；4D雷达可提供距离、方位、俯仰与径向速度，但点云稀疏含噪导致分类不可靠。作者希望构建多模态同步平台并提升仅雷达分类可靠性，为后续相机-雷达融合奠基。

Method: 搭建4D雷达与立体深度相机时间同步的路侧采集平台并采集真实数据集；分析模态间类别分布差异；针对雷达点云簇的二维位置标准差做时序平滑，构造Neyman-Pearson准则下的二分类器，轻量、可边缘部署。

Result: 数据集分析显示雷达在乘用车与摩托车间存在强混淆（分别占49.01%与48.60%）；所提NP二分类器将分类误差由52.1%降至42.7%。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个路侧4D雷达-立体相机同步数据集与低成本可部署的雷达分类基线，缓解了稀疏点云下的类别混淆问题，为后续相机-雷达融合感知奠定基础。

Abstract: Roadside sensing infrastructure is essential for Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), but cameras and legacy sensors are limited in range, weather robustness, and depth accuracy. 4D radar complements these modalities by resolving range, azimuth, elevation, and radial velocity under adverse conditions, though its sparse, noisy point clouds make reliable classification difficult. We present a roadside multi-sensor platform combining a 4D radar and stereo depth camera under synchronized acquisition, used to collect a real-world dataset. Our analysis reveals a substantial class-distribution discrepancy between modalities, most notably a strong radar confusion between passenger cars and motorcycles (49.01% and\ 48.60% of the dataset). To address this, we propose a Neyman-Pearson-based binary classifier on the temporally-smoothed 2D positional standard deviation of radar point cloud clusters, reducing classification error from 52.1% to 42.7%. This lightweight and edge-deployable approach improves radar-only classification reliability and lays the foundation for future camera-radar fusion.

</details>


### [213] [A conditional generative model for T2-weighted prostate MRI with downstream evaluation in clinically significant cancer classificatio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02197)
*Xavier Rafael-Palou,Alejandro Vergara-Richart,Ignacio Iborra Roncales,Carmen Prieto-de-la-Lastra,Andreu Antolin-Redondo,Juan Morote,Ana Jimenez-Pastor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 扩展MAISI-v2的条件生成模型（csPCa类别、分区与病灶掩膜引导）合成前列腺T2W MRI，FID由13.28降至2.04，合成数据增强在五种模拟数据稀缺场景下均提升csPCa分类AUC（+0.027~+0.088），但跨机构迁移增益不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺MRI训练数据稀缺且代表性不足，制约csPCa预测模型性能；希望通过带病灶级语义条件的合成T2W影像扩充训练集，缓解数据约束。

Method: 单中心回顾性研究（1303例、1654个病灶）；在MAISI-v2基础上引入csPCa类别条件、解剖分区（transition zone）条件与病灶掩膜引导，并结合相对优势加权损失（relative advantage weighted loss）微调；用增量消融评估保真度，在五种模拟训练数据场景、每种18种合成配置下评测下游csPCa分类器。
