Result: FID从预训练MAISI-v2的13.28降至内部2.04±0.06（PI-CAI外部3.83±0.51）；五种场景下合成增强均显著提升AUC（+0.027~+0.088，校正p=0.016–0.043）；跨机构增强PI-CAI仅+0.013（p=0.397），不显著。

Conclusion: 病灶级条件化生成可显著提升T2W MRI保真度，并在模拟数据受限条件下改善csPCa分类；但合成数据的增益未能显著跨机构迁移，提示需关注域泛化与生成分布偏差。

Abstract: Scarce and unrepresentative training data limit the performance of prostate MRI prediction models. Synthetic T2-weighted (T2W) MRI may augment training data containing clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) and transition zone (TZ) lesions. In this retrospective, single-center, ethics-committee-approved study, we developed a conditional generative model for T2W prostate MRI extending MAISI-v2 with csPCa class, zonal, and lesion-mask-guided conditioning, incorporating a relative advantage weighted loss fine-tuned on 1,303 patients (1,654 lesions). Fidelity was assessed by incremental ablation, and downstream utility was evaluated with T2W-based csPCa classifiers across five simulated training-data scenarios, each testing 18 synthetic-data configurations. The proposed model reduced Fréchet inception distance (FID) from 13.28 (pretrained MAISI-v2) to $2.04 \pm 0.06$ internally (PI-CAI: $3.83 \pm 0.51$). Synthetic augmentation significantly increased AUC in all five scenarios (+0.027 to +0.088; adjusted $p = 0.016$--$0.043$), though cross-institutional augmentation of PI-CAI yielded a non-significant gain (+0.013; $p = 0.397$). Overall, our model improved T2W MRI fidelity, and synthetic images improved csPCa classification under simulated data constraints, although benefit did not transfer significantly across institutions.

</details>


### [214] [Depth Anyviewpoint? Evaluating Monocular Depth Over Viewpoint Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02203)
*Theo Rode,Rui Zhang,Ryan Aubrey,Olivia Li,Jessica Huang,Liv Chu,Healani Dowd,Calden Wloka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出基于移动相机视频序列的单目深度模型评测协议，用SfM将仿射不变深度锚定为米制尺度，考察跨视角与长时序的空间一致性，并揭示SfM作为度量锚定工具的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单目深度模型（依赖仿射不变损失与基础模型特征）仅在单图基准与定性视频上验证，其在长时段视频流中的三维一致性与米制锚定能力未被充分考察，而这正是实际应用（如视频输入）所必需。

Method: 构建以移动相机拍摄的真实视频为输入的评测协议，在多样真实场景中用structure-from-motion输出的米制深度对模型仿射不变预测做尺度与偏移对齐，量化跨视角变化与长时间跨度下的一致性与空间结构保持。

Result: 实验显示通用单目深度基础模型在长时序上保持时间一致性仍存明显困难，并暴露了直接将SfM用作度量接地工具的若干问题。

Conclusion: 单目深度基础模型在可泛化的三维一致性与米制接地方面仍属开放问题，需要新的评测与尺度锚定范式。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation aims to predict depth maps from single RGB images (forgoing the need for stereo camera pairs) and has seen impressive leaps in performance in recent work due to the introduction of affine-invariant losses and the use of foundation model features. These monocular depth models predict affine-invariant depth, which describes the relative positions of objects in the scene instead of absolute depth. While these models demonstrate strong performance on single image benchmarks and qualitatively consistent predictions in video, their effectiveness at preserving consistent spatial structure has been less thoroughly explored. Many potential real-world applications, such as handling video streams as input, rely on coherent three dimensional consistency in scenes. Further, anchoring relative depth predictions to a metric reference for a given scene is a key challenge for applying monocular depth models to real-world situations. We develop a novel evaluation protocol for monocular depth models using video sequences with moving camera positions to test the consistency of prediction across variation in viewpoint. We demonstrate this methodology over diverse, real-world video sequences where we are able to anchor depth model output to metric depth values using structure from motion. Our work demonstrates open challenges in the development of broadly applicable monocular depth foundation models, particularly with their ability to provide temporal consistency over long time frames. We also identify challenges in the straightforward adoption of structure-from-motion as a metric grounding tool for monocular depth estimation models.

</details>


### [215] [Learning from high-resolution 2D images to reconstruct 3D microstructures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02204)
*Wenbo Sui,Lars P. Mikkelsen,Jens W. Andreasen,Daniel Lichau,Harold Phelippeau,Philip J. Withers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出特权跨模态关系蒸馏框架（PCRD），训练时用高分辨2D SEM图像作为特权模态，推理时仅需低分辨micro-CT，通过匹配空间锚点周围的相似度分布实现跨模态知识迁移，提升复合材料纤维微结构的三维重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨体成像昂贵、耗时且常具破坏性，而高分辨2D成像与低分辨体测量往往都易获得；因此希望在不增加推理成本的前提下，利用2D精细信息改善低分辨体数据驱动的样本级3D重建。

Method: 特权跨模态关系蒸馏（PCRD）：以SEM为特权教师模态、micro-CT为学生输入，在对应空间锚点周围构造相似度/关系分布并对齐，而非直接对齐异质特征向量，从而迁移空间组织结构。

Result: 2D截面重建mAP较直接micro-CT训练提升1.66个百分点；与高分辨同步辐射X射线CT对比，纤维体积分数、直径与局部间距高度一致；重建匹配89.97%参考纤维中心线长度，而插值低分辨体仅75.08%。

Conclusion: 关系式蒸馏可有效将精细2D特权信息注入低分辨体输入，实现无需高分辨体成像的近无损3D微结构表征，具有一定跨模态迁移普适性。

Abstract: High-resolution three-dimensional (3D) microstructure characterization remains difficult to undertake at scale because volumetric imaging at the required spatial resolution is expensive, time-consuming or destructive. In many settings, however, fine-resolution two-dimensional (2D) imaging and lower-resolution volumetric measurements are both readily available. We introduce a Privileged Cross-modal Relational Distillation (PCRD) framework that leverages fine-resolution 2D observations during training to improve specimen-specific 3D reconstruction from lower-resolution volumetric imaging alone. We demonstrate PCRD on pultruded carbon fiber-reinforced polymer composites, using scanning electron microscopy as the privileged modality and micro-CT as the inference input. The framework transfers spatial organization by matching similarity distributions defined around corresponding spatial anchors in the teacher and student representations, avoiding direct alignment of heterogeneous feature vectors. In 2D cross-sectional reconstruction, PCRD improves mAP by 1.66 percentage points over direct micro-CT training. Independent 3D validation against high-resolution synchrotron X-ray CT data shows close agreement in fiber volume fraction, diameter and local spacing. The PCRD reconstruction matches 89.97% of the reference fiber centerline length, compared with 75.08% for the interpolated low-resolution volume.

</details>


### [216] [Forecasting Earth Surface Change in Embedding Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02211)
*Jingtao Li,Sadiq Jaffer,Anil Madhavapeddy,Pedro Sousa,Anthony Ortiz,Kyle Gao,Zhengpeng Feng,Yanfei Zhong,Kevin White,Srinivasan Keshav*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出在地球基础模型的嵌入空间做时序卫星预测（而非光谱值预测），设计支持多传感器、不同基础模型与任意查询日期的 token 空间，并用双分支 Transformer E^2Forecast（高斯分支+rectified-flow 集合分支）完成预测与无监督异常变化检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感时序方法逐像素预测未来光谱值，但云、阴影与传感器噪声污染观测，使模型容量浪费在低层特征与噪声上；因此作者主张借助地球基础模型，在嵌入空间进行预测。

Method: 构建可处理不同传感器与不同基础模型的不规则历史 token 空间，支持任意查询日期；Forecaster 采用双分支 Transformer：高斯分支输出均值点预测与逐维标准差，rectified-flow 分支生成预测集合；通过实测与预测比对实现无标签、免重训的异常变化检测。

Result: 在 Sentinel-1/2 基准上，嵌入预测将余弦距离从 0.20 降至 0.10，z-score 标准差从 2.63 降至 1.22（缓解过度自信）；全球基准变化检测 F1 从 41.58 提升至 48.70；在九个遥感基础模型上一致验证优越性。

Conclusion: 嵌入空间预测优于光谱空间预测，并可复用多样预训练任务头；代码开源。工作属遥感时序应用，与物理 AI/世界模型核心议程关联偏间接。

Abstract: Repeated satellite imagery permits understanding of how our planet changes over time, letting us predict its future and plan mitigating actions. Most existing studies that rely on a time series of satellite observations forecast the spectral values at each pixel for a future target date. However, clouds, shadows, and sensor noise often corrupt these observations, so that spectral forecasters waste much of their capacity on low-level features or noise rather than real change. With the advent of Earth foundation models, we argue that forecasting in embedding space is a feasible and more effective alternative. To this end, we design a token space that handles irregular histories from different sensors and foundation models and supports forecasts at any query date. Tokens from this space are inputs to our proposed forecaster, E$^2$Forecast, which is a transformer with two branches: a Gaussian branch that directly predicts a mean point forecast and per-dimension standard deviations, and a rectified-flow branch that generates forecast ensembles. On Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 benchmarks, forecasting embeddings instead of spectral values halves the cosine distance (from 0.20 to 0.10) and greatly reduces overconfidence, lowering the z-score standard deviation from 2.63 to 1.22. By comparing new observations with its forecasts, E$^2$Forecast can also detect anomalous changes without labels or retraining, raising F$_1$ from 41.58 to 48.70 on a global benchmark. This consistent superiority is validated on nine remote sensing foundation models. Beyond change detection, we believe our approach advances the field by permitting effective reuse of diverse pretrained task heads. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [217] [SVD-Prune: Spectral Vision Token Pruning under Extreme Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02284)
*Yvon Apedo,Martyna Poreba,Michal Szczepanski,Samia Bouchafa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SVD-Prune：将视觉token剪枝表述为保留视觉表示的**主导低秩谱结构**，用SVD+统计杠杆分数进行全局token选择，无需训练、架构无关，可插入编码器端/解码器端/混合模式。最极端可削减99.3%视觉token，16 token预算下编码器端剪枝降82.4% FLOPs、含开销4.18×端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM/VLA需处理数百视觉token，视觉表示成为主要计算瓶颈。作者反对"逐个token重要性打分"的逐个独立视角，主张剪枝应关注整体低秩谱结构的保留。

Method: 训练无关框架：对视觉token矩阵做SVD，计算统计杠杆分数（leverage scores）衡量每个token对主导奇异子空间的贡献，据此做全局（非局部、非逐层贪心）token选择；支持编码器端、解码器端以及混合部署。

Result: 在VLM与VLA基准上极端压缩仍保持稳健；token预算最高降99.3%；16-token预算下编码器端剪枝FLOPs降82.4%，端到端4.18×加速（含剪枝开销）。

Conclusion: 低秩谱视角为视觉token剪枝提供了统一、可解释且架构无关的准则，可直接作为VLA/VLM推理加速的即插即用模块。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models process hundreds of visual tokens, making visual representations a major computational bottleneck. We argue that visual token pruning should be formulated not as identifying individually important tokens, but as preserving the dominant low-rank spectral structure of the visual representation. Based on this formulation, we introduce SVD-Prune, a training-free framework that leverages Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and statistical leverage scores for globally informed token selection. SVD-Prune is architecture-agnostic and can be applied at different stages of the multimodal pipeline, including encoder-side, decoder-side, and hybrid configurations Extensive experiments across VLM and VLA benchmarks demonstrate strong robustness under extreme compression. SVD-Prune reduces the visual token. SVD-Prune cuts the visual token budget by up to 99.3%, while, at a 16-token budget, encoder-side pruning lowers inference FLOPs by 82.4% and achieves a 4.18x end-to-end speedup, including pruning overhead.

</details>


### [218] [Peripheral prototypical contrastive loss for supervised medical image segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02305)
*Takuro Shimaya,Ryosaku Shino,Masahiro Saiko*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive (PPC) loss，利用边界附近局部区域的原型特征做对比学习，提升医学图像分割的边界识别能力，并在噪声标注下保持训练稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学图像边界定义模糊，现有边界感知损失函数对边界歧义引起的标注噪声敏感、训练不稳。

Method: 原型对比损失：从目标边界附近的局部区域提取原型特征，聚焦传统方法难以处理的歧义区域；并提出自适应确定原型计算局部区域的策略。

Result: 在多数据集上，即使存在噪声标签，PPC损失也能持续提升分割性能；自适应局部区域策略进一步提升鲁棒性并优于现有方法。

Conclusion: PPC损失有望支撑可扩展、可靠的医学图像分割，包括利用不完美标注构建基础模型。

Abstract: Robust segmentation of biomedical images remains challenging primarily due to ill-defined object boundaries. Although several loss functions have recently been proposed to enhance object boundary recognition, concerns remain about the susceptibility to unstable annotations resulting from boundary ambiguities. Here, we introduce the Peripheral Prototypical Contrastive (PPC) loss, which leverages prototypical contrastive learning to improve boundary recognition and enable stable training even under noisy annotation conditions. The PPC loss utilizes prototype features obtained from local regions near object boundaries, focusing specifically on ambiguous areas that have been challenging for existing approaches. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrated that the PPC loss consistently improve segmentation performance even under conditions with noisy labels. A newly proposed strategy, which adaptively determines the local region for prototype calculation, enhanced robustness and outperformed existing methods. Our findings indicate the potential of the PPC loss in facilitating scalable and reliable medical image segmentation, including the development of foundation models with imperfect annotations.

</details>


### [219] [Lie Routing Vision Language Models for View-Robust 3D Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02306)
*Jingjun Yi,Chen Hu,Qi Bi,Hao Zheng,Huimin Huang,Yongkang,Wei Ji,Yawen Huang,Xian Wu,Yefeng Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LieVLM 用局部 SO(3) 变换对多视角投影特征做"Lie 路由"，抑制 MLLM 三维理解中的视角诱发语义漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视角 RGB 输入的 MLLM 在同一物体/查询上会因相机视角不同给出不一致回答（viewpoint-induced semantic drift）；常规的加性融合无法显式建模视角旋转这一结构性因素。

Method: 由 VGGT 提取的几何 token 预测局部旋转参数与通道级路由系数；在学习到的三维子空间内，用闭式 Padé–Cayley 映射对投影视觉特征施加局部 SO(3) 变换，再将相对恒等的修正量反投影并门控注入原始视觉与几何特征，从而在保留预训练语义与直接空间上下文的同时学习视角相关调整。

Result: 在 3D 描述、grounding、检测与空间推理任务上，跨训练规模与骨干网络均稳定优于加性融合；消融验证了几何条件与变换结构的作用；视角分析显示路由状态随视角系统变化，目标响应更局部、跨视角性能更稳。

Conclusion: 将视角变化建模为 SO(3) 群作用并作为轻量路由注入，是实现视角鲁棒三维多模态理解的有效且可解释的范式。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in 3D scene understanding from multi-view RGB observations. Yet a fixed object and query can elicit inconsistent target-related responses across camera viewpoints, a phenomenon we characterize as viewpoint-induced semantic drift. We introduce LieVLM, a Lie routing framework for view-robust 3D understanding. Motivated by the rotational component of viewpoint change, Lie routing adapts visual representations by applying local $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ transformations to projected features within learned three-dimensional subspaces. Geometry tokens extracted by VGGT predict local rotation parameters and channel-wise routing coefficients. A closed-form Padé--Cayley map transforms projected visual features, whose identity-relative corrections are projected back and gated into the original visual and geometry features. This design retains the pretrained semantic and direct spatial context while learning view-dependent feature adjustments. Experiments on 3D captioning, grounding, detection, and spatial reasoning show consistent improvements over additive fusion across training scales and backbones. Controlled ablations examine the roles of geometric conditioning and transformation structure. Viewpoint analyses further reveal systematic variation in the predicted routing states alongside more localized target responses and stronger task performance across viewpoint changes.

</details>


### [220] [The DynaCell Evaluation Suite for Dynamic 3D Virtual Staining of Live Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02324)
*Alexandr A. Kalinin,Dihan Zheng,Taylla Milena Theodoro,Ivan Ivanov,Eduardo Hirata-Miyasaki,See-Chi Lee,Aofei Liu,Sricharan Reddy Varra,Talon Chandler,Soorya Pradeep,Chad Liu,Manuel D. Leonetti,Carolina Arias,Bo Huang,Shalin B. Mehta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DynaCell 三维时序虚拟染色评测套件，结合配对的三维时序荧光/非荧光活细胞图像、基线模型与三层指标（像素保真、细胞器分割、单细胞表型相似度），揭示回归与生成模型的取舍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 活细胞荧光成像存在标记与反复光照损伤细胞健康的问题，虚拟染色可由无标记图像预测荧光图；但现有虚拟染色模型在三维时序数据上的性能缺乏系统刻画，缺少统一评测基准。

Method: 构建评测套件：配对采集有/无荧光标记的三维时序活细胞图像数据；整理一组基线模型（回归类与生成类）；设计三层评测指标——像素级保真度、细胞器分割性能、单细胞表型相似度；并在 3 种细胞类型、2 种显微镜、4 种细胞器、3 种扰动状态下开展指标与模型行为分析。

Result: 回归基线在预测目标细胞器空间定位上更优，而生成基线在刻画跨细胞表型分布上更好；二者体现出结构保真与表型保真之间的权衡，该权衡被单指标评测所掩盖。

Conclusion: 单指标评测不足以刻画虚拟染色模型质量；需按下游任务（定位、分割、追踪、表型分析）选择模型并制定开发方向；公开数据、基线权重与评测代码，纳入 DynaCell 图像化细胞状态动态分析框架。

Abstract: Understanding how cells respond to perturbations over time is central to cell biology and drug discovery. Live-cell imaging captures the dynamics of perturbation-induced phenotypes in individual cells. While fluorescence imaging can visualize specific molecular phenotypes, labeling and repeated illumination often affect cell health. Virtual staining offers an alternative by predicting these fluorescence images from images acquired without fluorescent labels. Although many virtual staining models have been developed, their performance on volumetric time-lapse data remains poorly characterized. We address this gap with an evaluation suite for 3D time-lapse virtual staining of live cells. The suite combines paired 3D time-lapse images acquired with and without fluorescent labels, a set of baseline models, and three metric tiers measuring pixel-level fidelity, organelle segmentation performance, and single-cell phenotype similarity. Using this evaluation suite, we study metric and model behavior across 3 cell types, 2 microscopes, 4 organelles, and 3 perturbation states. We find that regression baselines better predict the spatial localization of target organelles, whereas the generative baseline better captures the distribution of phenotypes across cells. These differences expose trade-offs between structural and phenotypic fidelity that are obscured by single-metric evaluation and suggest how virtual staining models can be developed for diverse downstream tasks such as localization, segmentation, tracking, and phenotypic profiling. We release the curated datasets, baseline checkpoints, and evaluation code as part of DynaCell, a broader framework for image-based profiling of cell-state dynamics.

</details>


### [221] [Findings-aware Language-Image Pretraining for CT Volume Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02327)
*Takuro Shimaya,Junya Inoh,Masahiro Saiko*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FiLIP：用大语言模型从放射报告中抽取异常征象短语，并用生物医学文本嵌入模型构造显式语义目标特征，替代CLIP式"不同病例即负对"的弱监督对比学习，用于CT体数据与报告的视觉-语言表征学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT视觉-语言基础模型多采用CLIP式对比学习，将不同病例当作负对强行推开；但医学影像中不同病例可能存在临床相似性（相同异常征象），这种负对假设不成立，会产生错误的排斥监督。

Method: 1) 用大语言模型从放射报告中抽取abnormal finding短语；2) 用生物医学文本嵌入模型将这些征象编码为语义表征，作为图像编码器应显式输出的目标特征（回归式监督），而非批内对比的弱监督；3) 训练图像编码器与语言侧语义空间对齐。

Result: 在多标签零样本征象分类上，域内与外部域评估均优于弱监督（CLIP类）方法；在放射报告生成的下游任务微调中也取得有效提升。

Conclusion: 以临床知识驱动的显式语义目标监督优于病例级负对弱监督，可作为医学影像视觉-语言预训练的替代范式。

Abstract: Computed tomography (CT) provides diverse patient information and various clinical tasks, for which numerous deep learning models have been investigated. Recent years have seen the development of vision-language foundation models that can comprehensively extract clinical features, driven by representation learning that combines CT volumes with radiology reports. Existing approaches typically adopt Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based representation learning, where pairs from different cases are, in principle, treated as negative pairs such that the volume and report embeddings are pushed apart. In the biomedical imaging, however, treating different cases as negative pairs is not always appropriate, particularly when clinical similarity exists. In this study, we propose a supervised representation learning framework grounded in clinical knowledge from language foundation models, rather than the weak supervision used in CLIP. Specifically, we utilized a large language model to extract abnormal finding phrases from reports. We then explicitly constructed the target features that the image encoder should output, as the semantic representation of the extracted findings using a biomedical text embedding model. Our Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training (FiLIP) outperformed weakly supervised approaches in multi-label zero-shot finding classification in both in-domain and external-domain evaluations, and also proved effective when fine-tuned for the downstream task of radiology report generation.

</details>


### [222] [AgiWorld: An Agentic Video World Model for Building Persistent Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02341)
*Shaoheng Fang,Yiqun Mei,Hanwen Jiang,Xin Sun,Haitian Zheng,Hao Tan,Kalyan Sunkavalli,Georgios Pavlakos,Qixing Huang,Yiwei Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AgiWorld：由高层规划Agent（AgiWorld-Agent）与逐块生成视频世界模型（AgiWorld-WM）通过共享空间记忆和度量相机/结构化提示接口构成闭环，从单图+自由指令构建持久可回访世界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型只支持低层控制（相机运动+文本），需用户大量操作才能表达高层意图，且长程探索中世界不一致、不持久。作者希望把高层规划交给Agent，使持久性由"模型+Agent闭环"而非单一视频模型产生。

Method: 双层协同设计：(1) AgiWorld-Agent在世界状态中设计世界与旅程并指挥探索；(2) AgiWorld-WM分块生成视频并将其与几何存入空间记忆，Agent据此更新世界状态；接口为度量相机轨迹与结构化提示。WM中提出遮挡感知历史选择（按表面可见性检索历史视图）与基于可靠性的记忆维护（偏好可靠几何与更早观测）以应对遮挡与长rollout几何漂移。

Result: 在世界回访（revisiting）与探索基准上取得SOTA总体性能；定性结果与消融显示可在分钟级旅程中从自由指令构建持久世界。

Conclusion: 持久世界建模的关键在于视频世界模型与规划Agent围绕共享空间记忆的闭环，而非仅靠视频生成模型本身。

Abstract: Recent interactive video world models generate visually compelling videos from a single image, following user-provided camera motion and text prompts. However, such low-level control demands substantial user effort to realize a high-level intent, and the generated world struggles to remain persistent as the exploration proceeds. In this work, we present AgiWorld, an agentic video world model that explores and builds a persistent world from a single image and a free-form instruction. For high-level planning, our agent AgiWorld-Agent designs the world and the journey through it in a world state and directs the exploration. For low-level realization, our video world model AgiWorld-WM generates the video chunk by chunk and stores it with its geometry in a spatial memory, from which the agent updates its world state. This closed loop keeps the world faithful to the user's intent and keeps the agent's world state consistent with the generated content throughout the exploration. We co-design the two levels around the shared spatial memory and an interface of metric camera trajectories and structured prompts. In AgiWorld-WM, to handle occlusion and accumulated geometric errors in the spatial memory over long rollouts, we propose occlusion-aware history selection, which retrieves past views by surface visibility, and reliability-based memory maintenance, which prefers reliable geometry and earlier observations. AgiWorld-WM achieves state-of-the-art overall performance on world revisiting and exploration benchmarks, and qualitative results and ablations show that AgiWorld builds persistent worlds from free-form instructions over minute-long journeys. Persistence thus arises not from the video model alone but from its closed loop with the agent.

</details>


### [223] [Exploiting Textual Semantics for Robust Cross-View Object Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02356)
*Bing Fan,Yunhe Feng,Yan Huang,Heng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TeSCo利用视觉语言模型为目标生成文本描述，将文本语义与视觉线索结合用于跨视角目标对应（CVOC），通过文本引导调制融合模块和迭代文本特征精化模块提升复杂场景鲁棒性，在Ego-Exo4D和HANDAL-X上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨视角目标对应任务中，现有方法依赖视觉线索，在视角剧变和外观差异大的复杂场景下因目标信息不足而失效；文本描述包含类别、纹理、颜色等属性，具有视角与外观不变性，可补充视觉线索。

Method: 先用视觉语言模型从查询视角生成目标的文本表达并提取文本特征；设计文本条件跨模态融合（TCF）模块，以文本引导调制将文本特征注入视觉特征，形成鲁棒多模态表征；再提出迭代文本特征精化（ITFR）模块，在融合前利用搜索视角信息渐进调整文本特征，实现搜索视角感知的语义融合。

Result: 在Ego-Exo4D与HANDAL-X数据集上取得SOTA，显著优于其他对比模型，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 引入文本语义作为视角/外观不变的互补线索，并结合搜索视角感知的迭代文本精化，可有效提升跨视角目标对应在复杂场景下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Cross-view object correspondence (CVOC) aims to establish associations of the same target between query and search videos captured from different viewpoints. Existing methods often rely on visual cues for CVOC. Despite recent progress, these methods struggle in complicated scenarios with substantial viewpoint changes and appearance variations, due to lacking sufficient target information. Addressing this, we introduce TeSCo, a framework that exploits rich Textual Semantics of an object, in addition to its visual cues, for cross-view object Correspondence. Our key insight is, textual description of a target, by capturing diverse attributes such as category, texture, and color, provides viewpoint- and appearance-invariant semantics, which are complementary to visual cues and can hence enhance correspondence robustness in complicated scenes. Inspired by this, TeSCo first generates a textual expression of the target from the given query view using a vision-language model, and then extracts textual feature to enhance visual features for localization in the search view. To realize this, we introduce a text-conditioned cross-modal fusion (TCF) module that incorporates the textual feature into visual features with text-guided modulation, producing more robust multimodal target representation for object correspondence. Since not all textual cues are equally compatible with the target in current search-view frame, we propose an iterative textual feature refinement (ITFR) module that progressively adjusts textual feature using search-view information before the TCF module, enabling search-view-aware textual semantics to be fused into visual features and leading to better performance. In extensive experiments on Ego-Exo4D and HANDAL-X, TeSCo demonstrates state-of-the-art results and largely outperforms other models, validating its efficacy. Our code is released at this https URL .

</details>


### [224] [GEAR: Generative Editing for Scene-Conditioned Outfit Retrieval for VR Travel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02363)
*Gia-Huy Dinh,Thinh-Phuc Nguyen,Thanh-Hai Nguyen,Lam-Huy Nguyen-Ngoc,Hoang-Bach Nguyen-Phan,Nam-Quan Nguyen,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GEAR框架通过VLM描述场景所需服装概念、用指令引导扩散模型在标准参考人偶上渲染该服装、再裁剪服装区域做嵌入相似度检索，实现场景条件下的3D虚拟环境服装检索，并在Unity原型中完成实时场景捕获与3D Avatar自动试穿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D虚拟环境中选衣需与周围场景上下文协调，但3D环境视图与目录服装资产之间存在巨大视觉域差异，直接视觉相似度或美学打分难以桥接跨域鸿沟。

Method: 以第一视角场景图为检索信号：先用VLM从场景中生成适宜服装的文本描述，再用指令引导扩散模型将该概念渲染到标准化参考角色上，裁剪服装区域作为中间查询，通过嵌入相似度检索现有2D服装资产；并构建Unity交互原型支持实时采集、检索与引擎内3D Avatar拟合。评估采用受控数据集上的自动化Swiss-system成对比较，对比直接视觉相似度、美学打分与VLM重排序基线。

Result: GEAR取得有竞争力的排名表现（mean Elo@5 = 1012.75，top-10重叠率0.180），成对一致性0.539；20个虚拟旅行场景的用户研究中，GEAR在视觉吸引力（34.5%）与上下文适配性（34.5%）上获得最高总体偏好。

Conclusion: 用生成式中间查询（VLM描述→扩散渲染→裁剪检索）可有效桥接3D场景与2D服装目录的跨域检索问题，系统具备可交互的工程可行性；但核心贡献属虚拟内容/检索领域，与具身智能与3D重建主线相关性有限。

Abstract: In virtual environments, choosing appropriate outfits requires contextual harmony with surrounding scenes, yet bridging the visual gap between 3D ambient views and catalog garment assets remains challenging. This paper investigates scene-conditioned outfit retrieval for interactive 3D environments, where a user's egocentric view serves as the retrieval signal. We present GEAR (Generative Editing for Asset Retrieval), a framework that bridges the cross-domain gap by synthesizing intermediate visual queries rather than predicting direct compatibility. GEAR uses a vision-language model to describe suitable clothing from a captured scene, employs an instruction-guided diffusion model to render the concept onto a standardized reference character, and utilizes the cropped clothing region to retrieve existing 2D outfit assets via embedding similarity. An interactive Unity prototype demonstrates real-time scene capture, asset retrieval, and in-engine 3D avatar fitting. We benchmark GEAR against direct visual similarity, aesthetic scoring, and VLM-based reranking on a controlled dataset using automated Swiss-system pairwise judgments, where GEAR achieves competitive top-ranked performance (mean Elo@5 of 1012.75 and top-10 overlap of 0.180) alongside 0.539 pairwise agreement. Furthermore, a user study across 20 virtual travel scenes demonstrates that GEAR achieves the highest overall participant preference in both visual appeal (34.5%) and contextual suitability (34.5%).

</details>


### [225] [IMUdrape: Generating Garment-Mounted Virtual IMU Data from Text through Physics-Based Cloth Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02393)
*Zikang Leng,Thomas Plötz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IMUdrape 通过物理布料仿真从文本生成服装安装式虚拟 IMU 数据，缓解服装感知标注数据稀缺问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IMU 正被缝入衣物，但织物会滑动、扭转、摆动，使服装安装传感器同时记录身体与布料运动，且随服装而异。现有虚拟 IMU 生成器将传感器刚性地绑定于身体，无法建模这种服装附加运动；而面向特定服装的模型又缺少配对标注数据。

Method: IMUdrape 利用物理驱动的布料仿真生成服装安装式虚拟 IMU：从活动描述文本合成动作，从照片重建目标服装的缝制版型，将虚拟 IMU 放置在部署时真实传感器的位置，并用无穿透接触求解器仿真服装，从而每次仿真都得到成对的服装与身体信号。

Result: 在四个服装安装式传感器真实数据集上，IMUdrape 在活动识别与全身姿态估计上均优于现有虚拟数据方法。在单个真实受试者数据下，识别 macro-F1 较仅用真实数据提升 7%–46%，较同等动作的身体安装式虚拟数据提升 2%–11%。在录制动作上仿真服装时，零真实训练数据的姿态误差相对生成动作下降 30%–33%，且服装数据比身体数据精度高 12%。

Conclusion: IMUdrape 表明基于物理布料仿真的文本驱动虚拟 IMU 生成可作为服装安装式传感的有效数据增广手段，显著减少所需真实数据量；其贡献在于首次将虚拟 IMU 从刚体假设扩展到可变形服装层面。

Abstract: Inertial sensors are moving into clothing, from sensorized sportswear to garments instrumented with hundreds of IMUs. Sewn into clothing, a sensor no longer moves rigidly with the body: loose fabric slides, twists and swings, so a garment-mounted sensor records the motion of the fabric as well as that of the body, and this extra motion differs from one garment to the next. Models for such sensors need training data recorded with the deployed garment, yet labeled data are scarce. Virtual IMU data generated from videos or text have eased this scarcity for body-attached sensors, but existing generators attach their virtual sensors rigidly to the body. We present IMUdrape, which generates garment-mounted virtual IMU data from text through physics-based cloth simulation. IMUdrape synthesizes motion from activity descriptions, reconstructs the target garment as a sewing pattern from photographs, places virtual IMUs at the deployment's real sensor positions, and simulates the garment with an intersection-free contact solver, so that every simulation yields paired garment and body signals. On four real datasets with clothing-mounted sensors, IMUdrape improves on existing virtual-data approaches for both activity recognition and full-body pose estimation. With one real subject, its data improve recognition macro-F1 by 7% to 46% over real data alone and by 2% to 11% over body-mounted virtual data from the same motion. When the garment is simulated on recorded motion, the pose error without any real training data falls by 30% to 33% relative to generated motion, and garment data remain 12% more accurate than body data. IMUdrape thus reduces the amount of real data that garment-mounted sensing requires.

</details>


### [226] [TERA: Task-Evidence Restoration for Underwater Object Detection under Bandwidth-Constrained Transmission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02419)
*Heejin Kim,Joon-Seok Song,Eunil Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AquaTX传输退化水下检测基准与TERA接收端框架（任务引导像素复原+双状态特征校正，检测器冻结），在seen编码下mAP50:95由37.7→50.0（DUO-TX）、31.5→41.3（RUOD-TX）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下目标检测器均在"传输前"图像上评测，忽略了带宽受限下采样与压缩带来的额外退化，导致真实部署性能被高估。

Method: 构建AquaTX受控基准（基于真实水下检测数据集，含seen与held-out编码器）；提出TERA：元数据盲的接收端框架，联合任务引导的像素级复原与双状态（像素域+特征域）特征校正，检测器全程冻结无需微调。

Result: seen复合退化下，相对无复原的冻结检测器，DUO-TX mAP50:95 从37.7提升至50.0，RUOD-TX从31.5提升至41.3；保持干净输入性能不退化；在held-out AVIF编码器下与检测器微调方案性能相当。

Conclusion: 结果支持"传输感知评测"与"任务引导复原"作为水下目标检测的实用范式，且冻结检测器的轻量接收端校正可替代重训练。

Abstract: Underwater object detectors are typically evaluated on pre-transmission images, overlooking additional degradation from bandwidth-constrained downscaling and compression. We introduce AquaTX, a controlled benchmark built from real underwater detection datasets with seen and held-out codecs. We also propose TERA, a metadata-blind receiver-side framework combining task-guided pixel restoration and dual-state feature correction while keeping the detector frozen. Under seen compound degradation, TERA improves mean average precision (mAP50:95, averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95) from 37.7 to 50.0 on DUO-TX and from 31.5 to 41.3 on RUOD-TX relative to the frozen detector without restoration. TERA also preserves clean-input performance and remains competitive with detector fine-tuning under the held-out AVIF codec. These findings support transmission-aware evaluation and task-guided restoration for underwater object detection. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [227] [Blueprint2CAD: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Engineering Drawing-to-CAD Render Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02433)
*Alexander Valverde,Danny Xie-Li,Zhichao Wang,Marcos V. Conde*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Blueprint2CAD 基准：判断正交工程图与带阴影渲染是否同一零件；并构建 BlueCAD-30K（29,925 个模型 × 6 视角图纸+渲染+曲面类型元数据）。实验发现瓶颈在视角而非编码器骨干；6 个零样本 VLM 验证准确率仅 0.52–0.67 且带 Yes/No 偏置，LoRA 微调小幅提升但加剧偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程图纸是机械零件的核心表达形式，零件检索、设计复用与图纸数字化都依赖"图纸↔三维模型"对应关系，但此前没有公开基准衡量视觉模型是否具备该能力。

Method: 构建 BlueCAD-30K 数据层：对 Zero-to-CAD 模型套用开源制图流水线，生成视角对齐渲染、六视角的干净/标注尺寸线图及曲面类型元数据。任务设定为图-渲染对应二分类验证与 10,000 模型库检索。评估 4 个冻结编码器（已知/未知视角）与 6 个零样本 VLM，并比较 CoT 提示与域内 LoRA 微调的影响。

Result: 冻结编码器在已知视角下 Recall@1 最高 65%，未知视角降至 43%；四个编码器差距不足 6 点，说明瓶颈在视角而非骨干。零样本 VLM 验证准确率 0.52–0.67，存在模型特定的 Yes/No 偏置；CoT 会改变但无法消除偏置；LoRA 微调提升几点准确率但放大偏置，且未改善视角失效。

Conclusion: 图纸-渲染对应是现有多模态模型的系统性薄弱环节，主要受视角几何而非特征骨干制约，简单提示或微调不足以解决；该基准为后续几何感知对应方法提供了评测基础。

Abstract: Engineering drawings specify mechanical parts through orthographic projections. Recognizing which part a drawing depicts underlies part search, design reuse, and digitization, yet no public benchmark measures whether vision models can do it. We introduce Blueprint2CAD, a benchmark for drawing-to-render correspondence: given an orthographic line drawing and a shaded render, usually from another viewpoint, decide whether they show the same part. Its data layer, BlueCAD-30K, applies an open drafting pipeline to 29,925 Zero-to-CAD models, adding view-aligned renders, clean and dimensioned drawings from six viewpoints, and surface-type metadata. Frozen encoders retrieve the matching part from a 10,000-model gallery with up to 65% Recall@1 when viewpoints are known but 43% when they are not, and the four encoders we test lie within six points of each other: viewpoint, not backbone, is the bottleneck. Six zero-shot vision-language models reach only 0.52-0.67 verification accuracy, with model-specific Yes/No biases that chain-of-thought shifts but does not remove; a quick LoRA fine-tuning on in-domain pairs improves verification accuracy by a few points but sharpens these biases and leaves the viewpoint failure intact.

</details>


### [228] [Evaluating Synthetic Skin Lesion Images for Classifier Training: A Safety-Aware Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02437)
*Amindu Kumarasinghe,Vinh Bui,Reza Ghanbarzadeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 通过16种质量指标的"锦标赛"比较，发现不存在对所有类别都最优的单一合成图像筛选指标；提出按类加权并剔除记忆化样本的安全感知筛选算法，在ISIC-2018上使Swin-B的Macro-F2较FID基线提升约0.014–0.016。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤癌分类缺乏带标注图像、罕见病变尤甚，可用扩散模型合成数据补足；但生成图像质量参差，需筛选保留哪些。实践中通用做法依赖单一质量分数（多为FID），而FID并未针对分类器需求验证，也无法判断生成器是否记忆训练照片。

Method: 在275,472张由EDM2生成的图像池上做16种质量指标的筛选锦标赛：每个指标单独选出训练子集，训练分类器并逐类别打分。据逐类测量结果构造安全感知评估算法：按各指标在每类中的实测价值加权，并剔除与真实训练图过近的图像；在四个安全阈值下于ISIC-2018测试集评估。

Result: 无单一指标通吃所有类别：Inception特征FID对某一病变类型分类器最佳，对另一类相对随机采样无可测优势，且其偏好的生成设置恰是最接近训练图像的设置。安全感知算法使Swin-B的Macro-F2较FID基线提升+0.0136至+0.0164（Bonferroni校正p<0.02），较随机采样提升约+0.03，但对ResNet-50无此增益；收紧阈值可提升记忆化安全分且效用无可测变化，但所有筛选集的安全性仍低于随机采样。

Conclusion: 结果给出主分类器上幅度不大但统计显著的增益，并提供一套实用、安全感知的合成数据评估与使用流程；提示单一FID式代理指标不足以支撑类条件合成数据筛选，指标价值须逐类标定。

Abstract: Skin cancer classifiers need large sets of annotated images, which are scarce, especially for rare lesion types. AI-generated images can fill the gap, but a generator produces images of widely varying quality, so selecting which images to retain is important. That choice usually rests on a single quality score, most often the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), which has not been tested against what a classifier needs and cannot tell whether the generator memorizes its training photographs. We test that practice with a tournament of 16 quality metrics. Each metric alone selects a training subset from a pool of 275,472 images generated by a diffusion model (EDM2), and a classifier trained on each subset scores the metric per class. The tournament shows that no single metric serves every class: FID computed on Inception features gives the best classifier for one lesion type and no measurable advantage over random sampling for another, and the generation setting it prefers is also the one closest to the training images. We turn these per-class measurements into a safety-aware evaluation algorithm that weights each metric by its measured value in each class and removes images too close to a real training image. On the held-out ISIC-2018 test set, the algorithm improves Macro-$F_2$, a recall-weighted measure of classification performance, over the FID baseline for a Swin-B classifier by +0.0136 to +0.0164 across four safety thresholds (Bonferroni-corrected $p < 0.02$) and over random sampling by about +0.03, though not for ResNet-50. Tightening the threshold improves a memorization-safety score with no measurable change in utility, but every curated set remains less safe than random sampling. The results show a modest but statistically significant gain on the primary classifier, and offer a practical, safety-aware procedure for evaluating and using synthetic data.

</details>


### [229] [Gnomon4D: Learning Where and When to Focus for Geometric Motion-Grounded World-Action Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02474)
*Lingwei Dang,Yan Zhou,Juntong Li,Zhenhao Zhang,Yiteng Chen,Xiaoqiang Liu,Liang An,Hongwen Zhang,Wei Min,Guoxin Zhang,Pengfei Wan,Yebin Liu,Qingyao Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Gnomon4D 是一种世界-动作模型（WAM），在联合预测未来视频与机器人动作的同时生成 GeoDelta——与视频对齐的 4D 几何运动场（编码机械臂与物体点在跨帧图像平面的位移及深度变化），并通过 InSAttn 与 TransAgg 将人-机共享的"准动作"用于无动作预训练与机器人中训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 WAM 依赖 RGB 未来帧，物理状态变化与外观纠缠；逐帧深度/点图缺乏时序对应；已有 4D 方法或将运动隐式留在视觉特征中，或需独立接口把预测轨迹转成动作，导致交互关系难以直接暴露给动作专家。

Method: 提出 GeoDelta：视频对齐的 4D 几何运动场，显式编码跨帧图像平面位移与深度变化，将本体运动与物体响应置于同一共享空间；Interaction-Salient Attention（InSAttn）依据该关系将空间读出聚焦到任务相关交互区域；Transition-Anchored Aggregation（TransAgg）在相对运动变化（抓取、释放）附近聚合证据；GeoDelta 与本体无关，可作为人-机共享准动作，先在 EgoManip-5000H 上无动作预训练，再在 Robot-30H 上机器人中训练。

Result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、VLABench、RoboDojo 上取得领先；在分布内与分布外设置下分别比最强真实机器人基线高 7.0 与 16.0 个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式、与视频对齐的 4D 几何运动表示可有效桥接视频生成先验与动作预测，并通过共享准动作实现跨具身（人类视频）预训练，提升机器人策略的泛化性。

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) use video-generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Yet RGB futures entangle physical state changes with appearance, while frame-wise depth and point maps lack temporal correspondence. Existing 4D approaches either keep motion implicit in visual features or translate predicted traces into actions through a separate interface. We present Gnomon4D, a WAM that jointly generates future video, robot actions, and GeoDelta, a video-aligned 4D geometric motion field encoding the cross-frame image-plane displacement and depth change of embodiment and object points. By placing embodiment motion and object responses in a shared space, GeoDelta exposes their motion relations to the action expert at inference. Interaction-Salient Attention (InSAttn) uses these relations to focus spatial readout on task-relevant interaction regions, while Transition-Anchored Aggregation (TransAgg) aggregates evidence around changes in their relative motion, such as grasp and release. GeoDelta describes surface motion independently of embodiment-specific controls, providing a shared human--robot quasi-action for action-free pretraining on EgoManip-5000H followed by robot mid-training on Robot-30H. Gnomon4D leads on RoboTwin~2.0, VLABench, and RoboDojo, and outperforms the strongest real-robot baseline by 7.0 and 16.0 percentage points under in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, respectively.

</details>


### [230] [Fast-Slow Evolutionary Occupancy Prediction via Controlled Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02499)
*Runhe Yang,Zhiyuan Zhou,Yuxiang Yan,Xuetong Yang,Yikai Pan,Jiacheng Tang,Zhuolin He,Jianhua Han,Hang Xu,Jian Pu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EvoOcc将高精度慢模型与低时延快模型的3D语义占据预测结果通过"连续时间受控动力系统"进行演化融合，并把演化分解为自车状态（坐标补偿）与场景状态（真实几何/语义变化），在不改动上游架构的前提下实现快慢协同的精度-时延平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D语义占据预测对自动驾驶下游预测与规划要求高精度且低时延，但现有方法呈两极：性能导向模型精度高但慢，部署友好模型快但弱；二者特性互补，值得在不改动上游模型的前提下联合利用。

Method: 提出EvoOcc快慢演化框架：将演化式占据预测建模为连续时间受控动力系统，以适应可变的慢系统延迟与不规则的快系统到达；进一步分解为双状态演化——自车状态演化补偿确定性坐标位移，场景状态演化建模真实的几何与语义变化。

Result: 在三组快慢系统配对及不规则预测到达条件下，EvoOcc相对快系统基线持续提升，同时时延远低于慢系统，表现出良好的精度-时延权衡与实际推理下的稳定行为。

Conclusion: 通过动力系统式的双状态演化融合，快慢占据模型可在架构不变条件下获得更优的精度-时延折中；但缺少真实车载部署证据与下游规划定量验证。

Abstract: 3D semantic occupancy prediction provides dense geometric and semantic scene representations for autonomous driving, where both high accuracy and low response latency are crucial for safe downstream forecasting and planning. Existing methods usually exhibit different accuracy-latency characteristics. Performance-oriented models provide stronger geometric and semantic predictions, while deployment-friendly models provide faster responses. This motivates EvoOcc, a fast-slow evolutionary occupancy prediction framework that jointly exploits their complementary strengths to improve the accuracy-latency balance without changing the upstream architectures. EvoOcc models evolutionary occupancy prediction as a continuous time controlled dynamical system, enabling flexible adaptation to variable slow system delays and irregular fast system arrivals. The framework further decomposes the evolution process into dual state evolution where ego state evolution compensates for the deterministic coordinate shifts and scene state evolution models the genuine geometric and semantic scene changes. Extensive experiments on three different fast-slow system pairs and irregular prediction arrivals show that EvoOcc consistently improves over fast system baselines while maintaining much lower latency than the slow system, indicating a favorable accuracy-latency balance and stable behavior under practical inference situations.

</details>


### [231] [QFacePlacement: From Arbitrary Tensorization to Semantic Spatial Correspondence in Modern Face Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02505)
*Krishna Bhatia,Kavita Choudhary,Pruthwik Mishra,Praveen Kumar Chandaliya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过两个受控接口（跨模型嵌入对齐、局部描述子对应张量）检验张量网络/MPO 在人脸验证中的放置位置，发现稠密线性映射与全局余弦匹配在低FAR指标上优于压缩张量分解，强调接口选择需提供任务对齐轴与可压缩结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子启发式视觉常将高维特征重塑为张量并套用张量网络模型，但现代人脸嵌入为余弦相似度优化，张量化本身并不天然产生张量列/MPO所需的低秩结构，需澄清此类模型应放在何处才合理。

Method: 两个受控实验：(1) 512x512 跨模型嵌入对齐算符，将 AdaFace 嵌入映射到 ArcFace 空间，比较稠密 Ridge/Procrustes、确定性 TT-SVD、MPO 压缩（含基变换与低秩残差）；(2) 全局池化前由局部 AdaFace 描述子构造 7x7x7x7 探测-底库对应张量，使用几何感知对称张量列（bond 维 2，122 参数）对比稠密线性匹配器（2403 参数）。

Result: 64K 参数预算下平均方向 AUC：稠密 Ridge 0.9297、rank-64 SVD 0.8952、最佳低秩 MPO 混合 0.8685、原始 MPO 约 0.649。对应张量接口中，张量列匹配器以 122 参数达到 LFW AUC 0.9802（稠密匹配器 2403 参数）；但 CFP-FP 上 FAR=0.001 时 TAR 为 0.0102 vs 全局余弦 0.1734，CPLFW 上 0.7805 vs 0.8737。

Conclusion: 量子启发分解仅在所选接口提供任务对齐轴且结构可压缩时才可信；聚合 AUC 必须与低FAR运行指标联合评估，压缩不必然转化为更好的实际部署性能。

Abstract: Quantum-inspired computer vision often reshapes high-dimensional features into tensors and applies tensor-network models. In face verification, this can be misleading: modern embeddings are optimized for cosine similarity, and tensorization alone does not establish the low-rank structure needed for tensor trains or matrix-product operators (MPOs). We study model placement through two controlled interfaces. First, cross-model embedding alignment requires a 512 x 512 operator to map AdaFace embeddings into ArcFace space. Dense Ridge and Procrustes mappings remain strong, while deterministic TT-SVD and MPO compression underperform even with basis changes and low-rank residuals. At a 64K-parameter storage budget, mean directional AUC is 0.9297 for dense Ridge, 0.8952 for rank-64 SVD, 0.8685 for the best low-rank-MPO hybrid, and approximately 0.649 for raw MPO. Second, before global pooling, we construct a 7 x 7 x 7 x 7 probe-gallery correspondence tensor from local AdaFace descriptors. A geometry-aware symmetric tensor train with bond dimension 2 uses 122 trainable parameters, compared with 2,403 for a dense linear matcher, while attaining an LFW AUC of 0.9802. Yet compression does not translate into better low-false-acceptance performance: on CFP-FP, TAR at FAR = 0.001 is 0.0102 versus 0.1734 for global cosine matching, and on CPLFW it is 0.7805 versus 0.8737. These results suggest that quantum-inspired factorization is most credible when the chosen interface provides task-aligned axes and compressible structure. They also show why aggregate AUC must be assessed alongside operational low-FAR metrics.

</details>


### [232] [CellPlex: Benchmarking Single-Cell Spatial Proteomics Prediction from H&E](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02506)
*Zijun Gao,Yijiang Chen,Xiangde Luo,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CellPlex是一个细胞级虚拟染色基准：整合7个队列（结直肠癌、乳腺癌、淋巴结转移、骨髓、胶质瘤）、717张样本、4480万细胞、149个蛋白的同切片H&E+多重免疫荧光数据，统一流程生成细胞级目标，在同一细胞上评测适配的病理基础模型（PFMs）与专用模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间蛋白组学成本高、仅限小规模研究队列，而H&E切片几乎覆盖所有患者；现有虚拟染色模型各自在小队列、自有panel和像素级指标上评测，跨队列迁移差，无法判断该基于哪种方法、H&E究竟能揭示哪些蛋白。

Method: 构建细胞级基准：统一pipeline把同切片H&E与多重免疫荧光对齐并提取每细胞蛋白表达作为目标；以单一细胞级协议适配多种病理基础模型，在匹配算力预算下微调专用模型，所有模型在同一批细胞、同一划分上评分；并分析蛋白可预测性与组织类型及细胞数量的关系。

Result: 适配后的PFM在所有队列上均为最准确模型，即使专用模型经过微调仍落后；但PFM在未训练队列上仅保留不到一半精度；蛋白可预测性取决于组织类型而非测量细胞数。

Conclusion: 通过固定细胞、目标与划分，CellPlex为“从常规H&E推断昂贵分子测量”提供统一评测标准，量化了H&E替代空间蛋白组学的边界，并公开数据、划分、评测代码与基线，作为未来病理基础模型与虚拟染色方法的测试平台。

Abstract: Spatial proteomics measures tens of proteins in every cell of a tissue section, but its cost confines it to small research cohorts, whereas hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E) slides exist for nearly every patient. Inferring single-cell spatial proteomics from H\&E would bring its analyses to routine pathology, and a growing number of virtual staining models pursue this goal. Each is evaluated on its own cohort, panel and pixel-level metric, and released models transfer poorly to new cohorts, leaving open which approach to build on and which proteins H\&E can reveal. We introduce CellPlex, a benchmark that poses the task at the level of the cell: seven cohorts with same-section H\&E and multiplexed immunofluorescence, from colorectal and breast cancer to lymph-node metastases, bone marrow and glioma, with 717 samples, 44.8 million cells and 149 proteins, processed by one pipeline into per-cell targets. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are adapted with one cell-level protocol, specialist models are fine-tuned under a matched budget, and all are scored on the same cells. Adapted PFMs are the most accurate models on every cohort, ahead of the specialists even after fine-tuning, but keep less than half of their accuracy on cohorts they were not trained on. Which proteins can be predicted depends on the tissue, not on how many cells were measured for them. By fixing the cells, targets and splits on which predictions are judged, CellPlex sets a common standard for inferring costly molecular measurements from routine H\&E and shows how far H\&E can stand in for spatial proteomics. We will release the data, splits, evaluation code and baselines as a testbed for developing and comparing future pathology foundation models and virtual staining methods.

</details>


### [233] [Latent Spectral Prompting for Multimodal Hyperspectral Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02512)
*Wangshu Cai,Jun Zhou,Lei Wang,Mohammad Aminul Islam,Xu Han,Kuldip Paliwal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SProTrack通过潜在光谱提示（latent spectral prompting）将预训练RGB跟踪器的时间建模能力迁移到高光谱视频域，用自编码器从完整高光谱帧学习全局场景级光谱表示以指导提示提取，无需密集标注即可桥接RGB-高光谱模态鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱视频在伪装目标、低光照等挑战场景下具有鲁棒跟踪潜力，但高光谱标注稀缺且RGB-高光谱域差异大，难以直接复用现代时序预训练RGB跟踪器。现有波段选择方法丢弃大量光谱信息，局部搜索裁剪式提示方法又缺乏全局场景理解。

Method: 将时间建模与光谱适配解耦：冻结/复用预训练RGB跟踪器以继承时序动态；用自编码器从完整高光谱帧自监督学习全局场景级潜在光谱表示；再由该潜在表示引导光谱提示（prompt）提取，并以紧凑的谱-空潜变量提示注入RGB兼容输入，实现无需大量重训与稠密监督的跨模态迁移。

Result: 在HOT2020与HOT2023数据集上取得最佳整体性能，并在各光谱域上表现稳定且强劲。

Conclusion: 以潜空间光谱提示作为轻量跨模态接口，可有效复用RGB基础模型的时序先验并注入高光谱语义，为标注稀缺的高光谱跟踪提供可扩展方案；但需在真实高光谱传感部署与跨传感器泛化上进一步验证。

Abstract: Hyperspectral videos provide rich spectral signatures for robust tracking under challenging conditions such as camouflage and low illumination. However, limited hyperspectral annotations and the large RGB-hyperspectral domain gap hinder the direct use of modern temporally pretrained RGB trackers. We propose SProTrack, a multimodal framework that transfers temporal knowledge from pretrained RGB trackers to the hyperspectral domain through latent spectral prompting. The key idea is to decouple temporal modeling from spectral adaptation, allowing temporal dynamics to be inherited from RGB foundation models while hyperspectral information is learned from unlabeled data in a self-supervised manner. Unlike band-selection methods that discard most spectral information or prompt-based approaches that rely on local-search crops, SProTrack learns a global, scene-level spectral representation from the full hyperspectral frame using an autoencoder. This latent representation is used to guide spectral prompt extraction while a pretrained RGB tracker preserves strong temporal modeling on RGB-compatible inputs. By encoding spectral-spatial structure into compact latent prompts, SProTrack bridges the RGB-hyperspectral modality gap without extensive retraining or dense supervision. Experiments on HOT2020 and HOT2023 demonstrate that SProTrack achieves the best overall performance, with strong results across all spectral domains.

</details>


### [234] [MedHEB: Benchmarking Medical Embeddings Across Heterogeneous Clinical Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02519)
*Yingshu Li,Shaoyang Zhou,Zhanyu Wang,Yunyi Liu,Xinyu Liang,Xi Zhang,Lingqiao Liu,Lei Wang,Luping Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MedHEB统一医学检索基准(54数据集、107任务，覆盖2D/3D/文本、跨模态视觉匹配、区域级文本到区域检索)，并发布MLLM参考嵌入模型MedEmb。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床证据本质是关系性的，现有医学嵌入评测多聚焦孤立匹配，无法判断模型能否在模态、外观与粒度变化下检索到相关证据。

Method: 构建统一基准，按证据形态(2D图像/3D体数据/文本)、配对类型(图-图、图-文、文-文、跨模态视觉匹配)、相关粒度(全局/问题条件/区域级)三轴划分，含分布内与留出源评测；单一排序协议下变换临床证据定义；另训MLLM-based MedEmb作为基线。

Result: 代表性模型在不同检索族上表现不均衡：传统图-文、文-文检索强的模型在跨模态视觉匹配与区域级任务上可靠性下降。

Conclusion: 现有医学嵌入空间能捕捉部分临床关系，但尚未实现跨异质证据的均衡检索；开源基准与MedEmb以支持临床有意义嵌入研究。

Abstract: Clinical evidence is inherently relational: medical images are interpreted with prior studies, cross-modal examinations, reports, and localized findings, and retrieving relevant evidence is therefore central to clinical interpretation. Recent foundation models increasingly encode these heterogeneous sources into shared embedding spaces, yet existing embedding evaluation often focuses on isolated matches, leaving unclear whether current models retrieve relevant evidence across changes in modality, appearance, and granularity. We introduce MedHEB, a unified benchmark with 107 retrieval tasks from 54 datasets, including both in-distribution and held-out-source evaluation, across three axes: evidence form (2D images, 3D volumes, text), pairing type (image--image, image--text, text--text, and modality-bridging visual matching), and relevance granularity (global, question-conditioned, region-level). Under a single ranking protocol, MedHEB varies clinically relevant evidence definitions to test whether embedding proximity remains meaningful across heterogeneous evidence, including modality-bridging visual retrieval and region-level text-to-region retrieval. Across representative models, performance is uneven across retrieval families: models strong on conventional image--text or text--text retrieval are less reliable on modality-bridging and region-level tasks. Current embedding spaces capture some clinical relationships well but do not yet provide balanced retrieval across heterogeneous evidence. We further provide MedEmb, an MLLM-based reference embedding model trained on the MedHEB ID split, as a reproducible baseline for unified 2D--3D--text medical retrieval. We release MedHEB with preprocessing scripts, evaluation code, access manifests, and MedEmb to support research on clinically meaningful medical embeddings.

</details>


### [235] [INTERACT: Learning Interaction-Aware World Dynamics from Driving Videos for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02526)
*Zhan Chen,Songyan Zhang,Wenhui Huang,Zirui Li,Zhidong Wang,Qihang Huang,Shiyu Fang,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: INTERACT 提出三阶段框架：先从无标注驾驶视频学习槽位（slot）化的对象中心世界模型，再以槽位上下文与视频转移推断隐式自车动作并条件化未来槽位预测，最后将槽位、隐动作与未来槽位蒸馏进轨迹规划器。在 NAVSIM 与 nuScenes 上验证，NAVSIM 上达 SOTA，安全关键碰撞指标提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶模型把场景编码为稠密视觉或 BEV 特征，对象级交互是隐式的；而安全自动驾驶需要预测自车运动如何影响周边交通参与者，因此需要显式的、动作条件的对象中心世界模型。

Method: 三阶段训练：(1) 用循环槽位（recurrent slots）将稠密视觉特征无监督聚类为时序一致的场景实体表示，无需目标标注；(2) 从槽位上下文与视频帧间转移反推隐自车动作，用以条件化未来槽位预测，建模自车与实体共演化；(3) 将学到的槽位、隐动作与未来槽位预测蒸馏到轨迹规划器，指导轨迹生成与选择。

Result: 在 NAVSIM 与 nuScenes 上大量实验验证有效性；NAVSIM 上取得 SOTA，尤其在安全关键的碰撞类指标上有提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 无监督对象中心世界模型可作为端到端规划的表征与监督来源，动作条件化未来预测是提升安全性的关键；局限在于仅开环/闭环仿真基准评测，缺少真实车辆部署与定量细节。

Abstract: Safe autonomous driving requires more than recognizing the current scene: the ego vehicle must anticipate how surrounding traffic participants will evolve under its own motion. However, existing end-to-end driving models typically encode scenes into dense visual or BEV features, leaving object-level interactions implicit. We propose (INTERACT INTERaction-aware Action-Conditioned Trajectory learning), a three-stage framework that learns a slot-based object-centric world model from unlabeled driving videos and transfers it to trajectory planning. INTERACT first learns recurrent slots that group dense visual features into temporally structured scene-entity representations without object annotations. It then infers latent ego actions from slot context and video transitions, and uses them to condition future slot prediction, capturing how ego motion and surrounding entities co-evolve. Finally, the learned slots, latent actions, and future slot predictions are distilled into a trajectory planner to guide trajectory generation and selection. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes validate the effectiveness of INTERACT. In particular, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM, with improvements in safety-critical collision metrics.

</details>


### [236] [PixelBench: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Images Pixel by Pixel?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02540)
*Haoquan Zhang,Feiyang Liu,Juanxi Tian,Wanhua Li,Haodong Duan,Weiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixelBench：让LLM直接用token文本化输出像素图（调色板+索引网格），无需图像tokenizer/decoder；提出PRT微调，提升16个视觉基准表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成视觉资产依赖SVG/CAD等高阶原语或需训练图像tokenizer与解码器。作者追问：LLM能否仅靠既有词表直接生成栅格像素图，并以此为探针检验其像素级视觉理解能力。

Method: 构建PixelBench，含text-to-pixel(T2P)、image-to-pixel(I2P)多分辨率生成任务及像素理解评测；模型先输出RGB调色板，再输出每像素调色板索引网格。进一步提出Pixel Reconstruction Tuning (PRT)，将caption-palette-grid轨迹与通用指令数据混合，从预训练checkpoint后训练Molmo2-4B。另做分辨率缩放消融，对比palette-matched下采样与专用像素化算法。

Result: T2P下最强模型可直接由文本生成可辨识图像；I2P低分辨率下优于匹配下采样及专用像素化算法。像素理解与生成性能强相关；性能随分辨率升高先升后降。PRT后训练的Molmo2-4B在16个视觉中心基准上全面提升。

Conclusion: LLM无需专用视觉编解码器即可完成像素级生成与理解，两者能力耦合；显式像素重建可作为有效的辅助视觉监督，提升通用视觉能力，但分辨率存在收益上限。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate visual assets through text-based formats such as SVG and CAD, but these symbolic representations describe images using high-level primitives rather than explicit raster values. We ask whether LLMs can instead generate pixel images directly through their existing vocabulary, without a learned image tokenizer or decoder. We introduce PixelBench, a benchmark for text-to-pixel (T2P) and image-to-pixel (I2P) generation across multiple resolutions, together with a complementary pixel-understanding evaluation. Models generate an RGB color palette followed by a grid of indices specifying the palette color of each output pixel. In T2P, the strongest models produce recognizable images directly from text. In I2P, the strongest models outperform palette-matched downsampling and specialized pixelization algorithms at low resolutions. Pixel-understanding performance correlates strongly with generation performance. A resolution-scaling study shows that pixel-generation performance often improves initially before declining at high resolutions. Finally, we introduce Pixel Reconstruction Tuning (PRT), which augments visual instruction tuning with caption-palette-grid trajectories. We post-train Molmo2-4B from its pretraining checkpoint by mixing general instruction data with our curated PRT data, improving performance across 16 visual-centric benchmarks, indicating that explicit pixel reconstruction can provide useful auxiliary supervision.

</details>


### [237] [Flat Features, Detailed Images? Simple Detail Control for Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02551)
*Qingtao Yu,Zhen Wang,Jiyang Zheng,Minghao Sun,Hongdong Li,Dylan Campbell*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无训练方法，通过将每token通道幅值平方向更高熵分布平移，并配时间感知调度器在中间采样步集中干预，实现对扩散Transformer生成图像细节程度的连续标量控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示词工程虽能提升文生图细节，但缺乏可靠、连续、解耦的控制；作者发现细节增强提示的共性规律是提高每个token能量分布的熵而基本保持其排序不变（分布展平即细节增加）。

Method: 在6个扩散Transformer上对比有/无细节增强提示的特征token分析；据此设计training-free干预：对每个token的通道幅值平方做熵提升式重分布（保持排序），结合时间感知调度器将干预集中于中间采样步；仅需少量代码，推理开销可忽略。

Result: 在多种扩散Transformer上实验表明，可连续调节细节指标，同时基本保持图像质量与语义结构。

Conclusion: 细节程度可由token能量分布熵这一标量连续控制，为生成模型提供简单、解耦、免训练的可控性手段。

Abstract: Prompt engineering is commonly used to encourage text-to-image models to generate more detailed images. However, it does not provide reliable, continuous, or disentangled control. We analyze feature tokens produced with and without detail-enhancing prompts across six diffusion transformers and observe a common pattern: these prompts tend to increase the entropy of each token's energy distribution while largely preserving its ordering. That is, flattening the distribution increases the level of detail. Motivated by this counter-intuitive finding, we introduce a simple training-free approach that continuously adjusts the level of detail according to a scalar. Specifically, it shifts the squared channel magnitudes of each token toward a higher entropy distribution with a time-aware scheduler to concentrate the intervention at intermediate sampling steps. Across extensive experiments on different types of diffusion transformers, we show that our approach provides continuous control over detail metrics while largely preserving image quality and semantic structure. It requires only a few lines of code and adds negligible inference time overhead.

</details>


### [238] [SeMo3D: Unifying 3D Generation, Editing, and Completion via Selective Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02568)
*Xiaokun Sun,Jian Yang,Zhenyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Selective Modeling 范式，将3D生成、编辑与补全统一为"仅在指定区域合成、其余保持不变"的问题，构建统一扩散模型 SeMo3D（含 Omni3DiT 架构），无需配对编辑/补全数据即可联合训练三任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D生成/编辑/补全被当作"重新生成完整资产"处理，导致任务割裂、未修改区域不一致，且编辑与补全依赖任务特定配对数据。

Method: 核心观察：三任务本质均为"合成指定区域并保留其余内容"。据此提出区域选择性去噪训练：在标准3D资产上随机选取不同大小的区域，仅对该区域加噪并计算损失，从而同时学习生成/编辑/补全。架构上提出 Omni3DiT——多条件3D扩散Transformer，显式区分待创建与待保留区域，并融合图像、文本、点云引导实现细粒度控制。

Result: 在三个基准上三项任务均超越SOTA；生成具备多模态可控性，编辑与补全在一致性与准确性上表现强；可作为agent的统一建模工具，通过自然语言交互高效完成3D创作。

Conclusion: 统一建模与区域选择性训练有效打通3D生成/编辑/补全，天然保证未修改内容一致性并免除配对数据需求，具备agent化3D创作的潜力。

Abstract: 3D generation, editing, and completion are typically treated as regenerating the complete 3D asset under task-specific constraints, even when only a local region needs modification. This leads to task isolation, inconsistency in content that should remain unchanged, and dependence on task-specific paired data. We address these issues with a key observation: the three tasks all synthesize a designated region while keeping the rest intact---the full region for generation, the target region for editing, and the missing region for completion. We term this paradigm Selective Modeling and build SeMo3D upon it; it naturally unifies the three tasks, preserves unchanged content by construction, and enables training without paired editing or completion data, since any 3D asset can be partitioned into a selected region and its context. For training, we propose region-selective denoising, which randomly selects regions of varying sizes on standard 3D assets and applies noise and loss only to them, jointly learning all three tasks. For architecture, we propose Omni3DiT, a multi-condition 3D diffusion transformer that distinguishes regions to create from those to retain and fuses image, text, and point guidance for fine-grained control. Experiments across three benchmarks show SeMo3D surpasses state-of-the-art methods on all tasks, delivering multimodal controllability in generation and strong consistency and accuracy in editing and completion. SeMo3D further serves as a unified modeling tool for agents, enabling efficient 3D creation through natural-language interaction. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [239] [SMILE: A Structured Multi-Agent Clinical Reasoning for Liver Ultrasound Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02581)
*Haris Ghafoor,Minjee Seo,Seonaeng cho,Keungmo Yang,Jaejun Lee,Kyungho Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SMILE 提出结构化多智能体临床推理框架，用图像描述、临床分期推理、VQA 三个专科智能体加 judge-VLM 共识过滤，生成肝脏超声结构化报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 以单一推理路径将超声外观直接映射为文本，受视觉-语言模态鸿沟、疾病视觉证据细微、疾病模式异质、配对监督稀缺等问题制约。

Method: 三智能体分工：形态学描述图像解读智能体、临床阶段推理智能体、面向定向问询的 VQA 智能体；其输出由 judge VLM 依据共识过滤提示进行聚合与审查，输出统一的临床连贯报告。

Result: 在公开肝脏超声数据集与内部临床数据集上稳定优于 SOTA VLM，ROUGE-1 提升最高 19.0%，临床 F1 提升 18.8%，VQA F1 分别为 0.82 与 0.65。

Conclusion: 多智能体+共识过滤可缓解单路径推理在少监督临床场景下的局限，但评测局限于医学超声报告生成，未涉及通用智能体/具身或三维重建任务。

Abstract: Automated liver ultrasound report generation improves the diagnosis of liver diseases by producing clinically structured descriptions of anatomical and disease-related findings. However, current generative vision-language models (VLMs) often rely on a single reasoning pathway that maps ultrasound appearance directly to textual descriptions. In addition to the inherent vision-language modality gap, this design is limited for liver ultrasound because disease interpretation is constrained by subtle visual evidence, heterogeneous disease patterns, and limited paired supervision. To address these limitations, we propose SMILE, a Structured Multi-agent clInicaL rEasoning framework that uses multiple complementary specialist agents to interpret ultrasound images and consolidates their outputs through a judge-guided consensus mechanism. Our approach employs three specialized agents: an image interpretation agent for morphological descriptions, a clinical-stage reasoning agent, and a visual question answering (VQA) agent for targeted queries. These agent responses are then aggregated and scrutinized by a judge VLM using a consensus filtering prompt to produce a unified, clinically coherent output. Across a public liver ultrasound dataset and an internal clinical dataset, SMILE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art VLMs, achieving up to 19.0\% improvement in ROUGE-1 and 18.8\% improvement in clinical F1-score, while reaching VQA F1-scores of 0.82 and 0.65 on public and internal datasets, respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of SMILE for data-scarce and limited-supervision clinical settings. Our models, datasets, and code are available \href{ this https URL }{here}.

</details>


### [240] [AVID: A 5T fMRI Dataset for Benchmarking Auditory-induced Visual Mental Imagery Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02593)
*Shiqi Shen,Shurui Li,Xilin Zhang,Yuanning Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AVID：首个面向听觉诱发视觉心理意象（VMI）解码的训练规模5.0T fMRI数据集，约67小时、9名被试，含场景级复杂划分与属性受控简单划分，并提出解耦“源图像一致性”与“语义对齐”的标准化评测协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VMI解码受限于缺乏专用训练规模数据集：依赖视觉提示或短期记忆图像，引入视觉与记忆混淆，难以分离内生图像构建的神经活动；且对视觉属性缺乏描述性控制，无法系统评估细粒度细节。

Method: 以听觉叙述（普通话描述）诱发视觉心理意象，采集约67小时密集5.0T fMRI（9名被试），构建两个互补子集：自然场景描述的场景级复杂集与显式指定视觉属性的受控简单集；并形式化标准化评测协议，将重建结果与源图像的一致性同语义对齐分别度量。

Result: 基线的定性与定量结果显示，现有重建流程在AVID上仍受限；表现最好的重建能保留口语描述中的可辨识场景级语义，但细粒度视觉细节恢复不足。

Conclusion: AVID通过训练规模专用神经记录与标准化评测资源，为意象专用模型开发提供数据基础，并成为在显著降低感官污染条件下评估VMI解码的基准。

Abstract: Visual mental imagery (VMI) decoding uses brain activity to reconstruct internally generated visual scenes, providing a potential pathway for externalizing internal experiences and developing neuroprosthetic communication interfaces. However, progress is limited by the lack of dedicated, training-scale VMI datasets. Current VMI paradigms often rely on visual prompts or short-term memory images, introducing visual and mnemonic confounds that make it difficult to disentangle neural activity associated with endogenous image construction from signals driven by prior or concurrent visual input. Furthermore, existing VMI datasets offer limited descriptive control over individual visual attributes, making it difficult to systematically assess fine grained visual details. To address these gaps, we introduce AVID, the first dedicated training-scale 5.0 Tesla functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) resource for auditory-induced VMI decoding. AVID comprises approximately 67 hours of dense recordings from nine participants. The dataset is structured into two complementary splits: a scene-level complex split using naturalistic Mandarin descriptions and a controlled simple split with explicitly specified visual attributes. We further formalize a standardized evaluation protocol that decouples source-image consistency from semantic alignment, allowing for a more nuanced assessment of imagery reconstruction. Baseline qualitative and quantitative results show that current reconstruction pipelines remain limited on AVID, although the most successful reconstructions preserve recognizable scene level semantics from spoken descriptions. By combining dedicated training-scale neural recordings and standardized evaluation resources, AVID provides both a data foundation for imagery-specific model development and a benchmark for evaluating VMI decoding with substantially reduced sensory contamination.

</details>


### [241] [BGD-SF PolySegNet: boundary-guided dynamic selective fusion network for robust polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02603)
*Nishi Kanta Paul,Shamia Maherin,Morsheda Akter,Moinul Hossain,Md Kishor Morol*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BGD-SF PolySegNet提出边界引导的编码器-解码器架构，将边界信息作为主动架构组件控制多尺度上下文聚合、跳跃特征融合与掩膜细化三阶段，显著提升结肠镜息肉分割的边界质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有息肉分割模型在Dice上表现良好但边界分割困难，多数方法仅将边界作为训练期额外损失信号，网络无法显式学习边界引导的特征选择与掩膜细化。

Method: 以预训练EfficientNet-B4为骨干，设计三个模块：边界引导动态级联多尺度上下文聚合（BGD-CMSCA）、边界引导选择性注意力融合（BG-SAGF）与多级边界引导头（MBGH），在3,535张标注图像（Kvasir-SEG、BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp-Small、PolypGen）上训练，四个基准数据集外部验证。

Result: 内部测试集Dice 0.887、IoU 0.839、边界F1 0.531、HD95 30.32、ASSD 18.10，边界F1/HD95/ASSD较最强CNN基线提升15.7%/27.5%/34.6%；CVC-ClinicDB/CVC-ColonDB/ETIS-Larib/CVC-300的Dice分别为0.891/0.776/0.863/0.885；35 FPS、22.51M参数；Wilcoxon检验显示对7个消融变体中6个的边界F1提升显著（p<0.001，r=0.215–0.434）。

Conclusion: 将边界引导作为主动架构组件而非辅助损失，可可测量地改善息肉边界描绘能力，但属医学影像分割领域工作，方法洞察对通用视觉/具身系统迁移有限。

Abstract: Effective polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images is crucial for early detection of colorectal cancer, a leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide. While current deep learning models perform well on traditional Dice benchmarks, border segmentation remains difficult. Most methods use boundary information only as an additional loss signal during training, which prevents the network from explicitly learning border-guided feature selection or mask refinement. This paper introduces BGD-SF PolySegNet, a boundary-guided encoder-decoder architecture that controls three phases of the segmentation pipeline: dynamic multi-scale context aggregation, selective skip-feature fusion, and final mask refinement. The architecture comprises a pretrained EfficientNet-B4 backbone and three proposed modules: Boundary-Guided Dynamic Cascaded Multi-Scale Context Aggregation (BGD-CMSCA), Boundary-Guided Selective Attention Fusion (BG-SAGF), and a Multi-Level Boundary Guidance Head (MBGH). The model is trained on 3,535 annotated images from Kvasir-SEG, BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp-Small, and PolypGen, and evaluated on four held-out benchmark datasets. On the internal test set, BGD-SF achieves a Dice of 0.887, IoU of 0.839, mask-derived Boundary F1 of 0.531, HD95 of 30.32, and ASSD of 18.10, improving Boundary F1, HD95, and ASSD by 15.7%, 27.5%, and 34.6% over the strongest CNN baselines. External validation on CVC-ClinicDB, CVC-ColonDB, ETIS-Larib, and CVC-300 yielded Dice scores of 0.891, 0.776, 0.863, and 0.885, respectively. The model runs at 35 FPS with 22.51M parameters. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm statistically significant mask-derived Boundary F1 improvements over six of seven ablation variants (p < 0.001; small-to-moderate effect sizes, r = 0.215-0.434), demonstrating that integrating boundary guidance as an active architectural component measurably advances polyp boundary delineation.

</details>


### [242] [Latent Diffusion-GAN: Adversarial Learning in the Autoencoded Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02625)
*U-Chae Jun,Jaeeun Ko,Jiwoo Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LD-GAN 将潜空间扩散模型预训练的 VAE 复用为基于能量的判别器，并引入结构一致性能量，在不增加额外判别器参数、不改变原采样流程的前提下为扩散模型加入对抗训练，提升高频细节保真度与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于似然（去噪分数匹配）训练会使扩散模型对高频细节（纹理、边缘）过平滑，限制感知保真度；而 GAN 对抗训练虽提升锐度，却需额外判别器，增加算力并使训练不稳定。作者希望无额外参数地获得对抗收益。

Method: 提出 LD-GAN：把潜在扩散模型中的预训练 VAE 当作能量基判别器（encoder/decoder 特征构造能量），从而复用原有参数实现对抗训练，并保持大规模数据学到的结构化潜先验；同时提出结构一致性能量，对齐编码器与解码器特征表示，增强感知质量及与预训练潜空间的兼容性。整体不修改原有扩散推理管线。

Result: 在多种生成任务的广泛实验中，相比 SOTA 基线显著提升样本保真度、感知锐度与多样性，同时保持高效稳定的训练动态。

Conclusion: 对抗目标可以以"复用 VAE 作判别器 + 特征一致性正则"的零额外参数方式注入潜扩散训练，是提升扩散生成感知质量的一种低成本通用方案。

Abstract: Diffusion models are powerful generative frameworks for producing high-quality images by denoising latent variables from random noise. However, training with likelihood-based objectives, such as denoising score matching, can lead to locally over-smoothed high-frequency details, including fine textures and sharp edges, thereby limiting perceptual fidelity and structural detail. Adversarial training with GANs enhances sharpness but typically requires additional discriminator networks, increasing computational costs and destabilizing training. To this end, we propose Latent Diffusion Generative Adversarial Networks (LD-GAN), a novel framework that seamlessly integrates adversarial learning into diffusion models without modifying their original pipeline. LD-GAN leverages the pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent diffusion models as an energy-based discriminator, enabling adversarial training without extra parameters and preserving the structured latent priors learned from large datasets. We also introduce a structural consistency energy that aligns encoder and decoder feature representations, thereby enhancing perceptual quality and compatibility with the pretrained latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LD-GAN significantly improves sample fidelity, perceptual sharpness, and diversity over state-of-the-art baseline methods across various generation tasks while ensuring efficient training dynamics.

</details>


### [243] [UniCross3D: Unified Cross-View and Cross-Domain Diffusion for Consistent Single-Image 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02631)
*U-Chae Jun,Jaeeun Ko,Jiwoo Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出UniCross3D统一跨视角-跨域扩散框架，用跨视角隐变量正则保证几何一致性，并用基于成像物理的跨域互信息目标对齐颜色与法线，实现单图高质量3D重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单张RGB图像重建三维几何与外观存在遮挡、光照变化、纹理-几何纠缠等固有歧义；现有扩散式新视角合成方法缺乏跨视角几何一致性与跨域语义对齐。

Method: 统一扩散框架：1) 跨视角隐变量正则（惩罚潜变量方差）以强制合成视角间的几何一致性；2) 基于图像形成物理的跨域互信息目标，显式对齐合成颜色图与法线图。

Result: 实验显示在视角一致性与语义对齐上显著优于SOTA，在复杂纹理与歧义视角下获得更高保真度的重建结果。

Conclusion: 跨视角正则与跨域互信息对齐可有效缓解单图3D生成的几何不一致问题，是一个可推广的扩散式3D生成范式。

Abstract: Reconstructing detailed geometry and realistic appearance from a single RGB image is essential yet fundamentally challenging due to inherent ambiguities such as occlusion, lighting variations, and texture-geometry entanglement. While recent diffusion-based generative models have significantly improved novel view synthesis, existing approaches suffer from two critical limitations: lack of cross-view geometric consistency and insufficient cross-domain semantic alignment. To address these issues, we introduce UniCross3D, a unified cross-view and cross-domain diffusion framework designed explicitly for consistent and physically coherent 3D generation. UniCross3D features two novel contributions: (1) a cross-view latent regularization that enforces cross-view geometric consistency across synthesized viewpoints by penalizing latent variance, and (2) a cross-domain mutual information objective grounded in the physics of image formation, explicitly aligning synthesized color and normal maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniCross3D achieves significantly improved view consistency and semantic alignment over state-of-the-art methods and yields higher-fidelity reconstructions, particularly under challenging textures and ambiguous viewpoints.

</details>


### [244] [ReinSeg: Retrieval-Guided Bounded Multimodal Refinement for 3-D Road Anomaly Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02648)
*Haifa Zhang,Yijing Wang,Zhiqiang Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReinSeg：以检索引导、相对范数有界的多模态残差细化，在冻结 LIDO 打分接口上融合环视图像上下文，显著提升 LiDAR 三维路面异常分割的 AP 与高召回下 FPR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维道路异常分割的核心难点是：异常稀疏、正常结构密集，需要在保持逐点度量定位的同时把危险异常排在正常路面结构之前；纯 LiDAR 难以区分"意外的危险物"与"形状同样奇怪的正常结构"，而环视图像提供互补语义。目标是在不破坏已训练好的 LiDAR-only 异常打分接口、且仅用分布内语义标签监督的条件下引入视觉证据。

Method: 提出 ReinSeg 检索引导的有界多模态细化框架：1) 将被占据的 LiDAR BEV 栅格作为查询，在一个由 8 路环视图像构成的共享记忆库中检索场景相关上下文，检索模块不依赖标定参数；2) 将检索到的视觉上下文以"相对范数有界残差"的形式回注至 LiDAR 点特征，从而保持冻结的 LIDO 异常打分接口不变；3) 细化模块仅用分布内语义标签优化，不做异常标注训练。另配接口对齐与组件隔离实验验证各要素必要性。

Result: 在 STU（Spotting the Unexpected）基准上，验证集 AP 从 27.54% 提升至 35.67%，95% 异常召回下的假阳性率由 34.85% 降至 10.61%，高召回筛选集从 6754 万点缩减到 2055 万点；相对 REL，AP 高 24.99 个百分点、FPR95 低 0.99 点。消融显示检索场景图像与相对范数约束缺一不可；在相机缺失、损坏或错位条件下仍优于纯 LiDAR，运行速度 21.8 FPS。

Conclusion: 结果表明：对场景特定视觉证据进行有界检索式融合，是提升三维道路危险感知可靠性的有效途径，且能在冻结下游打分器、无需异常标注的前提下稳定生效。

Abstract: 3-D road anomaly segmentation is essential for risk-aware perception in autonomous driving. Its central challenge is to rank sparsely observed hazards ahead of abundant normal road structures while preserving point-wise metric localization. LiDAR provides accurate 3-D point support, whereas surround-view imagery offers complementary semantic context for separating unexpected hazards from challenging normal structures. We propose ReinSeg, a retrieval-guided bounded multimodal refinement framework for point-wise road anomaly segmentation. Occupied LiDAR bird's-eye-view cells retrieve scene-specific context from a shared memory of eight surround-view images without supplying calibration variables to the retrieval module. A relative-norm-bounded residual returns this context to the LiDAR point features, so the frozen LIDO anomaly-scoring interface is preserved, and the refinement is optimized with in-distribution semantic labels only. On the Spotting the Unexpected (STU) benchmark, ReinSeg improves validation average precision from 27.54\% to 35.67\% and reduces the false-positive rate at 95\% anomaly recall from 34.85\% to 10.61\%, shrinking the high-recall screening set from 67.54 to 20.55 million points. Relative to REL, AP is 24.99 percentage points higher and FPR95 is 0.99 points lower. Matched interfaces and component isolation show that retrieved scene imagery and the relative-norm bound are both essential, and ReinSeg stays above LiDAR-only performance under missing, corrupted, or misaligned camera inputs while running at 21.8 frames per second. These results establish bounded retrieval of scene-specific visual evidence as an effective route to reliable 3-D road-hazard perception.

</details>


### [245] [Computer Vision Applications for Art History: Reflections and paradigms for future research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02649)
*Amalia Foka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 从计算机科学视角分析艺术史期刊论文，识别艺术史家实际使用的图像特征，并将其转译为计算机视觉可理解的问题定义，进而提出以艺术史核心问题为导向的CV应用新范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 艺术史界对计算方法持续存在争议，原因之一在于现有计算研究未触及当代艺术史研究的核心问题；两个研究社群缺乏紧密协作，使得将艺术史方法形式化为明确的计算机视觉问题极为困难。

Method: 提出一种方法论：以计算机科学视角系统分析艺术史期刊中的论文文本，抽取其中艺术史家所依赖的图像特征，并用直接、可交流的术语向CV社群描述与界定。

Result: 识别出艺术史研究所使用的图像特征类别，并给出若干可弥合两个社群隔阂、面向艺术史核心问题的计算机视觉应用范式作为新起点。

Conclusion: 计算机视觉在艺术史中要产生实质价值，需以艺术史核心问题为出发点进行问题定义，并依赖跨学科协作；所提范式可作为未来研究的起点。

Abstract: One of the contributing factors to the continuing debate among art historians over the use of computational methods in art history research is that they do not consider the core of today's art history research questions. The lack of close collaboration between the two involved research communities makes the definition of contemporary art-historical methods as well-defined computer vision problems extremely difficult. For that purpose, it is devised as a methodology to study articles in art history journals from a computer science perspective. The objective is to identify which image features art historians utilise within their research and describe them in immediate and meaningful terms to the computer vision research community. Finally, some paradigms that could serve as a new starting point for exploring how computer vision applications for art history can address the core of today's art history research are given.

</details>


### [246] [Probe-Guided Gradient Balancing for Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02651)
*Vu Vo,Haytham M. Fayek,Thuy Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PGGB：用探测分类器估计各模态表征质量，以利用度差距（utilization gap）为信号，对弱模态梯度做有界、平滑的放大调制，不改变损失与融合架构，可与抑制类方法组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合训练多模态网络中，收敛快的模态主导共享融合目标并压制弱模态的梯度；现有做法多为抑制强模态，而直接提升弱模态失败，因为由联合损失派生的监控信号本身仍被强模态主导。

Method: 在每个模态的 stop-gradient 特征上挂轻量线性分类器，独立评估表征质量；两分数之差即"利用度差距"，作为不平衡信号，经有界且平滑的调制自适应缩放弱模态梯度。损失函数与融合结构不变，因而可与 throttling 方法组合。

Result: 在跨四个领域、2–4 模态的八个基准上，PGGB 在高不平衡数据集上优于 SOTA，在低/可忽略不平衡时仍具竞争力；理论上给出有界缩放、自衰减及标准 SGD 在平滑与有界方差假设下的下降界。

Conclusion: PGGB 提供了一种无需改动架构与损失、以独立探测信号驱动弱模态梯度增强的通用多模态训练改进，兼顾不平衡鲁棒性与理论保障，但属通用多模态机器学习方法，与具身/VLA/三维重建等核心方向仅弱相关。

Abstract: Jointly trained multimodal networks frequently underutilize weaker modalities, as faster-learning modalities dominate the shared fusion objective and suppress gradients reaching slower ones. Most existing approaches throttle dominant modalities, whereas directly boosting weaker modalities often fails because monitoring signals derived from the joint loss remain dominated by stronger modalities. We propose Probe-Guided Gradient Boosting (PGGB), a gradient modulation approach that boosts weaker modalities while preserving the strength of dominant ones. PGGB attaches lightweight linear classifiers to stop-gradient features from each modality to estimate representation quality independently. The gap between these scores, termed the utilization gap, provides an imbalance signal used to adaptively scale weaker-modality gradients through bounded and smoothed modulation. PGGB is composable with throttling methods, as it leaves the loss function and fusion architecture unchanged. Experiments across eight benchmarks spanning four domains and 2-4 modalities demonstrate that PGGB outperforms state-of-the-art methods on highly imbalanced multimodal datasets while remaining competitive under low or negligible imbalance. We further establish bounded scaling, self-attenuation, and a descent bound for standard SGD under smoothness and bounded-variance assumptions. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [247] [VerdictAD: Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Decision-Guided Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02654)
*Shangquan Sun,Wenjun Luo,Yuanzhi Wang,Ruiqi Li,Ruoyu Chen,Jiachen Liu,Shijian Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VerdictAD：免训练即插即用框架，用类型化视觉决策模型为查询图像及局部区域输出结构化判定概率，作为互补证据细化现有少样本异常检测器的全局分数与异常图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
