Motivation: 少样本异常检测依赖查询与正常参考的特征差异，但正常外观变化也会产生高异常分（假阳性），而结构/逻辑型异常又不产生显著局部特征差异（假阴性），单纯视觉差异不等于真实缺陷。

Method: 不替换现有检测器，而引入类型化决策模型：对查询图像及区域与少量正常参考做判定，直接输出结构化决策概率而无需文本生成；Global Verdict Refinement（GVR）用图像级决策校正整体异常分，Local Verdict Refinement（LVR）聚合区域决策校正异常图；并可与简单 DINOv2 检测器组合。

Result: 与 DINOv2 检测器组合时在半监督 one-shot/few-shot 设置下具竞争力；作为即插即用模块在 MVTec AD、VisA、MVTec LOCO AD 上一致提升现有检测器。

Conclusion: 视觉决策信号可作为对特征差异检测器的有效互补修正，免训练、可插拔地提升少样本工业异常检测。

Abstract: Detecting defects in real-world industrial inspection often requires learning from only a few normal images per category. Recent few-shot anomaly detection methods have achieved strong performance by measuring feature differences between query images and normal references. However, visual differences do not always indicate genuine defects, as normal appearance variations can also produce high anomaly scores. Conversely, structural or logical anomalies may not produce strong local feature differences, making them difficult to detect. To address this limitation, we introduce VerdictAD, a training-free framework that refines existing anomaly detectors through visual decisions. Rather than replacing existing detectors, VerdictAD adopts a typed decision model to assess the query image and its local regions against a few normal references. By directly producing structured decision probabilities without text generation, the model provides complementary evidence for refining anomaly responses at different spatial scales. Building on this capability, we introduce two modules: Global Verdict Refinement (GVR) uses image-level decisions to refine the overall anomaly score, while Local Verdict Refinement (LVR) aggregates regional decisions to refine the anomaly map. Combined with a simple DINOv2-based detector, VerdictAD achieves competitive performance in one-shot and few-shot anomaly detection. More importantly, as a plug-and-play framework, it consistently improves existing anomaly detectors across MVTec AD, VisA, and MVTec LOCO AD, achieving strong results across one-shot and few-shot settings. Our code and experimental logs are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [248] [OctreeSplat: Hierarchical Octree-Guided Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02658)
*Yibin Zhao,Yihan Pan,Wenli Yang,Jun Nan,Jianjun Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OctreeSplat：基于冻结视觉基础模型特征构建层级八叉树并预测稠密化分数，实现按局部复杂度自适应分配高斯基元的前馈式3DGS，仅训练76M新增参数、35 GPU小时，在Replica/TUM/TnT/DTU上取得有竞争力的RGB、深度与表面重建效果，同时减少基元数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈式3DGS虽免去逐场景优化，但固定图像/空间分辨率导致基元无法按局部复杂度自适应分配，冗余与不足并存。

Method: 从冻结VFM提取多视角特征与几何先验→构建层级八叉树→预测稠密化分数，在空间上变密度放置高斯基元；采用随机实体体素渲染改善深度渲染与几何监督以支持表面重建；可选测试时优化（TTO）校正相机参数。

Result: Replica、TUM、Tanks and Temples、DTU上RGB视图合成、深度合成与表面重建均具竞争力；基元数量减少而质量维持。

Conclusion: 八叉树引导的层级自适应稠密化可为前馈3DGS带来更高效的原语分配；但未涉及机器人/具身交互场景，泛化性（in-the-wild、实时推理）与代码开源情况未在摘要中体现。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for novel view synthesis (NVS) and 3D reconstruction. Feed-forward methods avoid costly per-scene optimization, but fixed image or spatial resolutions limit their ability to allocate primitives according to local complexity. We present OctreeSplat, a hierarchical octree-guided feed-forward Gaussian splatting. OctreeSplat extracts multi-view features and geometric priors from a frozen visual foundation model (VFM), constructs a hierarchical octree, and predicts densification scores. The resulting representation allocates Gaussian primitives at spatially varying densities according to local complexity. Stochastic solids volume rendering improves depth rendering, strengthens geometric supervision, and supports surface reconstruction. When camera parameters are available, an optional test-time optimization (TTO) module improves agreement between predicted and ground-truth parameters. Training updates only 76 million additional parameters and requires 35 GPU-hours. Experiments on Replica, TUM, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive RGB view synthesis, depth synthesis, and surface reconstruction. OctreeSplat reduces the number of Gaussian primitives while maintaining high reconstruction quality.

</details>


### [249] [PriCBMs: Multi-granular Concept Bottleneck Vision-Language Models for Visual Privacy Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02661)
*Shenglei Pei,Haotian Sun,Pengfei Li,Bingxu Lu,Wenlong Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出隐私概念瓶颈模型（PriCBMs），用隐私相关概念作为中间语义表示，先做视觉-概念匹配定位与类别相关的隐私线索，再由概念响应预测多标签隐私类别，并设计概念选择策略与全局-区域建模模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体图像广泛传播，需要识别无意暴露的隐私信息。多标签视觉隐私识别存在两个难题：(1) 隐私类别是高层次语义属性，与视觉物体并非一一对应（同类别可对应不同物体、同物体可含不同隐私类型），直接预测方法缺乏对类别相关隐私线索的显式引导，映射过程隐含、性能受限；(2) 隐私线索分散在图像局部区域，全图特征表达不足。

Method: 1) 引入隐私相关概念作为中间语义表示，构建概念瓶颈结构：先通过视觉-概念匹配识别类别相关线索，再基于概念响应预测隐私类别，使预测过程可解释；2) 概念选择策略：综合目标类别相关性、跨类别判别性、语义多样性筛选概念；3) 全局-区域建模模块：在保留全局上下文的同时捕获局部隐私证据。

Result: 在 VISPR 与 FineViP 两个数据集上，四项多标签评价指标全部优于所评估的对比方法；消融实验与概念质量分析验证了各设计组件的有效性；代码已开源。

Conclusion: 将概念瓶颈模型引入多标签视觉隐私识别，以显式概念中介替代隐性图像到标签的映射，兼顾可解释性与精度；局部区域证据与全局上下文结合是处理分散隐私线索的有效手段。

Abstract: Widespread image sharing on social media has increased the need for visual privacy recognition to identify inadvertently exposed privacy information. However, multi-label visual privacy recognition presents two challenges. First, privacy categories represent high-level semantic attributes and do not have a one-to-one correspondence with visual objects. Different visual objects may involve the same privacy category, while the same type of object may contain different types of privacy-sensitive information. In this setting, direct prediction methods generally lack explicit guidance for identifying category-relevant privacy cues, leaving this process implicit in the learned image-to-label mapping and potentially limiting classification performance. Second, privacy cues are often distributed across image regions and may not be adequately represented by whole-image features. To address these challenges, we propose Privacy Concept Bottleneck Models (PriCBMs). By introducing privacy-related concepts as intermediate semantic representations, PriCBMs first identify category-relevant privacy cues through visual-concept matching and then predict privacy categories based on concept responses. This process makes privacy predictions more interpretable. To improve the quality of these concepts, we design a concept selection strategy based on target-category relevance, cross-category discriminability, and semantic diversity. Meanwhile, we introduce a global-region modeling module to capture localized privacy evidence while retaining global context. Experiments on VISPR and FineViP show that PriCBMs outperform evaluated competitors across all four multi-label metrics. Ablation studies and concept-quality analyses support the effectiveness of the proposed design. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [250] [TME-ContextNet: Class-Conditioned Spatial Supervision and Grouped Decoding for Joint Nuclei Instance Segmentation and Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02671)
*Rukang Ma,Bingxue Wang,Liwen Zou,Yingying Cao,Zhenghua Cai,Yu Li,Dong Wang,Huiyu Zhou,Luying Gui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TME-ContextNet：多任务框架，用距离变换生成的类别条件空间监督+局部-全局上下文模块+分组解码器，联合完成细胞核实例分割与分类，参数比HoVer-Net更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细胞核实例分割与分类需要精确边界和邻域信息以区分形态相似的细胞类型，但额外组织区域标注代价高。

Method: 将核标注通过欧氏距离变换扩展为稠密类别条件空间目标（无需额外器官/组织标注），并给出最近区域解释与扰动稳定性分析；局部-全局上下文模块结合空洞卷积与自注意力；分组任务解码器按几何类与语义类分组以减少冗余计算；空间头仅用于训练监督，推理时移除。

Result: PanMix/CoNSeP/PanNuke Dice 分别为 80.23%/65.32%/79.13%，mPQ+ 为 67.62%/35.50%/43.74%（PanNuke 为三折平均）；消融验证距离监督与分组解码的组合及对任务配置的依赖；参数量 36.40M vs HoVer-Net 54.74M。

Conclusion: 提出一种紧凑、上下文感知的联合细胞核分析方案，适用于计算病理。

Abstract: Joint nuclei instance segmentation and classification requires precise boundaries and neighborhood information that helps distinguish morphologically similar cell types. We present TME-ContextNet, a multi-task framework that learns class-conditioned spatial context from existing nuclear annotations and organizes decoding into geometry-related and semantic task groups. Class-conditioned spatial supervision extends nuclear labels into a dense target using Euclidean distance transforms, requiring no additional tissue-region annotation. We derive its nearest-region interpretation and characterize its stability to small annotation perturbations. A local--global context module combines dilated convolution and self-attention, while a grouped task decoder reduces redundant computation. The spatial head supplies training supervision and is omitted during inference. Experiments on PanMix, CoNSeP, and PanNuke yield Dice scores of 80.23%, 65.32%, and 79.13%, and mean multi-class panoptic quality (mPQ+) scores of 67.62%, 35.50%, and 43.74%, respectively. PanNuke results are averaged across three test folds. Target and decoder controls support the combination of distance-based supervision and grouped decoding while identifying their dependence on task configuration. The framework uses 36.40 million parameters, compared with 54.74 million for HoVer-Net. These findings support a compact, context-aware formulation for joint nuclei analysis in computational pathology.

</details>


### [251] [Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Convolutional Network with Contrastive Score Refinement for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02685)
*Minh Ta Tran Nhat,Yuning Ye,Yuseok Ban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DyGCN提出几何约束的动态超图卷积网络，用GeoHC模块动态构建动作特定超边，并用CSR原型对比学习精炼兼容性分数，在NTU RGB+D、NTU RGB+D 120和Northwestern-UCLA上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统GCN仅做成对关节建模，难以刻画人体运动的高阶交互；现有超图方法依赖基于解剖学先验的静态结构，缺乏捕捉动作特定动态关节关联的灵活性。

Method: 核心为DyGCT块，含GeoHC与CSR两个组件：GeoHC利用几何约束的二阶兼容性动态构造动作特定超边，摆脱静态超边结构；CSR在超图构建过程中用基于原型的对比学习显式精炼成对兼容性分数以增强超边判别性，且仅在训练阶段生效，推理零开销。

Result: 在NTU RGB+D、NTU RGB+D 120、Northwestern-UCLA三个基准上实验验证有效，达到广泛使用基准上的SOTA性能，并开源代码。

Conclusion: 动态、动作自适应的超图结构优于静态解剖先验超图；训练期对比精炼可无推理成本地提升骨架动作识别性能，但应用面局限于骨架分类，未涉机器人或物理交互场景。

Abstract: Skeleton-based action recognition is a pivotal task in computer vision; however, conventional Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) are often constrained by pairwise joint modeling, which fails to capture the intricate high-order interactions inherent in human movement. While recent hypergraph-based methods attempt to address this limitation, they typically rely on static structures derived from anatomical priors, lacking the flexibility to capture dynamic, action-specific joint correlations. To this end, we propose DyGCN, a Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Convolutional Network for skeleton-based action recognition. At the core of DyGCN is the Dynamic Hypergraph Construction Network with Contrastive Score Refinement (DyGCT) block, which comprises two novel components: the Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Construction (GeoHC) module and the Contrastive Score Refinement (CSR) module. Specifically, GeoHC dynamically constructs action-specific hyperedges by leveraging geometry-constrained second-order compatibility, transcending the limitations of static hyperedge structures. Furthermore, CSR explicitly refines the pairwise compatibility scores during hypergraph construction through prototype-based contrastive learning, fostering more discriminative action-specific hyperedges, with zero inference-time overhead as CSR operates only during training. Extensive experiments on NTU RGB+D, NTU RGB+D 120, and Northwestern-UCLA validate the effectiveness of DyGCN, achieving state-of-the-art performance on widely used benchmarks. The source code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [252] [Discovering Semantic Granularity in Images through Clustering of Pretrained Visual Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02686)
*Ying Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出基于表示驱动的方法，通过对预训练视觉模型特征拼接后用SVD投影得到像素级主表示图(PRM)，并用其聚类在无监督下发现多粒度语义区域，同时提出语义连续性率(SCR)及其SNR分析来评估表示适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练视觉表示是否内在编码多粒度语义结构尚不清楚，缺乏无需语义监督即可发现多粒度有意义图像区域的手段。

Method: 选取预训练视觉模型的多层特征图拼接，经SVD投影得到逐像素主表示图(PRM)；对PRM进行语义聚类。引入基于轮廓系数的语义连续性率(SCR)量化不同候选粒度下簇内/簇间表示一致性，并分析SCR剖面的信噪比(SNR)以判断表示的适用性。

Result: 在COCO-2017与VOC-2012验证集上用Hungarian匹配IoU(HIoU)评测，分割性能与对比方法相比具有竞争力；SNR更高的PRM在初始聚类数区间内倾向于产生跨多个粒度更有语义的区域。

Conclusion: 无需语义监督、仅通过聚类PRM即可发现有用的语义粒度，验证了预训练视觉表示隐含多粒度语义结构，且SNR可作为表示适用性的诊断指标。

Abstract: Semantic granularity, which refers to the levels at which visual representations organize image content into meaningful entities, is fundamental to image understanding. However, whether pretrained visual representations inherently encode semantic structures at multiple granularities remains poorly understood. This paper presents a representation-driven approach for discovering semantically meaningful image regions at different granularities through clustering of pretrained visual representations without semantic supervision. Specifically, we concatenate selected feature maps extracted from a pretrained visual model and apply a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based projection to derive pixel-wise principal representation maps (PRMs). The resulting PRMs capture implicit semantic structures embedded in pretrained visual representations, making them accessible to subsequent semantic clustering. We then introduce the semantic continuity rate (SCR), based on the silhouette principle, to quantify the coherence of pixel-wise representations within and between clusters at different candidate granularities. Furthermore, we analyze the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of SCR profiles to assess representation suitability for discovering semantic regions at multiple granularities. Our results indicate that PRMs exhibiting higher SNR values over an initial range of cluster numbers tend to yield more semantically meaningful regions across multiple granularities. We evaluate the proposed approach on the COCO-2017 and VOC-2012 validation datasets using Hungarian-matched intersection over union (HIoU). The results demonstrate competitive segmentation performance among the compared methods, supporting the feasibility of discovering useful semantic granularities through clustering PRMs without semantic supervision.

</details>


### [253] [3L-D: A Low-Light Level Dataset from a Sensor-Agnostic, Alignment-Preserving Acquisition Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02695)
*Léo Rueff,Maurgène Ghezal,Valentin Gorse,Astrid Dufaure,Esteban Monsalvo,François Atteia,Ludovic Escoubas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 3L-Dataset：基于模块化、传感器无关的物理标定采集框架，构建覆盖 Midavaine 夜间照度 1–5 级（约 1000 mlx 至 0.1 mlx）、可见光至近红外波段的低照度图像与视频配对数据集，采用高精度机械驱动实现亚像素级空间对齐的六元组（1 参考 + 5 照度级），无需后处理 warping。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督式低照度增强依赖的数据集存在根本缺陷：多为非受控环境拍摄、依赖曝光/ISO 调整或中性密度滤片，无法复现真实夜空近红外光谱内容与低光子噪声分布；且动态配对序列采集难以避免 warp 伪影与传感器特定偏置。

Method: 设计模块化、传感器无关的测试台，忠实复现标准 Midavaine 夜间照度标尺（Level 1 满月约 1000 mlx 至 Level 5 阴天无月夜约 0.1 mlx），覆盖乡村、森林、城市、沙漠沙盘等场景及可见—近红外光谱；通过高精度可编程机械执行机构在同步六元组间实现亚像素级空间对齐，避免图像后处理变形；并在此基础上评测多种代表性深度学习基线。

Result: 在多个夜光等级下评测代表性深度学习基线，揭示极端光子匮乏条件下重建保真度、感知质量与推理时延之间的关键权衡；采集框架可适配不同相机、光学系统、传感器与分辨率，支持数据集持续扩展。

Conclusion: 3L-Dataset 提供了物理标定、可控照度分级且像素级对齐的低照度图像/视频配对基准，弥补真实夜天光谱与噪声建模的空白；其模块化设计具备良好可扩展性。但工作核心为数据集与基准评测，未提出新的增强方法，对本方向的直接方法启发有限。

Abstract: Supervised low-light image and video enhancement has achieved remarkable progress, yet current models remain fundamentally constrained by the limitations of existing datasets. Prevailing methods typically rely on uncontrolled ambient captures, camera parameter manipulation (e.g., exposure or ISO adjustments), or neutral density filters, failing to replicate authentic night-sky near-infrared spectral content and genuine low-photon noise distributions. Furthermore, capturing dynamic paired sequences without introducing warping artifacts or sensor-specific biases remains an open challenge. In this paper, we introduce 3L-Dataset, a physically calibrated low-light image and video dataset generated using a modular, sensor-agnostic acquisition framework. Our test bench faithfully reproduces the standardized Midavaine night level scale from Level 1 (full moon, approximately 1000 mlx) down to Level 5 (overcast moonless night, approximately 0.1 mlx), spanning the visible to near-infrared spectrum across diverse realistic environments, including countryside, forest, urban, and desert scale models. Using high-precision programmable mechanical actuation, our acquisition framework guarantees sub-pixel spatial alignment across synchronized sextuplets, each composed of one reference image and five corresponding images acquired at the five standardized night levels, without post-processing image warping. We evaluate multiple representative deep learning baselines across varying night levels, revealing critical trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity, perceptual quality, and inference latency under severe photon starvation. The modular acquisition framework can be adapted to different cameras, optical systems, sensor technologies, and resolutions, enabling the dataset to be continuously expanded.

</details>


### [254] [Attention Residual U-Net for Enhanced Cross-Dataset Polyp Localization in Endoscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02726)
*Romil Imtiaz,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 基于注意力残差U-Net的内镜息肉检测框架，学习病灶聚焦空间表征并在推理阶段转为边界框预测，多设备公开数据集上AUC提升最高22.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用目标检测（如YOLO）在内镜临床条件下鲁棒性下降，源于设备差异、肠道内容物、数据集偏置及小而低对比度病灶，故需更稳健的病灶定位方法。

Method: 以Attention Residual U-Net为核心的检测框架：残差特征传播、注意力引导的编码器筛选（重构前抑制无关背景响应）、多尺度上下文学习；不做全局特征直接回归，而将病灶聚焦空间图在推理时映射为边界框。

Result: 在多个不同设备采集的公开内镜数据集上对比实验，优于相关SOTA，AUC最高提升22.0%。

Conclusion: 选择性抑制背景、注意力引导的编码-解码定位能提升异构成像条件下的病灶检测鲁棒性，可作为分割式表征驱动检测的可行范式。

Abstract: Precise localization of pathologies in endoscopy is a critical task in medical imaging, with deep learning (DL) frameworks now serving as the primary methodology for automated lesion detection. Today, generic object detection methods, such as YOLO, provide state-of-the-art performance in this context. However, their robustness often decreases under real-world clinical conditions due to variations across endoscopic devices, intestinal content, dataset bias, and the presence of small or low-contrast lesions. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a novel polyp detection framework based on a Attention Residual U-Net offering enhanced polyp localization. Instead of directly regressing bounding boxes from global feature representations, the proposed method learns lesion-focused spatial representations and converts them into bounding-box predictions during inference. Unlike conventional encoder-decoder localization frameworks that directly propagate all encoder activations into the decoding pathway, the proposed method selectively suppresses irrelevant background responses before feature reconstruction. This encourages the network to focus on lesion-relevant spatial evidence under heterogeneous imaging conditions. To achieve this, the framework integrates residual feature propagation, attention-guided encoder filtering, and multi-scale contextual learning. The proposed framework was evaluated on multiple public endoscopic datasets acquired using different devices. The comparative experimental results validate its effectiveness over the relevant state-of-the-art methods, with an improvement up to 22.0% in terms of the area under the receiving operating characteristic (AUC).

</details>


### [255] [MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02737)
*Suhyeon Lee,Zhengang Li,Soo Ye Kim,Peihao Zhu,Jong Chul Ye,Chun-Hao Paul Huang,Duygu Ceylan,Yan Kang,Hyeonho Jeong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoviEdit：面向长时长多镜头视频编辑的端到端框架，用三路自动数据管线构建87K配对编辑数据，采用"双向建立全局一致草稿 + 自回归传播精修"的级联架构，并发布MoviEdit-Bench基准，性能超开源模型、接近工业前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时长多镜头视频编辑需在场景、视角、主体外观突变下保持编辑意图连贯，且上下文远超常规单镜头编辑器；同时存在跨镜头监督数据缺失与评测缺失两大瓶颈。

Method: 1) 数据：同步多视角素材、真实多镜头视频、生成式多镜头内容三条自动管线，无人工标注产出87K配对编辑视频；2) 模型：级联双向-自回归设计——轻量双向阶段在时空压缩表示上先建立全局一致的编辑草稿，再在全视频上自回归传播与精修；3) 评测：提出MoviEdit-Bench。

Result: 在文本引导与图像引导编辑任务上显著优于现有开源模型，与工业前沿模型表现相当。

Conclusion: 长视频多镜头编辑可通过"全局草稿+局部自回归精修"的级联范式在规模化自动数据支撑下取得实用化效果，配套基准推动该方向系统评测。

Abstract: Long-form multi-shot video editing requires an intended edit to remain coherent across abrupt changes in scene, viewpoint, and subject appearance, while processing substantially longer visual context than conventional single-shot editors. We introduce MoviEdit, an end-to-end framework for scalable long-form multi-shot video editing that jointly addresses the challenges of data, modeling, and evaluation. To provide cross-shot supervision data at scale, we develop automatic data-generation pipelines spanning synchronized multi-view footage, real-world multi-shot videos, and generated multi-shot content, yielding 87K paired editing videos without manual annotation. Architecturally, MoviEdit employs a cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive design: a lightweight bidirectional stage first establishes a globally coherent editing draft over a spatiotemporally compressed representation, which is then autoregressively propagated and refined over the full video. We further introduce MoviEdit-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for systematic evaluation of long-form multi-shot video editing. Extensive experiments show that MoviEdit substantially outperforms existing open-source models and performs on par with industry frontier models across text-guided and image-guided editing. Visit our project page for complete results and to access the benchmark: this https URL

</details>


### [256] [Subspace Representations for Synthetic-to-Real Transfer in 3-D Surface Inspection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02744)
*Abdulla Nasir Chowdhury,Naish Ibrahim,Gulpi Qorik Oktagalu Pratamasunu,Kazuhiro Fukui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究合成到真实迁移下3D表面缺陷检测中子空间表示的作用：不同决策规则在真实缺陷上窗口AUC相近，图像级检测接近随机，域内阈值全部失效；提出"子空间能解释多少特征位移，就能吸收多少偏移"的泄漏界，并在Real3D-AD上以单类模板子空间达到点AUROC 0.957、类均值物体AUROC 78–81（免训练）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成缺陷训练、部署前仅有合格件扫描的无监督3D异常检测中，子空间方法被广泛使用但其在域偏移下的具体作用机制缺乏系统分析；作者希望厘清性能来自子空间本身，还是来自参考模板与配准。

Method: 以三种经典构造（最近子空间分类器、单类模板子空间、广义差分GDS）作为受控工具，在冻结特征上进行逐位置评估；用无标注合格扫描度量"泄漏"（类子空间外部的特征位移分量），并给出该泄漏对未见扫描位移的界定关系；跨MVTec 3D-AD（1,197扫描）与Real3D-AD（597物体）验证。

Result: MVTec 3D-AD上各决策规则真实缺陷窗口AUC相近，图像级检测停留在随机水平，无规则保持域内阈值；Real3D-AD上注册模板单类子空间点AUROC 0.957，类均值物体AUROC 78–81，未在该基准上训练；泄漏量可约束未见扫描的位移。

Conclusion: 子空间对域偏移的帮助与其所张成的偏移方向成正比；参考式检测中，参考模板及其配准比子空间选择更关键。属于分析性工作，给出可操作的设计指引而非新SOTA方法。

Abstract: This paper studies what subspace representations contribute to synthetic-to-real transfer in 3-D surface inspection, where models learn from synthetic defects and the only real data before deployment are scans of good parts. We use three classical constructions as instruments: the nearest-subspace classifier, one-class template subspaces and the generalized difference subspace (GDS). On 1,197 MVTec 3D-AD scans without target annotation we find that every decision rule ranks real defects at a similar window AUC, that image-level detection stays at chance, and that no rule keeps its in-domain threshold. We show that the margin of a nearest-subspace rule moves by at most the part of the feature shift outside its class subspaces, and that this leakage, measured from unlabeled good scans, bounds the displacement observed on unseen scans. On 597 Real3D-AD objects, a one-class subspace of registered templates evaluated at every location on frozen features reaches point AUROC 0.957 on pre-registered scans and a category-mean object AUROC of 78 to 81 with no training on the benchmark. Our results suggest that a subspace helps under shift in proportion to the shift it spans, and that in reference-based inspection the reference and its registration matter more than the subspace.

</details>


### [257] [Pair-Relative Partial Equivariance for Rotation-Robust Keypoint Descriptor Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02751)
*Jongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"pair-relative partial equivariance"以图像对的相对旋转经验分布度量等变性，并给出PaSteer——一种允许steering映射偏离精确SO(2)表示流形的松弛描述子steering框架（soft残差版与free-form Fourier版）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在冻结骨干（如DeDoDe）的upright描述子上做旋转鲁棒匹配时，现有steerer强制整个描述子空间服从单一精确SO(2)表示，过于刚性；作者论证对固定非等变描述子而言，逐角度的最优线性steerer一般不满足群复合律，说明精确表示在冻结描述子设定下是次优的。

Method: 1) 定义pair-relative partial equivariance：在图像对相对旋转的经验分布上评估等变性，而非对整个SO(2)群；2) PaSteer：保持轻量、无backbone的steering设计，但放宽约束使steering map可离开精确表示流形；3) 两个实例：PaSteer-soft（保恒等残差steerer）与PaSteer-free（自由形式的Fourier steerer）。

Result: 在Roto-360、MegaDepth-1500、AIMS与IMC-PT上，PaSteer在冻结DeDoDe描述子上一致优于精确steerer，在大相对旋转下提升尤为明显，同时upright性能退化极小。

Conclusion: 精确群表示约束对关键点描述子并非必要，基于pair-relative分布的部分等变性是更合适的松弛目标，可在不引入backbone代价的前提下显著提升旋转鲁棒匹配；为描述子后处理层面的等变性设计提供了新视角。

Abstract: Learned keypoint descriptors trained on upright imagery often fail under large in-plane rotation. Steerers address this by applying a single exact SO(2) representation to the descriptor space, but this global group constraint can be too rigid for keypoint descriptors, whose angular responses need not follow a single group representation. We propose pair-relative partial equivariance, which measures equivariance under the empirical distribution of relative rotations in image pairs, and PaSteer, a relaxed descriptor-steering framework that allows the steering map to leave the exact representation manifold while retaining the lightweight, backbone-free design of steering. PaSteer instantiates this relaxation with two variants: an identity-preserving residual steerer (PaSteer-soft) and a free-form Fourier steerer (PaSteer-free). We show that the per-angle optimal linear steerer for a fixed non-equivariant descriptor generally does not obey the group composition law, explaining why exact representations can be suboptimal in the frozen-descriptor regime. On Roto-360, MegaDepth-1500, AIMS, and IMC-PT, PaSteer consistently improves rotation-robust matching over an exact steerer on frozen DeDoDe descriptors, especially under large relative rotations, with minimal upright degradation.

</details>


### [258] [DINOFAS: Bonafide-Centric Representation Learning for Face Anti-Spoofing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02756)
*Shakeel Muhammad Ibrahim,Muhammad Sohail Ibrahim,Muhammad Shahid Jabbar,Shujaat Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DINOFAS: 基于 DINOv3 的活体中心式人脸防伪框架，结合 LoRA 参数高效适配、注意力风格-内容解耦（ASCD）模块与双分支架构，实现跨域与合成到真实的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 FAS 模型易学到攻击类型与数据集特定线索，在未见采集条件和新型呈现攻击下性能显著退化，需提升跨域与跨攻击的泛化性。

Method: 以 DINOv3 为骨干，LoRA 参数高效微调；引入 ASCD 模块分离风格（域相关外观）与内容表示以减少域偏移；设计双分支结构，一支做基于原型的真实人脸活体学习，另一支在 detach 特征上做攻击语义监督；联合优化活体中心原型损失、攻击语义分类损失与正交正则。

Result: OCIM 留一域协议下平均 HTER 9.09%；SynthASpoof 训练、四个真实数据集测试的平均 HTER 21.41%、平均 AUC 86.14%，均为对比方法最优；OULU-NPU 与 SiW-Mv2 上对采集条件、设备与未见攻击类型表现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 将 FAS 重构为活体中心表征学习，并借力大规模自监督骨干，可有效缓解域偏移与攻击多样性问题；方法在多项跨域基准上取得领先，为通用化人脸防伪提供了可复用范式。

Abstract: Face anti-spoofing (FAS) models often learn attack- and dataset-specific cues that degrade performance under unseen acquisition conditions and presentation attacks. We present DINOFAS, a DINOv3-based framework that formulates FAS as bonafide-centric representation learning. The proposed framework combines parameter-efficient DINOv3 adaptation using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), an attention style-content disentanglement (ASCD) module for reducing domain-specific appearance variations, and a dual-branch architecture that separates prototype-based liveness learning from attack-semantic supervision. The model is jointly optimized using a bonafide-centric prototype objective, an attack-semantic classification loss applied to detached features, and orthogonality regularization. DINOFAS achieves an average HTER of 9.09\% under the standard OCIM leave-one-domain-out protocol, where training is performed on three source datasets and evaluation is conducted on the held-out unseen domain. We further evaluate synthetic-to-real generalization by training exclusively on SynthASpoof and testing on four unseen real-world datasets, where DINOFAS achieves the lowest average HTER of 21.41\% and the highest average AUC of 86.14\% among the compared methods. Evaluations on OULU-NPU and SiW-Mv2 additionally demonstrate robustness to variations in acquisition conditions, devices, and unseen presentation attacks.

</details>


### [259] [Trace4D: Grounded Spatiotemporal Reasoning via 4D State Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02759)
*Wooseok Jang,Seungryong Kim,Yan Lu,Lei Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Trace4D 训练 VLM 从视频直接预测按时间排序的 4D 状态序列，并以“4D 状态 + 时序视觉上下文”构成 4D-grounded 链式思维（CoT）作为作答证据；构建 600K 4D 感知与约 70K 接地问答数据集，经 SFT + 几何感知 GRPO 训练，在 Trace4D-Bench 与 VLM4D 上提升 QA 精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 难以理解物体及其空间关系在 3D 空间中随时间（尤其视角变化）的演化；已有方法虽引入几何信息，但缺乏对“时序有序的 4D 状态演化”的显式监督，也未将其作为中间证据使用。

Method: 提出 Trace4D：让 VLM 联合时序视觉观测预测 4D 状态序列并推理跨时间步变化；设计 4D-grounded CoT 显式表示 4D 状态、分析时序视觉上下文并将二者作为答案证据。数据方面从 in-the-wild 视频构建 Trace4D-Train（600K 4D 感知样本 + 约 70K 接地 QA）；训练采用监督微调后接几何感知 GRPO 的联合策略。推理阶段直接从视频预测 4D 状态与推理，无需参考标注或外部几何模型。

Result: 在 Trace4D-Bench 与 VLM4D 上 QA 准确率优于基座 VLM；消融显示从 4D 状态变化与时序视觉观测中推理带来增益。

Conclusion: 显式 4D 状态序列监督与将其作为 CoT 中间证据，可有效提升 VLM 的动态 4D 空间推理能力，且无需推理期依赖外部几何模型。

Abstract: Understanding how objects and their spatial relationships evolve in 3D space over time remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), particularly under changing viewpoints. Recent approaches incorporate geometric information into reasoning, but explicit supervision for temporally ordered 4D state evolution and its use as intermediate evidence remains limited. We introduce \textbf{Trace4D}, which trains VLMs to predict 4D state sequences and reason over their inter-timestep changes alongside temporal visual observations. Its 4D-grounded chain-of-thought (CoT) explicitly represents 4D states, analyzes temporal visual context, and connects both as evidence for the answer. We construct Trace4D-Train from in-the-wild videos with 600K 4D perception examples and approximately 70K grounded QA examples, and train with joint supervised fine-tuning followed by geometry-aware GRPO. At inference, Trace4D predicts 4D states and reasoning directly from video without reference annotations or an external geometric model. Experiments on Trace4D-Bench and VLM4D show improved QA accuracy over the base VLMs and benefits from reasoning over 4D state changes and temporal visual observations.

</details>


### [260] [GaussFlaw: Fine-Grained Perceptual Diagnosis for 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02767)
*Shaocheng Shen,Zihan Zheng,Kejin Li,Lu Liu,Xiaoyun Zhang,Qiang Hu,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个大规模3DGS细粒度感知诊断数据集GaussFlaw-80K（80,049个伪影区域、14,289张渲染图，像素级掩码+8类缺陷标签），并给出几何引导多任务模型GeoCritic，同时定位与分类伪影，诊断结果可用于高斯增密、属性修正与离群点剪枝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS虽可实时渲染并实现照片级新视角合成，但其渲染伪影在空间上局部化且形态多样，现有全局质量指标与图像级基准无法指示伪影位置与类型，缺乏细粒度、可度量的诊断手段。

Method: 构建模型辅助、人在回路的标注流水线生成GaussFlaw-80K数据集；提出GeoCritic几何引导多任务网络，融合RGB外观与深度派生线索，联合完成伪影区域定位（分割）与八类缺陷分类（几何、混合/blending、光度退化）；并将诊断结果反馈到下游三项定向操作：高斯增密、属性修正、离群点剪枝。

Result: GeoCritic达到AUC-J 0.9507、Acc@1 80.08%；诊断引导的细化在多个数据集与多种3DGS骨干上一致提升全部全局与裁剪级指标。

Conclusion: 将3DGS伪影诊断显式化为可测量任务，数据集与模型可作为诊断工具，并通过诊断驱动的优化闭环证明细粒度伪影理解对重建质量具有实际提升价值。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic novel- view synthesis with real-time rendering, yet fine-grained di- agnosis of its rendering artifacts remains challenging. These artifacts are typically spatially localized and exhibit diverse degradation patterns, making them difficult to character- ize using global quality metrics and image-level assessment benchmarks, which provide no explicit indication of where they occur or what types of artifacts they represent. To ad- dress this limitation, we introduce GaussFlaw-80K, the first large-scale dataset for fine-grained perceptual diagnosis in 3DGS. Constructed through a model-assisted human-in-the- loop pipeline, GaussFlaw-80K contains 80,049 artifact re- gions across 14,289 rendered images, each annotated with a pixel-level mask and one of eight flaw labels spanning ge- ometric, blending, and photometric degradations. These an- notations turn 3DGS artifact diagnosis into an explicit and measurable task. Building on this dataset, we propose Ge- oCritic, a geometry-guided multi-task model that integrates RGB appearance with depth-derived cues to jointly localize artifacts and classify their flaw types. Beyond evaluation, we further demonstrate the downstream benefits of fine-grained diagnosis through three complementary targeted operations: Gaussian densification, attribute correction, and outlier prun- ing. Experiments show that GeoCritic achieves an AUC-J of 0.9507 and an Acc@1 of 80.08%, while diagnosis-guided re- finement improves all reported global and crop-level metrics across diverse datasets and 3DGS backbones.

</details>


### [261] [Unlocking the Potential of Vision Foundation Models for Multi-Task Dense Prediction via Mixture of Task Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02769)
*Yunzhi Zhuge,Xinzhuo Yu,Sitong Gong,Lu Zhang,Pingping Zhang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: D2MoE：在冻结的 DINOv3 主干上用 Task-Generic LoRA + 末端稀疏任务自适应 MoE 实现两层级适配，缓解多任务稠密预测的负迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型的语义不变性与稠密预测任务的频率/平滑性偏好相冲突；联合微调或单路 adapter 把竞争梯度压入同一更新通道，导致负迁移与跨任务一致性不稳。

Method: 提出两级适配框架：网络全部注意力投影中插入 TG-LoRA 提供共享稳定适配通道；仅在每个 stage 最后一个注意力块注入 TA-MoE，单次前向内做稀疏、任务条件化的 token-mixing 扰动；另设 Semantic Prior Injector 将多层任务特征与冻结基础模型先验耦合。

Result: 在多个稠密预测 benchmark 上取得稳健的多任务性能提升，可训练参数占比小。

Conclusion: 结构化因子化（共享适配 + 任务稀疏特化）是保先验、以基础模型为中心的多任务稠密感知的可扩展路线。

Abstract: Multi-task dense prediction seeks a single, coherent representation that supports simultaneously discriminative semantic recognition and regularized geometric/structural inference. For vision foundation models, pretrained semantic invariances conflict with the frequency and smoothness biases of dense objectives; joint fine-tuning and single-route adapters therefore compress competing gradients into one update channel, causing negative transfer and unstable cross-task agreement. We frame this as two-level adaptation: task-generic alignment that preserves priors, and task-aware specialization that resolves late-stage conflicts. Based on this principle, we propose D2MoE , a Mixture of Task Adapters that explicitly factorizes these roles within a frozen DINOv3 backbone. D2MoE introduces Task-Generic Low-Rank Adaptation (TG-LoRA) in attention projections throughout the network to provide a stable, shared adaptation channel, and a Task-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (TA-MoE) injected only at the final attention block of each stage to enact sparse, task-conditioned perturbations of token mixing in a single forward pass. A Semantic Prior Injector further couples multi-level task features with frozen foundation priors to reinforce semantic coherence while preserving boundary and structural fidelity. Experiments across diverse benchmarks substantiate that this structured factorization yields robust multi-task improvements with a small trainable footprint, establishing a principled and scalable route to prior-preserving, foundation-centric multi-task dense perception.

</details>


### [262] [Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: A Formal Framework for Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02775)
*Subodh Lonkar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将金融文档识别重构为"风险约束的证据恢复问题"，提出分层质量模型、基于置信上界的非补偿性验收门，以及带审核容量约束的选择性自动化风险-覆盖率框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CER/WER等聚合指标无法反映金融工作流中关键字段错误的真实后果，需要能够认证关键字段可靠性的形式化评估体系。

Method: 形式化定义带类型、证据可追溯的金融事实；构建覆盖文本、版面、表格、字段、语义关系、校准、鲁棒性与运行性能的多层质量模型；基于关键字段错误率的上置信界设计非补偿性验收门；将选择性自动化建模为带审核容量限制的约束风险-覆盖率问题；并规定标注要求、抗泄漏基准划分、统计estimand和可复现卡片。

Result: 给出命题证明聚合分数不能认证关键字段可靠性、零观测错误不意味着零风险；以合成示例演示决策规则。属纯理论工作，无实证基准或模型性能结论。

Conclusion: 强调评估应从平均精度转向风险可控、证据可追溯的验收机制，为高风险文档自动化提供可执行的统计与决策框架，但缺乏真实数据验证。

Abstract: Financial document recognition is commonly evaluated using character and word error rates, which do not adequately represent the consequences of errors in financial workflows. This paper formalizes financial document recognition as a risk-constrained evidence-recovery problem. It defines typed, evidence-linked financial facts and a multi-layer quality model spanning text, layout, tables, fields, semantic relations, calibration, robustness, and operational performance. It introduces non-compensatory acceptance gates based on upper confidence bounds for critical-field errors, and formulates selective automation as a constrained risk-coverage problem with review-capacity limits. The paper also specifies annotation requirements, leakage-resistant benchmark splits, statistical estimands, and a reproducibility card. Formal propositions establish why aggregate scores cannot certify critical-field reliability and why zero observed errors do not imply zero risk. A synthetic example illustrates the decision rule. The work is theoretical; no empirical benchmark or model performance claim is presented.

</details>


### [263] [Lookahead Prediction-Guided Adaptive Visual Refocusing for Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02780)
*Mengzhao Wang,Yanli Ji,Peng Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LPAVR：无需训练的测试时框架，将多token预测（MTP）的草稿头解码转化为"前瞻信号"，用目标模型验证后的近未来语义前缀来判断历史视觉证据是否覆盖下一步推理区域，覆盖不足则切换为前瞻引导的视觉证据，实现交错式多模态CoT的自适应重聚焦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交错多模态链式推理主要从历史上下文中检索视觉证据，当推理焦点转移时，历史引导的证据仍停留在先前区域，无法覆盖下一步所需视觉信息，作者称之为"时序证据近视"（Temporal Evidence Myopia）。

Method: 训练无关的测试时框架。MTP解码时草稿头生成多个未来token，目标模型并行验证并保留与其解码轨迹一致的最长前缀；该目标验证前缀承载近未来语义，用于构造前瞻引导证据并评估历史证据的区域覆盖率，不足则切换证据来源。同时前瞻与目标模型轨迹的一致性也提升了投机解码的接受率。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，LPAVR同时提升推理准确率与MTP投机token接受率，即视觉推理效果与投机解码效率共同改善。

Conclusion: 以解码器的前瞻预测替代历史回溯来动态重聚焦视觉证据，是缓解交错多模态推理中证据滞后问题的有效且免训练途径，并能与投机解码加速机制形成正向耦合。

Abstract: Interleaved multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning improves the visual reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models by dynamically incorporating visual evidence during reasoning. However, existing methods primarily select evidence from historical context. When the reasoning focus shifts, history-guided evidence may remain focused on prior regions and fail to cover the visual information required by the next step. We refer to this lag between visual evidence and subsequent reasoning demands as Temporal Evidence Myopia. To address this issue, we propose Lookahead Prediction-guided Adaptive Visual Refocusing (LPAVR), a training-free test-time framework. LPAVR transforms Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) from a decoding acceleration mechanism into a lookahead signal for anticipating upcoming reasoning intent. During MTP decoding, the draft head generates multiple future tokens, while the target model verifies them in parallel and retains the longest prefix consistent with its decoding trajectory. This target-verified prefix contains near-future semantics, which LPAVR uses to construct lookahead-guided visual evidence and assess whether history-guided evidence covers the indicated regions. If the coverage is sufficient, the history-guided evidence is retained; otherwise, LPAVR switches to the lookahead-guided evidence. This better aligns the visual context with upcoming reasoning and improves consistency between draft predictions and target-model decoding. Experiments on multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that LPAVR improves both reasoning accuracy and the acceptance rates of MTP speculative tokens, jointly enhancing visual reasoning and speculative decoding efficiency.

</details>


### [264] [History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02782)
*Hangyi Kuang,Chengzhi Wang,Yefei He,Weijie Wang,Yuke Zhao,Zhuokun Chen,Zisu Huang,Yifan Yang,Xiaoxuan He,Feng Chen,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 History Forcing 统一 on-policy 蒸馏框架，用"有/无历史上下文"的教师预测残差解耦出历史监督信号，加权重加入 score/velocity 预测形成修正目标，使少步自回归视频扩散模型具备长程历史一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散生成高效，但长 rollout 一致性差，主体/场景离开视野再回归时难以保持一致；现有蒸馏方法未充分利用更丰富的历史信息约束学生当前预测。

Method: on-policy 蒸馏 + 历史残差解耦：教师在有信息性历史上下文（早期漂移较少的生成 chunk，或保持场景可见的固定视角教师 rollout）与无该上下文两种条件下的预测做差，得到历史监督残差；对其加权后加到用于蒸馏的 score/velocity 预测上，构成 corrected target，学生对齐该目标即以蒸馏形式注入长程历史约束。

Result: 1.3B 规模模型中达 SOTA：15s 生成 VBench quality 85.07，60s 生成 VBench-Long 综合 79.82；出视野世界建模中 PlayWorld Evolution Quality 2.35→2.70，MemoBench Object Consistency 58.43→62.18，相机回归时状态更一致。

Conclusion: 历史残差蒸馏是给少步自回归视频生成器注入长程记忆的有效通用手段，兼顾效率与长时一致性，可推广到长视频生成与出视野世界建模。

Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient generation, yet maintaining consistency over long rollouts remains challenging, especially when subjects or scenes reappear after going out of sight. Despite progress in fidelity and rollout robustness, existing distillation methods do not fully exploit richer historical information to constrain the student's current prediction. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{History Forcing}, a unified on-policy distillation framework that strengthens historical supervision for few-step autoregressive video generators. The framework uses the residual between teacher predictions with and without informative historical context to decouple this supervision. Such a historical context can be obtained using earlier generated chunks with less accumulated drift or a fixed-view teacher rollout that keeps the scene visible while the student looks away. The residual is then weighted and added to the score or velocity prediction used for distillation, forming a corrected target. By aligning the student with this corrected target through distillation, History Forcing incorporates long-range historical constraints into autoregressive generation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among 1.3B models, with a VBench quality score of 85.07 for 15s video generation and a VBench-Long aggregate score of 79.82 for 60s generation. For out-of-sight world modeling, evaluations further demonstrate more plausible scene evolution and more consistent states when the camera returns, with Evolution Quality improving from 2.35 to 2.70 on PlayWorld and Object Consistency from 58.43 to 62.18 on MemoBench.

</details>


### [265] [Local-Global Joint Modeling for Point Cloud Super-Resolution Guided by Multi-Scale Spatial Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02786)
*Wang Yang,Wenyi Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于多尺度空间先验与局部-全局联合建模的距离图像点云超分方法，含空间门控融合、多粒度局部-全局协同感知与2D中值残差去噪，在KITTI-360/nuScenes上IoU 0.4703/0.3593。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 距离图像投影是稀疏室外LiDAR点云超分的有效途径，但现有方法存在三个问题：(1) 距离图像垂直方向分布高度非均匀，远处稀疏、近处密集，部分跨尺度融合未考虑不同垂直位置特征可靠性的差异，导致远处无效值与噪声传播进解码器；(2) 单一卷积或序列建模难以同时保持局部高频几何细节与全局长程依赖，重建过平滑；(3) 前后景边界处深度过渡平滑，二维反投影回三维时产生尖峰伪影。

Method: 三段式设计：空间门控融合模块（按垂直位置可靠性差异对跨尺度特征加权，抑制远处稀疏无效值），多粒度局部-全局协同感知模块（联合卷积局部细节与序列/全局建模），2D中值残差去噪（在距离图域抑制边界尖峰伪影）。

Result: 在KITTI-360与nuScenes上验证有效，IoU分别为0.4703与0.3593，作者称支持该距离图像超分方案的可行性。

Conclusion: 针对垂直非均匀性、局部-全局失衡与反投影尖峰三类问题分别给出模块化解决方案，属室外LiDAR距离图超分的增量式改进；摘要未给出与SOTA的对比幅度、推理速度或开源信息。

Abstract: Range-image-based point cloud super-resolution provides an effective way to reconstruct sparse outdoor point clouds by projecting low-resolution LiDAR scans into a regular 2D representation. However, current methods still face three challenges. First, range images exhibit pronounced vertical nonuniformity, with sparse observations in distant regions and denser observations in nearby regions. Some cross-scale fusion mechanisms do not account for the varying reliability of features at different vertical positions, allowing invalid values and noise from distant sparse regions to propagate into the decoder. Second, a single convolutional or sequence-modeling architecture often struggles to preserve both local high-frequency geometric details and global long-range dependencies, resulting in over-smoothed reconstructions. Third, smooth transition depths near foreground-background boundaries can produce spike artifacts when the 2D range image is back-projected into 3D. To address these issues, we propose a point cloud super-resolution method based on multi-scale spatial priors and joint local-global modeling. The design comprises a spatially gated fusion module, a multi-granularity local-global cooperative perception module, and 2D median-residual denoising. Experiments on KITTI-360 and nuScenes demonstrate effective reconstruction, with IoU scores of 0.4703 and 0.3593, respectively, supporting the feasibility of the proposed method for range-image super-resolution.

</details>


### [266] [OmniOPD: Stable On-Policy Distillation for Joint Audio-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02803)
*Zihao Fan,Xin Lu,Jie Huang,Hexin Zhang,Xueyang Fu,Zheng-Jun Zha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniOPD：面向音视频联合生成的模态级on-policy蒸馏框架，通过特权视觉信息（非对称加噪调度）、分组多噪声采样和时间步重要性加权，解决跨模态token数不平衡导致音频监督稀疏、蒸馏不稳定的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合音视频RL生成中，模态专属奖励异构，易产生跨模态干扰；OPD可将专门化音视频RL教师蒸馏进单一学生模型，但音视频token数严重失衡使音频监督稀疏、蒸馏不稳。作者进一步观察到单纯提高音频损失权重无效，因为音频学习高度依赖视觉上下文。

Method: 三个组件：(1) 非对称噪声调度构造特权视觉信息，使音频教师从更干净的视频上下文中生成更具信息量的目标；(2) 分组多噪声采样扩大音频监督覆盖度并稳定训练；(3) 基于师生转移散度的时间步重要性加权，保留可靠监督、降低不可靠信号权重。

Result: 在JavisBench与VBench上评测，OmniOPD在保持音频质量的同时显著提升视频生成性能，实现有效的联合蒸馏。

Conclusion: 面向音视频联合生成，模态级OPD结合特权视觉上下文与重要性加权的蒸馏可缓解跨模态监督不平衡，实现平衡且稳定的联合蒸馏；方法层面为多模态教师蒸馏提供了可迁移的加权思路。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) elevates joint audio-video generation, but optimizing heterogeneous, modality-specific audio and video rewards often introduces cross-modal interference. On-policy distillation (OPD) alleviates this issue by transferring the capabilities of specialized audio and video RL teachers into a single student model. However, a significant imbalance in cross-modal token counts leaves audio with sparse supervision, causing unstable distillation. We observe that naively increasing the audio loss weight fails to solve this problem since audio learning relies heavily on visual context, indicating richer visual cues are crucial to offset sparse audio signals. To address this, we propose OmniOPD, a modality-wise on-policy distillation framework designed for balanced and stable audio-video generation. First, we construct privileged visual information using asymmetric noise scheduling, allowing the audio teacher to generate more informative targets from cleaner video context. Second, we introduce grouped multi-noise sampling to expand audio supervision coverage and stabilize training. Third, we introduce timestep-wise importance weighting based on teacher-student transition divergence, preserving reliable supervision while down-weighting unreliable learning signals, to stabilize fluctuations in audio learning. Evaluated on JavisBench and VBench demonstrate OmniOPD preserves audio quality while significantly enhancing video generation, achieving effective joint distillation.

</details>


### [267] [Disen-Forcing: Disentangling Semantic Anchoring from Motion for Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02822)
*Zhengyang Yu,Akio Hayakawa,Masato Ishii,Qingtao Yu,Xuesong Li,Takashi Shibuya,Yuki Mitsufuji,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文重新审视AR视频扩散模型中的frame sink机制，发现长程一致性由稀疏注意力头锚定，多数头只捕捉局部时序动态；据此提出Disen-Forcing，通过解耦上下文路由与运动解耦正则缓解过度条件化病态，同时提升长程一致性与运动动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在推理时域超过训练时域后因曝光偏差累积而迅速退化；现有做法启发式沿用LLM式frame/attention sink，把初始帧作为永久上下文，但该机制为何有效并未被验证，且可能导致运动塌缩到低动态模式。

Method: 对AR-VDM注意力头进行机制分析，发现长程一致性由稀疏子集的注意力头负责、其余头主要建模局部时序动态，从而指出现有frame-sink策略对所有头统一暴露初始帧造成"过度条件化"；提出Disen-Forcing作为蒸馏阶段的即插即用模块，包含解耦上下文路由（disentangled context routing）与运动解耦正则（motion-disentangling regularization），以分离并强化头的功能专门化。

Result: 在长时程视频生成基准上，Disen-Forcing同时改善基础AR-VDM的长程一致性与运动动态性；而基于sink的方法难以平衡这一权衡。

Conclusion: 初始帧稳定AR-VDM长程一致性的机制并非LLM式attention sink，而是稀疏注意力头的专门化；显式解耦头的上下文路由可同时兼顾一致性并保留运动动态，为长时程自回归视频生成提供了一种轻量蒸馏插件。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models (AR-VDMs) enable real-time, long-horizon video generation but degrade rapidly once the inference horizon outruns the training horizon, due to compounding exposure bias. To stabilize long rollouts, recent methods heuristically adopt frame sink, keeping initial frames as a persistent model context, inspired by attention sinks in LLMs. We revisit this design and find that the mechanism by which initial frames stabilize long-range consistency in AR-VDMs is not an LLM-style attention sink; instead, long-range consistency is anchored through a sparse subset of attention heads, while the majority of heads predominantly capture local temporal dynamics. This observation reveals an over-conditioning pathology in existing frame-sink strategies: by universally exposing every head to the pinned initial-frame context, the model becomes prone to collapsing motion toward the low-dynamic modes of the teacher during model distillation. We propose Disen-Forcing, a distillation-time plug-in for AR-VDMs that disentangles and reinforces this head specialization through disentangled context routing and motion-disentangling regularization. On long-horizon video generation benchmarks, Disen-Forcing simultaneously improves long-range consistency and motion dynamics of base AR-VDMs, a trade-off that sink-based methods fail to balance.

</details>


### [268] [Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier for Urban Photogrammetric Point Cloud Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02844)
*Chong Liu,Yonghua Lu,Zhanglin Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ACASAC: 在航空影像-点云跨表示融合中引入决策级样本自适应分类器，用点对齐航空区域建模场景-局部差异与2D-3D表示差异，自适应生成每个样本的分类头，在SensatUrban/UrbanBIS上比固定融合头提升2.1/2.7 mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市摄影测量点云通常按局部3D patch处理，上下文受限，难以区分几何相似的类别；而同一数据的正射投影（DOM/RGB-D）虽能提供大范围上下文，却压缩了垂直几何。现有投影-点方法仅在特征层融合两种表示，并对所有样本共享同一分类器，无法适应场景到局部的变化以及2D与3D支持之间的表示差异。

Method: 提出Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier（ACASAC）。构造点对齐的航空区域（point-aligned aerial region）以衔接完整航空裁剪图与局部3D patch；在投影内部建模场景-局部变化，并对齐后的2D/3D支持建模表示差异；将两种关系迁移用于精化局部点类表示。精化表示、场景级航空上下文与固定的融合头先验共同动态生成当前样本的分类器（决策级自适应），作为特征级融合的补充。

Result: 相较固定双表示融合头，在SensatUrban和UrbanBIS上分别提升2.1与2.7 mIoU；在四组编码器组合上提升2.1–2.3 mIoU，显示出对骨干网络的稳定性。

Conclusion: 决策级、样本自适应的分类头可作为特征级投影-点融合的有效补充，用轻量改造换取稳定的分割增益；但验证仅限城市航空点云语义分割基准，未涉及机器人或具身场景，属相邻方法性工作。

Abstract: Urban photogrammetric point clouds are commonly processed as local 3D patches, limiting the context available for distinguishing geometrically similar categories. Orthographic projection of the same data yields a co-registered digital orthophoto map (DOM)/RGB-D representation that supports efficient large-context modeling but compresses vertical geometry. Existing projection--point methods mainly fuse these two representations at the feature level while retaining a classifier shared across all samples. We present the Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier (ACASAC), which complements feature fusion with decision-level adaptation. A point-aligned aerial region bridges the full aerial crop and local 3D patch. ACASAC models scene-to-local variation within the projection and the representation discrepancy between aligned 2D and 3D supports, then transfers both relations to refine the local point class representation. The refined representation, scene-level aerial context, and fixed fused-head prior jointly form a classifier for the current sample. ACASAC improves the fixed dual-representation head by 2.1 and 2.7 mIoU points on SensatUrban and UrbanBIS, respectively, and by 2.1--2.3 points across four tested encoder combinations.

</details>


### [269] [Scaling Action-Free Video Latent Prediction for Transferable Representations in End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02853)
*Xingtai Gui,Xubin Zhou,Yucheng Zhou,Dongqian Guo,Jiahao Gong,Feiyang Tan,Jianbing Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ScaleDrive：仅用无动作标注的大规模互联网开放世界驾驶视频做视频潜空间预测预训练，冻结编码器后迁移到多种端到端规划策略，验证表征可扩展性与跨策略、跨闭环基准的泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶策略需要同时捕捉空间结构与时间动态的视觉表征；视频潜空间预测已成为学习时空表征的有效范式，但缩放该目标（用无动作驾驶视频）能否产生有益于端到端规划的冻结表征尚不清楚。

Method: 提出ScaleDrive：以无动作视频潜空间预测为可扩展预训练目标，仅在互联网开放世界驾驶视频上预训练（无动作标注、无基准特定数据）；下游端到端规划训练时保持视频编码器冻结以隔离表征迁移性；用自运动（ego-motion）与深度探测任务评估表征质量；在多种端到端驾驶策略与闭环基准上系统评测迁移。

Result: 自运动与深度探测显示，随预训练规模扩大，冻结表征中的时序与几何信息逐步增强；跨不同策略架构与闭环基准，ScaleDrive 一致提升下游性能。

Conclusion: 无动作视频潜空间预测的规模化预训练可产生跨规划策略架构与评测场景/协议均可泛化的视觉表征，是一条可扩展的自动驾驶预训练路径。

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving policies require effective visual representations that capture both spatial scene structure and temporal dynamics. Video latent prediction has emerged as an effective paradigm for learning spatiotemporal visual representations, yet it remains unclear whether scaling this objective with action-free driving videos can yield representations that benefit end-to-end planning. We study action-free video latent prediction as a scalable pretraining objective and introduce ScaleDrive, a driving-oriented framework pretrained exclusively on large-scale internet open-world driving videos, without action annotations or benchmark-specific data. We keep the pretrained video encoder frozen during downstream end-to-end planning training to isolate the transferability of representations learned from internet driving videos. Ego-motion and depth probes show that scaling action-free video pretraining progressively strengthens the temporal and geometric information encoded in the frozen representation. We systematically study the visual representation transfer across different end-to-end driving policies and closed-loop benchmarks, where ScaleDrive consistently improves downstream performance and demonstrates that scaling action-free video latent prediction yields representations that generalize across both planning policy architectures and evaluation scenarios and protocols.

</details>


### [270] [Task Adaptation Through Guidance in Frozen Feature Upsampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02854)
*Pingan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过匹配残差适配器的消融实验，区分"上采样前特征适配"的增益来自特征值变化还是空间聚合变化，提出readout-null干预以保持冻结分类器粗粒度logits不变而让空间注意力自适应，在VOC和Cityscapes上获得1.0-2.0 mIoU提升，并确认自适应空间引导是改进冻结上采样系统的有效目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密预测中"上采样前适配特征"虽有增益，但无法判定增益源自特征数值改变、空间聚合方式改变，还是二者兼有；需要解耦分析并验证哪条适配路径真正有效。

Method: 在共享父模型下，于冻结的JAFAR上采样器前后放置匹配的残差适配器进行对比；构造readout-null干预，在冻结线性分类器粗logits保持不变的前提下允许空间注意力权重自适应；在已训练模型上做guidance/value交换，并用固定guidance的再训练对照实验；在PASCAL VOC与Cityscapes上进行三随机种子实验，并覆盖JAFAR与AnyUp两种上采样器。

Result: 上采样前适配相比上采样后适配，mIoU分别提升0.807（VOC）与1.413（Cityscapes）个百分点；readout-null适配相对对应冻结线性基线在两数据集、两种上采样器上平均增益1.379-1.987点；再训练对照进一步支持自适应空间引导的收益。

Conclusion: 稠密预测的提升可以在粗粒度分类器输出不变的情况下实现，说明增益主要来自空间引导（聚合权重）而非特征值；因此自适应空间引导是适配冻结特征上采样系统的关键目标。

Abstract: Adapting features before upsampling can improve dense prediction, but the gains may arise from changes in feature values, spatial aggregation, or both. We investigate this ambiguity by comparing matched residual adapters before and after a frozen JAFAR upsampler under a shared parent. We construct a readout-null intervention that preserves a frozen linear classifier's coarse logits while allowing spatial attention weights to adapt. Guidance/value exchanges on trained models and retrained fixed-guidance controls test the utility of this adaptation route. In three-seed experiments on PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) and Cityscapes, adaptation before upsampling improves mean intersection over union (mIoU) by 0.807 and 1.413 percentage points, respectively, over adaptation after upsampling. Across both datasets and the JAFAR and AnyUp upsamplers, readout-null adaptation produces mean gains of 1.379-1.987 points over the corresponding frozen linear baselines. Retrained controls further support the benefit of adaptive spatial guidance. These findings explain how dense predictions can improve despite unchanged coarse classifier outputs and identify spatial guidance as a useful target when adapting frozen feature upsampling systems.

</details>


### [271] [Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02857)
*Jeong-gi Kwak,Andrea Tagliasacchi,Sho Kagami,Yuki Ono,Kwang Moo Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Solv3R 是一个循环 Transformer 求解器，学习从当前状态继续求解多视角几何，其更新算子与迭代次数无关，从而统一支持离线重建、增量重建、重定位和流式重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 SfM 的迭代式结构使地图可增量扩展与细化，而多数几何基础模型采用单次前向或递推状态更新，难以实现视角的新增与已有几何的持续精化。

Method: 提出 looped transformer 形式的 Solv3R：以当前几何估计为隐状态，学习一个迭代数无关的更新算子；训练目标包含在持续迭代下保持准确重建以及对错误状态的纠正；已解算视角的表示可缓存并作为几何上下文复用，实现紧凑的 KV cache。

Result: 分析了求解器动态特性，并与 SOTA 方法对比；单一学习求解器在无需任务特定训练或模块的情况下，支持离线重建、增量重建、重定位与流式重建，并可从缓存视角表示中获益。论文给出了代码与模型的开源承诺。

Conclusion: 将 SfM 的迭代精化思想引入前馈几何基础模型，用一个统一、可缓存、可增量更新的循环求解器替代多任务专用架构，为前馈 3D 重建的可扩展性与在线部署提供了新范式。

Abstract: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved'' they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [272] [Performance evaluation of super-resolution techniques for characterization and phenotyping of commodity crops using multispectral imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02862)
*Abhiram Karukayil,João F. C. Mota,Mateo Vásquez-Guevara,Tito Arevalo-Ramirez,Fernando Auat Cheein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 评估8种预训练单图超分(RGB训练)方法直接应用于RGN作物多光谱影像的可行性与光谱保真度，发现Transformer类方法(HAT、HiT-SR、SRFormer)显著最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多光谱遥感影像空间分辨率低，难以呈现精细作物结构并影响植被指数(VI)估计，而RGB域SISR方法成熟，需验证其跨域迁移是否保持光谱一致性。

Method: 选取bicubic、nearest、Real-ESRGAN、HAT、HiT-SR、SRFormer、ResShift、StableSR共8个预训练模型，不做微调直接作用于RGN三通道图像；在4×与16×倍率下对整图与人工分割叶片区域重建；用MAE、PSNR、SSIM、SAM、ERGAS及8种植被指标的MAE/PSNR/SSIM评价。

Result: Transformer类方法在两种评价设置下均显著优于GAN与扩散类方法(p<0.001)，HAT、HiT-SR、SRFormer构成最高性能统计层级；重建在提升空间细节同时保持光谱一致性与VI可靠性。

Conclusion: RGB训练的SISR可迁移至RGN作物影像以支撑高分辨率表型分析；方法学贡献主要是评测与迁移验证，不含专用光谱约束网络设计。

Abstract: Multispectral imagery provides spectral information beyond the visible range for vegetation monitoring, but it typically suffers from limited spatial resolution, which can obscure fine crop structures and affect vegetation-index (VI) estimates.} This study evaluates whether single-image super-resolution (SISR) methods developed for red, green, and blue (RGB) imagery can enhance the spatial resolution of red, green, and near-infrared (RGN) crop images while preserving spectral fidelity. Eight pretrained methods are applied directly to RGN images without fine-tuning: bicubic and nearest-neighbor interpolation, Real-ESRGAN, HAT, HiT-SR, SRFormer, ResShift, and StableSR. Reconstruction at $4\times$ and $16\times$ is evaluated for whole images and manually segmented leaf regions. Reconstruction quality is assessed using mean absolute error (MAE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), spectral angle mapper (SAM), and erreur relative globale adimensionnelle de synthèse (ERGAS). Eight VIs, computed from reference and super-resolved images, are evaluated using MAE, PSNR, and SSIM. Transformer-based methods \modification{significantly} outperform GAN- and diffusion-based approaches in both evaluation settings \modification{($p < 0.001$)}, with \modification{HAT, HiT-SR, and SRFormer forming the highest-performing statistical tier}. These findings indicate that RGB-trained SISR can enhance spatial detail in RGN crop imagery while maintaining spectral consistency and VI reliability for high-resolution crop phenotyping.

</details>


### [273] [ProtoFusion: Protocol-Guided Prompt Refinement for Generative Infrared and Visible Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02877)
*Pengwei Liang,Junjun Jiang,Junhui Hou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProtoFusion 将红外-可见光图像融合重构为"协议约束的生成"任务，用结构化协议（环境状态卡、接地原则、风格画像）表达融合意图，并通过闭环 prompt 精炼学习协议，推理时固定协议引导生成，另加结构化信念构造做保守后校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有融合方法依赖固定算子、手工目标函数或一次性人工 prompt，无法显式指定应保留/抑制哪些证据、融合结果应满足什么属性，导致融合意图表达不充分、源模态残留不一致。

Method: （1）把融合建模为协议约束的生成：结构化协议包含环境状态卡、接地原则与风格画像；（2）协议引导的 prompt 精炼：在多模态证据下迭代执行生成—评估—修正的闭环学习，学习完成后在推理时固定；（3）结构化信念构造：将模态可靠性、场景证据与跨模态冲突组织为结构化表示，对生成结果做保守校正。

Result: 在标准红外-可见光融合基准上定量指标提升，美学评价表现良好，输出视觉上连贯。摘要未给出具体数值与下游任务（如检测、分割）增益。

Conclusion: 把显式协议+闭环 prompt 优化引入图像融合是一条可行路线，可替代固定算子与手工目标；但该方法面向通用 CV 图像融合任务，未涉及三维重建、机器人或具身场景，实用性限于图像级增强。

Abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion integrates complementary information from both modalities to provide a more comprehensive representation of the scene. We propose ProtoFusion, a protocol-guided generative framework for infrared and visible image fusion. Instead of relying on fixed fusion operators, hand-crafted objectives, or manually specified one-shot prompts, ProtoFusion formulates fusion as protocol-constrained generation. It represents fusion intent with a structured protocol, consisting of environment state cards, grounding principles, and a style profile, which explicitly specifies which evidence should be preserved or suppressed and which properties the fused result should satisfy. To optimize this protocol, we introduce protocol-guided prompt refinement, a closed-loop learning framework that iteratively performs generation, evaluation, and revision under multimodal evidence. Once learned, the optimized protocol is fixed at inference time and directly guides fusion generation. To address residual source inconsistencies, we further incorporate structured belief construction, which organizes modality reliability, scene evidence, and cross-modal conflicts into a structured representation for conservative correction after generation. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that ProtoFusion improves quantitative performance, achieves favorable results in aesthetic evaluation, and produces visually coherent fusion outputs. Project Page: { this https URL }.

</details>


### [274] [PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360$^{\circ}$ View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02897)
*Yuan-Kang Lee,Kuan-Lin Chen,Chia-Che Chang,Yu-Lun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhotoGuider 提出"先测量、后取景"的 360° 全景摄影构图方法：用基础模型与任务专用模型提取共享构图特征并结构化为 Subject/Composition/Aesthetics/Integrity 四个摄影 token，用紧凑学习评分器同时完成视点方向选择与精细裁剪，并由微调 MLLM 生成以测量结果为条件的构图解释，且可输出相机参数用于原生重渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图像裁剪默认原图已含值得保留的构图，只需决定裁剪框；而 360° 场景中"看哪里"本身未知，需先发现可构图的视点方向。作者希望用一套共享的构图感知特征同时解决"选方向"与"定边框"，并补上可解释性与可重渲染的输出。

Method: measure-then-frame 流水线：1) 用 foundation models 与任务专用视觉模型提取构图相关特征，组织为四个摄影语义 token（Subject、Composition、Aesthetics、Integrity）；2) 在这些共享 token 之上训练紧凑学习评分器，分别用于全景视点方向选择与 2D 细化取景；3) 微调 MLLM explainer，以图像＋token 测量值为条件生成构图解释；4) 输出相机参数支持原生重渲染。

Result: 在两个标准 2D 裁剪基准上取得最高平均 mIoU（对比真值裁剪）。盲评排序实验中，120 名参与者在 Poly Haven HDRI 公共库的 100 个全景场景上对三种裁剪方法排序，本方法取景以 53.2% 位列第一，两个强基线分别为 27.3% 与 19.5%。

Conclusion: 据作者所述，这是首个将 360° 全景显式构图导向的方向选择、精细取景、相机参数原生重渲染输出与测量条件化解释相结合的方法。整体属于摄影构图/计算美学方向的 CV 应用工作，缺少 embodied/3D 重建或机器人相关的可迁移方法洞察。

Abstract: Traditional image cropping assumes the photograph already contains the composition worth keeping, and asks only where to crop. A full 360$^{\circ}$ scene offers no such guarantee: the viewing direction in a scene has to be discovered before anything can be framed. We present PhotoGuider, a measure-then-frame method that answers both questions with compact learned scorers over one shared set of composition-aware features. The designed features are extracted using foundation and task-specific vision models and structured into four photographic tokens: Subject, Composition, Aesthetics, and Integrity. Our MLLM explainer is fine-tuned to generate composition-related explanations conditioned on images and measured token assessments. To our knowledge, PhotoGuider is the first method to combine explicit composition-based direction selection in 360$^{\circ}$ panoramas with refined framing, camera-parameter output for native re-rendering, and measurement-conditioned explanations. On two standard 2D cropping benchmarks, PhotoGuider achieves the highest average mIoU performance against ground-truth crops. In a blind ranking study, 120 participants ranked three cropping methods over 100 panoramic scenes from the public Poly Haven HDRI library, placing our framings first in 53.2% of cases, against 27.3% and 19.5% for two strong alternatives. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [275] [TailorRig: Controllable and Structured Auxiliary Skeleton Generation for Garment-Aware Rigging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02902)
*Yajing Chen,Xin Chen,Saidan Lu,Yeqi Yuan,Weikai Chen,Changyu Hu,Cheng Zeng,Xin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TailorRig 将带服装的人形角色绑定重构为结构化、可控的全绑定生成问题，提供两条显式艺术控制轴（身体骨架模板 + 语义标签驱动的自回归辅助骨链生成），并提出链到骨骼的分层蒙皮权重公式以抑制权重渗透，同时发布 Human-Mix 数据集（3.8 万+ 人形模型）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂服装角色需要密集辅助骨骼与精细蒙皮控制，现有自动绑定方法仅从几何恢复绑定，对辅助关节缺乏艺术家可控性，且缺少显式语义/运动链结构，导致不稳定与权重渗透。

Method: 统一框架内暴露两条控制轴：(1) 用户指定身体骨架模板以保持与身体绑定的兼容性；(2) 艺术家提供语义标签，驱动自回归生成器合成指定类别的辅助骨链。蒙皮上采用分层"链→骨骼"公式：顶点先归属某运动链，再在链内细化骨骼权重。

Result: 在多样化角色上评估，并在新构建的 Human-Mix（3.8 万+ 人形模型）数据集上验证；相较现有方法在骨架精度、变形稳定性、可控性与实用性上均有提升。

Conclusion: 将服装感知的人形绑定从"自动恢复"转向"艺术驱动的绑定创作"，语义结构化的链式权重分配可有效缓解密集骨骼下的权重渗透，为可编辑角色绑定提供可行范式。

Abstract: Humanoid rigging for modern characters with complex garments remains challenging due to the need for dense auxiliary skeletons and precise skinning control. Existing automatic methods primarily recover rigs from geometry, providing limited artist control over auxiliary articulation and often lacking explicit semantic or kinematic-chain structure for dense garment bones, leading to instability and weight bleeding. We present TailorRig, a framework that reformulates garment-aware humanoid rigging as a structured, controllable full-rig generation problem. This formulation shifts the goal from automatic rig recovery to artist-driven rig authoring, where both body-template compatibility and auxiliary articulation are explicit design choices. TailorRig exposes two explicit axes of artist control within a unified framework: a user-specified body skeleton template that preserves body-rig compatibility, and artist-provided semantic labels that drive an autoregressive generator to synthesize requested category-specific auxiliary bone chains. To robustly assign skinning weights under dense skeletal configurations, we further introduce a hierarchical chain-to-bone formulation: vertices are first associated to a kinematic chain, and bone weights are then refined within that chain, reducing weight bleeding between spatially adjacent but semantically unrelated structures. We evaluate TailorRig on a diverse set of characters and introduce Human-Mix, a large-scale dataset of over 38,000 humanoid models curated for garment-aware rigging. Experiments show that TailorRig improves skeleton accuracy, deformation stability, controllability, and practical usability over existing methods.

</details>


### [276] [Unlocking the Potential of Contrastive Regularization for Diffusion Transformer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02921)
*Yi Tan,Beier Zhu,Sirui Chen,Yunzhe Lin,Yuan Zhou,Cheng Chen,Xingyu Zhu,Tianrun Chen,Yanbin Hao,Hanwang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CRAN（Clean Representation-ANchored Contrastive）正则化，用干净样本表示距离约束InfoNCE的过度分散，抑制扩散输入中近正交噪声分量带来的"捷径"，使标准对比学习成为扩散Transformer的有效正则器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer的表示正则化已被证明有效，但最经典的InfoNCE式对比学习在此设定下几乎未被充分探索。作者发现朴素InfoNCE正则仅带来边际收益：扩散输入中的近正交噪声分量构成捷径，可在不需正对对齐的情况下拉大负对距离，尤其在高噪声水平下使目标被捷径主导。

Method: 分析并定位InfoNCE在扩散训练中的"噪声捷径"失效机制，随后提出CRAN：以干净样本的表示距离作为锚点约束对比学习的分散度，将干净样本的关系语义结构迁移到含噪扩散表示上，从而压制噪声捷径。仅在内部表示层面施加，无需外部教师模型。

Result: ImageNet上跨多种模型规模与训练预算，CRAN持续改善扩散Transformer训练，优于内部特征对齐与分散式正则基线，并与外部DINO引导的REPA相当。

Conclusion: InfoNCE式对比学习可以作为扩散训练的有效正则器，前提是恰当约束其噪声驱动的过度分散；CRAN重新确立了这一经典目标在扩散Transformer训练中的地位，且不依赖外部预训练特征。

Abstract: Representation regularization has emerged as an effective way to improve diffusion transformer training. Yet one of the most canonical regularizers--InfoNCE-style contrastive learning--remains largely underexplored in this setting. We naturally ask a question: can standard contrastive learning serve as an effective regularizer for diffusion transformers? Surprisingly, we find that naive InfoNCE regularization brings only marginal gains. Our analysis reveals that the objective is easily dominated by a shortcut: near-orthogonal noise components in diffusion inputs provide a bypass for enlarging negative-pair distances while weakening positive-pair alignment, especially at high noise levels. To unlock the benefit of contrastive regularization, we propose Clean Representation-ANchored Contrastive (CRAN) regularization. Specifically, CRAN anchors contrastive dispersion with clean-sample representation distances, transferring clean relational semantic structure to noisy diffusion representations to suppress the noise shortcut. Extensive experiments on ImageNet show that CRAN consistently improves diffusion transformer training across model scales and training budgets, outperforming internal feature-alignment and dispersive regularization baselines while matching external DINO-guided REPA. These results re-establish InfoNCE-based contrastive learning as an effective regularizer for diffusion training, once its noise-driven over-dispersion is properly constrained.

</details>


### [277] [Comprehensive Evaluation of Monocular and Multi-view 3D Human Pose Estimation Models for Fitness Exercise Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02929)
*Néstor Ortega,Agustín Salgado,Javier Sánchez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在Fit3D上统一评测两个单目提升方法(TCPFormer、PoseMamba-L)与一个多视角方法(MVGFormer)，并分析2D检测器质量与三种时序滤波后处理对精度、时序一致性和鲁棒性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D人体姿态估计虽在标准基准上精度高，但在真实健身/运动场景下的表现缺乏系统研究；单目与多视角方法之间的权衡、以及后处理对时序一致性的收益，尚未在健身类数据上统一比较。

Method: 以Fit3D多视角同步健身动作数据为测试床，统一评测协议下比较两个单目提升方法TCPFormer、PoseMamba-L与多视角模型MVGFormer；单目方法分别输入真值关键点与RTMPose、YOLO-Pose生成的2D检测，并对比三种时序滤波器在抑制抖动与保持运动动态间的平衡。

Result: 给出各方法在精度、时序一致性与对不完美2D检测鲁棒性上的详细对比；量化2D检测质量对提升类方法的显著影响，并比较Transformer与状态空间时序架构的表现差异。

Conclusion: 健身动作分析中，2D检测质量、时序建模与后处理需联合考虑；单目与多视角方案存在实际权衡。工作为基准评测与经验性分析，未提出新方法或开源实现。

Abstract: Three-dimensional human pose estimation has become a fundamental component of computer vision systems for sports analytics, rehabilitation, and motion understanding. Although recent deep learning approaches have achieved remarkable accuracy on standard benchmarks, their performance under realistic sports scenarios remains insufficiently studied. Furthermore, the trade-offs between recent monocular and multi-view approaches, as well as the benefits of post-processing techniques for improving temporal consistency, have not been systematically evaluated on fitness-oriented datasets. This paper evaluates recent state-of-the-art 3D human pose estimation methods on Fit3D, a dataset of synchronized multi-view recordings of a wide variety of fitness exercises with accurate ground-truth annotations. We study two recent monocular lifting approaches, TCPFormer and PoseMamba-L, and a multi-view model, MVGFormer, under a unified evaluation protocol. To investigate the influence of the input data, monocular methods are evaluated using ground-truth keypoints and detections generated by recent 2D pose estimators, RTMPose and YOLO-Pose. Additionally, we analyze the effectiveness of three temporal filters for reducing prediction jitter while preserving motion dynamics. Experimental results provide a detailed comparison of accuracy, temporal consistency, and robustness to imperfect 2D detections across the evaluated methods. Our analysis highlights the impact of detector quality on lifting-based approaches, compares transformer- and state-space-based temporal architectures, and discusses the practical trade-offs between monocular and multi-view systems for fitness motion analysis. Our results show that 2D detection quality, temporal modeling, and post-processing must be considered jointly in pose estimation pipelines for exercise analysis.

</details>


### [278] [Training-Time Domain Transfer for Generator-Free Diagnostics on Novel Modalities in Computational Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02931)
*Julia A. Mielcarz,Andrea Camilloni,Nita Mulliqi,Jessica A. Frank,Anders Blilie,Emilius A.M. Janssen,Martin Eklund,Kimmo Kartasalo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出“训练时域迁移”范式：从归档常规样本生成目标模态合成训练数据，使模型可直接在真实新模态输入上诊断，避免推理时生成，并以未染色前列腺病理验证优于虚拟染色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新成像模态缺乏训练数据，推理时域迁移（如虚拟染色）虽能复用已有诊断模型，但带来幻觉风险、计算开销与监管复杂性。借鉴 sim-to-real 思想，希望将域迁移从推理期前移到训练期。

Method: 受 sim-to-real 迁移启发，用归档的常规（H&E）样本合成未染色/去石蜡等目标域图像作为训练数据，训练直接在真实目标模态输入上推理的诊断模型；以前列腺组织病理未染色图像为概念验证，与推理时虚拟染色及常规 H&E 基线做一致性对比。

Result: 与常规基准一致性：原始组织 κ=0.59 vs 虚拟染色 0.37，AC1=0.73 vs 0.29；去石蜡组织 κ=0.66 vs 0.61，AC1=0.73 vs 0.64。

Conclusion: 训练时域迁移在一致性上优于推理时虚拟染色，且推理阶段无生成开销与幻觉风险，显示出对新诊断模态的复用潜力；但仅在单一医学影像概念验证上验证，缺乏跨模态/跨任务泛化证据。

Abstract: Novel imaging modalities promise improved diagnostics, but AI development is constrained by scarce training data. Inference-time domain transfer can address this by mapping novel modalities to established ones, enabling reuse of existing diagnostic models. However, this introduces hallucination risks, computational overhead, and regulatory complexity. Inspired by sim-to-real transfer, we propose training-time domain transfer, generating synthetic target-domain training data from archived routine samples to enable direct diagnosis on real inputs without inference-time generation. Using unstained prostate histopathology as a proof-of-concept, we compare this approach with inference-time virtual staining and conventional H&E-based cancer detection. Training-time transfer achieved higher concordance with the conventional benchmark than virtual staining for both raw (Cohen's $\kappa$=0.59 vs. 0.37; Gwet's AC1=0.73 vs. 0.29) and deparaffinized tissue ($\kappa$=0.66 vs. 0.61; AC1=0.73 vs. 0.64), supporting its potential for emerging diagnostic modalities.

</details>


### [279] [RouteREPA: Routed Representation Alignment for Just Image Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02941)
*Yi Tan,Beier Zhu,Sirui Chen,Cheng Chen,Xingyu Zhu,Yuan Zhou,Zhenshan Tan,Tianrun Chen,Hanwang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 揭示像素空间JiT中判别性对齐与像素重建的表征冲突，提出基于轻量路由器的RouteREPA按深度自适应路由表征，在ImageNet-1K上用1/3训练量超越PixelREPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: REPA（表征对齐）在潜空间扩散Transformer（如DiT）中广泛用于加速训练，但直接迁移到像素空间模型JiT时存在困难：JiT学到的表征与DINOv2对齐程度显著低于潜空间模型，且施加REPA会持续降低其中间表征的可重建性，而Latent JiT无此现象。作者将这一"表征冲突"归因于JiT直接重建像素，其表征需在不同网络深度上分层编码判别性语义与重建相关视觉信息。

Method: 提出Routed Representation Alignment（RouteREPA）：用轻量级、依赖表征的路由器（router）自适应地为对齐任务与生成任务路由面向任务的表征；并在多个网络深度上施加路由，以适配各深度不同的表征需求。

Result: 在ImageNet-1K 256×256上，RouteREPA在各模型规模与训练预算下均稳定提升JiT，优于标准REPA；在JiT-H/16上，仅用PixelREPA三分之一的训练epoch且在无分类器引导（CFG）条件下即超越PixelREPA。

Conclusion: 像素空间扩散Transformer存在判别性对齐与像素重建之间的表征冲突，可通过表征依赖的深度路由机制予以缓解；RouteREPA是一种高效、可插拔的像素空间DiT训练加速方案。

Abstract: Representation alignment (REPA) is widely used to accelerate the training of latent-space diffusion transformers (DiTs). However, applying it to pixel-space models such as Just Image Transformers (JiT) is challenging. Our analysis reveals a pronounced representation conflict between discriminative alignment and pixel-space generation. Compared with its latent counterpart, JiT learns representations that are substantially less aligned with DINOv2. Applying REPA to JiT consistently reduces the reconstructability of its intermediate representations, whereas this effect is not observed in Latent JiT. We attribute this conflict to JiT directly reconstructing pixels, which requires its representations to hierarchically encode discriminative semantics and reconstruction-relevant visual information across network depths. To address these challenges, we propose Routed Representation Alignment (RouteREPA), which uses lightweight, representation-dependent routers to adaptively route task-oriented representations for alignment and generation. We further apply routing across multiple network depths to accommodate their depth-dependent representation requirements. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K at 256x256 resolution show that RouteREPA consistently improves JiT across model scales and training budgets, outperforming standard REPA. On JiT-H/16, RouteREPA further surpasses PixelREPA using only one-third of its training epochs without classifier-free guidance.

</details>


### [280] [Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02952)
*Filipe Laitenberger,Hirokatsu Kataoka,Yuki Asano,Cees Snoek,Mohammadreza Salehi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BRIDGE：无需标签的反馈闭环，用当前编码器的kNN距离评分定位长尾稀疏带，用冻结的图生图扩散模型生成局部变体并扩增源集，从而平衡长尾自监督表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习的覆盖度受源数据限制：无标签语料长尾时，表示在频繁模式附近稠密、在覆盖薄弱处稀疏。现有长尾SSL目标只对已有图像重新加权，无法引入新样本。

Method: 以当前编码器的平均kNN距离对源图像打分，用预算化的采集规则从分数分布的"稀疏带"（排除极端尾部、且生成器仍能产生忠实变体的区间）挑选锚点；冻结的图像到图像扩散模型为锚点生成局部变体，扩充源集后继续预训练。理论上将采集形式化为"可恢复性加权"的局部支撑分配，并给出有限预算下应偏向稀疏带、以及固定目标下每次修复后重分配为最优的条件。

Result: 在五种长尾（网络爬取与合成）源设置下，七任务线性探针与kNN平均最优；增益在ViT-S上可迁移到对比与自蒸馏目标、低标签微调与语义分割；掩码重建下增益较小。生成修复效果与"恢复被留出真实图像"的oracle相当；冻结编码器下，插入图像使被选锚点的邻域收缩程度约为匹配的未选图像的两倍。

Conclusion: 无需标签、不改变预训练目标即可嵌入非精选网络数据的预训练流程，由编码器自主决定生成哪些图像，具备良好的可插拔性。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning inherits the coverage of its source data. When an unlabeled corpus is long-tailed, the representation becomes dense around frequent modes and thin where coverage is weak. Objectives for long-tailed SSL reweight the images already in the corpus and add no new ones. We introduce BRIDGE (Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data), a label-free feedback loop around the source set. The current encoder scores every source image by its mean kNN distance, and a budgeted acquisition rule selects images from a band of that score distribution where support is thin and the generator still produces faithful variants. A frozen image-to-image diffusion model then adds local variants of the selected anchors, and pretraining continues on the enlarged source set. We formulate acquisition as recoverability-weighted allocation of local support and derive when a finite budget should favor a sparse band that excludes the extreme tail and when reallocation after each repair is optimal under a fixed objective. Across five long-tailed, web-scraped and synthetic source regimes, BRIDGE has the highest seven-task linear-probe and kNN average of the compared methods, and paired experiments extend the gain to ViT-S under contrastive and self-distillation objectives, to low-label fine-tuning and to semantic segmentation. The linear-probe gain is smaller under masked reconstruction.
