Generated repair matches an oracle that restores the withheld real images, and under a frozen encoder the inserted images shrink the neighborhoods of the selected anchors about twice as much as those of matched unselected images. BRIDGE needs no labels and leaves the pretraining objective unchanged, so it can be added to pretraining on uncurated web data, where the encoder decides which images to generate.

</details>


### [281] [One Image Is Enough: Self-Generated Supervision for Personalizing Human Video Diffusion at Test Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02964)
*Sadman Rakib Pinon,Adamo Orsini,Yanis Falaki,Linlian Jiang,Jacob Kingi,Yang Wang,Xinxin Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出用合成伪真值帧替代真实视频来监督姿态驱动人体视频扩散模型的身份个性化：领域微调的姿态条件生成器产出关键姿态伪GT，推理时参考图引导采样器挑选最保身份候选，再用仅由参考图配置的逐subject LoRA在静态合成片段上训练，无需subject视频/真值/标注，在TikTok与UBC Fashion上全面超越基座并反转"身份-运动"权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 姿态驱动人体动画在目标姿态远离参考图时难以保身份，人脸与服饰失真；个性化是标准解法，但监督信号缺失——单张参考图只固定单一姿态下的身份，而实践中无法假定存在多姿态subject视频。作者据此提出"合成缺失的监督"。

Method: 1) 领域微调的姿态条件生成器在选定关键姿态上生成伪真值帧；2) 推理时使用仅参考图的条件采样器将这些候选拉向subject，并保留身份最一致者；3) 在由参考图单独配置、由这些伪帧构成的静态片段上训练逐subject低秩适配器（LoRA）；全流程不使用subject视频、真值或标注。关键观察：真实帧携带的运动侵蚀时序先验，而静态片段只传达外观。

Result: 在TikTok与UBC Fashion数据集上，适配后模型在所有指标上均优于基座（base），身份-运动权衡被反转；在不使用任何真实帧的情况下，与基于5张真实帧的适配相当或更优。作者认为低保真度的合成帧作为监督比真实帧更有效。

Conclusion: 合成伪真值帧可作为有效的个性化监督替代真实subject视频，解耦外观与运动是先验保持的关键；方法免标注、免subject视频，具备较强实用性与工程可复现性（已开源代码与权重）。

Abstract: Pose-driven human video diffusion animates a person from a single reference image and a target pose sequence, yet it struggles to preserve identity, rendering the face and garments unfaithfully as the pose departs from it. Personalization is the standard remedy, but its supervision is missing: one image fixes identity at a single pose, while a multi-pose subject video cannot be assumed in practice. Instead, we synthesize the missing supervision. A domain-tuned, pose-conditioned generator produces pseudo-ground-truth frames at selected key poses. An inference-time reference-only sampler steers these candidates toward the subject and keeps the most identity-consistent. A per-subject low-rank adapter then trains on static clips of them, configured from the reference alone, with no subject video, ground truth, or labels. Although lower in fidelity, these synthetic frames supervise more effectively than real ones. Real frames as captured carry motion that erodes the temporal prior, while a static clip conveys appearance alone. On TikTok and UBC Fashion, the adapted model improves the base on every metric, inverts the identity-versus-motion trade-off, and matches or surpasses adaptation on five real frames despite using none. Code and weights are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [282] [ILLRAW: Illumination-Aware RAW Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02995)
*Xinzhe Wang,Xiao Liang,Xiaoli Zhang,Kang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ILLRAW，一种光照感知的端到端 RAW 域目标检测框架，通过轻量特征适配器直接学习检测导向的 RAW 特征，避免 RAW-to-sRGB 重建范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAW 检测器先用可学习 ISP 把 RAW 转成类 sRGB 图像以适配现成检测器，这种解耦导致网络继承人类视觉先验，并丢弃 RAW 的线性传感器响应、高位深与低处理场景线索等本质优势。

Method: 在现有检测器输入阶段插入轻量特征适配器；估计光照掩码，引入通道敏感嵌入建模 Bayer 通道响应，再用光照注意力融合模块融合两类特征。

Result: 在 AODRaw 基准上取得明显提升，LOD 与 PascalRAW 上具竞争力，暗光曝光条件下效果尤为突出。

Conclusion: 端到端 RAW 特征学习优于 RAW-to-sRGB 解耦范式，验证了直接利用 RAW 内在特性对检测任务的价值，尤其适用于低照度场景。

Abstract: Existing RAW-based detectors typically introduce learnable ISP modules to convert RAW inputs into sRGB-like formats to fit off-the-shelf detectors. However, this RAW-to-sRGB paradigm decouples representation learning from the downstream detection task. Crucially, it forces the network to inherit human-centric visual priors while discarding intrinsic RAW advantages, such as linear sensor responses and high-bit-depth, minimally processed scene cues. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ILLRAW}, an \textbf{ILL}umination-aware end-to-end \textbf{RAW} object detection framework. Instead of reconstructing visually plausible sRGB images, ILLRAW directly learns detection-oriented RAW features through a lightweight feature adapter inserted at the input stage of existing detectors. ILLRAW estimates an illumination mask and introduces channel-sensitive embeddings to model Bayer-channel responses. These features are fused by an illumination attention fusion module. Experiments show clear improvements on the diverse AODRaw benchmark and competitive performance on LOD and PascalRAW, with particularly strong results under dark exposure.

</details>


### [283] [Q-CamTuning: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Fine-Grained Quality Reasoning in Livestreaming Camera Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03007)
*Yanchao Bi,Pengfei Chen,Yulong Yan,Qian Zhang,Biao Wang,Leida Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 构建直播摄像头调优指令数据集 FGLive-Comments，并提出多模态大模型 Q-CamTuning，以"感知-证据-指导"渐进框架实现细粒度图像对偏好判断与参数调整建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 IQA 方法难以区分摄像头调优中常见的细微画质差异，且缺乏细粒度差异解释与调参建议能力，无法满足直播场景下普通用户的 QoE 需求。

Method: 先构建带细粒度图像对偏好标注及全局/局部视觉证据质量推理的指令微调数据集 FGLive-Comments；再基于该数据训练多模态大语言模型 Q-CamTuning，其渐进式"感知—证据—指导"框架依次学习质量感知视觉表征、全局-局部证据驱动的细粒度推理，并将质量问题映射为摄像头参数调整方向。

Result: 在质量打分与细粒度图像对排序任务上均优于现有 IQA 模型；用户研究验证了其摄像头调优建议的有效性。

Conclusion: 将 IQA 从单纯打分拓展为"可解释诊断 + 可执行调参建议"，为直播端自动摄像头调优提供了数据与模型一体化方案。

Abstract: With the popularization of livestreaming applications, automatic camera tuning has become indispensable for ordinary users to enjoy high Quality of Experience (QoE). However, the existing Image Quality Assessment (IQA) methods face two challenges in camera tuning. First, they struggle to identify subtle quality difference between images, which is common in camera tuning. Second, the ability to explain fine-grained differences and to provide suggestions for camera tuning are even more lacking. To address these challenges, we first construct FGLive-Comments, an instruction tuning dataset with rich annotations of both preferences for fine-grained image pairs and quality reasoning from global and local visual evidence, which supports selective adjustment recommendations of camera parameters. Based on FGLive-Comments, we develop Q-CamTuning, a multimodal large language model for livestreaming camera tuning. Its progressive perception-evidence-guidance framework learns quality-aware visual representations, enhances fine-grained reasoning with global-local evidence, and maps quality issues to camera-parameter adjustment directions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that Q-CamTuning outperforms existing IQA models in both quality scoring and fine-grained image pair ranking. User study also validates its ability to recommend camera tuning suggestions.

</details>


### [284] [Efficient Hybrid Distillation: Synergizing Score and Adversarial Objectives for One-Step Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03017)
*Fei Peng,Junqiang Wu,Haoxian Tan,Jun Zhou,Jie Hu,Xiaoming Wei,Jie Guo,Xiu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EASD框架，指出Score Distillation与Adversarial Distillation的有效工作区间互补（前者擅高噪声全局分布，后者擅低噪声细节），通过regime-adaptive采样让各目标仅作用于其有效区间，实现扩散/流匹配模型的一步蒸馏，在ImageNet 256×256上SiT-XL/2+REPA达到FID 1.39。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合蒸馏策略优于单一范式，但现有方法仅是目标函数的简单叠加，未探讨如何有效协同；本文专门研究Score Distillation与Adversarial Distillation的协同机制。

Method: 分析两类蒸馏目标的有效噪声区间：Score Distillation在高噪声区间捕获全局分布但低噪声区缺乏细粒度监督；Adversarial Distillation低噪声区有效但高噪声区不稳定、判别器易失效。据此设计regime-adaptive采样策略，按噪声区间将各目标路由至其有效区，并将该范式扩展到基于DiT的Flow Matching模型。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，使用SiT-XL/2+REPA模型取得1.39的一步生成FID；提供了混合蒸馏潜力最大化的具体准则。

Conclusion: 混合蒸馏的关键不在于简单加权叠加目标，而在于按噪声区间进行分区协同；该分区适配思路可推广至DiT/Flow Matching架构，为扩散模型加速提供可操作指南。

Abstract: Numerous distillation methods have been developed to accelerate diffusion models. Recent research indicates that hybrid strategies---blending different paradigms---yield superior results compared to single-method approaches. However, current works predominantly rely on a simple combination of objectives, leaving the question of how to effectively synergize them largely underexplored. In this paper, we specifically investigate the synergy between Score Distillation and Adversarial Distillation. We reveal that their operating zones are distinct and complementary: Score Distillation is effective in high-noise regimes for capturing the global distribution yet lacks fine-grained supervision in low-noise regions. Conversely, Adversarial Distillation is effective in low-noise regions but is prone to instability and suffers from discriminator failure when applied to high-noise intervals. Leveraging this insight, we propose Efficient Adversarial Score Distillation (EASD), a framework that synergizes these objectives via a regime-adaptive sampling strategy, directing each objective to focus on its effective interval. We further apply this paradigm to DiT-based Flow Matching models. Empirically, our method achieves a promising one-step FID of 1.39 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 using the SiT-XL/2+REPA model. This work provides a concrete guideline for maximizing the potential of hybrid distillation. Our code and model are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [285] [VizDAGuide: Misleading Chart Question Answering in Compact Vision Language Models via DAG-Structured Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03023)
*Haiyang Zhang,Sicheng Song,Zixin Chen,Jie Gu,Huiya Ou,Chenhui Li,Changbo Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VizDAGuide：用DAG结构化推理状态与依赖关系，并按节点角色分配监督权重，序列化为统一训练目标，用于误导读图问答的开放式与选择题单次推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态模型在误导读表问答中易得出与底层数据矛盾的结论，而现有工作多聚焦推理时策略，训练时监督（尤其是过程级监督）探索不足。

Method: 将中间推理状态及其依赖建模为有向无环图，按角色赋予监督权重，将图序列化为统一SFT目标，支持开放式与多选问答的单遍推理；与内容和权重匹配的线性CoT-SFT基线对比，并在Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5两个模型及两个基准上验证。

Result: 在两种答案格式上均优于内容与权重匹配的线性CoT-SFT基线；过程级评测显示grounding与操作执行提升；消融表明依赖结构与加权监督组合时最有效。

Conclusion: DAG结构化的加权监督对误读图表问答有效，优于线性链式过程监督；属于多模态推理/过程监督范畴，与具身智能、VLA、3D重建等核心方向关联较弱。

Abstract: Misleading charts can lead vision-language models to conclusions that conflict with underlying data. Existing work focuses on inference-time strategies, while training-time supervision remains less explored. We present VizDAGuide, a DAG-structured supervision method for misleading-chart question answering. The method represents intermediate reasoning states and their dependencies as a directed acyclic graph, assigns supervision weights according to their roles, and serializes the graph into a unified training target for open-ended and multiple-choice QA with single-pass inference. Experiments on two benchmarks across Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 models show improvements over a content- and weight-matched Linear CoT-SFT baseline on both answer formats. Process-level evaluation shows gains in grounding and operation execution, while ablations indicate that dependency structure and weighted supervision are most effective when combined. These results support DAG-structured weighted supervision for misleading-chart question answering.

</details>


### [286] [VLM-as-a-Judge for Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03027)
*Bessie Dominguez-Dager,Miguel Cazorla,Vincent Lepetit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将通用视觉-语言模型(VLM)零样本用作重排判官，对两个冻结专家模型的短候选列表做重排，在CHIRLA换衣行人重识别基准上显著提升rank-1，并提出基于“两专家rank-1不一致”的无阈值门控以减少VLM调用与算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 换衣行人重识别(CC-ReID)现有方法互不占优：各方法依赖不同身份线索，在某一基准领先的方法在其他基准上失效，缺少统一主导方案。作者希望利用通用VLM的开放世界身份判断能力来弥补专用检索模型的短板。

Method: 提出“专家检索 + VLM判官重排”的级联流水线：两个冻结的CC-ReID专家分别给出短候选列表，将两专家短列表合并后由零样本VLM在候选间做身份比对并重排；目标数据上不微调任何组件。为降低开销，借鉴集成学习判据，仅在两专家rank-1不一致时调用VLM（无阈值门控）。

Result: 在CHIRLA四个场景上，重排使rank-1全部提升，平均比最优专家高12.9个点、比二者朴素集成高9.4个点；合并双专家短列表效果不低于仅重排较强专家且成本更低。门控减少约40%的VLM调用及相应总算力，rank-1无显著下降，代价是mAP下降1.8–3.8个点。VLM仍占绝大部分FLOPs（主要开销）。

Conclusion: 在专用CC-ReID模型陷入停滞的基准上，冻结的通用VLM是最强的身份判官；级联重排+不一致门控是兼顾精度与算力的实用方案，但判官成本仍是瓶颈。

Abstract: Cloth-changing person re-identification (CC-ReID) is still very challenging, and no method clearly dominates: methods that lead on one benchmark collapse on the others, because they rest on different identity cues. We show that a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM), used zero-shot as a judge for reranking a short candidate list, beats the expert retrieval models it reranks by a wide and consistent margin. On the four scenarios of CHIRLA, a long-term CC-ReID benchmark that no publicly released Re-ID model is trained on, reranking the candidates of two frozen experts raises rank-1 on every scenario, by 12.9 points on average over the best expert and 9.4 over the best naive ensemble of the two, with no component fine-tuned on the target data. Merging both experts' shortlists matches or beats reranking the stronger expert's shortlist alone, at lower cost. Introducing a VLM does, however, come at a cost: almost all of the pipeline's FLOPs are spent on it. We therefore borrow a criterion from ensembling and invoke the VLM judge only where the two experts disagree at rank 1. This threshold-free gate removes 40% of the calls, and a comparable share of total compute, with no significant drop in rank-1, trading 1.8 to 3.8 points of mAP. Judging remains the dominant cost, but on a benchmark where dedicated experts stall, we find a frozen general-purpose model to be the strongest judge of identity. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [287] [GPU-Native Real-Time Textured Mesh Reconstruction with Seam-Aware Multi-View Radiometric Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03033)
*Hiroyuki Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出全GPU驻留的体视频系统，从多RGB-D输入实时重建带纹理三角网格，将TSDF融合、Marching Cubes、连通域去噪、视角纹理映射、补洞与辐射接缝校正全部留在显存内，并用固定大小数组表示网格拓扑与逐相机低频增益场烘焙纹理图集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSDF系统虽加速了融合与网格提取，但逐帧带纹理网格化仍需CPU网格处理、CPU端纹理工作或阶段间的CPU-GPU数据往返，难以做到实时。

Method: GPU原生的体视频流水线：输入暂存后所有阶段（TSDF融合、Marching Cubes、连通分量噪声剔除、基于视角的纹理映射、inpainting、辐射接缝校正）全程驻留GPU，阶段间无中间网格或图像回传主机；用固定大小数组表示网格拓扑以获得常数时间邻域访问并使网格级操作数据并行；每个面仅由单相机取纹理，故估计逐相机低频增益场并在GPU上烘焙进纹理图集以消除曝光接缝。

Result: 在CMU Panoptic数据集上，所有测试体素分辨率与传感器数量下均快于基线，相对CUDA加速的nvblox与CPU版Open3D峰值加速超过一个数量级，重渲染感知质量接近离线带纹理网格化基线。

Conclusion: 端到端GPU驻留设计可消除阶段间主机往返瓶颈，实现实时、可渲染的带纹理网格重建，并兼具接近离线方法的视觉质量。

Abstract: We present a GPU-native volumetric-video system for real-time reconstruction of graphics-compatible textured triangle meshes from multiple RGB-D sensors. Existing TSDF systems accelerate fusion and mesh extraction, but extending them to per-frame textured meshing adds CPU mesh processing, CPU-side texturing work, or extra CPU-GPU transfers between stages. After input staging, our method keeps the reconstruction and texturing stages (TSDF fusion, Marching Cubes, connected-component noise removal, view-based texture mapping, inpainting, and radiometric seam correction) resident on the GPU; no intermediate mesh or image data returns to the host between these stages. A fixed-size-array representation of mesh topology gives constant-time neighbor access on the GPU and makes the downstream mesh-level operations data-parallel. Because we texture each face from a single camera, exposure seams that vary smoothly across each image remain; we estimate a per-camera low-frequency gain field and bake it into the atlas on the GPU. On the CMU Panoptic dataset, our method is faster than the baselines at every tested voxel resolution and number of sensors, achieves peak speedups of more than an order of magnitude over CUDA-accelerated nvblox and CPU-based Open3D, and approaches an offline textured-meshing baseline in perceptual re-rendering quality.

</details>


### [288] [Bayesian Sequential Optimal Experimental Design for Single-Pixel Imaging using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03042)
*Marcos Antonio Obando,Tianyuan Wang,Tanja Tarvainen,Tristan van Leeuwen,Felix Lucka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将单像素成像的自适应压缩感知重构为强化学习问题，学习从后验到二值照明图案的策略以最大化期望信息增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应压缩感知可建模为贝叶斯序贯最优实验设计，但单像素成像的设计空间为全体二值照明图案，直接优化信息论目标计算上不可行。

Method: 将sOED目标转化为RL：智能体以期望信息增益为奖励，通过重复试验学习策略，使当前图像后验信念直接映射到下一个最优二值测量图案；比较两种策略参数化，并考察近似后验、噪声及生物医学约束下的表现。

Result: 数值实验表明所学策略具备可扩展性，在近似后验与含噪测量下仍保持稳健，并可扩展至更复杂的大规模SPI场景。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯sOED-RL框架为单像素成像提供计算高效的自适应测量设计，具备鲁棒性，但仅在简单代表性仿真场景中验证。

Abstract: Adaptive compressed sensing (CS) aims to select the most informative measurements sequentially, which is crucial for many modern imaging systems. This task can be formulated as a Bayesian sequential optimal experimental design (sOED) problem, where each new acquisition is chosen to maximally reduce uncertainty about the unknown image given prior information and subsequent data provided by acquisitions. However, in single-pixel imaging (SPI), the large design space consists of all possible binary illumination patterns. Directly optimizing the Bayesian sOED objective over this space using conventional methods is generally challenging. In this work, we reformulate sOED for SPI as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem. In RL, an agent learns a policy through repeated experimental trials to maximize a reward, here given as the expected information gain, the most complete measure of uncertainty reduction in Bayesian OED. This avoids the need to directly optimize complex information-theoretic objectives during a measurement to obtain the next design. Instead, the result is a learned policy function that directly maps the current posterior belief about the image to the next optimal binary measurement pattern, in a computationally efficient way. Using a simple yet representative SPI imaging scenario, this work evaluates the scalability of the learned policy under two different policy parameterizations. Furthermore, we investigate how performance deteriorates when only approximate posterior information is available or the measurements are impaired by noise, and propose several strategies to introduce additional design constraints motivated by biomedical applications. The numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian sOED-RL framework remains robust and can be extended to more complex, large-scale SPI scenarios.

</details>


### [289] [VideoEditor-MoE: Scaling Complex Video Editing with Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03043)
*Xiao Cao,Fuchen Long,Yansong Qu,Wen Xiao,Xin Zhang,Xinlong Sun,Xi Chen,Zhiyong Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VideoEditor-MoE是首个开源视频编辑MoE框架：除稀疏MLP-MoE外，引入MoE-Attention（路由K-V专家扩展注意力容量并保留全局token交互）；由5B模型初始化，扩展至14B/56B，每token约激活8B参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂视频编辑需同时理解复杂指令并满足多编辑请求，依赖稠密模型scaling会大幅增加计算成本，因此需要稀疏激活的MoE方案在保持性能的同时控制推理开销。

Method: 提出VideoEditor-MoE：在稀疏MLP-MoE层之外设计MoE-Attention，以路由的key-value专家扩充注意力容量，同时保留视频token的全局交互；从5B视频编辑模型初始化并扩展至14B与56B（每token约8B激活）。与显式专家引导（Explicit-MoE）和纯MLP-MoE两种基线做对照分析，并引入解耦权重衰减以稳定专家扩展。

Result: 与现有方法及两种互补基线相比体现了MoE注意力结构的收益；分析显示所有专家均保持活跃，路由对样本内容与扩散噪声水平的响应强于人工定义的编辑类别，空间分析表明模型对物体级语义特征敏感；解耦权重衰减可稳定专家scaling。

Conclusion: MoE-Attention + MLP-MoE的联合稀疏扩展是在可控激活成本下提升复杂视频编辑能力的有效路径，且路由行为呈现内容/噪声驱动而非类别驱动的特性。

Abstract: Complex video editing requires understanding complex instructions while jointly fulfilling multiple editing requests. Meeting these demands through dense model scaling substantially increases computational cost. We introduce VideoEditor-MoE, the first open-source mixture-of-experts framework for video editing. Beyond sparse MLP-MoE layers, MoE-Attention expands attention capacity through routed key--value experts while preserving global interactions among video tokens. Initialized from a 5B video editing model, VideoEditor-MoE scales to 14B and 56B parameters, with approximately 8B parameters activated per token in both variants. Comparisons with existing methods and two complementary baselines, Explicit-MoE and MLP-MoE, assess its benefits over explicit expert guidance and MLP-only expert architectures. Further analyses demonstrate that all experts remain active and reveal that learned routing responds more strongly to sample content and diffusion noise levels than to human-defined editing categories. Spatial analysis further indicates sensitivity to object-level semantic features. We also identify decoupled weight decay as a strategy for stabilizing expert scaling.

</details>


### [290] [MuCHMDPoser: Multiview RGB-Camera Full-Body Pose Tracking for Virtual Reality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03062)
*Antoine Maiorca,George Fletcher,Thierry Ravet,Thierry Dutoit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 用外部多视角RGB相机扩展VR稀疏传感器（HMD+手柄）追踪框架，融合RGB姿态估计显著降低下半身追踪误差，并给出免物理标记的一次性HMD-相机标定方法，实现RTX3080上60FPS端到端动画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级VR仅追踪3个上半身关节（头显+双手），全身姿态尤其是下半身高度欠约束、误差大，需要外部感知补足信息。

Method: 在HMD/手柄稀疏追踪基础上引入外部多视角RGB相机，将基于RGB的人体姿态估计结果与稀疏IMU/运动学信号融合；并设计无需物理标记的一次性HMD-相机外参标定流程；最后给出可实时运行的完整实现。

Result: 加入RGB姿态估计后下半身追踪误差显著下降，且在RGB估计存在常见伪影（噪声、失败帧等）时仍鲁棒；标定无需物理标记；整体框架在Nvidia RTX3080上达到60FPS端到端动画。

Conclusion: 多视角RGB与稀疏VR传感器的混合追踪是降低全身自化身误差的有效方案，具备实时可行性与免标记部署便利性。

Abstract: Accurate full-body tracking in Virtual Reality (VR) is heavily underconstrained when relying solely on consumer-grade sparse sensors, such as Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs) and handheld controllers. Indeed, the self-avatar full-body pose must be inferred based on the 3 available upper-body joints tracked by these devices. This leads to significant tracking error, especially in lower-body pose. To overcome this issue, we propose to extend the tracking setup with external multiview RGB cameras. We show that integrating RGB-based pose estimation this framework is able to significantly decrease lower-body tracking errors, even under common artifacts in RGB-based estimates. Additionally, we evaluate a only-once HMD-camera calibration procedure that does not require any physical markers. We finally propose an implementation of the overall framework, achieving an end-to-end animation at 60 FPS on a Nvidia RTX3080 GPU. Codes are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [291] [VL-Dedup: Graded Multimodal Entity Resolution for Image-Text Data Deduplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03080)
*Zhenxi Liu,Guanze Chen,Dehui Yu,Xingyu Wang,Bingxu Hou,Chengwei Li,Tao Ma,Ke Wang,Gongsheng Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将图文去重重新表述为"分级多模态实体解析"，提出 VL-Dedup：先按视觉实体聚类并限簇大小，再在簇内用 VLM+CLIPScore 决定 caption 保留/标记，并构建 VL-DedupBench（5 万条 COCO/SOP 记录、66,788 对标注）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图文语料中存在重复图、同图多 caption、跨图复用 caption、图文不匹配等多种情况，需不同处理动作；但去重与多模态实体解析只做成对判定，pair 级指标无法反映聚类结果与有用 caption 的被删情况。

Method: 提出分级多模态实体解析（决定视觉同一性、caption 处理、不匹配关系），在 pair/cluster/保留集三层评估；VL-Dedup 用聚类+簇大小上限，簇内以 VLM 与 CLIPScore 判定 caption 取舍与标记；构建 VL-DedupBench。

Result: 在标注对上年错误边为零的分类器仍会把数百万异实体记录对连在一起；把 VLM 调用花在簇内对上而非分数不确定对，可获更优 caption 决策；即使簇几乎全对，"每簇留一条"式删除仍丢失大量事实，而 VL-Dedup 的信息损失显著更小。

Conclusion: pair 级评估不足以刻画去重质量，需在簇与保留集层评估；簇内定向使用 VLM 比按不确定性分配预算更有效，且分级策略能明显减少信息损失。

Abstract: Image-text corpora contain copies of one image, captions that describe one image in different ways, captions reused for different images, and captions that do not match their images. Each case calls for a different curation action. Deduplication and multimodal entity resolution (ER) only decide whether records are the same, and they are evaluated on labeled pairs. Yet pair scores do not tell which records end up in the same cluster or which useful captions get deleted. We therefore formulate image-text deduplication as graded multimodal ER, which decides visual identity, caption handling, and mismatches for each pair, and we evaluate it at three levels: pairs, clusters, and the retained set. Our method, VL-Dedup, groups records of the same visual entity into clusters and caps the size of each cluster. Within each cluster, a vision-language model (VLM) and CLIPScore decide which captions to keep and which to flag. We also build VL-DedupBench, with 50,000 COCO and SOP records and 66,788 labeled pairs. On it, a classifier that selects no false edge among the labeled pairs still joins millions of record pairs from different entities. Spending VLM calls on the pairs inside clusters, rather than on pairs with uncertain scores, gives better caption decisions from the same model. Even when almost all clusters are correct, keeping one record per cluster loses facts in many deletions, while the deletions of VL-Dedup lose much less information.

</details>


### [292] [MIRA: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Deceptive Contextual Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03087)
*Zhihan Yin,Jianxin Liang,Yifeng Yao,Nonghai Zhang,and Bingyue Peng,Chunguang Qie,Huishuai Zhang,Dongyan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIRA 提出一种无需人工标注的 RLVR 训练框架，通过注入筛选后的欺骗性视觉上下文构造"硬陷阱"，并结合组内反思触发机制，使多模态模型能自主检测并纠正视觉线索与逻辑约束的不一致，缓解"感知—推理鸿沟"与级联幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 多模态推理过度依赖看似相关的视觉 token，微小感知扰动会沿推理链传播并导致级联幻觉，形成感知—推理鸿沟；因此需要提升模型对错误视觉上下文的鲁棒性。

Method: 1) 训练时注入经过滤的"欺骗性视觉上下文"构造 hard traps，压测模型对误导信息的鲁棒性；2) 组内（group-wise）反思触发机制，让模型自行检测并修正视觉线索与逻辑约束间的矛盾，并内化为策略行为；3) 全流程不依赖人工标注。

Result: 在多个推理与感知基准上，域内基准平均提升约 7%，以视觉为中心的基准也取得一致提升；消融与分析实验给出有效性来源的解释。

Conclusion: 主动的错误恢复能力是鲁棒多模态推理的关键；通过对抗式视觉陷阱加自反思机制可在无标注条件下有效弥合感知—推理鸿沟。

Abstract: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced multimodal reasoning, existing frameworks suffer from a critical "perception-reasoning gap." Due to an over-reliance on seemingly relevant visual tokens, even minor perceptual perturbations can propagate through the reasoning process, leading to compounding hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose MIRA, a training framework that improves robustness to erroneous visual contexts while enhancing logical reasoning ability. By injecting filtered, deceptive visual contexts during training, we construct challenging "hard traps" that stress-test the model's robustness to misleading information. Furthermore, we introduce a group-wise reflection-triggering mechanism that enables the model to autonomously detect and rectify inconsistencies between visual cues and logical constraints, which is ultimately internalized as an intrinsic policy behavior. Importantly, MIRA does not rely on human annotations. Experimental results across multiple reasoning and perception benchmarks show that MIRA yields an average 7% improvement on in-domain benchmarks, with consistent improvements on vision-centric benchmarks. These findings highlight that active error recovery is essential for robust multimodal reasoning. Comprehensive ablation studies and analyses further provide insights into why MIRA is effective.

</details>


### [293] [DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03097)
*Tiansheng Hu,Yichuan Wang,James V. Talwar,Nicholas Tomlin,Chen Zhao,Sewon Min*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DR Pixel：首个以渲染页面图像为唯一检索与推理单元的开源端到端多模态深度研究智能体（1.06M页面语料），并提出DRPixelBench；训练阶段引入反事实信用重加权（counterfactual credit reweighting）对教师轨迹中的推理/动作步按反事实贡献加权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度研究（DR）智能体将科学论文降维为OCR文本，丢失了表格、图、公式等丰富视觉信息；作者想验证VLM能否直接对渲染页面图像做"page-native"检索与推理，并解决智能体SFT中教师轨迹噪声大（关键步骤与冗余/失败尝试混杂）导致的信用分配问题。

Method: 以渲染页图作为检索与推理的唯一单元，构建端到端多模态DR智能体（1.06M页语料）；构建DRPixelBench（需对文本、图、表、公式联合推理）。训练时用反事实信用重加权：以各推理/动作步对最终答案的反事实贡献为权重，进行细粒度信用分配以做智能体监督微调。

Result: 无训练即优于OCR基线（GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Qwen3.6-27B）且工具调用更少；训练后在DRPixelBench上检索召回提升约15点、最终准确率提升10点以上，并在4个现有基准上超过未训练基线；分布外ViDoRe-V3上距"直接给金标页面"的oracle仅1.8点。

Conclusion: 传统OCR-then-retrieve流水线不仅非必要而且次优；直接对视觉文档页面检索与推理使复杂深度研究更有效、更高效。反事实信用重加权是缓解智能体轨迹噪声的有效训练手段。

Abstract: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.

</details>


### [294] [Ray-SCR: Generalizing Scene Coordinate Regression Across Camera Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03098)
*Jaemin Cho,Oleksii Nasypanyi,Francois Rameau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Ray-SCR 在已有场景坐标回归（SCR）架构上加入"标定视线射线（calibrated viewing ray）条件化"的轻量模块，并用浅层局部 Transformer 聚合相邻射线条件化特征，同时在射线空间构建监督、以稀疏 SfM 点作为跨视角/跨相机模型的度量锚点，从而使单一场景表示可由全景建图序列构建，并准确位姿回归针孔、鱼眼与全向相机的查询图像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SCR 紧凑、精度高、速度快，但对相机模型变化（全向、强矫正图像）泛化差：视场角、镜头畸变、矫正重采样会改变同一场景内容在像素坐标中的表现，导致定位精度下降。作者希望用相机内参/射线信息显式解耦"外观与像素位置"的耦合，实现跨相机模型的通用场景表示。

Method: (1) 射线条件化：将每个局部视觉特征与对应的标定视线射线关联，使特征不再绑定绝对像素位置；(2) 用浅层局部 Transformer 在邻域内精化射线条件化特征；(3) 监督直接建立在射线空间中（预测射线而非像素坐标）；(4) 以稀疏 SfM 点作为度量锚点，跨视角、跨相机模型关联观测；(5) 保持轻量、可即插即用地扩展到多种现有 SCR 网络结构。

Result: 在多种 SCR 架构、以及包含针孔、鱼眼、全向相机的数据集上评测，射线条件化显著提升跨相机泛化，在困难的跨相机设定下取得当前最优（SOTA）定位性能。项目页面公开。

Conclusion: 显式射线空间建模是一种简单有效的手段，可在不改变 SCR 主体架构的前提下解决相机模型异构导致的泛化瓶颈；单一全景建图序列即可支撑多相机类型的统一场景表示与查询定位，对移动机器人、AR/VR 多传感器位姿估计有直接应用价值。

Abstract: Among visual localization strategies, scene coordinate regression (SCR) has emerged as an attractive approach for its compactness, accuracy, and speed. Despite these advantages, SCR models generalize poorly across substantially different camera models, such as omnidirectional or strongly rectified imagery. This limitation arises because, changes in field of view, lens distortion, or rectification-induced resampling can make the same scene content appear differently depending on its pixel position, degrading localization accuracy. To cope with this limitation, we introduce Ray-SCR, a lightweight extension to existing SCR architectures that conditions local visual features on their calibrated viewing rays and refines neighboring ray-conditioned features with a shallow local Transformer. We further formulate supervision directly in ray space and use sparse SfM points as metric anchors that link observations across views and camera models. Taken together, these components enable a single scene representation built from a panoramic mapping sequence to accurately localize query images captured with very different cameras, including pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. We evaluate Ray-SCR across multiple SCR architectures and on datasets with pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. The proposed ray conditioning substantially improves generalization across cameras and leads to state-of-the-art localization performance in these challenging cross-camera settings. The project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [295] [Multimodal Prompt Learning with Dual-Granularity Contrastive Alignment for Preoperative Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma Invasiveness Using 3D CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03109)
*Qing Huang,Xiaotong Tan,Lintong Yao,Wufeng Xue,Ruobing Huang,Dong Ni,Hao Wu,Tian Xiao,Jun Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多模态提示学习框架，采用双粒度（全局报告级+局部关键字级）图文对齐，仅用3D CT推理即可分类肺腺癌浸润性（IAD vs Pre-IAD）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术前准确判断肺腺癌浸润程度对手术规划与个体化治疗重要，但CT表现重叠使IAD与Pre-IAD难以区分；同时希望推理时仅依赖CT，不依赖文本。

Method: 3D ResNet-CBAM编码全局与空间视觉特征；冻结RadBERT加两套可学习提示（报告级、关键词级），提示由真实临床报告语义表征初始化；全局对比对齐将整卷CT与基于标注放射属性的生成报告对齐；基于多实例学习的局部对齐模块将空间特征与血管相关放射关键词关联；联合优化分类与对齐目标。

Result: 1593例病理确诊结节，测试集准确率87.92%、F1 87.78%、AUC 0.9499，显著优于同视觉骨干的图像单模态基线（AUC 0.9297，DeLong p=0.0078）；消融验证全局/局部对齐互补与提示初始化收益；可视化激活集中于结节及邻近血管结构。

Conclusion: 双粒度放射学语义监督可提升CT浸润性预测，且保持仅CT的推理流程，属于医学影像领域的方法性改进。

Abstract: Accurate preoperative prediction of lung adenocarcinoma invasiveness is important for surgical planning and individualized treatment. However, overlapping CT appearances make it challenging to distinguish invasive adenocarcinoma (IAD) from Pre-IAD lesions. We propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework with dual-granularity image-text alignment for 3D CT-based IAD classification. A 3D ResNet-CBAM encoder extracts global and spatial visual features. A frozen RadBERT backbone is adapted with separate learnable prompts for report-level and keyword-level text encoding. These prompts are initialized using semantic representations derived from real-world clinical reports. Global contrastive alignment connects whole-volume CT representations with reports generated from clinician-annotated radiological attributes to provide overall semantic supervision. A multiple instance learning-based local alignment module associates spatial CT features with vascular-focused radiological keywords, to capture local imaging characteristics potentially associated with tumor invasion. The framework jointly optimizes classification and alignment objectives, while inference requires only CT images. Experiments included 1,593 pathologically confirmed nodules. On the test set, the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 87.92%, F1-score of 87.78%, and AUC of 0.9499. Its AUC significantly exceeded that of the image-only Res-CBAM baseline with the same visual backbone (0.9297; DeLong test, p = 0.0078). Ablation analyses supported the complementary contributions of global and local alignment and the benefit of report-based prompt initialization. Qualitative visualizations showed activation within nodules and adjacent vascular structures. These findings suggest that dual-granularity radiological supervision can enhance CT-based invasiveness prediction while preserving a CT-only inference workflow.

</details>


### [296] [3D Gaussian Splatting within Self-Learned Neural View-Dependent Color Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03114)
*Yixiao Yang,Yu-Shen Liu,Zhizhong Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出将3DGS几何与神经网络连续视角相关颜色场耦合学习的框架，通过颜色连续约束与Lipschitz约束把高频颜色变化归因于几何建模，从而缓解离散高斯导致的低质量深度与浮点伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS显式堆叠的离散高斯在深度上质量较差、几何细节缺失且存在大量浮点（floaters），难以表达平滑辐射场，因此需要引入连续先验来规范几何建模。

Method: 在3DGS基础之上，用神经网络参数化连续的视角相关颜色场；利用网络的低频偏置诱导几何承担图像高频变化，避免仅依赖高斯自身颜色属性；对神经颜色场施加Lipschitz连续性约束，使颜色变化与位置变化保持比例一致；并提出无需外部先验的自学习策略提升神经颜色场学习效果。

Result: 在常用公开基准上进行了定量与可视化对比，方法在深度与几何细节恢复的高保真度上优于基线，验证了连续颜色约束对3DGS几何建模的促进作用。

Conclusion: 连续神经颜色场可作为有效的正则化手段改善3DGS的几何表达，自学习策略使其无需外部知识即可泛化到未见场景。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a vital tool in novel view synthesis. 3D Gaussian functions with attributes like color, opacity, and scale are stacked together to explicitly model a radiance field. However, discrete 3D Gaussians usually produce poor depth with few geometry details but lots of floaters, which hinders the effective modeling of smooth radiance fields. To address this issue, we propose to learn a radiance field within a continuous view-dependent color field parameterized by neural networks. With continuous constraints in color, the bias on low-frequency signals of neural networks can highly encourage the geometry modeling to contribute to high-frequency color variations on images, getting rid of solely relying on the color attribute itself. Moreover, we impose a constraint to improve the Lipschitz continuity of the neural color field, making large changes of each Gaussian's color also match with large changes of its position in terms of a ratio. To this end, we additionally introduce novel self-learning strategies to improve the learning of the neural view-dependent color field without any external knowledge or priors, aiming for better generalization on unseen scenes. Our numerical and visual comparisons on widely used benchmarks justify our idea and show better ability of high fidelity geometry recovery in 3DGS. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [297] [KAUSTics-Net: Diffusion-Based Through-Water UAV Restoration with a Semi-Synthetic Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03120)
*Dario Scilla,Omar A. Lopez,Kasper Johansen,Brian O. Nieuwenhuis,Matthew F. McCabe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出半合成浅水图像数据集KAUSTics与像素空间条件扩散复原网络KAUSTics-Net，用于UAV浅水环境图像去畸变与色彩恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UAV浅水测绘受折射、焦散与波长相关衰减等水体致畸影响，且真实成对（退化-参考）数据稀缺，难以训练有监督复原模型。

Method: 构建KAUSTics半合成数据集：32幅高分辨率UAV图像的1,280个参考patch，经Blender水面渲染与经验性色彩/模糊增强生成12,800个退化样本；提出KAUSTics-Net——像素空间条件扩散框架，集成多尺度条件编码器、FiLM调制、交叉注意力与复合重建损失。

Result: 与8种图像复原方法对比并做架构消融与跨数据集实验。KAUSTics上三随机种子平均PSNR 31.715±0.439 dB、SSIM 0.849±0.002、LPIPS 0.145±0.007；独立Sea-Undistort数据集上采样器感知微调后达19.469±0.332 dB PSNR、0.554±0.005 SSIM，但存在感知指标权衡；真实UAV影像上验证特征保持与分割行为。

Conclusion: 半合成训练与条件扩散在浅水图像复原上有潜力，但需同时评估重建保真度与下游遥感效用，跨域泛化与感知-保真权衡仍待解决。

Abstract: Accurate mapping of shallow-water environments using unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenged by water-induced distortions, including refraction, caustics, and wavelength-dependent attenuation. The scarcity of paired distorted and reference imagery further limits the development of supervised restoration methods. To address this challenge, we introduce KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset combining 1,280 reference patches derived from 32 high-resolution UAV images with 12,800 degraded observations generated through Blender-based water-surface rendering and empirical color and blur augmentations. We further propose KAUSTics-Net, a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework integrating a multi-scale conditional encoder, feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), cross-attention, and a composite reconstruction objective to restore shallow-water imagery. We evaluated the framework against eight image-restoration methods, complemented by architectural ablations and cross-dataset experiments. On KAUSTics, KAUSTics-Net achieved a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 31.715 +/- 0.439 dB, structural similarity index (SSIM) of 0.849 +/- 0.002, and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) of 0.145 +/- 0.007 across three training seeds. On the independent Sea-Undistort dataset, sampler-aware fine-tuning improved restoration fidelity, reaching 19.469 +/- 0.332 dB PSNR and 0.554 +/- 0.005 SSIM under combined water-surface distortions, although perceptual trade-offs remained. Additional experiments on real UAV imagery examined feature preservation and segmentation behavior. These findings demonstrate the potential of semi-synthetic training and conditional diffusion for shallow-water image restoration while highlighting the importance of evaluating both reconstruction fidelity and downstream remote-sensing utility.

</details>


### [298] [SurgPace: Complexity-Aware Progressive Distillation for Surgical Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03125)
*Zhicheng He,Xiaohan Xing,Hongqiu Wang,Kun Yuan,Guankun Wang,Yanheng Li,Haoxuan Che,Nassir Navab,Hongliang Ren,Long Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SurgPace，一种复杂度感知的连续课程蒸馏框架，用于压缩手术视觉语言模型（MLLM）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手术MLLM计算开销大难以临床部署；直接蒸馏因样本难度、视觉歧义与临床上下文差异大而不稳定，且监督角色在训练早期（多模态对齐）与后期（任务监督）应动态变化。

Method: 用预测置信度与Lorentz几何一致性估计样本复杂度并融合打分，驱动连续"易到难"课程；再引入层级表示对齐（特征、logit、概率三级），并随训练逐步将重点从教师模仿迁移到任务监督，实现样本级课程与目标级调度的解耦。

Result: 在自建Surg-396K（基于4个公开手术数据集、5种对话范式）上一致优于强MLLM蒸馏基线，获得更紧凑、显存高效且解码更快的手术MLLM，代码开源。

Conclusion: 将几何一致性纳入难度估计的连续课程蒸馏可稳定提升手术MLLM压缩效果，但证据限于受控基准，缺少真实手术场景验证。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential in robotic surgery for question answering, scene understanding, and grounded assistance, but their high computational cost limits real clinical deployment. Knowledge distillation provides a practical way to build compact surgical MLLMs, yet direct distillation is not well suited to surgical data because surgical samples vary greatly in difficulty, visual ambiguity, and required clinical context, making uniform teacher-student transfer unstable. In addition, the role of supervision changes during training: early stages require stronger teacher guidance for multimodal alignment, while later stages rely more on task supervision for effective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. SurgPace estimates sample complexity using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency, and uses the fused score to guide a continuous easy-to-hard training process. We further introduce hierarchical representation alignment, which aligns the student with the teacher at the feature, logit, and probability levels, while gradually shifting the training focus from teacher imitation to task supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling, leading to more stable and effective distillation. We evaluate SurgPace on Surg-396K, a benchmark built from four public surgical datasets and covering five dialogue paradigms. SurgPace consistently outperforms strong MLLM distillation baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for building compact, memory-efficient surgical MLLMs with faster decoding under controlled benchmarks. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [299] [Behavioral Affinity Transduction for Zero-Shot Vision-Language Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03132)
*Junxi Huang,Wenshuo Chen,Xiucheng Wang,Meitong Shen,Shaofeng Liang,Yuehan Kou,Yutao Yue,Nan Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Behavioral Affinity Transduction (BAT)，利用未标注查询批次内图像在类词表上的响应轮廓构建稀疏图进行转导式邻居证据聚合，可插入冻结 VLM 的直接与迭代读出，显著提升零样本分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本 VLM 对每张图独立打分，忽略了同一未标注批次中邻居图像所能提供的判别证据；而纯视觉相似度易受姿态、背景干扰，可能跨越真实类别边界，因此需要更可靠的建邻依据。

Method: BAT 以每张图在类词表上的分数分布（类响应轮廓）作为表示，构建稀疏亲和图，在预测时聚合邻居证据；对 EM-Dirichlet 读出额外用于候选类筛选与赋值初始化，兼容直接与迭代两类读出，全程冻结 VLM、无需标注。

Result: 在多组数据集上，BAT 使所有测试读出的平均精度均有提升；主实验 RN50 上，soft 与 hard EM-Dirichlet 分别提升 4.22 与 2.72 个百分点。

Conclusion: 批次内基于类响应轮廓的转导式邻居证据是零样本 VLM 读出中被忽视且易得的增益来源，可作为通用插件低成本提升分类性能。

Abstract: An image that is hard to classify on its own may have a helpful neighbor in the same unlabeled batch. Zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) score images independently and leave this evidence unused. We study small unlabeled query batches with no labeled examples. Visual similarity can reflect pose or background, so it may connect images from different classes. Each image's scores over the class vocabulary offer another way to choose neighbors. We introduce Behavioral Affinity Transduction (BAT), which builds a sparse graph from these class-response profiles. The graph supplies neighbor evidence during prediction. For EM-Dirichlet, it also screens candidate classes and initializes assignments. BAT plugs into direct and iterative readouts of a frozen VLM. Across diverse datasets, BAT improves the mean accuracy of every tested readout. In the main RN50 comparison, soft and hard EM-Dirichlet gain $4.22$ and $2.72$ percentage points.

</details>


### [300] [Znaki: A Russian Fingerspelling Recognition Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03136)
*Petr Surovtsev,Pavel Korotaev,Alexander Nagaev,Alexander Kapitanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Znaki：首个公开的俄罗斯手语（RSL）指拼数据集，35.4 小时、37,252 段视频、1,593 个字母序列，68 名母语者众包录制，覆盖全部 33 个西里尔手形，并提供两个 ASL 指拼识别基线的适配结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RSL 使用人数超过 15 万，但相比 ASL、BSL、DGS 等，缺乏公开的指拼（fingerspelling）数据集，阻碍指拼识别研究。指拼用于拼写人名、术语和未登录词，是手语的必要组成部分。

Method: 众包采集流程：两级签署者资格审核 + 专家校验；68 名母语签署者（37 聋人、29 重听、2 名认证手译员）录制 1,593 个来自 16 个领域类别的专有名词序列，共 37,252 段视频（35.4 小时）；覆盖全部 33 个西里尔手形，字母频率分布与俄罗斯国家语料库对齐。基线采用从 ASL 指拼识别迁移的两个模型：Squeezeformer 编码器-解码器与 Fingerspelling-PoseNet。

Result: Squeezeformer 基线字符级准确率（1-CER）0.932、序列准确率 0.596；Fingerspelling-PoseNet 分别为 0.886 与 0.545。

Conclusion: 填补 RSL 指拼数据空白，提供开放数据与可复现基线，为后续 RSL 指拼识别研究建立参照点。

Abstract: Fingerspelling - the sequential signing of letters that compose proper names, technical terms, and out-of-vocabulary words - is an integral component of any sign language. Despite Russian Sign Language (RSL) being used by more than 150,000 native signers, no public fingerspelling dataset for RSL exists, in contrast to American, British, German, and several other sign languages. We introduce Znaki the first open RSL fingerspelling dataset: 37,252 video recordings (35.4 hours) of 1,593 unique sequences - proper names sampled from 16 domain categories - recorded by 68 native RSL signers (37 Deaf, 29 hard-of-hearing, and 2 certified interpreters) through a crowdsourcing pipeline with a two-stage signer qualification procedure and expert validation. The dataset covers all 33 Cyrillic handshapes, and its letter-frequency distribution matches the Russian National Corpus. As reference points for future research, we establish two baselines adapted from American Sign Language fingerspelling recognition: a Squeezeformer-based encoder-decoder, reaching a character-level accuracy ($1-\mathrm{CER}$) of 0.932 and a sequence accuracy of 0.596, and Fingerspelling-PoseNet, reaching 0.886 and 0.545, respectively.

</details>


### [301] [When Optimization Meets Human Intent: Human-Centered Diffusion Model Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03140)
*Renye Yan,Jikang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文是一篇以人为中心的综述（position/synthesis paper），系统梳理扩散模型优化中的"人类意图"表达、翻译为可优化目标、施加于模型或生成过程、以及输出评估四个环节，并讨论个人化生成中意图对齐的权衡、自动化指标与真实用户判断之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化扩散系统多用可测量指标（如美学分数）近似人类需求，但人类需求是多维、情境化、动态的；固定指标只部分捕获意图，优化时甚至可能放大与真实意图的偏差，导致更高分数未必更符合用户期望。作者希望厘清人类意图如何进入并影响优化流程。

Method: 概念性综合分析：沿"意图表达→目标转化→作用于模型行为/生成过程→输出评估"四阶段框架对现有扩散优化/微调/引导方法进行归类与批判性重组织，并分析对齐权衡与指标-用户判断差距。文中未提出新算法或开展新实验。

Result: 给出一个以人为中心的扩散优化分类框架，明确各环节中意图失真的来源（指标部分覆盖、优化放大偏差、评估与用户判断脱节），并总结个性化图像生成中意图对齐的多目标权衡。

Conclusion: 扩散优化的核心问题在于意图的表示与评估，而非单纯提升可测指标；面向人类偏好的个性化生成系统需要更全面的意图建模与更贴近真实用户的评估。该框架可作为系统参考，但缺乏实证验证。

Abstract: Diffusion models are evolving from general tools into personalized systems that adapt to user needs through fine-tuning and guidance. However, diffusion optimization mainly targets measurable objectives such as aesthetics, rarely examining whether they align with human intent. Human needs are multidimensional, contextual, and dynamic, whereas existing methods approximate them with fixed metrics. Because these metrics capture human needs only partially and may amplify deviations from true intent during optimization, higher scores need not yield results better matching human expectations. To understand how human needs enter and influence optimization, we systematically analyze how human intent is expressed, translated into optimizable objectives, applied to model behavior or generation, and evaluated through outputs. We further discuss trade-offs affecting human-intent alignment in personalized image generation and gaps between automated metrics and real user judgments. This human-centered synthesis reorganizes diffusion optimization and provides a systematic reference for personalized generation systems designed for human preferences.

</details>


### [302] [Visual-to-Executable Procedural Reconstruction of Buildings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03143)
*Zichong Zhu,Zhihao Liu,Andrei Sharf,Zhanglin Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 从单张野外图像中通过两阶段结构化预测（全局结构布局树 + 组件参数化）恢复可执行CGA程序化建筑描述，生成可编辑可复用的3D建筑资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序化建模表示紧凑、可编辑、可复用，但构建仍严重依赖人工编写文法；单图像证据不完整且视角依赖，直接生成低级程序脆弱。

Method: 两阶段结构化预测：(1) 微调布局模型 + 渲染引导的视觉-符号反射，恢复立面尺度的split-and-repeat组织，形成Global Structure Layout Tree；(2) Component Parameterization schema将代表性立面瓦片映射为结构化程序属性。两表示确定性地编译为可执行CGA程序，并附着于简单体量模型实现建筑级实例化。

Result: 实验显示可同时处理规则立面与挑战性野外图像，保持高结构一致性、程序可执行性与细粒度建筑细节，并支持可控、可复用的3D资产生成。

Conclusion: 以“结构化中间表示+确定性编译”替代直接程序生成，是稳健的图像到程序化建筑重建路线。

Abstract: Procedural modeling offers compact, editable, and reusable representations for architectural content, but building such models still depends heavily on manually authored grammars. We study image-based procedural building reconstruction from in-the-wild images, with the goal of recovering an executable procedural description that can be instantiated as an editable 3D building asset. Because a single image provides only partial and view-dependent evidence, we focus on recovering the dominant visible facade(s) and attach the recovered facade program to a simple mass model for building-level instantiation. Our method decomposes this task into two structured prediction stages. First, a Global Structure Layout Tree recovers facade-scale split-and-repeat organization through a fine-tuned layout model with render-guided visual-symbolic reflection. Second, a Component Parameterization schema maps representative facade tiles to structured procedural attributes for local architectural component synthesis. These two representations are then deterministically compiled into executable Computer Generated Architecture (CGA) programs, avoiding the brittleness of direct low-level program generation. Experiments show that the proposed framework handles both regular facades and challenging in-the-wild images, while maintaining high structural consistency, procedural executability, and fine-grained architectural detail. The recovered programs further enable controllable and reusable 3D building asset generation.

</details>


### [303] [MoSoLoco: Monocular 3D Human Localization through Visual Latent Features and Social Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03189)
*Yasamin Borhani,Javad Khoramdel,Yang Gao,Po-Chien Luan,Alexandre Alahi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoSoLoco：复用姿态检测器内部视觉特征与2D骨架的单目逐帧3D人体定位器，可融合同帧稀疏多人社交上下文，无需额外RGB/深度编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人导航与运动预测需要轻量级单目3D人体定位；现有基于关键点的定位器虽计算量小，但丢弃了姿态估计器内部的丰富视觉表征。

Method: 以姿态检测器内部特征（而非新增RGB/深度编码器）与检测到的2D骨架联合回归3D位置；增加稀疏社会交互模块，利用同帧邻近检测结果细化单个体位置估计；保持逐帧、轻量特性。

Result: JRDB与NuScenes上复用姿态检测器表征带来定位提升，JRDB最佳误差较最强关键点基线降低约23%；社交交互模块进一步改进；轨迹预测下游实验显示收益；完整流程可在Jetson AGX Xavier上高效推理。

Conclusion: 姿态特征复用与稀疏多人上下文是低成本、可部署的3D人体定位有效手段，对下游轨迹预测有实用价值。

Abstract: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.

</details>


### [304] [AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03228)
*Weirong Chen,Ismail El-Yamany,Ganlin Zhang,Chuanxia Zheng,Andrea Vedaldi,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnchorComplete 基于 TRELLIS.2 从部分点云重建完整场景网格，通过全局 token 与局部空间证据相结合的部分点条件化和度量尺度粗到细窗口生成，在 Replica/SCRREAM 上优于基线，尤其稀疏视角下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像驱动的三维重建器只能恢复可见表面，产生带大空洞的部分点云，未观测几何无法求解；本文拟在保留已观测几何的前提下补全场景级几何。

Method: 构建于 TRELLIS.2 之上：(1) partial-point conditioning：融合全局场景 token 与局部空间证据，将生成锚定到输入点云；(2) metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation：在固定尺寸窗口内渐进细化几何，同时维持全局结构一致性，支持不同尺度场景。

Result: 在 Replica 与 SCRREAM 上，完整场景重建一致优于强基线，稀疏视角设置下提升尤为明显。

Conclusion: 提出了可扩展的场景级补全框架，兼顾观测几何保真与未观测区域生成，但证据限于合成/仿真类数据集，缺乏真实场景泛化与开源情况说明。

Abstract: Most image-based 3D reconstructors primarily recover visible surfaces, producing partial point clouds with large holes and leaving unobserved geometry unresolved. To address this limitation, we introduce AnchorComplete, a framework that reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds while preserving observed geometry and supporting scenes of varying scales. Building on TRELLIS.2, our method combines partial-point conditioning, which integrates global scene tokens with local spatial evidence to anchor generation to the input, and metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, which progressively refines scene geometry within fixed-size windows while maintaining global structural consistency. Experiments on Replica and SCRREAM demonstrate that AnchorComplete consistently outperforms strong baselines in complete-scene reconstruction, particularly under sparse-view settings.

</details>


### [305] [CL3DOD: Understanding the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Outdoor Class-Incremental 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03229)
*Muhammad Ahmed Ullah Khan,Khalil Ahmed,Didier Stricker,Muhammad Zeshan Afzal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次在KITTI与nuScenes上统一跨基准分析室外类增量3D目标检测，提出CL3DOD框架（上阶段检测器伪标签复原旧类监督+查询级知识蒸馏+EMA时序一致性正则），揭示一致的稳定性-可塑性困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室外3D目标检测的类增量学习研究稀少，现有工作（SDCoT++仅KITTI、CL2OD仅nuScenes）各自使用不同增量设置、单基准评测，难以判断所观察到的持续学习行为能否跨自动驾驶基准泛化。

Method: 构建跨基准统一评测（双任务与多阶段设定）；CL3DOD包含三部分：(1) 用上一阶段检测器的预测为旧类恢复缺失监督；(2) 查询级(query-wise)知识蒸馏以保留旧类响应；(3) 基于EMA的时间一致性正则化。

Result: 在KITTI与nuScenes上均观察到一致的稳定性-可塑性困境；CL3DOD相比受控增量基线与已发表先前方法取得更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡，并在多增量阶段下保持旧知识保留与新类获取的兼顾。

Conclusion: 验证了室外类增量3D检测中稳定性-可塑性困境的跨基准普遍性，所提出的CL3DOD提供了一种有效的监督复原+蒸馏+时序一致性组合方案；代码、评测与任务划分将公开。

Abstract: Class-incremental learning (CIL) for outdoor 3D object detection remains largely underexplored. Existing outdoor studies are limited to single-benchmark evaluations, with SDCoT++ considering KITTI and CL2OD considering nuScenes under different incremental settings. This makes it difficult to assess whether observed continual-learning behavior generalizes across autonomous-driving benchmarks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of outdoor class-incremental 3D object detection across multiple autonomous-driving benchmarks, covering both two-task and multi-stage settings. We investigate: (1) how severely existing 3D detectors forget previously learned classes, (2) how incremental training exposes the stability-plasticity dilemma between knowledge retention and new-class acquisition, and (3) which forms of supervision are most effective for balancing these objectives. We introduce CL3DOD, a class-incremental 3D detection framework that restores missing supervision for previous classes using predictions from the previous-stage detector, preserves old-class responses through query-wise knowledge distillation, and employs EMA-based temporal consistency regularization. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes reveal a consistent stability-plasticity dilemma across both benchmarks. CL3DOD generally achieves a more favorable stability-plasticity balance than controlled incremental baselines and improves upon published prior methods in the reported benchmark comparisons. This advantage persists across multiple incremental stages, demonstrating strong retention of previously learned knowledge while maintaining effective new-class acquisition. Our code, evaluation setup, and incremental task splits will be publicly released.

</details>


### [306] [Calibrating Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation under Reliability and Availability Modality Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03232)
*Jiangmeng Li,Jinglin Xu,Yi Li,Yumeng Liu,Jiahuan Zhou,Fanjiang Xu,Hui Xiong,Gang Hua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 AdaPGC，将类别条件高斯建模扩展到多模态测试时自适应（TTA），在模态可靠性与可用性迁移下同时校准单模态与融合表征并恢复缺失融合表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态 TTA 面临多表征视角共存交互的复杂性，尤其存在可靠性漂移（模态可用但信息质量下降）与可用性漂移（模态完全缺失）两类情况，单模态类别条件高斯建模无法直接迁移。

Method: 对模态特定表征与融合表征分别维护类别条件高斯模型，用其概率预测校准源模型输出、指导基于可靠性的修正，并利用高斯联合分布恢复不可用的融合表征；模型在测试流中持续更新。

Result: 在多种模态损坏与缺失条件下实验，AdaPGC 在可靠性与可用性漂移下均显著提升鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 类别条件高斯建模经扩展后可有效处理多模态分布漂移，作为无需训练数据的推理期自适应方案，为多模态 TTA 提供了统一概率校准框架。

Abstract: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) enables pretrained multimodal models to accommodate distribution shifts during inference using only unlabeled test data, without recourse to the original training data. Compared with unimodal adaptation, multimodal adaptation is further complicated by the coexistence and interaction of multiple representation perspectives. This complexity is particularly pronounced under modality reliability shifts, which preserve modality availability but degrade information quality, and modality availability shifts, which render the corresponding modality entirely inaccessible. Category-conditional Gaussian modeling offers a natural starting point for handling such distributional variations, having proven effective in unimodal test-time adaptation for characterizing representation distributions, yet its extension to multimodal settings requires a more elaborate formulation. To this end, we propose Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration (AdaPGC), which extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling across modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations for probabilistic calibration under multimodal distribution shifts. AdaPGC continuously updates category-conditional Gaussian models over modality-specific and fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model predictions and guide reliability based rectification, while exploiting their joint distributions to recover unavailable fusion representations. Extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC effectively improves robustness under both modality reliability and availability shifts. Our source code will be released at this https URL .

</details>


### [307] [HyperFlow: Class-Incremental Semantic Change Detection via Hyperbolic Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03245)
*Manon Béchaz,Léo Buecher,Emanuele Dalsasso,Ciprian Tomoiaga,Patrick Jayet,Marcin Detyniecki,Laetitia Chapel,Lucas Drumetz,Nicolas Courty,Devis Tuia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出类增量语义变化检测任务，利用双曲空间表示土地利用类别层级结构，以Busemann原型构建语义流异常检测方法HyperFlow，并发布HiChange数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感语义变化检测方法假设变化类别集合固定，难以适应不同地区或随时间变化的关注类别；而新引入的类别往往是对已有类别的细粒度细分，天然具备层级关系，适合用双曲空间建模。

Method: 将土地覆盖语义类别嵌入双曲空间以保持层级结构；提出HyperFlow，基于Busemann原型在学习到的双曲语义流中把变化建模为异常，从而将变化检测与类增量语义分割耦合，实现类增量语义变化检测；同时构建HiChange大规模高分辨率遥感数据集，含细粒度层级标注。

Result: 实验表明HyperFlow在各增量步骤上均取得较强变化检测与语义分割性能；逐步细化语义类别的方式优于一次性引入全部类别，验证了增量学习对语义变化检测的增益。

Conclusion: 双曲层级表示与语义流异常建模可有效支撑类增量语义变化检测，渐进式类别细化能提升变化检测效果。

Abstract: Semantic change detection in remote sensing aims to identify and characterize land-cover transitions observed in pairs of satellite or aerial images. Existing methods assume a fixed set of change categories, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where changes of interest may vary, for example across geographies or over time. In this work, we tackle the problem of class-incremental semantic change detection, where a model progressively learns to detect new types of semantic change. To do so, we exploit the hierarchical structure of land-cover semantics, where newly introduced categories correspond to fine-grained refinements of existing ones, and represent said semantic categories in hyperbolic space, which is particularly well suited to represent such hierarchical relationships. To capture semantic changes, we introduce HyperFlow, a method relying on Busemann prototypes, modeling change as an anomaly in a learned semantic flow within the hyperbolic embedding space induced by segmentation. HyperFlow couples change detection to class-incremental semantic segmentation, enabling class-incremental semantic change detection. We also present HiChange, a new large-scale, high resolution remote sensing dataset with detailed, fine-grained hierarchical labels. Experimental results demonstrate that HyperFlow achieves both strong change detection and semantic segmentation performance across incremental steps. In particular, we show that progressively refining semantic categories, rather than considering them all directly, yields improved change detection, highlighting the benefits of incremental learning for semantic change detection.

</details>


### [308] [R$^2$-Omni: Reducing Structural and Precision Redundancy in Omni-LLMs for Long-Form Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03247)
*Bolong Feng,Pengfei Zhou,Zhenglin Wan,Wei Wang,Wangbo Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架R²-Omni，对Omni-LLM的KV缓存同时削减"结构冗余"（时空/局部相似性合并token）与"精度冗余"（按语义敏感度分配量化精度），长文本生成下显存降5.0×、保留97.98%质量、端到端加速1.48×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Omni-LLM处理大量音视频token导致KV缓存显存与算力开销巨大；激进token剪枝在选择题任务尚可，但在开放长文本生成时质量显著下降，原因是query引导的选择只保留"选答案"所需证据而丢弃生成细节。因此需转向降低token间重叠信息（结构冗余）并保留多样性，同时缓存值仍存在数值精度冗余。

Method: 免训练两级冗余压缩：①Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC)，利用视频时空相似性与音频局部连续性合并冗余表示；②Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA)，以量化键条件下注意力输出误差的估计降低量为准则，结合query注意力与音视频对齐作为语义先验，为保留表示分配value精度。

Result: 在长文本生成基准上平均显存占用降低5.0×，保留97.98%基线生成质量，端到端加速1.48×。

Conclusion: 联合降低结构冗余与精度冗余可有效缓解Omni-LLM长文本生成中的KV缓存瓶颈，兼顾效率与质量，且无需训练。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) typically process large numbers of multimodal tokens from audio-visual inputs, incurring substantial computational costs and a large memory footprint for the key-value (KV) cache. Aggressive token pruning can alleviate this problem while maintaining competitive performance on multiple-choice tasks, which require only a single option as output. However, we observe substantial quality degradation when generating long-form, open-ended responses. We attribute this gap to query-guided selection, which can retain sufficient evidence for answer selection while discarding details needed for comprehensive generation. This motivates reducing overlapping information across tokens, termed structural redundancy, while preserving diverse content. However, the retained representations may still contain precision redundancy due to unnecessarily high numerical precision in their cached values. To address these two levels of redundancy in token representations, we introduce a training-free framework named R$^2$-Omni. First, Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) consolidates redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Then, Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA) allocates value precision to the retained representations according to the estimated reduction in attention-output error under quantized keys, with query attention and audio-visual alignment providing a semantic prior. Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks demonstrate an average 5.0$\times$ reduction in the memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48$\times$ end-to-end speedup, highlighting the benefits of jointly reducing structural and precision redundancy.

</details>


### [309] [ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03283)
*Vasiliki Vasileiou,Panagiotis P. Filntisis,Petros Maragos,Kostas Daniilidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReVA-HPE 将相对头部姿态估计扩展到完整 6DoF（增加深度归一化相对平移），用单张无标注注册图重建个性化头像并渲染已知姿态的虚拟锚点库，通过多锚点共识给出旋转假设、用真实注册图 + 地标 PnP 处理平移，从而在推理时无需锚点真实姿态。模型仅在合成人脸渲染上训练，在 BIWI/FaMoS 上取得 SOTA 旋转精度且平移具竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目绝对回归式头部姿态估计忽略同一人跨时间的可用锚点图像；已有的相对头部姿态估计虽能利用锚点几何变化，但推理时仍要求锚点姿态已知，实用性受限。

Method: 把相对姿态估计扩展为 6DoF：预测深度归一化相对平移并与锚点组合以恢复相机坐标系下的度量查询姿态。用单张无标签注册图重建个性化 avatar，渲染一组已知姿态的虚拟锚点库；旋转分支用多锚点共识产生稳健假设，平移分支用真实注册图的地标 PnP。另提出高效变体：在注册阶段一次性摊销锚点库开销，之后每次查询只做一次 real-to-real 相对预测。估计器仅用合成人脸渲染训练，不使用真实姿态监督、伪标签、域适应或评测集微调。

Result: 在真实 6DoF 基准上，BIWI 达到 SOTA 旋转精度；在近似正脸的注册图条件下，FaMoS 亦为 SOTA；尽管仅有合成姿态监督，度量平移仍具竞争力。代码与项目页公开。

Conclusion: 以"虚拟锚点库 + 合成监督"替代推理期真实锚点姿态需求，为免标定、跨时间的个体化 6DoF 头部姿态估计提供了可行范式，并用摊销式变体给出精度/效率折中。

Abstract: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: this https URL

</details>


### [310] [Mesh-Agnostic Refinement Models for Latent Space Encoding of 3D Human Body Shapes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03285)
*Chaima Zouaouid,Jonathan Cerqueirab,Sylvain Arguillere,Martin Bauer,Nicolas Charon,Mohamed Daoudi,Emmanuel Hartman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于几何差异（varifold距离）的SMPL人体重建精化框架，含潜码修正VaRefine、顶点位移预测VRefine、弹性约束直接优化ElaOpt三条互补路径，无需顶点对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数化人体模型（如SMPL）的重建误差同时来源于潜参数估计不准与解码器表达能力有限；作者希望不依赖顶点对应关系、直接利用初始解码表面与目标网格的几何差异来精化结果。

Method: 三类方法：(1) Latent-VaRefine：用varifold距离梯度修正潜码，保持原参数化表示；(2) Vertex-VaRefine：以DiffusionNet为骨干处理多尺度varifold梯度特征，在标准姿态下预测顶点位移，得到近似姿态等变的精化流程；(3) ElaOpt：在弹性正则与法向约束下直接优化表面形变。

Result: 摘要未给出定量结果；预期在无对应点设定下降低初始解码表面与目标网格的几何误差，且各方法在潜空间一致性与形变自由度之间形成取舍。

Conclusion: 几何差异驱动的后处理精化是改善参数化人体重建的有效通用范式，可在不改变参数化模型的前提下提升几何保真度。

Abstract: Parametric human body models such as the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) model provide compact representations of human shape and pose, but their reconstructions remain affected by both errors in estimated latent parameters and limitations in the decoder's expressive capacity. We propose a framework for refining these reconstructions by exploiting the geometric discrepancy between an initial decoded surface and a target mesh, without requiring vertex correspondences between them. The framework comprises three complementary approaches. Latent-VaRefine uses varifold-distance gradients to correct the estimated latent code while preserving the original parametric representation. Vertex-VaRefine processes multiscale varifold-gradient features with a DiffusionNet backbone to predict vertex displacements in a canonical pose, yielding an approximately pose-equivariant refinement pipeline. ElaOpt directly optimizes surface deformations under elastic regularization and normal-direction constraints.

</details>


### [311] [ArabGeoText: Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Models for Arabic Geospatial Text Spotting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03339)
*Yakoub Bazi,Sarah Alsaleh,Mohamad M. Al Rahhal,Mohamed A. Mekhtiche,Mansour Zuair*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出阿拉伯语地理空间文本检测基准ARABGEOTEXT（利雅得与吉达970个地点、每种视图17,875个标注实例，OSM渲染与叠加遥感影像的成对视图），并提出YOLO26定位+裁剪矫正与LoRA适配Qwen3.5-4B识别的工具增强VLM框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语文本识别在文档与自然场景已有大量研究，但地理空间（地图）场景中的阿拉伯语文本检测识别尚属空白；地图标签小、密集、任意朝向，且背景（渲染图vs遥感影像）差异大。直接用Qwen3.5-4B检测难以召回瓦片内全部标签。

Method: 构建成对视图基准：同一地点的OSM渲染图与其叠加在对应遥感影像上的合成图，保持标签内容与像素几何一致，支持城市内与跨城市（city-disjoint）分区评测检测、识别与端到端检测识别。方法上将任务分解：YOLO26负责定位与裁剪矫正，Qwen3.5-4B经LoRA适配作为读取器，形成工具增强的两阶段VLM框架。

Result: 工具增强框架在两种视图与两个测试城市上均优于直接LoRA适配的Qwen3.5-4B端到端检测；在固定定位结果时，LoRA读取器相比零样本预训练读取器进一步提升识别性能。直接端到端spotting难以覆盖瓦片内全部标签。

Conclusion: 地理空间阿拉伯语文本检测识别需要解耦定位与识别，专用检测器+适配读取器的组合更有效；成对视图基准可支撑背景泛化与跨城市评测。数据集与代码将公开。

Abstract: Geospatial text spotting involves locating and transcribing geographic labels, such as road names, district names, and landmarks, in raster maps. These labels are often small, densely arranged, and arbitrarily oriented. Although Arabic text recognition has been studied extensively in documents and natural scenes, Arabic geospatial text spotting remains underexplored. We introduce ARABGEOTEXT, an Arabic-centric benchmark covering 970 geographic locations in Riyadh and Jeddah, with 17,875 manually annotated text instances per view type. For each location, we pair an OpenStreetMap (OSM) rendering with a composite created by overlaying that rendering on the corresponding remote sensing (RS) imagery. The paired views preserve label content and pixel geometry, allowing evaluation across different backgrounds. Geographic partitions support in-city and city-disjoint evaluation of detection, recognition, and end-to-end spotting. Experiments with direct Qwen3.5-4B spotting show difficulties in recovering all labels within a tile. We therefore propose a tool-augmented vision-language framework that combines YOLO26 localization and crop rectification with Qwen3.5-4B recognition adapted through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The framework outperforms direct LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-4B spotting across both image views and test cities. With localization held fixed, reader adaptation further improves recognition over the pretrained zero-shot reader. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [312] [Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03360)
*Moein Heidari,Junbo Rao,Yudan Chen,Yasamin Medghalchi,River Jiang,Wenjin Chen,David J. Foran,Jasmine Grewal,Ilker Hacihaliloglu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Kev-Bio视觉语言模型，用临床测量问题引导超声关键点检测，通过决策表征生成查询并与共享稠密超声特征匹配产生空间概率图，从而回归卡尺端点坐标与测量值，在FU/GU Biometry 2026九视图数据集上MRE 22.50像素、测量MAE 15.38。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声生物测量依赖手动放置卡尺，存在操作者间变异；传统方法为不同任务设计专用预测头，缺乏灵活性；直接用VLM做坐标回归无法显式建模空间似然分布，难以表达定位歧义。

Method: 受System One决策模型启发，用语言模型的决策表征为每个卡尺端点生成查询，与共享稠密超声特征做匹配得到空间概率图，再由概率图导出关键点坐标与临床测量值；端到端联合训练关键点定位损失与临床测量损失。

Result: 在九视图FU/GU Biometry 2026数据集上平均径向误差22.50像素、临床测量MAE 15.38，整体优于对比基线。

Conclusion: 验证了以文本测量的形式统一多解剖视图的超声关键点检测与测量任务的可行性，概率图式查询匹配优于直接坐标回归。

Abstract: **Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity. **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses. **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance. **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [313] [Fuse To Align: Multimodal Representation Learning for Retrieval via Hypergraph Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03370)
*Anindya Nag,Ambuj Mehrish,Sebastiano Vascon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出训练期超图融合框架（wHyVol/wRHG），在样本内与语义相关样本间建立跨样本模态证据交换，学习视图权重与语义亲和度，推理阶段不改变检索流程、无额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态检索中各视图常缺失、含噪或信息量不均，样本自身的视图证据不足时难以学到有效检索表征；已有基于volume的目标只在单样本内部对齐模态，未显式实现跨样本信息交换。

Method: 构建训练期超图，将观测模态在样本内和语义相关样本间连接；HyVol为其特例。wHyVol学习视图贡献权重与对称语义亲和度；wRHG通过关系传播进一步建模类型化交互与参与角色。缺失模态直接省略而非插补，超图在训练后丢弃。

Result: 在11个零样本视频-文本与音频-文本检索基准上，GRAM和HyperGRAM均获广泛提升。17个视频基准-模态设置、双向检索共34项比较中，wRHG全胜GRAM、33/34胜HyperGRAM。文本到视频平均R@1：GRAM 63.4→68.2，HyperGRAM 64.8→68.4；ActivityNet上视频到文本最大提升13.3个百分点。缺失模态评测下，7个基准在所有缺失率下均保持正增益，单模态缺失达90%时仍有效。

Conclusion: 跨样本超图证据融合可作为纯训练期增强，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升多种多模态检索任务，并对严重模态缺失具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Multimodal retrieval must integrate complementary evidence from views that may be missing, noisy, or unequally informative. When a sample provides limited reliable evidence, learning from its views alone can hinder the acquisition of useful retrieval representations. Semantically related training samples may provide complementary observations, yet existing volume-based objectives jointly align modalities within each sample without explicitly enabling information exchange across samples. We therefore propose a training-time hypergraph fusion framework that connects observed modalities both within samples and across semantically related samples, allowing representation learning to draw on evidence beyond an individual sample while leaving the retrieval pipeline unchanged at inference. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and introduces two configurations: wHyVol learns view contribution weights and symmetric semantic affinities, whereas wRHG additionally models typed interactions and participant roles through relational propagation. Missing modalities are omitted rather than imputed, and the hypergraph is discarded after training, incurring no additional inference cost. Experiments on eleven zero-shot video-text and audio-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate broad improvements with both GRAM and HyperGRAM. Across 17 video benchmark-modality settings evaluated in both retrieval directions, wRHG outperforms GRAM in all 34 comparisons and HyperGRAM in 33 of 34. Mean text-to-video R@1 increases from 63.4 to 68.2 with GRAM and from 64.8 to 68.4 with HyperGRAM, while the largest video-to-text gain reaches 13.3 percentage points on ActivityNet. Under missing-modality evaluation, both weighted configurations retain positive text-to-video gains over GRAM across seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate, even when 90% of clips lack one modality.

</details>


### [314] [EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03371)
*Mohamed Atef Abouelhadid,Diaa Addeen Abuhani,Muhammad Akhtar Munir,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对d3-flash（8.4B决策模型）在23个公开EO基准、30个设置上做诊断性研究，并用LoRA适配为EO-Jev，提升精度与校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EO工作流需要从已知选项中选答案、估计置信度并处理海量影像；生成式VLM自回归解码代价高且置信度不可靠，而决策模型单次前向即可给出候选答案概率，但其精度、校准与跨任务迁移性尚不清楚。

Method: 在30个设置（来自23个公开EO基准）上系统评测d3-flash的准确率、校准与迁移性；再在公开EO训练集上做低秩（LoRA）微调得到EO-Jev。

Result: d3-flash组合推理迁移良好，在24个设置上校准优于Qwen3.5-9B主干；但计数、变化量化、损毁分级、缺失目标识别仍困难。EO-Jev在26/30设置显著提升，20/28匹配或超过专家模型，12个留出设置平均+8.0分，21/28设置ECE更低，通用决策性能仅降1.8分。

Conclusion: 通用决策模型可通过轻量适配成为有竞争力的EO通才，但定量感知、选项顺序一致性与分布偏移下的校准仍是持续挑战。

Abstract: Earth observation (EO) workflows require selecting among known outcomes, estimating confidence, and processing large volumes of imagery. Generative vision-language models can address these tasks, but autoregressive decoding is computationally costly and their confidence estimates are unreliable. Decision models offer an alternative, returning probabilities over candidate answers in a single forward pass. However, their accuracy, calibration, and transfer across EO tasks remain insufficiently understood. We investigate these properties through a diagnostic study of d3-flash (8.4B parameters) across 30 settings from 23 public EO benchmarks. We find that compositional reasoning transfers well and calibration improves over its Qwen3.5-9B backbone on 24 settings, while counting, change quantification, damage grading, and absent-object recognition remain challenging. To address these limitations, we adapt d3-flash through low-rank fine-tuning on public EO training splits, producing EO-Jev. EO-Jev improves significantly over d3-flash on 26 of 30 settings and matches or exceeds specialist references on 20 of 28. It also achieves an average gain of 8.0 points across 12 held-out settings and lower expected calibration error than specialists on 21 of 28 settings. These improvements come at a modest cost of 1.8 points in general decision performance. Our results demonstrate the potential of adapting general decision models into competitive EO generalists while highlighting persistent challenges in quantitative perception, option-order consistency, and calibration under distribution shift.

</details>


### [315] [ASCoR: Asymmetric Semantic-Spatial Learning for Remote Sensing Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03382)
*Zitong Wang,Shuchang Lyu,Meng Li,Qiang Wang,Guangliang Cheng,Zhenwei Shi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ASCoR，一个基于 SAM3 的非对称语义-空间域泛化框架：文本条件语义分支用类名提示做显式类别引导，配合"Probe-Once 动态自适应 LoRA"限制源域过拟合；另一条冻结编码器的密集空间分支学习多尺度表示；轻量可靠性路由器按局部预测可靠性做有界空间校正。仅在源域监督下训练，在 ISPRS/LoveDA/OpenEarthMap 九个跨域迁移上取得 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感语义分割的 source-only 域泛化需在无目标域数据下可靠预测。视觉基础模型虽有可迁移知识，但类别识别仍依赖源域特有的视觉线索；而任务特化微调又可能侵蚀预训练的可迁移性，二者构成张力。

Method: 基于 SAM3 的双分支非对称架构：(1) 文本条件语义分支，用类名 prompt 提供显式类别先验；(2) Probe-Once 动态自适应 LoRA，在编码器各 block 间分配固定适配预算以抑制源域特化；(3) 任务特化的密集分支，使用独立的冻结 SAM3 图像编码器学习多尺度空间表示；(4) 轻量可靠性路由器，依据局部预测可靠性以有界空间校正融合两分支。全流程仅用源域监督。

Result: 六个 ISPRS 迁移平均 mIoU 68.61%，较此前最优提升 2.69 个百分点；三项 LoveDA/OpenEarthMap 迁移全部最优：Rural-to-Urban 59.07%、Urban-to-Rural 47.95%、Urban-to-OpenEarthMap 49.38%。消融、特征可视化与空间可靠性分析验证各组件有效性与互补性。

Conclusion: 语义提示分支与空间分支可互补，配合预算受限的 LoRA 适配与可靠性门控融合，能在纯源域训练下显著提升跨域遥感分割泛化性，为冻结基础模型的分割适配提供可复用范式。

Abstract: Source-only domain generalization (DG) for remote sensing semantic segmentation seeks reliable predictions in unseen domains without target-domain data during training.
