Although vision foundation models offer transferable knowledge, category recognition remains sensitive to source-specific visual cues, while task-specific adaptation may weaken pretrained transferability. We propose ASCoR, an asymmetric semantic-spatial framework built on SAM3. Its text-conditioned semantic branch uses class-name prompts to provide explicit category guidance. Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA distributes a fixed adaptation budget across encoder blocks to limit source-specific specialization. A complementary task-specific dense branch learns multi-scale spatial representations using a separate frozen SAM3 image encoder. A lightweight reliability router integrates the two branches through bounded spatial correction based on local prediction reliability. All components are trained using source-domain supervision only. Experiments on the ISPRS, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap benchmarks cover nine cross-domain transfers. ASCoR achieves a state-of-the-art mean IoU of 68.61% across six ISPRS transfers, outperforming the previous best method by 2.69 percentage points. It also achieves the best results on all three LoveDA/OpenEarthMap transfers, with 59.07%, 47.95%, and 49.38% mIoU on Rural-to-Urban, Urban-to-Rural, and Urban-to-OpenEarthMap, respectively. Ablation studies, feature visualizations, and spatial reliability analyses support the effectiveness and complementarity of the proposed components. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [316] [Progressive Multi-Scale Super-Resolution via Cascaded Bicubic Anchors and Inter-Scale Mutual Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03390)
*Chun-An Lin,Yu-Chia Chang,Chi-Mao Fan,Yen-Chieh Ouyang,Tsung-Jung Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PMS-SR：低分辨率网格上Transformer骨干的单输入多输出渐进超分网络，一次前向输出x2/x4/x8；Stage1以双三次级联为初始化做残差预测，Stage2用space-to-depth反馈+可变形对齐+逐像素融合做跨尺度互细化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SR网络每个放大倍数需单独训练一个模型，多分辨率输出成本高；需在参数量与推理效率受限下同时获得多尺度结果且不牺牲各尺度质量。

Method: PMS-SR：(1) Stage1各尺度预测为对上一尺度预测的detached双三次上采样的残差，配合Dirac/零初始化使训练从双三次级联精确起步，各head只补充上一尺度缺失的频带；(2) Stage2跨尺度互细化，通过space-to-depth反馈、可变形对齐与逐像素融合双向耦合尺度，使x8特征回馈细化x2输出。模型7.95M参数，DF2K训练。

Result: 在五个标准基准的x4、x8上PSNR均高于所有对比的多尺度方法；x8上全面超过x8专用的DRN-L，Urban100领先所有对比方法，其余基准距最优仅0.13 dB以内。对比三个单尺度SwinIR-M，参数量为22%、BSD100推理快2.9x，输出一致性高6.7–12.4 dB。

Conclusion: 单一模型即可高效产出多倍率高质量超分结果，跨尺度双向互细化可让小尺度输出受益于大尺度特征；属于通用图像超分方向，与具身/3D重建等核心领域无直接关联，代码与权重承诺开源。

Abstract: Super-resolution networks are trained for one magnification factor, so several output resolutions require several models. We propose PMS-SR, a progressive single-input multiple-output network that produces x2, x4, and x8 results in one forward pass, with a Transformer backbone on the low-resolution grid. In Stage 1, each scale is predicted as a residual over the detached bicubic upsampling of the previous scale's prediction. With Dirac and zero initialization, training starts exactly from the bicubic cascade, and each head adds only the band the previous scale lacks. In Stage 2, inter-scale mutual refinement couples the scales in both directions through space-to-depth feedback, deformable alignment, and per-pixel fusion, so x8 features refine the x2 output. Trained on DF2K, the 7.95M-parameter model achieves a higher PSNR than every compared multi-scale method at x4 and x8 on all five standard benchmarks. At x8, it outperforms the x8-specific DRN-L on all of them, leads all compared methods on Urban100, and is within 0.13 dB of the best result elsewhere. Against three single-scale SwinIR-M models, PMS-SR uses 22% of the parameters, runs 2.9x faster on BSD100 inputs, and its outputs agree 6.7-12.4 dB more closely. Code and pretrained models will be released at this https URL upon acceptance.

</details>


### [317] [TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03393)
*Xinyang Li,Zeran Xu,Qijun Gan,Chenwei Zhang,Meiguang Jin,Junfeng Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出音频引导的人脸视频修复框架：在参考引导的视频流模型中，用源-噪声混合初始化保留部分观测信息，并结构化注入参考（分离外观锚点与连续运动上下文），联合训练退化图像/视频恢复与目标音频下的配音纠错。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成视频中人物小面积人脸区域分辨率低，单纯视觉超分虽能锐化唇齿，却无法保证恢复内容与语音一致（唇音同步歧义）。

Method: 基于参考引导的视频流模型（flow matching）：1) 源-噪声混合初始化，从部分保留的观测出发重建；2) 结构化参考注入，将外观锚点与连续运动上下文分离；3) 训练目标结合退化图像/视频恢复与在目标音频条件下对被降质配音源的校正；4) 引入外观与同步监督。

Result: 在说话人视频修复基准上，配对感知相似度与音画同步指标均优于对比修复方法；消融分析验证音频条件、重建公式与参考注入的作用；原生AIGC样例显示可恢复唇部轮廓、牙齿结构与周边面部纹理。

Conclusion: 将音频同步纳入人脸视频修复的生成过程，可在恢复细节的同时支持语音替换下的视觉配音，但缺乏与机器人/物理世界相关的实验支撑。

Abstract: AI-generated videos often depict people within detailed scenes while leaving their small facial regions poorly resolved. Visual super-resolution can sharpen these regions without resolving whether the recovered lips and teeth agree with the spoken audio. We present an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that addresses this ambiguity within a reference-guided video flow model. Source--noise mixing initializes reconstruction from a partially preserved observation, and structured reference injection separates appearance anchors from continuous motion context. Training combines restoration of degraded images and videos with correction of degraded dubbed sources under target audio. Appearance and synchronization supervision allow the model to recover facial detail and support visual dubbing when the audio is replaced. On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the best paired perceptual similarity and synchronization scores among the compared restoration methods. Component comparisons examine audio conditioning, the reconstruction formulation, and reference injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage. injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage.

</details>


### [318] [TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03394)
*Qijun Gan,Chenwei Zhang,Xinyang Li,Meiguang Jin,Junfeng Ma,Shen Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TaoMate-HD: 自回归高分辨率音视频流式数字人生成模型，分块内两级分辨率去噪（2步低清定结构+1步高清细化），音频沿同一轨迹生成，跨文本更新保留历史以支持续说（continuation training，非对称文本条件），实现1.6x单模型加速、阶段并行再1.9x，CER降低11.18个百分点，支持小时级生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式数字人需在文本持续到达时产出高分辨率音视频；高清去噪代价高，且文本更新易导致重复或中断的语音，需要兼顾效率与跨更新一致的说话内容推断。

Method: 自回归分块生成：每块先用2步低分辨率去噪建立粗结构，再用1步细化到高分辨率；音频在同一条生成轨迹中同步产出。各阶段将音视频预测作为下一块同阶段的历史传入。文本更新时保留该历史以推断已说内容；continuation training采用非对称文本条件，为生成与蒸馏设置不同文本窗口；并给出阶段并行部署方案。

Result: 同模型同硬件下相较直接高分辨率生成提速1.6x；阶段并行部署相较串行渐进生成再获1.9x整体加速；continuation training使CER相对基线下降11.18个百分点；支持小时级音视频生成。

Conclusion: 通过分层分辨率去噪、跨块历史传递与针对文本更新的续说训练，可在保证高清质量的同时显著降低流式数字人延迟并提升长时一致性，配合阶段并行可实际部署。

Abstract: Streaming digital humans produce detailed video while continuing speech as new text arrives. High-resolution denoising is costly, and text updates can cause repeated or interrupted speech. We present TaoMate-HD, an autoregressive model for high-resolution audio-video streaming. For each short segment, or chunk, two denoising steps establish coarse video structure at low resolution. A final step refines the video to high resolution, with audio generated throughout the same trajectory. Each stage passes its audiovisual predictions to the same stage of the next chunk as history. Across text updates, the model retains this history to infer what has already been spoken. Continuation training utilizes asymmetric text conditioning, with separate text windows for generation and distillation. Experiments show a 1.6x speedup over direct high-resolution generation with the same model and hardware. Optimized stage-parallel deployment provides a further 1.9x overall speedup over serial progressive generation. Our continuation training reduces character error rate by 11.18 percentage points relative to the baseline. The model also supports hour-long audiovisual generation. Our project page is this https URL .

</details>


### [319] [Image Guided Depth Upsampling using Anisotropic Total Generalized Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03399)
*David Ferstl,Christian Reinbacher,Rene Ranftl,Matthias Rüther,Horst Bischof*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于高阶正则化的凸优化深度图上采样方法，利用高分辨率强度图计算各向异性扩散张量进行引导，并用原始-对偶算法高效并行求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kinect、ToF等现代深度相机虽能提供稠密高质量深度，但横向分辨率受限，需要上采样以匹配高分辨率彩色图像。

Method: 构建带高阶正则项的凸优化上采样问题，正则项由高分辨率强度图推导的各向异性扩散张量加权，以边缘感知地引导深度扩散；推导原始-对偶数值算法，实现高效并行、每秒多帧。

Result: 在Middlebury 2007数据集上，速度与精度均明显优于当时最先进方法；并提出带高精度真值的新数据集，首次支持用真实传感器数据benchmark深度上采样。

Conclusion: 高阶各向异性正则化加原始-对偶求解可实现快速、精确的引导式深度上采样，配套真实数据基准有助于该方向的标准化评测。

Abstract: In this work we present a novel method for the challenging problem of depth image upsampling. Modern depth cameras such as Kinect or Time of Flight cameras deliver dense, high quality depth measurements but are limited in their lateral resolution. To overcome this limitation we formulate a convex optimization problem using higher order regularization for depth image upsampling. In this optimization an anisotropic diffusion tensor, calculated from a high resolution intensity image, is used to guide the upsampling. We derive a numerical algorithm based on a primaldual formulation that is efficiently parallelized and runs at multiple frames per second. We show that this novel upsampling clearly outperforms state of the art approaches in terms of speed and accuracy on the widely used Middlebury 2007 datasets. Furthermore, we introduce novel datasets with highly accurate groundtruth, which, for the first time, enable to benchmark depth upsampling methods using real sensor data.

</details>


### [320] [VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03404)
*Yexin Liu,Yunlong Lin,Zehan Wang,Guangxin He,Xinli Xu,Jiajun Zha,Yaofu Liu,Yueze Wang,Bowen Ping,Yuanming Li,Amie Wang,Bernard Ghanem,Bing Li,Harry Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VidDub 提出"替换感知的跨音频监督"训练视频配音编辑器：配对音频用全帧重建，替换音频样本屏蔽源嘴部重建损失、仅用音视频同步监督嘴部；并蒸馏为两步扩散（2 NFE），兼顾唇同步与画质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频配音编辑器多以原始配对音频做自重建训练，但当驱动语音被替换时，源嘴部运动成为冲突目标，模型会被拉回错误口型，导致跨音频泛化差。

Method: 1) 替换感知跨音频监督：非配对替换音频样本中mask掉源嘴部重建损失，仅以音视频同步约束嘴部，其余面部与背景仍做重建；2) VidDub 全上下文扩散编辑框架，离线利用完整源视频与目标语音；3) 教师-学生蒸馏：替换感知教师学习准确唇同步，匹配轨迹回归迁移 CFG 引导轨迹到两步学生，再用分布匹配蒸馏恢复视觉质量；4) 发布 VidDub-Bench 数据集、配对/跨音频评测清单及统一评测代码。

Result: 三个训练种子上，屏蔽冲突源嘴重建使跨音频 Sync-C 提升 0.833；最终两步模型在四个基准上同时取得强唇同步、更优视觉质量、身份保持与视觉语音识别效果。

Conclusion: 冲突监督屏蔽是跨音频视频配音的关键设计，配合轨迹与分布两级蒸馏可实现 2 NFE 的高质量实时可用编辑；开源基准与清单有利于后续对比。

Abstract: Video dubbing aims to synthesize lip movements that match target speech while preserving the speaker identity, head pose, and background of a source video. Existing editors are predominantly trained via self-reconstruction under original paired audio, even though the source mouth becomes a conflicting target when driving speech is replaced. We introduce replacement-aware cross-audio supervision: paired-audio samples use full-frame reconstruction, whereas unpaired replacement-audio samples mask out source-mouth reconstruction losses and supervise the mouth solely through audio-visual synchronization while preserving unmasked facial regions and background. Because offline dubbing provides the complete source video and target speech beforehand, we present VidDub, a full-context diffusion editor distilled into two denoising steps (2 NFE). Our replacement-aware teacher first learns accurate lip synchronization without regressing toward conflicting source mouth movements. Matched trajectory regression then transfers the teacher's CFG-guided trajectories to a two-step student, and distribution matching distillation recovers visual quality after step compression. We will release the curated training dataset, VidDub-Bench, fixed paired- and cross-audio evaluation manifests, preprocessing outputs, and unified evaluation code. Across three training seeds, masking out conflicting source-mouth reconstruction improves cross-audio Sync-C by 0.833; the final two-step model combines strong lip synchronization with superior visual quality, identity preservation, and visual speech recognition across four benchmarks.

</details>


### [321] [Circumventing Magnitude Collapse via Modular Two-Stage Open-Set Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03421)
*Laurin van den Bergh,Halil Bisgin,Andres Palechor,Mike Suter,Manuel Günther*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究开放集识别(OSR)两阶段流程中"表示学习"与"后处理"的模块化交互，揭示在大规模数据下使用已知未知类数据的表示学习方法会出现"幅度崩溃(magnitude collapse)"并不可逆地破坏判别信息，提出幅度感知后处理与 K+1 分类基线以规避该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OSR 现有研究将表示学习与后处理方法独立开发，二者的交互作用未被探索；且当前在小规模数据上对已知未知类数据的评估是否能外推到大规模尚不清楚，亟需厘清模块化组合的有效边界。

Method: 将 OSR 重新表述为模块化的两阶段流水线，在多种数据集规模与已知未知类数据使用设置下，对表示学习方法与后处理方法的所有组合进行系统性交互研究；分析幅度崩溃现象的成因与影响；并提出 K+1 类分类基线配合幅度感知后处理。

Result: 发现利用已知未知类数据的表示学习方法在小规模有效、但在大规模下出现幅度崩溃并不可逆地丢失判别信息；模块化交互可在部分情况下带来两阶段性能增益，但在幅度崩溃时会被放大恶化；简单 K+1 基线加幅度感知后处理可达到 SOTA 且规避崩溃；证明小规模评估无法预测大规模表现。

Conclusion: OSR 应作为整体流水线来设计与评估，模块化交互效应必须纳入考量；当前 OSR 研究中基于小规模已知未知数据的最佳实践被证伪，需要重新审视评估协议。

Abstract: Open-set recognition (OSR) requires neural networks to classify known classes while rejecting unknown samples, which is critical for real-world deployment. So far, OSR research studied and developed representation learning and postprocessing methods independently and their interactions remain unexplored. In this paper, we reconsider OSR as a modular two-stage pipeline and present the first systematic study of interactions between representation learning and postprocessing methods across dataset scales and usage of known unknown data. First, we discover a failure mode we term \emph{magnitude collapse}, where representation learning methods that utilize known unknown data can suffer performance degradation at large scale and irreversibly destroy discriminative information, despite excelling at small scale. Second, we study the modular interactions and reveal when they can be leveraged for modular performance gains via two-stage processing and where interaction effects amplify performance degradation due to magnitude collapse. Third, we show how these findings can be used to achieve state-of-the-art performance with a simple $K+1$ class classifier baseline and magnitude-aware postprocessing while circumventing magnitude collapse. Finally, our results demonstrate that small-scale evaluations with known unknown data are not predictive of large-scale performance, invalidating current best practices in OSR research. Code available at this https URL .

</details>


### [322] [Evaluating Depth-Augmented Visual Features for Cross-Dataset Lunar Traversability Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03430)
*Jan Baturo,Bartosz Ptak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出弱监督（稀疏成对标注）月球地形可通行性估计框架，检验深度/法向/几何描述子增强视觉特征是否有效；发现几何增强无稳定增益，训练数据源域相关性才是跨域迁移主导因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 月面作业受通信延迟与遮挡限制，需自主移动；现有深度学习方法在地球类比环境与真实月面间存在域差异，且真实月面可通行性标签稀缺，难以全监督训练。

Method: 基于稀疏成对标注的弱监督可通行性估计框架；将深度、表面法向及组合几何描述子与视觉特征融合，在资源受限边缘设备上推理；在两个地球类比数据集与嫦娥PCAM真实月面数据集上做域内与跨域评估，并以随机种子方差为参照做受控对比。

Result: 朴素几何增强相对强视觉基线在域内与跨域设置下均无一致提升，效应量小于种子间方差；训练源域选择对迁移质量影响显著，域相关源域训练的模型迁移到真实月面图像的增益远大于几何融合策略。

Conclusion: 为月球感知提供受控基线：几何特征简单拼接并非有效增益来源，未来多模态融合架构设计应优先考虑源域选择与更具表达力的融合机制。

Abstract: Autonomous mobility is essential for sustained lunar surface operations, as communication delays and line-of-sight occlusions limit continuous teleoperation. Although recent traversability estimation methods increasingly rely on deep learning, the domain gap between terrestrial analogue environments and real lunar terrain can limit their generalisation, and real lunar traversability labels are scarce, making fully supervised training difficult. To address these challenges, we build a weakly supervised framework trained on sparse pairwise annotations and study whether augmenting visual features with depth-derived geometric information: depth, surface normals, and combined geometric descriptors. We evaluate the models in both in-domain and cross-domain settings using two terrestrial analogue datasets and the real lunar Chang'E PCAM dataset. Contrary to expectations, we find that naive geometric augmentation yields no consistent improvement over a strong visual-only baseline in either setting, with effects small relative to seed-to-seed variance. Instead, the choice of training source emerges as the dominant factor in transfer quality: models trained on domain-relevant sources transfer substantially better to real lunar imagery than the geometric fusion strategy improves any single model. Our evaluation runs onboard a resource-constrained edge device and provides a controlled baseline for designing more expressive multimodal fusion architectures in future lunar perception systems.

</details>


### [323] [Align Once to Explain: Feature Alignment for Scalable B-cosification of Foundational Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03438)
*Raphael Maser,Siddhartha Gairola,Sukrut Rao,Bernt Schiele*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ALOE: 一次性的无标签特征对齐方法，将基础视觉模型（监督/自监督/视觉-语言）高效转换为内在可解释的 B-cos 变体，可即插即用于下游任务并保持可比的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础视觉模型性能强但高度不透明，难以解释；从头训练 B-cos 可解释模型代价高且数据需求大。

Method: 提出 ALOE（ALign Once to Explain），通过一次性、无标签的特征对齐，将预训练基础视觉骨干转换为 B-cos 可解释骨干；对齐后作为 drop-in 替代用于分类、线性探测、k-NN、零样本迁移与稠密预测任务，摊销可解释性成本。

Result: 分类上显著优于 vanilla B-cosification（DINOv3 ViT-B/16 的 ImageNet top-1 提升 +10.5 p.p.）；保留教师级泛化，数据需求比从头训练少若干数量级；线性探测、k-NN、零样本迁移与 DINOv3/SigLIP2 相当；保留空间结构特征，解释定位良好且高度人类可读。

Conclusion: ALOE 提供了一种跨预训练范式通用、数据高效的可解释性转换方案，使可解释性可由一次对齐在所有下游任务中复用，且不牺牲精度与表示质量。

Abstract: Foundational vision models have become the de facto standard for many vision tasks due to their strong performance. However, they are notoriously opaque and remain hard to interpret. We present ALOE (ALign Once to Explain), a one-time, label-free feature alignment approach that efficiently converts foundational vision models into inherently interpretable B-cos variants. Once aligned, the B-cos backbone is used as a drop-in replacement across several downstream tasks-amortizing the cost of interpretability. ALOE is robust across pre-training paradigms (supervised, self-supervised, vision-language) and can preserve teacher-level generalization with orders of magnitude less data than training from scratch. On classification, it strongly outperforms vanilla B-cosification (e.g., +10.5 p.p. top-1 on ImageNet for DINOv3 ViT-B/16), retains strong linear probing, k-NN, and zero-shot transfer competitive with foundational backbones (DINOv3, SigLIP2) across diverse downstream datasets. It also preserves spatially structured features useful for dense prediction, while yielding well-localized and highly human-interpretable explanations by design.

</details>


### [324] [Intent2CAD: How Semantic-Parametric Supervision Shapes Text-to-CAD Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03449)
*Jinbo Yang,Mingyue Yuan,Shikai Jing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"意图导向"的文本到CAD生成：设计意图以可恢复的代码级信号（语义特征、可复用参数、轻量参数化关系）表达，构建IntentCAD-100K与IntentCAD-Edit-1K数据集，并用两阶段"保守提升"管线重写监督数据，在不改动模型架构与解码的前提下提升生成可靠性与零样本意图保持编辑能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到CAD工作只关注生成可执行几何，而实际CAD工作流还需要生成程序暴露可复用结构以支持后续修改；作者希望研究监督表示粒度（representation granularity）对生成质量与意图保持编辑的影响。

Method: 将低层CAD构造轨迹转换为可执行CadQuery程序，构建100K文本-代码配对数据集IntentCAD-100K；另构建IntentCAD-Edit-1K评测零样本意图保持编辑。Intent2CAD采用两阶段保守提升：语义提升把可靠的图元组重写为特征级操作，参数化提升显式暴露轻量参数化关系；模型架构与解码过程不变，仅受控微调。

Result: 语义提升主要提升生成可靠性与特征恢复，IR从2.39%降至0.22%，API Recovery达99.96%；参数化提升使可复用关系结构显式化，并进一步改善关系感知的零样本编辑。

Conclusion: 监督表示的粒度本身即是提升文本到CAD生成与可编辑性的有效杠杆，无需改动模型或解码即可获得更可靠、结构可复用的CAD程序，并支持零样本意图保持编辑。

Abstract: Text-to-CAD generation aims to make CAD modeling more accessible by generating executable CAD programs from natural-language descriptions. However, practical CAD workflows require more than executable geometry: generated programs should also expose reusable structure that supports later modification. We introduce intent-oriented text-to-CAD generation, where design intent is expressed as recoverable code-level signals: semantic features, reusable parameters, and lightweight parametric relations. Rather than changing the model architecture or decoding procedure, we investigate how supervision representation granularity affects both CAD generation and zero-shot intent-preserving editing. To enable this study, we construct IntentCAD-100K, a 100K paired text--code dataset built by converting low-level CAD construction traces into executable CadQuery programs. We further construct IntentCAD-Edit-1K to evaluate zero-shot intent-preserving editing from the same representation perspective. Intent2CAD uses a two-stage conservative lifting pipeline: semantic lifting rewrites reliable primitive groups into feature-level operations, while parametric lifting exposes lightweight parametric relations. Under controlled fine-tuning, semantic lifting mainly improves generation reliability and feature recovery, reducing IR from 2.39% to 0.22% and achieving 99.96% API Recovery, while parametric lifting makes reusable relation structure explicit and further improves relation-aware zero-shot editing. Datasets and code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [325] [Bg-Mix: On Using Image Backgrounds for Data Augmentation in Electron Microscopy Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03455)
*Ankur Srivastava,Joana Sarah Grah,Katharina Ladewig,Nils Körber*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Bg-Mix 数据增强方法：将训练图像分解为前景目标与背景再随机重组生成新图像，用于缓解电镜病毒数据集小、标注稀疏的问题，使目标检测 box mAP 提升 +0.8~+3.3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电镜病毒图像数据集规模小、标注稀疏，难以训练可用的深度学习检测模型；但样本背景内容丰富、多样，未被充分利用。

Method: 背景驱动的前景-背景分解与重组增强（Bg-Mix）：把训练图像分离成前景对象与背景，再将二者重新组合成新的合成图像，从而扩充数据多样性。

Result: 在两个数据集、两种检测架构上，相比基线 box mAP 提升 0.8 至 3.3 个点，验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: Bg-Mix 是一种简单有效的数据增强策略，可提升小样本、稀疏标注场景下的检测性能并增加训练数据多样性；但应用局限于电镜病毒检测这一特定域。

Abstract: Electron microscopy (EM) serves as a cornerstone in virology enabling the visualization of viral particles and is widely used in research, diagnostics and morphological characterization of pathogens. Computer-assisted image analysis can help facilitate and speed up this labor-intensive method, however, typical EM virus datasets are small and sparsely labeled, resulting in a lack of readily available deep learning models due to training limitations. To overcome data shortages and leverage content-rich, diverse sample backgrounds, we employed background-based data augmentation. To this end, we propose Bg-Mix, a form of data augmentation method, which decomposes training images into foreground objects and backgrounds and subsequently rearranges both into novel augmented images. This not only enhances the performance of object detection models but also increases the diversity of the training data. Using Bg-Mix provides an increase between +0.8 and +3.3 box mean average precision (mAP) points over the baseline when tested across two datasets using two architectures, thereby demonstrating its effectiveness.

</details>


### [326] [Contrastive Adapter Training and Consensus Knowledge Distillation for Multi-Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Skin Cancer Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03528)
*Ali Abedi,Q. M. Jonathan Wu,Ning Zhang,Farhad Pourpanah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAT-CKD：用冻结ViT+轻量ConvPass适配器做监督对比学习构建域不变特征空间，再用多源模型logit共识蒸馏在无源数据条件下适配无标签目标域，实现皮肤病变分类的MSFDA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑色素瘤与良性痣视觉相似，CNN/ViT在异质临床来源数据上性能下降；传统域适应需访问源数据，受隐私法规限制不可行。现有MSFDA方法全骨干微调导致灾难遗忘与小数据过拟合，仅在后段聚合阶段处理域偏移、未建立共享域不变特征空间，且依赖硬伪标签/置信度加权聚合引入噪声监督。

Method: 1) Contrastive Adapter Training (CAT)：在冻结ViT骨干中插入轻量ConvPass适配器，用监督对比学习(SCL)在源域特定模型训练前建立共享域不变特征空间；2) Consensus Knowledge Distillation (CKD)：将多个源模型logit聚合成共识监督信号，用KL散度在无标签目标数据上适配学生模型。可训练参数仅4.3M。

Result: 在五个公开皮肤病变数据集上平均AUROC达86.1%，优于现有MSFDA方法，可训练参数仅4.3M。

Conclusion: 以参数高效适配器+对比学习构建域不变表示、以logit共识软监督替代硬伪标签，是无源多域适应中降低遗忘与噪声监督的有效组合；但适用范围限于医学影像分类，缺乏可迁移到机器人/3D任务的实证。

Abstract: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) have shown promising performance, their effectiveness often deteriorates on data from heterogeneous clinical sources. Conventional domain adaptation methods address domain shift but require access to source data during adaptation, which is often infeasible due to privacy regulations. Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses this limitation by leveraging multiple labeled source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data. However, existing MSFDA methods rely on full backbone fine-tuning, leading to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting on small clinical datasets, and address domain shift at the aggregation stage without establishing a shared domain-invariant feature space. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels or confidence-weighted aggregation introduces noisy supervision signals under domain shift. To address these limitations, we propose CAT-CKD, consisting of two components: (1) contrastive adapter training (CAT), which trains lightweight ConvPass adapters within a frozen ViT backbone using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific model training, and (2) consensus knowledge distillation (CKD), which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using KL divergence. Experiments on five publicly available skin lesion datasets show that CAT-CKD achieves an average AUROC of 86.1%, outperforming existing MSFDA methods while requiring only 4.3M trainable parameters. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [327] [CoLa3D: Composable Latent 3D Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03533)
*Xudong Cai,Yongcai Wang,Deying Li,Chuanxia Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoLa3D：以单张图像或场景网格为输入，在共享的整体场景隐空间中用轻量query-based transformer直接分解出空间布局一致、可重组的物体网格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可组合3D场景分解多为逐物体在规范空间生成再用脆弱的位姿与尺度估计拼装，导致全局一致性和物体质量差；本文主张在统一的整场景隐空间内直接完成分解。

Method: 全体场景隐表示（来自单图或已有mesh）+ 轻量可扩展的query-based transformer；支持2D mask、3D点、可学习query等多种查询；在紧凑隐空间中学习将场景分解为多个物体网格，输出自带一致空间布局、可直接拼回场景。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集上达到可组合3D场景分解SOTA，显著提升场景级一致性与物体级质量，速度快2倍，训练数据不足SAM 3D的1%；可见深度与MoGe2相当，说明隐空间分解保留可见几何且生成物理完整的可分解物体网格。

Conclusion: 共享整场景隐空间内的直接分解是可组合3D场景分解的有效新范式，兼顾效率、一致性与可扩展的查询接口。

Abstract: We introduce CoLa3D, a simple and effective model for composable 3D scene decomposition that, given a single whole-scene latent from either a single image or an existing scene mesh as input, directly outputs a set of object meshes with consistent spatial layout that can be assembled back into a coherent scene. CoLa3D introduces a novel paradigm for 3D scene decomposition within a shared whole-scene latent, unlike alternatives that perform per-object generation in canonical spaces and then glue the objects back together with fragile pose and scale estimation. The network is a lightweight, flexible, and scalable query-based transformer that accepts various types of queries, including 2D masks, 3D points, and learnable queries, and learns to decompose the scene into objects in a compact latent space. On both synthetic and real-world datasets, CoLa3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on composable 3D scene decomposition, substantially improving global scene-level consistency and object-level quality while running 2 times faster and using less than 1% of SAM 3D's training data. Visible depth on par with MoGe2 further confirms that latent decomposition preserves accurate visible scene geometry while producing physically complete, decomposable object meshes.

</details>


### [328] [PlantVLM-Edge: Quantized Vision-Language Models for On-Device Crop Health Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03557)
*Gaurab Wagle,Bishal Adhikari,Jiajia Li,Xiaolei Huang,Dong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PlantVLM-Edge：面向边缘设备的量化视觉语言框架，用于对话式作物健康诊断。结合农业领域适配、训练后量化与离线端侧服务，在 Jetson AGX Orin 上验证 Qwen3-VL-2B 与 LLaVA-1.5-7B、四种量化方案与两个诊断域；8-bit 量化几乎无损，4-bit AWQ 保留 98.6% 全精度回答质量并将 2B 骨干权重内存降低 49%；最紧凑版本权重内存 2.01 GiB，首 token 约 0.12 s，64 token 响应 0.78 s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作物病害/虫害诊断依赖专家知识，而通用 VLM 计算与显存开销大，难以部署在资源受限的田间边缘设备上；需要兼顾诊断质量与端侧实时性的可行方案。

Method: 提出骨干无关的 PlantVLM-Edge 框架：农业领域适配 + 训练后量化（含 AWQ 激活感知权重量化）+ 端侧推理服务与离线对话界面。系统性地以两种架构/规模的 VLM（Qwen3-VL-2B、LLaVA-1.5-7B）、四种量化位宽和两个诊断域做消融，并全部在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上实测。

Result: 8-bit 量化相对全精度几乎不损答案质量；4-bit AWQ 在两个域上均保留 98.6% 全精度质量，2B 骨干权重内存减少 49%。最紧凑配置权重 2.01 GiB、首 token 延迟约 0.12 s、64 token 诊断响应 0.78 s，全程离线无云依赖。

Conclusion: 端侧、及时且较准确的作物健康诊断具备工程可行性，为下一代作物监测与决策支持系统提供基础；方法以量化部署为主，属于领域应用型系统工作，未涉及机器人操作、具身智能或三维重建等核心方向。

Abstract: Timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is essential for sustainable agricultural production, yet accurate diagnosis often requires expert knowledge that is not readily available. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and natural-language interaction, creating new opportunities for intelligent crop health assessment. However, deploying VLMs on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper presents PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that can run entirely on resource-constrained edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge combines agricultural domain adaptation, post-training quantization, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. The framework is backbone-agnostic: we validate it with two different VLM types with varying scale and architecture (Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B), four quantization schemes, and two diagnostic domains (plant diseases and insect pests), and we deploy all variants on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Eight-bit quantization affects answer quality minimally relative to the full-precision model, and 4-bit activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality on both domains while reducing the weight memory of the 2B backbone by 49%. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weight memory, returns its first token in about 0.12 s, and completes a 64-token diagnostic response in 0.78 s. These results demonstrate that timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is practical on edge devices, providing a foundation for next-generation crop monitoring and decision support systems.

</details>


### [329] [3D-BBDA: Backpropagation-Free Black-Box Domain Adaptation for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03588)
*Shivangi Rai,Kunal Jangid,Vaibhav Kumar,Vinod K Kurmi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 3D-BBDA：无反向传播的黑盒域自适应框架，仅用源模型输出做伪标签引导的原型对齐，并用高斯扰动原型先验补全缺失类原型，在4个腐蚀3D基准上超过Source-only与BFTT3D。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D点云分类器在传感器变化、环境差异与采集伪影造成的域偏移下性能下降；现有适配方法依赖源数据或源模型内部参数，受隐私、许可与安全限制难以部署，因此需要仅凭黑盒输出的适配方案。

Method: 提出backpropagation-free的3D-BBDA：(1) 伪标签引导的类原型对齐；(2) 加权预测模块融合源logits与对齐logits以抑制噪声伪标签影响；(3) 由无标签目标预测构建高斯扰动原型先验，在伪标签覆盖不全时作为缺失/不可靠类原型的回退。仅需一次前向、无梯度更新。

Result: 在4个腐蚀3D基准上稳定优于强基线。ModelNet-40C上平均误差32.08%(PointNet)/29.62%(GDANet)，优于Source-only(35.88%/34.03%)与BFTT3D(33.78%/32.36%)。单次前向、无梯度更新，适合实时与隐私受限部署。

Conclusion: 黑盒、免反向传播的点云域自适应可行且有效，可作为可迁移3D识别流水线中的轻量适配模块；但验证仅限合成腐蚀分类基准，缺少真实机器人/现场采集验证。

Abstract: Robust 3D point-cloud recognition is critical for robotics, mapping, and urban sensing, yet point-cloud classifiers often suffer performance drops under domain shifts caused by sensor changes, environmental variation, and acquisition artifacts. Many existing adaptation methods are difficult to deploy in practice because they require access to source data or the internal parameters of the source model, which may be restricted by privacy, licensing, or security constraints. We present 3D-BBDA, a backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation framework that adapts a source-trained predictor to unlabeled target data using only black-box outputs. Our method performs pseudo-label guided prototype-based alignment and employs a weighted prediction module to fuse source logits with alignment logits, reducing sensitivity to noisy pseudo-labels. To stabilize prototype memory when pseudo-label coverage is incomplete, we construct a Gaussian-perturbed prototype prior from unlabeled target predictions and use it as a fallback for missing or unreliable class prototypes during alignment. Experiments on four corrupted 3D benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines. On ModelNet-40C, 3D-BBDA achieves mean errors of 32.08% (PointNet) and 29.62% (GDANet), outperforming Source-only (35.88% / 34.03%) and BFTT3D (33.78% / 32.36%). 3D-BBDA requires only a single forward pass with no gradient updates making it suitable for real-time, privacy-preserving deployment in transferable 3D recognition pipelines. Project page is available at this https URL

</details>


### [330] [Structured Visual Landscape: Generating Preferred Representations in Biological and Artificial Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03597)
*Yusong Zhao,Edgar Y. Walker,Hao Wang,Mi Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将视觉神经元/脑区激活正则化引入隐空间，提出Vis-Lens框架，用VAE+扩散模型直接生成能最大化指定神经元或脑区响应的自然逼真"偏好图像"，无需逐图迭代优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解神经元对视觉刺激的响应，既能提升黑盒人工神经网络的可解释性，也有助于认识人脑视觉表征；已有方法（如激活最大化）生成的偏好图像不自然、且需逐图迭代优化。

Method: 构建结构化视觉表征景观，并设计基于激活的先验对景观进行正则化（正则项来自脑区或网络单元激活）；Vis-Lens 将变分自编码器与扩散模型整合为图像生成框架，通过在隐码上直接施加激活正则化来生成偏好图像，避免逐样本迭代优化。

Result: 在人工神经网络与人脑视觉皮层（fMRI数据）两类目标上验证有效，激活调制幅度与图像真实感均优于近期SOTA的偏好视觉表征生成方法。

Conclusion: 脑激活先验中的隐空间正则化可高效生成高保真的神经元偏好刺激，为神经网络可解释性与人脑视觉编码研究提供统一、可复用的工具。

Abstract: Understanding how neurons respond to visual stimulus is an important question in both deep learning and neuroscience. It has significant implications for enhancing the interpretability of black-box artificial neural networks and for understanding the visual representation in the human brain. We propose a structured visual representations landscape and design an activation-based prior that allows us to effectively regularize the landscape with activations from brain regions or neural network units. Our model Vis-Lens integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model into an image generation framework. It enables the generation of natural, realistic preferred images by directly modifying the activation-regularized latent codes without per-image iterative optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on both artificial neural networks and human visual cortex using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. Our framework improves activation modulation and image realism compared with a recent state-of-the-art method for generating preferred visual representations of these neural targets.

</details>


### [331] [Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03602)
*Tengfei Liu,Yang Shi,Yuran Wang,Yuqi Tang,Yizhuo Jia,Zhuoran Zhang,Qixun Wang,Shujie Li,Xuanyu Zhu,Xinyu Liu,Minghui Guo,Shixuan Liu,Haotian Wang,Yuanxing Zhang,Pengfei Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Reviso是一个agentic视频描述框架：从低帧率全局预览构建层次化Context–Focus–Points（CFP）观察计划，按计划选择性回看时间段并调用工具做细粒度检查，迭代更新计划并融合全局/局部证据生成字幕；用验证引导流水线构造轨迹，结合GRPO与Key-Fact奖励、Plan Alignment Reward、Unproductive Tool-Call Penalty训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型生成视频字幕时易过度关注次要细节而忽略关键上下文与核心事件；作者认为视觉证据的重要性因视频内容而异，不应平均分配注意力，因此需要让模型自主"学会看什么、如何收集相关视觉证据"。

Method: 1) 由低帧率全局预览生成层次化CFP观察计划（视频上下文→优先关注面→具体观察目标及对应工具）；2) 计划引导的主动感知：选择性回看时间片段、组合工具细粒度检查、解读证据并按需更新计划；3) 验证引导数据流水线（事实核验+教师精炼）构造高质量训练轨迹；4) 采用GRPO强化学习，奖励含key-fact字幕质量奖励、Plan Alignment Reward（识别重要观察目标）与按字幕质量调节成本的UTCP惩罚。

Result: 在四个视频字幕基准上优于所评估的开源基线，且生成的字幕更好地支撑下游视频问答任务。

Conclusion: 优先级引导的主动观察策略对视频字幕有效，兼具下游迁移潜力；表明"先规划关键观察目标、再按需调用工具取证"的agent范式优于均匀采样的被动描述。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate detailed video captions, yet they may overemphasize minor details while overlooking essential context and key events. We argue that not all visual evidence deserves equal attention, as the importance of visual information depends on the content of each video. Motivated by this observation, we propose Reviso, an agentic video captioning framework that learns what to observe and how to gather relevant visual evidence. From a low-frame-rate global preview, Reviso constructs a hierarchical Context--Focus--Points (CFP) observation plan that identifies the video context, prioritizes key aspects, and defines concrete observation targets and corresponding tools. Guided by this plan, Reviso performs goal-directed active perception by selectively revisiting temporal segments and combining tools for fine-grained inspection. It interprets the acquired evidence, updates its plan as needed, and integrates global and local information to generate the final caption. To learn this observation strategy, we develop a verification-guided pipeline that constructs high-quality training trajectories through factual verification and teacher-guided refinement. We further train Reviso using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), incorporating a key-fact reward for caption quality, a Plan Alignment Reward (PAR) for identifying important observation targets, and an Unproductive Tool-Call Penalty (UTCP) that adjusts observation-cost penalties based on caption quality. Experiments across four video captioning benchmarks show that Reviso outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines, while its generated captions better support downstream video question answering. These findings highlight the effectiveness and potential of priority-guided active observation for video captioning.

</details>


### [332] [Isekai3D SDG: A Platform for Diverse Synthetic Gameplay Visual Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03626)
*Rafal Karp,Gene Liu,Shih-Hsin Li,Eric Courtemanche,Shengze Wang,Josef Spjut,David Pankratz,Mischa Kolbe,Michael Stengel,Sven Elflein,Adam Grygielski,Liwen Wu,Anjul Patney*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Isekai3D是一个基于虚幻引擎的合成3D游戏数据生成平台，采用"世界模拟—回放采集"两阶段工作流，可复用同一录制轨迹生成多种渲染输出并附带帧对齐相机/角色/动作元数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉与世界模型、神经渲染、游戏智能体等研究亟需大规模、带精确标注的可控合成数据；现有合成管线中模拟与渲染耦合，重复仿真代价高、中间存储与人工处理开销大。

Method: 将可复用环境/角色资产与Unreal Engine插件组合，分两阶段：第一阶段进行世界模拟，录制世界状态、角色运动、动作与相机轨迹；第二阶段按指定分辨率、帧率、渲染与相机配置回放录制内容，采集渲染视频、图像、深度图，并输出帧对齐的相机/角色/动作元数据，直接上传为训练友好格式。

Result: 实现同一录制游戏过程可批量产生多种输出变体而无需重复仿真；减少中间存储、数据准备时间与人工后处理。摘要为系统报告性质，未给出定量实验或下游任务性能数据。

Conclusion: 该系统提供了工程上解耦模拟与渲染的合成数据生成框架，对世界模型与神经渲染研究有工具价值；但因缺乏方法创新与实证评估，属于相关基础设施而非核心突破。

Abstract: We present Isekai3D Synthetic Data Generation (SDG), a platform for simulating and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay for research in vision and world models, neural graphics, gameplay agents, and other applications. The platform combines reusable environment and character assets with Unreal Engine plugins in a two-stage workflow. First, world simulation generates gameplay while recording the world state, character movements, actions, and camera tracks needed for replay. Second, the recorded simulation is replayed to capture selected outputs, such as rendered video, images, and depth maps, at a specified resolution and frame rate under selected rendering and camera configurations. Separating simulation from capture allows the same recorded gameplay to produce multiple output variants without repeating the original simulation. Visual outputs are accompanied by frame-aligned camera, character, and action metadata. The platform uploads generated data directly in a training-friendly format, reducing intermediate storage, preparation time, and manual processing. This report describes the design of our overall system, including the platform's assets, plugins, and their functionality, explaining how they work together to generate diverse synthetic gameplay data.

</details>


### [333] [EgoActionBench: Benchmarking Dense Action Captioning for Egocentric Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03646)
*Yujiao Shen,Jiahe Song,Haitian Li,Jingkang Yang,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoActionBench：将连续第一人称操作视频标注为时间定位的原子动作，并关联左手/右手/双手，共1407段视频、41132条人工精修标注；提出含时间检索-内容匹配-多维评分的评测协议，基准测试20个模型，并用SFT+RL微调Qwen3-VL-4B与LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从人类数据学习是实现具身智能的可扩展路径，但要求模型从第一人称观测中准确理解细粒度人类动作；现有基准在动作原子性、时间精度和手-动作关联三方面存在不足。

Method: 构建EgoActionBench基准（1407 episodes/41132条人工精修标注，标注左/右/双手的时序原子动作）；设计评测协议：先检索时间可行候选、再按内容一致性选预测，最后联合评分语义保真度、时间重叠度及动作精确率/召回率；在20个基线模型/系统上评测，并对Qwen3-VL-4B、LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B做自动标注数据上的SFT+RL适配。

Result: EgoActionScore在两个backbone上分别提升15.9与23.2分，两个适配模型均超过所有开源基线；实验显示现有模型在动作原子性、时间精度和手-动作关联上存在明显局限。

Conclusion: 通用视频理解能力与具身智能所需的动作理解之间仍有显著差距；EgoActionBench提供了细粒度手-动作时序理解的评测与改进途径。

Abstract: Learning from human data offers a scalable path toward embodied intelligence, yet it requires models to accurately understand fine-grained human actions from egocentric observations. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association. We introduce EgoActionBench, a benchmark that represents continuous human manipulation as temporally localized atomic actions associated with the left hand, right hand, or both hands. EgoActionBench contains 1,407 episodes with 41,132 human-refined action annotations. To evaluate such dense predictions, we propose an evaluation protocol that retrieves temporally eligible candidates, selects a prediction by content agreement, and scores semantic fidelity and temporal overlap alongside action precision and recall, jointly capturing what happens, when it happens, and which hand performs it. We benchmark 20 baseline models and systems on EgoActionBench and further adapt two backbones, Qwen3-VL-4B and LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B, through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning on automatically annotated training episodes. EgoAction improves EgoActionScore by 15.9 and 23.2 points on the two backbones, and both adapted models outperform all open-source baselines. Our experiments reveal substantial limitations of current models in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association, highlighting the gap between general video understanding and the action understanding required for embodied intelligence.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [334] [CheXPoT: Post-Hoc Visual Verification and Correction of VLM-Generated Radiology Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00785)
*Joey Guo,Rayan Ansari,Alaa Youssef*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CheXPoT: a training-free program-of-thought post-hoc verification pipeline that decomposes VLM-generated chest X-ray reports into RadGraph predicates, grounds them via DenseNet-121 + Grad-CAM evidence, executes verification code, and rewrites reports by dropping ungrounded findings.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision-language models for chest radiograph report generation hallucinate findings not grounded in the image, limiting clinical trust and adoption; existing fixes (RL, preference optimization, CoT supervision) are costly to compute.

Method: RadGraph + LLM decompose reports into predicate tuples; a DenseNet-121 classifier with Grad-CAM produces a visual evidence table; PoT verification code tests each predicate against the evidence table; unsupported predicates are removed and the report rewritten. Evaluated on a 4,145-image held-out split across 14 CheXpert classes with MedGemma-4B, LLaVA-Med, and MAIRA-2.

Result: Significant precision gains on 8/14 classes and F1 gains on 5, no significant decreases. Micro precision 19.2%→46.8% and F1 23.0%→49.4% on MedGemma-4B; LLaVA-Med 4.5%→17.7% / 6.3%→19.4%; MAIRA-2 15.6%→42.1% / 21.0%→45.3%.

Conclusion: Inexpensive post-hoc visual grounding can substantially reduce unsupported findings across multiple VLM generators, offering a lightweight route to more trustworthy radiology report generation.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise for chest radiograph report generation, but adoption remains limited because of hallucinated findings that are not grounded in the image. Correcting these hallucinations and improving overall report quality remains a significant challenge. Prior work has addressed this problem by refining models with reinforcement learning, preference optimization, or chain-of-thought supervision, often at substantial compute cost. To address this gap, we introduce CheXPoT, a program-of-thought (PoT) framework that verifies each generated finding against image features and removes those it cannot ground. CheXPoT decomposes generated reports into predicates with RadGraph and an LLM, grounds these predicates against a DenseNet-121 and Grad-CAM visual evidence table, executes PoT verification code, and rewrites reports after removing unsupported predicates. On a 4,145-image held-out split, CheXPoT yields statistically significant precision gains on 8 of 14 CheXpert classes and F1 gains on 5, with no significant decreases in either metric. CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% (MedGemma-4B) to 46.8% (MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT) and micro-average F1 from 23.0% to 49.4%, absolute gains of 27.6% and 26.4% respectively. We also tested CheXPoT on other VLM report generators. On LLaVA-Med, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 4.5% to 17.7% and micro-average F1 from 6.3% to 19.4%. On MAIRA-2, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 15.6% to 42.1% and micro-average F1 from 21.0% to 45.3%. Our results suggest that inexpensive post-hoc visual verification may improve VLM trustworthiness by correcting unsupported findings from generated reports. CheXPoT lays a foundation for tools that help validate VLM-generated radiology reports and reduce unsupported findings. These innovations may subsequently help increase trust and adoption of VLM tools in Medicine.

</details>

# cs.HC [[Back]](#toc)

### [335] [Do the Numbers Match the Plot? Statistical-Visual Verification for Automated Exploratory Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00004)
*Zixun Fu,Jian Huang,Maojun Sun,Yancheng Yuan*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: EDAagent是一个顺序框架，在执行统计后按发现逐条进行"统计-视觉验证"：记录统计结果、生成可视化请求、绘图并用观察到的模式保留/限定/推翻原解释；配套8B的VisPlan模型将可视化理由转为详细图表方案。87份端到端报告在六维评分下多项满分率达87–97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化EDA系统能正确计算统计量却给出误导性解释（相关由强影响点驱动、均值差异源于偏态/重叠/稀疏子群而非整体分布位移），缺少对统计结论的视觉核查环节。

Method: 顺序化多步流程：对每个发现依次执行"统计结果记录→生成指向相关分布特征的可视化请求→生成图表→依据图形模式决定保留、限定或重新考虑解释"，即statistical-visual verification；含VisPlan（8B参数）负责将可视化rationale转成详细chart plan。评估用EDA-Bench 87份端到端报告、六维rubric、GPT-5.1多模态打分，加166个VisEval开放任务。

Result: 满分比例：事实性与视觉一致性87.4%，统计-视觉交叉验证93.1%，分析叙述96.6%；VisEval上VisPlan将总体均分从4.55（Qwen3-8B）提升至4.62，美学提升最明显。

Conclusion: 描述性结果表明视觉验证能让自动化EDA报告更透明地呈现统计发现与底层数据结构的关系；但缺乏与基线的显著性对比与人工复核，证据强度有限。

Abstract: Automated exploratory data analysis (EDA) systems can execute statistics correctly while producing misleading interpretations. For example, correlations may be driven by influential observations, and mean differences may arise from skewness, overlap, or sparse subgroups rather than broad distributional shifts. We present EDAgent, a sequential framework that performs targeted visual verification before report synthesis. For each finding, the system records the statistical result, generates a visualization request identifying relevant distributional features, creates the corresponding chart, and uses the observed pattern to retain, qualify, or reconsider the interpretation. We call this process statistical-visual verification. EDAgent includes VisPlan, an 8B-parameter model that converts visualization rationales into detailed chart plans. We evaluate 87 end-to-end reports on EDA-Bench using a six-dimension rubric and GPT-5.1 multimodal evaluation. Maximum-score proportions reached 87.4% for factuality and visual consistency, 93.1% for statistical-visual cross-validation, and 96.6% for analytical narrative. On 166 open-ended VisEval tasks, VisPlan improved the mean overall score from 4.55 (Qwen3-8B) to 4.62, with the largest gain in aesthetics. These descriptive results indicate that visual verification can make automated EDA reports more transparent about how statistical findings relate to underlying data structure.

</details>


### [336] [How to Simplify a Line Chart: A Taxonomy and Feature-Based Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00179)
*Rifat Ara Proma,Paul Rosen*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 提出基于视觉特征的折线图简化算法分类体系，形式化12种感知驱动的时序视觉特征、21项特征保持度量与Feature–Complexity(FC)评分，在80个数据集上系统评测19种算法（Transformers/Reducers/Aggregators三族）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大或噪声时序的可视化简化是生成可解释折线图的前提，但现有算法对趋势、极值、周期性、曲率、粗糙度、复杂度等视觉特征的改变差异巨大，缺乏统一、可比较的特征层面评测框架。

Method: 特征化分类法：将19种常用算法归为Transformers（如Gaussian、Mean、Median滤波）、Reducers（如Douglas-Peucker、M4）、Aggregators（如ASAP、PAA）；形式化12个感知动机且可计算的视觉特征；每特征采用多种相似度度量得到21项特征保持指标；融合保真度与复杂度提出FC分数；并分析算法表现的跨数据集可预测性。

Result: Transformers在几乎所有指标上取得A档但保持完整时间分辨率；Reducers多为D–F档，以保真度换取渲染点减少；Aggregators居中，多为B–C档。Gaussian、Mean、Douglas-Peucker跨数据集表现稳定；FPCS、ASAP数据依赖性强、波动大。附带交互式网站。

Conclusion: 折线图简化不存在普适最优算法，需按目标视觉特征与复杂度预算在算法族间权衡；特征化分类框架与FC分数可支撑算法选择与后续设计。

Abstract: Simplifying large or noisy time-series is often a prerequisite for producing interpretable line charts, yet existing methods vary widely in how they alter visual features such as trends, extrema, periodicity, curvature, roughness, and overall complexity. We introduce a feature-based taxonomy of line chart simplification that evaluates 19 commonly used algorithms across three families: Transformers, Reducers, and Aggregators. We also formalize 12 perceptually motivated, computationally defined visual features commonly used when analyzing time-series in line charts. We assess preservation using multiple similarity metrics per feature to capture different aspects of fidelity, yielding 21 distinct feature-preservation measurements. To capture the trade-off between fidelity and simplicity, we introduce a Feature--Complexity (FC) score that combines feature preservation with complexity. Our systematic evaluation on 80 datasets reveals distinct family-level patterns: Transformers such as Gaussian, Mean, and Median filters achieve A-mode grades on nearly all metrics but retain full temporal resolution; Reducers such as Douglas-Peucker and M4 receive predominantly D-F mode grades trading fidelity for a reduction in the number of rendered points; and Aggregators ASAP and PAA occupy a middle ground with primarily B-C mode grades. We further characterize the predictability of algorithm behavior across datasets: some methods produce consistent grades regardless of dataset type (Gaussian, Mean, Douglas-Peucker), while others exhibit high data-dependency, with performance varying substantially based on dataset characteristics (FPCS, ASAP). An interactive website supporting exploration of all evaluated techniques, datasets, and results is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [337] [From White Canes to Edge AI: A Survey of Assistive Navigation Technologies for Blind and Low-Vision Individuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00671)
*Abtin Zandi,Arian Ashrafi,Sarvin Nami,Seyed Sina Negahban,Amirabbas Entezari,Parsa Abbasian,Ariyan Azami,Parisa Taherzadeh,Bardia SabaghKermani,Roza Ganjipour,Hamed Farbeh*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: 综述108篇2008–2026年盲人与低视力(BLV)辅助出行技术文献，划分为机械辅具、电子助行硬件、深度学习、边缘原生四个技术阶段，并归纳4类检测器家族与12种模型压缩策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BLV人群的独立出行是自主生活的基础需求，但支撑该需求的辅助技术演进缓慢；领域缺少对近二十年技术脉络、感知模态、计算架构与性能的系统梳理，也缺乏对算法进步与真实部署之间落差的诊断。

Method: 系统性文献综述：纳入108篇同行评审研究（2008–2026），按技术演进划分四个时代，逐时代分析代表性系统、传感模态（超声/红外/卫星定位/视觉）、计算架构（云端→边缘）与报告性能；将模型优化技术整合为涵盖四类检测器家族与十二种压缩策略的技术参考；并归纳系统性障碍（界面认知负荷、评测协议碎片化、BLV受试者研究稀缺）。

Result: 识别出算法快速迭代与真实世界采纳缓慢之间存在持续性错配，主要归因于认知过载的用户界面设计、缺乏统一的评测基准与协议、以及参与式用户研究的严重不足。

Conclusion: 提出开放挑战与路线图：室内外无缝切换、标准化基准、隐私保护感知、多模态基础模型的应用，以及以用户为中心、社会可接受的辅助导航发展方向。

Abstract: Independent mobility is a foundational requirement for the autonomy of blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals, yet the assistive technologies that support it have historically evolved slowly. This survey systematically reviews 108 peer-reviewed studies published between 2008 and 2026, organizing the field into four technological eras: (i) a foundational era of passive mechanical aids, namely the white cane and the guide dog; (ii) a hardware era of electronic travel aids built on ultrasonic, infrared, and satellite positioning sensors that alert users to proximity but lack semantic understanding; (iii) a deep learning era in which convolutional and transformer-based detectors introduced context-aware scene understanding, initially tethered to cloud infrastructure; and (iv) a contemporary edge-native era defined by model compression, quantization, hardware acceleration, and multi-sensor fusion that relocate intelligence onto resource-constrained wearable and mobile devices. For each era we analyze representative systems, sensing modalities, computational architectures, and reported performance, and we consolidate the field's model-optimization techniques into a single technical reference spanning four detector families and twelve compression strategies. Across the corpus, we find a persistent mismatch between rapid algorithmic progress and slow real-world adoption, driven by cognitive overload in user interfaces, fragmented evaluation protocols, and the scarcity of studies involving BLV participants. We conclude with open challenges, including seamless indoor-outdoor transition, standardized benchmarks, privacy-preserving perception, and the emerging role of multimodal foundation models, and outline a roadmap for socially acceptable, user-centered assistive navigation.

</details>


### [338] [Touching Projected Agents through the DAT Screen -System Design and Questions of Interaction Boundaries-](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02525)
*Takaya Tamamoto,Tomoko Yonezawa*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: DAT：投影+可变形网面+张力检测的触觉屏幕，实现单点触控定位/压深估计与电机可调抗压刚度，并引出“虚拟智能体是否应表达偏好/边界”的设计问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 触摸虚拟智能体不应只是屏幕上的指位检测；真实接触包含形变、抗力与智能体回应。作者希望触觉界面同时具备空间投射、形变感知与可变阻力，以支持“可触摸智能体”的交互设计。

Method: 半透明可变形网面作为投影屏；通过柔性屏周边张力变化反演单点接触位置与压入深度；第二版原型加入电机张力控制，改变屏面抗压刚度。

Result: 首版原型实现单点触控及位置/深度估计；张力控制版实现可调阻抗并能驱动演示。论文明确区分已观察现象与待研究问题，未提供用户对“拒绝/同意”行为的解读实验数据。

Conclusion: 该系统为触觉化虚拟智能体提供硬件与交互框架，并提出智能体是否/何时应表现偏好与边界的开放设计问题；缺乏系统性用户评估与量化指标。

Abstract: Touching a virtual agent involves more than detecting a finger on a display: the contact surface can deform and resist the user's push, and the agent can respond to that action. We describe the Desktop Amid Touch (DAT) screen, which combines spatial projection onto a semi-transparent, deformable mesh with touch sensing and motorized control of resistance to indentation. An initial prototype detected a single touch and estimated its position and depth from tension changes around a flexible projection screen. A subsequent prototype added motorized tension control to vary the screen's resistance to indentation. We describe the tension-controlled DAT implementation and its demonstrations, distinguishing what has been observed from what remains an open design question. These capabilities raise a design question: should touchable virtual agents respond as though they had preferences or boundaries, and under what conditions should such behavior be implemented on systems like DAT. The present paper describes a system and frames this question; it does not establish how users interpret an agent's refusal or consent.

</details>


### [339] [Camera-Free Object Discovery and Interaction with GazeTags](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02599)
*Vimal Mollyn,Chris Harrison*

Main category: cs.HC

TL;DR: GazeTags：无摄像头、无CV的红外标签方案，用户所戴设备发出与头部朝向对齐的窄束红外光，仅被注视方向的低功耗标签（约2美元、纽扣电池可用一年以上）被唤醒并回传身份与传感数据，实现凝视感知环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摄像头+CV的凝视/物体感知方案功耗高、隐私敏感，难以在电池受限的可穿戴设备上持续运行；需要一种低功耗、保护隐私的"头部朝向物体感知"机制。

Method: 设计低成本无源式电子标签（约2美元、纽扣电池>1年）与用户佩戴设备（智能眼镜、耳机等）配合：佩戴端周期性发射与头部朝向对齐的聚焦红外光束，仅落在窄束内的标签被唤醒并应答，返回ID及可选负载（物体状态、实时传感器读数）；避开了摄像头与视觉流水线。

Result: 给出了硬件设计、系统性能表征与工作权衡分析，并展示多种凝视感知环境的应用示例。

Conclusion: 该方案能耗极低、可长期连续运行、无视觉隐私问题，为可穿戴端的凝视感知交互提供了可行的低功耗替代路径。

Abstract: We present GazeTags, a camera- and computer-vision-free approach for worn head-gaze object awareness. Our small electronic tags cost roughly \$2 each and can operate for more than a year on a coin cell battery. They work in concert with a user-worn device (smartglasses, hearables, etc.) that periodically emits a focused infrared signal aligned with the user's head direction. Only GazeTags within that narrow head-oriented beam wake and respond, providing their identity and optional payloads such as object state or live sensor readings. By avoiding cameras and computer vision pipelines, our approach is very energy efficient, able to operate continuously even in battery-constrained wearables, and sidesteps non-trivial privacy issues. We describe our hardware design, characterize our system performance and operating tradeoffs, and demonstrate how GazeTags can enable practical gaze-aware environments.

</details>
