### [340] [Interpretable structural temperature scaling for calibrating graph neural networks and point-cloud segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00175)
*Chenyi Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ISTS：12参数线性模型，用节点置信度、邻域、与标注节点距离等结构化描述子为每个节点预测温度，实现可解释的图神经网络置信度校准，预测不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图感知校准器（如基于辅助网络的节点级温度预测）决策难以审查；作者希望在保持节点级校准性能的同时获得可追溯、可检查的温度来源。

Method: 提出Interpretable Structural Temperature Scaling：以命名描述子（置信度、邻域统计、与标注节点距离）线性组合出每节点温度，仅12个参数；交叉验证选择正则化强度以决定偏离全局温度缩放的程度；保持原预测不变。

Result: 组级别解释忠实：测试节点上对过度自信组降温度、欠自信组升温度，246组Spearman相关0.67；7个图、2个骨干、11个基线中NLL与Brier平均排名最优，NLL较TS降低1.8%，超过同等拟合的熵基温度两倍；在预先固定的协议下于4个留出图再次排名第一；约100个校准节点以上即有效；点云分割任务上显著改善NLL、Brier及点排序拒绝性能。

Conclusion: ISTS在小样本校准数据下价格低廉且可检查，是图/点云模型置信度校准的实用替代方案。

Abstract: Graph-aware calibrators make graph neural networks (GNNs) more trustworthy by predicting a temperature for each node, usually with auxiliary networks whose decisions are hard to inspect. We propose Interpretable Structural Temperature Scaling (ISTS), a twelve-parameter linear model that sets each node's temperature from named descriptors of its confidence, neighbourhood and closeness to labelled nodes, so every temperature traces back to descriptor contributions. ISTS preserves predictions, and cross-validated regularisation lets the calibration data decide how far the model departs from temperature scaling (TS). Its explanations are faithful at the level of node groups: on test nodes, ISTS softens groups that a global temperature leaves over-confident and sharpens under-confident ones (Spearman correlation 0.67 over 246 groups). On seven graphs with two backbones and eleven baselines, ISTS has the best average rank in negative log-likelihood (NLL) and Brier score and lowers NLL relative to TS by 1.8%, more than twice the gain of an identically fitted entropy-based temperature. It ranked first again on four held-out graphs under a protocol fixed in advance. From about 100 calibration nodes on, ISTS is a cheap and inspectable choice, and on point-cloud segmentation it significantly improves NLL, Brier score and the ranking of points for rejection.

</details>


### [341] [Crop Mapping Evaluation under Sampling Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00794)
*Akram Zaytar,Kemunto Ochwang'i,Caleb Robinson,Girmaw A. Tadesse,Gilles Q. Hacheme,Rahul Dodhia,Inbal Becker-Reshef,Juan M. Lavista Ferres*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出现有作物地图验证存在"部署性能差距"（实地标注非随机采样，偏向路边、易达地块），提出加权版 prediction-powered inference（PPI），利用全区域无标注点的分类器预测与加权标注残差修正，权重由卫星嵌入密度比估计；在欧洲五区与肯尼亚三数据集上验证，显著缩小估计偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政府机构依作物地图进行产量估计、粮食安全监测与政策制定，但地图精度通常只在非随机的实地标注上评测（近路、易达地块被过采样，小块或难达地块被跳过），导致报告的指标偏向"被访问过的地方"，与覆盖整个制图区域的真实性能存在系统偏差，即"部署性能差距"。需要一种在区域层面估计真实性能的方法。

Method: 采用加权形式的 prediction-powered inference（PPI）：以分类器在整个区域无标注数据上的预测作为初估，再用带标注点上的预测误差对该初估进行校正，并按条件欠采样程度给标注赋更大权重；权重通过卫星嵌入空间中的密度比估计得到。对比基线为随机交叉验证、5 km 块交叉验证，以及使用同一权重的加权交叉验证。

Result: 在欧洲五个有全覆盖作物登记标签的区域中，模拟六种已记录的实地采集实践，性能差距最高达 0.20 macro-F1；在各区域差距最大的采集规则下，5 km 块交叉验证仍高估 macro-F1 达 0.18，而加权 PPI 将跨区域最大误差降至 0.07；同权重的加权交叉验证效果接近，说明改进主要来自权重本身。在肯尼亚三份无全区域参考标签的数据上，路边头盔相机数据集估计 macro-F1 从随机交叉验证的 0.93 降至 0.61，但校正依赖少数高权重样本。

Conclusion: 基于卫星嵌入密度比的再加权是消除非随机采集偏差的主要来源，加权 PPI（或等价的加权交叉验证）能在缺乏全区域参考标签时给出更贴近部署条件的性能估计；方法仍需关注少量高权重标签带来的估计不稳定性。

Abstract: Government agencies use crop maps to estimate production, monitor food security, and set agricultural policy. These crop maps are usually validated against field labels, but these labels are rarely a random sample of the area the map covers. Field teams tend to label parcels near roads and skip ones that are small or hard to reach, so performance measured on held-out labels mainly describes the places they visited. We call the difference between this reported performance and performance over the whole mapped region the deployment performance gap. To estimate performance over the whole region, we use a weighted form of prediction-powered inference (PPI). The classifier's predictions on unlabeled points across the region give a first estimate, and its errors on the labeled points correct that estimate, with more weight on labels from under-sampled conditions. We test this in five European regions where crop registers label every declared parcel, so the true performance is known. Simulating six documented collection practices there produces gaps of up to 0.20 macro-F1. On the collection rule that creates the largest gap in each region, 5 km block cross-validation still overestimates macro-F1 by as much as 0.18, while PPI with weights estimated from satellite embeddings reduces the largest error across regions to 0.07. Importance-weighted cross-validation with the same weights does almost as well, so most of the improvement comes from the weights themselves. We also apply the method to three Kenyan datasets that have no region-wide reference labels. For a roadside dataset collected with helmet-mounted cameras, the estimated macro-F1 falls from 0.93 under random cross-validation to 0.61, although the correction relies on a small number of heavily weighted labels. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [342] [Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01460)
*Haoyu Zhao,Zafeirios Fountas,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TAL：将教学视频整理为结构化“教程书”记忆的两阶段对抗式非参数持续学习，推理时按目录树检索，在象棋教程视频基准VidLearn上显著超越MLLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体训练后能力冻结，全参数更新代价高昂，而海量教学视频（人教授知识的主要载体）无法被利用；核心问题：能否在不更新参数的前提下让智能体从教学视频中持续学习。

Method: 两阶段对抗过程：从视频中挖掘"困难"的、需视频落地证据的问答来提炼并精化持久的结构化tutorialbook记忆；推理时通过Table-of-Contents（TOC）树检索，使检索与模型推理路径耦合而非依赖embedding相似度。另构建VidLearn基准：72个象棋教程视频、12种开局的多模态QA。

Result: VidLearn上超越所有基线，随视频消费量单调提升，训练/测试划分相对vanilla MLLM提升达113%/91%；实际对弈中69%的对称比赛在开局阶段取得更优局面；第二领域评测显示一定泛化性。

Conclusion: 教学视频可作为无需参数更新的大规模智能体持续学习资源；TOC树式非参数记忆优于相似度检索。

Abstract: Humans continuously acquire knowledge from carefully crafted materials such as books and tutorial videos, carrying that understanding into future tasks. Millions of such instructional videos are uploaded online every day, yet LLM agents remain unable to exploit this ever-expanding wealth of human teaching. Their capabilities are frozen after training, while parameter updates at scale remain prohibitively expensive. This raises the central question: can LLM agents learn from this vast instructional resource without parameter updates? We introduce Tutorial Agentic Learning (TAL), a nonparametric continual-learning paradigm that consolidates tutorial videos into a persistent, structured tutorialbook memory through a two-stage adversarial process that harvests hard, video-grounded questions and uses them to refine the memory. At inference time, TAL retrieves through a Table-of-Contents (TOC) tree, tying retrieval directly to the model's reasoning rather than to embedding similarity. To study this setting, we introduce VidLearn, a multimodal QA benchmark built from 72 chess tutorial videos spanning 12 openings. On VidLearn, TAL outperforms all evaluated baselines and improves monotonically as more videos are consumed, achieving up to 113% and 91% relative gains over the corresponding vanilla MLLMs on the training and test splits, respectively. In actual gameplay, TAL reaches a stronger opening-phase position than its vanilla counterpart in 69% of head-to-head games. Evaluation in a second domain further demonstrates the generality of TAL. Together, these results highlight instructional videos as a scalable resource for parameter-update-free agent continual learning.

</details>


### [343] [Beyond Validation Loss: Coverage and Reliability Dynamics in Robot Policy Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01565)
*Zhanyi Sun,Max Simchowitz,Shuran Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该工作提出用closed-loop pass@k评估生成式机器人策略预训练质量，揭示大k pass@k能反映pass@1无法捕捉的后训练(posttraining)差异，并给出离线checkpoint选择准则与生成式数据增强两项改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统预训练指标(验证损失、平均成功率)无法反映策略是否既适合直接部署又适合后续微调/RL后训练，需要能预测posttraining收益的评估与选择准则。

Method: 定义闭环pass@k(同一初始条件下k次rollout至少成功一次的概率)，系统扫描多种posttraining配方的checkpoint，分析pass@1与大k pass@k的关系；据此提出(1)纯离线、无需闭环评估的checkpoint选择准则(平衡coverage与reliability)，(2)扩展有限示教集的生成式数据增强流程。

Result: pass@1相近但大k pass@k不同的checkpoint后训练表现显著不同；pass@k在监督预训练中于不同checkpoint达到峰值，呈现coverage-reliability权衡；数据增强在保持/提升pass@1的同时保持大k pass@k，并抬升覆盖-可靠性Pareto前沿。

Conclusion: 应将posttraining纳入策略评估、checkpoint选择与训练流程设计，pass@k可作为连接预训练与后训练的关键诊断指标。

Abstract: In modern robot learning, generative robot policies are first pretrained through supervised learning from demonstrations, then refined through reinforcement learning, supervised finetuning, or other forms of posttraining. Yet conventional pretraining metrics, such as validation loss and average task success, provide an incomplete account of which policies support both effective direct deployment and subsequent posttraining. In this work, we study closed-loop pass@k, which evaluates the probability that k rollouts from the same initial condition attain at least one success. Thus, pass@1 measures mean task success; large-k pass@k measures whether success remains reachable under repeated sampling. Across a wide range of posttraining recipes, we show that large-k pass@k reveals posttraining differences not captured by pass@1. In particular, checkpoints with similar pass@1 but different large-k pass@k have different posttraining performance. Moreover, we show pass@k peaks at different checkpoints during supervised pretraining, revealing a coverage-reliability tradeoff over the course of training. Based on these observations, we propose two practical interventions: (1) a purely offline checkpoint-selection criterion that balances coverage and reliability without closed-loop evaluation, and (2) a generative data augmentation procedure that expands supervision beyond the finite demonstration set, preserving large-k pass@k while maintaining or improving pass@1 and raising the observed coverage-reliability Pareto frontier. Together, our results motivate evaluation, checkpoint selection, and training procedures that explicitly account for posttraining. Blog post, visualizations, and code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [344] [LLM-Enhanced Multimodal House Price Prediction using Structured, Textual, and Visual Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01615)
*Khandokar Md. Rahat Hossain,Souvik Das,Tahsina Hashem,Mohammed Eunus Ali,Tanzima Hashem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多模态房价预测框架：用LLM从文本描述提取时空与上下文特征，用无监督视觉-语言方法将房源照片聚类为室内/室外/混合/户型图等类别（借助伪文本提示对齐，无需人工标注），融合结构化属性、文本与视觉特征后经回归器预测价格，在真实房源数据集上优于传统与多模态基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统房价预测仅用结构化属性（卧室、浴室、车位数量），忽略文本描述与照片中的丰富上下文信息；已有深度多模态方法未能有效提取文本中的结构化时空/上下文特征，也未挖掘图像的语义视觉信息。

Method: 三模态融合框架：(1) 结构化属性特征；(2) 用大语言模型从房源文本中提取领域相关的时空与上下文特征；(3) 无监督视觉-语言聚类，通过对齐图像簇与精心设计的伪文本提示，自动划分室内/室外/混合/户型图等照片类别并生成类别化视觉嵌入；三部分特征融合为统一表示，输入优化后的回归器预测价格，并保持可解释性。

Result: 在大型真实房源数据集上优于传统方法和现有多模态基线；消融实验表明LLM文本特征提取与类别化视觉嵌入分别显著提升预测精度与可靠性。

Conclusion: 系统化整合结构化属性、文本与图像并配合LLM特征抽取与无监督视觉-语言照片分类，可同时提升房价预测精度与可解释性；LLM驱动的文本特征工程与类别化视觉聚类是该任务的有效手段。

Abstract: Accurate house price prediction is essential for real estate buyers, sellers, agents, and financial institutions. Traditional methods rely primarily on structured data, e.g., number of bedrooms, bathrooms, parkings, but they overlook rich contextual information embedded in textual descriptions and property photos. Previous deep learning approaches for house price prediction have fused multimodal data but they fall short to extract structured spatio-temporal and contextual features from texts and semantic visual information from images. In this paper, we introduce a novel multimodal framework that addresses these limitations by systematically integrating structured attributes, textual descriptions, and visual images of properties to achieve higher prediction accuracy while maintaining interpretability. We use a large language model to derive domain-specific spatio-temporal and contextual features from text, and an unsupervised vision-language approach to automatically group photos into meaningful classes like indoor, outdoor, mixed, or floorplan, that are commonly present in real-world house listings. These categories are created without manual labeling by aligning image clusters with carefully designed pseudo text prompts. We fuse all features into a unified representation and use an optimized regressor to predict prices. Experiments on a large real-world property dataset demonstrate that our method outperforms traditional methods and existing multimodal baselines. Ablation studies confirm that the novel textual feature extraction and categorized visual embeddings substantially contribute to more accurate and reliable price predictions.

</details>


### [345] [Scalar Smoothness Is One Point on a Besov Spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02037)
*Bum Jun Kim,Anastasis Kratsios*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出有限差分粗糙度谱（roughness spectrum），在扰动尺度×方向上刻画模型响应的平滑性，统一了Lipschitz敏感性与方向Hessian曲率，并联系经典Besov理论；据此设计RSC提升噪声鲁棒性，以及基于块的混合精度量化分配，在7个LLM的14种设置下优于HAWQ-V2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一标量平滑性度量（Lipschitz常数、Hessian统计）无法刻画模型响应随扰动的尺度、方向与位置变化，与真实部署中遇到的扰动不匹配。

Method: 构造有限差分粗糙度谱，在多尺度/多方向上剖面化模型响应，将Lipschitz敏感性与方向Hessian曲率纳入统一框架；用Besov理论刻画变差随尺度的变化；理论证明更大的输出偏移未必造成更大任务损失、局部曲率本身会遗漏对有限扰动最脆弱的块。应用：图像分类中用Roughness Source Control抑制沿噪声方向的margin粗糙度；PTQ中按与各块量化误差尺度/方向匹配的扰动测任务损失增量，做混合精度分配。

Result: 图像分类上，在4个模型-数据集组合、80个checkpoint对比中RSC降低margin粗糙度并提升噪声鲁棒性；量化上，在7个held-out LLM的14种设置中，相同GPTQ权重与比特预算下混合精度分配perplexity低于Hessian-based HAWQ-V2。

Conclusion: 多尺度、方向化的有限差分粗糙度谱是比标量平滑性度量更具诊断力的工具，可同时指导鲁棒性训练正则与量化敏感度分配；理论结果表明输出灵敏度不等于任务损伤，需以任务损失为度量。

Abstract: Studies of neural network generalization and robustness often summarize smoothness with a single number, such as a Lipschitz constant or a Hessian curvature statistic. However, Lipschitz constants summarize global worst-case sensitivity and Hessian statistics summarize local curvature; neither captures how model responses vary with the size, direction, and location of perturbations encountered in real-world deployment. To measure smoothness under these perturbations, we introduce a finite-difference roughness spectrum that profiles model responses across these conditions. Our roughness spectrum generalizes scalar smoothness measures, bringing Lipschitz sensitivity and directional Hessian curvature into a common framework across perturbation scales. We connect this spectrum to classical Besov theory, which describes how a function's variation changes with scale. Our theoretical analysis also proves that a larger output shift can cause less task damage than a smaller one, and that local curvature alone can miss the blocks most vulnerable to finite perturbations. In image classification, Roughness Source Control (RSC) suppresses margin roughness along noise directions and improves noise robustness in a comparison of 80 checkpoints across four model--dataset combinations. In post-training quantization, we identify blocks that need higher precision by measuring task-loss increases from perturbations matched to the size and direction of each block's quantization error. Our mixed-precision allocation achieves lower perplexity than the Hessian-based HAWQ-V2 baseline under the same GPTQ weights and bit budgets in all 14 settings across seven held-out large language models.

</details>


### [346] [Do Visual RL Gains Scale at Test Time? A Quantile View of Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02366)
*Austin Wang,Lexing Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文指出视觉生成模型的强化学习后训练在 Best-of-N 测试时扩展下存在"扩展迁移失效"现象：单样本奖励提升不保证质量-计算前沿更优，并从分位数视角给出解释，提出 QUPO 优化分位数效用混合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 后训练只优化单样本质量，而实际部署常用 Best-of-N 采样消耗额外推理算力，因此需要厘清 RL 收益能否在测试时扩展下保持，尤其在困难留出任务上。

Method: 在多种 RL 方法、骨干与任务（组合生成、文字渲染、偏好对齐）上系统评测 Best-of-N 的质量-计算前沿；用分位数迁移框架分析，指出 N 增大时采样权重集中于奖励分布上尾，RL 可能压缩高奖励尾部；据此提出 Quantile Utility Policy Optimization（QUPO），优化对应不同推理预算的分位数效用的可控混合。

Result: RL 收益在大采样预算下会衰减、饱和甚至反转，基座模型可反超后训练模型；在 SD3.5-M 与 BAGEL 上，QUPO 更好保留上尾质量，并在困难留出提示上显著改善扩展表现。

Conclusion: 视觉生成模型不应仅以单样本质量评价和优化，还应关注后训练如何重塑推理时扩展所依赖的完整奖励分布。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the single-sample quality of visual generative models, but deployment often provides additional inference compute through Best-of-N sampling. Whether RL gains transfer under such test-time scaling, particularly on difficult held-out tasks, remains poorly understood in the visual domain. Our central contribution is to systematically identify and characterize a failure mode of scaling transfer in visual RL: across multiple RL methods, model backbones, and evaluations spanning compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment, higher single-sample reward does not necessarily imply a better quality-compute frontier. RL gains may attenuate, saturate, or even reverse at large sampling budgets, with the base model eventually outperforming its post-trained counterpart. We explain these regimes through a quantile-transfer framework, showing that Best-of-N places increasing weight on the upper tail of the reward distribution as N grows. Consequently, RL can improve typical samples while compressing or degrading the rare high-quality outcomes that test-time scaling exploits. As a simple intervention motivated by this analysis, we introduce Quantile Utility Policy Optimization (QUPO), which optimizes a controllable mixture of quantile utilities corresponding to different inference budgets. Experiments on SD3.5-M and BAGEL show that QUPO better preserves upper-tail quality and substantially improves scaling on challenging held-out prompts relative to standard RL post-training. Our results suggest that visual generative models should be evaluated and optimized not only for single-sample quality, but for how post-training reshapes the full reward distribution that inference-time scaling exploits.

</details>


### [347] [End-to-End Stability of Online Active Learning in Large-Scale Neural Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02488)
*Shuiwen Shen,Jinhua Zhang,Chenlei Hou,Peng Shi,Yong Han,Bo Gao,Xiaoxiao Na,Zhihui Lin,Pengtao Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出以稳定性为核心的在线主动学习(OAL)框架：以预测误差为反馈信号训练结构化深度模型，将在线学习与Lyapunov能量最小化联系起来，并证明多层网络下整体学习过程的渐近稳定性与目标参数轨迹的唯一性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线主动学习需在动态物理环境中进行实时交互式持续适应，是安全关键应用的前提，但多层网络在线参数更新是否稳定缺乏理论保证；且仅靠输出误差收敛无法推出参数收敛。

Method: 构建预测误差反馈驱动的结构化深度模型，与Lyapunov能量最小化对应；将分析分解为输出误差调节、内部零动态、层间耦合与参数收敛四部分；引入持续激励(PE)与主动阻尼消除收敛误差后的零空间模态；级联Lyapunov分析给出整体渐近稳定性，单调激活函数与微分同胚层映射提供目标参数轨迹唯一性条件。

Result: 理论上证得整体OAL学习过程的渐近稳定性，并给出参数轨迹唯一性条件；同时说明多层网络可能存在高维等效输出解流形，从而解析出输出误差收敛与参数收敛之间的间隙。

Conclusion: 为在线自适应学习在大规模、非平稳与安全关键的神经系统中应用提供了理论依据，但暂无实证或机器人验证。

Abstract: Online Active Learning (OAL) aims to extend deep learning from static inference after offline training to continuous adaptation during real-time interaction with a changing physical environment. This transition is essential for safety-critical applications, but it raises a central theoretical question: whether the online parameter update process remains stable when scaled to multilayer neural architectures. This paper develops a stability-focused OAL framework. The framework uses prediction error as a feedback signal to update a structured deep model, thereby linking online learning with Lyapunov-based energy minimization. We show that prediction error convergence alone is insufficient for global parameter convergence because multilayer networks may admit high-dimensional manifolds of equivalent output solutions. The analysis therefore separates output error regulation, internal zero dynamics, interlayer coupling, and parameter convergence. Persistency of excitation and active damping are then used to remove the residual null-space modes that remain after output error convergence. A cascaded Lyapunov analysis establishes asymptotic stability of the overall OAL learning process, while monotonic activation functions and diffeomorphic layer mappings provide the uniqueness condition for the target parameter trajectory. The resulting proof provides a theoretical basis for applying online adaptive learning to large-scale neural systems in nonstationary and safety-critical settings.

</details>


### [348] [LipLingo: CNN Model for Lip Reading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02776)
*Mahmoud S. Mayaleh,Liban Ali Achkir,Nijat Mehdiyev,Ahmet Ozdil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于LipNet改进的唇读系统LipLingo，加入标准化嘴部预处理、轮换验证策略与灵活的相似度评估，在GRID上达95.0%字符准确率、87.2%句准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 唇读在语音识别、听障辅助与生物认证中有价值，但说话人变化及视觉相似音素会导致性能下降，需提升跨说话人鲁棒性评估与建模。

Method: 沿用LipNet的3D卷积时空特征提取+双向循环序列建模，采用CTC损失与Adam优化；改进点在于统一嘴部区域表示的标准化预处理管线、面向未见说话人泛化的轮换验证策略，以及更可靠的句级灵活相似度评估。

Result: GRID数据集上字符准确率95.0%（CER 4.99%），句准确率87.2%，语料级WER 13.1%，优于LipNet基线，与3D-ResNet+Bi-GRU+MixUp方案相比具竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过预处理标准化与更严谨的验证/评估协议可显著提升唇读鲁棒性，但整体仍属增量性工程改进，距离真实场景部署尚有差距。

Abstract: Lip reading plays a crucial role in applications such as speech recognition, assistive technologies for the hearing-impaired, and biometric authentication. However, performance often degrades when the speaker varies and when certain speech sounds are visually similar. To address these challenges, we propose LipLingo, a robust lip-reading system based on the LipNet architecture, enhanced with a standardized preprocessing pipeline for consistent mouth-region representation, a rotational validation strategy for improved generalization to unseen speakers, and a flexible similarity evaluation for more reliable sentence-level assessment. The model architecture combines 3D convolutional layers for spatio-temporal feature extraction and bidirectional recurrent layers for sequence modeling, optimized using the Adam optimizer and Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) loss. On the GRID dataset, LipLingo achieved 95.0\% character-level accuracy (CER 4.99\%) and 87.2\% sentence-level accuracy. At the corpus level, the system obtained a (WER 13.1\%), outperforming the baseline LipNet and demonstrating competitive performance relative to recent 3D-ResNet + Bi-GRU + MixUp approaches. These results provide insights into strategies that enhance lip-reading robustness and highlight directions for future work toward real-world deployment.

</details>


### [349] [Gibbs Variational Last Layers for Long-Horizon Dynamics Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02891)
*Paul Brunzema,Henrik Hose,Sebastian Trimpe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 从Gibbs变分推断视角重新审视VBLL，将后验推断与训练损失解耦，提出引入多步长时域结构、CRPS鲁棒损失与全自回归rollout训练的多步损失族，显著提升长时域预测精度与分布拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VBLL以近确定性成本提供可处理不确定性，但仅用单步似然目标训练，对多步自回归rollout的可靠性不足。

Method: 利用Gibbs变分推断解耦后验推断与训练损失；设计递进式多步训练损失：逐步引入长时域结构、CRPS（连续排序概率分数）鲁棒项、以及在完整自回归rollout上训练；保持VBLL架构简洁性，直接优化多步预测质量。

Result: 在示意性合成环境、多种混沌动力系统及真实数据上，多步CRPS目标显著提升长时域精度与分布拟合，一致优于单步似然训练。

Conclusion: VBLL的训练目标而非其推断结构是长时域性能瓶颈；解耦训练损失后引入多步CRPS目标可低成本获得可靠的长时间概率预测，适用于基于模型的决策。

Abstract: Accurate long-horizon probabilistic predictions of dynamical systems are a prerequisite for model-based decision-making. Variational Bayesian last layers (VBLLs) are an attractive model class for this setting, offering tractable uncertainty at near-deterministic cost, yet they are trained exclusively with single-step likelihood objectives that may be insufficient for reliable multi-step rollouts. We revisit VBLLs through the lens of Gibbs variational inference, which decouples posterior inference from the choice of training loss. Building on this perspective, we introduce a family of multi-step training losses that progressively incorporate long-horizon structure, robustness via continuous ranked probability scores (CRPS), and training on full autoregressive rollouts. Our approach retains the simplicity of VBLLs while directly optimizing for multi-step predictive quality. Across illustrative synthetic environments, a diverse suite of chaotic dynamical systems, and real-world data, we show that multi-step, CRPS-based objectives substantially improve long-horizon accuracy and distributional fit, consistently outperforming single-step likelihood training.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [350] [When appearance and motion disagree: evaluating class--motion consistency against disguised uncrewed surface vessels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00367)
*Jon Reifschneider*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 用AIS航迹构建"混合回放"协议评估海上目标防御：对抗性船体补丁可将检测抑制率提升至29%但不会误判为无害，而物理伪装可同时绕过相机与雷达检查；基于资产相对接近率的检查在15-20节、4海里内直接冲撞场景下可标记94-95%，显著优于纯航迹速度检查的12%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 岸基视觉/雷达防御系统需在足够预警时间内区分接近的无害船只与无人水面艇（USV），且这些系统可能被对抗性船体补丁或物理伪装攻击；现有工作缺乏对攻击有效性与防御手段的系统性、可复现的对比评测方法。

Method: （1）实测评估对抗性船体补丁与物理伪装的攻击效果；（2）提出基于AIS航迹的混合回放协议，将真实记录的 benign 运动与直接/离轴攻击航段拼接，形成可控的攻击-防御测试集；（3）提出资产相对接近率（closing-rate）检查，并与纯航迹速度检查对比，采用"任一检查触发即标记"的融合策略，报告留出集虚警率。

Result: 对抗补丁在最多29%的尝试中抑制检测，但未造成向无害类别的误分类；物理伪装可同时绕过相机检查与雷达存在性检查。对标记为休闲船只、在4海里内直接冲撞的目标，接近率检查在15-20节时标记率94-95%，纯速度检查仅12%；两种检查在离轴接近时互补，迫使攻击者同时低于两个阈值并延长抵达资产所需时间。融合标记的留出集整体虚警率4.9%，休闲类船只上为12.3%。

Conclusion: 单一检查（速度或视觉）易被规避，资产相对接近率是更有效的判别特征，与速度检查互补可形成约束性防御；所提出的回放式评测协议为海上防御方法提供了可比较的测试与评估框架。

Abstract: Defense systems for maritime assets must distinguish approaching benign craft from uncrewed surface vessels (USVs) with sufficient warning to act. Shore cameras using computer vision can separate hostile vessels from benign traffic, but these systems may be attacked using an adversarial hull patch or physical disguise. We evaluate adversarial hull patches and find they suppress detection in up to 29% of attempts but never cause misclassification as benign. Physical disguise, however, can bypass both a camera check and a radar presence check. To evaluate defenses, we develop a hybrid replay protocol from automatic identification system (AIS) tracks that combines recorded benign motion with direct or off-axis attack run-ins. We find that for recreational-labeled vessels attacking via direct run-in within 4 nautical miles, an asset-relative closing-rate check flags 94-95% at 15-20 knots, compared with 12% for a track-only speed check. The checks are complementary on off-axis approaches, constraining the attacker to remain below both thresholds and extending the time required to reach the asset. Flagging on either check has a 4.9% held-out false-alarm rate overall and 12.3% on recreational traffic. The replay-based evaluation protocol supports comparative test and evaluation of defense methods.

</details>


### [351] [Pop Goes the Verifier: Phoneme-Targeted Data Poisoning of Voice Liveness Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01095)
*Eshaq Jamdar,Amith Kamath Belman*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Pop Goes the Verifier，一种更隐蔽的音素注入数据投毒攻击：用 FastSpeech 2 + 改版 HiFi-GAN 声码器在爆破音位置注入局部 pop 突发并叠加细微高斯噪声，以降低波形/频谱图上的可见伪影，从而攻击 VoicePop 类活体检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VoicePop 等基于低频 pop 突发（GFCC+SVM）的活体检测对传统重放攻击有效，但存在数据投毒脆弱性。已有 SyntheticPop 攻击虽可用 20% 投毒样本把模型准确率打到 14.01%，但其波形能量可视化下伪影明显，易被检测。

Method: 基于 ASVSpoof 2019 数据集，使用 FastSpeech 2 合成语音并配以修改的 HiFi-GAN 声码器，在爆破音音素处注入局部 pop 突发，同时叠加细微高斯噪声以掩盖注入痕迹，从信号层面提升隐蔽性。

Result: 实现"中等强度"投毒效果，但相较原始 SyntheticPop 在抵抗信号级检查（波形与频谱图分析）方面更强，攻击更隐蔽。

Conclusion: 通过生成式音素级注入 + 噪声掩蔽，可在牺牲部分攻击强度的情况下显著提升语音活体检测投毒攻击的隐蔽性，说明现有 pop 突发类活体检测的安全性设计需重新评估。

Abstract: Many Automated Speaker Verification Systems (ASVs) commonly employ liveliness detection techniques, such as VoicePop, which identify genuine speech by analyzing low- frequency pop bursts from plosive phonemes using Gammatone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (GFCC) and an SVM classifier. While effective against traditional replay attacks, such systems are vulnerable to data poisoning techniques. Prior work shows that broadly applied SyntheticPop attacks can collapse model to accuracy to as low as 14.01% using only 20% poisoned samples, but the resulting artifacts are easily detectable when visualizing the waveform energies. This paper introduces Pop Goes the Verifier, a stealthier phoneme injection poisoning attack. By leveraging FastSpeech 2 (FS2) with a modified HiFi-GAN vocoder, we inject localized pop bursts at plosive phoneme locations and overlay subtle Gaussian noise to reduce the visibility of injected artifacts in waveform and spectrogram analysis. Using the ASVSpoof 2019 as the dataset, we observe that the approach achieves a moderate poisoning attack while providing greater resistance to signal-level inspection than the original SyntheticPop attack.

</details>


### [352] [Detecting Generated-Depth Injection Attacks on RGB-D Place Authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01550)
*Seigo Kawachi,Satoshi Matsuura*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该文研究RGB-D地点认证中的软件层呈现攻击检测（PAD），分析基于配准与几何一致性的分类器在攻击者不同程度掌握相机内参时检测单目深度估计（MDE）注入深度的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目深度估计已足够成熟，攻击者可由公开RGB图像生成深度并提交伪造RGB-D查询，从而破坏"深度来自传感器"这一认证核心假设，因而需要软件层的防御机制并明确其边界。

Method: 采用基于注册与查询视角几何一致性（重投影误差、配准残差）的PAD分类器，设计三阶段评估：内参仅估计值、内参精确已知、以及以真值3D几何拟合warp的oracle评估（最强情形为每个有效查询关键点给定真值3D坐标）。

Result: 第一阶段对三种MDE模型伪造的验证AUC为0.997–0.999；第二阶段原分类器降至接近随机（AUC 0.54–0.61），但重训练后仍可依赖配准残差；oracle最强设定下检测才接近随机。重投影误差反映内参误估，配准残差在内参精确时依然有效。

Conclusion: 几何一致性PAD在内参未知时可高效拦截MDE注入深度，但其保障本质上是"内参秘密依赖"；需结合多线索并考虑更强的oracle攻击设定来评估真实安全性。

Abstract: Advances in monocular depth estimation (MDE) now let an attacker generate depth from publicly available RGB images and submit forged RGB-D queries. Such attacks break a core assumption of RGB-D place authentication: that depth comes from a sensor. We study a presentation attack detection (PAD) classifier that uses geometric consistency between the enrollment and query views, as a software-layer defense. A three-stage evaluation shows how far this classifier detects software-injected depth, depending on how accurately the attacker knows the camera intrinsics. In the first stage, the attacker has only an estimate of the intrinsics, and the PAD classifier separates forgeries generated by all three MDE models with a validation area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.997-0.999. In the second stage, the attacker obtains the exact intrinsics, and the original PAD classifier falls to near chance (AUC 0.54-0.61); a retrained PAD classifier, however, still has the registration residual between enrollment and query as a cue. In the third stage, an oracle evaluation, in which the evaluator fits warps using the ground-truth 3D geometry, shows that detection falls to near chance only in its strongest case, where every valid query keypoint is given its ground-truth 3D coordinate. Of the detection cues, the reprojection error captures the attacker's misestimate of the intrinsics, whereas the registration residual remains even when the attacker knows the exact intrinsics.

</details>

### [353] [Contrastive Astromer: Two-Stage Contrastive Representation Learning for Astronomical Light Curve Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00150)
*Justin Minggan Wei,Pavlos Protopapas,Guillermo Cabrera-Vives*

Main category: astro-ph.IM

TL;DR: Contrastive Astromer：在不改动 ASTROMER 2 编码器的前提下，用无监督+有监督对比学习对掩码重建预训练的光变曲线表示做适配，冻结编码器后线性分类的 macro-F1 超过微调基线约 5.1 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型巡天数据光变曲线丰富但类别标签稀缺；ASTROMER 2 的掩码重建目标并不显式鼓励在紧凑表示中形成类别可分性，导致表示对分类任务利用不足。

Method: 两阶段对比适配：(1) 在单波段 MACHO 无标签光变曲线上做无监督对比学习，拉近同一目标不同增强视图的表示；(2) 用另一个带标签的 Alcock 样本做有监督对比学习，并辅以辅助分类损失增强类间判别。评估时冻结编码器，单独训练下游分类器。

Result: 在 600 个目标的留出集上，每类 500 个标注样本时 macro-F1 为 0.7943，比复现的 ASTROMER 2 微调-分类流程高 5.10 个百分点；每类 20 与 100 样本预算下分别为 0.7078 与 0.7704，同样优于基线。嵌入空间分析显示有监督适配提升了局部类别一致性与全局类间分离度。

Conclusion: 对比式适配使预训练光变曲线表示在分类上更有效、并对变星类别结构更具信息量；方法不改编码器结构，可作为通用的表示后训练范式。

Abstract: Large astronomical surveys collect abundant light curves, but reliable class labels remain scarce. ASTROMER 2 learns from unlabeled light curves by reconstructing masked observations, yet this objective does not explicitly encourage class separation in a compact representation of each light curve. We introduce Contrastive Astromer, a two-stage approach that makes these representations more useful for classification without changing the ASTROMER 2 encoder architecture. First, unsupervised contrastive learning on single-band MACHO light curves brings together representations of augmented views of the same object. Supervised contrastive learning, supported by an auxiliary classification loss, then uses a separate labeled Alcock sample to strengthen class discrimination. We evaluate the resulting representations by freezing the encoder and training a separate classifier. On a held-out set of 600 objects, this classifier achieves a macro-F1 of 0.7943 with 500 labeled examples per class, exceeding our reproduction of the ASTROMER 2 finetune-and-classify pipeline by 5.10 percentage points. With downstream classifier training budgets of 20 and 100 examples per class, macro-F1 reaches 0.7078 and 0.7704, respectively, also surpassing this baseline. Embedding-space analyses further show that supervised adaptation improves local class consistency and global class separation. These results show that contrastive adaptation makes pretrained light-curve representations more effective for classification and more informative about the structure of variability classes.

</details>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [354] [Learned optical compression for single-pixel quantitative phase imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01675)
*Ary Portes,Yuntian Wang,Che-Yung Shen,Shiqi Chen,Aydogan Ozcan*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 面向单像素定量相位成像(QPI)，联合优化衍射光学编码器与数字神经网络解码器，以学习到的编码图案将相位信息压缩进少量标量强度测量，实现约40倍降维压缩的高保真相位重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QPI通常依赖空间分辨的强度测量（面阵探测器），在探测器阵列昂贵或不可用的波段代价高；作者希望把相位信息压缩进极少量的单像素标量测量，实现低数据率、可复用的测量高效QPI框架。

Method: 单像素QPI系统：一块可重构相位调制平面依次显示与输入物体无关的学习编码图案，每个图案产生一个标量强度测量；衍射编码器与数字神经解码器端到端联合优化，使测量向量集中重建相关相位信息。解码器仅微调即可适配新数据分布（编码器固定）。可见光波段实验验证，并与其它编码策略在同一测量预算下对比。

Result: 实验实现约40倍维度压缩，仅用重建像素数2.55%的强度测量；对手写数字与类光栅相位物体盲测的Pearson相关系数分别为0.945与0.848；同测量预算下重建保真度显著优于其他编码策略；固定光学编码器下仅解码器自适应即可迁移到未见数据分布。

Conclusion: 学习式光学压缩为QPI提供测量高效且可复用的框架，将相位信息压缩集成到单像素强度测量中并保持对新数据的适应性，有望用于低数据率相位成像与传感，并推广到高质量探测器阵列昂贵或缺失的光谱区域。

Abstract: Quantitative phase imaging (QPI) reveals optical path-length variations in transparent objects but typically relies on spatially resolved intensity measurements. Here we numerically and experimentally demonstrate learned optical compression for single-pixel QPI, jointly optimizing a diffractive encoder and a digital neural decoder to concentrate reconstruction-relevant phase information into a compact measurement vector. A single reconfigurable phase-modulation plane sequentially displays the learned encoding patterns, which are independent of the input object, each yielding one scalar intensity measurement. Operating at a visible wavelength, the experimental system reconstructs quantitative phase images of unknown objects with ~40-fold dimensional compression, using only 2.55% as many intensity measurements as reconstructed pixels. Experimental blind testing on handwritten digits and grating-like phase objects achieves mean Pearson correlation coefficients of 0.945 and 0.848, respectively. Benchmarking under the same measurement budget demonstrates substantially higher reconstruction fidelity than other encoding strategies, highlighting the advantages of learned optical compression. With the optical encoder fixed, decoder-only neural adaptation enables experimental transfer to previously unseen data distributions, extending the utility of the learned measurement representation. These results establish learned optical compression as a measurement-efficient and reusable framework for QPI, integrating phase-information compression into single-pixel intensity measurements while retaining adaptability to new data. This approach paves the way for low-data-rate phase imaging and sensing, with the potential to extend QPI to spectral regions where high-quality detector arrays are costly or unavailable.

</details>


<div id='eess.SY'></div>

# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [355] [Spectral and Conformal: Neural Network Methods for Calibrated Trajectory Prediction and Control-Point Intervals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00231)
*Jasmine Ratchford,Raffaele Romagnoli*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 用谱基神经网络学习四旋翼闭环轨迹及分位数带（内嵌初值与稳定性约束），结合改进的保形分位回归给出轨迹级联合覆盖，再用区间算术把无噪声覆盖保证扩展到控制点；Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W 上单条轨迹推理 3.45 ms，全流程 9.81 ms（约 100 Hz）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主导航需快速评估候选轨迹的可行性与安全性；数值积分计算开销大，而快速数据驱动代理模型缺乏形式化保证，需在保证与实时性之间取得折中。

Method: (1) 谱基（spectral backbone）神经网络拟合轨迹与分位数带，训练中内嵌初始条件与稳定性约束；(2) 修改的保形分位回归实现校准的轨迹级联合覆盖；(3) 区间算术将无噪声覆盖保证推广到控制点；(4) 面向推理重构网络以降低延迟。

Result: 闭环 LQR 下四旋翼轨迹推理 3.45 ms，含轨迹推理的完整流水线 9.81 ms（约 100 Hz），与典型控制频率匹配，具备嵌入式端实时性。

Conclusion: 为轨迹可行性/安全性评估提供了一个兼具形式化覆盖保证与嵌入式实时性的学习型框架，可作为传统数值积分的快速替代。

Abstract: Autonomous systems that navigate their environment need methods to quickly assess the feasibility and safety of desired trajectories. Traditional solutions that rely on numerical integration can be computationally heavy, while fast data-driven surrogates lack the formal guarantees that numerical approaches provide. This work demonstrates a framework that uses (1) a neural network with a spectral backbone to learn trajectories and quantile bands with built-in constraints (initial conditions and stability); (2) a modified conformal quantile regression to provide calibrated, joint trajectory-level coverage; and (3) interval arithmetic to extend noise-free coverage guarantees to control points. After refactoring the network for inference, the trajectory inference time for a quadrotor under a closed-loop linear quadratic regulator is 3.45~ms on a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W. The total pipeline time, including trajectory inference time, is 9.81~ms, or approximately 100~Hz, consistent with typical control rates.

</details>


### [356] [Vision-based Sensing of Urban Environment using Hardware-Software co-design at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00699)
*Akshit Gupta,R Venkatesha Prasad*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: UrbanScapes：面向城市环境大规模街景感知的模块化软硬件协同设计平台，集成RGB/近红外/热红外多光谱成像通道，支持自行车、车辆、行人机会式部署与市政车队定向部署，并利用端侧深度学习模型在采集端实时去除个人可识别信息（PII），再将街景多光谱影像与航空/卫星多光谱遥感数据融合，实现可扩展的物理型环境指数计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有城市环境监测高度依赖人工巡检、高空遥感和有限的地面RGB影像，缺乏街景层面的综合多光谱视角；同时街景数据采集面临隐私合规障碍与大范围时空覆盖的部署成本问题。

Method: 模块化硬件架构，可插拔多光谱传感通道（RGB、NIR、热红外）；软硬件协同设计以适配多种载体（自行车、车辆、行人、市政车队）而无需硬件重设计；端侧（on-device）深度学习模型在边缘实时脱敏PII；软件侧完成街景多光谱影像与航空多光谱遥感的配准融合，计算基于物理模型的环境指数。

Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅声称可实现高时空可扩展性、无需硬件重设计即可切换部署模式、边缘端隐私保护，并支持城市尺度的物理型环境指数计算。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可扩展的街景多光谱采集与分析基础平台，将地面多光谱观测与空中遥感结合，为气候适应型城市的精细化环境分析奠定数据与方法基础；后续需以实际部署规模、传感器标定精度与指数验证实验来支撑其有效性。

Abstract: Urban environmental monitoring is crucial for climate-adaptive cities, yet current approaches rely heavily on human inspection, overhead remote sensing, or limited terrestrial RGB imagery, thereby lacking comprehensive multispectral perspectives at street level. To bridge this gap, this paper introduces UrbanScapes, an adaptable and flexible hardware-software co-design platform for large-scale, vision-based sensing of urban environments. Built on a modular architecture, UrbanScapes seamlessly integrates multispectral imaging channels, including Red, Green, Blue (RGB), Near-Infrared, and Thermal, to capture multispectral street-level imagery. The system is designed for both opportunistic deployment on bicycles, vehicles, or pedestrians and targeted deployments on municipal fleets, ensuring high spatio-temporal scalability without requiring hardware redesigns. Crucially, the platform utilizes on-device deep learning models to automatically remove personally identifiable information (PII) at the edge, addressing privacy concerns inherent in street-level data collection. By combining this multispectral street-level imagery with overhead multispectral remote sensing imagery, UrbanScapes enables scalable calculation of physics-based environmental indices, providing a foundational tool for advanced citywide analysis.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [357] [AuroraWorld: Structured 4D World Modeling for Exo-to-Ego Video Generation in Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00177)
*Hao Xue,Peng-Fei Zhang,Ying Cheng,Lanyun Zhu,Lei Zhu,Heng Tao Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有从大规模第三人称（exocentric）操作视频合成第一人称（egocentric）观测的方法在大视角变换、严重遮挡、复杂物体交互与稀疏视角下难以生成物理一致且策略相关的视频。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称观测能捕捉接触交互与物体状态变化，对视觉运动策略学习至关重要且外部相机难以获得；但第一人称数据采集因额外硬件与平台适配成本高昂。从大规模第三人称操作视频合成第一人称观测是可扩展的替代方案，而现有方法在此类极端条件下失效。

Method: 摘要未给出具体方法细节（属问题陈述型摘要），仅提出从exocentric操作视频合成物理一致、策略相关的egocentric视频这一技术目标与任务设定。

Result: 摘要未报告实验结果，仅指出既有方法在大视角变换、严重遮挡、复杂物体交互及稀疏观测下表现不足。

Conclusion: 该工作瞄准机器人操作数据的第一人称视角合成与数据增广方向，问题定位清晰但缺少可验证的方法与定量证据，需阅读全文评估其技术贡献与真实验证。

Abstract: Egocentric observations provide a robot-centric view of manipulation processes, capturing contact interactions and object-state changes that are important for visuomotor policy learning but difficult to observe from external cameras. However, collecting such data at scale remains expensive due to additional hardware requirements and platform-specific deployment costs. Synthesizing egocentric observations from large-scale exocentric manipulation videos provides a scalable alternative. However, existing methods struggle to synthesize physically consistent and policy-relevant egocentric videos under substantial viewpoint transformations, severe occlusions, complex object interactions, and inherently sparse observations from available exocentric viewpoints.

</details>


### [358] [MemU-Bench: Benchmarking GUI Agents on Long-Horizon User Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00191)
*Yizhou Liu,Zhengxi Lu,Fei Tang,Yiwen Qiu,Yong Du,Tongbo Chen,Bofan Chen,Tao Jiang,Wenhao Xu,Yunfeng Shu,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MemU-Bench：基于29条长程轨迹的118个"模糊且依赖历史"的移动端GUI任务基准，用序列化应用数据库验证结果，并引入 IE 与 SPL 度量以区分"真正回忆"与"穷举搜索"；同时提出免训练框架 AppMem（结构化的以应用为中心的记忆库 + 跨应用中断意图跟踪 + 目标应用推断检索），使 GPT-5.5 的 SPL 从 15.7% 提升到 66.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GUI 基准使用精确、无状态的指令，而真实使用中指令往往模糊且依赖历史（用户记不清过去操作细节），要求智能体从长而噪声大的交互历史中恢复缺失上下文。现有评测缺乏对这一能力的衡量，且成功率高可能来自跨应用穷举搜索而非真实记忆。

Method: 1) 构建 MemU-Bench：118 个模糊任务、29 条长程用户轨迹，结果以序列化应用数据库状态校验；除成功率外引入 Interaction Efficiency (IE) 与 Success weighted by Path Length (SPL)，惩罚穷举式搜索。2) 提出免训练框架 AppMem：将原始交互流蒸馏为结构化、以应用为中心的记忆库；跟踪跨应用切换的被中断意图；通过目标应用推断选择性检索相关记忆。

Result: 无用户历史时，最强系统 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 SPL 仅 16.4%，端到端 GUI 智能体低于 5%；加入 AppMem 后 GPT-5.5 的 SPL 由 15.7% 升至 66.9%（+51.2%），比朴素摘要基线高 9.3%，且在多个骨干模型上取得一致增益。

Conclusion: 揭示了模糊、历史依赖型 GUI 任务是一个显著的评测空白，且当前前沿模型在无记忆条件下几乎无法有效完成；结构化的应用中心记忆库 + 意图跟踪 + 目标应用推断检索是有效的、免训练的记忆增强范式。

Abstract: Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) benchmarks predominantly rely on precise and stateless user instructions. In everyday usage, however, instructions are often \emph{vague and history-dependent}: users omit the exact details of their past operations because they no longer remember them, leaving the agent to recover the missing context from long and noisy interaction histories. To bridge this evaluation gap, we introduce \textbf{MemU-Bench}, a mobile benchmark of \textbf{118 vague tasks} grounded in 29 long-horizon user trajectories, where agents must distill raw interaction streams into memory and retrieve the missing context on demand, with task outcomes verified against serialized application databases. Alongside Success Rate, we incorporate Interaction Efficiency (IE) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) to expose agents that succeed by exhaustively searching across different applications rather than by \emph{genuinely recalling} the history. Evaluations show that without user history, state-of-the-art systems struggle under such ambiguity: the best-performing Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves an SPL of only 16.4\%, and end-to-end GUI agents fall below 5\%. To address this, we further propose \textbf{AppMem}, a training-free framework that distills user history into a \emph{structured, app-centric} memory bank, tracks interrupted intents across application switches, and selectively retrieves relevant memories via target-app inference. AppMem raises the SPL of GPT-5.5 from 15.7\% to 66.9\% (\textbf{+51.2\%}), outperforms a naive summary baseline by 9.3\%, and delivers consistent gains across evaluated backbones.

</details>


### [359] [Taurus: LLM-in-the-Loop CT Annotation Matches Coding Agents at Half the Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00247)
*Bing Hu,Rishabh Sharma,Jatin Mehta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 构建 Taurus 框架：自动化流程先出标注、LLM 仅做质检式复核（固定规则平滑表面 + 大错误检测 + 带候选修正的单选题），在 6 个公开主动脉 CT 数据集（939 例）盲测标注恢复。最终版与自由式 Opus agent 主指标无差异，成本降至每例 $1.22（对手 $2.71）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动脉 CT 稠密标注耗时；公开数据集各自标注约定不一致。探索 LLM agent 以自由式写代码分割，还是在 harness 中"自动标注+模型复核"更有效。

Method: 盲标签恢复评测：隐藏 6 个公开数据集的真实标签，按各数据集自身类别评分。v1 Taurus 由模型自由复核；自由式 agent（Claude Opus）自写分割代码。随后将自由式 agent 的优势迁移到自动化 pass（38 例留出验证）；最终版加固定规则表面平滑 + 大误差检查（如动脉瘤仅画一半），触发时以多选题形式（候选修正在扫描上可视叠加）询问模型。

Result: v1 复核仅在 6 个数据集中 2 个提升主指标且小于同一病例两次复核的噪声；自由式 Opus agent 在多数数据集更高。迁移后增益大部分保留。最终版匹配人类参考的表面平滑度，主指标与自由式 Opus 无显著差异，成本 $1.22 vs $2.71/例。

Conclusion: Taurus 的竞争力主要来自 harness 与自动化流程而非 LLM 本身；该类标注可自动化，专家时间可从"画标签"转向"查标签"。

Abstract: Dense labels of the aorta in CT are slow to draw, and the public aortic CT datasets that could stand in for them each label different structures under their own conventions. Large language model (LLM) agents can now write code and read images. We asked whether such a model labels these scans better as a free-form agent that writes its own segmentation code, or inside a harness, where an automated pass labels the scan and the model reviews the result. We built a harness, Taurus, and compared it with free-form agents by blind label recovery: we withheld the human labels of six public datasets (939 volumes) and scored every approach against each dataset's own classes. In the first version of Taurus, the model's review raised the primary metric on only two of six datasets, by less than the noise between two reviews of the same case. A free-form agent running Claude Opus 5.5 scored higher on most datasets. Moving what the free-form agents did well into the automated pass then carried most of the gain on 38 held-out cases. The final version smooths the label surfaces with a fixed rule and checks for the large errors the automated pass tends to make, such as an aneurysm drawn to half its size. Each check that fires puts a multiple-choice question to the model, with candidate corrections drawn on the scan. It matched the surface smoothness of the human references, and in the primary metric we found no difference from the free-form Opus agent, at under half its cost, $1.22 against $2.71 per case. Most of what made Taurus competitive came from the harness and its automation rather than from the language model itself. Taurus shows that this kind of annotation can be automated, so that expert time can move from drawing labels to checking them.

</details>


### [360] [CalVLA: Shaping Native Confidence in Vision-Language-Action Policies with Outcome Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00394)
*Boniface Chukwuemeka Godwin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CalVLA 通过对 OpenVLA-7B 微调低秩适配器，用成功/失败轨迹和 ACal 平方间隔排序损失塑形原生动作 token 置信度，使动作概率可直接作为任务失败信号；LIBERO-10 留出集上联合失败判别 AUROC 达 0.7392±0.0480，但任务成功率从 58% 降至 55%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 策略本身缺少对任务失败的自我判断能力，通常需外挂独立失败检测器。作者希望验证：能否直接利用策略自身输出的动作 token 概率作为失败信号，从而无需辅助检测模块。

Method: 仅用低秩适配器（LoRA）微调 OpenVLA-7B；以成功/失败 rollout 构造配对样本，在同一任务内按相近归一化已用时长（非等效物理进度）配对；采用 Action-Confidence Alignment（ACal）平方 margin-ranking 损失直接塑形动作 token 置信度。测试时取 130 与 260 步的置信度均值作为判别分数，并在三个随机种子上报告结果；另设冻结策略的线性探针基线。

Result: 500 个 LIBERO-10 配置的留出测试集上，适配后置信度的联合失败判别 AUROC 为 0.7392±0.0480；同一置信度汇总量在适配前为 0.4485，适配后为 0.7327；冻结策略探针为 0.6146–0.6436，但相对线性探针的优势在统计上不显著。任务平均成功率由 58% 降至 55%。

Conclusion: 通过置信度塑形可显著提升 VLA 自身动作概率的失败判别能力（近乎随机 → 可用水平），但该增益与现有探针方法相比未达统计显著；同时控制性能略有下降。作者明确指出这仅是"判别能力提升"，不构成控制性能或安全收益的证据。

Abstract: Can a vision-language-action (VLA) policy signal likely task failure from its own action probabilities? We introduce CalVLA, which shapes native action-token confidence using successful and failed rollouts and an Action-Confidence Alignment (ACal) squared margin-ranking loss. Low-rank adapters update OpenVLA-7B without an auxiliary failure detector. Observations are paired within tasks at similar normalized elapsed times, not necessarily equivalent physical progress. On a held-out test split from 500 LIBERO-10 configurations, adapted confidence achieves a joint failure-discrimination AUROC of $0.7392\pm0.0480$ over three seeds, averaging scores at 130 and 260 steps. Frozen-policy probes reach 0.6146--0.6436, but superiority over the linear probe is statistically inconclusive. For the same confidence summary, AUROC rises from 0.4485 before adaptation to 0.7327 after adaptation. Mean task success decreases from 58% to 55%. These results show improved failure discrimination, not improved control or established safety benefits.

</details>


### [361] [FOCUS: Closed-Loop Attention Feedback for Efficient Vision-Language Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01438)
*Akul Santhosh,Aastha Jhunjhunwala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FOCUS：免训练三层框架，用小型同族VLM的patch嵌入差异做时序门控按需触发burst，融合patch差异与自顶向下注意力先验形成空间聚焦图，用于校准VLM value cache，并把解码器文本-视觉交叉注意力回灌为下一轮先验；EgoSchema 500视频流式评测74.8%仅25.4次调用，captioning质量相当且调用减少57%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逐帧调用VLM推理成本高、无法支撑实时视频理解；均匀采样忽略内容会漏事件，token剪枝仍逐帧调用模型，均未同时解决"调用次数"与"调用时关注何处"。

Method: 免训练三层：1) 时序门控——在小型同族VLM的patch嵌入空间度量帧间不相似度，仅在语义显著变化时触发burst采样；2) 空间聚焦——burst内累积patch级差异，与top-down注意力先验融合为focus map，生成时校准value cache，放大任务相关视觉token、抑制无关token而不删除任何token；3) 闭环——从解码器提取text-to-vision交叉注意力作为下一burst的先验，迭代收敛到语义关键区域。

Result: EgoSchema 500视频流式模式下（统一Qwen3-VL-8B骨干）：74.8%准确率/25.4次调用，对比均匀采样74.6%/55次、BOLT 74.2%/55次；四领域第一视角视频描述质量与最强基线持平，调用量比均匀采样少57%。

Conclusion: 通过门控调用次数与注意力引导调用内容，可在不训练、不删token的前提下大幅降低VLM视频推理开销并保持精度；反馈式注意力闭环为流式视频理解提供了可复用的效率范式。

Abstract: Processing every video frame through Vision-Language Models (VLMs) adds significant inference cost and limits their ability to comprehend real-time video. Existing approaches either sub-sample frames uniformly, ignoring content and missing important events, or prune visual tokens inside the VLM to cut per-call cost while still invoking the model on every sampled frame. We introduce FOCUS, a training-free three-layer framework that reduces the number of invocations and steers each one towards what matters. Temporal gating measures inter-frame dissimilarity in the patch-embedding space of a smaller VLM from the same family, triggering burst captures only when the scene changes in a semantically meaningful way. Patch-level dissimilarity is then accumulated across the burst and fused with a top-down attention prior into a spatial focus map that encodes where motion and semantic relevance coincide. That map calibrates the VLM's value cache during generation, progressively amplifying vision tokens in task-relevant regions and attenuating off-target ones, without removing any token from the context. The loop closes after each response: text-to-vision cross-attention is extracted from the decoder and fed back as the prior for the next burst, letting the system converge on semantically important regions over successive observations. We evaluate FOCUS on the 500-video EgoSchema subset in streaming mode, with a single Qwen3-VL-8B backbone shared by every method. It reaches 74.8% accuracy using 25.4 VLM calls per clip, against 74.6% with 55 calls for uniform sampling and 74.2% with 55 calls for BOLT. On egocentric video captioning across four domains, it matches the best baseline's quality while issuing 57% fewer VLM invocations than uniform sampling.

</details>


### [362] [Seeing What Matters, Verifying What Pays: Load-Adaptive Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01617)
*Hong Nie,Zhangchi Gao,Yuqian Liang,Jun Yu,Bo Wang,Jianqing Sun,Shengping Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Uni-LaSpec 是一种面向视觉语言模型的分块并行投机解码框架：复用验证器的注意力来挑选少量视觉 token 供草稿模型门控融合，并按显存/算力负载动态选择验证结构（树或线性+动态头截断）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 投机解码草稿器要么缺乏图像证据、要么为每个视觉 token 付出昂贵条件代价；且固定验证结构无法适应不同 GPU 负载，导致加速收益受限。

Method: 1) 复用验证器上一轮保留的 query 对缓存的 int8 量化视觉 key 排序，并用跨层投票选出少量（默认 8 个）视觉 token，经门控交叉注意力注入草稿器；2) 接受感知训练，按各草稿位置对已接受前缀的贡献加权；3) 边际成本准则按请求、按轮选择验证结构——轻载用 draft tree 利用空闲验证容量，重载用动态头截断的线性草稿。

Result: 6 个 VLM（3 个模型家族）、17 个文本与多模态基准：8 个视觉 token 保留全图至少 98.6% 的接受率，选择开销亚毫秒；贪心解码并发为 1 时文本吞吐最高 5.11×、多模态 3.24×；6 种负载×3 类 GPU 共 144 种设置中 123 种不劣于最佳固定验证策略；突发到达下平均端到端延迟较线性验证降低 47.6%。

Conclusion: Uni-LaSpec 通过验证器注意力复用 + 极稀疏视觉条件 + 负载自适应验证分配，在不改变输出分布的前提下显著提升 VLM 推理吞吐与延迟表现，具备较强工程可落地性。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language model (VLM) inference without altering the output distribution, yet two factors limit its gains. Existing drafters either lack the image evidence required for visually grounded tokens or pay to condition on every visual token, although a short draft block typically depends on only a few image regions. Moreover, the value of verifying additional candidates varies with GPU load, so no fixed verification structure is efficient across serving conditions. We present Uni-LaSpec, a block-parallel speculative decoding framework that addresses both factors. To improve draft quality, Uni-LaSpec reuses the verifier's own attention: the query retained from the preceding verification ranks the cached, int8-quantized visual keys, and a cross-layer vote selects a few visual tokens that the drafter fuses through gated cross-attention. Acceptance-aware training further weights each draft position by its contribution to the accepted prefix. To allocate verification, a marginal-cost criterion selects the structure per request and per round: draft trees exploit idle verifier capacity under light load, whereas a dynamic head truncates linear drafts under heavy load. Across six VLMs from three model families and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, selecting eight visual tokens retains at least 98.6% of the acceptance obtained from the full image at sub-millisecond selection cost. With greedy decoding at concurrency one, Uni-LaSpec achieves up to 5.11x text and 3.24x multimodal throughput over autoregressive decoding. Across six load levels and three GPU types, it outperforms autoregressive decoding in every setting and matches or exceeds the best fixed verification strategy in 123 of 144 settings; under bursty arrivals, it reduces mean end-to-end latency by 47.6% relative to linear verification.

</details>


### [363] [Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair for Safe Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01713)
*Chan Park,Sunwoo Hong,Kirak Kim,Yoonjeong Park,Alexander W. Olson,Ali Pesaranghader*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair 事后修复模块：利用 VLA 短时动作块（action chunk）预判被障碍阻断的标称轨迹，生成"进入-绕行-回归（entry-exit-rejoin）"路由引导，以软约束形式加入 CBF-QP 目标函数，同时保持 CBF 安全约束为硬约束，从而在 SafeLIBERO 上优于 AEGIS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型生成的任务导向动作不保证在障碍密集场景中安全执行；CBF-QP 安全滤波器虽可将不安全动作投影到安全集，但会产生"过度修正"，使机器人偏离学习到的任务轨迹，且缺乏可靠的回归方向，导致任务失败。因此需要一个既能保证安全、又不丢失任务可恢复性的修复机制。

Method: 后验（post-hoc）修复模块，无需重训 VLA。1）采样 VLA 输出的短时动作块，用于检测标称轨迹是否被障碍阻塞；2）在受阻时生成 entry-exit-rejoin 绕行路径（进入点、退出点、回归原标称轨迹的衔接段）；3）将选定路径作为软引导项加入 CBF-QP 目标函数，CBF 安全不等式保持硬约束，QP 求解得到兼顾安全与任务回归的控制量。

Result: 在 SafeLIBERO 仿真基准上与 AEGIS 对比，避碰率、任务成功率与 SafeSuccess 指标均有提升。摘要未报告具体数值、真机实验或推理开销。

Conclusion: 以"软路由引导 + 硬安全约束"的方式解决安全滤波导致的任务偏离问题，是一种模块化、可插拔的安全层设计思路；但证据限于仿真基准与单一基线，缺少定量结果与真实机器人验证，实际部署价值仍待确认。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can generate task-oriented robot actions, but they do not guarantee safe execution in obstacle-rich manipulation scenes. Although CBF-QP safety filters can locally project unsafe actions into a safe set, such correction may push the robot away from the learned task trajectory and leave the VLA policy without a reliable recovery direction. We propose Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair, a post-hoc repair module that uses the short-horizon action chunk predicted by the VLA to detect blocked nominal trajectories and generate entry-exit-rejoin guidance around obstacles. The selected route is added to the CBF-QP objective as a soft guidance term, while the CBF safety constraint remains hard. On SafeLIBERO, our method improves collision avoidance, task success, and SafeSuccess compared with AEGIS. Our project page is available at GitHub.

</details>


### [364] [TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01934)
*Zhongxiang Sun,Chenghao Yang,Haojie Ding,Boheng Zhang,Fan Yang,Qingsong Wen,Kun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TriPhysBench基准（200视频410题），统一评测物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理；并提出TriPhys框架，从工具集成轨迹学习统一策略，27B模型答案准确率相对提升17.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体需要物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理协同工作，但现有基准仅分别推进物理理解或通用工具使用，三者在物理场景中的协同能力缺乏系统刻画。

Method: 受Popper三世界理论启发构建TriPhysBench，含measurement-grounded与knowledge-grounded子任务，强制"获取观测—检索外部规格—定量求解"的互补流程。提出TriPhys：在完整工具集成轨迹上学习统一策略，用中间推理驱动检索与计算，再将工具反馈回灌至后续物理推断。

Result: 六个代表性VLM中最优答案准确率仅50.38%；在110道训练未见视频问题上，TriPhys在三种Qwen配置上答案与解答分数均提升，TriPhys-27B较Qwen3.6-27B主干答案准确率相对提升17.7%。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了面向"理解物理过程"而非仅识别事件的基准与学习路径，推动具身智能体从事件识别走向物理定量推理。

Abstract: Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments. Existing benchmarks advance physical understanding and general-purpose tool use, yet the coordination of these capabilities in physical scenarios remains insufficiently characterized. Inspired by Popper's Three Worlds, we introduce TriPhysBench, a benchmark of 410 questions from 200 videos that brings physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning into a shared evaluation setting. Its measurement-grounded and knowledge-grounded subtasks impose complementary demands on obtaining observations and acquiring external specifications, then applying them to quantitative problems. Among six representative vision-language models, the best achieves an answer accuracy of only 50.38%, revealing limited performance on tasks that require these capabilities to work together. We further introduce TriPhys, a framework that learns a unified policy for physical perception, knowledge retrieval, and quantitative reasoning from complete tool-integrated trajectories. The policy uses intermediate reasoning to guide retrieval and computation, then incorporates tool feedback into subsequent physical inference. On 110 questions from videos excluded from training, TriPhys improves answer and solution scores across three Qwen configurations, with a 17.7% relative gain in answer accuracy for TriPhys-27B over its Qwen3.6-27B backbone. This work provides a benchmark and a learning pathway toward embodied agents that move beyond recognizing events to understanding and reasoning about the physical processes behind them.

</details>


### [365] [Probing Local Conditional Fit for Diffusion Model Membership Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02578)
*ByungHee Cha,Naoki Murata,Yuhta Takida,Jong Chul Ye,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 LoFIT（Local Conditional Fit）：利用条件预测偏移下去噪损失的初始响应方向来判定扩散模型成员推断，仅需前向查询，四个数据集上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成员推断是审计文本到图像扩散模型训练数据使用情况的重要工具；现有基于去噪损失的基线区分力弱（尤其在微调早期接近随机水平），需要更强的信号。

Method: 观察到成员样本沿"条件预测偏移"（同一噪声输入下更换文本条件导致的预测噪声变化）方向上的局部改进空间更小；据此定义 LoFIT，度量去噪损失沿归一化预测偏移的初始导数式响应，并在多文本条件与多扩散时间步上聚合；只需对去噪器做前向查询，无需目标模型梯度。

Result: 在四个数据集上，对微调模型与预训练模型均获得更好的成员判别效果；LoFIT 在微调早期即可区分成员，而朴素去噪损失基线仍接近随机；控制实验表明判别信号集中于一阶响应，仅凭预测偏移幅度几乎无区分力。

Conclusion: 条件预测偏移的一阶响应对扩散模型成员推断具有明确方向的判别信号，且无需梯度即可高效实现，可作为数据使用审计的实用工具。

Abstract: Membership inference determines whether a candidate example was used to train a text-to-image diffusion model and is an important tool for auditing training-data use. We identify a directional membership signal in \emph{conditional prediction shifts}, the changes in predicted noise under alternative text conditions at a fixed noisy input: whether movement toward the alternative prediction initially lowers or raises the denoising loss from its value under the original caption. Members exhibit less room for such local improvement. To quantify this response, we propose \emph{LoFIT} (Local Conditional Fit), which measures the initial response of the denoising loss along normalized prediction shifts and aggregates it across multiple text conditions and diffusion states. LoFIT requires no target-model gradients and can be computed using only forward queries to the denoiser. Evaluations on four datasets show improved membership discrimination across fine-tuned and pretrained models. LoFIT distinguishes members early in fine-tuning, while the naive denoising-loss baseline remains near chance. Controlled comparisons show that the membership signal is concentrated in the first-order response, with little discrimination from prediction-shift magnitude alone.

</details>


### [366] [Parametric CAD Bench v3: Evaluating Agentic Parametric CAD Authoring from Text and Engineering Drawings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02659)
*Mei Chen,Yu Xia,Haipeng Mao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Parametric CAD Bench v3，含100个任务（30个文本→CAD、30个文本→CAD创建+编辑、40个工程图重建实体零件），在固定FreeCAD环境中由agent提交原生CAD产物，交独立程序化验证器评测；主指标为连续奖励（几何相似度+规格一致性），13个系统快照中Claude Code+Opus 5.5最高61.03%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅生成“可执行的CAD脚本”不足以证明满足了工程设计需求，还需评估最终几何、标注尺寸与原生建模历史，故需要一个同时校验几何与规格一致性的评测基准。

Method: 构建100任务基准（文本→CAD、文本→CAD创建并编辑、工程图→机械零件重建）；agent在固定版本FreeCAD环境中操作并提交原生CAD工件；由独立程序化验证器检查，主指标为融合几何相似度与规格一致性的平均连续任务奖励，而非二元成功率。

Result: 2026年9月24日快照覆盖13个模型-智能体系统；Claude Code + Claude Opus 5.5总分点估计最高，为61.03%；其图像→CAD平均奖励为84.66%。作者强调这些测量刻画的是完整系统而非单一模型能力。

Conclusion: CAD agent的评测应以几何、尺寸与建模历史一致性的连续奖励为准；该基准以版本化任务、评估配置与可检视结果工件形式公开，可作为agent驱动3D生成/重建流程的可复现评测工具。

Abstract: Producing an executable CAD script is not sufficient to establish that an agent has satisfied an engineering design request. Evaluation must also consider the resulting geometry, specified dimensions, and native CAD modeling history. We present Parametric CAD Bench v3, a 100-task benchmark comprising 30 text-to-CAD creation tasks, 30 text-to-CAD create-and-edit tasks, and 40 tasks that reconstruct mechanical parts from engineering drawings. Agents operate in a pinned FreeCAD environment and submit native CAD artifacts to a separate programmatic verifier. The primary metric is mean continuous task reward, combining geometry similarity and specification consistency rather than binary task success. A September 24, 2026 snapshot covers 13 model-agent systems; Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest overall point estimate, 61.03%, and an image-to-CAD mean reward of 84.66%. These measurements describe complete systems, not isolated model capabilities. We release versioned tasks, evaluation configurations, and inspectable result artifacts.

</details>


### [367] [Human-Oriented World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02690)
*Saihui Hou,Zengyun Mou,Chunshui Cao,Yongzhen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"人本世界模型"(HOWM)概念框架:以任务相关人类状态及其演化为核心,融合观测、个体历史与社会/环境上下文,实现持续状态估计、个性化动态预测与行动支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期陪伴、辅助或人机协作场景中,需要在重复交互里理解人的当前状态并预判其演化,现有世界模型缺乏对"人"这一核心状态变量的建模与个性化处理。

Method: 概念性框架:由当前观测+个体历史+环境/社会上下文构成状态估计闭环;动态期望与新观测共同更新当前状态;基于共享知识与个体经验做个性化预测;外部策略将不同条件下的预测与人目标/偏好/约束关联以生成支持;实际响应与结果作为证据回写状态估计与个人动态模式。

Result: 无实验与定量结果,仅通过假设性的训练与学习场景进行框架示例说明;提出两条研究议程:交互经验累积是否提升后续估计与预测,以及使用该模型是否帮助个体长期达成目标。

Conclusion: 提出以人为中心的世界模型研究议程,将状态估计、个性化预测、行动支持与经验回写整合为统一框架,但尚属概念阶段,缺乏形式化定义、基准与实证验证。

Abstract: Supporting a person over repeated interactions requires interpreting their current state in context and anticipating its subsequent evolution. We formulate the \emph{Human-Oriented World Model} (HOWM) as a conceptual framework centered on task-relevant human states and their evolution. HOWM connects current observations and individual history with environmental and social context to organize continuing state estimation, personalized dynamics prediction, and action support. Dynamic expectations and new observations jointly inform the current estimate, which in turn anchors personalized forecasts based on shared knowledge and individual experience. An external policy relates forecasts under alternative conditions to the person's goals, preferences, and constraints when considering support. Actual responses and outcomes provide evidence for revising the state estimate and personal dynamic patterns, thereby informing subsequent estimation, prediction, and support. We illustrate the framework through hypothetical training and learning scenarios. Our research agenda asks whether accumulated interaction experience improves subsequent estimation and prediction, and whether using the model helps the person pursue their goals over time.

</details>


### [368] [Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03377)
*Ahmad Jarjis Hasan,Jonathan Lwowski*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统复现8个多模态LLM多选题基准的官方评分器，在5个可单卡（16GB）运行的VLM上揭示：评分规则本身可使同一输出的准确率变动高达22个点，且非合规回答（而非"啰嗦"）是误差来源；主张基准应报告非合规率并至少采用两种评分规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态多选题基准的最终分数由一段藏在代码中、未经论证的评分规则决定（如何把自由文本回答转成对/错），该规则直接影响发表数字却从未被审视；作者希望量化评分规则的敏感性并检验其可靠性。

Method: 复现8个同行评审基准的官方评分器；在5个开源VLM上测试（均可在16GB GPU上运行）；引入盲测的人工+LLM裁判联合裁定（Cohen's kappa=0.956）以还原模型真实回答；对比多种评分规则（最近选项吸附、弃答、似然评分、不同正则匹配）对准确率的影响，并统计非合规率。

Result: 同一输出下评分规则可造成最高22点准确率差异；若模型输出规范选项字母则差异恰为0，因此在强模型榜单上该问题被掩盖。非合规率最高的基准其伪影恰为0（因其评分器选择弃答而非猜测）；非合规率为0.000的推理模型仍可因解析器保留trace中哪个正则匹配而波动9.5点。最近选项吸附会给出模型从未给出的答案同时埋没正确表述；弃答会丢弃已被文字陈述的答案；似然评分受答案token先验影响。单一评分混杂了能力与运气。

Conclusion: 没有标准评分规则是可靠的；基准应报告非合规率并至少给出两种规则下的结果，而非单一未经审查的分数。作者开源全部代码、标注与协议。

Abstract: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model's response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen's kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. We release all code, labels, and the protocol, and argue benchmarks should report a non-compliance rate and at least two rules, not one unexamined grade.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [369] [MirrorComm: A Communication-Efficient Cooperative Perception Framework via Mirrored World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02405)
*Shenghan Luo,Yin Xu,Cixiao Zhang,Yang Wang,Yujie Cao,Zhuoran Xiao,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: MirrorComm: 首个基于世界模型的通信高效协同感知框架，利用收发端镜像世界模型预测当前观测，仅传输修正预测误差的更新，在OPV2V上带宽最高降低约66倍且性能可比SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协同感知压缩方法多为逐帧范式，忽视时间可预测性，反复传输可由历史上下文推断的信息，造成带宽浪费。

Method: 发射端与接收端共享同一历史重构观测，各自运行镜像世界模型预测发射端当前观测；发射端将预测与真实当前观测比较，仅选择性地传输用于校正预测误差的观测更新。

Result: 在OPV2V数据集的目标检测与语义分割两项下游任务上，带宽需求最高降低约66倍，同时保持与SOTA方法相当的性能；消融实验验证各组件有效性。

Conclusion: 时间维度的预测性冗余是协同感知通信压缩的重要未被挖掘维度，世界模型驱动的残差式传输可显著降低带宽而不损任务性能。

Abstract: Cooperative perception (CP) requires substantial communication bandwidth to exchange sensing information among connected agents. A variety of compression techniques have been proposed to reduce transmission costs while retaining task-relevant information. However, most existing methods follow a frame-wise compression paradigm, overlooking temporal predictability and repeatedly transmitting information that could be inferred from historical context. To address these limitations, we propose MirrorComm, the first world model-based communication-efficient CP framework. Specifically, mirrored world models at the transmitter and receiver predict the transmitter's current observation from a shared history of its reconstructed observations. The transmitter compares this prediction with its current observation and selectively transmits observation updates to correct prediction errors, reducing repeated transmission of predictable information. Experiments on the OPV2V dataset across two downstream tasks including object detection and semantic segmentation show that MirrorComm reduces communication bandwidth requirements by up to approximately 66-fold while maintaining comparable performance to a state-of-the-art (SOTA) method. Ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of the individual components.

</details>


<div id='cs.PF'></div>

# cs.PF [[Back]](#toc)

### [370] [DIMWIT: Directly Invoking Models Without Intensive Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01463)
*Saarth Deshpande,Neeraja J. Yadwadkar,Venkat Arun*

Main category: cs.PF

TL;DR: 提出"跳过策略开发"，直接让预训练模型（1个前沿LLM+2个小决策模型）根据当前系统状态、目标结果和可选动作做资源管理决策；在微服务自动扩缩容、DRAM容量配置、视频编码三类任务上验证，小模型可接近/超过策略式基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统资源管理需要为每个任务单独开发策略（启发式、优化器或专用模型），开发成本高，且随负载或系统变化需反复修订；若模型能直接依据状态与候选动作做决策，则可免去策略开发。

Method: 将资源管理形式化为"给定系统状态+期望结果+可用动作"的条件决策问题，直接由预训练模型输出决策，无需任务专用策略；在微服务autoscaling、DRAM sizing、视频编码三个场景中用前沿LLM与两个小决策模型对比策略式自动扩缩容器。

Result: 两个微服务应用中，小决策模型在满足延迟目标下，副本数在策略式autoscaler的10%以内、在前沿LLM的13%以内；DRAM sizing中较静态配置降低最多27.5%用量，同时保持≥95%基线性能；视频编码中比前沿LLM快至4.3×，VMAF仅下降1.1点（不可感知）。

Conclusion: 做单个资源管理决策可能远比开发通用决策策略简单；预训练模型可直接充当资源管理决策器，无需任务专用策略开发。

Abstract: Resource managers typically encode what to do in a task-specific policy---a heuristic, an optimization procedure, or a model trained for the task---that must be developed before use and may need revision as the workload or system changes. We propose bypassing policy development and instead asking pretrained models to make resource-management decisions directly, given the current system state, desired outcome, and available choices. We evaluate this approach on microservice autoscaling, DRAM sizing, and video encoding, using a frontier LLM and two small decision models. On two microservice applications, a small decision model meets latency targets while using within 10% of the replicas allocated by policy-based autoscalers and within 13% of the frontier LLM. In DRAM sizing, a small decision model reduces DRAM usage by up to 27.5% relative to static provisioning while maintaining at least 95% of baseline performance. In video encoding, it completes encodes up to 4.3$\times$ faster than the frontier LLM, with an imperceptible 1.1-point decrease in Video Multi-Method Assessment Fusion (VMAF), a metric of perceptual video quality. Making individual resource-management decisions may be considerably simpler than developing a general strategy for making them.

</details>

### [371] [Modeling Visual Cortex with Layerwise Multiscale Manifold Capacity Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02245)
*Thomas Yerxa,SueYeon Chung,Eero P. Simoncelli*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 提出以流形容量（manifold capacity）表述的高效编码中间损失，使层级网络可用局部学习信号训练，并在腹侧视流通路三个脑区预测与人类心理物理任务上达到或超过对照基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务优化深度网络虽为灵长类视觉皮层响应的最佳预测模型，但依赖全局反向传播的精确信用分配，生物学合理性不足；已有工作通过让各阶段完成递进复杂任务来实现逐层局部学习，但缺少设计中间损失的 principled 方法。

Method: 在高效编码框架下，用流形容量刻画中间表征的可分性并据此构造逐层无监督损失；利用视觉信号多尺度特性与级联表征中感受野尺寸逐层扩张之间的对应关系来调制任务复杂度，使同一组"典型皮层计算"式损失可在各层级重复使用，从而免去全局反向传播。

Result: 在猕猴腹侧视流三个脑区的神经数据集以及人类物体分类心理物理数据上，该无监督逐层模型在所有评估中达到或超过架构匹配的竞争基线。

Conclusion: 以流形容量为中间目标的逐层局部学习是一种生物学上更合理、同时保持甚至提升神经与行为预测力的视觉层级建模方案。

Abstract: Task-optimized deep neural networks have risen to prominence as the most predictive phenomenological models of responses in primate visual cortex, but leave much to be desired from the perspective of biological plausibility. One such limitation is the reliance on precise credit assignment through global backpropagation of error signals. Recent work has shown that this weakness can be circumvented by requiring each subsequent stage to solve a distinct and increasingly complex task, allowing for layerwise local learning signals. We propose a novel strategy for crafting such intermediate losses that uses an efficient coding framework formulated in terms of manifold capacity, and which can be computed using a sequence of {canonical cortical computations}. In particular, we leverage the relationship between the multiscale nature of visual signals and the dilation of receptive field sizes in cascaded visual representations to modulate complexity, allowing for the reapplication of these common loss computations at each stage of the hierarchy. We evaluate our approach on its ability to predict neural datasets spanning three areas of the ventral stream hierarchy in macaques, as well as human psychophysical data on an object classification task. We find that our unsupervised layerwise model matches or exceeds the performance of competitive architecture-matched baselines on all evaluations considered.

</details>


<div id='physics.ao-ph'></div>

# physics.ao-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [372] [SATFRONT: Detecting Atmospheric Fronts with Satellite Data using Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.42111)
*Ioannis Dravilas,Miruna Stoicescu,Roope Tervo,Carlos Horn,Oriol Hinojo Comellas,Sina Montazeri,Andrea Meraner,Ana Lucic*

Main category: physics.ao-ph

TL;DR: SATFRONT：仅用静止气象卫星观测（可选加ERA5）检测欧洲冷锋、暖锋、锢囚锋的机器学习框架，纯卫星输入CSI=0.428（150 km），加ERA5升至0.591，显著优于业务规则法（0.133）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中纬度高影响天气多与锋面相关，但锋面识别与分类长期依赖人工、主观性强；现有深度学习方法主要依赖格点再分析/预报数据，难以用于对时效性要求高的卫星观测场景。

Method: 构建SATFRONT框架，以静止卫星观测为主输入、再分析为可选辅助输入，预测冷/暖/锢囚锋；训练标签来自五个欧洲国家气象机构的锋面分析，以英国气象局2024年分析为评测基准，采用150 km容差的CSI指标，并与业务化规则型峰面检测器对比。

Result: 纯卫星CSI 0.428，落在不同机构分析一致区间（0.277–0.501）内，高于规则法（0.133）；加ERA5后CSI达0.591，ERA5主要改善单条锋面的位置精度，对年度空间分布的影响因锋面类型而异。

Conclusion: 冷、暖、锢囚锋可直接从静止卫星观测中检测，为高时间频次的自动化锋面分析提供基础，可支撑时效敏感应用。

Abstract: Atmospheric fronts are associated with much of the high-impact weather in the mid-latitudes, yet their identification and classification remain largely manual and subjective. Existing deep learning approaches rely primarily on gridded reanalysis or forecast data, limiting their applicability to satellite observations available for time-critical applications. We introduce SATFRONT, a machine learning framework for detecting cold, warm, and occluded fronts over Europe from geostationary satellite observations, with reanalysis data as an optional additional input. The model is trained on frontal analyses from five European national meteorological services and evaluated against UK Met Office analyses for 2024. Using satellite observations alone, SATFRONT achieves a Critical Success Index (CSI) of 0.428 at a 150 km tolerance, within the range of agreement between analyses from different meteorological services (0.277-0.501) and higher than that of an operational rule-based front detector that uses satellite data (0.133). Adding ERA5 reanalysis increases the CSI to 0.591. ERA5 substantially improves the placement of individual fronts, although its effect on their annual spatial distribution varies by front type. These results demonstrate that cold, warm, and occluded fronts can be detected directly from geostationary satellite observations, providing a basis for automated frontal analyses at the high temporal frequency required for time-critical applications.

</details>


### [373] [Tropical Cyclone Wind Field Diagnosis with Image-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00038)
*Sarah J. Ollier,David S. Nolan,Brian D. McNoldy,Eduardo Siman*

Main category: physics.ao-ph

TL;DR: 该研究用条件化的image-to-image GAN，将单帧红外亮温转换为热带气旋完整海面风场（覆盖6°×6°或7°×7°、256×256），以WRF模拟和GOES真实卫星两套配对数据分别训练WRF2WRF与GOES2PARA模型，可诊断四象限R64/R50/R34及RMW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热带气旋海面风场观测稀少（主要依赖散射计、SAR等稀疏观测），而红外卫星图像高频可得，因此希望借助生成式方法从单一红外帧实时反演完整风场，弥补传统风速算法的低频更新问题。

Method: 采用pix2pix式图像到图像GAN，以风暴强度、移动速度和纬度作为条件输入，输入单通道红外亮温、输出风场。训练集包括WRF模拟生成的3,323对IR-风场（WRF2WRF）和11,886张真实GOES图像配IBTrACS参数化风场（GOES2PARA）。

Result: 像素级RMSE均值6.4 kt（GOES2PARA）、7.2 kt（WRF2WRF）；相对IBTrACS，RMW的MAE分别为10.0 NM与14.8 NM，R34均为25.9 NM；与SAR风场比较，GOES2PARA（RMSE 12.1 kt，MAE 9.5 kt）优于WRF2WRF（13.9 kt/11.3 kt）。

Conclusion: image-to-image GAN可作为每帧卫星图像即更新的风场诊断工具，兼顾外核风场非对称性与精细化雨带/眼墙结构；但评估主要在合成或参数化真值以及有限的SAR个例上进行，真实全风场泛化仍需更多独立观测验证。

Abstract: This study presents a novel application of image-to-image generative adversarial networks (GANs) to produce a complete tropical cyclone (TC) surface wind field diagnosis from a single frame of satellite infrared brightness temperature (IR). Because TC surface wind fields are infrequently observed, we train on two data sets. The first contains 3,323 image pairs of IR and wind fields from Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) simulations (WRF2WRF). The second contains 11,886 real IR satellite images paired with parametric wind fields built on the extended best-track data set (IBTrACS) of TC intensities and wind radii (GOES2PARA). Both models, conditioned on storm intensity, motion, and latitude, transform single-channel IR into wind fields over 6$^{\circ} \times$ 6$^{\circ}$ (WRF2WRF) and 7$^{\circ} \times$ 7$^{\circ}$ (GOES2PARA) domains, at 256 $\times$ 256 pixel resolution. GOES2PARA captures outer wind field asymmetries, enabling diagnosis of 64, 50, and 34-knot wind radii (R64, R50, R34) in each quadrant. WRF2WRF also produces detailed rainbands and eyewall asymmetries. Pixel-wise RMSE against held out truth demonstrates realistic wind field generation with mean RMSE of 6.4 knots (GOES2PARA) and 7.2 knots (WRF2WRF). Compared against IBTrACS, WRF2WRF achieved mean absolute errors (MAE) of 14.8 nautical miles (NM) for radius of maximum wind (RMW) and 25.9 NM for R34. GOES2PARA achieved 10.0 NM MAE for RMW and 25.9 NM for R34. Against Synthetic Aperture Radar wind fields GOES2PARA yielded a lower mean pixel-wise error (RMSE 12.1 kt, MAE 9.5 kt) than WRF2WRF (RMSE 13.9 kt, MAE 11.3 kt). Unlike many existing operational surface wind speed algorithms, our image-to-image models provide updated wind fields with every new satellite image.

</details>
