Method: 改造并增强一种分散式可达性（reachability）避碰验证方法，适配尺寸-重量-功耗（SWaP）受限的多旋翼UAV集群；在室外环境进行迭代式实飞实验，采集验证性能、资源占用与时间开销数据，并结合开源 safety_checker 库持续调优。

Result: 共完成140次室外飞行（含6次8机集群飞行）；方法能高效地实时验证多机安全并引导各智能体采取安全动作避免碰撞；单机验证未来4秒安全耗时约500-520ms，其中可达集广播时间（约300-500ms）为主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 分散式运行时验证可在真实SWaP受限UAV集群上实时运行，但性能受通信广播主导；算法假设与实现细节的一致性决定了真实世界有效性，本文为真实CPS集群部署提供实践指导。

Abstract: In this paper we present the methodologies, results, and analysis used to deploy a decentralized safety verification algorithm on a robotic swarm to prevent collisions at runtime in an outdoor environment. Typically, approaches toward verification of swarms of cyber-physical systems (CPS) are evaluated solely in numerical simulations or in highly controlled, noiseless indoor environments. Our efforts to implement collision avoidance on a real swarm system outdoors have revealed that the underlying algorithmic assumptions juxtaposed against the implementation details of the target system are critical factors in a method's efficacy in the real world. Here we modify, enhance, and analyze a decentralized reachability-based method for collision avoidance on a size, weight, and power-constrained uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm with the objective of illustrating the challenges of real-world CPS deployments as well as provide guidance for researchers in this space. Verification performance, resource utilization, and timing data were gathered over the course of 140 total outdoor vehicle flights, including 6 swarm flights composed of 8 UAVs, and used to improve collision-avoidance performance as experimentation progressed. Our extensive experiments show that the proposed decentralized runtime verification approach can efficiently verify the safety of multiple UAVs in real-time and help all agents take safe actions to avoid collisions. On average, each agent, using our open-source safety_checker library, takes approximately 500-520 ms to verify its safety for the next 4 s into the future, in which the reachable set broadcast time dominates the total verification time (~300-500 ms).

</details>


### [411] [Auriga Technical Report: A Task-Agnostic Agent Harness for Zero-Shot Embodied Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01112)
*Chengcheng Wang,Yuheng Shi,Siyu Xu,Yutong Wang,Jinjing Zhao,Chenghao Xia,Jinqi Liao,Jiankun Peng,Ligong Bi,Yuechuan Ma,Jiaqi Liu,Wenbo Wang,Zijian Wang,Yuemin Wu,Minjing Dong,Xiu Su,Tao Huang,Jianyuan Guo,Chengbin Du,Yunke Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Auriga：任务无关的 agent harness，通过显式任务信念、校准3D测量、指参照双臂控制、轨迹预览与阶段容差校验的准入网关，将模型的任务决策与物理执行解耦，零样本缩小68.3%规划-执行差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM具备指令理解与任务规划能力，但直接作为机器人策略时存在显著的“规划-执行差距”（RoboDojo上去掉执行环节成功率从22.5%升至76.2%），说明瓶颈在执行接口与误差反馈而非高层决策。

Method: 提出Auriga：任务无关的harness，模型在显式任务信念上做决策，通过直接工具调用或合成多步Python程序执行；harness提供校准3D测量、指参照双臂控制与单一机器人准入网关；运动前暂停仿真并检查轨迹可视化预览，执行中校验声明阶段容差与抓取边界，偏离即停机并回传实测偏差用于原地恢复；经13轮跨任务能力迭代后冻结。

Result: RoboDojo排行榜第一，成功率57.7%（Score 64.0），同一模型下较参考harness翻倍以上；场景随机化下仍第一，而学习型策略最多下降33.9%。RoboCasa365上冻结harness达73.2%成功率，复合任务上超VLA辅助agent最多23.1%。零样本无目标任务试错或重置。

Conclusion: 以harness而非模型改造的方式系统性弥合规划-执行差距，验证了“解耦决策与物理执行+结构化误差反馈+可验证准入”是提升通用VLM机器人操作可靠性的有效路径，且冻结后仍具跨基准泛化性。

Abstract: Vision-language models can interpret instructions and plan manipulation tasks, yet struggle when acting directly as robot policies. On RoboDojo, a large planning-execution gap separates high-level task decisions from physical execution: removing arm execution raises GPT-6 Astra's success rate from 22.5% under the reference control interface to 76.2%. We present Auriga, a task-agnostic agent harness that closes 68.3% of this gap in zero-shot manipulation without target-task trials or resets. In Auriga, the model makes all task decisions over an explicit task belief and acts through either direct tool calls or synthesized multi-step Python programs, while the harness supplies calibrated 3D measurements, finger-referenced dual-arm control, and a single admission gateway to the robot. Before motion, the model inspects a visual trajectory preview while simulation is paused; during execution, the harness checks declared stage tolerances and grasp bounds, stopping the robot on divergence and returning the measured discrepancy for in-place recovery. Developed across 13 cross-task capability iterations and frozen for evaluation, Auriga ranks first on the RoboDojo leaderboard with a 57.7% success rate (64.0 Score), more than doubling the reference harness on the same model, and remains first under scene randomization while learned policies drop by up to 33.9%. On RoboCasa365, the same frozen harness reaches a 73.2% success rate, outperforming VLA-assisted agents by up to 23.1% on composite tasks. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL

</details>


### [412] [ClothDojo: Learned Data Generation and Benchmarking for Bimanual Garment Flattening and Folding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01190)
*Zilong Huang,Zipeng Ye,Caicheng Wang,Yuchen Xie,Jiaxiang Luo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ClothDojo：用 NOCS 纹理把服装规范网格坐标编码进视觉输入，微调 VLA 模型自动生成大规模衣物展平/折叠轨迹数据集，再重渲染为 RGB，用于训练下游策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 布料展平与折叠需要机器人在操作过程中感知衣物结构并随形变调整动作；真实人类演示与纠正数据稀缺，难以覆盖多样衣物与初始状态，缺乏可闭环评估的大规模仿真数据生成手段。

Method: ClothDojo 仿真平台：1）将每件衣物的规范网格坐标编码为 NOCS 纹理，使预训练 VLA 模型通过视觉接口获得规范表面位置线索；2）用人类演示+纠正微调得到数据生成策略；3）策略自主生成仿真操作轨迹，按任务特定成功判据筛选保留成功轨迹；4）每条保留轨迹随机采样外观重渲染，输出不含 NOCS 的 RGB 观测供下游策略使用；最后在闭环中评估策略。

Result: 两项任务共在数百件衣物上生成近 8,000 条成功轨迹；基于生成轨迹训练的 RGB 策略在所有衣物划分与外观设置下均优于直接用原始人类演示与纠正训练的策略。多策略模型评估显示整体性能与外观鲁棒性随模型和任务变化，对未见衣物的泛化仍是共同难点。

Conclusion: 以规范坐标纹理作为 VLA 的“特权感知”进行可扩展轨迹生成，是低成本获取可变形物体操作数据的有效方案；但跨衣物泛化与外观鲁棒性尚未解决，仅限仿真验证、无真机结果。

Abstract: Garment flattening and folding require robots to identify garment structure during manipulation and adapt their actions as the cloth deforms. We present ClothDojo, a simulation platform that generates adaptive manipulation trajectories at scale across diverse garments and initial states and evaluates policies in closed loop. ClothDojo encodes each garment's canonical mesh coordinates as an NOCS texture, providing canonical surface-position cues through the visual interface of a pretrained vision-language-action model. We fine-tune the model on human demonstrations and corrections to obtain a data-generation policy. The policy autonomously generates simulated manipulation trajectories, and we retain rollouts that satisfy task-specific success criteria. Each retained trajectory is re-rendered under a randomly sampled appearance to provide RGB observations for downstream policies that do not receive NOCS. Across both tasks, the policy produces nearly 8,000 successful trajectories over hundreds of garments. RGB policies trained on these generated trajectories outperform those trained directly on the original human demonstrations and corrections across all evaluated garment splits and appearance settings. Evaluations across multiple policy models show that overall performance and appearance robustness vary across models and tasks, while generalization to unseen garments remains a common challenge.

</details>


### [413] [Learning Agile Humanoid Dodgeball with Onboard Monocular Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01197)
*Feng Tian,Yulin An,Chenhao Li,Matthias Heyrman,Marco Hutter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 人形机器人整机系统:单目视觉检测+时序球状态/威胁标志估计+学习式全身控制,在仿真与Unitree G1实体上完成闪避—恢复—再搜索的闭环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人在共享动态环境中需在保持平衡的同时对快速接近物体做出反应。作者以"躲避球"作为受控测试平台,将视觉威胁评估与全身闪避、恢复、目标再捕获耦合起来,检验机载单目感知在高度动态运动下的可行性。

Method: 系统由三部分组成:(1)球检测器输出包围框历史;(2)时序估计器预测相对球位置与二值威胁标志;(3)学习式全身控制,分为dodge/recovery与search/track两套策略,共享估计器接口并按序组合以支持重复遭遇。训练采用三阶段课程:先用特权球状态训练控制;再从稳定策略rollout中启动估计器监督;最后用估计器输出替换actor的特权输入。通过解析投影与感知随机化生成类检测器观测,避免图像渲染。

Result: 仿真中按接近角分箱、每速度—距离条件1000次投掷:5.0 m、6 m/s时闪避成功率97.8–100.0%;2.5 m、10 m/s时33.2–40.8%。实体Unitree G1上多次单投测试(>15次)成功率超过85%;硬件序列演示了全方位目标再捕获后再次成功闪避。

Conclusion: 结果展示了机载单目视觉在高度动态运动下的集成闭环能力;但当前工作为单一感知—控制任务,未涉及操纵、接触恢复或三维重建,与VLA/世界模型/3D重建等核心方向关联有限,主要价值在于人形全身动态控制的sim-to-real范式。

Abstract: Humanoid robots operating in shared, dynamic environments must respond to rapidly approaching objects while maintaining balance. We study dodgeball as a controlled test of this capability, coupling visual threat assessment with whole-body evasion, recovery, and target reacquisition. We develop a system that integrates onboard monocular perception, temporal ball-state and threat-flag estimation, and learned whole-body control. A ball detector supplies bounding-box histories, and a temporal estimator predicts relative ball position and a binary threat flag. Separate dodge/recovery and search/track policies share this interface and are composed to support repeated encounters. A three-stage curriculum first trains control with privileged ball states, then starts estimator supervision from stable policy rollouts, and finally replaces the actor's privileged inputs with estimator outputs. Analytic projection and perception randomization provide detector-like training observations without image rendering. Across approach-angle bins in controlled simulation, dodge success ranges from 97.8--100.0% for 5.0 m launches at 6 m/s to 33.2--40.8% for 2.5 m launches at 10 m/s, with 1000 throws per speed--distance condition. On a physical Unitree G1, controlled single-throw success exceeds 85% over more than 15 trials. A hardware sequence demonstrates full-azimuth target reacquisition followed by another dodge. These results demonstrate an integrated onboard-monocular-vision system under highly dynamic motions.

</details>


### [414] [Vision-Language Models Are Joint Denoisers in Robotic Action Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01215)
*Xicheng Gong,Wenxuan Song,Chengze Liu,Qiwei Li,Qize Yu,Jiaolong Yang,Haoang Li,Yadong Mu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: JADE提出联合动作去噪器，让预训练VLM在每一步去噪中读取含噪动作潜变量，通过门控交叉注意力动态引导动作专家，并监督VLM从噪声恢复干净动作潜变量，实现感知-控制耦合与少步采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散式VLA（如π0.5）把VLM限制为静态条件编码器，预训练感知与推理无法随生成过程引导动作，OOD场景泛化受限；同时需降低VLM参与带来的推理开销。

Method: 构建结构化动作潜变量，使VLM在每步去噪中同时接收视觉、语言与当前含噪动作；通过门控交叉注意力向动作专家传递随动作演化的引导；增加VLM从含噪潜变量重建干净动作的辅助监督；联合去噪减少采样步数，并引入自适应步长调度平衡性能与延迟。基于π0.5实现。

Result: RoboDojo平均成功率12.67%，为评测的π0.5类方法中最高，与大规模预训练的VLA/WAM基础模型具竞争力；RoboTwin 2.0提升；四个真实双臂任务平均成功率较π0.5提升20.8个百分点。

Conclusion: 将VLM从静态条件器转为联合去噪参与者可有效提升动作生成质量与泛化，并通过少步采样与自适应调度缓解额外推理成本。

Abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models cascade pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion action experts, but typically restrict the VLM to providing static conditioning. This separation limits how much pretrained perception and reasoning can guide action generation, especially in out-of-distribution settings. We introduce JADE, a Joint Action DEnoiser that enables the VLM and action expert to jointly refine actions. Our key insight is that structured action latents allow the VLM to read the current noisy action together with visual observations and language instructions. At every denoising step, the VLM contextualizes the noisy action and guides the action expert through gated cross-attention, so that its guidance evolves with the action being generated. We further supervise the VLM to recover clean action latents from noisy ones, which gives it a direct action-learning signal and couples perception with control. Additionally, joint denoising enables JADE to generate actions with fewer sampling steps, helping offset the additional cost of VLM participation. An adaptive step-size schedule further balances task performance and inference latency. On RoboDojo, JADE achieves an average success rate of 12.67%, the highest among the evaluated $\pi_{0.5}$-based methods, and is competitive with recent VLA and WAM foundation models pretrained at scale. It also improves performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and raises the average success rate across four real-world bimanual tasks by 20.8 percentage points compared with $\pi_{0.5}$.

</details>


### [415] [Differentiable Iterative Learning Control for Black-Box Position-Commanded Manipulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01220)
*Mohammed Al-Ghaili,Yakoop Qasim,Hassan Almubarak*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Diff-ILC：通过隐式微分局部KKT系统求超梯度，在真实执行间在线更新约束ILC的超参数，两轮试验即将关节与笛卡尔RMSE较固定参数model-based ILC降低约78.8%/76.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 位置指令型机械臂的底层控制器不可访问，高精度重复跟踪困难；而基于模型的约束迭代学习控制（ILC）需要大量手动调参，难以泛化到未见轨迹。

Method: 在线bilevel框架：先用成对的平滑扰动一次性辨识闭环微分模型并固定；每次试验用约束二次规划求可行指令修正，并以真实锚定的下轮预测构造任务级目标；对局部激活的KKT系统做隐式微分得到超梯度，从而在不额外执行机器人的情况下进行多次计算型参数更新。

Result: 在6-DoF DOBOT CR3上对未见平面与三维轨迹测试，物理试验收敛显著快于固定参数model-based ILC；四条主轨迹在两轮trial-to-trial更新后平均关节向量与笛卡尔RMSE分别降低78.8%与76.4%。

Conclusion: 将可微优化与ILC结合、自动调节约束ILC参数，能大幅减少人工调参与真实试验次数，是面向商用位置控制机械臂实现高精度重复跟踪的实用方案。

Abstract: High-accuracy repetitive tracking is challenging for position-commanded manipulators whose low-level controllers are inaccessible, while constrained model-based iterative learning control (ILC) can require substantial manual parameter tuning. We present Differentiable Iterative Learning Control (Diff-ILC), an online bilevel framework that adapts the parameters of a constrained ILC update between physical robot executions. A closed-loop differential model is identified once from paired smooth perturbations and subsequently kept fixed. At each trial, a constrained quadratic program computes a feasible command correction, while a real-anchored next-trial prediction defines a task-level objective. Hypergradients are obtained by implicitly differentiating the locally active KKT system, enabling multiple computational parameter updates without additional robot executions. Experiments on a 6-DoF DOBOT CR3 across unseen planar and three-dimensional trajectories show substantially faster physical-trial convergence than fixed-parameter model-based ILC. Across the four primary trajectories, after only two trial-to-trial updates, Diff-ILC achieves 78.8% and 76.4% lower mean joint-vector and Cartesian RMSE, respectively, than fixed-parameter model-based ILC.

</details>


### [416] [Shades of Success: Evaluating Manipulation Quality from Object-Centric Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01250)
*Lorena Maria Genua,Sarvesh Prajapati,Ananya Trivedi,Taskin Padir*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SPECTRA：用少量仿真专家演示学习"进度对齐相对位姿"上的约束方向与容许偏差，构建任务参考，并对新执行打分得到[0,1]的Task Quality Index（Q），用于区分成功但几何精度不同的执行质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值成功标签无法区分成功执行之间的几何精度差异，缺少对操作执行质量的细粒度、可解释量化指标。

Method: 以物体为中心，将交互表示为进度对齐的相对位姿序列；从约30条仿真oracle演示中识别哪些相对位姿方向受约束及其容许变化范围，形成任务参考；对未见执行，超出容许范围的偏差被汇总为Task Quality Index Q∈[0,1]。

Result: 在7个仿真任务上以每任务30条演示恢复约束的准确率达94%；在三个学习策略的rollout上，与人类评分池化Spearman相关为全部rollout p=0.81、仅成功rollout p=0.61，优于全部基线；用其筛选最高分演示训练硬件扩散策略，探索性结果显示成功率高于随机选择演示。

Conclusion: 相对位姿约束可作为可迁移的任务质量参考，既做细粒度评估，也可反哺数据筛选与策略训练。

Abstract: As learned manipulation policies become increasingly capable of solving practical manipulation tasks, assessing how well a task is performed becomes a fundamental challenge. While binary labels confirm task success, they cannot distinguish successful executions with different levels of geometric precision. To address this, we introduce SPECTRA, an object-centric framework for quantifying execution quality in manipulation of rigid objects. From a small set of oracle demonstrations generated in simulation, SPECTRA represents object interactions through progress-aligned relative poses. SPECTRA identifies which relative-pose directions are constrained and their admissible variations from demonstrations. These constraints establish a reference for evaluating robotic manipulation tasks. To score an unseen execution, deviations beyond the admissible variation are summarized by a Task Quality Index Q in [0,1]. Across seven simulated tasks, SPECTRA recovers constraints with 94% accuracy using 30 demonstrations per task. On rollouts from three learned policies, its scores achieve pooled Spearman correlations with human judgments of p=0.81 over all rollouts and p=0.61 among successful rollouts, exceeding all baselines in both subsets. Using the task reference learned in simulation, we use SPECTRA to select the highest-scoring demonstrations for training a diffusion policy on hardware. Exploratory results show higher success rate than training on randomly selected demonstrations.

</details>


### [417] [Programmable Droplets as Active Matter in a Reconfigurable Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01277)
*Ivan Shmarov,Abhishek Sharma,Michael Jirasek,Kristine Laws,Leroy Cronin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出自主闭环机器人平台，实时表征并用迭代筛选配方方式编程多组分油水液滴的自主动力学；引入"持续性"（速度-形状复杂度空间中的持久性域）与"多样性"（自发/扰动诱导的运动变异与重定向倾向）两个描述符，并揭示二者存在行为权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连接非生命与生命物质的合成系统需要可重构环境与具备自主动运动、自适应行为、持久动力学的合成体；自驱动液滴是研究类生命行为的最小平台，但缺乏可同时刻画持续性与适应性、进而支持闭环重配置的定量指标。

Method: 构建闭环机器人平台：实时成像分析液滴行为→迭代选择化学配方；探索含/不含外部pH扰动的两个组成空间。定义持续性（在速度—形状复杂度空间中映射时序动力学，划出区分活性/非活性液滴的持续性域）与多样性（捕捉自发或环境诱导的运动变异及扰动下重定向/适应倾向）两个定量描述符。

Result: 持续性域可有效区分活性与非活性液滴；持续性与多样性受行为权衡约束——高持续性限制多样性，高多样性削弱持久活性；闭环实验揭示了这一组织原则。

Conclusion: 为主动液滴的类生命行为提供了可导航、可编程的定量框架，并表明闭环实验方法能够发现复杂活性物质中的组织规律。

Abstract: Exploring systems that bridge the gap between non living and living matter requires a reconfigurable environment coupled to synthetic systems capable of autonomous motion, adaptive behaviour and persistent dynamics. Self propelled droplets provide a minimal platform for such life like behaviour, but quantitative measures capturing both persistence and adaptability to enable closed loop reconfiguration remain lacking. Here we introduce an autonomous closed loop robotic platform to characterise and dynamically program the autonomous behaviour of multicomponent oil in water droplets. We explored two chemical composition spaces, with and without external pH perturbations, analysing droplet behaviour in real time and iteratively selecting formulations. To quantify this behaviour, we introduce two descriptors, persistence and diversity. Persistence is quantified by mapping temporal dynamics in a speed shape complexity space, where we identify a persistence domain that distinguishes active from inactive droplets. Diversity captures spontaneous or environmentally induced variation in motion and the propensity of droplets to reorient or adapt under perturbation. We show that persistence and diversity are constrained by a behavioural trade off: high persistence limits diversity, whereas high diversity reduces persistent activity. Our results provide a quantitative framework for navigating and programming life like behaviours in active droplets and show how closed-loop experimentation can uncover organising principles in complex active matter.

</details>


### [418] [Same Path, Less Time: Training-Free Fast Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models under Inference Latency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01390)
*Fuyi Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PTS: 冻结VLA action-chunk策略的免训练执行层，将机器人运动视为参考路径的时间重参数化，通过"路径层"（单步确定性解码、按推理期已消耗进度进入）与"时间层"（累加增量、夹爪运动时臂保持1x、按执行器线性范围与延迟下chunk可行性限速）同时消除推理停顿与动作加速两类时间浪费。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA部署中两类与模型能力无关的时间浪费：推理下一chunk时机器人停等（stop-and-wait），以及以缓慢保守示教速度运动。已有方法各只解决一个损失，直接叠加会因异步与加速各自改变"计划进度—执行运动"的对应关系而失效。

Method: 提出Path-preserving Time Scaling，作为冻结action-chunk策略之上的免训练执行层。核心原则：运动是参考路径的时间重参数化，路径仅在新观测时更新。路径层：每次重规划单步确定性解码并按推理期间已消耗的进度接续进入（避免错位入口与随机采样）。时间层：对计划增量求和得到路径进度，夹爪运动期间保持机械臂1x，并以执行器线性范围及延迟下chunk可行性为上界限速。理论分析给出错位入口与随机采样引入的偏差与方差，并推导break-even成功率刻画何时加速划算。

Result: LIBERO上注入推理延迟、两个冻结VLA条件下，吞吐量较最强可部署基线提升33%（pi0.5）与104%（SmolVLA），成功率持平或更高，且在全部6个模型-套件组合上最优，甚至超过零延迟1x执行；与同用单步解码的异步1x执行相比，仅时间层即带来28%与38%增益。LIBERO-Dynamic上较停等执行提升38%，与异步1x执行相当。

Conclusion: 异步与加速并非简单可叠加的独立优化，需在同一"路径—时间"分解下统一处理；免训练、与冻结策略解耦的执行层可在不牺牲成功率的前提下显著提升部署吞吐，并提供理论化的加速收益判据。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, yet deployed robots waste time in two ways that are independent of model capability: they halt while the next chunk is inferred, and they move at the speed of slow, cautious demonstrations. Existing remedies remove one loss each, and stacking them fails, because asynchrony and speed-up each change the correspondence between planned progress and executed motion. We present Path-preserving Time Scaling (PTS), a training-free execution layer for frozen action-chunking policies built on one principle: the robot's motion is a time reparameterization of a reference path, and the path changes only in response to new observations. A path layer decodes every replan deterministically in one step and enters it at the progress consumed during inference. A time layer sums the planned increments, keeps the arm at 1x while the gripper moves, and caps the rate by the actuator's linear range and by chunk feasibility under latency. We show that misaligned entry and stochastic sampling add a bias and a variance to the continuation error, and derive a break-even success rate that states when speeding up pays off. On LIBERO with two frozen VLAs under injected inference latency, PTS raises task throughput over the strongest deployable baseline by 33% for pi0.5 and 104% for SmolVLA while matching or improving the success rate, is best on all six model-suite combinations, and exceeds zero-latency 1x execution. Against asynchronous 1x execution with the same one-step decoder, the time layer alone adds 28% and 38%. On LIBERO-Dynamic it improves on stop-and-wait execution by 38% and is comparable to asynchronous 1x execution.

</details>


### [419] [Serving Agentic Robot Fleets: Workload Characterization, KV-Cache Thrashing, and Admission Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01404)
*Sida He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文刻画"VLM大脑+vLLM服务+VLA策略"机器人智能体集群的双重资源约束：大脑反复重访增长的KV cache，VLA在严格控制截止期下执行动作块，并给出容量规划与准入原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人集群同时承担长上下文VLM推理与低延迟VLA控制，两层资源竞争（KV驻留 vs 动作截止期）此前缺乏量化刻画，缺少容量规划与准入依据。

Method: 在H800上采集80个LIBERO-PRO episode（GPT-6-Astra、RPent、pi0.5，共1862个大脑turn、1582个VLA推理块），分别profile大脑与VLA两层，并在vLLM上replay智能体程序；测量KV长度、延迟、饥饿率与吞吐随并发变化，并评估静态活跃episode上限的准入策略。

Result: 大脑上下文可达215k token，Astra请求中位延迟7.78 s而环境步间隔仅1.0 s；0.25 s动作块截止期下单GPU满足1%饥饿目标支持1台机器人，1.0 s截止期下容量至少32；并发由20升至32时吞吐从~2.4降至~0.6 req/s（重复prefill挤占generation）；静态活跃episode上限恢复2.24-2.25 req/s，完整trace程序吞吐由1.30升至5.00-5.55 episodes/min。

Conclusion: 测量揭示了动作截止期与大脑KV驻留之间随负载变化的主导权切换，为持续运行的机器人智能体集群提供容量规划与准入控制原则；属系统/服务层实证工作，未提出新的VLA或重建方法，也缺少真机部署验证。

Abstract: Agentic robots combine a vision-language brain, a tool-using harness, and a vision-language-action (VLA) policy. Serving a fleet of these agents introduces two coupled resource constraints: the brain repeatedly revisits long, growing key-value (KV) cache states, while the VLA executes action chunks under tight control deadlines. We characterize 80 LIBERO-PRO episodes generated by GPT-6-Astra, RPent, and pi0.5 (1,862 brain turns and 1,582 VLA inference chunks), profile both layers on H800 graphics processing units (GPUs), and replay the resulting agent programs on a vLLM serving engine. Brain contexts reach 215k tokens; the median Astra request takes 7.78 s, while the intervening environment-step gap is only 1.0 s. Under a 0.25 s action-chunk deadline, one VLA GPU meets the 1% starvation target for one robot; under a 1.0 s deadline, its measured capacity reaches at least 32. In sustained brain replay, increasing concurrency from 20 to 32 robots reduces throughput from about 2.4 to 0.6 requests/s as repetitive prefill displaces generation. A static active-episode cap restores 2.24-2.25 requests/s and raises completed trace-program throughput from 1.30 to 5.00-5.55 episodes/min. Our measurements expose the workload-dependent shift between action deadlines and brain KV residency, and establish practical principles for capacity planning and admission in sustained agentic robot fleets.

</details>


### [420] [Adaptive Surface Cleaning under Uncertain Cleaning Response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01437)
*Ruichen Li,Rachel Holladay*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 将自适应表面清洁建模为POMDP，提出信念感知规划框架，利用观测到的清洁结果在线更新隐式局部清洁响应模型，从而自适应调整清洁位置、力与遍数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表面清洁中，污染对清洁动作的响应在空间上不一致，且交互前不可观测，因此机器人必须同时决定“清洁哪里”和“如何清洁”，传统静态规划难以胜任。

Method: POMDP形式化；维护关于潜在局部清洁响应模型的信念（belief），用实际清洁结果做贝叶斯式更新；基于信念规划空间分解、运动轨迹、接触力与清洁遍数，构成闭环规划器。

Result: 仅在网格世界仿真中验证：闭环规划器能随表面状态演化自适应调整空间分解与清洁动作；无真实机器人实验、无定量指标报告。

Conclusion: 提供了一个信念感知、可在线适应未知清洁响应的规划框架，思路清晰但证据薄弱，尚需真实平台与接触级建模验证。

Abstract: Surface cleaning requires robots to adapt both where they clean and how they interact with contamination whose response to cleaning may vary spatially and remain unobservable prior to interaction. We formulate adaptive surface cleaning as a partially observable Markov decision process and propose a belief-aware planning framework that uses observed cleaning outcomes to update a latent local cleaning-response model and adapt subsequent cleaning motions, forces, and passes. Preliminary grid-world simulations demonstrate the resulting closed-loop planner adapting its spatial decomposition and cleaning actions as the surface evolves.

</details>


### [421] [Dual Path Following for an Aerial Manipulator Under State and Input Constraints via Transverse Feedback Linearization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01442)
*Hamza Tariq,Adeel Akhtar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 用横向反馈线性化把四旋翼+三自由度机械臂的双路径跟随（质心沿载体路径、末端执行器沿另一路径）写成二次规划，仅松弛末端速度，可化为有闭式解的标量问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四旋翼搭载机械臂时，载体与臂机械耦合，质心路径与末端路径需同时满足，且要兼顾关节限位与奇异姿态，单一控制器难以同时处理两条路径任务。

Method: 以质心坐标与末端执行器路径坐标为输出，并对推力做动态扩展，使系统具有无内部动态的法式（normal form），并刻画该法式失效的状态集；将横向反馈线性化控制器表述为二次规划，仅松弛末端沿路径的速度，把安全与执行器限位作为不等式约束，最终化简为标量凸问题并给出闭式解。

Result: 若QP始终严格可行，反馈局部Lipschitz，两条路径不变且吸引，全部约束满足；在Drake仿真中，控制器通过降低末端速度消解两路速度参考冲突，两路径保持不变，而带安全滤波器的级联方案则偏离两条路径。

Conclusion: 动态扩展+横向反馈线性化+闭式QP为耦合空中机械臂的双路径跟随提供了具理论保证的紧凑方案，但缺真实硬件实验。

Abstract: This paper studies dual path following for a quadrotor carrying a three-degree-of-freedom arm. The center of mass of the combined system must follow a vehicle path and the end effector must follow a second path, while the arm respects its joint limits and avoids its singular postures. The vehicle and the arm are mechanically coupled, so one controller must handle both paths. With the center of mass and the end-effector path coordinates as outputs, and a dynamic extension of the thrust, the system admits a normal form without internal dynamics. We characterize the states where this normal form fails. We formulate the transverse feedback linearizing controller as a quadratic program that relaxes only the speed of the end effector along its path and imposes safety and actuator limits as inequality constraints. The program reduces to a scalar problem with a closed-form solution. If it remains strictly feasible for all time, the feedback is locally Lipschitz, both paths are invariant and attractive, and every constraint holds. In the physics engine Drake, the controller resolves a conflict between the two speed references by slowing the end effector while both paths remain invariant. By contrast, a cascade with a safety filter leaves both paths. Code and animations are available at this https URL

</details>


### [422] [$TF^2$-Steering: Action Refinement with Tactile Forecasts and Feedback via Velocity-Field Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01483)
*Yiming Chen,Xiaofei Wei,Chun Gu,Wei Xiao,Peidong Liu,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 TF²-Steering：在流匹配动作专家速度场上学习触觉残差引导，结合触觉 MoE（同时建模触觉预测与实时触觉反馈）与三阶段训练，使触觉信号能纠正甚至改变动作生成轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人策略以视觉为主导，直接注入触觉信号易被忽略，甚至破坏预训练视觉基座策略的能力（实验中观察到性能下降）；触觉数据稀缺、接触事件稀疏是核心瓶颈。

Method: 在视觉基座流匹配策略之上，学习残差式动作细化：对动作专家的速度场施加触觉条件引导；采用触觉混合专家（MoE）结构融合触觉预测（forecast）与实时触觉反馈；配套三阶段训练流程，保持基座动作生成能力的同时让触觉在必要时重定向生成过程。

Result: 在 6 个仿真与 6 个真实操作任务上验证：相比最强基线，平均仿真成功率提升 10.7 个百分点，真实世界平均进展成功率提升 9.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 触觉应以「残差引导」而非「直接拼接」方式接入流匹配策略，可在不牺牲视觉基座能力的前提下显著提升接触丰富任务的操纵性能。

Abstract: Tactile sensing plays a crucial role in everyday human interaction. Consider inserting a plug into a tight socket, vision alone provides limited guidance during the final insertion stage, and we instead rely on both anticipated contact and realized tactile feedback to ajust the insertion motion. The same capability is equally important for robots, particularly in dexterous manipulation tasks. Yet many contemporary robot policies remain vision-dominant. This visual bias, compounded by limited tactile data and sparse contact events, can cause directly incorporated tactile signals to be ignored or even compromise the policy's pretrained capabilities, yielding degrading performance as observed in our experiments. We present $TF^2$-Steering, which refines actions via learned residual steering of the flow-matching action expert's velocity field, using a tactile mixture-of-experts architecture to integrate both tactile forecasts and real-time tactile feedback. Together with specific designed three stages training recipe, $TF^2$-Steering enables tactile signals to correct and, when necessary, redirect the flow-matching action-generation process, while building on the strong action-generation capacity of the vision-based foundation policy. Extensive experiments across six simulated and six real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of $TF^2$-Steering. It outperforms the strongest evaluated baselines by 10.7 percentage points in average simulation success rate and 9.1 percentage points in average real-world progress success rate. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [423] [Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01560)
*Jiarui Yuan,Yuxin Zuo,Xiaoyu Huang,Wenbo Zhang,Kwanyoung Park,Junlin Yang,Tianxiang Zhang,Ruoqu Chen,Yutao Ouyang,Bingxiang He,Xingtai Lv,Hongjin Wu,Jiajun Liu,Jiahao Zhao,Tianwei Luo,Haozhan Li,Cheng Qian,Jiaxin Ge,Huan-ang Gao,Kaisen Yang,Jiaqi Deng,Qixin Xu,Siqiao Huang,Bowen Zhou,Mengdi Xu,Zhiyuan Liu,Pieter Abbeel,Ning Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 uni-robot-agent：支持继续训练的开放权重机器人使用 Agent（RUA）统一评测框架；无特权输入下开箱 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 得 RoboDojo 31.39，超过已发表 GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe 的 28.97，并在 19 个真实任务上表现有竞争力；归纳出四项通用能力与有效机器人使用相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RUA 的零样本操作能力有前景，但依赖前沿闭源模型，无法开展后续训练研究；为"民主化"RUA 研究，需要一个支持开放权重模型与持续训练的统一评测与训练基座。

Method: 构建统一的开放权重 RUA harness（uni-robot-agent），标准化输入/接口以禁止特权输入，支持微调等后续训练；在 RoboDojo 基准上评测新一代、不同家族与规模的模型，并额外评测 19 个真实世界任务；通过跨代际、跨家族、跨规模对比分析定位影响机器人使用效果的四项通用能力。

Result: 开箱 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 取得 RoboDojo 31.39，高于已发表 GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe 的 28.97，也优于多个 VLA/WAM 基线；在 19 个真实任务上表现具竞争力（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Conclusion: 开放权重 RUA 可在无特权输入条件下达到甚至超越闭源前沿模型；有效机器人使用与四项通用能力相关，未来 RUA 训练应联合发展这些能力。属 harness/基准 + 分析型工作，方法细节与真机量化证据在摘要中偏薄。

Abstract: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks. Our analysis across model generations, families, and sizes links effective robot use to four general capabilities, suggesting that future RUA training should develop them jointly.

</details>


### [424] [Recursive Self-Improvement of Exoskeleton Assistance Policies through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01581)
*Muyuan Ma,Shuo Jiang,Lijun Han,Xinpan Meng,Zhenghua Ma,Xiuze Xia,Houcheng Li,Long Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出由智能体自动生成外骨骼助力控制代码、经人体实验反馈后自主迭代修订的闭环进化框架，用 GPT/DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi 四模型验证，单次迭代即可获得有效助力，肱二头肌/肱三头肌激活分别降低 29.4%/35.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外骨骼助力策略设计高度依赖人工经验和大量参数调优，成本高、迭代慢，需要一种能自主生成并按主观反馈+生理信号自动改进策略的框架。

Method: 以 LLM 智能体直接生成可执行助力控制代码；在真人实验中采集主观反馈、运动表现与肌电信号进行策略评估；由智能体基于评估结果自主定位缺陷并改写控制代码，形成"生成—人反馈—评估—自主精炼"闭环。以四种模型对比初始性能与单轮精炼效果。

Result: 四种模型初始性能存在差异，但均在单次自主精炼后实现有效助力；三个任务中肌电激活较无外骨骼条件分别降低 29.4%（肱二头肌）与 35.2%（肱三头肌）。对突发状况的适应性有限。

Conclusion: LLM 智能体驱动的代码级策略进化在人体实验中可行且模型间鲁棒，但鲁棒性与安全性仍需加强，后续需面向异常工况改进。

Abstract: To reduce reliance on manual design and extensive parameter tuning, a framework for the autonomous evolution of exoskeleton assistance policies through human feedback is proposed. Assistance policies are autonomously generated as executable control code by an intelligent agent and evaluated in experiments with human participants. Subjective user feedback, movement performance, and muscle activation measurements are incorporated into policy assessment. Based on these assessments, policy deficiencies are autonomously identified and the control code is revised by the agent for subsequent trials. A closed loop of policy generation, human feedback, evaluation, and autonomous refinement is thereby established. The framework is evaluated using GPT, DeepSeek, GLM, and Kimi, and initial assistance performance and refinement outcomes are compared across models. Despite differences in initial performance, effective assistance is achieved with all four models after a single autonomous refinement iteration under the tested conditions. Across three tasks, biceps and triceps muscle activation levels are reduced by 29.4% and 35.2%, respectively, compared with those measured without an exoskeleton. However, limited adaptability to unexpected situations is observed, indicating that further improvements in robustness and safety are required.

</details>


### [425] [SCOUT: Planning under Occlusion via Object-Centric World Model Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01600)
*Amir Hossain Raj,Xuesu Xiao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SCOUT：遮挡感知的杂乱场景操作规划框架，用对象中心表示重建隐藏几何并提取遮挡层级/可达通道等关系状态，由LLM提出结构化动作候选，再用学习到的动作条件世界模型驱动MCTS做物理推演，在Reveal/Placement任务超VLA策略与3D世界模型，并有真实货架环境验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 杂乱空间中机器人只能从部分视角规划，前景遮挡目标、周边几何与可用自由空间；反应式策略忽略隐藏约束，穷举搜索在密集杂乱下计算不可行。

Method: 对象中心场景表示重建被遮挡几何→构造含阻塞物层级与可达通道的关系规划状态；LLM生成结构化动作候选以压缩动作空间；学习式动作条件世界模型支撑MCTS做接地rollout评估，形成高层推理与物理推演的分层闭环。

Result: 在Reveal与Placement任务上优于VLA策略、具身智能体与3D世界模型，长时域需对遮挡几何推理的任务提升显著；真实杂乱货架环境中的操作验证了鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 遮挡感知的“LLM提议+MCTS世界模型评估”分层框架可在部分观测杂乱场景中实现可靠长时域操作规划，且具备真实机器人可迁移性。

Abstract: Robots manipulating in cluttered spaces must often plan from partial views where foreground objects occlude the target, surrounding geometry, and usable free space. Reactive policies often miss these hidden constraints, while exhaustive search becomes computationally prohibitive in dense clutter. We present SCOUT, an occlusion-aware planning framework that bridges high-level deliberation with grounded physical rollouts. SCOUT leverages an object-centric scene representation to reconstruct hidden geometry and derive a relational planning state capturing blocker hierarchies and accessibility corridors. To navigate the vast action space in clutter, an LLM proposes structured action candidates which are then rigorously evaluated via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) using a learned action-conditioned world model. Evaluations on 'Reveal' and 'Placement' tasks show that SCOUT outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, embodied agents, and 3D world models, with significant gains in long-horizon tasks requiring reasoning over occluded geometry. We further validate the framework's robustness through real-world robotic manipulation in a cluttered shelf environment.

</details>


### [426] [MagPillar: A Soft Magnetopillar Array Tactile Sensor for Robotic Surface Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01609)
*Haotian Guo,Yu Feng,Hao Wu,Jiazhi Tang,Jianshu Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MagPillar: 磁柱阵列+三轴霍尔阵列的仿蜘蛛触毛触觉传感器，配合全阵列力学-磁场叠加模型，将表面纹理/几何转化为磁响应模式，实现六种材料分类(99.34%)与周期性凸起的幅值/峰间距感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人表面探索需要能同时适应接触变形并捕捉表面特征的触觉接口；现有触觉传感器在多柱分布式感知的物理可解释性与材质-几何联合感知上仍有限。

Method: 仿蜘蛛触毛的柔性磁柱阵列 + 三轴霍尔传感阵列；建立全阵列机械变形与叠加磁场模型，解释柱体形变对阵列测量场的影响；用频谱特征 + 逻辑回归分类材料；用连续扫描分析周期凸起的幅值与峰间距变化。

Result: 六类材料离线分类精度99.34%（会话内时间分块交叉验证）；周期凸起扫描的幅值与峰间距变化与几何变化一致，可定性感知表面轮廓。

Conclusion: 将柔顺接触力学与分布式磁感知联系起来，为材料识别与定性表面轮廓感知提供新途径；但验证限于离线分类与定性轮廓，缺少闭环机器人操作与跨会话泛化证据。

Abstract: Robotic surface exploration benefits from tactile interfaces that accommodate contact and capture variations in surface characteristics. Herein, we report MagPillar, a tactile sensor inspired by spider tactile hairs that combines a magnetic pillar array with three-axis Hall sensing. A full-array mechanical and magnetic-field model characterizes how pillar deformation affects the superposed fields measured across the array, providing a physical basis for interpreting its contact responses. The compliant pillar architecture translates contact with surface textures and geometric features into distinct magnetic response patterns. Then, in robotic surface perception experiments, spectral features and logistic regression distinguish six material surfaces with an offline accuracy of 99.34% under within-session temporally blocked cross-validation. Continuous scans over periodic protrusions produce amplitude and peak-spacing variations consistent with changes in surface geometry. These findings connect compliant contact mechanics with distributed magnetic sensing, paving a new path for material recognition and qualitative surface-profile perception.

</details>


### [427] [HuG: Learning Humanoid Whole-Body Affordance-Aware Grasping with Active Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01659)
*Xuanbin Peng,Lai Wei,Yuze Zhai,Qingyuan Yu,Keyi Wang,Jianglong Ye,Xiaolong Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HuG提出"感知-对齐-抓取"流水线，将视角作为显式决策变量做主动感知以解决遮挡，用点云条件化的affordance策略生成全身抓取，并在浮动基座上引入controller-in-the-loop动力学仿真筛选训练数据（剔除73%运动学可行但不稳定的抓取），纯仿真零真机示范即在多层货架任务上达87.5%真机成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人在人类环境中取物困难：自视角下目标常被部分遮挡；同时基座浮动导致必须协调全身运动，既保持目标可见可达又维持基座稳定。现有方法多为纯运动学验证，忽略执行器/控制器的动力学可行性，导致学到的affordance在部署时失稳。

Method: 1) 信念驱动主动感知：把视点作为显式决策变量，通过移动身体/头部消解遮挡；2) 点云条件化的affordance策略输出全身抓取候选；3) affordance感知对齐阶段将身体重定位到最可执行构型；4) 关键：controller-in-the-loop动力学仿真构建训练数据，剔除73%运动学有效但会 destabilize 部署控制器的抓取，使策略学到kinodynamically feasible affordance；全程仿真训练，无真机示范。

Result: 多层货架任务真机成功率87.5%；对新颖物体泛化；各测试高度成功率均≥73%；仿真大规模测试中在远低于训练分布的表高上仍成功，表现出空间外推能力。

Conclusion: kinodynamically 过滤的合成数据使 affordance 落在物体几何与全身可行性上而非记忆构型；主动感知、affordance策略与对齐三者的耦合是人形全身抓取的有效范式。

Abstract: Acquiring objects in human environments is hard for humanoids: targets are partially occluded under egocentric viewpoints, and reaching them demands coordinated whole-body motion that keeps the target visible and reachable while the base stays stable. We present HuG, a framework for whole-body affordance-aware grasping with active perception that couples perception and action through a Perceive-Align-Grasp pipeline: belief-driven active perception resolves occlusion by treating viewpoint as an explicit decision variable; a point-cloud-conditioned affordance policy proposes whole-body grasps; and an affordance-aware alignment stage repositions the body to the most executable configuration. A key insight is that, on a floating base, kinematic validity is not enough: we curate training data with controller-in-the-loop dynamics simulation, rejecting 73% of kinematically valid grasps that would destabilize the deployment controller, so the policy learns kinodynamically feasible affordances. Trained entirely in simulation with zero real demonstrations, HuG attains 87.5% real-world success on a multi-level shelf task, generalizes to novel objects, and holds at least 73% success at every tested height. Beyond generalizing within its training distribution, the policy extrapolates spatially: at scale in simulation it succeeds at table heights well below any seen during training, indicating that kinodynamically filtered synthetic data grounds affordances in object geometry and whole-body feasibility rather than in memorized configurations.

</details>


### [428] [ODE Policy: Robot Learning via Action Dynamics, Not Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01729)
*Jindou Jia,Jingliang Li,Kuangji Zuo,Tuo An,Yuxuan Hu,Mengfei Zhao,Bofan Lyu,Jiaqi Bai,Daoyuan Zhu,Hengyu Dai,Junpeng Zhang,Jianfei Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ODE policy，用神经常微分方程学习动作的向量场（动作动力学）而非离散动作值，部署时由前一动作积分得到当前动作，从而在构造上保证轨迹连续；用于IL、VLA/WAM动作头与MBRL actor，在仿真与14个真机任务上均达最高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模仿学习与强化学习策略大多在离散控制步上做观测到动作值的映射，把物理运动的连续性交给隐式学习，导致动作不平滑、多模态覆盖差、推理慢。

Method: 以神经ODE学习动作向量场：IL中在短动作chunk上、RL中在单步上匹配积分动作与目标；轻量diversity head通过随机化向量场方向捕捉多模态行为；推理时逐步积分，轨迹天然连续。作为视觉运动策略、VLA/WAM动作头及基于模型RL的actor进行评估，对照14个基线，覆盖单臂、双臂、灵巧手、运动与移动操作任务。

Result: IL中相比flow matching，单epoch后成功率5.9×、泛化5.4×、模态平衡3.9×，动作生成快10.8×，且大多比人类示教更平滑；14个真机任务（单臂、双臂、灵巧手、人形）成功率最高；RL中加速SuperMimic人形运动跟踪并平滑动作。

Conclusion: ODE式动作参数化为机器人策略提供了连续、多模态、高效的动作生成方案，在学习效率、数据、参数与执行效率上均有优势，具备规模化的潜力。

Abstract: Most robot policies, whether trained by imitation learning (IL) or reinforcement learning (RL), map observations to action values at discrete control steps and leave the continuity of physical motion to be learned implicitly. We propose ODE policy, which learns the dynamics of the action rather than the action itself. A neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) learns the vector field of the action by matching the integrated actions to the targets over short action chunks in IL and single control steps in RL. A lightweight diversity head captures multi-modal behavior by randomizing the direction of the field. At deployment, each action is integrated from the previous one, so the executed trajectory is continuous by construction. We evaluate it as a visuomotor policy, as the action head of vision-language-action (VLA) and world action models (WAMs), and as the actor of model-based RL against 14 baselines on unimanual, bimanual, dexterous, locomotion, and loco-manipulation tasks. In IL, against flow matching, it reaches 5.9$\times$ the success, 5.4$\times$ the generalization, and 3.9$\times$ the mode balance after one epoch, and generates actions 10.8$\times$ faster. It mostly moves more smoothly than human demonstrations. On 14 real-world tasks across single-arm, dual-arm, dexterous, and humanoid robots, it achieves the highest success rate. In RL, it further speeds up SuperMimic for humanoid motion tracking and smooths its actions. Efficient in learning, data, parameters, and execution, ODE policy offers a promising path to scaling robot learning.

</details>


### [429] [CompliantBot: Learning Whole-Body Compliance across Task Interfaces for Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01748)
*Haoyang Li,Keqi Zhu,Zhanxiang Cao,Yang Zhang,Yizhi Chen,Xuekang Yang,Yue Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Humanoid controllers need the ability to yield to external forces while retaining the capacity to resume their original tasks. However, tracking objectives penalize the deviations needed for yielding, while relaxing tracking goals persistently can make task recovery harder. Existing approaches often rely on task-specific interaction command interfaces or constructed compliant motion data and reference trajectories, limiting the direct reuse of their compliance-training mechanisms across different task interfaces. We introduce CompliantBot, a compliance-training framework for motion tracking and velocity-command locomotion. It preserves the original task inputs and requires no preconstructed compliant data or target trajectories. A state-dependent interaction force field couples applied loads to the robot's motion, enabling local articulation and whole-body movement to change the forces experienced. A complementary force-magnitude reward encourages lower interaction loads, while task rewards are downweighted during loading and restored after release to coordinate yielding and task resumption. The trained policies use task inputs and proprioceptive history without explicit external-force measurements. Across both task interfaces, CompliantBot yields farther under constant pulls and experiences lower spring interaction loads than matched baselines, while resuming task tracking after force removal. CompliantBot achieves the highest task completion among the compared methods under stronger pulls. Power evaluations further show that CompliantBot has the lowest mean joint mechanical power among the compared methods. Real-robot demonstrations further illustrate compliant responses through arm motion, stepping, and body reorientation.

</details>


### [430] [Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Aware Latent-Space Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01814)
*Chandrakiran Ravula,Siddhanth Ramesh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 用潜空间神经控制障碍函数(CBF)替代二值碰撞分类器，为VAE潜空间路径规划(LSPP)提供前向不变性保证，并用闭式一阶投影保证避障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LSPP用二值碰撞分类器约束优化，其在障碍边界处梯度饱和、缺乏时间结构，导致优化停滞，且无前向不变性/安全保证。

Method: 在VAE学到的紧凑可微构型流形上学习神经CBF：三项损失=安全/不安全符号约束+在"障碍盲"名义规划器状态转移上的离散时间递减条件；规划时对每步目标导向潜变量增量做闭式一阶投影回到CBF约束集。

Result: 7-DoF Franka Panda上固定障碍任务成功率75.6%（比35组调优分类器配置中最佳高12.0个百分点），多位置任务83.8%；α扫描显示最优区间α∈[0.10,0.20]；全随机障碍场景成功率降至33.0%，归因于训练转移分布与修正规划器访问状态间的协变量偏移。

Conclusion: 神经CBF可作为LSPP的安全约束层，带来可证明的不变性与更好的规划成功率，但泛化到随机障碍仍受分布偏移限制，需在修正规划器轨迹上重采样或迭代训练。

Abstract: Latent-space path planning (LSPP) compresses the configuration space of a robotic manipulator into a compact, differentiable manifold learned by a variational autoencoder, enabling fast gradient-based planning without explicit inverse kinematics. Existing LSPP frameworks enforce obstacle avoidance with a binary collision classifier, whose saturated gradients near obstacle boundaries and lack of temporal structure cause the optimizer to stall and provide no forward-invariance guarantee. We replace the classifier with a neural control barrier function (CBF) learned directly in the latent space. The barrier is trained with a three-term objective that combines safe and unsafe sign constraints with a discrete-time decrease condition evaluated on transitions of an obstacle-blind nominal planner, and it is enforced at planning time by a closed-form, first-order correction that projects each goal-directed latent step back onto the CBF constraint. On a 7-DoF Franka Panda manipulator, the CBF planner achieves a 75.6\% success rate on a fixed-obstacle task, 12.0 percentage points above the best of 35 tuned classifier configurations, and 83.8\% on a multi-position task. A sweep of the decay rate $\alpha$ characterizes the safety--performance trade-off, with the best operating points in $\alpha \in [0.10, 0.20]$. In a fully general random-obstacle setting, success drops to 33.0\%, which we trace to covariate shift between the obstacle-blind training transitions and the states visited by the corrected planner.

</details>


### [431] [OpenNWM: A Generalist Navigation World Model with Latent Action Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01844)
*Dujun Nie,Ruiqi Song,Zixuan Wang,Hanqing Wang,Yifan Han,Baiyong Ding,Wenzhao Zheng,Hangbin Wu,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OpenNWM 提出带“潜在动作预训练”的通用导航世界模型：先在 1750 万条无动作导航视频上通过视觉预测学习通用潜动作，再用动作条件后训练将其对齐到真实物理运动，从而利用大规模无标签视频提升开放世界导航动力学学习与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 导航世界模型依赖动作标注数据，覆盖受限导致跨环境泛化差；而无动作导航视频丰富多样，却缺少动作标签，无法直接用于动作条件训练。作者希望弥合这一数据鸿沟。

Method: 两阶段训练：1）视觉预测预训练，从大规模无动作视频中学习通用潜动作；2）动作条件后训练，将潜动作与真实物理动作对齐。并构建 NavAnywhere 数据集（1500 万+级视觉观测、15 个异构来源，覆盖地面机器人、人类、无人机视角及住宅、商业、城市、公园、自然等五类场景）。

Result: 在域内与域外基准上视觉预测性能均有提升，导航任务性能同步改善，说明潜动作预训练可把多样无动作视频转化为动力学学习与泛化的增益。

Conclusion: 潜动作预训练为利用海量无动作视频提供了可行范式，可作为开放世界导航世界模型的通用预训练方案；但摘要未披露具体量化指标、计算开销及实机部署细节。

Abstract: Navigation world models predict future observations conditioned on navigation actions to support planning, but their generalization across real-world environments remains constrained by the limited coverage of action-labeled data. Action-free navigation videos provide diverse visual experience, yet lack the recorded actions required for action-conditioned training. We introduce OpenNWM, a generalist navigation world model with latent action pretraining. It learns universal latent actions from large-scale action-free videos through visual prediction pretraining, and further aligns them with physical motions via action-conditioned post-training. To support video pretraining, we curate NavAnywhere, a large-scale action-free navigation video dataset comprising 17.5 million visual observations from 15 heterogeneous sources. It captures navigation by ground robots, humans, and drones, with diverse viewpoints and motion patterns across five broad scene types: residential areas, public and commercial spaces, urban settings, parks, and natural landscapes. Experiments demonstrate improved visual prediction on in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, together with improved navigation performance. These results show that latent-action pretraining enables diverse, action-free videos to improve dynamics learning and generalization for open-world navigation.

</details>


### [432] [Answering Without Arriving: An Evidence Audit for Embodied Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01958)
*Shubh Garg,Divyansh Pandey,Niyati Rawal,Vedant Khandelwal,Amit Sheth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出多房间具身问答benchmark（200测试episode、800问题，按路径长度分层），用固定问题、只改变证据供给的"评估阶梯"（纯文本探针→闭环智能体→参考轨迹回放）诊断答案是否真由观察支撑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身问答仅看答案准确率无法判断智能体是否真的导航、观察并依据观测作答；答案可能来自问题措辞、房间标签或选项等捷径，正确答案不等于证据被采集。

Method: 问题由房间、可见物体与帧的符号记录生成，答案可回溯到支撑观测；评估阶梯在问题不变前提下改变证据来源（text-only、闭环VLA智能体、参考轨迹回放）；另做家族级审计（8类问题族）检验是否引用无法确立答案的帧，并用oracle条件检验"计数式"捷径。

Result: 闭环视觉语言智能体在200个episode中零次到达目标，却答对45.5%，与无图像条件仅差0.1分；回放参考轨迹使同模型升至57.4%，说明证据存在于路线中但未被采集。审计显示8族中4族基本可由文本回答，1族引用不能支撑自身答案的帧，oracle在Rooms-visited达59.5%。

Conclusion: 在把准确率提升归功于记忆之前，必须先建立证据获取、答案覆盖与捷径敏感性的三重评估；纯准确率指标具有误导性。

Abstract: Embodied question answering asks an agent to navigate, observe, and then answer questions about what it saw, yet answer accuracy alone cannot tell whether any of this happened. A plausible answer can come from the question, the room label, or the answer choices, and a correct answer does not show that the supporting observation was ever made. We present a multi-room benchmark whose 200 test episodes and 800 questions are stratified by route extent, with an evaluation ladder that holds the questions fixed while varying only the evidence supplied to the answerer, from text-only probes through closed-loop agents to replay of the reference trajectory. Questions are generated from symbolic records of rooms, visible objects, and frames, so every answer can be traced to the observations that support it. A closed-loop vision-language agent reaches no target in 200 episodes yet answers 45.5% of questions, within 0.1 points of the same model given no images; replaying the reference trajectory raises the same model to 57.4%, so the evidence exists along the route but is not gathered. A family-level audit then shows that access to evidence is not the same as use of it. Four of eight families are largely answerable from text, one cites frames that cannot establish its own answer, and the oracle conditions reach 59.5% on Rooms-visited by counting the supplied images. Evidence acquisition, answer coverage, and shortcut sensitivity must therefore be established before an accuracy gain can be credited to memory.

</details>


### [433] [Do Embodied VLMs Actually Use Their Scene-Graph Memory?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02056)
*Shubh Garg,Divyansh Pandey,Vedant Khandelwal,Niyati Rawal,Amit Sheth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"graph-swap"诊断测试：给每个episode换成另一episode的场景图，统计答案变化数，以检验微调VLM是否真正依赖场景图记忆；对比文本与图两种投递方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体回答路线问题时需要关于所见场景的记忆，场景图是天然载体。但仅看准确率无法判断图中是否包含episode事实、是否传递到模型、以及是否被真正使用，缺乏对"依赖度"的诊断手段。

Method: 在2–7个房间路线的具身问答基准上微调VLM；(1) 提出graph-swap反事实测试：替换为其他episode的场景图并统计答案翻转率；(2) 比较文本输入、图编码器+池化/后融合、每节点独立token三种投递方式；(3) 用探测分析定位图中信息在管线中丢失的环节。

Result: 文本形式记忆被强依赖，路线问题提升约30点；图形式几乎不被使用，原因为编码器保留信息但标准池化与后融合将其丢弃；改为每节点独立输入token可恢复部分信息，路线问题+8.3点，且swap测试证实该增益来自图。swap测试还揭示准确率掩盖的捷径：当相同事实同时出现在文本中时，模型忽略其场景图。

Conclusion: graph-swap测试提供了廉价、可量化的VLM场景图记忆依从性检查，并能暴露捷径行为；结论是场景图记忆应以逐节点token方式而非池化/后融合投递。属诊断分析类工作，未涉及真实机器人部署或3D重建方法。

Abstract: Embodied agents that answer questions about their route need a memory of what they saw, and scene graphs are a natural form for it. A vision-language model (VLM) can receive such a graph as text or through a graph encoder, but accuracy alone cannot show whether the graph holds the episode's facts, reaches the model, or is actually relied on. In this diagnostic study, we introduce a graph-swap test for the last of these: each episode is given another episode's graph, and we count how many answers change. On an embodied question-answering benchmark with routes through two to seven rooms, we use it to compare ways of delivering scene-graph memory to a fine-tuned VLM. As text, the memory is used strongly, adding 30 points on route questions. As a graph, it is not, and we trace why: the encoder preserves the information, but standard pooled and late fusion discard it. Giving each node its own input token recovers part of it, a gain of 8.3 points on route questions that the swap test confirms comes from the graph. The test also exposes a shortcut that accuracy hides: when the same facts appear in the text, the model ignores its graph. The test thus offers a cheap check of whether a VLM uses its scene-graph memory, and our analysis points to how that memory should be delivered.

</details>


### [434] [Back to the Future: Predicting Long-Horizon Dynamics with Retrospective Correction for Disturbance-Aware Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02073)
*Jiwoong Choi,Haoyu Li,Yiwei Lyu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DARE 是一个几何感知的关系动力学框架，通过物体级消息传递预测动作引起的扰动传播，并借助"回溯校正"机制在获得稀疏观测时修正早期状态并重跑其间动力学，从而支持长时程、感知扰动的密集堆叠物体取物规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集堆叠仓储取物时，狭小间隙迫使机器人无法将目标抬起越过障碍，必须接触并扰动周围物体；而接触扰动会沿接触链向非邻域物体传播，同时学习到的动力学在长规划时程上误差累积导致不可靠。因此需要兼顾扰动传播建模与长时程预测精度的取物方法。

Method: 1) 紧凑物体描述子编码 + 物体级消息传递的图关系动力学，预测动作条件下的扰动传播；2) 回溯校正（retrospective correction）：当稀疏观测到来时，学习到的校正器利用预测-观测差异修正先前的预测状态，并重跑中间动力学，使校正在预测的接触链上传播；3) 上述预测驱动滚动时域（receding-horizon）规划器，在取物进度与周围物体位移/旋转代价之间权衡，允许必要接触、抑制有害扰动。

Result: 在平面环境与 RoboCasa 环境中进行评估，涵盖长时程预测、泛化性与密集杂物中扰动感知取物的鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体量化指标。

Conclusion: 将接触链扰动传播建模与回溯式预测校正在统一框架中结合，可显著缓解长时程动力学误差累积，使机器人在密集堆叠场景中主动利用接触完成取物同时控制附带扰动。

Abstract: Retrieving objects from densely packed storage requires anticipating how contact disturbs surrounding objects when limited clearance prevents lifting the target over clutter. However, contact can propagate beyond the target's immediate neighbors, while accumulated prediction errors make learned dynamics unreliable over long planning horizons. We introduce DARE (Disturbance-Aware REtrieval), a geometry-aware relational dynamics framework that uses retrospective correction to improve long-horizon prediction for disturbance-aware retrieval. DARE encodes compact object descriptors and predicts action-conditioned disturbance propagation through object-level message passing. When a sparse observation becomes available, a learned corrector uses the prediction discrepancy to amend an earlier predicted state and reruns the intervening dynamics, propagating the correction through the predicted contact chain. These predictions guide a receding-horizon planner that balances retrieval progress against displacement and rotation of surrounding objects, permitting necessary contact while discouraging harmful disturbance. Experiments in planar and RoboCasa environments evaluate long-horizon prediction, generalization, and robustness for disturbance-aware retrieval in dense clutter. See our project website: this https URL

</details>


### [435] [Local Solution Repair for Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02090)
*Ethan Schneider,Jingkai Chen,Seth Hutchinson,Sonia Chernova*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LSR: a run-time goal replanning (local solution repair) method for Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery that detects suboptimal behaviors and locally repairs plans to reduce agent conflicts.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing MAPD planners produce globally feasible but locally inefficient plans; in long-horizon large-scale warehouse deployments, backtracking and idling in congested regions accumulate and degrade throughput.

Method: Local Solution Repair (LSR): at run time it detects suboptimal behaviors (e.g., backtracking from goals, idling in congestion) and applies local goal replanning to improve plans and reduce conflicts, applied on top of MAPD baselines M2M and LNS-PBS.

Result: In long-horizon warehouse simulations across three environments, task throughput improves by up to 5.9% over SOTA, cutting suboptimal instances by ~36k (14.6%) with minor extra computation.

Conclusion: Local, targeted repair of existing MAPD plans is an effective low-cost complement to global MAPD solvers for long-horizon warehouse deployment.

Abstract: Multi-robot systems in automated warehouses must efficiently attend to a constant stream of pickup-and-delivery tasks while avoiding collisions. Existing Multi-Agent Pickup-and-Delivery (MAPD) solutions generate plans that are globally feasible but often locally inefficient. In large-scale, long-horizon deployments, these inefficiencies, such as robots backtracking from target goal locations and idling in congested areas, accumulate over time and degrade performance. This paper contributes Local Solution Repair (LSR), a goal replanning approach that detects suboptimal behaviors at run-time and locally improves plans to reduce conflict between agents. We demonstrate the utility of our approach by repairing solutions generated by state-of-the-art MAPD baselines, M2M and LNS-PBS. Our results in long-horizon warehouse simulations over three environments show upwards of 5.9% improvement in task throughput over current state-of-the-art methods by reducing the number of suboptimal instances by ~36k or by 14.6% with minor additional computation time.

</details>


### [436] [When Delay Meets Drift: Physical Safety of Robot Foundation Models Is a Cross-Layer Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02101)
*Liangkai Liu,Bimal Thapa Magar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出"跨层变异传播"(cross-layer variation propagation)框架,论证机器人基础模型的物理安全不是模型单独属性,而是环境、模型、算力平台与执行延迟在闭环中交互涌现的属性。用交互对比量(interaction contrast)衡量联合变异是否超过各单独效应之和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全工作割裂:鲁棒性基准扰动场景但假设瞬时推理;实时执行研究只考察标称场景下的推理延迟。闭环系统中二者如何耦合、是否会超加性放大风险,缺乏统一度量。

Method: 将系统分为物理环境、模型、计算平台、执行四个层次,形式化跨层变异传播;定义交互对比(interaction contrast),即联合变异效应减去各单独效应之和。实证采用pi0.5 VLA模型在LIBERO上做4000对配对闭环回合,交叉<jats:a>推理延迟(400 ms)与相机视角扰动(60°)。

Result: 400 ms延迟在训练视角下使安全违规率仅上升3.5个百分点,但在60°相机偏移下上升37个百分点;交互项为33.5个百分点(95% CI: 25–43),显著超加性。

Conclusion: 安全性需作为跨层交互属性来评估;提出面向"可预测物理智能"的研究议程:预测变异何时转化为风险,并据此自适应调节算力、功耗与控制策略。另倡导配对闭环协议与交互对比报告规范。

Abstract: Robot foundation models now act in a closed loop, yet their safety is evaluated one variation at a time: robustness benchmarks perturb the scene while assuming instantaneous inference, and real-time execution methods study inference delay in nominal scenes. We argue that physical safety is not a property of the model alone, but emerges from how variations in the physical environment, the model, the computing platform, and execution interact in closed loop. We formalize this as cross-layer variation propagation across these system layers and use an interaction contrast to measure when joint variation creates more risk than the sum of its parts. In 4,000 paired closed-loop episodes of the pi0.5 vision-language-action model on LIBERO, a 400 ms inference delay raises the safety-violation rate by 3.5 percentage points under the training viewpoint but by 37 percentage points under a 60-degree camera shift: 33.5 percentage points (95% CI: 25-43) more than the two effects combined. We close with a research agenda toward predictable physical intelligence: predicting when variation becomes risk, and adapting compute, power, and control accordingly.

</details>


### [437] [History-Aware Force Sensing and Tunable Stiffness in a Pneumatic Kresling Origami Cell](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02140)
*Hengyi Zhou,Jiaqi Wang,Yilin Ma,Dezhong Tong,Xiaonan Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出3D打印PEBA Kresling折纸单元+磁性角度传感，用多尺度GRU从角度历史估计接触力，实现零压测力、正压可调刚度测力与负压自感知驱动三种模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人中力学滞回与气动加载使基于形变测量的接触力估计困难，需要紧凑方案同时兼顾力反馈、可调轴向刚度与自感知驱动。

Method: 3D打印PEBA Kresling单元内置磁性角度传感器；采集角度序列，训练多尺度GRU回归接触力，以同时建模几何形变与材料响应；正压按压力分档训练专用模型；负压驱动时用基于能量的补偿模型把零压模型迁移过来。

Result: 零压测试RMSE 0.76 N；+20 kPa时前3 mm压缩的平均轴向刚度约翻倍，分压模型RMSE<0.93 N；负压准静态下经能量补偿后RMSE 1.66–2.10 N。

Conclusion: 该工作以单一紧凑折纸单元集成力反馈、可调轴向刚度与自感知驱动，验证了序列模型补偿滞回的可行性，为软体驱动器提供了一种简化的多模态传感方案。

Abstract: Mechanical hysteresis and pneumatic loading complicate contact force estimation from deformation measurements in soft robots. This work presents a 3D-printed polyether block amide (PEBA) Kresling cell with magnetic angular sensing that supports three operating modes: force sensing at zero gauge pressure, force sensing with tunable stiffness under gauge positive pressure, and self-sensing actuation under negative gauge pressure. A multiscale gated recurrent unit (GRU) network estimates contact force from angular histories to account for the the combined effects of geometric deformation and material response. At zero gauge pressure, the model achieves a test RMSE of 0.76~N. Positive gauge pressure approximately doubles the average axial loading stiffness at +20~kPa over the first 3~mm of compression, while pressure-specific models maintain RMSEs below 0.93~N. Under negative gauge pressure, an energy-based compensation model enables contact force estimation using the the model trained at zero gauge pressure, achieving RMSEs of 1.66--2.10~N under quasi-static conditions. These results demonstrate a compact approach to combining force feedback, tunable axial stiffness, and self-sensing actuation in soft origami systems.

</details>


### [438] [GoalDex: Learning Image-Goal-Conditioned Policies for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02171)
*Arjun Bhardwaj,Mayank Mittal,Maximum Wilder-Smith,Vaishakh Patil,Marco Hutter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出端到端视觉运动框架，用RGB与本体感知直接完成手内灵巧重定向，跳过显式物体位姿估计；通过特权状态教师的行为蒸馏与辅助重建目标联合学习视觉表征与策略，并支持图像目标条件化重定向，实现单策略五物体sim-to-real迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有灵巧手内操作普遍以显式物体位姿估计为核心，但在严重手-物遮挡下位姿跟踪不可靠，且常需物体特定监督，形成感知-控制瓶颈，限制鲁棒性与可扩展性。

Method: 端到端RGB+本体感知的视觉运动策略，无中间位姿估计；从特权状态教师做行为蒸馏，配合辅助重建目标联合训练视觉表征与控制策略；引入图像目标条件化（image-goal-conditioned）重定向，用图像而非规范位姿表征指定目标构型。

Result: 在仿真中覆盖多样物体几何与实例，性能稳定优于基于位姿的方法及基于预训练视觉编码器的策略；单一图像目标条件策略成功直接sim-to-real迁移至5个真实物体。

Conclusion: 精确的灵巧手内重定向无需显式位姿估计即可实现，端到端表征学习结合蒸馏与重建可绕开感知-控制瓶颈并支持图像目标接口。

Abstract: Dexterous in-hand manipulation is commonly formulated around explicit object pose estimation, yet reliable pose tracking is challenging under severe hand-object occlusions and often requires object-specific supervision. This dependence creates a bottleneck between perception and control that can limit robustness and scalability. We present an end-to-end visuomotor framework for dexterous in-hand reorientation that operates on RGB observations and proprioception without intermediate pose estimation. Our approach jointly learns visual representations and control policies through behavior distillation from privileged state teachers and auxiliary reconstruction objectives. Furthermore, we introduce image-goal-conditioned reorientation, allowing desired object configurations to be specified directly through images rather than canonical pose representations. We evaluate our approach across a diverse set of object geometries and instances in simulation, where it consistently outperforms pose-based methods and policies built on pretrained visual encoders. Finally, we demonstrate direct sim-to-real transfer of a single image-goal-conditioned policy across five real-world objects, showing that accurate dexterous reorientation can be achieved without explicit pose estimation. For videos and code release, please refer to the project website: this https URL

</details>


### [439] [Directional Bounded-Confidence Cucker-Smale Flocking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02173)
*Hossein B. Jond*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在Cucker–Smale集群模型中引入视线坐标系下的径向/切向分解与紧凑支撑核门控，构造时变、状态依赖的矩阵加权交互，证明能量耗散恒等式、滑动窗口PE下指数速度一致性与有界直径判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典CS模型采用各向同性标量耦合，无法区分相对速度的不同方向分量；各向同性tied-confidence规则在多群体场景中易陷入极化而失效，需要更细粒度的方向性置信机制。

Method: 将成对相对速度在瞬时视线（line-of-sight）坐标系分解为独立径向与切向通道，分别用紧凑支撑核进行门控，得到严格推广标量CS的时变、状态依赖矩阵加权交互律；在分歧子空间上定义滑动窗口持续激励（PE）条件进行稳定性分析。

Result: 建立精确能量耗散恒等式（平均速度守恒），证明PE条件下速度指数收敛；给出分离度量衰减与聚合方向矫顽性的CS有界直径判据及簇收敛保证；仿真验证耗散平衡，并显示方向门控在传统各向同性规则保持极化的情形下恢复全局对齐。

Conclusion: 方向性有界置信是标量CS对齐的有效且可分析推广，能在不牺牲理论保证的前提下改善多群体对齐的鲁棒性。

Abstract: This paper introduces a directional bounded-confidence extension of the Cucker--Smale (CS) flocking model that decomposes pairwise relative velocities into independent radial and tangential channels within the instantaneous line-of-sight frame. Gating these components via compactly supported kernels creates a time-varying, state-dependent, matrix-weighted interaction that strictly generalizes classical scalar CS alignment. We establish an exact energy-dissipation identity with conserved mean velocity and prove exponential velocity consensus under a sliding-window persistent excitation (PE) condition formulated directly on the disagreement subspace. Furthermore, we derive a CS bounded-diameter criterion separating metric decay from aggregate directional coercivity, along with a cluster convergence guarantee. Simulations validate the exact dissipation balance and demonstrate that directional gating successfully restores global alignment in scenarios where traditional isotropic tied-confidence laws remain polarized.

</details>


### [440] [Human Sensorimotor Model Adaptation to Account for Robot Accuracy and Speed Augmentation in Human-Robot Co-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02181)
*Frits van Hall,Kevin Haninger,Luka Peternel*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出在随机最优控制框架中引入任务终态约束与基于Fitts定律的时域约束，并用递推最小二乘在线估计Fitts参数，使机器人运动时长自适应人类行为，在定位任务中验证了计算可行性与速度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将人类感觉运动模型嵌入机器人轨迹规划的方法，未考虑随人类交互行为自适应调整的时域（时长）约束，导致人机协作运动难以对齐。作者希望让机器人运动时长匹配人类实际操作节奏，并假设机器人提升精度后人类可相应提高速度。

Method: 构建带终态约束的随机最优控制问题：终态约束来自任务的空间约束，时域约束由Fitts定律给出（运动时间与难度指数的关系）。用递推最小二乘（RLS）在线估计Fitts定律参数（如截距与斜率），从而把机器人运动时长调整到与人类一致。在人机分工的定位任务中验证：机器人控制具有可重复运动的自由度，人类在互补自由度上自适应调节。

Result: 该方法计算量适合在线使用；在人与机器人相互适应的过程中收敛；能提高整体运动速度（机器人承担并提升精度后人类提速）。但作者明确指出仍需开展充分的人因实验验证。

Conclusion: 将Fitts定律时域约束与在线参数估计融入随机最优控制，是实现人机运动时长对齐的可行途径，具备在线可用性与相互适应收敛性，未来需系统的人机实验与更复杂的多自由度任务验证。

Abstract: In human-robot co-manipulation, the robot's trajectory should accommodate the human's, where human sensorimotor behavior is affected by the task's spatial and temporal constraints, as well as personal factors. Several robot trajectory planning methods have been proposed to embed human sensorimotor models in the robot trajectory planning, but these methods do not consider temporal constraints that adapt to how the human behaves when interacting with the robot. To better align human and robot collaborative motion, this work adapts a stochastic optimal control problem with a final state constraint from the task constraints and a temporal constraint from Fitts' law. A recursive least squares method is used to estimate the Fitts' law parameters, adapting the robot's motion duration to that of the human, thus allowing the robot to adapt to how the human behaves when interacting with the robot. It is hypothesized that a speed increase can result from the robot augmenting the accuracy. The feasibility of the approach is validated on a positioning task where the robot controls degrees of freedom which have repeatable motion, and the human adapts motion in the complementary degrees of freedom. The approach is shown to be computationally suited to online use, it converges as the human and robot mutually adapt, and can increase the movement speed, although thorough human studies are needed in future work.

</details>


### [441] [Directional Bounded-Confidence Matrix Alignment in Vicsek Flocking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02189)
*Hossein B. Jond*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出方向性有界置信的离散时间Vicsek多智能体模型：在瞬时视线坐标系下用状态相关的半正定矩阵分别门控径向与切向航向对齐分量，并给出全局适定性、局部几何收缩与接触保持的理论保证及数值验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Vicsek标量加权对齐无法区分视线方向上的径向与切向信息，导致被抑制通道的信息仍泄漏进一致性平均；作者希望用矩阵值置信门控实现分量可选择性的方向对齐，同时保持系统适定与收敛可分析。

Method: 构建离散时间方向性有界置信Vicsek变体，对齐权重为状态相关半正定矩阵，在视线坐标系下独立门控径向/切向分量；分析归一化矩阵加权动力学，证明提议向量的一致非消失下界以得全局适定性；在完全度量交互下对小散布状态证明航向直径线性几何收缩，并给出离线可验证的空间自举条件以保证度量连边保持与不重合；构造连通矩阵图上的极化不变量反例；与未滤波Vicsek平均、标量绑定置信、迹匹配标量基线、受限角度规则进行数值对比。

Result: 理论上获得全局适定性的统一有界性、局部航向直径的线性几何收缩及使度量接触保持/重合规避的先验自举条件；反例表明连通矩阵图上存在不变的极化状态，揭示结构性限制；实验中实现无被拒通道泄漏的分量选择性滤波，并在多种群密度的多随机种子基准上相比基线取得更优的固定界对齐效果。

Conclusion: 矩阵值方向性置信为多智能体航向对齐提供了可分析、可选择性过滤的机制，兼具收敛保证与结构性极限刻画，但其贡献限于理论模型与仿真验证，尚缺实体机器人部署与真实感知噪声下的验证。

Abstract: This paper proposes a directional bounded-confidence variant of the discrete-time Vicsek multiagent model, in which pairwise heading alignment is modulated by a state-dependent, positive semidefinite matrix that independently gates orthogonal radial and tangential components in the instantaneous line-of-sight frame. We analyze the normalized, matrix-weighted system dynamics, proving a uniform non-vanishing bound on proposal vectors that guarantees global well-posedness across arbitrary network states. For local small-spread states under complete metric interaction, we prove linear geometric contraction of the heading diameter and establish an offline-verifiable spatial bootstrap condition that guarantees metric contact preservation and coincidence avoidance a priori. A counterexample demonstrates invariant polarized states on connected matrix graphs, delineating systemic structural limits. Numerical experiments against unfiltered Vicsek averaging, scalar tied confidence, trace-matched scalar baselines, and restricted-angle rules demonstrate component-selective filtering without rejected-channel leakage, along with improved fixed-bound alignment on multi-seed benchmarks across varying population densities.

</details>


### [442] [Beyond Ensemble Disagreement: Predictive STL Monitoring of RL Locomotion under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02218)
*Qurban Ali,Badaruddin Chachar,Maqsood Ali,Sajjad Ali Rajper*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文评估了基于预测式STL（Signal Temporal Logic）监测与闭环世界模型推演的安全监控方法在分布偏移下的有效性，发现预测鲁棒性排序有用，但集成模型分歧不可作为可靠性信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL运动策略在名义仿真下训练，部署时遭遇分布偏移可能违反安全约束；预测式监视器可提前预警，但其世界模型在偏移下可能失真，且集成分歧未校准，需要实证检验。

Method: 对冻结的Ant-v5与HalfCheetah-v5策略，使用闭环世界模型rollout与三模型集成计算未来K步的STL鲁棒性预测，在外力扰动、观测噪声、质量偏移三类偏移下与当前状态鲁棒性、分歧加权方案对比，以AUROC评估违规排序。

Result: HalfCheetah上预测鲁棒性对STL违规排序强；分歧与观测预测误差及违规无稳定相关。严重噪声下K=20违规率64.2±24.4%，但当前状态鲁棒性AUROC仅差0.03；分歧加权无一致提升。Ant的组合目标无正违规、any-violation目标多为单类，仅提供按规格的补充证据。

Conclusion: 预测式鲁棒性提供了STL专属的有效排序，但相较当前状态监测未展现额外排序价值；不应将集成分歧视为安全不确定性的可靠指标，未来需更校准的不确定性度量。

Abstract: RL locomotion policies trained under nominal simulation conditions may encounter distribution shifts that compromise safety. Predictive monitors could anticipate violations, but their world-model forecasts may become unreliable under shift, and ensemble disagreement is not calibrated. We evaluate predictive Signal Temporal Logic (STL) monitoring for frozen Ant-v5 and HalfCheetah-v5 policies using closed-loop world-model rollouts and a three-model ensemble. Across external-force, observation-noise, and mass shifts, predicted robustness ranks HalfCheetah's future STL violations strongly, whereas disagreement does not reliably track observation prediction error or violations. Under severe noise, violations remain common ($64.2\pm24.4\%$ at $K{=}20$ across three PPO seeds), yet current-state robustness without prediction comes within $0.03$ AUROC of predictive robustness. Penalizing predicted robustness by disagreement does not consistently improve ranking. Ant provides complementary per-specification evidence, but its composite target has no positive violations and its any-violation target is single-class in most evaluated seed-condition slices. Overall, predictive robustness provides useful STL-specific ranking but little demonstrated additional ranking value over the current state; these findings caution against treating ensemble disagreement as a reliable indicator of safety uncertainty.

</details>


### [443] [When to Probe and When to Act: Clarity-Aware Risk-Adaptive Control for Interactive Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02240)
*Youran Wang,Devodita Chakravarty,Yiwei Lyu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一信念空间MPC框架，将"清晰度"标量信息状态作为显式规划变量，与清晰度自适应CVaR安全约束耦合，实现信息获取与安全规范协同设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统架构将预测与规划解耦，把风险评估与信息获取视为独立目标，在高不确定交互场景下导致"冻结机器人问题"或不安全机动。作者主张安全阈值应随系统内部置信度动态演化，而非静态设定。

Method: 统一的belief-space MPC，联合多步信息规划与clarity-adaptive CVaR barrier：将标量"清晰度"作为规划变量，高模糊时收紧保守性、置信提升后松弛约束，自动从探测过渡到任务执行；并给出性能分析，证明信息获取代价与相对真值控制器的规划代价差受残余模糊度与求解误差界定。

Result: 在并道与非信号交叉口场景中与代表性交互规划基线对比，5000次仿真取得最高成功率（94.6%、93.2%）和最低碰撞率（1.2%、1.4%）。

Conclusion: 为以人为中心的交互环境中提供了一种有原理支撑的鲁棒决策框架，但仅限仿真验证，缺乏真实车辆部署。

Abstract: Safe navigation in interactive traffic requires autonomous vehicles to reason about unobservable human characteristics and the reciprocal nature of multi-agent interactions. Traditional architectures often decouple prediction from planning, leading to the "Frozen Robot Problem" or unsafe maneuvers under high ambiguity because they treat risk assessment and information acquisition as independent objectives. We argue that the notion of safety should not remain static but must instead dynamically co-evolve with the system's internal confidence: the robot should actively clarify ambiguity when necessary while also recognizing the diminishing returns of information, and naturally transition toward task execution. We introduce a unified belief-space Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that couples multistep information planning with a clarity-adaptive Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) barrier mechanism. By treating clarity, a scalar informational state, as an explicit planning variable, the controller co-designs its probing strategy with its safety specification, tightening conservatism under high ambiguity and relaxing constraints as confidence improves. We further provide a performance analysis showing that the cost of information seeking and the expected planning-cost gap to a controller that knows the true human characteristic are bounded by residual ambiguity and solver error. We evaluate the framework in lane-merging and unsignalized-intersection scenarios against representative interactive-planning baselines. Across 5,000 simulations, the proposed method achieves the highest success rates (94.6% and 93.2%) and the lowest collision rates (1.2% and 1.4%) among the compared methods, providing a principled foundation for robust decision-making in human-centric environments.

</details>


### [444] [Late Autumn: LLM Agents Specialize a General Multi-Robot Planner for One Warehouse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02391)
*Yimin Tang,Han Zhang,Shao-Hung Chan,Erdem Bıyık,Sven Koenig,Jingkai Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"Late Autumn"研究范式：让LLM编程智能体以自主研究方式，将通用多机器人规划器针对单一仓库场景进行专门化（以牺牲通用性换取吞吐量），类比LLM的post-training。在6个研究campaign中，吞吐量提升22–60%，且可迁移、可审查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实仓库是"窄问题"——布局与流程几乎不变，但运营方仍在多站点统一使用同一通用多机器人规划器，因为专家无法为每个站点单独调参。作者希望用LLM编码智能体自动完成这种站点级专门化，降低工程成本。

Method: 在任务分配+多智能体路径规划（MAPF）结合的终身规划器上，于模拟现有自动化仓库的地图上开展6次自主研究campaign；LLM编码智能体自主迭代修改代码、评分提交，形成链式"scored commits"（单步中位数27行，最终补丁0.7k–2.4k行）。在未见随机种子、另一布局、更大机队、不同服务时间、更小机队与出站偏好需求分布下做评测，并进行人工代码审查。

Result: (1) 吞吐量提升22–60%，在未见种子上保持；(2) 智能体重新发现已知MAPF机制（走廊出口优先、局部引导、rollout），不同campaign独立定位到同一瓶颈；(3) 增益可迁移至另一布局、更大机队与其他服务时间，随小机队衰减，在出站偏重的需求组合下基本消失；(4) 补丁由可审查的提交链构成，人工审查发现评分未捕捉的问题，部分补丁使规划器计算量增加超100倍。

Conclusion: LLM智能体能以极低工程成本将每个站点的场景偏置转化为额外吞吐量，产出可审查的补丁；未来专家角色将转向设计有洞察力的指标与贴近真实问题的快速仿真器。

Abstract: No algorithm is best on all problems, but a real warehouse is a narrow problem: its layout and processes rarely change. Operators still run one general multi-robot planner at many sites, because experts cannot tune it for each one. In this work, which we call Late Autumn, we explore whether LLM coding agents running autonomous research can specialize a general planner for one site, trading generality for throughput, much as post-training adapts a pretrained LLM to one task. We study six campaigns on a lifelong planner that combines task assignment with multi-agent path finding, on a floor modeled on an existing automated warehouse. We find that (1) the agents raise throughput by 22--60%, and the gains hold on unseen seeds; (2) they rediscover known MAPF mechanisms, such as corridor-exit priorities, local guidance, and rollouts, and independent campaigns find the same bottleneck; (3) the gains largely carry over to another layout, a larger fleet, and other service times, shrink with a smaller fleet, and mostly vanish under an outbound-heavy demand mix; and (4) each final patch (0.7k--2.4k lines) is a chain of scored commits with a median step of 27 lines, so experts can review it, and review finds problems that the score misses; some patches multiply planner compute by over 100x. LLM agents can therefore turn each site's bias into extra throughput at little engineering cost, with reviewable patches; we expect experts to shift toward designing insightful metrics and fast simulators that mirror the real problem.

</details>


### [445] [Learning Purposeful Co-designs of Bio-inspired Quadrupedal Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02462)
*Fabio Boekel,Jiatao Ding,Cosimo Della Santina*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Dogger: 模块化三段腿+四连杆+可调被动膝柔顺的四足机器人，两阶段框架(先训练形态条件RL策略并冻结，再用贝叶斯优化选设计)，实现几何-柔顺全共设计的零样本部署，运输代价降低18.6%/35.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形态与控制分离设计限制了四足机器人的效率与适应性，而现有共设计方法受限于狭窄的设计空间；作者希望通过扩展物理设计空间(几何+被动柔顺)来释放任务驱动形态-控制共设计的潜力。

Method: 硬件：仿生四足，模块化三段腿、四连杆机构、可调被动膝柔顺，使几何与柔顺参数可连续变化。算法：两阶段框架——阶段一用强化学习训练形态条件(morphology-conditioned)控制策略，跨多设计泛化；阶段二冻结策略，用贝叶斯优化在任务特定目标下选择设计参数。

Result: 零样本部署的机器人在巡检任务中降低运输代价18.6%，在负载携带任务中降低35.7%。对比实验表明完整的几何-柔顺共设计优于固定或受限设计范围；跨任务测试揭示不同任务偏好不同形态，且存在共享的机械权衡。

Conclusion: 提供了硬件层面的证据，说明在腿足机器人中扩大物理设计空间并与学习控制结合，是实现任务驱动形态-控制共设计全部潜力的关键。

Abstract: Treating morphology and control as separate design problems has constrained the efficiency and adaptability of quadrupedal robots, while current co-design approaches are often constrained by restricted design spaces. We overcome this limit by introducing Dogger, a bio-inspired quadruped with modular three-segment legs, four-bar linkages and adjustable passive knee compliance. A two-stage framework combining reinforcement learning and Bayesian optimization is developed: the morphology-conditioned control policy is trained across designs and then held fixed during task-specific design selection. The resulting designs and policies deployed zero-shot reduce the cost of transport by 18.6% and 35.7% for inspection and payload-carrying tasks. Comparisons demonstrate that full geometry-compliance co-design outperforms fixed and restricted design scopes. Cross-task tests further reveal distinct task-specific morphologies with shared mechanical trade-offs. These results provide hardware-level evidence that expanding the physical design space alongside learned control is essential to realize the full potential of task-driven morphology-control co-design in legged robotics.

</details>


### [446] [To Coordinate or Not to Coordinate? Learning to Swim with Eight Soft Arms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02468)
