*Junkai Chen,Dehan Yuan,Yiyuan Zhang,Yu Duan,Fan Shi,Dixia Fan,Cecilia Laschi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 八臂欠驱动软体游泳机器人中，仅靠共享节律驱动下独立学习各臂振幅（无需臂间相位耦合）即可实现速度与方向跟踪，效果显著优于相位耦合与端到端PPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验多欠驱动软臂游泳是否需要显式臂间相位协调，探索更简洁的控制结构是否能支撑速度/方向跟踪。

Method: 基于PPO比较三种控制策略：①无臂间相位耦合、仅学习各臂驱动振幅；②带预设相位耦合的振幅学习；③无显式节律结构的端到端PPO。任务为200个随机三维速度指令回合，并辅以直线游泳与指定换向试验。

Result: 200个随机指令回合中，无相位耦合策略满足跟踪准则169次，相位耦合117次，端到端PPO仅28次；直线与换向试验同样显示无相位耦合的跟踪更准确。

Conclusion: 八臂软体游泳无需预设臂间相位耦合，通过节律控制结构内的臂级振幅调制学习即可实现有效游动控制；说明低维参数化节律+独立振幅是欠驱动软体多臂系统的有效控制归纳偏置。

Abstract: Does effective swimming with multiple underactuated soft arms require explicit coordination between arms? We hypothesize that an eight-arm swimmer can control its swimming speed and direction by independently learning each arm's actuation amplitude under a shared rhythmic drive, without prescribed inter-arm phase coupling. To test this hypothesis, we compare three reinforcement learning-based control strategies using proximal policy optimization (PPO): (1) learning arm-specific actuation amplitudes without inter-arm phase coupling, (2) learning actuation amplitudes with prescribed inter-arm phase coupling, and (3) directly learning actuator commands through end-to-end PPO without an explicit rhythmic structure. Across 200 episodes with randomized three-dimensional velocity commands, the controller without phase coupling satisfies the tracking criterion in 169 episodes, compared with 117 for the phase-coupled controller and 28 for end-to-end PPO. Straight-line swimming and commanded direction-change trials further demonstrate more accurate velocity tracking without phase coupling. These findings suggest that effective eight-arm swimming does not require prescribed inter-arm phase coupling, but can instead be achieved through learned arm-specific amplitude modulation within a rhythmic control structure.

</details>


### [447] [RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02497)
*Tan Sang Nguyen,Yi Ru Wang,Shailesh Shailesh,Gang Yang,Jiamo Hu,Jianuo Jiang,Haoquan Fang,Zhongzheng Ren,Zhongyi Luo,Ian Chong,Aaron Tung,Santiago Pravisani,Minghui Lin,Yao Mo,Ishneet Singh,Benjamin Tee,Harold Soh,Siddhartha Srinivasa,Dieter Fox,David Hsu,Haoming Song,Maxime Ellerbach,Thomas Wolf,Pepijn Kooijmans,Ruijie He,Michael Cho,Jiafei Duan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboColosseum：跨124个本地站点的分布式真实机器人评测框架，统一策略服务与标准化协议；对5个VLA策略与3个前沿AI Agent在4种本体上做盲测配对Open Track与统一100 demo/任务的Fine-tune Track，共5699次配对对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实物理评测受本体、任务、环境差异影响，跨机构结果难以复现与可比，需要分布式、标准化、盲测的真实机器人评测基础设施。

Method: 分布式评测框架：本地运行的异构机器人网络 + 统一策略推理服务 + 标准化实验协议；Open Track（无任务适配、盲测配对）与Fine-tune Track（每任务100示教、20任务×4本体）；引入部分进度指标（partial progress）与主动匹配（active matchmaking）分配试验。

Result: 前沿通用Agent与专用VLA在Open Track上表现相当，但二者在开放世界任务上均难以可靠完成；微调后GR00T N1.7在SO-101领先、pi0.5在Franka与Bimanual-YAM领先；跨本体排名一致性弱（Kendall W=0.24）；微调前排名无法预测微调后表现，三个共享本体上均出现明显名次反转；G1人形无任何策略完成任务但平均进度达13.3%–23.2%；主动匹配以更少物理试验达到相近排名一致性。

Conclusion: 分布式真实世界评测可同时揭示泛化边界、任务适配能力与失败任务上的部分进展，并表明现有评测范式（单站点、只看成功率）不足以刻画VLA能力。

Abstract: General-purpose robot policies must work across robots, tasks, and environments, yet the variation that makes physical trials informative also makes them difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboColosseum, a distributed evaluation framework that combines unified policy serving and standardized protocols across a network of locally operated robots in diverse environments. Our initial study evaluates five vision-language-action (VLA) policies and three frontier AI agents across four embodiments (SO-101, Franka, Bimanual-YAM, and G1 Humanoid). The Open Track compares models without task-specific adaptation in blinded, pairwise trials under matched local conditions. The Fine-tune Track measures how well VLA policies adapt to 20 tasks across all four embodiments when each policy receives the same 100 demonstrations per task. Across 5,699 pairwise Open Track comparisons at 124 sites, frontier agents rival specialized VLA policies, while all systems struggle to complete open-world tasks reliably. After fine-tuning, GR00T N1.7 leads on SO-101 and pi0.5 leads on Franka and Bimanual-YAM. Policy rankings show weak agreement across embodiment-specific task suites (Kendall W = 0.24). Open Track rankings poorly predict relative performance after fine-tuning, with substantial rank reversals on all three embodiments shared between tracks. Measuring partial progress reveals differences that task success alone misses. On the G1 Humanoid, no policy completes any of the five tasks, yet average progress ranges from 13.3% to 23.2% across policies. Open Track rankings stabilize as trials accumulate, and active matchmaking achieves comparable ranking agreement with substantially fewer physical trials than uniform sampling. These results show how distributed physical evaluation can reveal where robot policies generalize, how well they adapt to new tasks, and how far they progress on tasks they fail to complete.

</details>


### [448] [Neuro Inspired Robotics: What Robot Learning Can Borrow from the Sensorimotor Brain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02510)
*Ruihan Zhang,Davy Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场性综述（position paper），认为机器人策略泛化失败源于设计缺陷，并借鉴神经系统（本体柔顺性、快速视觉通路、小脑预测器、运动皮层动作组合）提出下一代机器人模型的设计假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人策略虽经百万级轨迹、数十台机器人数据的预训练，仍难以应对陌生任务、新物体、动态场景与技能自提升；而儿童仅用一个身体、数年学习即可掌握。作者主张差距不在数据规模，而在模型设计范式。

Method: 提出四项神经科学启发的设计：（1）柔顺控制——策略同时输出刚度与位置，降低精确位置输出需求；（2）专用快速视觉系统——预计算策略所需量，以相机频率驱动反应式策略，与慢速识别通路并行；（3）策略旁的预测器——类比小脑，前向预测指令后果并从自身误差中在线重校准；（4）运动皮层式统一模型——由原语组合动作单元，在感觉边界处逐一验证，针对最弱单元带假设练习，并将已证原语由代码固化为权重以实现流畅快速执行。

Result: 无实验验证或定量结果；各项提案均以“待检验假设”形式给出，论证以生理学类比与设计推演为主。

Conclusion: 作者提出一种具备自主行动能力的机器人架构愿景，作为部署与递归自我改进的基础，并呼吁将各部分作为独立假设加以实证检验。

Abstract: Robot policies still fail at everyday manipulation: an unfamiliar task, an object never held before, a scene that changes mid-motion, a skill that should improve with use. They fail despite pretraining on over a million trajectories, pooled from dozens of robots at great expense, while a child acquires all of these abilities within a few years of learning from a single body. This survey argues that the gap is one of design, and proposes designs for the next generation of robot models, drawn from how the nervous system solves the same problems. From the body we take compliance: the policy commands stiffness alongside position, so the controller yields where the task allows and presses where it must, which greatly lowers the demand for precise position output. From the visual system, where a fast pathway for action runs in parallel with the slow pathway for recognition, we take a dedicated fast vision system for motor behavior: it precomputes the quantities the policy needs and drives a reactive policy at camera rate. From the cerebellum we take a predictor beside the policy that forecasts the consequence of each command and recalibrates from its own error. From motor cortex we take a single model that composes action units from primitives, verifies each at a sensory boundary, practices the weakest unit with a hypothesis in mind, and reasons each attempt closer to the goal. Proven primitives are then consolidated from code into weights, so they run fluently and respond quickly the next time. Together these describe a robot that acts on its own initiative, the basis of deployment and recursive self-improvement, and we offer each proposal as a hypothesis to be tested.

</details>


### [449] [A Study on the Effects of Finger Movements on a Humanoid Hugging Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02517)
*Daigo Suhara,Tomoko Yonezawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 实验研究机器人"拥抱"过程中手指运动（有无、运动模式）对用户心理感受的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人-机器人触觉交互中，拥抱类机器人多关注整体压力/包裹感，而手指细节运动这一拟人化线索的心理效应缺乏系统实证。

Method: 受控被试实验，操纵手指运动的存在与否及运动模式（重复性、多指异步、全指同步、轻柔拥抱等条件），测量用户主观感受与对机器人主动接触的接受度。

Result: 手指运动的有无与模式会影响用户希望从机器人获得的感觉：重复运动与多指异步运动增强此类感觉；全指同步运动与轻柔拥抱更易唤起"被关怀"感；在抵抗机器人主动身体接触方面无显著差异。

Conclusion: 手指级运动模式可作为调节拥抱机器人情感表达的可控设计变量，但不足以改变用户对机器人主动接触的抵触程度。

Abstract: This study aimed to examine the impact of finger movements in hugging robots on users by experimentally investigating how the presence and patterns of such movements affect users psychologically. The results suggest that the presence and patterns of finger movements influence the sensations users seek from the robot; specifically, repetitive movements and asynchronous movements across multiple fingers tended to enhance these sensations. Additionally, simultaneous movement of all fingers and gentle hugging tended to evoke a greater sense of care. Conversely, no differences were observed regarding resistance to physical contact initiated by the robot.

</details>


### [450] [Interactive 3D Cutaway Visualization for Subsurface Target Localization in Robot-Assisted Surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02537)
*Yuxin Chen,Wenxuan Wang,Wanwen Chen,Qi Zeng,Septimiu E. Salcudean*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出可交互 3D 剖切视图 Virtual Box，用于机器人辅助手术中克服混合 AR 深度线索歧义，在组织体模中显著降低定位误差与深度误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合 AR 将皮下解剖结构叠加在组织表面之上，造成深度线索歧义与"悬浮"错觉，使操作者难以准确判断靶点真实深度，影响机器人辅助手术的靶点定位。

Method: 设计 Virtual Box：一种可交互 3D 剖切界面，用户可独立调整观察视角以检查皮下靶点。15 名工程学生的被试内平衡对照体模实验，在水箱中用 da Vinci 器械分别借助 Virtual Box 与深度增强混合 AR 叠加完成靶点对准；以配准 3D 经直肠超声测量 3D 定位误差与深度误差，并记录完成时间与主观量表。

Result: 3D 误差由 12.92 mm 降至 4.96 mm（降 61.6%），深度误差由 9.48 mm 降至 2.07 mm（降 78.2%），p<0.001；空间理解、深度感知与信心评分均显著提升，但完成时间从 21.64 s 增至 32.58 s（p=0.008），总体工作负荷无显著差异。

Conclusion: 交互式 3D 剖切可视化在受控任务中改善了定位精度与主观空间理解，代价是额外操作时间；值得在真实手术导航场景中进一步评估。

Abstract: Purpose: Blended augmented reality (AR) overlays can provide ambiguous depth cues in which subsurface anatomy floats above the tissue surface. We investigate whether an interactive 3D cutaway visualization can improve robot-assisted target localization. Methods: We propose Virtual Box, an interactive 3D cutaway interface that allows users to independently manipulate the viewing perspective to inspect subsurface targets. In a controlled, counterbalanced within-subject tissue phantom study, 15 engineering students used Virtual Box and a depth-enhanced blended AR overlay to position a da Vinci instrument at virtual targets in a water tank. We used registered 3D transrectal ultrasound to measure 3D localization error and depth error. We also collected completion time and subjective ratings. Results: Virtual Box reduced mean 3D error from 12.92 to 4.96 mm (61.6% reduction) and depth error from 9.48 to 2.07 mm (78.2% reduction; both p < 0.001). Spatial understanding, depth perception, and confidence ratings were higher (all unadjusted p < 0.001), but completion time increased from 21.64 to 32.58 s (p = 0.008). Overall workload did not differ significantly. Conclusion: Virtual Box improved localization accuracy and perceived spatial understanding in this controlled task, with additional completion time, supporting further evaluation for surgical navigation.

</details>


### [451] [Energy-Based Policy Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02546)
*Weirui Ye,Yen-Jen Wang,Elvis Hsieh,Zhiyang Dou,Shibo Zhao,Pieter Abbeel,Yilun Du,Leslie Pack Kaelbling,Tomás Lozano-Pérez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"策略编排"问题:在动态高维任务中运行时选择"策略-目标对"而非仅选择策略;EPO 为每个目标条件策略学习复合能量函数(能量越低=可行性与目标达成度越高),运行时细化各策略目标并执行最低能量对,支持增量式纳入新策略。仿真显示精度-鲁棒性权衡改善,并在真实人形移动操作任务上完成 sim-to-real 部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层控制中固定的"规划器-策略"接口在接触、平衡、扰动变化快于高层更新频率时失效;执行阶段不仅需要决定运行哪个低层策略,还需决定给该策略什么策略特定的目标。作者将此形式化为策略编排问题。

Method: 面向模块化目标条件策略族,为每个策略学习覆盖低层目标的复合能量模型;运行时对每个策略的候选目标进行能量下降式细化,并据此在策略间选择性切换(执行最低能量策略-目标对);能量为策略私有,新策略仅需学习自身能量模型,无需重训已有策略或集中式调度器。仿真中冻结训练好的策略与能量,直接迁移到真实人形机器人做移动操作验证。

Result: 仿真中通过"先精化策略特定目标、再基于能量分数选择切换"提升了经验精度-鲁棒性权衡;同一组冻结策略与能量模型在真实人形机器人移动操作任务上成功部署,验证了 sim-to-real 可行性。

Conclusion: 将分层控制中的接口选择提升为策略-目标联合编排,能量建模提供了可组合、可增量的可行性判别机制,并为模块化策略族的在线编排与实机部署提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Hierarchical control scales robot behavior by separating task-level planning from low-level control. In dynamic, high-dimensional tasks, however, a fixed planner-to-policy interface can fail when contacts, balance, or disturbances evolve faster than high-level policy updates. Execution therefore requires choosing not only which low-level policy to run, but also which policy-specific goal should be given to it. We formulate this problem as policy orchestration: runtime selection of a policy-goal pair that is likely to remain feasible while tracking the planner target. We develop EPO, an energy-based policy orchestrator for modular goal-conditioned policy families. For each policy, EPO learns a composite energy over low-level goals, where lower energy corresponds to higher feasibility and more accurate target realization. At runtime, EPO refines each policy's goal and executes the lowest-energy policy-goal pair. Because energies are policy-specific, new policies can be incorporated by learning their own energy models, without retraining the existing policies or a centralized scheduler. In simulation, EPO improves the empirical precision-robustness trade-off by refining policy-specific goals before selectively switching among policies based on energy scores. We further demonstrate sim-to-real deployment of the same frozen policies and energy models on real humanoid loco-manipulation tasks. Project website: this https URL

</details>


### [452] [Sequential Recovery Updates for Learned Controllers under Successful-Trajectory Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02555)
*Zongtan Li,Tianming Liu,Ye Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出“约束技能入口规则而非参数”的持续学习框架：在失败状态处拟合反馈技能及入口规则，并通过累计成功轨迹回放的准入检验，保证组合控制器不破坏历史成功行为；两个人形系统、四条技能流上仅两次更新即新增62个恢复，且零损失；量化去除约束的代价（多恢复33个但破坏8个受保护轨迹）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的学习型控制器能从扰动中恢复，进一步改进需要学习“修正”以及“何时不施加修正”。冻结技能参数并不能防止新入口规则把旧技能曾成功处理的状态改道，因此需要约束入口而非参数，以避免破坏原有技能成功率。

Method: 在实测失败状态处搜索反馈技能，拟合读取观测的入口规则并拒绝所有累计成功轨迹上的状态；仅当组合控制器能自主复现新恢复、且精确回放全部受保护轨迹时才准入；给出保持前一控制器的有限轨迹充分条件；在两条人形系统的四个技能流上验证，并做消融以度量该保证的代价。

Result: 每条流两次更新共在192个留出扰动中新增62次恢复，且不损失基座控制器任何成功；移除入口约束可再恢复33个条件，但导致8条受保护轨迹完全无法完成；仅排除准入中已证明必要的状态则无法挽回该代价。

Conclusion: 将安全/保持性保证施加于技能入口规则（而非参数）是维护已学技能并持续叠加恢复能力的有效机制，但其保持性保证存在可度量的容量代价，且该代价不能通过最小化约束范围消除。

Abstract: A competent learned controller already recovers from many disturbances. Improving it means learning a correction, and learning when not to apply it. Freezing a skill's parameters does not settle the second half. In a controller that routes among frozen skills, a new entry rule can redirect the states an old skill succeeded on. We therefore constrain entry instead of parameters. Each update searches for a feedback skill at a measured failure. It fits an entry rule that reads observations and rejects every state on an accumulated successful trajectory. The skill is admitted only if the composed controller reproduces the new recovery on its own and replays every protected trajectory exactly. A finite-trajectory condition states when this preserves the previous controller. One mechanism runs on four streams: two motions on each of two humanoid systems. Two updates per stream add 62 recoveries over 192 withheld perturbations, and lose none of the base controller's successes. We then price that guarantee. Removing the constraint recovers 33 more conditions but stops eight protected ones from completing at all, and excluding only what admission proves necessary recovers none of that cost.

</details>


### [453] [Central pivot point control of a body-attached spring-mass runner: periodic gaits, stabilization, template embedding and approximate analytic return maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02564)
*İzel Sever,O. Kaan Karagöz,M. Mert Ankaralı*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出中央枢轴点(CPP)髋力矩律,使地面反作用力通过质心,从而精确解耦躯干俯仰,将躯干模型支撑相化为平面中心力问题,并给出首个躯干模型的解析返回映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SLIP模型忽略躯干,而含躯干模型中髋力矩耦合姿态与质心运动,破坏中心力结构,导致躯干模型几乎只能数值研究。作者希望恢复该解析结构。

Method: 定义CPP髋力矩律(使GRF过质心)以实现俯仰解耦;利用直立姿态下的时间反演对称得到单参数周期步态族;引入支撑相俯仰律与步幅级调节器稳定步态;在线性径向模板下推导支撑半径与恒动量扫掠的闭式解,并加入重力修正得到解析返回映射;构造基于该映射的deadbeat步幅控制器。

Result: 解析返回映射对离地速度与顶点位置预测的平均误差分别为1.6%与0.9%;近可逆性论证解释其单位乘子,标量方程以0.8%精度预测自然步态;deadbeat控制器可跟踪速度、高度与姿态变化,髋力矩与摩擦有界。

Conclusion: CPP使躯干模型可复用SLIP的解析工具,将姿态与质心运动解耦,为带躯干的跑步/步态控制提供可解析、可实时调节的框架。

Abstract: The spring-loaded inverted pendulum (SLIP) describes the center-of-mass (COM) motion of runners but has no trunk. In trunk models, the hip torque couples posture and COM motion and destroys the central-force structure on which SLIP analysis relies. As a result, trunk models have been studied almost only numerically. We show that this structure can be restored. The central pivot point (CPP), a hip-torque law that directs the ground reaction force through the COM, decouples pitch exactly and reduces stance to a planar central-force problem. At upright posture, time-reversal symmetry produces one-parameter families of periodic gaits. A stance-phase pitch law and a stride-level regulator stabilize all computed gaits, also with bounded hip torque and friction. Under CPP, any radial force law in virtual-leg coordinates can be embedded independently of posture. For a linear radial template, the stance radius and the constant-momentum sweep have exact closed forms. With a new gravity correction, the resulting analytic return map, to our knowledge the first for a trunk model, predicts liftoff velocity and apex position with mean errors of 1.6% and 0.9%. The natural gaits of the embedded runner are symmetric and need no force step at touchdown. A near-reversibility argument explains their unit multiplier, and a scalar equation predicts them within 0.8%. A deadbeat stride controller based on the analytic map tracks changes of speed, height and posture. CPP thus makes trunk models accessible to the analytic tools developed for SLIP.

</details>


### [454] [W2A: Distilling World Priors into Action Models for Real-Time Robotic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02600)
*Xiaopeng Zhang,Yongjin Mu,Yueyang Weng,Chengzhi Zhao,Yanjie Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: W2A 提出两阶段蒸馏框架，将视频世界模型（WAM）中间去噪表征中的监督信息蒸馏进动作模型，测试时完全丢弃视频模型，实现实时机器人操作控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）测试时需显式想象未来状态，计算开销与延迟大，难以用于实时机器人控制。

Method: 假设视频隐表征虽高维，但存在低维压缩子空间足以提供有效动作监督；据此采用两阶段蒸馏，把视频扩散模型中间去噪表征蒸馏为动作模型的低维监督信号，推理阶段不再运行视频模型。

Result: 仿真与真实环境实验均取得有竞争力的成功率；LIBERO 平均成功率 95.9%，推理速度较代表性 WAM 基线约快 21 倍。

Conclusion: 通过表征级蒸馏可在丢弃视频模型的前提下保留世界模型带来的性能收益，同时大幅提升推理效率，为实时机器人操作提供可行路线。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently shown great promise in robotic control, benefiting from the future imagination capability of large-scale pretrained video models. However, most existing WAMs require explicitly imagining future states at test time, incurring substantial computational overhead and latency that make them unsuitable for real-time robotic control. In this paper, we propose W2A, a two-stage distillation framework for real-time robotic manipulation that distills intermediate denoising representations from a video diffusion model into an action model during training, while entirely discarding the video model at test time. We hypothesize that although video latent representations are high-dimensional, a compressed low-dimensional subspace is sufficient to provide effective supervision for action generation. This makes it possible to transfer such information effectively into an action model. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate competitive success rates while significantly improving inference efficiency. On LIBERO, W2A achieves a 95.9% average success rate. More importantly, W2A achieves about 21x faster inference than the representative WAM baseline.

</details>


### [455] [MAPO: Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization for Universal Humanoid Motion Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02613)
*Seonghyeon Lim,Hyeonwoo Lee,Mincheol Kim,Kimin Lee,Hyun Myung*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MAPO 通过交替优化 MoE 策略中的 router 与 experts，避免动态路由导致的策略散度误估，从而改进人形机器人通用运动跟踪的强化学习训练稳定性与成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人通用运动跟踪需要高表达力的策略，MoE 借助动态路由被广泛采用；但在策略梯度更新中，旧策略与更新后策略之间的散度会因动态路由被误估，导致更新过于保守或过大，从而得到次优策略。

Method: 提出 Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization（MAPO），交替优化 router 与 experts，从而规避因路由动态变化引起的策略散度误估问题。

Result: MAPO 稳定跟踪 182 个 PPO+MoE 无法跟踪的运动，而 PPO+MoE 仅跟踪 1 个 MAPO 失败的运动；在对比方法中取得最高跟踪成功率，且在多数误差指标上最低。

Conclusion: 交替优化 MoE 组件可有效解决散度误估，显著提升人形机器人运动跟踪的鲁棒性与精度。

Abstract: Universal humanoid motion tracking is essential for enabling humanoid robots to perform diverse tasks in human environments. To capture the wide diversity of human motions, mixture-of-experts (MoE) policies have been widely adopted, leveraging dynamic routing to enhance policy expressiveness. However, we identify that divergence between old and updated policies can be misestimated during policy-gradient updates of MoE policies, due to their dynamic routing. Because most policy-gradient algorithms regulate policy updates based on the divergence, this misestimation can lead to either overly conservative or excessively large updates, which can yield a suboptimal policy. In this paper, we propose Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization (MAPO), which alternately optimizes the router and the experts to avoid the divergence misestimation. MAPO consistently tracks 182 motions that PPO with MoE fails to track, whereas PPO with MoE tracks only one motion that MAPO fails to track. MAPO also attains the highest tracking success rate among the compared methods and the lowest tracking error across most error metrics, demonstrating its superior performance. Videos can be found on the project website: this https URL

</details>


### [456] [Neural Integral Control Barrier Functions for Agile Collision Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02626)
*Dasari Raj Vamsi,Vrushabh Zinage,Efstathios Bakolas,Rohan Chandra*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 用神经ODE学动力学、模仿学标称控制器、监督回归学控制障碍函数，并以"可生存性"而非几何安全标注训练屏障，构建ICBF安全滤波器，用于6自由度动态自行车模型的敏捷竞速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典CBF要求控制仿射动力学、解析屏障函数与已知标称控制器；ICBF虽放宽仿射与输入约束假设，但仍依赖给定标称控制器和屏障函数，实际部署中三者都难以获得。

Method: （1）神经ODE拟合动力学；（2）模仿学习得到标称控制器；（3）监督回归学习屏障函数，标签由可生存性（存在满足执行器上限的紧急机动可避免越界）定义而非几何距离；（4）将学习的三个模块解析地组装为ICBF滤波约束，执行器上限作硬约束、学习到的屏障行可松弛以保证可行性，并给出与真实模型输入偏差的上界。

Result: 在6维动态自行车敏捷竞速任务上，200个留出赛道布局中消除全部12次不安全事件，成功率不降，单CPU核>100Hz；在约束满足基准上100%满足输入约束（联合训练基线仅53.38%），且在大摩擦误差下仍保持优势。

Conclusion: 端到端从数据学习动力学、标称控制器与可生存性屏障可构造实时、硬约束精确、全程可行的ICBF滤波器，值得向实车迁移验证。

Abstract: Control barrier functions (CBFs) are a standard way to keep a planner inside a safe set, but they assume control affine dynamics, a barrier function given in closed form, and a known nominal controller. Integral control barrier functions (ICBFs) remove the first assumption and absorb input constraints, yet they still assume a given nominal controller and a barrier function. In this work, we present an approach to learn all three from data, using neural ordinary differential equations (ODEs) for the dynamics, imitation for the nominal controller, and supervised regression for the barrier function. The learned dynamics, nominal controller, and the barrier function are used to build the ICBF filter constraint analytically. Furthermore, the barrier is trained on viability rather than geometry, meaning that a state counts as safe only if some emergency maneuver can still avoid the constraint under the actuator limits, a correction that geometric labels miss entirely and that grows with speed. Actuator limits then enter the online program as hard bounds while the learned barrier rows may be relaxed, which keeps the program solvable at every state and the actuator limits exact, and we bound how far the input it returns can drift from the one the true models would give. On agile racing with a 6-D dynamic bicycle, the filter removes all 12 unsafe episodes from 200 held out layouts at an unchanged success rate and above 100 Hz on one CPU core, holds the input constraint on every episode of a benchmark where a jointly trained baseline holds it on 53.38%, and keeps that advantage under large errors in the plant friction.

</details>


### [457] [DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02629)
*Haonan Ping,Jianshu Hu,Yimin Wang,Yi Zhu,Pai Liang,Qiyan Jin,Qirui Bao,Ying Qian,Xinyang Ding,Hongfei Qiao,Tianle Xue,Yucheng Bai,Soo Wei Jie,Shuguang Li,Yutong Ban*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DexArena长时程双臂灵巧操作基准：含10个长时程任务与30个阶段级任务，具备显式阶段划分、物理可信成功判据、统一接口与人遥操演示，系统评测学习与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有操作基准多聚焦孤立技能或支持有限末端执行器，难以系统评测多技能组合、精细双臂协调、可泛化视觉理解与鲁棒技能切换等长时程灵巧操作能力。

Method: 构建DexArena：覆盖家庭与工业场景的10个长时程任务及30个阶段级子任务；每个长时程任务由显式阶段与物理可信成功条件构成；提供统一基准接口、经校验的人体遥操演示、标准化仿真配置、场景随机化、轨迹回放与任务级评测。

Result: 广泛基线实验显示，现有策略在精细操作、场景变化泛化与技能组合方面仍面临显著挑战，中间进度与端到端完成率均不理想。

Conclusion: DexArena为长时程双臂灵巧操作提供了一个具有挑战性且可复现的评测平台，可支撑面向可泛化长时程灵巧行为的机器人学习方法研发与比较。

Abstract: Long-horizon dexterous manipulation remains a fundamental challenge for robot learning, requiring the composition of multiple skills, precise bimanual coordination, generalizable visual understanding, and robust skill transitions. Yet existing manipulation benchmarks largely emphasize isolated skills or support only a limited range of end-effectors, making these capabilities difficult to evaluate systematically. We introduce DexArena, a benchmark designed to evaluate learning and generalization in long-horizon bimanual dexterous manipulation. DexArena features 10 long-horizon tasks and 30 stage-level tasks spanning diverse household and industrial scenarios. Each long-horizon task is composed of explicitly defined stages with physically grounded success conditions, enabling reliable evaluation of both intermediate progress and end-to-end task completion. A unified benchmark interface and verified human-teleoperated demonstrations enable testing different policy learning algorithms, with standardized simulation configurations, scene randomization, trajectory replay, and task-level evaluation. Through extensive baseline experiments, we identify substantial challenges in precise manipulation, generalization to scene variation, and skill composition. DexArena establishes a challenging and reproducible benchmark for developing robot learning methods that move toward generalizable long-horizon dexterous behavior.

</details>


### [458] [HeLM: Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory for Non-Markovian Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02660)
*Gyeonghun Kim,Donghoon Kim,Minsoo Choi,Suyun Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HeLM：分层VLA框架，用显式语言记忆存任务历史，通过事件检测+事件触发更新克服马尔可夫假设，在非马尔可夫真实机器人任务上提升成功率并大幅降低记忆/时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA多为马尔可夫式单帧观测映射，缺乏工作记忆，在需要历史上下文的非马尔可夫任务（含跨episode持续上下文）中失效。

Method: 受"内心独白"启发，构建分层VLA：分解式事件检测识别任务相关事件，事件触发式更新维护显式语言记忆，仅在事件发生时写入，分层组织记忆并供策略读取。

Result: 10个非马尔可夫真实任务、56变体（含5个新提出的跨episode任务）；单episode成功率较最强基线+12.8pp，组合泛化子任务成功率78%；长时程下记忆占用降至1/4.5、速度提升2.5x（相对关键帧基线）。

Conclusion: 显式语言记忆+事件触发更新是低成本、高效的非马尔可夫VLA可行路径，真实机器人证据较扎实，但暂非本领域核心热点方向。

Abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have enabled fine manipulation capabilities, yet performing tasks that require working memory remains a key challenge. Most existing VLA architectures operate under a Markovian assumption, mapping only the current observation to an action, which leads to failure in non-Markovian environments. Inspired by the human 'inner monologue', we propose Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory (HeLM), a hierarchical VLA framework that maintains task-relevant history in explicit language through factorized event detection and event-triggered memory updates. We evaluate HeLM across 10 non-Markovian real-world tasks with 56 variants, including five newly formulated inter-episode tasks that require persistent context across task boundaries. HeLM improves intra-episode success by 12.8 percentage points over the strongest baseline and achieves 78% subtask success on compositional generalization tasks, while using up to 4.5x less memory and running 2.5x faster than the keyframe baseline at long horizons.

</details>


### [459] [Visuo-tactile Diffusion Policy for Robotic Manipulation with Auxiliary Tactile Dynamics Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02677)
*Kaihong Ouyang,Zihao Su,Chengxuan Zheng,Weiyi Lai,Dong Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出视觉-触觉扩散策略：用双视角相机与双指触觉图像各4步历史作为条件，经循环时序表示生成动作序列，并以"预测两步后触觉图像变化"的辅助目标只在训练期注入接触演化先验；MuJoCo装配任务成功率59.0%±2.6%，较纯视觉基线42.7%±1.5%提升16.3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程装配（抓取-对准-插入）中，视觉提供全局位姿与场景上下文，指尖触觉提供局部接触线索，尤其在接触状态变化时互补；现有策略往往缺乏对"动作如何改变接触"的显式建模。

Method: 视觉-触觉多模态扩散策略：(1) 输入为两路相机视图 + 两路指尖触觉图像的4步历史；(2) 循环时序表征融合双模态近期观测；(3) 辅助自监督目标——由时序表征与示教动作预测两步后的指尖图像变化，迫使表征编码动作-接触动力学；(4) 该辅助损失仅在训练阶段使用，不增加推理开销。

Result: MuJoCo 装配实验中，3个独立训练种子下完整模型平均成功率59.0%±2.6%，纯视觉基线42.7%±1.5%，提升16.3个百分点；绝对成功率仍偏低，且无真机验证。

Conclusion: 以触觉预测作为训练期辅助任务可有效提升长程接触丰富装配的性能，代价为零推理开销；但证据局限于仿真环境，泛化性与真机迁移尚待验证。

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic assembly requires reliable perception and action across grasping, alignment, and insertion. Vision captures global object pose and scene context, where as fingertip touch provides local contact cues that are especially useful as contact states change. We present a visuotactile diffusion policy that combines four-step histories from two camera views and two fingertip tactile images to condition action-sequence generation. A recurrent temporal representation integrates recent observations from both modalities. To encourage it to capture how contact evolves under action, an auxiliary objective predicts fingertip-image changes two steps ahead from the temporal representation and demonstrated actions. This objective is used only during training and adds no inference-time computation. Across three independent training seeds in MuJoCo assembly experiments, the full model achieves an average success rate of $59.0\% \pm 2.6\%$, improving on the visual-only baseline ($42.7\% \pm 1.5\%$) by 16.3 percentage points.

</details>


### [460] [Closing the Dynamics Gap through Self-Directed Robotic Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02691)
*Xilun Zhang,Liam Achenbach,Luis Pabon,Matthew Foutter,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 CUE:一个 agentic Real2Sim2Real 系统,仅在高层指令、无重置条件下自主构建感知、辨识物理参数(摩擦、恢复系数),并主动选择模拟最不准确的交互点来缩小 dynamics gap。台球场景仿真中隐藏物理条件下留出球位误差降 72%,并在真实球桌上部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Real2Sim2Real 可从相机观测重建场景,但接触富集动力学(摩擦、恢复系数)无法通过被动观测获得,形成"dynamics gap",导致仿真与真实不一致。

Method: Agentic 系统:仅给定高层指令、无环境重置;agent 自建感知管线、在线参数辨识、并以主动探索策略选择使仿真误差最大的交互进行采集与更新,形成闭环迭代精化。

Result: 仿真台球 25 组隐藏物理条件下,留出球位误差较最强基线降低 72%;同时在真实台球桌上完成部署验证。

Conclusion: 交互式主动辨识是弥合 Real2Sim2Real 动力学差距的可行路径;agent 化(自主感知+主动实验设计)在接触富集任务中具备实际迁移能力。

Abstract: Agentic Real2Sim2Real systems can reconstruct a scene in simulation from camera observations, but contact-rich dynamics such as friction and restitution cannot be observed without interaction. We call this the dynamics gap and present CUE, an agentic system that closes it by interacting with the environment itself. Given only a high-level instruction and no resets, the agent builds its own perception, identifies physical parameters, and targets interactions where its simulation is least accurate. On billiards, CUE reduces held-out ball-position error by 72% relative to the strongest baseline across 25 hidden-physics conditions in simulation, and we further deploy it on a real pool table. More details can be found on the project website: this https URL

</details>


### [461] [Source-Resolved Collective Cognition in Robotics: Mathematical Foundations for Multimodal and Collective Estimation, and Their Reach across the Cognition Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02693)
*Juergen Graf*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文系统构建广义奇异值分解(GSVD)及其估计理论：从线性代数与统计学基础(内积、谱定理、SVD、李群切扰动、Fisher信息、CCA等)出发，给出GSVD的两种表述与两条互补证明路径，并以单矩阵对的多视角手工计算、数值验证贯穿全书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GSVD是比较作用于同一未知量的两个线性算子的核心工具，可回答"第一算子沿哪些状态方向支配第二算子、支配多少"这一基无关问题；但现有文献中其周边数学与估计理论分散、缺乏自洽且数值可验证的系统论述。

Method: 专著式教材结构：(1)重新推导后续所需的全部线性代数与统计估计工具，含工作数值示例；(2)以透明形式与维度通用形式陈述GSVD，并用两条互补路径证明；(3)对同一小矩阵对用五种不同视角手算并数值校验；(4)对集合系统区分信息归因、子空间几何、统计依赖与决策论判别；(5)评估GSVD在认知回路中的作用与局限；(6)数值实践与经测试的参考实现，所有数字以双精度验证，假设与定理明确区分。

Result: 形成自洽、可复现的GSVD理论体系：基础部分完整推导、GSVD双形式与双证明、五视角案例验证、集体系统四类分析维度的明确划分、认知回路中的适用边界讨论，以及经双精度验证的参考实现。

Conclusion: GSVD可作为跨信息归因、依赖分析与判别决策的统一框架，其价值与适用范围依赖明确假设；作为教材型基础文献更适合作为方法论与工具参考，而非直接面向具身/物理AI任务的算法贡献。

Abstract: The Generalized Singular Value Decomposition (GSVD) is a central tool for comparing two linear operators that act on the same unknown. Once the output metrics are fixed, it answers the basis-independent question "along which state directions does the first operator dominate the second, and by how much?". This foundational volume builds the GSVD and its surrounding estimation theory from the ground up. Part I re-derives every piece of linear algebra and statistical estimation machinery needed later -- inner products, the four subspaces, orthogonal matrices, the spectral theorem, quadratic forms, the ordinary SVD, Lie-group tangent perturbations, Jacobians, covariance, whitening, Fisher information, CCA, mutual information, discrimination criteria, and covariance intersection -- with self-contained derivations and worked numerical examples. Part II states the GSVD in both a transparent and a dimensionally general form, then proves it by two complementary routes. Part III works one small matrix pair through five different lenses, each computed by hand and verified numerically. Part IV separates information attribution, subspace geometry, statistical dependence, and decision-theoretic discrimination for collective systems. Part V evaluates the role and limits of the GSVD across the cognition loop. Part VI covers numerical practice, including a tested reference implementation. Every number printed in this document was verified in double precision. Where a statement is an assumption rather than a theorem, it is labelled as such.

</details>


### [462] [Right Ranking, Wrong Scale: Reproducing the Robotic World Model's Dynamics Model and Testing the Uncertainty of Its Follow-up](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02699)
*Joyjeet Singh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 复现RWM动力学模型并检验其后续工作RWM-U用于离线策略优化奖励惩罚的不确定性估计，发现集成体分歧排序能力好但覆盖严重不足，并发现评估流水线两处缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RWM-U在离线策略优化中用集成体不一致度惩罚奖励，其不确定性估计的可靠性此前缺乏独立验证；作者希望判断该信号是否能真实反映长时域rollout误差。

Method: 重实现RWM动力学模型（梯度与发布模型一致）；在留出数据上比较"用模型自身rollout训练"与单步训练；以Spearman秩相关评估集成体分歧对rollout误差的排序能力；用一/二σ覆盖率检验校准性；对集成成员在其自身预测上滚动；采用horizon-specific重缩放并做留一episode评估。

Result: 长时域(预注册)上自rollout训练在全部10个episode上优于单步训练，但短时单步窗口更差。分歧排序良好(100步ρ=0.90)，然而一σ覆盖率仅4.6%（校准高斯为68%），成员滚动后升至33%。采样预测上的平方误差损失使各成员方差趋零。按horizon重缩放可恢复LOEO下的一σ覆盖，但二σ覆盖仍不达标。另指出发布评估流水线两处缺陷。

Conclusion: RWM-U的集成分歧适合作相对排序信号，但绝对值严重欠置信，直接用于奖励惩罚会对长时域误差激励不足；需方差正则/horizon校准。结论限于单一机器人、单一步态、单一数据集，且未训练策略，泛化性待验证。

Abstract: We reimplement the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) and test the uncertainty estimate that its follow-up, RWM-U, uses to penalize reward in offline policy optimization. Our implementation matches the released model's gradients. On held-out data, training on the model's own rollouts beats one-step training at the preregistered long horizon for all ten episodes, but loses on short one-step windows. RWM-U's ensemble disagreement ranks rollout errors better than forecast step (Spearman rho = 0.90 at 100 steps), yet its spread substantially understates error: one-sigma coverage on the released checkpoint is 4.6% at 100 steps, versus 68% for a calibrated Gaussian. Rolling ensemble members on their own predictions raises coverage to 33%. The implemented squared-error loss on sampled predictions drives each member's variance toward zero. A horizon-specific rescaling restores one-sigma coverage under leave-one-episode-out evaluation, but not two-sigma coverage. We also identify two defects in the released evaluation pipeline. The study covers one robot, one gait and one dataset; it trains no policy.

</details>


### [463] [Beyond Policy Patches: Distilling RL Specialists into Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02777)
*Zhennan Jiang,Tingying Xie,Shilong Ji,Shu'ang Yu,Tianxing Zhou,Yuhui Chen,Jiahuan Gao,Kaizhi Xie,Yuanfan Xu,Feng Gao,Yu Wang,Haoran Li,Dongbin Zhao,Chao Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: REPAIR：用critic加权的流匹配蒸馏，把轻量RL专家的能力迁移进单一VLA，部署时移除专家即可在6个真机任务上达100%成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略在长程操作的非关键阶段表现良好，但在短精度关键阶段易失败；轻量RL专家可修复这些问题，但需保留辅助控制器与切换机制，部署复杂。

Method: 价值引导蒸馏框架：对关键阶段观测查询专家生成多个动作候选，用其critic加权构造监督分布，以共享的加权流匹配目标先离线初始化（专家辅助rollout观测），再在自身执行观测上做on-policy精炼；专家仅提供监督信号，部署时移除。

Result: 6个真实机器人任务、每任务30次试验，全部达到100%成功率；所有任务末端执行器jerk均值均低于专家辅助执行。

Conclusion: critic加权监督分布+on-policy精炼可有效将RL专家能力内化到单一VLA中，消除部署期辅助控制器，并获得更平滑的动作轨迹。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can handle noncritical stages of long-horizon manipulation yet fail during short precision-critical phases. Lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) specialists can address these failures without directly applying RL to the full VLA, but retain auxiliary controllers and switching mechanisms at deployment. We study how to transfer their capabilities into a single flow-matching VLA. Direct imitation of specialist rollouts can reproduce action jitter and leave the VLA unprepared for states encountered during its own execution. We introduce REPAIR, a value-guided distillation framework that combines offline initialization with on-policy refinement. At each critical-phase observation, REPAIR queries the corresponding specialist for multiple action candidates and weights them using its critic to construct a supervision distribution. A shared weighted flow-matching objective trains the VLA first on observations from specialist-assisted rollouts, then on observations collected through its own execution. Specialists provide supervision without taking control during on-policy collection and are removed at deployment. Across six real-robot tasks with 30 evaluation trials per task, REPAIR achieves 100% success on all six tasks, with lower mean end-effector jerk than specialist-assisted execution on every task.

</details>


### [464] [SomaAlign: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Representation Learning for Soft Robotic Grasping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02794)
*Haoyuan Wang,Shuai Peng,Yongkai Liao,Yuxiao Sun,Wei Luo,Xinxing Chen,Jian Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Soma 多模态软体抓取数据集（100物/1000轨迹/74,914样本，RGB+深度+触觉+IMU+文本）与 Soma-Success 抓取结果数据集；提出三阶段 SomaAlign（掩码重建估计模态可靠性→可靠性感知自适应温度的对比对齐→冲突感知语义约束），跨模态检索 Recall@10 达 90.66%，冻结编码器在抓取结果分类/预测达 94.59%/84.07%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人抓取的多模态感知受模态相关噪声、语义歧义与缺乏协同多传感器数据制约，需要统一的数据与表征学习基础。

Method: 构建 Soma 数据集（按软件采集周期分组的六模态样本）与 Soma-Success 独立结果数据集；SomaAlign 三阶段训练：掩码重建估计相对模态可靠性、基于配对自适应温度的可靠性感知对比对齐、冲突感知语义约束（保持全局特征几何）。下游用冻结编码器+轻量探针评估迁移。

Result: 30 项有向跨模态检索平均 Recall@10 90.66%；支持物理属性识别、多模态问答、跨模态生成与跨数据集迁移；Soma-Success 上事后分类 94.59%、早期预测 84.07%。

Conclusion: 提供面向软体操作鲁棒多模态感知的数据与表征学习基础，模态可靠性建模与冲突感知对齐是有效关键设计。

Abstract: Robust multimodal perception for soft robotic grasping is challenged by modality-dependent noise, semantic ambiguity, and limited coordinated multisensory data. We introduce Soma, a dataset containing 100 objects, 1,000 continuous grasping trajectories, and 74,914 multimodal samples grouped by software acquisition cycle, spanning remote RGB, hand RGB, depth, tactile, IMU, and structured text observations. We also collect Soma-Success, an independent grasp-outcome dataset with 1,000 trials (998 retained after quality control), to evaluate frozen-encoder transfer for post-hoc grasp outcome classification and early grasp success prediction. Built on Soma, SomaAlign learns multimodal representations in three stages: masked reconstruction estimates relative modality reliability; reliability-aware contrastive alignment uses pair-specific adaptive temperatures to adjust alignment sharpness; and conflict-aware semantic constraints improve intra-sample cross-modal consistency while preserving global feature geometry. SomaAlign achieves an average Recall@10 of 90.66% across 30 directed cross-modal retrieval tasks. The learned representations also support physical attribute recognition, multimodal question answering, cross-modal generation, and cross-dataset transfer to grasp outcome prediction. On Soma-Success, frozen SomaAlign encoders with lightweight probes achieve 94.59% post-hoc classification accuracy and 84.07% early prediction accuracy. Together, Soma, Soma-Success, and SomaAlign provide a data and representation-learning foundation for robust and transferable multimodal perception in soft robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [465] [ReGATE: Recurrent Gated Visual Fusion for Reactive Humanoid-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02871)
*Hao Zhu,Jorge Peña-Queralta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ReGATE：面向人形机器人全身 loco-manipulation 的教师-学生递入门控融合控制器，融合自我中心深度、本体感知与在线运动/接触指令，用循环适配器在无外部物体位姿估计情况下预测物体几何与接触状态，实现抓取-搬运-释放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人做 loco-manipulation 时需在视觉观测不完整、接触转瞬即逝的条件下协调抓取、运输与释放，并响应在线指令；现有感知式运动控制中的循环门控融合尚未扩展到该类任务。

Method: 教师-学生框架；循环适配器做交互状态估计（物体几何+物理接触），head-wise 与全局门控调节视觉更新注入本体感知通路；视觉接地与损坏课程训练适配器；相位感知初始化提升短暂接触过渡态覆盖。

Result: 仿真：静态物体抓取 330 次试验成功率 85.2%（VisualMimic 同协议 48.5%）；移动物体 440 次试验 85.9%。Unitree G1 上完成指令化抓取-搬运-释放与横向偏移箱体获取；定性实验显示初始观测后、接触指令前摄像头被遮挡仍可成功抓取。

Conclusion: 首次将板载深度与本体感知的循环门控融合从感知式运动控制推广到视觉中断条件下的人形 loco-manipulation，仿真与真机均验证有效性。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinating object acquisition, transport, and release from onboard sensing while responding to user commands and incomplete visual observations. We present ReGATE, a whole-body controller that combines egocentric depth, proprioception, and online locomotion and contact commands. Built on a teacher-student framework, ReGATE integrates interaction-state estimation through a recurrent adapter that predicts object geometry and physical contact without an external object-pose estimator. Head-wise and global gates regulate visual updates to a proprioceptive pathway. A visual-grounding and corruption curriculum trains the adapter, while phase-aware initialization increases coverage of brief contact transitions. In simulation, ReGATE achieves 85.2% success across 330 static-object acquisition trials, compared with 48.5% for VisualMimic under the same protocol, and 85.9% across 440 moving-object acquisition trials. Deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates commanded grasp-transport-release sequences and acquisition of laterally displaced boxes. A qualitative hardware experiment further demonstrates successful box acquisition when the camera is occluded after an initial observation and before the contact command. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to extend recurrent gated fusion of onboard depth and proprioception from perceptive locomotion to humanoid loco-manipulation under interrupted visual sensing.

</details>


### [466] [Design and Experimental Validation of the Separation and Deployment System for the CHERI Lunar Micro-Rovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02872)
*Ahmet Mustafa Kangal,Oğuzhan Şahan,Teoman Efe Aycan,Görkem Egemen Güloğlu,Halil Ersin Söken,Ali Emre Turgut,Uluç Saranlı,Mustafa Mert Ankaralı*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CHERI月球微型巡视器（5 kg）分离系统的设计、优化与测试：铝制底板+中心非火工锁紧释放机构+非对称四弹簧弹射阵列，通过等效底盘阻尼修正多体动力学模型、重优化弹簧，并用密度法拓扑优化将底板一阶模态从34 Hz提升至84 Hz（要求70 Hz、质量预算1.6 kg），最终通过正弦/随机振动与冲击验收测试，光学动捕分离试验验证了仿真与着陆间隙。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行星微型巡视器需在承受发射振动的同时可靠地与着陆器分离；初期分离试验出现速度亏损，且硬件迭代在振动试验中先后因弹簧卡滞与底板34 Hz一阶模态而失败，需要系统性地解决能量损失建模与结构动刚度问题。

Method: 1）将柔性轮腿与底盘的弹射行程能量吸收等效为多体动力学模型中的底盘阻尼并据此重优化弹簧；2）针对弹簧导向座卡滞与平板低频模态，采用密度法拓扑优化提升基频；3）开展正弦/随机振动与冲击验收试验；4）用质量匹配的1/6质量模型配合光学动捕进行分离与着陆试验。

Result: 拓扑优化后基频由34 Hz升至84 Hz，满足70 Hz着陆器要求且质量约1.6 kg；最终构型通过验收级正弦、随机与冲击试验无结构退化；光学动捕分离试验确认脱离着陆器，自由飞行与仿真偏差在弹射速度的跑次间波动范围内；着陆结果主要受触地与稳定动力学支配，残余俯仰角速度是主要可控设计参数。

Conclusion: 机械分离系统可通过"等效阻尼建模+拓扑优化+分级试验"闭环实现高可靠设计；因着陆结局由触地动力学主导，自扶正恢复应视为部署架构的组成部分而非附加功能。

Abstract: Reliable separation mechanisms are critical for planetary micro-rovers, which must withstand launch vibrations and then eject the vehicle clear of the lander. This paper presents the design, optimization, and testing of the separation system of the CHERI (Challenging Environment Exploration Rovers for Intelligence) lunar micro-rovers. Sized for a 5 kg vehicle, the assembly comprises an aluminum ground plate, a central non-explosive hold-down and release mechanism, and an asymmetric four-spring ejection array. Initial separation trials revealed a velocity deficit caused by energy absorption in the flexible wheel-legs and chassis during the ejection stroke. This loss was represented as equivalent chassis damping in a multi-body dynamic model, and the springs were re-optimized accordingly. Early hardware iterations failed vibration testing, first through spring jamming in the guide housings and then through a 34 Hz fundamental mode of the flat ground plate. A density-based topology optimization raised the fundamental frequency to 84 Hz, above the 70 Hz requirement of the lander, within a 1.6 kg mass budget. The final configuration passed acceptance-level sinusoidal vibration, random vibration, and shock testing without structural degradation. Separation tests with a weight-matched one-sixth mass model, tracked by optical motion capture, confirmed clearance of the lander and reproduced the simulated free flight to within the run-to-run variation of the measured ejection velocity. These tests further showed that landing outcome is dominated by touchdown and settling dynamics, indicating that the residual pitch rate is the main controllable design parameter and confirming self-righting recovery as an integral element of the deployment architecture.

</details>


### [467] [AnchorHEC: Targetless Hand-Eye Calibration of Wrist and Fixed Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02884)
*Guebin Hwang,Taeyeop Lee,Yeonseo Lee,Hyosup Shin,Sungho Jo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AnchorHEC：无需标定物的手眼标定框架，用RGB图像、正运动学(FK)与已知内参，在单一流程中同时标定腕部相机与固定相机；通过FK约束的腕部图像光束法平差降低重建位姿/尺度误差影响，再用精化后的腕部外参与FK三角化度量点以估计固定相机位姿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有腕部+固定相机的机器人系统需要两套相机-机器人外参；主流手眼标定依赖标定靶或本体观测，基于3D重建的场景法虽免标定物但仅适用于腕部相机。

Method: 用FK与共享的3D基础模型重建初始化两类相机外参；执行FK约束的腕部图像捆绑调整以抑制重建位姿与尺度误差；若精化失败或内点过少，则放宽对可能不准确FK位姿与镜头参数的约束；最后用精化腕部变换与FK三角化度量点、求解固定相机位姿。仅需RGB、FK与已知内参。

Result: 在三种骨干网络上，仿真中两类相机的平均标定误差相对基于重建的基线在平移上降低86.4%、旋转降低71.6%；并在真实机器人上完成验证。

Conclusion: 免标定物、无需本体观测的统一手眼标定流程可同时处理腕部与固定相机，且对重建尺度/位姿误差与FK噪声具鲁棒性，具备真机可行性。

Abstract: Recent robot systems combine wrist and fixed cameras, requiring camera-to-robot transforms for both. Most hand-eye calibration methods rely on targets or robot-body observations. Scene-based methods using 3D reconstruction require neither but address only wrist cameras. We introduce AnchorHEC, a targetless hand-eye calibration framework for wrist and fixed cameras in a single procedure using RGB images, forward kinematics (FK), and known camera intrinsics. We initialize both camera types using FK and a shared 3D foundation model reconstruction. FK-constrained wrist-image bundle adjustment reduces the impact of reconstructed pose and scale errors. If this refinement fails or retains too few inliers, we relax the constraints on potentially inaccurate FK poses and lens parameters. We use the refined wrist transform and FK to triangulate metric points and estimate fixed-camera poses. Across three backbones, calibration errors in simulation decrease by 86.4% in translation and 71.6% in rotation, averaged over both camera types, relative to reconstruction-based baselines. We also validate AnchorHEC on a physical robot. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [468] [An intelligent satellite must do nothing well](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02922)
*Fabrizio Pilone,Giordana Bucchioni*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 以"设计轴"分解视角重新分析航天器自主巡检目标：燃料效率主要由三件事决定——是否允许漂移、状态是否记录漂移历史、规划视界是否足够长；算法重要性体现在其表征能力上（基于模型且世界模型含燃料项），并在决策层下方加CBF滤波器保证安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域内常把自主巡检简化为"经典下一最佳视角规划 vs 强化学习"的算法之争，作者认为算法选择是最不重要的设计轴，需要在一维变量控制的"阶梯"实验上找出真正决定燃料消耗的设计因素，并解决学习策略缺乏安全保证的问题。

Method: 构建单轴受控的阶梯式对比实验（controlled ladder），逐一改变：是否允许自由漂移（利用轨道动力学的自然轨迹零燃料观测）、状态中是否编码漂移历史/轨迹依赖、规划视界长度；并比较有/无模型算法及其世界模型是否对燃料建模；最终在决策层下方串联控制障碍函数（CBF）滤波器做安全过滤。

Result: 三个因素中任意缺失一项，燃料开销翻倍以上；基于模型但世界模型忽略燃料的智能体燃料消耗高出数倍；CBF滤波器在2000个评估回合中消除了全部禁飞区（keep-out-zone）违规。

Conclusion: 算法并非主要设计轴，燃料效率由"漂移许可—状态记忆—规划视界"三者共同决定，算法的影响经由其可表征内容实现；任何学习策略都不能内生安全，需在决策层下叠加CBF等安全过滤层失效保护。

Abstract: Autonomous inspection of a resident space object is usually posed as a contest between classical next-best-view planning and reinforcement learning. We argue that the choice of algorithm is the least informative of the design axes. An inspector spacecraft has no rest state: when it stops thrusting, orbital dynamics carry it along a natural trajectory that can be used to observe the target at no fuel cost. On a controlled ladder in which one design axis is varied at a time, fuel efficiency turns out to be set by three things: whether the agent is allowed to drift, whether its state records where drifting has taken it, and whether its planning horizon is long enough for the benefit to appear. Removing any one of them doubles the fuel bill or more. The algorithm still matters, but through what it can represent: a model-based agent whose learned world model ignores fuel spends several times more of it. Finally, no learned policy is safe by construction, and a control barrier function filter beneath the decision layer removed every keep-out-zone violation in two thousand evaluation episodes.

</details>


### [469] [PointPilot: Unified Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric 3D Point Flow Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02930)
*Yihan Fang,Yuxin Tian,Ruixiang Wang,Zhanqi Zhang,Xing Hu,Zhen Yang,Huayi Zhou,Yongyi Su,Wei Gao,Kui Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PointPilot: 以3D点流预测为核心的任务聚焦、3D对齐操作框架，仅建模任务相关物体（含夹爪），统一坐标系下支持跨具身零样本泛化与闭环自动执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人泛化需同时应对具身形态、相机位姿、场景布局等多维域变化；现有方法依赖全局场景建模（含冗余部分）、需额外action head/action expert，且多为半自动或单臂专用，跨具身数据难以统一利用。

Method: 端到端联合学习子任务规划、任务相关物体定位（grounding）与3D点流预测；将机器夹爪视为物体，只预测任务相关物体的点流而非全局场景；在统一3D坐标系中表示空间，使异构数据（不同具身/相机/场景）共享同一3D点流空间；由点流直接驱动闭环、全自动的动作执行，跨多种操作模式，无需独立训练的动作专家或动作头。

Result: 仿真与真实世界实验验证有效性；实现零样本具身泛化：单一训练策略可直接部署于未见具身并完成操作任务，无需额外微调。

Conclusion: 以任务聚焦的3D点流作为具身无关的中间表示，是替代动作头、实现跨具身泛化与多模式统一操作的可行路径。

Abstract: Generalization remains a central challenge in robotics, calling for policies that address domain variations from multiple dimensions such as diverse embodiments, camera poses, and/or scene layouts. In order to approach this problem, we introduce PointPilot, a task-focused and 3D aligned manipulation framework built on a 3D space point-flow prediction. Rather than modeling the global scene, PointPilot only represents task-focused objects (robot grippers treated as objects), avoiding the prediction of potentially redundant scene parts unrelated to the manipulation tasks. Moreover, PointPilot aligns 3D spatial representation in one unified coordinate and supports closed-loop and fully automatic action execution across different manipulation modes from object point flow without a separately trained action expert, while existing works typically need an extra action head or are (semi-)automatic and single-arm mode specific. Given sensor observations and language instructions, our model jointly learns subtask planning, task-relevant object grounding, and 3D point flow prediction in an end-to-end way. By processing heterogeneous data in a shared 3D point flow space, PointPilot is able to absorb demonstrations from different embodiments. Extensive simulative and real world experiments validate our method. Notably, we demonstrate zero-shot embodiment generalization with PointPilot. A single trained policy can be deployed on previously unseen embodiments and successfully complete manipulation tasks without any additional fine-tuning.

</details>


### [470] [RESONATE: a Real Social Navigation Testbed for Autonomous Service Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02937)
*Stefano Trepella,Andrea Ostuni,Mauro Martini,Irene Borgini,Marcello Chiaberge*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RESONATE 是一个基于统一机器人平台、共享 ROS 2 栈、精确轨迹真值与结构化社交交互场景的可复现真实世界社交导航基准，含 8 种控制器配置 × 8 场景 × 5 次重复共 320 次物理实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交导航（human-aware navigation）对在人类环境中作业的自主服务机器人至关重要，但缺乏大规模真实世界基准，导致方法间难以公平比较、进展受限。

Method: 构建统一硬件平台 + ROS 2 软件栈 + 轨迹 ground truth + 结构化社交交互场景的真实测试床；评估 8 种控制器配置（经典与预测型局部规划器结合不同社交建模策略），覆盖 8 个代表性场景，每场景重复 5 次，共 320 次物理实验；评测融合定量导航/社交指标与基于参与者的主观问卷，联合衡量效率、安全、舒适度与感知社交性。

Result: 结果显示各方法存在场景相关的性能权衡：DWA + 高斯社交代价地图可靠性最佳；SFM-MPPI 在鲁棒性、导航效率与社交接受度之间取得最佳平衡。

Conclusion: RESONATE 为社区提供真实世界基准、可复用基线、数据与测试床以及一致的评测协议，推动社交感知导航研究。作为基准类工作，其价值在于评测基础设施而非新算法；若后续开放代码/数据，可作为该方向的标准化对照平台。

Abstract: Social navigation is essential for autonomous service robots operating in human environments, but progress remains constrained by the lack of extensive real-world benchmarks. This paper presents the Real Social Navigation Testbed (RESONATE), a reproducible benchmark for human-aware navigation based on a unified robotic platform, a shared ROS 2 software stack, precise trajectory ground truth, and structured social interaction scenarios. We evaluate eight controller configurations, combining classical and predictive local planners with different social modeling strategies, over eight representative scenarios with five repetitions each, yielding 320 physical experiments. The benchmark combines quantitative navigation and social metrics with participant-based qualitative assessments to jointly measure efficiency, safety, comfort, and perceived social behavior. Results reveal scenario-dependent trade-offs among the tested methods. The algorithms that stands out for their performance are the DWA with Gaussian social costmaps for its reliability, and the SFM-MPPI to provide the best balance between robustness, navigation efficiency, and social acceptance. Overall, RESONATE supports the robotics community with a real-world benchmark, reusable baselines, data, and testbed, and a consistent evaluation protocol for advancing socially aware navigation research.

</details>


### [471] [Positive Safety Margins from Artificial Potential Field Reward Augmentation for Size-Robust Obstacle Avoidance under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02947)
*Ziyi Hao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在障碍物尺寸/位置不可观测的仿真Panda到达任务中，加入一项水平人工势场奖励项，即可在不向策略暴露障碍几何的前提下诱发安全裕度，显著提升半径外推时的无碰撞成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景中障碍物大小与精确位置常不可观测，使以障碍几何为输入的RL控制器不可用；而仅含碰撞惩罚的奖励不约束障碍外间隙，在步长代价下策略会贴面绕行，一旦障碍半径超出训练值即失效。作者希望仅通过一个解析奖励项在隐藏观测下注入安全裕度。

Method: 在仿真Franka Emika Panda到达任务的奖励中加入水平人工势场项，对两根支柱（标称布局固定、随机漂移）周围安全裕度内的接近程度施加惩罚；策略观测中不包含障碍几何。设置半径0.03–0.055 m扫描、30个随机种子，对比有无该项；并在三种RL求解器与全观测设定下复现，另与已知支柱位置的经典势场规划器对比。

Result: 隐藏观测下安全成功率达88%以上，无该奖励项在最大半径处低于10%；最小间隙47.9 mm（对照9.6 mm）；训练期碰撞消除早至少8倍（中位步数）；所有分布外半径上优势统计显著，跨三种求解器与全观测一致；安全成功率与经典势场规划器相当；代价是路径长度增加约19%。

Conclusion: 单一解析奖励塑形项即可在障碍几何不可观测时提供固定缓冲式安全裕度，泛化到未见半径且实现简单、与求解器无关；但裕度为固定缓冲而非随半径自适应，并带来约19%路径代价。方法限于仿真标称布局，属增量式奖励塑形贡献。

Abstract: Collision-free reaching is central to manipulation, yet real cells often leave the size and exact position of an obstacle unobserved, which excludes reinforcement learning controllers that take obstacle geometry as input. A reward limited to a collision penalty does not depend on the clearance outside the obstacle, so under a step cost its learned policy skims the obstacle surface and fails once the obstacle radius exceeds its training value. We investigate whether a single analytic reward term can induce a safety margin without exposing the obstacle to the policy. We augment the reward of a simulated Franka Emika Panda reaching task with a horizontal artificial potential field that penalizes proximity within a safety margin around each of two pillars (fixed nominal layout, random drift). Under hidden observation, policies trained with this term maintain a safe success rate above 88% across a radius sweep from 0.03 m to 0.055 m (30 seeds), while policies without it fall below 10% at the maximum tested radius; the term induces a minimum clearance of 47.9 mm against 9.6 mm without it and eliminates training collisions at least eight times earlier (median steps). The advantage is statistically significant at all out-of-distribution radii and holds across three reinforcement learning solvers and under full observation. Its safe success rate is comparable to that of a classical potential-field planner given the pillar positions. The margin is a fixed buffer rather than an adaptation to the radius, and it lengthens the path by about 19%.

</details>


### [472] [ReContact: Reconstruct and Retarget Human Contacts from Video for Contact-Rich Humanoid Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02968)
*Zhongkai Gu,Yang Liu,Wei Zhu,Mitsuhiro Hayashibe*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ReContact，用物体中心的接触计划（接触阶段、接触对、锚点、压紧方向、粘/滑模式）统一重建与重定向人类-物体接触转移，接触先验稳定遮挡下的物体位姿重建，并在冻结全身跟踪器上以残差策略奖励按锚点与方向施加接触力；仿真大腿支撑换手率达83.5%，一策略对247条参考重解新摆放将管件传递成功率20.4%→97.8%，并在Unitree G1 实机完成9类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人的全身接触转移可从人类视频规模化获取，但身体遮挡导致物体位姿跟踪失效、重定向运动被污染；且仅复现物体轨迹无法保证在预期接触点施加稳定力，后续易滑落。因此需要显式建模接触计划以同时纠正几何重建与接触力。

Method: 以接触计划为核心表示（接触阶段、接触对、锚点、压紧方向、粘/滑模式）；用接触先验约束遮挡下的物体位姿重建；采用冻结全身跟踪器 + 残差强化学习策略，奖励在计划锚点接触且力方向对齐；单策略在多参考上泛化到新物体摆放。

Result: 仿真大腿支撑换手任务：三个训练种子上平均83.5%达两次掌底托持，最佳适配基线约0.16%；247条参考训练的单策略将新摆放的管内传递成功率由20.4%（仅源参考）提升至97.8%；实机Unitree G1 上执行7项接触丰富操作与2项移动操作任务。

Conclusion: 显式接触计划可同时缓解遮挡下的位姿重建误差与接触力不匹配，提供人类视频到全身接触重定向的可扩展管线，并在真实人形上验证。

Abstract: Contact transitions allow humanoid robots to redistribute object support across the whole body, enabling manipulation beyond hand-only grasps. Human videos provide a scalable source of such transitions for robots to learn from. However, body occlusion disrupts object pose tracking and corrupts retargeted motion. Moreover, accurately reproducing the object trajectory does not ensure that the robot applies stabilizing forces at the intended contacts, risking slips or drops in later phases. To address these challenges, we propose ReContact, which reconstructs and retargets human-object interactions through an object-centric contact plan. The plan specifies contact phases, contact pairs, anchors, pressing directions, and sticking or sliding modes. Contact priors stabilize object pose reconstruction through occlusion. A residual policy over a frozen whole-body tracker is rewarded for making contact at planned anchors with forces aligned to the specified directions. In simulation, on a thigh-supported regrasp task, ReContact achieves the planned two-palm bottom hold in 83.5 of episodes over three training seeds, versus 0.16% for the best adapted baseline. One policy trained on 247 references re-solved for new placements raises in-workspace tube-transfer success from 20.4% (source reference only) to 97.8%. On a real Unitree G1, policies execute seven contact-rich manipulation and two loco-manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [473] [MS-DOTT: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Off-Road Traversability Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02992)
*Shivani Subramanyan,Saksham Sharma,Samahith SA,Ahaan Kotian,Suresh Sundaram*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MS-DOTT:多模态越野数据集,融合长距3D与短距高分辨率感知、本体感知、4D RADAR,覆盖正常/弱光/无光条件,并验证SOTA多传感器融合用于可通行性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越野自主导航需要跨空间尺度与多成像模态的鲁棒感知,但现有传感配置难以同时捕获远场环境上下文与近场地形细节,且缺乏多光照条件下带本体动态的多模态数据支撑可通行性估计研究。

Method: 构建数据集:采集正常光、弱光、无光三种光照下的轨迹;同步长距大尺度与短距高分辨率2D/3D传感(相机+激光雷达点云),加入提供点云速度估计的4D RADAR,并融合本体感知信号追踪车辆动力学;通过适配SOTA多传感器融合方法做可通行性估计以展示数据价值。

Result: 摘要未给出定量结果,仅以适配SOTA融合方法完成可通行性估计的任务验证,表明数据可支撑感知、融合与可通行性研究。

Conclusion: 该数据集为越野感知、多传感器融合与非结构化环境可通行性估计提供多模态、多光照基准,有望推动相关方法与系统发展。

Abstract: Autonomous robots are gaining traction in off-road environments, driven by their rising demand in agriculture, defense, and search-and-rescue operations. However, these environments are inherently unpredictable and navigation remains a formidable challenge given the complex environmental conditions including challenging terrain and varying illumination. Off-road autonomy requires robust perception across multiple spatial scales and imaging modalities, yet most sensing setups struggle to capture both far-field environmental context and near-field terrain detail simultaneously across various illumination conditions. To facilitate development of robust off-road perception and traversability estimation systems, we propose MS-DOTT (Multi-Sensor Dataset for Off-road Terrain Traversability) a comprehensive multi-modal off-road dataset with long-range 3D sensing and short-range, fine-grained perception to facilitate high-fidelity terrain understanding by combining proprioceptive signals for tracking vehicle dynamics with exteroceptive imaging and pointcloud data. The dataset includes trajectories recorded across nominal lighting, low-light, and no-light conditions with diverse 2D and 3D sensing for both long-range large-scale and short-range high-resolution sensing, as well as 4D RADAR measurements that provide velocity estimates for detected pointclouds. We demonstrate the utility of the dataset by adapting a SOTA multi-sensor fusion method for the purpose of traversability estimation. This dataset will aid the robotics community in advancing research and development of methods for traversability estimation, off-road perception and multi-sensor fusion in unstructured environments.

</details>


### [474] [SyncHeC: Markerless Spatio-Temporal Hand-Eye Calibration via Differentiable Rendering and Continuous-Time Joint Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02999)
*Zhengdong Hong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SyncHeC：用稠密可微渲染从单条机器人轨迹联合估计无标记手眼标定与图像-关节状态时间偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续运动下的无标记手眼标定需同时求解相机几何与图像-关节状态间的时间延迟，二者强耦合，现有方法常分开处理或依赖标记板/静态采集。

Method: 连续时间前向运动学使延迟可微；以度量深度补足掩码轮廓的稠密可微渲染损失；离线规划器结合空间敏感度与时间激励优化轨迹；交替优化支持Eye-to-Hand、Eye-in-Hand与多相机配置。

Result: 7自由度机械臂上6.5秒运动即达0.21 cm平移误差（对标定板）、0.34 cm接触测试误差、延迟误差2.7 ms（参考87 ms，95%不确定度±1.5 ms）；相对CM-Calib在匹配录制上平移与名义延迟误差分别改善3.7×与2.3×；跨7种机械臂与4种深度传感器；在策略训练与部署中补偿偏移使6类任务族、6项任务成功率提升8.1个百分点（1800对，95% CI [6.3, 9.9]）。

Conclusion: 快速、无标记、单轨迹的联合标定与延迟估计方法具备跨硬件泛化性，并在真实操作策略中产生可测的性能增益，可直接嵌入机器人部署流程。

Abstract: Markerless hand-eye calibration under continuous motion requires jointly resolving camera geometry and the time offset between images and joint states. We present SyncHeC (Synchronized Hand-Eye Calibration), a dense differentiable-rendering framework that estimates both from a single robot trajectory. Continuous-time forward kinematics makes latency differentiable, metric depth complements mask contours, and an offline planner combines spatial sensitivity with temporal excitation. Alternating updates support Eye-to-Hand, Eye-in-Hand, and multi-camera calibration. On a 7-DoF arm, one $6.5$\,s motion yields $0.21$\,cm translation error against a marker-board reference, $0.34$\,cm touch-test error, and $2.7$\,ms latency error relative to an $87$\,ms reference with $95\%$ uncertainty of $\pm1.5$\,ms. Against CM-Calib on matched recordings, translation and nominal latency errors improve by $3.7\times$ and $2.3\times$. Experiments span seven arms and four depth sensors. Compensating the recovered offset during policy training and deployment increases success by $8.1$ percentage points across six families and six tasks ($1{,}800$ matched pairs; paired $95\%$ confidence interval $[6.3,9.9]$ points).

</details>


### [475] [Swarm Choreography Made Simple: Superposed Guiding Vector Fields for Rigid Formation Path Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03016)
*Jo{ã}o Machado,Matthieu Verdoucq,Christophe Jouffrais,Murat Bronz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于简单规则向量场叠加的分散式制导向量场框架，实现多无人机刚性编队路径跟随。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多无人机刚性编队路径跟随通常需要高带宽通信与集中式协调，难以分布式实现；作者希望通过向量场叠加将各控制目标解耦编码，降低通信开销并保证安全性。

Method: 将各控制目标编码为独立的向量场分量：归一化切向项（沿预设几何路径按期望速度推进）、收敛项（驱动机群趋近路径）、基于伪路径参数的局部协调项（保持刚性编队形状）、局部分离项（机间避碰）。协调机制每智能体仅交换一个标量，通信带宽需求低。

Result: 在无分离项时部分理论结果证明集群收敛到期望路径与编队，避碰则给出形式化保证；五架四旋翼实机完成两组三维编排：保持V形刚性编队的螺旋路径跟踪，以及旋转圆形编队跟踪垂直直线形成的螺旋式运动，实验验证了有效性与实用性。

Conclusion: 向量场叠加式的分散协调以极低通信量实现刚性编队路径跟随，理论部分不完备（收敛性在无避碰项下成立），但实机实验支持其工程可用性。

Abstract: This paper presents a decentralized guiding vector field framework for rigid formation path following in multi- UAV systems based on the superposition of simple rule-driven vector fields. Each control objective is encoded as a dedicated vector-field component: a normalized tangential term to ensure progression along a prescribed geometric path at a desired speed, a convergence term driving the formation toward the path, a local coordination term that preserves the desired formation shape through a pseudo-path parameter, and a local separation term for inter-agent collision avoidance. The coordination mechanism requires the exchange of only a single scalar per agent, resulting in low communication bandwidth. Partial theoretical results establish convergence of the swarm to the desired path and formation in the absence of the sepa- ration term, while collision avoidance is formally guaranteed. The approach is experimentally validated using a swarm of five quadrotors executing two 3D choreographies. The first experiment involves tracking a helical path while maintaining a rigid V-shaped formation. The second demonstrates a spiral- like motion obtained by a rotating circular formation tracking a vertical line. The experimental results support the effectiveness and practical applicability of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [476] [BeyondContact: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Airflow-Based Non-Contact Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03059)
*Peiyu Yang,Mohamad S. Moudallal,Antonio Langella,Giulio Turrisi,Victor Barasuol,Claudio Semini*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文为 Isaac Lab 开发了机器人/任务无关的气流仿真扩展，用实验辨识的气流模型计算物体受力，支持大规模并行 RL 训练，并训练出"推+吹"混合策略(HPB)与纯气流立方体重定向策略(RR)，配合轻量高速鼓风机在真机上实现零样本部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触式操作受末端可达性与物体力学属性限制；气流可在无接触情况下施力，扩展可操作空间并适用不宜接触的场景。但缺乏合适的仿真环境，导致 RL 难以用于气流操作，使其普及度远低于接触式方法。

Method: 构建 robot- and task-agnostic 的 Isaac Lab 气流扩展（可并行训练），基于实验辨识的气流力/力矩模型计算物体所受作用；在此平台上训练 HPB（接触推动 + 气流吹动混合）和 RR（仅气流控制长方体航向）两类策略；硬件上设计可与夹爪共存的小型高速鼓风机。

Result: 零样本真机部署：HPB 在 20 次试验中成功率 80%；RR 在四个目标航向下平均绝对航向误差 2.6°。

Conclusion: 仿真扩展 + 实验辨识物理模型 + 轻量硬件使气流操作能以 RL 训练并零样本迁移真机，证明气流可作为接触式操作的补充模态，具备开源复现价值。

Abstract: Contact-based robotic manipulation is constrained by end-effector reachability and the mechanical properties of objects. Airflow can exert forces without direct robot-object contact, enabling manipulation of objects beyond the reach or when direct contact is undesirable. However, the lack of suitable simulation has hindered the application of reinforcement learning to airflow-based manipulation, limiting the broader adoption of this mechanism compared with contact-based methods. To address this gap, we developed a robot- and task-agnostic airflow extension for Isaac Lab that supports massively parallel training. The extension uses experimentally identified airflow models to compute the forces and torques exerted on objects. Based on this extension, we train a hybrid push-blow (HPB) policy that combines contact-based pushing with airflow manipulation and a rectangular reorientation (RR) policy that controls a cuboid's heading using airflow alone. To enable physical execution, we design a lightweight, high-speed blower that coexists with a gripper. In zero-shot real-world deployment, HPB achieves an 80% success rate over 20 trials, while RR achieves a mean absolute heading error of 2.6 degrees across four target headings. The project materials are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [477] [PlanContext: Benchmarking In-Context Driving Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03067)
*Ruikai Li,Naiyu Gao,Hao Shan,Yizhe Fan,Yanhao Wu,Han Jiang,Yilong Ren,Zhenning Li,Haiyang Yu,Yanhu Shan,Rui Wu,Hao Zhao,Hongyang Li,Zhiyong Cui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PlanContext：通过固定场景、变换高层驾驶意图构造配对评测，评估端到端自动驾驶模型的上下文相关决策能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶基准主要用安全、合规、舒适、行驶进度等轨迹质量指标，无法刻画依赖场景上下文的决策正确性。

Method: 构建配对评估：保持观测场景不变、改变高层驾驶意图，定义六类代表性驾驶上下文，并以类别平衡指标联合评估上下文决策正确性、道路合规性与动态安全性。

Result: 在 NAVSIM 上 9,561 个场景条件实例、23 个公开端到端驾驶模型上评测；发现高常规驾驶质量分数与强路线级上下文决策能力并不一致，且模型行为随决策时机、道路结构、交通交互而变化。

Conclusion: 上下文相关驾驶决策应作为端到端驾驶系统评估的重要补充维度。

Abstract: Real-world driving requires context-aware decision-making. Existing end-to-end driving benchmarks primarily assess trajectory quality through safety, compliance, comfort, and driving progress, leaving context-dependent decision-making insufficiently characterized. To fill this gap, we present PlanContext, a benchmark for evaluating in-context driving decision-making. PlanContext constructs paired evaluations by varying high-level driving intentions while keeping the observed scene fixed, enabling a natural and controllable assessment of context-dependent decision-making. We further define six representative driving contexts and jointly evaluate contextual decision correctness, road compliance, and dynamic safety with class-balanced metrics. Experiments on 9,561 scene-condition instances from NAVSIM and 23 public end-to-end driving models show that high conventional driving-quality scores do not consistently correspond to strong route-level in-context driving decision-making. Further analysis shows that model behavior varies with decision timing, road structure, and traffic interaction depending on the decision required by the current context. Our results highlight in-context driving decision-making as an important complementary dimension for evaluating end-to-end driving systems.

</details>


### [478] [KlaskTron-IL: A Contact-Rich Adversarial Imitation Learning Benchmark with a Validated Sim-to-Real Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03091)
*Nicklas Sohm,Aswin Ramachandran,Raffaello D'Andrea*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: KlaskTron：开源硬件双人对抗物理平台+学习式执行器模型实现零样本sim-to-real；配套KlaskTron-IL多层级模仿学习数据集及诊断基线，揭示BC数据缩放平台期、GAIL判别器弱梯度、BC先验×奖励密度非对称交互三大失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富、对抗性动态环境缺乏可复现的物理平台与公开数据，且标准模仿学习方法在此类动力学下的失效机制不明；同时希望打通"策略接口—执行器模型—硬件"链路，使训练策略可零样本部署。

Method: 自建开源硬件双人对抗平台（Klask类），训练学习式执行器模型以桥接策略接口与真实执行器，并获零样本验证的PPO专家策略；构造分层数据：8万步真机人类示教、32万步对称性增广、至多500万步合成专家轨迹；以BC、GAIL及BC先验+奖励密度组合进行诊断性基线实验。

Result: BC呈数据缩放平台期；GAIL判别器可解释但梯度弱（peg-ball接近恢复Spearman ρ=-1.0，logit跨度<0.1）；BC先验与奖励密度存在非对称交互。最强BC基线在指令处于执行器模型±0.2 m/s辨识范围内时实现零样本真机运行。

Conclusion: 该平台+数据集可作为接触丰富对抗动力学下IL方法的标准诊断基准，执行器模型保证了跨域接口一致性；但方法层面以基准与失效分析为主，未提出新学习算法。

Abstract: KlaskTron is an open-hardware physical platform for two-player adversarial reinforcement learning, with a learned actuator model that supports zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of trained policies. Building on this platform, we contribute KlaskTron-IL: a multi-tier imitation learning dataset (80k human demonstration timesteps collected directly on the physical robot, 320k symmetry-augmented timesteps, and synthetic expert trajectories up to 5M steps generated by the zero-shot-validated PPO policy), and diagnostic baselines that expose three characteristic failure modes of standard IL methods under contact-rich adversarial dynamics: BC's data scaling plateau, GAIL's interpretable but weak-gradient discriminator (Spearman $\rho = -1.0$ peg-ball proximity recovery, but a logit span under 0.1), and an asymmetric BC-prior x reward-density interaction. Because the policy interface used throughout this paper is the same one the actuator model bridges to hardware, a policy trained on this benchmark can run unchanged on the physical robot, as we demonstrate zero-shot for the strongest BC baseline, so long as its commands respect the actuator model's $\pm 0.2$ m/s identification range.

</details>


### [479] [VLALagBench: Understanding When and Why VLA Inference Latency Matters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03103)
*Qi Wen,Borui Xu,Hussein Amro,Hongshi Tan,Hanmin Lin,Chaoyi Ruan,Shanghao Liu,Gang Yang,Yuejiang Liu,Jiafei Duan,Bingsheng He,Jason Clemons,Christos Kozyrakis,Wenqi Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VLALagBench基准，系统研究VLA策略推理延迟对任务成功率的影响，并建立可从少量标定数据预测成功率的经验模型，用于指导算法-系统协同配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA推理延迟在动态物理世界中会影响任务成败，但延迟与成功率之间的定量关系尚不清楚，缺乏系统化评测手段。

Method: 构建覆盖面广的延迟敏感性基准，跨任务类型、目标运动速度、同步/异步执行模式与多种VLA策略进行受控实验；基于实验规律拟合经验预测模型。

Result: 100 ms的推理延迟可使运动目标任务成功率近乎减半；敏感性因任务与策略差异显著，反映精度与连续运动需求的差别；异步执行通过重叠推理与执行可挽回部分损失，但推理请求更频繁；经验模型预测RMSE仅5.7–7.8%。

Conclusion: 延迟是VLA部署的关键系统变量，可被建模与预测，据系统延迟与吞吐量选择VLA配置可最大化成功率，为机器人算法-系统协同设计提供基础。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising path toward general-purpose robot manipulation. While inference latency can affect task success in a constantly evolving physical world, the relationship between latency and task success rate remains poorly understood. In this paper, we introduce VLALagBench, a comprehensive benchmark for studying VLA inference latency sensitivity across task types, object speeds, execution modes (synchronous and asynchronous), and VLA policies. Using VLALagBench, we find that even a modest inference latency of 100 ms can nearly halve task success on moving targets, with sensitivity varying substantially across tasks and policies. These differences reflect task-specific requirements for precision and continuous motion. By overlapping inference with action execution, asynchronous execution can recover some of the lost success at the cost of more frequent inference requests. Building on these findings, we develop an empirical model that predicts task success from limited calibration data, achieving root-mean-square prediction errors of only 5.7-7.8% across various VLA policies. Given an inference system's latency and per-robot throughput, these predictions guide the selection of system-specific VLA algorithm configurations to maximize task success. We believe VLALagBench and these findings provide a solid foundation for future robotics algorithm-system co-design.

</details>


### [480] [A Tightly Coupled Magnetic-Inertial SLAM System for Field Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03106)
*Chuan Huang,Tongxing Peng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MISLAM：IMU + 九磁力计阵列紧耦合的磁-惯SLAM，无外部里程计与平台运动假设，融合局部多项式磁场模型（短期运动估计）与全局高斯过程磁场模型（误差状态卡尔曼滤波漂移校正）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矿道、隧道、灾区的现场机器人在GNSS拒止且粉尘/烟雾/弱光导致相机与LiDAR退化时需要可靠定位；地面与空中机器人协同任务也需要不依赖可见性、预装基础设施或轮式接触的互补传感模态。磁场在结构内部具有空间唯一性，可作为该类退化场景下的替代观测。

Method: 硬件为IMU加九磁力计阵列。将惯性导航模型与两类磁场模型紧耦合在误差状态卡尔曼滤波器(ESKF)中：局部多项式磁场模型用于短期运动估计，全局高斯过程磁场模型用于全局漂移校正；不依赖外部里程计，也不依赖平台特定运动约束。

Result: 在三个手持平台采集的室内数据集上离线评估，总端点闭环误差相较磁-惯里程计降低45.7%–78.0%；弱光条件下视觉惯性里程计失效后MISLAM仍保持跟踪，水平闭环误差0.332 m；垂向漂移仍是主要局限。仅离线、手持装置验证，缺少真机机器人闭环与实时性数据。

Conclusion: 磁-惯SLAM可作为视觉退化条件下机器人传感器套件的互补定位模态；后续需解决垂向可观测性不足、真机部署与在线运行问题。

Abstract: Field robots operating in mines, tunnels, and disaster areas require reliable localization despite GNSS denial and degraded camera and LiDAR measurements caused by dust, smoke, or poor illumination. Missions involving both ground and aerial robots further motivate complementary sensing modalities that do not depend on visibility, preinstalled infrastructure, or wheel contact. This letter presents MISLAM, a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial simultaneous localization and mapping system using an IMU and a nine-magnetometer array, without relying on external odometry or platform-specific motion assumptions. The system combines the inertial navigation model with local polynomial magnetic-field models for short-term motion estimation and a global Gaussian process model for drift correction using an error-state Kalman filter. Offline evaluation on three indoor datasets collected with a handheld rig shows reductions in total endpoint closure error of 45.7% - 78.0% relative to magnetic-inertial odometry. Under poor illumination, MISLAM maintains tracking after visual-inertial odometry fails, achieving a horizontal closure error of 0.332 m, although vertical drift remains a limitation. These results support magnetic-inertial SLAM as a complementary localization modality for robotic sensor suites operating under degraded visual conditions.

</details>


### [481] [KlaskTron: An Open-Source Platform for Physical Adversarial Multi-Agent RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03138)
*Aswin Ramachandran,Jona Schulz,Maurus Derungs,Carlo Angelini,Tobias Meier,Raffaello D'Andrea*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出开源低成本（<2500美元）桌面级对抗性多智能体强化学习硬件测试床 KlaskTron，基于桌面游戏 KLASK，配双 CoreXY 龙门架、GPU 原生数字孪生、神经执行器模型与零样本 sim-to-real 策略迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理多智能体强化学习缺乏可获取、标准化、可复现的硬件基准；现有物理平台昂贵、需专用场地、缺少开放设计与机制，阻碍仿真涌现行为向真实系统迁移。

Method: 双 CoreXY 龙门架 + 高扭矩无刷电机实现高速精密操控；提供完整 CAD/BOM 与装配文档；在 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 构建 GPU 原生数字孪生；用学习到的神经执行器模型搭建 sim-to-real 基线，并训练对抗 MARL 策略。

Result: 基线实现零样本策略迁移，训练智能体在真实平台上展现出涌现的对抗行为；全部资产（硬件、推理软件栈、仿真与 MARL 训练代码）公开以保可复现。

Conclusion: KlaskTron 为物理对抗 MARL 提供低成本、开源、端到端可复现的基准平台，打通仿真涌现行为到真实桌面竞技的迁移路径。

Abstract: Progress in robot learning, particularly physical multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), is currently challenged by a limited availability of accessible, standardized benchmarks. While simulation-based MARL has produced remarkable emergent behaviors, from coordinated team play to complex tool use, translating these advances to physical systems remains difficult. A key barrier is infrastructural: physical platforms are often prohibitively expensive, require specialized facilities, or lack open mechanisms and designs for reproducibility. We introduce KlaskTron, an open-source, low-cost (<\$2500 USD), desktop-scale robotic testbed for adversarial MARL based on the dynamic tabletop game KLASK. The platform features dual CoreXY gantries with high-torque brushless motors, enabling the high-speed, precise manipulation required for competitive play. Crucially, we provide a complete ecosystem: hardware designs (CAD, BOM), a GPU-native digital twin in NVIDIA Isaac Lab for high-fidelity modeling and simulation, and a validated sim-to-real baseline using a learned neural actuator model. We demonstrate that this baseline enables zero-shot policy transfer, with trained agents exhibiting emergent adversarial behaviors. To ensure full reproducibility of our results, all project assets are released publicly: hardware CAD/BOM and assembly documentation at [ this https URL ], inference software stack at [ this https URL ] and the simulation and MARL setup at [ this https URL ].

</details>


### [482] [FineCraft: Enhancing VLA Models for Fine-Grained Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03163)
*Shuaike Zhang,Ziheng Quan,Junhao Ran,Muhe Ding,Shaokun Wang,Jianlong Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FineCraft：面向MetaFine细粒度操作挑战的任务路由策略混合框架，独立适配DINOv2-DiT与预训练π0.5策略并通过统一观测-动作接口调度，以0.878总分位列第四，在全部五个任务上超过公开参考基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度操作同时要求指令接地、局部视觉精度与持续执行，单一预训练策略难以兼顾；论文面向MetaFine挑战赛，目标是低成本地组合已有预训练模型以覆盖多阶段、指令变更与视觉扰动下的任务。

Method: 采用任务路由的混合策略（mixture of policies）：通过统一观测-动作接口，按任务选择独立适配的DINOv2-DiT策略或预训练π0.5策略。局部视觉特征用于定位指令所指物体部件；利用示范数据与专家续接（expert continuation）学习所需动作；执行中由新观测驱动重规划。

Result: 整体得分0.878，排名第四，五个任务均超过公开参考方法；官方结果与本地诊断分析了视觉扰动、指令变化与多阶段操作下的表现。

Conclusion: 该工作显示"预训练骨干独立适配 + 任务级策略路由 + 执行期重规划"是应对细粒度操作挑战的实用路线，但方法本质为竞赛工程集成，缺少消融与新方法贡献。

Abstract: Fine-grained manipulation couples instruction grounding, local visual precision, and sustained execution. We present FineCraft, a framework that adapts pretrained models for fine-grained manipulation in the MetaFine Challenge. A task-routed mixture of policies selects independently adapted DINOv2-DiT or pretrained $\pi_{0.5}$ policies through a common observation-action interface.
