Local visual features help identify the instructed object parts, demonstrations and expert continuations teach the required actions, and new observations guide replanning during execution. FineCraft ranks fourth with an overall score of $0.878$, exceeding the published reference on all five tasks. Official results and local diagnostics characterize performance across visual perturbations, instruction changes, and multi-stage manipulation. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [483] [Rollout then Recycle: 3,718 Labelled Real-Robot Episodes from Benchmarking 7 Policies on 12 Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03168)
*Praveen Selvaraj,Lorenzo Uttini,Ville Kuosmanen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 发布 ArmnetBench v0.1 数据集：3718 个 episode（600 遥操作示范 + 3118 条七种模仿学习/VLA 策略在 12 个桌面任务上的 rollout，73% 失败），含三视角图像、关节状态与动作，附人工成败标注，提供 LeRobot v3.0 与奖励模型两种格式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA/模仿学习研究缺少在同一批示范、同一实验条件下对多种策略进行受控对比与失败分析的数据，尤其是低成本机械臂上的失败样本库，可用于奖励建模与失败诊断。

Method: 基于低成本 SO-101 机械臂采集 12 个桌面任务；每任务固定 50 条遥操作示范，七种策略在同一示范集上训练/微调并在同一 cell 上 rollout；人工逐条标注成功/次优/失败；每条 episode 存三路相机视角、关节状态与动作。

Result: 共 3718 条 episode，其中 3118 条 rollout 中 73% 为失败，形成多策略在共享任务上的失败语料；数据以 LeRobot v3.0 和 reward-model 格式托管于 Hugging Face Hub，并附采集流程与使用局限的说明文档。

Conclusion: 该工作是一份受控采集的机器人操作策略评测与失败数据集，对奖励建模、失败分析与策略鲁棒性研究有工具价值，但本篇为数据说明/技术报告，未提出新方法。

Abstract: We release all 3,718 episodes from the ArmnetBench v0.1 evaluation ( arXiv:2607.24481 ), which contains 600 teleoperated demonstrations and 3,118 rollouts of seven imitation-learning and vision-language-action policies on 12 tabletop tasks, recorded on low-cost SO-101 arms; 73% of the rollouts are failures. Every policy for a task was trained or fine-tuned on the same 50 demonstrations and rolled out on the same cell, so the corpus contains many policies' failures on shared tasks. An operator labelled every rollout successful, suboptimal or failure. Each episode has three camera views, joint states and actions and is available on the Hugging Face Hub in LeRobot v3.0 and a reward-model format. This note documents how the episodes were collected and the limitations that could affect their use.

</details>


### [484] [Towards end-to-end co-design for one-shot printable task-specific soft robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03216)
*James Wood,André Farinha,Will Browne,Josh Pinskier,Krishna Manaswi Digumarti*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于可微MPM仿真器的软体机器人协同设计框架，联合优化材料分布、气动执行器位置与朝向及控制，设计可直接一体化FDM打印且经物理实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软体机器人协同设计虽能联合优化形态与控制，但所得设计常难以制造；可制造的方案又往往限制执行器布局或需手工装配。作者希望打通从任务级目标到可物理实现的软体机器人的路径，同时保留形态与驱动设计的自由。

Method: 构建可微分的二维平面应力Material Point Method（MPM）仿真器，嵌入经实验验证的材料模型，以及由实验数据拟合的3D打印充气执行器代理模型；在该框架内以梯度法联合优化材料分布、气动执行器放置与朝向及控制信号，针对指定末端轨迹优化软体机械臂。

Result: 优化设计可直接导出为一次性整体FDM打印件，执行器集成、无需后装配；物理实验表明实体机械臂再现了仿真预测的行为，验证了仿真到实物的可迁移性。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了从任务目标到可制造软体机器人的端到端设计流程，兼顾可制造性与形态/驱动的设计自由度，为软体机器人协同设计提供可行路径。

Abstract: Soft robot co-design methods can jointly optimise morphology and control, but the resulting designs are often difficult to manufacture, while manufacturable approaches typically restrict actuator placement or require manual assembly. We present a simulation-based co-design framework that jointly optimises material distribution, pneumatic actuator placement and orientation, and control, while producing designs that can be fabricated monolithically using fused deposition modelling. The framework uses a differentiable 2D plane-stress Material Point Method simulator, incorporating an experimentally validated material model and an empirically derived surrogate model of a 3D-printed inflatable actuator. We demonstrate gradient-based optimisation soft robotic arms for prescribed tip trajectories. Optimised designs are transferred directly from simulation to one-shot monolithic FDM fabrication, with integrated actuators and no post-assembly. Physical experiments demonstrate that the resulting arms reproduce the behaviour predicted in simulation. This framework provides a path from task-level objectives to physically realisable soft robots while retaining substantial freedom over both morphology and actuation.

</details>


### [485] [TRAILS: Trajectory Generation for Automated Indoor Locomotion Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03254)
*Juho Kalliokoski,Evan G. Center,Steven M. LaValle,Timo Ojala,Basak Sakcak*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TRAILS：面向VR导航与人-机实验的自动化场景生成框架，融合WFC式约束过程化环境生成、优化三次贝塞尔曲线轨迹与 kinematic 约束速度剖面，产出多样、时长一致、可复现的完整导航场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VR导航与模拟机器人运动实验需要大量大尺度、真实且互不重复的轨迹，以避免被试重复感并保证对照实验的可比性；手工设计满足几何与运动学约束的场景代价极高，且现有数据驱动方法缺乏透明性与可复现性。

Method: 三步流水线：(1) 受Wave Function Collapse启发的约束式过程化环境生成器，输出含走廊、开阔空间与障碍物的室内布局；(2) 基于优化三次贝塞尔曲线的轨迹生成，满足墙体距离等几何约束；(3) 满足速度/加速度运动学约束的时长参数化速度剖面生成；整体由少量直观用户参数与随机种子控制，无学习模型。

Result: 可自动批量生成等时长、路径几何/贴墙距离/速度剖面各异的导航场景，并尽量降低这些特征间的系统性相关；输出透明、可复现、可配置，代码已开源。

Conclusion: TRAILS是一个轻量工具型框架，适合遥操作呈现与人因实验的场景构建，属于实验基础设施而非感知/决策方法贡献。

Abstract: Virtual reality experiments involving navigation and simulated robot motion often require large, realistic environments and numerous distinct trajectories to avoid repetitive navigation while providing sufficient variation for controlled experiments. Designing such scenarios manually is labor-intensive, particularly when trajectories must satisfy predefined geometric and kinematic constraints while remaining diverse and comparable across experimental conditions. This paper presents TRAILS, an automated framework for generating complete virtual navigation scenarios consisting of an environment layout, a path, and a time-parameterized motion profile. The framework combines a constraint-based procedural environment generator inspired by Wave Function Collapse, trajectory generation using optimized cubic Bézier curves, and speed-profile generation subject to kinematic constraints. The generated scenarios provide diverse indoor environments with corridors, open spaces, and obstacles, together with trajectories of identical duration that vary in path geometry, wall proximity, and velocity profiles while minimizing systematic dependencies between these characteristics. The framework is designed as an easy-to-use tool requiring only a small number of intuitive user-defined parameters to automatically generate large sets of distinct navigation scenarios satisfying prescribed geometric and kinematic constraints. By relying on explicit, seed-controlled algorithmic procedures rather than data-driven models, the generated scenarios remain transparent, reproducible, and configurable, making the framework well suited for telepresence and human-subject experiments. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [486] [VerifLM: Physically Verified Image-Edit-Guided Goal Pose Generation for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03268)
*Xuanyou Chen,Jinyu Chen,Glen Chou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: VerifLM 将图像编辑后的目标状态转换为经物理验证的 6-DoF 物体位姿：由编辑图恢复初始相对位姿，用 VLM 生成轴向采样约束与任务校验程序，在多种几何-物理假设的并行仿真世界中筛选候选位姿，并由 VLM 选出最符合任务意图者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多操作目标易于视觉直观表达但难以用显式几何约束数值化描述；同时现有方法依赖预定义物体网格与物理参数，难以迁移到未知物体。

Method: 从单张编辑图像恢复主动-被动物体的初始相对位姿；VLM 生成逐轴采样约束与任务专属验证程序；基于 RGB-D 重建度量几何并构造多组不同物理/几何参数的假设仿真（并行世界）；在各候选世界中评估候选位姿，按满足验证程序的世界数排序，最后由 VLM 选出最符合任务的候选。

Result: 在 9 个操作任务中，8 个任务取得最高成功率，且在需要精细朝向与接触关系的目标上提升最明显。

Conclusion: 以"图像目标 + 物理仿真验证 + 多世界稳健性排序"替代显式几何约束，可在无物体网格与物理参数的条件下生成可靠的可执行 6-DoF 目标位姿。

Abstract: Many manipulation goals are easier to visualize than to specify numerically through explicit geometric constraints. We present VerifLM, a framework that converts image-edited goal configurations into physically verified 6-DoF object poses for planning. Using an edited image, VerifLM recovers an initial relative pose between an active object and a passive object, then prompts a vision-language model to generate axis-wise sampling constraints and a task-specific validation program. Candidate poses are evaluated in a physics simulator, and the VLM selects the most task-consistent retained candidate. To operate without predefined object meshes or physical parameters, VerifLM reconstructs metric object geometry from RGB-D observations and constructs multiple hypothetical simulations with varying physics and geometry. Parallel-world validation evaluates candidates across geometry--physics variations and ranks them by the number of worlds in which they satisfy the validation program. We evaluate VerifLM on nine manipulation tasks. VerifLM achieves the highest task success on eight of nine tasks, with the largest performance gain on goals requiring precise orientation and contact relationships.

</details>


### [487] [ForceLDM: A Force-aware Latent Dynamics Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03294)
*Peiyuan Tang,Yao Li,Xiaodong Zhang,Wuyang Zhang,Qin Xia,Yanyong Zhang,Zijiang Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ForceLDM: a force-aware latent dynamics model that distills future force/torque + optical-flow dynamics features into a student policy trained only on current observations, guiding action generation for contact-rich manipulation.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision-only policies fail at contact-rich manipulation because contact states and interaction forces are hard to infer from images; existing force/tactile-augmented methods treat these signals as auxiliary observations and do not model future interaction dynamics.

Method: Two-stage knowledge distillation: a teacher network with privileged future force/torque and optical flow extracts compact future-dynamics latent features; a student trained only on current observations (incl. current force) regresses these features, avoiding direct future-observation prediction that entangles task-irrelevant details. Curriculum-based progressive noise injection on the latent targets reduces over-reliance on future features.

Result: Outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks; generalizes to novel objects and is robust to environmental perturbations. Project page and code released.

Conclusion: Future-aware latent dynamics distillation is an effective way to inject force/tactile priors into manipulation policies without requiring future sensing at deployment.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires fine-grained control and complex physical interactions with the environment, posing significant challenges for robot policy learning. Vision-only policies struggle with such tasks, as contact states and interaction forces are difficult to infer from visual observations alone. Existing methods mitigate this issue by incorporating force or tactile sensing. However, they often treat these signals as auxiliary observations without fully exploiting their role in modeling future interaction dynamics. To address this, we propose ForceLDM, a force-aware latent dynamics model that learns future contact and motion dynamics to guide action generation. Rather than directly predicting future observations, which can entangle task-relevant dynamics with irrelevant sensory details, ForceLDM learns a compact representation of future dynamics through knowledge distillation. Specifically, a teacher network with privileged future force/torque and optical flow signals extracts future dynamic features, which are then distilled into a student network trained only on current observations. This enables the student model to reason about upcoming contacts and physical dynamics without relying on future sensory inputs at deployment. To improve robustness and generalization, we further introduce a curriculum-based progressive noise injection strategy to mitigate over-reliance on future features. Experiments on five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate that ForceLDM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, generalizes effectively to novel objects, and remains robust to environmental perturbations. Project page and code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [488] [Safe-Ballbot: Tilt-Consistent MPC with Control Barrier Functions for Ballbot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03307)
*Duc Cuong Vu,Tung Lam Nguyen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出三层?不,两层球平衡机器人导航方案:上层在jerk模型上做MPC并用离散时间CBF处理静态/动态/凹陷障碍;下层用HSMC-ESO-ECBF跟踪并约束倾角;两层通过闭式加速度上界耦合。MuJoCo中保持10cm间隙、2cm RMS跟踪、9-12ms规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球平衡机器人靠倾斜加速,倾斜受轮矩与安全限制。全模型MPC计算昂贵,而忽略平衡动力学的规划产生不可跟踪的参考轨迹,需要既高效又可执行的规划-跟踪耦合方案。

Method: 上层:基于jerk模型的MPC + 离散时间控制屏障函数(DT-CBF),覆盖静态、移动、旋转与凹陷障碍。下层:带扩张状态观测器的分层滑模控制 + 鲁棒指数CBF(HSMC-ESO-ECBF)约束倾角。两层以闭式推导的加速度上界连接,该上界由CBF允许的最大稳态倾斜导出,保证规划不要求跟踪器拒绝的倾斜。对仅预测运动的障碍,用共形预测半径膨胀障碍以概率界定预测误差。

Result: 在MuJoCo(含全向轮滚子接触与力矩饱和)中,保持≥10cm间隙,跟踪误差≤2cm RMS,倾角不超限,规划耗时9-12ms,比进入膨胀障碍的全模型非线性MPC快10-15倍;对预测障碍,共形膨胀在30个随机穿越场景中消除匀速预测器的碰撞,并在闭合轨迹长跑中减少碰撞。

Conclusion: 通过闭式加速度界将快速MPC与鲁棒倾角CBF跟踪器解耦耦合,实现了球平衡机器人安全、可跟踪且实时的导航;共形预测为动态障碍提供概率保证。效果来自仿真验证,尚缺真实机器人实验。

Abstract: Ball-balancing robots (ballbots) must lean to accelerate, and the lean is limited by the wheel torques and by safety. Planners that use the full robot model are expensive, while planners that ignore the balance dynamics produce references that cannot be followed. This paper presents a two-layer navigation scheme for a three-omni-wheel ballbot. The upper layer is a model predictive controller on a \emph{jerk model} of the ball position, with discrete-time control barrier functions for static, moving, rotating and concave obstacles. The lower layer is a hierarchical sliding mode controller with an extended state observer and a robust exponential control barrier function on the tilt (HSMC-ESO-ECBF). The layers are linked by an acceleration bound derived in closed form from the largest steady tilt that the barrier function admits, so that the plan never asks for a lean the tracker refuses. For obstacles whose motion is only predicted, the obstacles are inflated by conformal prediction radii that bound the prediction error with a prescribed probability. In MuJoCo, with omni-wheel roller contacts and torque saturation, the scheme keeps at least $10$\,cm of clearance, tracks the plan within $2$\,cm RMS, keeps the tilt below the limit and plans in $9$--$12$\,ms, $10$--$15$ times faster than a full-model nonlinear MPC that enters the inflated obstacles; with predicted obstacles, the conformal inflation removes the collisions of a constant-velocity predictor in $30$ random crossing scenarios and reduces them in an endless run on a closed this http URL source code and video illustrations are available at this https URL

</details>


### [489] [OpenZilo: An Open Smart-Ring Platform for Human-Centric Sensing and Interaction with Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03410)
*Qianggang Ding,Xingyao Wang,Rui Feng,Chi Qin,Weijian Lin,Lizhi Ding,Jiankai Tang,Yuntao Wang,Xiangke Liu,Bang Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出开源智能戒指平台（麦克风+IMU+PPG+皮温），软硬件分层（采集/事件解释/交互策略/机器人执行），在10名被试上评测语音与手势控制及生理事件触发的机器人交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴机器人接口需要把用户输入及时映射为物理动作，但现有研究多只报识别精度，缺少对任务各阶段（识别、交互、执行、时延）统一评估的平台与指标。

Method: 多模态智能戒指硬件 + 分离式软件架构；刻画7种运行模式；语音/手势各5条命令、每模态250次试验；对比GMM-HMM与SVM在三种词表规模下的识别表现；用模拟事件通知评估生理事件触发交互的时延。

Result: 语音/手势任务成功率90.4%与88.8%，识别精度高于任务成功率；GMM-HMM精度优于SVM但打分耗时更长；共同语音起始手势调整响应中位时延短于语音；整任务成功率手势70.0%、语音64.0%；通知到机器人到达均值11.71 s，现场人员9.20 s。

Conclusion: 应同时用识别指标与物理执行结果评估可穿戴机器人接口，并按任务阶段选用相应的时间度量；样本量小，结论为描述性。

Abstract: Wearable robot interfaces must connect user input to timely physical action. We present the proposed platform, an open smart-ring platform for studying this connection across task stages. The ring integrates a microphone, an inertial measurement unit, photoplethysmography, and skin-temperature sensing. Its software architecture separates acquisition, event interpretation, interaction policy, and robot execution. We characterize seven operating modes and evaluate speech and gesture control with 10 participants. Across five commands and 250 trials per modality, speech and gestures achieved task success rates of 90.4% and 88.8%, respectively. Recognition accuracy exceeded task success for both modalities. Gaussian hidden Markov models achieved higher accuracy than a support vector machine across three vocabulary sizes, with longer scoring times. Following a shared spoken task start, gesture-based adjustments had shorter median response times than speech. Whole-task success was 70.0% with gestures and 64.0% with speech. We further examine physiological-event-triggered robot interaction using simulated event notifications. Mean notification-receipt-to-arrival times were 11.71 s for the robot and 9.20 s for an on-site person. These descriptive findings support evaluating wearable robot interfaces through both recognition and physical outcomes, with timing measures appropriate to each task stage.

</details>


### [490] [Myoelectric Control for Upper-Limb Exoskeletons: A Decoder-Shaper-Controller Framework, Design Guidelines, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03418)
*Davide Costanzi,Eldison Dimo,Emanuele Feola,Mario Sedilesu,Francesco Pascucci,Andrea Calanca*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"解码器-整形器-控制器"(decoder-shaper-controller)三层功能框架，用于统一分析上肢外骨骼的连续肌电控制，并据此梳理各模块设计与评估现状、指出整形器模块方法学缺失等开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有肌电控制系统(MCS)常将意图解码、助力整形与底层驱动控制混为一体，导致各模块贡献难以评估与横向比较，异构架构间也缺乏共同比较基准。

Method: 综述性工作：将连续sEMG上肢外骨骼控制分解为(1)解码器——从sEMG估计意图相关变量；(2)整形器——按助力策略映射为控制参考；(3)控制器——驱动执行器实现参考；按模块设计、标定与评估三个维度对代表性方法进行批判性比较。

Result: 发现整形器决定助力的幅值与形态却缺乏成熟的设计与整定方法，常被隐含嵌入解码器或控制器；同时存在助力水平报告不一致、交互感知的稳定性/无源性工具使用不足、跨自由度、跨用户、跨任务验证不充分等问题。

Conclusion: 给出模块化分步整定的设计准则，并提出未来研究优先方向，以弥合精确意图解码与真实工况下安全、有效、可泛化助力之间的差距。

Abstract: Myoelectric Control Systems (MCSs) enable voluntary control of wearable robots through muscle activity. However, intention decoding, assistance shaping, and low-level actuator control are often not explicitly distinguished, making their contributions difficult to evaluate and compare. This review introduces a functional decoder-shaper-controller framework for continuous myoelectric control of upper-limb exoskeletons. The decoder estimates an intention-related variable from surface electromyography (sEMG), the shaper maps it to a control reference according to an assistance policy, and the controller realizes that reference through actuator control. This decomposition separates intention estimation from assistance-policy design and enables comparison of heterogeneous architectures. Representative approaches are critically examined in terms of module design, calibration, and evaluation. The analysis highlights that the shaper, despite determining the magnitude and shape of assistance, lacks established design and tuning methodologies and is often embedded within the decoder or controller. Key open issues include inconsistent reporting of assistance levels, limited use of interaction-aware stability and passivity tools, and insufficient validation across degrees of freedom, users, and tasks. Building on these findings, this review provides design guidelines for systematic module-wise tuning and identifies future research priorities to bridge the gap between accurate intention decoding and safe, effective, and generalizable assistance under real-world operating conditions.

</details>


### [491] [Toward Uncertainty-Aware, Physics-Grounded Human World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03428)
*Yufei Zhang,Zijun Cui*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论证 KNOWN（带偶然/认知不确定性的实时3D人体重建）与 PhysMoP（基于学习动力学的欧拉-拉格朗日人体运动预测）恰好构成人体世界模型的"状态估计+动力学预测"两半，并定义二者接口与不确定性注入机制，但无新实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在人周围工作需要关于人的世界模型：既要有身体状态的信念分布，也要有预测下一状态演化的动力学模型。作者认为这两个已发表组件可互补组合成完整系统。

Method: 概念性/立场论文。梳理 KNOWN 的范式：单帧11.6ms实时重建3D人体并同时估计偶然不确定性与认知不确定性，用认知项驱动重优化；梳理 PhysMoP：以学习的动力学项求解欧拉-拉格朗日方程进行未来身体构型预测。提出两者间的接口定义，提出三种将 KNOWN 不确定性传入 PhysMoP 的机制，并设计野外视频评估协议。

Result: 无新实验结果。引用组件已有数据：KNOWN 的认知不确定性驱动优化把低密度输入误差从81.3mm降至70.3mm；PhysMoP 将80ms预测误差在Human3.6M上从9.6mm降至2.1mm、3DPW上从12.1mm降至0.7mm。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知的人体状态估计与物理一致的动力学预测可被耦合为统一的人体世界模型，为后续在野外视频上的系统评估提供方案框架。

Abstract: A robot that acts around people needs a world model of the human: a belief over the person's body state and a dynamics model that predicts where that state goes next. This abstract argues that two published components form exactly these two halves, and specifies how to couple them. KNOWN [1] reconstructs the 3D human body while estimating both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in real time (11.6 ms per frame); its aleatoric term identifies unreliable observations, its epistemic term identifies inputs from low-density regions of the training data, and refinement driven by the epistemic term reduces the error on such inputs from 81.3 to 70.3 mm. PhysMoP [2] predicts future body configuration by solving the Euler-Lagrange equations of the body with learned dynamics terms, reducing the 80 ms prediction error from 9.6 to 2.1 mm on Human3.6M and from 12.1 to 0.7 mm on 3DPW. We define the interface between the two, propose three mechanisms by which KNOWN's uncertainty enters PhysMoP, and specify an evaluation protocol on in-the-wild video. No new experimental results are reported here.

</details>


### [492] [Clinician-AI Collaboration in Endovascular Neurointerventions: In-Vitro User Study of Copilot Assistance Modes for Robotic Navigation Across the Autonomy Spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03446)
*Nikola Fischer,Harry Robertshaw,S.M.Hadi Sadati,Xingyu Chen,Weiyuan Deng,Benjamin Jackson,Michael Adofo Kwakye,Sara Sciacca,Naga Kandasamy,Parthiban Balasundaram,Sahan Guruge,Charles Cummins,Joe Leyon,Nasr Abdelsalam,Matthew Benger,Andrew Falzon,Alejandro Granados,Christos Bergeles,Thomas Booth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Copilot Assistance Modes (CAMs)人机协作层级框架，在体外血管模型上比较11名专家+2名学生使用6种导航模式的表现；全自主成功率由仿真81%跌至体外23%，而多种人机共享自主模式达92-97%，与直接遥操作(95%)相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械取栓受限于神经介入专家短缺，遥操作/AI辅助系统或有帮助，但临床医生与不同自主等级的交互方式、以及自主导航在真实环境中的表现尚不清楚。

Method: 定义覆盖手动到全自主的 clinician-AI 协作框架 CAMs；在患者特异性血管体模中开展首次体外用户研究（13名被试×6种模式），结合客观性能、主观负荷与可用性评估；并对自主导航分别在仿真(in silico)与体外(in vitro)评测以考察 sim-to-real 迁移。

Result: 手动操作总体最优(100%成功)；全自主仿真81%、体外降至23%；共享自主模式92-97%，约为全自主的4倍且接近直接机器人控制(95%)；用户定向任务委派与旋转式共享控制性能与接受度平衡最佳。

Conclusion: 可靠的机器人神经介入导航当前更依赖有效的医生-AI协作与控制权分配，而非单纯提高自主等级；协作可缓解 sim-to-real 域偏移。

Abstract: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is an effective treatment for acute ischemic stroke, yet access remains limited by the availability of neurointerventional expertise. Telerobotic and AI-assisted systems may help address this challenge, but it remains unclear how clinicians interact with different levels of autonomy and how autonomous navigation systems perform in realistic environments. This work introduces Copilot Assistance Modes (CAMs), a framework for clinician-AI collaboration in robotic endovascular navigation spanning the autonomy spectrum from manual operation to full autonomy. In the first in-vitro user study comparing clinician-AI collaboration strategies, 11 experts and two students evaluated six navigation modes in a patient-specific vascular phantom. Objective performance metrics were combined with subjective assessments, including workload and usability. Autonomous performance was additionally evaluated both in silico and in vitro to investigate sim-to-real transfer. Hands-on manual navigation achieved the strongest overall performance (100% success). While fully autonomous navigation achieved 81% success in simulation, performance dropped to 23% in vitro. In contrast, several clinician-AI shared-autonomy modes achieved success rates of 92-97%, approximately four times higher than full autonomy and comparable to direct robotic control (95%), demonstrating mitigation of sim-to-real domain shift through clinician-AI collaboration. Among the evaluated AI-driven approaches, user-directed task delegation and rotational shared control demonstrated the most favorable balance between performance and clinician acceptance. These findings suggest that effective clinician-AI collaboration and allocation of control authority may currently be more important for reliable robotic neurointerventional navigation than increasing autonomy alone.

</details>


### [493] [Exploring Proximity and Tactile Sensing for Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03489)
*Eric T. Chang,Bianca Aumann,Zhanpeng He,Mohamed Elnoor,Thomas Liang,Matei Ciocarlie,Nima Fazeli,Joshua Migdal,Tye Brady,Taskin Padir*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ToFTouch 将三路 4×4 分辨率的飞行时间（ToF）传感器与光学压力阵列融合为多模态触觉传感器，装于平行夹爪上，实现接触前的预感知（pre-touch sensing），并在预抓取调整、杂乱堆叠中取物、狭窄空间插入三类任务上验证了其增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人手部感知以接触后触觉为主，缺乏对即将发生接触的对象距离/形状信息，难以在接触前进行预判与自适应，从而在抓取前调整、从杂乱环境中取物、精细插入等任务中造成时间浪费与失败。

Method: 硬件层面，把三个多区域（4×4）ToF 传感器与基于光学的压力传感阵列集成，构成多模态触觉/近距传感器，并安装在平行两指夹爪上；实验层面设计三条任务管线：(i) 预抓取调整——利用 ToF 反馈在接近阶段提前闭合夹爪；(ii) 杂乱环境取物——在标称抓取点存在 ±2 cm 深度偏差时利用 ToF 调整；(iii) 密集杂乱中插入——分析插入轨迹过程中近距与触觉信息的变化。

Result: 预抓取调整中 ToF 反馈使周期时间减少 7.4%；取物任务中 ToF 感知在 ±2 cm 的各深度偏移条件下均成功，包括基线失败的情形，结果标准差低于 0.4 cm；插入实验展示了插入轨迹中近距与触觉信息的可用性。

Conclusion: 多区域 ToF 预触觉感知可为夹爪操作提供有价值的接触前信息，与压力触觉互补，在预抓取时序优化、鲁棒取物与插入等任务中带来可测量的收益。

Abstract: Pre-touch sensing, or sensing information about an object before contact, is an attractive modality for robot hands as it can allow a robot to anticipate and respond to a contact before it happens. In this work, we introduce ToFTouch, a multimodal tactile sensor combining three multizone (4$\times$4 resolution) time-of-flight sensors with an optics-based pressure sensing array. We mount this sensor on a parallel jaw gripper and demonstrate its utility on three distinct tasks: (i) pre-grasp adjustment, (ii) item extraction from clutter, and (iii) item insertion into tight spaces. For pre-grasp adjustment, ToF feedback reduced cycle time by 7.4$\%$ by enabling anticipatory gripper closure during approach. For extraction, ToF sensing enabled successful retrieval across all tested depth offsets ($\pm$2 cm) deviating from the nominal pick point, including conditions where baseline approaches failed, with standard deviations below 0.4 cm. For insertion into dense clutter, we explore the proximity and tactile information provided from ToFTouch during an insertion trajectory. The results demonstrate the utility of multizone ToF sensing in a manipulation environment.

</details>


### [494] [Delay-Certified Readiness Barriers for Overactuated Multirotor Allocation Without Lipschitz Constants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03490)
*Giuseppe Silano*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对过驱动多旋翼在采样控制与速度环延迟下的"就绪度(readiness)"保持问题，利用每个旋子对自身力矩的单调闭式响应结构，将不确定切换时刻下可达转速集合包络为可廉价计算的盒，且最低就绪度必然落在预先已知的角点，从而得到无Lipschitz常数的测试与回退力矩方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过驱动多旋翼存在大量等价转速组合，部分组合虽产生同一wrench但机动储备不足（如抗阵风能力差）。连续时间的readiness barrier仅在连续控制下成立；采样指令加上变化的转速环延迟，可保证的鲁棒裕度不足1 ms，实际不可用。

Method: 1) 利用旋子转速对自身力矩的单调、闭式响应，把不确定切换时刻下的可达转速集合近似为可快速计算的盒；2) 证明该盒上readiness下界位于预先已知角点，从而无需估计Lipschitz常数即可检验指令能否将readiness维持在地板之上直至下一采样；3) 若检验失败则输出回退力矩，使飞行器沿可认证计划运行。

Result: 六旋翼仿真，延迟2–40 ms、抖动±2 ms：readiness滤波器从未越过地板。10±2 ms时在设计包络内与延迟补偿预测器性能相当；超出包络时跟踪误差高2–30%，而单独预测器在16次任务中有2–16次违反地板约束。

Conclusion: 通过挖掘问题结构（单调闭式映射+盒+已知角点），把连续时间readiness保证推广到带延迟与抖动的离散采样控制，代价是超包络时略增跟踪误差，换取硬约束的可靠满足。属于仅仿真验证的控制理论/机器人控制工作，规模有限。

Abstract: Overactuated multirotors can produce the same wrench with many rotor-speed combinations, some of which leave the vehicle unable to change its wrench quickly, e.g., to reject a gust. Readiness barriers keep this ability, the readiness, above a floor, but only in continuous time; with sampled commands and varying speed-controller delays, the available robustness bound covers less than one millisecond. We remove this limit by exploiting the structure of the problem: each rotor responds monotonically and in closed form to its own torque, so the speeds reachable under uncertain switching times lie in a cheaply computed box, and the lowest readiness over that box sits at a corner known in advance. This yields a Lipschitz-free test that a command keeps the readiness above its floor until the next sample, plus a fallback torque that keeps the vehicle on a certified plan. In hexarotor simulations with 2--40~ms delays and $\pm2$~ms jitter, the filter never violated the floor. At $10\pm2$~ms, it matched a delay-compensating predictor within the design envelope and cost 2--30\% more tracking error beyond it, where the predictor alone violated the floor in 2 to 16 of 16 missions.

</details>


### [495] [SNAP: Semantic Navigation Among Pedestrians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03498)
*Jakob Wolfram,Pascal Roth,Fan Yang,Cesar Cadena,Marco Hutter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种强化学习导航策略，从单张语义标注的鸟瞰图（BEV）中联合推理语义地形与动态障碍，无需显式行人状态估计，在真实场景中超过人群导航与语义感知基线，并零样本迁移到足式机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将人群避障与语义路径规划割裂处理，而城市环境中机器人需同时遵守人行道等社会规范并避让行人，因此需要统一框架。

Method: RL 导航策略；输入为单一语义标注 BEV 地图，联合编码语义地形通道与动态障碍信息；不依赖显式行人状态估计（位置/速度）模块，端到端输出动作。

Result: 在评测中优于既有 crowd-navigation 与 semantic-aware 基线；零样本迁移至足式机器人，在高度动态的真实场景中实现符合社会规范的导航。

Conclusion: 语义 BEV 表征可作为统一接口同时承载地形规范约束与动态障碍避让，简化感知管线并具备真实机器人迁移能力。

Abstract: Navigating crowded urban environments requires robots to avoid pedestrians while adhering to social norms such as remaining on sidewalks. Existing approaches typically address either crowd avoidance or semantic path planning in isolation. We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policy that jointly reasons about semantic terrain and dynamic obstacles from a single semantically annotated bird's-eye-view (BEV) map, without relying on explicit human-state estimation. Our policy outperforms established crowd-navigation and semantic-aware baselines and transfers zero-shot to a legged robot, demonstrating socially compliant navigation in highly dynamic real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [496] [When Robots Outweigh Objects: How Inertia Mismatch Shapes Robot Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03501)
*Younghyo Park,Antonia Bronars,Pulkit Agrawal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过受控仿真实验改变机械臂与物体质量，研究惯性失配对强化学习与行为克隆的影响，并提出通过选择低惯性工作区或引导示范者给出低惯性解来降低接触惯性、提升模仿可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机械臂相对其操作物体极重，造成严重惯性失配；尽管现代学习方法已能在此类平台上实现多样操作，但不清楚高惯性是否为学习带来隐藏代价（更差的数据扩展性或更低的性能上限）。

Method: 在仿真中系统改变机器人质量和物体质量进行对照实验；比较强化学习与行为克隆在不同质量组合下的表现；单独考察仅通过减速比/传动改变电机反映惯性（质量不变）的情况；并测试两种降低接触惯性的低成本策略：采集数据前选择低惯性工作空间、引导示范者采用低惯性任务解。

Result: 强化学习在广泛质量组合下均能成功；行为克隆在"轻机器人操作重物体"时更可靠，增加数据可缩小但不消除差距；质量不变而传动惯量增大时行为克隆性能下降；两种低惯性示范策略在仿真中均使模仿更可靠。

Conclusion: 高惯性对模仿学习构成隐性代价，且该代价难以仅靠数据规模消除；由于硬件难以更换，可通过数据采集的工作空间选择与示范轨迹的低惯性偏置在现有硬件上实质缓解问题。

Abstract: Conventional robot arms can be extremely heavy compared with the everyday objects they manipulate, creating a significant inertia mismatch at contact. Even a small accidental bump from a heavy arm can knock a light object out of place. Modern learning methods have nevertheless demonstrated a wide range of successful manipulation behaviors on these platforms, suggesting that even extreme inertia mismatch can be overcome with sufficient data. However, it remains unclear whether high inertia imposes a hidden cost on learning, potentially worsening scaling with data or lowering the performance ceiling of modern robot learning methods. We investigate this question through controlled simulation experiments that vary robot and object masses. We find that reinforcement learning succeeds across a broad range of mass combinations, while behavior cloning learns more reliable policies when a lighter robot manipulates a heavier object, and more data narrows the resulting gap without closing it. Behavior cloning likewise degrades on a simulated robot arm as its motors reflect more inertia through their gearing, even though its weight stays the same. Finally, because new hardware is rarely an option, we explore ways to lower contact inertia on the arm one already has, either by choosing a lower-inertia workspace before collecting data or by steering the demonstrator toward lower-inertia solutions of the task. In both simulated cases, the lower-inertia demonstrations are imitated more reliably. Project website: this https URL

</details>


### [497] [PanoTac: A Dense Three-Axis Tactile Sensor for Robust Touch-Centric Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03520)
*Binglin,Wang,Xiaole,Jiang,Zicheng Teng,Xinqi Liu,Yunzhu Li,Lerrel Pinto,Zichen Jeff Cui,Binghao Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PanoTac: 低成本柔性触觉指尖，提供12×32×3密集三轴触觉表征（每点含法向z与切向x,y），60Hz、单指成本<50美元，配合视触觉策略在试管准备、舀米、倒盐任务上较纯视觉基线平均提升46.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富操作需要同时感知接触几何细节与交互力：舀颗粒时接触图案可推断勺姿态，抓握传递的阻力可引导运动。现有低成本触觉指尖难以同时提供密集空间分辨率与三轴（法向+切向）反馈。

Method: 设计柔性指尖传感器PanoTac，每个taxel输出法向z与两个切向x/y响应分量，形成12×32×3密集三轴触觉图；进行传感器标定，量化响应可重复性及跨实例、跨接触位置的一致性；将PanoTac集成到机器人系统并构建视觉-触觉策略流水线，在试管准备、颗粒舀取、倒盐三类任务上评测，并做模态消融（去除空间接触信息、去除切向反馈）。

Result: 相对纯视觉基线平均提升46.7个百分点；消融显示去掉空间接触信息或去掉切向反馈均导致整体性能下降，说明二者互补且均必要；传感器层面验证了响应可重复性与跨实例一致性。

Conclusion: 低成本、可扩展的密集三轴触觉指尖能为接触丰富操作带来显著收益，空间接触分布与切向力反馈是关键要素，具备实际机器人部署价值。

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation benefits from tactile feedback that captures both detailed contact geometry and interaction forces. When scooping grains, contact patterns help infer spoon orientation, while resistance transmitted through the grasp guides motion. To provide these complementary sensing capabilities, we present PanoTac, a low-cost, compliant tactile fingertip designed for dense three-axis tactile sensing. Each fingertip provides a $12 \times 32 \times 3$ tactile representation, with one normal ($z$) and two shear ($x$, $y$) response components at each taxel. The sensor operates at 60 Hz and costs less than $50 per fingertip. Sensor characterization quantifies response repeatability and consistency across sensor instances and contact locations. We integrate PanoTac into a robotic system with a visuo-tactile pipeline. Across test-tube preparation, grain scooping, and salt pouring, the resulting policies outperform vision-only baselines by an average of 46.7 percentage points. Ablations show that removing either spatial contact information or shear feedback reduces overall performance across the task suite. Our project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [498] [Mediating Human-Swarm Interactions Through a Robot Helper: A Shepherding-Inspired Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03548)
*Arihant Yadav,Sophie Jörg,Eakta Jain*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 通过 VR 羊群驱赶任务比较低层遥操作与基于运动基元的高自主性接口在"不可操控"集群（无法单独寻址成员）上的人-集群交互效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人-集群控制与人-集群交互（HSI）方法普遍假设集群成员可被单独寻址/控制，但这一假设在野生动物群、鱼群等"不可治理"集群上不成立，需要研究通过中介机器人助手间接操控大群体的交互范式。

Method: 以牧羊为动机构建 VR 集群驱赶任务，对比两种控制接口：低层遥操作 vs. 作用于集群整体形状（如基于边界的控制）的运动基元接口，并在不同集群内聚动力学条件下进行用户实验评估。

Result: 作用于集体形状的运动基元接口提升了任务表现，并降低了主观感知工作负荷。

Conclusion: 对不可寻址集群，高层集体形状控制（运动基元）比低层遥操作更有效、更省力，为野生动植物管理等场景下的人-集群交互设计提供依据。

Abstract: This work investigates human-swarm interaction (HSI) for steering large collectives through an intermediary robot helper. While prior robot-swarm control and HSI techniques commonly assume swarm members are addressable, these assumptions often fail for ``ungovernable'' swarms such as wildlife flocks and schools of fish. Motivated by pastoral shepherding, we compare low-level teleoperation to a higher-autonomy motion-primitives interface in a virtual reality (VR) shepherding task under varied swarm cohesion dynamics. Results indicate that motion primitives that operate on collective shape (e.g., boundary-based control) improve task performance and reduce perceived workload.

</details>


### [499] [TAMPAgent: Agentic Belief-Space Planning for Mobile Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03584)
*Utkarsh A. Mishra,Alperen Degirmenci,Yongxin Chen,Danfei Xu,Tucker Hermans,Caelan Garrett*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TAMPAgent 将 LVLM 智能体的开放世界推理与 TAMP 的结构化约束满足结合，在部分可观测环境下做长时程移动操作规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接工具调用的 LVLM 智能体难以处理几何不确定性，仅适用于完全可观测的桌面场景；而 TAMP 可处理部分可观测的长时程任务，但计算代价高且依赖封闭世界假设。

Method: 给 LVLM 智能体配备基于信念空间的规划模型与可扩展的感知/规划/控制工具 API：智能体先给出含参数化观测与执行动作的部分任务计划，交由经典搜索算法补全；随后提取几何约束，通过工具 API 绑定可行参数值生成可执行运动规划，并在执行中持续更新信念历史，交替观测与操作形成闭环。

Result: 在 Rainbow Y1 与 Unitree G1 平台上完成复杂家庭移动操作任务，显著优于直接工具调用的智能体基线。

Conclusion: 将 TAMP 约束满足嵌入智能体规划闭环，是应对非结构化、部分可观测环境的必要设计。

Abstract: Open-world robotic mobile manipulation requires acting in physical environments with only partial information. While recent Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) agents show strong open-world reasoning capabilities, existing architectures that rely on direct tool calling struggle with geometric uncertainty and thus are limited to fully-observable tabletop environments. In contrast, Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems can solve long-horizon tasks under partial observability but incur high computational costs and require closed worlds. We propose \textbf{TAMPAgent}, an agentic planning framework that unifies the reasoning of LVLMs with the structured constraint satisfaction of TAMP systems. We endow an LVLM agent with a belief-space planning model operating over an extensible API of perception, planning, and control tools. The agent formulates a partial task plan composed of parameterized observation and execution actions, which is subsequently completed using classical search algorithms. After extracting the plan's geometric constraints, the agent leverages its tool API to bind valid parameter values, satisfying feasibility requirements and producing an executable motion plan. Upon execution, the agent continuously updates its belief history and repeats this closed-loop process by interleaving observation and manipulation actions. Evaluated across complex household mobile manipulation tasks on Rainbow Y1 and Unitree G1 platforms, TAMPAgent significantly outperforms direct tool-calling agentic baselines, demonstrating that integrating TAMP constraint satisfaction into agentic planning loops is essential for unstructured, partially observable environments.

</details>


### [500] [Seeing Through the Illusion: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03585)
*Cheikh Ahmed,Mahdi Mostajabdaveh,Milad Yazdani,Zirui Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: WISE：冻结WAM，在决策前用三项评分（动作有效性/时序规律、动作与想象运动的逆动力学一致性、指令条件任务进度）对多个候选轨迹打分并择优执行，RoboLab上闭环成功率6.0%→24.0%，LIBERO 75.1%→78.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型能同时生成动作与想象未来，但"预测合理"不等于"配套动作可实现该未来"，需在执行前对候选rollout进行筛选。

Method: 提出WISE预执行选择器：对每条采样rollout计算(a)动作有效性与时间规律性、(b)动作与想象运动间的逆动力学一致性、(c)指令条件任务进度三项分数并融合排序；每次决策采样4个候选，选分数最高者执行，WAM本身保持冻结；并做组件消融与分数间一致性分析。

Result: RoboLab+Cosmos 3 Edge：闭环成功率6.0%→24.0%；LIBERO+DreamZero：75.1%→78.3%；聚合上分别比现有最佳选择器高4.0与0.9分；三项分数对候选排序差异明显，任务进度权重最大。

Conclusion: 推理期缩放式候选评估（不改模型参数）即可显著提升WAM的闭环可靠性，且"任务进度"是选择中最关键的信号。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) jointly generate actions and imagined futures, but a plausible prediction need not be realized by its co-generated action. We introduce WISE (\emph{World Action Inference Scaling through Evaluation}), a pre-execution selector that scores each sampled rollout on action validity and temporal regularity, inverse-dynamics consistency between the proposed action and the imagined motion, and instruction-conditioned task progress, and executes the highest-scoring candidate while keeping the WAM frozen. With four candidates per decision, WISE raises closed-loop success from 6.0\% to 24.0\% on RoboLab with Cosmos~3 Edge and from 75.1\% to 78.3\% mean success on LIBERO with DreamZero, and exceeds the best existing selector in aggregate by 4.0 and 0.9 points. Component ablations and agreement analyses show that the three scores rank candidates differently and that task progress carries the largest weight in the fused decision.

</details>


### [501] [D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03622)
*Marius Memmel,Shawn Yin,Urvi Rutia,Angad Wadhwa,Eldon Li,Gavin Angeloff,Ankit Goyal,Jesse Zhang,Dieter Fox,Fabio Ramos,Anqi Li,Abhishek Gupta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: D&A（Describe & Assess）将VLM零样本任务进度估计解耦为"任务锚定的客观文本描述"与"显式评分准则评估"两阶段，通过让模型先写出绝对成功的文本定义来锚定全局标准，缓解确认偏误与失败执行被幻觉为有进度的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM进度估计框架存在确认偏误：隐含成功假设或相对时序排序设计导致失败执行被幻觉为有进度；朴素提示退化为二分类成功检测器，无法刻画非线性进度；后训练方案需昂贵真实机器人数据且对每个基座模型重复计算密集训练。

Method: 纯提示（prompt-only）的两阶段解耦框架：第一阶段生成与任务对齐的场景动态客观文本描述；第二阶段依据显式rubric（评分准则）进行评估。关键在于强制VLM在打分前先显式合成绝对成功的文本定义，使评价锚定于外部全局准则而非视频内部时间线。

Result: 零样本估计得到校准，确认偏误得到缓解；能给出细粒度部分进度指标，准确惩罚失败执行并正确插值成功轨迹；跨任务、本体与基准泛化，效果匹配或超过后训练奖励模型，且其奖励估计可支撑下游强化学习。

Conclusion: 借助"先描述、再评估"的解耦与显式绝对成功准则，无需任何训练即可获得校准良好的进度/奖励信号，为机器人学习中零样本进度估计与RL奖励提供低成本、可泛化的替代方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) hold promise for zero-shot video task-progress estimation in robot learning, yet existing frameworks frequently suffer from confirmation bias, hallucinating progress in failed executions due to implicit success assumptions or relative temporal ranking designs. Naive prompting of frontier models collapses into a binary success detector that fails to capture nuanced, non-linear progress and failures. While post-training approaches can mitigate this through explicit training, they demand expensive real-world robotics data and require computationally intensive post-training for every individual base model. To resolve these limitations, we introduce D&A (Describe & Assess): our approach decouples progress estimation into an objective, task-grounded textual description of scene dynamics followed by an assessment phase using explicit rubrics. By compelling the VLM to synthesize an explicit, text-based definition of absolute success before scoring, the framework anchors evaluations to an external, global criterion rather than the video's internal timeline. Empirical results demonstrate that our method calibrates zero-shot estimates and mitigates confirmation bias, providing fine-grained, partial progress metrics that accurately penalize failed executions while correctly interpolating successful runs. Being purely prompt-based, D&A generalizes across tasks, embodiments, and benchmarks---matching or surpassing post-trained reward models---and its reward estimates enable efficient downstream reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [502] [Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03647)
*Jason Jingzhou Liu,Tony Tao,Deepak Pathak,Ruslan Salakhutdinov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Pixel-UMI 提出从人类演示数据学习环境感知全身移动操作策略的流水线：环境感知重定向（EAR）结合重建场景几何与头/夹爪轨迹生成无碰撞的关节与基座目标，并以延迟校准的动作分配转成动作；针对运动学差异造成的残余位姿误差，提出重定向误差感知掩码（REAM）降低对不匹配视角的依赖；再用 DAgger 收集在线人类纠偏弥补接触密集型交互的动作估计不足。在五类挑战任务上平均任务进度 87.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类演示数据可扩展，但人-机器人 embodiement 差异（运动学、视角）导致策略学习困难；现有重定向方法忽略场景几何、不生成无碰撞基座/全身目标，且动作估计无法刻画接触丰富交互。

Method: 1) EAR：融合重建场景几何与演示的头/夹爪轨迹求解机器人全身姿态，生成碰撞感知的关节+基座目标；延迟校准的动作分配将轨迹转为动作标签。2) REAM：利用重定向残余位姿误差计算视角不匹配程度，训练时做掩码以降低部署时对失配视图的依赖。3) DAgger 在线人类纠偏以补足接触密集型动作。

Result: 在铰接物体操作、可变形物体处理、受限空间伸展、全身避障、接触丰富双臂协同五类任务上达到 87.0% 平均任务进度。

Conclusion: 将场景几何纳入重定向 + 误差感知训练掩码 + 在线纠偏，可有效从人类演示获得环境感知的全身移动操作策略，缓解 embodiment gap。

Abstract: Sensorized human demonstrations offer scalable data for mobile manipulation, but embodiment differences complicate policy learning. We present Pixel-UMI, a pipeline for learning environment-aware whole-body policies from human data. We first introduce Environment-Aware Retargeting (EAR), which combines reconstructed scene geometry with demonstrated head and gripper trajectories to determine robot posture and generate collision-aware joint and base targets. Delay-calibrated action assignment converts these trajectories into actions. However, kinematic differences can leave residual pose errors, creating viewpoint mismatches between human demonstrations and robot observations. We therefore introduce Retargeting-Error-Aware Masking (REAM), which uses these errors during training to reduce reliance on mismatched views at deployment. Finally, because estimated actions cannot fully capture contact-rich interactions, we collect on-policy human corrections through DAgger to improve performance. We evaluate Pixel-UMI on five challenging tasks spanning articulated-object manipulation, deformable-object handling, constrained-space reaching, whole-body collision avoidance, and contact-rich bimanual coordination, achieving 87.0% average task progress. Video results are available at this https URL

</details>


### [503] [Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03648)
*Tony Tao,Jason Jingzhou Liu,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,Deepak Pathak*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Pixel 是一个软硬件协同设计的全栈移动操作学习系统，整合低成本轮式人形机器人（人形对齐运动学+柔顺夹爪）、多套遥操作与无机器人真人数据采集接口、统一全身控制器，以及在人类与机器人演示上共用的策略学习流程，并以分层学习栈实现语言条件视觉运动控制与长程任务执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用移动操作需要硬件、可扩展数据采集、全身控制与策略学习共同支撑，但现有系统各组件独立开发，导致接口与能力错配，限制了整体系统性能。作者主张从协同设计角度打通全栈组件。

Method: （1）低成本轮式人形平台，运动学与人体对齐并配柔顺夹爪；（2）多种遥操作界面 + 无需机器人的真人数据采集接口；（3）统一全身控制器，衔接人类演示与机器人执行；（4）跨人类/机器人演示的通用策略学习流水线；（5）分层学习栈：上层语言条件任务规划，下层视觉运动策略，支持长程执行。

Result: 在硬件、数据采集与策略学习三方面进行了系统评估，展示了对灵巧性、主动感知、导航与全身协调均有要求的移动操作行为。摘要未给出量化指标与对照基线，仅给出定性结果。

Conclusion: Pixel 以软硬件-数据-控制-学习协同设计的方式提供了可集成、可扩展的机器人学习研究基座，强调组件间一致性与真人数据规模化是提升整体移动操作能力的关键；后续价值取决于量化评测与开源程度。

Abstract: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system. We present Pixel, a co-designed full-stack system for learning general-purpose mobile manipulation. Pixel combines a low-cost wheeled humanoid with human-aligned kinematics and compliant grippers, multiple teleoperation and robot-free human data-collection interfaces, a unified whole-body controller, and a common policy learning pipeline across human and robot demonstrations. A hierarchical learning stack further enables language-conditioned visuomotor control and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the system across hardware, data collection, and policy learning, and demonstrate mobile-manipulation behaviors requiring dexterity, active perception, navigation, and whole-body coordination. We hope that Pixel provides an integrated and extensible foundation for studying how robot hardware, data, control, and learning can be designed together for robot learning. More results at this https URL

</details>


<div id='cs.CG'></div>

# cs.CG [[Back]](#toc)

### [504] [Catenary Visibility: A Geometric Framework for Planning with Tethered Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00324)
*B. Ábrego,J.M. Díaz-Báñez,S. Fernández,D. Flores-Peñaloza,V. Sánchez-Canales*

Main category: cs.CG

TL;DR: 提出"悬链线可见性"(catenary visibility)概念，为地面机器人-无人机系绳系统建立几何框架，计算障碍环境下从3D目标点可见的地面可行部署轨迹集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系绳式"袋鼠式"(marsupial)机器人系统（地面车+系绳无人机）可提供持续供电并扩展作业范围，但需回答关键规划问题：地面车应停在哪里，才能让系绳沿无碰撞悬链线到达3D目标点？该可行部署区域的几何刻画此前缺失。

Method: 将系绳建模为长度有界的可伸长悬链线；先求解2D子问题（障碍、目标与地面车运动线共处同一竖直平面），算法沿运动线计算完整可行发射点集合，并同时给出每点对应的可行缆长区间；进一步解决给定地面位置下求所有无碰撞缆长区间的查询问题；最后在受限障碍类别下推广到3D。

Result: 给出了2D情形下可行发射点全集及对应可行缆长范围的完备计算结果，并提供查询版本的求解方法；在受限障碍类别上得到3D推广解。

Conclusion: 为系绳式空地协同系统提供了可见性感知规划的几何基础与可计算算法，覆盖2D完备解到受限3D推广，可用于部署选址与缆长约束规划。

Abstract: This paper introduces \emph{catenary visibility}, a new geometric visibility concept for a robotic system consisting of a ground robot tethered to an aerial drone. The tether is modeled as an extensible catenary curve with bounded length, providing sustained power and significantly extending operational range. We define a point on the ground plane as \emph{catenary-visible} from a target point in 3D if there exists a collision-free catenary connecting them, given a set of obstacles. This paper introduces a geometric framework for visibility-aware planning of a tethered marsupial system, addressing the computational challenge of determining the feasible deployment locus: the collection of points in the ground plane that are catenary-visible from a given target in 3D space. We begin by solving the 2D subproblem, where the obstacles, target, and the ground vehicle's line of motion are all constrained to a single vertical plane. Our algorithm for this case computes the complete set of feasible launch points along the motion line and simultaneously determines the range of viable cable lengths for each. We also consider the query problem of finding all collision-free length ranges for a given location of the ground robot. Building upon this planar solution, we then generalize the approach to three dimensions, deriving a 3D solution for a constrained class of obstacles.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [505] [Anchored Fusion for Automated Airway Segmentation in Pediatric and Adult CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40702)
*Huseyin Umut Isik,Ege Mert Balcik,Duygu Atasoy,Asutosh Sahu,Seyda Ertekin,Sila Kurugol*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: A-Fuse通过体素级并集融合TfeNet、重训的MEDPSeg与复现的AirMorph三种气道分割模型，再保留与AirMorph掩码重叠最大的连通分量，从而在成人与儿童胸部CT上提升气道树覆盖率与分支检出率，并已部署为网页应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童气道更细小且标注扫描稀缺，外周支气管分割困难；不同模型各自能恢复互补的气道分支，简单取并集虽提升树覆盖率却会引入不相连的非气道伪影。

Method: 锚定融合（A-Fuse）：对TfeNet、重训MEDPSeg和重新实现的AirMorph三模型掩码做逐体素并集，然后仅保留与AirMorph掩码重叠IoU最大的连通分量，以去除离散非气道目标。

Result: 在ATM'26训练集30例留出成人CT上Dice为93.24%，分支检测率92.05%（对比方法中最高）；9例儿童扫描上Dice 94.15%、分支检测率68.79%；39例测试扫描全部保留气道树，而"保留最大连通分量"基线在4例中误选非气道目标。

Conclusion: 模型集成加上以可靠模型为锚的连通分量选择可稳健提升气道树分割，已作为自动化Web应用部署，并开源代码、权重及ITK-SNAP三维管状分割编辑插件。

Abstract: Airway segmentation from chest CT enables branch-level measurement of airway size and growth, but peripheral bronchi remain hard to segment, particularly in children, whose airways are smaller and for whom few annotated scans exist. Different models recover complementary branches of the airway tree. Their union improves overall tree coverage but also introduces disconnected non-airway objects. We propose anchored fusion (A-Fuse), which takes the voxel-wise union of TfeNet, a retrained MEDPSeg and a reimplemented AirMorph and retains the connected component with greatest overlap with the AirMorph mask. On 30 held-out adult CTs from the ATM'26 training set, A-Fuse reaches a Dice score of 93.24% and the highest branch detection rate among compared methods (92.05%). On nine pediatric scans, it reaches 94.15% Dice and 68.79% branch detection. A-Fuse retains the airway tree in all 39 test scans, whereas keeping the largest component selects a non-airway object in four. A-Fuse is deployed as an automated web application and we release all code, trained weights and an open-source ITK-SNAP extension for 3D tubular segmentation editing.

</details>


### [506] [InSARFlow: Riemannian Flow Matching for Interferometric SAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00003)
*Georges Le Bellier,Arnaud Breloy,Nicolas Audebert*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出 InSARFlow，首个基于黎曼流匹配（平坦环面）的 InSAR 干涉图去噪与生成框架，在环面上学习分布传输，几何感知地满足相位周期性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相位具有内在周期性，干涉图天然是平坦环面上的点；现有欧氏空间深度学习方法容易违背相位周期性，产生无效估计。因此需要设计尊重干涉图本征几何约束的生成式学习方法。

Method: 在黎曼流形（平坦环面）上采用流匹配（Riemannian flow matching）学习分布传输。两个用例：(1) 生成——建模从环面上均匀噪声到真实干涉图的传输；(2) 去噪——将含噪干涉图传输到去噪结果。在受控合成数据集上进行实验，与欧氏基线对比。

Result: 在受控合成数据集的干涉图去噪任务中，InSARFlow 持续优于所研究的基线方法，验证了几何感知学习的优势；同时展示了真实干涉图生成能力。

Conclusion: 将干涉图建模为环面流形上的点并用黎曼流匹配进行生成/去噪，可避免相位周期性破坏，是几何感知学习在 InSAR 处理中的有效范式；代码与权重已开源。

Abstract: Interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR) enables the analysis of topological changes in natural sites or urban areas. This technique operates by recovering the surface displacement from the study of the phase difference (interferogram) between two or multiple SAR images of the same scene at different times. In practice, the use of phase denoising algorithms is necessary to extract relevant information from the interferograms, which motivated numerous developments in the past decade. Due to the inherent periodicity of phases, interferograms can naturally be represented as points on a Riemannian manifold (specifically, the flat torus). This strong prior knowledge motivates the design of learning-based methods that respect the interferogram's intrinsic geometric constraints. Building on this observation, this paper introduces InSARFlow: a generative modeling framework for the denoising and generation of interferograms. Unlike conventional deep learning approaches formulated in Euclidean spaces, which may violate phase periodicity and produce invalid estimates, this method leverages Riemannian flow matching to learn distributional transports directly on the torus. The interest of this approach is demonstrated on two use cases: (1) realistic interferogram generation, in which we model the transport between uniform noise on the torus to real-world interferograms; (2) interferogram denoising, where InSARFlow transports noisy interferograms to their denoised counterparts. Extensive experiments on a controlled synthetic dataset validate the effectiveness of InSARFlow for interferogram denoising. The proposed approach consistently outperforms studied baselines, highlighting the benefits of geometry-aware learning on the torus. Code and weights available at this https URL .

</details>


### [507] [Toward Contrast-Free Breast MRI: Improving Cancer Detection With Virtual Contrast Enhanced Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00140)
*Hongxi Chen,Sunwoo Kwak,Sanyukta Adap,Katerina Dodelzon,Paula Feldman,Mert R. Sabuncu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出结合非增强(NC)与虚拟增强(VCE)MRI预测的乳腺癌检测框架，并在患者层面模拟"路由"策略，优先用NC+VCE替代约60%的增强检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 钆对比剂静脉注射带来患者安全与临床流程负担，若能以AI虚拟增强替代部分真实增强检查，可减少造影剂使用而不牺牲诊断性能。

Method: 训练NC MRI癌症检测模型与VCE MRI预测模型，将两者预测结果进行融合；进一步设计患者级路由策略，依据NC预测置信度逐步将患者导向NC+VCE路径以替代实际增强扫描。

Result: 留出测试集上，仅用NC MRI的AUROC为0.865，融合NC与VCE后提升至0.901；路由模拟显示约40%患者保留真实增强即可基本维持诊断性能。

Conclusion: VCE MRI与NC MRI具有互补价值，有望支持乳腺癌筛查中选择性使用对比剂；但结论基于离线路由模拟，缺乏前瞻性临床验证。

Abstract: Although contrast-enhanced (CE) breast MRI is an important tool for cancer detection, intravenous gadolinium administration introduces additional considerations for patients and clinical workflows. AI based virtual contrast enhanced (VCE) MRI could help identify patients for whom acquired CE imaging may be avoidable without compromising diagnostic performance. We developed a framework that combines non contrast (NC) and VCE MRI predictions for cancer detection. On the held-out test set, cancer detection using NC MRI alone achieved an AUROC of 0.865. Combining the predictions from NC and VCE MRI improved AUROC to 0.901. Building on this complementary predictive value, we evaluated patient-level routing to progressively replace acquired CE examinations with the NC plus VCE pathway, prioritizing patients with the most confident NC predictions. This simulation suggests that diagnostic performance can be largely preserved while limiting acquired CE imaging to approximately 40% of patients. Together, these findings demonstrate the complementary value of VCE MRI and suggest its potential to support selective contrast use in breast cancer screening.

</details>


### [508] [Interpretable Multiple-Instance Learning of Glomerular Pathomics and Subtype Ratios for eGFR Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00151)
*Tianyu Shi,Yuechen Yang,Leiyue Zhao,Daniel Reisenbüchler,Jing Jin,Thangamani Muthukumar,Kenji Ikemura,Mert R. Sabuncu,Yihe Yang,Ruining Deng*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 用注意力MIL将每例活检WSI建模为"肾小球实例袋"，融合传统肾小球亚型比例提升eGFR分类AUC（0.725→0.763）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WSI级均值化的亚型比例压缩了肾小球层面的形态异质性，且低估少见病理模式的贡献，需在实例级别建模。

Method: 162例肾活检WSI（eGFR<60 vs ≥60）。分割肾小球并提取尺寸、形状、强度、纹理特征，构成患者级实例袋；训练ABMIL聚合异质病理组学特征，与均值池化MLP基线对照，比较亚型比例、pathomics及二者融合，五折交叉验证，SHAP解释特征贡献。

Result: 亚型比例单独AUC 0.7262±0.0596；pathomics MIL 0.7362±0.0788；二者融合最高0.7630±0.0665。样本量小、单中心，绝对性能有限。

Conclusion: 概念验证表明MIL级pathomics可作为亚型比例的互补信息源，提供肾小球级判读线索。

Abstract: Chronic kidney disease is characterized by structural alterations in renal tissue and progressive loss of kidney function. While glomerular subtype ratios provide a compact and clinically meaningful summary of glomerular composition, representing pathomic information using whole-slide image (WSI)-level mean values diminishes glomerulus-level heterogeneity and the contribution of less prevalent patterns. In this proof-of-concept study, we investigated whether modeling individual glomeruli using multiple-instance learning (MIL) could provide complementary information to conventional subtype ratios for estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) classification. We analyzed 162 kidney-biopsy WSIs from 162 patients, categorizing renal function as eGFR < 60 or >= 60 mL/min/1.73 m^2. Quantitative size, shape, intensity, and texture features were extracted from segmented glomeruli, representing each patient as a bag of glomerular instances. An attention-based MIL model was trained to aggregate these heterogeneous pathomic profiles. We evaluated subtype ratios, pathomics, and their combination using ABMIL, with a mean-pooled multilayer perceptron baseline. In five-fold cross-validation, the subtype-ratio-only model achieved an AUC of 0.7262 +/- 0.0596. MIL using pathomics alone achieved an AUC of 0.7362 +/- 0.0788, whereas integrating pathomics with subtype ratios produced the highest mean AUC of 0.7630 +/- 0.0665. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to examine individual feature contributions. These results demonstrate that MIL-based pathomics can complement established glomerular subtype ratios by capturing additional glomerulus-level information for quantitative kidney-biopsy analysis.

</details>


### [509] [FlowFPR: Flow Matching Prior for Oversampled Fourier Phase Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00157)
*Li Jiatai,Cao Wenfei,Chen Yang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: FlowFPR将预训练Flow Matching先验与松弛平均交替反射（RAAR）结合求解过采样傅里叶相位恢复，每次外迭代用单次时间依赖Flow预测获得干净图像估计，再经测量一致性校正与自适应融合，无需反传测量误差；并在自然彩色人脸图像上以多重重启评估验证其在非零噪声下级联最优且运行时间低于扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 傅里叶相位恢复仅凭幅度重建图像，噪声与通道歧义使自然彩色图像恢复困难；扩散先验方法虽提供强图像约束，但在更强测量噪声下性能退化，且重复生成更新计算代价高。

Method: 提出FlowFPR：外迭代中单步Flow Matching预测得到干净图像先验估计，施加测量一致性校正，再融合两者候选重建下一路径状态，避免测量误差通过Flow网络反传。进一步引入基于残差改进的自适应融合权重，以及结合早停与最优保留候选选择的受控内层搜索；形成基础法、两项独立改进及联合变体。

Result: 在自然人脸图像、真值辅助多重重启评估协议下，联合变体在两个非零噪声水平取得最优平均重建质量；同硬件计时显示端到端运行时间低于扩散类基线。

Conclusion: Flow Matching先验可高效替代扩散先验用于傅里叶相位恢复，配合自适应融合与早停内层搜索在噪声鲁棒性与计算效率上均有优势；但仅在合成幅度、人脸域上评估，尚未涉及真实采集或下游感知任务。

Abstract: Fourier phase retrieval reconstructs images from magnitude measurements without phase information, but noise and channel ambiguities make natural color-image recovery challenging. Although diffusion-prior methods provide strong image constraints, their recovery can deteriorate under stronger measurement noise, and repeated generative updates incur substantial computational cost. This paper proposes FlowFPR, which integrates a pretrained Flow Matching prior with relaxed averaged alternating reflections for oversampled Fourier phase retrieval. Each outer iteration obtains a clean image estimate through a single time-dependent Flow prediction, applies measurement-consistency correction, and reconstructs the next path state after fusing the two candidates. This process requires no backpropagation of measurement errors through the Flow network. To address ineffective or excessive correction caused by prescribed fusion weights and fixed inner depths, we introduce adaptive fusion based on residual improvement and a controlled inner search combining early stopping with best-so-far candidate selection. Their combination yields a joint variant alongside the basic method and the two independent improvements. Experiments on natural face images under a common ground-truth-assisted multiple-restart evaluation protocol show that the joint variant achieves the best mean quality among the evaluated methods at the two tested nonzero noise levels, while same-hardware timing demonstrates lower end-to-end runtime than the diffusion-based baselines.

</details>


### [510] [A Rate-Distortion Optimized Skip Mode Coding Framework for Neural Video Compression in AVS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00181)
*Yuntian Jiang,Shuai Li,Yanbo Gao,Jinglin Zhang,Hui Yuan,Mao Ye*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 针对AVS NVC中的skip mode编码，提出RDOSkip：利用hyperprior预测的统计分布并结合Bayes定理对skip模式的率与失真建模，实现空时联合RD优化的自适应skip判决，无需训练、复杂度几乎不变，BD-rate分别节省0.90%（AVS）与1.29%（HEVC）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: skip mode在NVC中承担大量运动与残差特征编码，但其率失真性能缺乏系统研究；现有方法采用固定skip阈值，隐含刚性的固定失真分布假设，无法适应失真在空间与时间上的变化。

Method: 首先统计分析帧内空间维度以及不同时域参考质量下skip模式编码的率与失真分布，验证其时空非平稳性；随后基于hyperprior预测的统计分布与Bayes定理对skip模式的率与失真建模，提出空时联合RD优化的自适应skip判决，在GOP内跨通道与跨帧进行skip决策；无需训练，推理时可直接使用。

Result: 时域skip判决方法已被正在制定的AVS NVC标准采纳并写入参考软件；在AVS与HEVC数据集上BD-rate分别节省0.90%与1.29%，复杂度增量可忽略。

Conclusion: 以统计分布驱动的空时联合RD优化替代固定阈值skip判决，可在零训练成本下稳定提升NVC编码效率，并具备标准落地价值。

Abstract: With the development of deep learning, neural video compression (NVC) is gaining increasing interest and is currently under standardization in the AVS (Audio Video Coding Standard). Skip mode coding, a crucial component in the traditional video compression, is also adopted in AVS NVC. Although the skip mode takes a large portion in encoding the motion and residual features in the NVC, there is a lack of investigation on the rate distortion performance of the skip mode coding. In this paper, we first thoroughly investigate the rate and distortion distribution in the skip mode coding within a spatial frame and under different temporal reference qualities, and demonstrate that distortion distribution changes spatially and temporally. Therefore, a rate-distortion optimized skip mode coding (RDOSkip) framework is proposed, where the rate and distortion in the skip mode coding is formulated based on a statistical distribution predicted by the hyperprior and the Bayes' theorem. An adaptive skip mode decision method based on spatial-temporal joint RD optimization is developed for the skip mode coding among channels and frames in a group of pictures. It addresses the limitation of the rigid fixed-distortion distribution assumption in skip mode coding within the existing methods that rely on a fixed skip threshold. The temporal skip mode decision method has been adopted in the ongoing AVS NVC standard and incorporated into the reference software. The proposed RDOSkip can be directly used in the inference without any training and with negligible complexity increase. Experimental results further demonstrate that the proposed RDOSkip can improve the performance by 0.90% and 1.29% on AVS and HEVC datasets, respectively, in terms of BD-rate saving.

</details>


### [511] [Does Vendor Image Processing Matter? Learning Echocardiography Display Appearance from Native Beamspace Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00184)
*Elias Stenhede,Arian Ranjbar*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: This paper trains a small beamspace CNN to reproduce GE's vendor display processing from native ultrasound data, then uses it to study how undocumented filtering affects downstream segmentation performance across EchoXFlow and CAMUS.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Most echocardiography datasets contain vendor-processed images whose processing pipeline is undocumented, which may bias model performance and hurt robustness. The authors want an explicit, learnable model of that processing to make filtering controllable and reproducible.

Method: A compact convolutional network operating on native beamspace B-mode data (8,406 recordings, 605 patients) is trained to reproduce GE display appearance; it is compared against the optimal pointwise brightness map, an equivalent Cartesian-domain CNN, and CPU real-time inference is reported. Filtering is then used as training augmentation and evaluated on EchoXFlow and CAMUS segmentation.

Result: The beamspace CNN reduces test MAE by 43% relative to the optimal pointwise brightness map, outperforms the Cartesian CNN, and runs in real time on CPU. Across both datasets, unfiltered training with filtered evaluation gives the lowest mean Dice for every class.

Conclusion: Vendor display processing can be efficiently emulated in beamspace, and applying it as augmentation may improve robustness when evaluation data are filtered or their processing is unknown.

Abstract: Most echocardiography datasets contain vendor-processed images, but processing is often undocumented and may affect model performance and robustness. To address this, we train a small convolutional neural network to reproduce General Electric display appearance from native beamspace brightness-mode ultrasound, using 8 406 recordings from 605 unique patients. The beamspace CNN reduces test mean absolute error by 43% over the optimal pointwise brightness map, outperforms an equivalent Cartesian CNN and runs in real time on a CPU. Across the EchoXFlow and CAMUS datasets, unfiltered training followed by filtered evaluation yields the lowest mean Dice for every class, suggesting filtering may be useful as augmentation when evaluation data are filtered or their processing is unknown. Code and pretrained weights: this https URL

</details>


### [512] [VC-1K: A Diverse Video Test Set for Real-Time Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00192)
*Yu-Chen Sun,Jie Dong,Sergey Sablin,Hassene Tmar,Sriram Srinivasan*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: VC-1K：约1000段用户自拍/后摄的视频通话序列，带同步音频，覆盖多样设备、光照、运动与人群，用于RTC视频处理与编码评测，并给出OpenH264/SVT-AV1/libaom在CBR下的对比及RealESRGAN/GFPGAN超分基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频测试集多来自影视制作或屏幕内容，缺少真实RTC场景下消费级移动端采集的用户生成通话视频，难以支撑实时通信编码与前后处理研究的可信评测。

Method: 构建开源数据集（约1K序列，含同步音频），以talking-head为主并含少量无后摄人脸片段；统计并按设备、光照、运动强度、室内外、人群属性分层设计；在典型RTC分辨率下以CBR对三种编码器做率失真对比，并用两种超分方法（RealESRGAN、GFPGAN）建立前/后处理基线。

Result: 给出数据集的统计分布与设计方法学，以及多编码器在CBR条件下的对比评测与超分方法在该集上的定量结果，验证其作为RTC编码与预/后处理基准的可用性。

Conclusion: VC-1K作为公开RTC视频测试集，填补真实通话场景评测空白，可作为编码器选型与超分等处理算法的社区基准；无新方法贡献。

Abstract: We introduce Video Conferencing 1000 (VC-1K), an open-source test set comprising approximately 1,000 video sequences specifically designed for evaluating video processing and encoding pipelines in real-time communication (RTC) scenarios. Unlike existing test sets that primarily rely on studio-produced or screen content, VC-1K consists of user-generated video call content captured on consumer mobile devices under a wide variety of conditions. The dataset predominantly features talking-head sequences with distinct faces, but also includes a small subset of outward-facing, rear-camera videos without faces to reflect additional common RTC use cases. It spans a wide range of real-world variables including device type, lighting conditions, motion levels, indoor/outdoor environments, and demographic diversity. All video sequences are accompanied by synchronous audio to facilitate multimodal research. We detail the dataset's design methodology and statistical distribution, and demonstrate its utility through a comparative encoder evaluation of OpenH264, SVT-AV1, and libaom under constant bitrate (CBR) encoding at resolutions typical of RTC deployments. Furthermore, two super-resolution approaches, RealESRGAN and GFPGAN, are evaluated on VC-1K, highlighting the dataset as a useful benchmark for pre- and post-processing research. VC-1K is intended to serve as a publicly available dataset for the video RTC research community.

</details>


### [513] [Directional Dual-Head Supervision for Real-Time Source-Free Polyp Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00238)
*Hai-Dang Nguyen,Nhat-Khoi Le,Huu-Thuan Huynh,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: MedRT-SFSeg：基于双头YOLO分割架构的实时无源域适应医学息肉分割框架，用Mask-DHF融合双头伪实例、DURR依双头像素分歧符号方向性扩缩掩码、Seg-MARD做掩码引导分层采样正则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SFDA在医学图像分割中受确认偏差困扰：自训练模型易漏检小息肉、幻觉前景、轮廓不精确，且需在保护隐私的前提下适配无标注目标域。

Method: 采用一对一/一对多双头YOLO分割架构；Mask-DHF将偏精确与偏召回的预测融合为稳定伪实例；DURR以像素级双头分歧的符号作为方向线索扩缩掩码，并恢复漏检、抑制幻觉；Seg-MARD通过掩码引导的区域分层采样正则化特征表示。

Result: 在Kvasir-SEG与CVC-ClinicDB双向适应上达到80.43%/80.77% Dice、ASD 5.53/8.44 mm，较无适配基线提升7.7与9.8 Dice点，端到端>62 FPS。

Conclusion: 分割感知的双头监督可在不牺牲实时推理的前提下提升伪标签质量，为实时SFDA医学分割提供可行路径；但仅在两个同源内窥镜数据集上验证，缺乏跨模态/跨器官泛化证据。

Abstract: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) is critical for medical image segmentation as it adapts a model to an unlabeled target domain without accessing source data, thereby preserving data privacy. However, its effectiveness is often limited by confirmation bias: self-training models tend to miss small polyps, hallucinate foreground, and produce imprecise contours. We propose MedRT-SFSeg, a real-time SFDA framework built on a dual-head one-to-one/one-to-many YOLO segmentation architecture. Mask-DHF fuses precision- and recall-oriented predictions into stable pseudo-instances, while DURR uses the sign of pixel-level dual-head disagreement as a directional cue to expand or shrink masks, and additionally recovers missed instances and suppresses hallucinations. Seg-MARD further regularizes feature representations through mask-guided, region-stratified sampling. Experiments on bidirectional adaptation between Kvasir-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB show that MedRT-SFSeg achieves 80.43%/80.77% Dice and 5.53/8.44 mm ASD, improving the non-adapted baseline by 7.7 and 9.8 Dice points while running at more than 62 FPS end-to-end. These results suggest that segmentation-aware dual-head supervision can improve pseudo-label quality without sacrificing real-time inference. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [514] [The MASSIMAL Dataset: UAV Hyperspectral Images and Ground Truth Observations for Coastal Habitat Mapping in Norway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00763)
*Martin Hansen Skjelvareid,Eli Rinde,Kasper Hancke,Katalin Blix,Galice Guillaume Hoarau,Nicolo Grometto,Maia Røst Kile*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: MASSIMAL：挪威海岸浅水生境（海带林、海草床、藻礁）测绘数据集，含45次UAV飞行的400–1000nm/300波段高光谱影像（GSD 3.5cm），221幅带分层分类标签与分割掩码，并提供反射率/耀光校正处理流水线及RGB、多光谱、镶嵌图与水下视频、影像、单波束声呐真值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感手段难以精细测绘浅水海岸生境（海带林、海草床、藻礁），需构建高空间与光谱分辨率的数据基础以支持生境分布评估、变化追踪与生态系统服务评价。

Method: 沿挪威海岸4个区域、59°–67°N跨纬度开展45次无人机飞行采集推扫式高光谱影像（GSD 3.5cm，400–1000nm，300波段，单景沿轨上限2000行）；对约1000幅中221幅进行分割掩码与分层分类体系标注；开源处理流水线生成反射率与耀光校正影像，并结合RGB、多光谱镶嵌图及水下视频、地理标记水下影像、单波束声呐构成真值体系。

Result: 产出多模态、跨纬度的高分辨率浅水海岸遥感数据集：约1000幅高光谱影像（221幅已标注）、配准RGB/多光谱与镶嵌图、以及小时级水下视频、数千张水下影像和数十公里声呐真值数据；配套开源辐射与耀光校正处理流程。

Conclusion: 该数据集为浅水海岸生境测绘方法研究与生境分布、动态监测、生态服务评估提供基准数据支撑，服务于挪威沿岸的证据化管理；但以数据资源为主，未提出新方法或方法性结论。

Abstract: The MASSIMAL dataset was collected in an effort to develop new remote sensing methods for mapping shallow water coastal habitats, such as kelp forests, seagrass meadows and maerl beds. The main component of the dataset is a set of hyperspectral images collected using a unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Images were collected during 45 UAV flights performed at 4 main areas along the Norwegian coast, spanning across a wide latitude range, from 59 to 67 degrees north. The ground sampling distance of the hyperspectral images is 3.5 cm, and the spectral range is 400-1000 nm, sampled across 300 spectral bands. During acquisition, push-broom imagery was automatically split into images with a maximum along-track length of 2000 lines. Out of approximately 1000 hyperspectral images, 221 have been annotated, using segmentation masks and a hierarchical taxonomy. An open source image processing pipeline has been developed as part of the dataset preparation, enabling efficient generation of reflectance images and glint-corrected images based on published radiance images. The dataset also includes color images (RGB) and multispectral images collected using UAV, and georeferenced image mosaics constructed from these. Ground truth data supporting the remote sensing images include hours of underwater video, thousands of geotagged underwater images, and tens of kilometers of single-beam sonar data. The data provide a foundation for assessing habitat distribution, tracking changes, and evaluating ecosystem services, thus supporting evidence-based management in Norwegian coastal environments.

</details>


### [515] [Adaptive Land Units from Earth Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01050)
*Albert Alonso,Jamal Jokar Arsanjani,Andres R. Masegosa*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出用 AlphaEarth 嵌入 + 并行贝叶斯层次聚类从数据自身涌现自适应土地利用单元，将丹麦 4.02 亿像素压缩为 127 万异质化单元（约 320 倍），并在单张消费级 GPU 上完成全国土地利用建模与分钟级不确定性估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 土地利用建模的空间单元通常由规则格网给定，分辨率受计算预算约束而非地物本身；本文追问能否让"好的土地单元"从遥感数据自身中涌现，从而在保证表达力的同时大幅降低计算成本。

Method: 以 AlphaEarth 嵌入为特征，采用并行贝叶斯层次聚类（Bayesian hierarchical clustering）生成自适应空间单元——均质区域大、异质区域小；无监督、无标签；在丹麦全国 402M 像素上运行，得到 1.27M 单元，并在其上训练土地利用模型、做全国尺度估计与不确定性量化；与像素模型、以及对原始卫星影像聚类的结果对比。

Result: 单元数减少约 320 倍；达到同等土地利用标签一致性，规则格网需约 5 倍单元，对地块申报作物需约 4 倍单元；相比直接聚类影像，嵌入达到同等纯度只需一半单元；基于单元的模型精度与像素模型相差仅几个百分点，但可在不到一分钟内完成全国估计并给出可靠不确定性，而像素模型甚至无法装入显存。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的自适应单元可作为实用建模单元，在不牺牲精度的前提下把全国尺度土地利用制图与不确定性量化变为轻量可行任务，为大规模地理空间 AI 提供可替代规则格网的范式。

Abstract: Modeling land use starts with a choice of spatial units, typically a regular grid of pixels whose resolution is set by the spatial detail the process requires and, often more critically, by the computational budget. With Earth observation data more abundant than ever, we ask whether good land units can instead emerge from the data itself. To do that, we cluster AlphaEarth embeddings with a parallel Bayesian hierarchical clustering into adaptive land units, large where the land is uniform and small where it is highly heterogeneous. Using Denmark as a case study, we turn 402M land pixels into 1.27M newly defined units, about 320 times fewer, without any labels (i.e., unsupervised), making it possible to fit the whole country on a single consumer-grade GPU. Importantly, these units describe the land well, as a regular grid needs about 5 times as many cells to match them against land-use labels, and about 4 times as many against the declared crop of every field. Compared to clustering the satellite images themselves, the embeddings need half the units for the same purity. But more notably, they work as modeling units. Land-use maps learned on them are within a few points of accuracy of pixel models at a small fraction of the cost, and they make whole-country land-use estimates with reliable uncertainty possible in under a minute, where the same model on pixels does not even fit in device memory.

</details>


### [516] [OpenULF: A Modular Toolkit Enables Data-Driven Ultra-Low-Field MRI with both Classical and Quantum Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01511)
*Hanhan Wu,Yuchen Yuan,Weiwen Jiang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: OpenULF：开源模块化超低场MRI仿真工具包，用Bloch方程验证的物理模拟器+校准SQUID/线圈接收器模型生成配对训练数据，支持端到端ML重建与自动设计空间探索；训练774个模型后给出SQUID与线圈的交叉点约450 µT，指出传感器与重建需协同设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超低场（<10 mT）MRI可用SQUID量子传感器（高灵敏但需低温）或室温感应线圈（低成本但信号弱），两者在传统物理成像下SNR均低。数据驱动重建可突破此限，但缺乏开放数据集、基准和灵活模拟器，阻碍了ULF-MRI的ML重建研究。

Method: 提出OpenULF开源仿真工具包：接收器抽象基类、解耦物理与学习的类型化HDF5契约、可恢复扫描引擎，使传感器/模型/数据集可独立替换；集成Bloch方程验证的物理模拟器、校准的SQUID与线圈接收器模型、多种重建ML网络及自动化设计空间探索引擎。

Result: 在四个解剖数据集上训练774个模型，完成三次设计空间探索；发现ML重建效果强依赖数据集与传感器，识别出约450 µT处SQUID→线圈的性能交叉点，并证明系统设计时传感器硬件与ML模型容量可相互权衡。

Conclusion: 传感器与重建算法必须协同设计：最优传感器取决于数据集与场强，而非单纯由SNR决定；OpenULF为ULF-MRI的ML重建提供了可复现的开源基准与工具链。

Abstract: Ultra-low-field (ULF) Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) offers a portable, low-cost alternative to conventional scanners by operating at field strengths below 10 mT. At these fields, two sensor technologies compete: quantum SQUID (Superconducting Quantum Interference Device) sensors, which provide high sensitivity but require cryogenic cooling, and classical induction coils, which are inexpensive and room-temperature but produce weaker signals. With conventional physics-based imaging, both suffer from low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). Data-driven reconstruction has overcome similar limits in related inverse problems, but its use for ULF-MRI has been hindered by a lack of open datasets, benchmarks, and flexible simulators. To close this gap, we present OpenULF, a modular, open-source simulation toolkit that generates paired training data and supports end-to-end machine-learning (ML) reconstruction. OpenULF integrates a Bloch-equation-validated physics simulator, calibrated SQUID and coil receiver models, reconstruction ML networks, and an automated design-space exploration engine. Architecturally, a receiver abstract base class, a typed HDF5 contract that decouples physics from learning, and a resumable sweep engine make sensors, models, and datasets independently substitutable. Using OpenULF, we train 774 models across four anatomical datasets and conduct three design-space explorations. The effectiveness of ML reconstruction depends strongly on the dataset and the sensor. We identify a SQUID-to-coil crossover near 450 $\mu$T and demonstrate that sensor hardware and ML model capacity can be traded off during system design. Sensor and reconstruction choices must therefore be co-designed: the best sensor is set by the dataset and field strength, not by SNR.

</details>


### [517] [Task-driven sparse-view planar X-ray computed tomography for axial metrology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01537)
*Yibin Tian,Shuming Yang,Wolfgang Heidrich*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出任务驱动的稀疏视角X射线断层计算成像框架，以PCB背钻孔轴向终止间隙（ATG）测量为例，直接从多色投影数据经物理灵敏度模型估计ATG，并用门控分层估计器加贝叶斯信息准则选择模型复杂度，给出任务特定Cramér-Rao界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统XCT依赖完整三维重建，采集负担重；作者认为若系统围绕任务相关信息设计（而非图像保真），可显著降低采集需求，并在工业PCB背钻孔ATG计量这一具体任务上验证该思路。

Method: 不重建而直接估计：基于物理的灵敏度模型将多色投影数据映射到ATG；门控分层估计器先联合拟合ATG与辐射度扰动，仅当约化卡方充分性检验与BIC支持时才引入全局几何与样品形变模型；同一低维扰动模型用于边缘化Fisher信息分析，得到条件与校准感知的CRB。

Result: 数值实验显示，在固定总光子预算下，任务驱动计量在12–64视角变化范围内误差几乎不变，而重建驱动方法强烈依赖视角数且误差大得多；直接估计器呈现预期的光子受限标度规律。

Conclusion: XCT的采集、物理建模与推断应按任务所需的定量信息来评估，而非通用体图像保真度，这为任务驱动计算传感提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Computational imaging can reduce the acquisition burden when the system is designed around task-relevant information rather than complete image recovery. We investigate this framework for sparse-view planar X-ray tomography (XCT) of layered objects, using measurement of the axial termination gap (ATG) of back-drilled printed-circuit-board (PCB) vias as a representative task. Instead of using 3D reconstruction, the proposed method estimates ATG directly from polychromatic projection data through a physics-based sensitivity model. A gated hierarchical estimator first fits ATG together with radiometric perturbations and selectively introduces global geometry and specimen-warp models only when a reduced chi-squared adequacy test and Bayesian information criterion justify the added degrees of freedom. The same low-dimensional perturbation model is incorporated into marginalized Fisher-information analyses, yielding task-specific conditional and calibration-aware Cram'er-Rao bounds. Numerical experiments show that, under a fixed total photon budget, task-driven metrology changes little over 12-64 views, while reconstruction-driven metrology is strongly view-dependent with much larger errors. The direct estimator also follows the expected photon-limited scaling. These results demonstrate a computational sensing strategy in which XCT acquisition, physical modeling, and inference are evaluated according to the quantitative information required by the task rather than for general-purpose volumetric image fidelity.

</details>


### [518] [Cross-Dataset Generalization of Glaucoma Detection CNNs: Effects of Operating Threshold, Multi-Source Training, and Color Normalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.01992)
*Al-Amin Rahman,Saifuddin Ahmed,Resalat Ahmed*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 该研究发现眼底图像青光眼检测CNN跨数据集泛化显著下降：域内平均AUC 0.913，跨源仅0.702（下降0.211）；阈值迁移使特异度从0.870降到0.506；LAB参考归一化与强颜色增强可将跨源AUC提升至约0.755，把下降缩小到约0.16，但无法消除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有青光眼深度学习模型几乎只在同源数据上测试，无法反映其在新医院或新相机上的实际表现，作者希望量化跨源泛化差距并检验常见域适应/归一化手段是否能缓解该问题。
