Method: 用相同设置微调五个ImageNet预训练CNN（ResNet50、DenseNet121、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B0、InceptionV3），分别在ACRIMA、ORIGA、RIM-ONE DL三个公开眼底数据集上训练，在本源留出集与另外两个数据集全集上测试；三个随机种子报告均值与标准差；比较源域阈值迁移、目标域10%重设阈值、双源联合训练，以及多种图像归一化（LAB参考归一化、Ben Graham、CLAHE、gray-world）与强颜色增强的影响；另用仅测试的G1020作为外部集。

Result: 域内平均AUC 0.913、跨源0.702，下降0.211（SD 0.030，95% CI 0.135–0.286）；多重比较校正后未发现架构差异（仅3个种子、统计功效低）。源域阈值迁移后特异度0.870→0.506、敏感度0.831→0.726；用目标域10%图像重设阈值特异度回升到0.670但敏感度降至0.609，平衡准确率仅0.616→0.639。双源联合训练无效（0.695 vs 0.702）。LAB参考归一化（0.755）与强颜色增强（0.754）效果最好，下降缩至约0.16；Ben Graham（0.733）、CLAHE（0.712）较弱，gray-world（0.696）无效。最佳两法提升特异度但降低敏感度。在G1020上所有条件下AUC均近0.5，G1020内部训练的模型也接近随机。

Conclusion: 域内强表现不能证明模型可用；归一化与颜色增强只能缩小而无法消除跨源性能下降；外部验证应同时报告AUC与工作阈值下的特异度/敏感度，而非仅AUC。

Abstract: Deep learning models for glaucoma detection are usually tested on images from the same dataset used for training. That says little about how they will work at a new hospital or with a new camera. We fine-tuned five ImageNet-pretrained CNNs (ResNet50, DenseNet121, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B0, InceptionV3) with identical settings on one of three public fundus datasets (ACRIMA, ORIGA, RIM-ONE DL). Each was tested on a held-out part of its own dataset and on the other two datasets in full. We used three random seeds and report mean and SD over seeds. Mean in-domain AUC was 0.913 and cross-source AUC was 0.702, a drop of 0.211 (SD 0.030; 95% CI 0.135 to 0.286). After correction for multiple comparisons we found no evidence that any architecture did better, though three seeds give low power. At thresholds set on the source validation data, specificity fell from 0.870 to 0.506 and sensitivity from 0.831 to 0.726. Resetting the threshold on 10% of the target images raised specificity to 0.670 but lowered sensitivity to 0.609, and balanced accuracy rose only from 0.616 to 0.639. Training on two sources together did not help (held-out AUC 0.695 versus 0.702). LAB reference normalization (cross-source AUC 0.755) and strong color augmentation (0.754) gave similar gains, cutting the drop to about 0.16. Ben Graham normalization (0.733) and CLAHE (0.712) helped less, and gray-world (0.696) did not help. The two best methods raised specificity but lowered sensitivity. On G1020, used only for testing, AUC stayed near 0.5 in every condition, and networks trained within G1020 were also close to chance. Strong in-domain results do not show that a glaucoma model will work on new data. Normalization and color augmentation reduce the drop but do not remove it. Studies should report external validation and check the operating threshold, not only AUC.

</details>


### [519] [Spectral-spatial vision test-time training for hyperspectral image classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02364)
*Xiang Zhao*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: ViTTT-HSI 将视觉测试时训练（ViT3）框架适配到高光谱图像中心像素分类：谱感知嵌入主干 + 两个 ViT3 TTT 编码块 + 中心像素与邻域均值特征融合，在四个标准数据集上取得约 97.6–99.3% 的总体精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱分类需在有限标注下同时建模连续光谱签名与空间上下文；固定权重的 token mixing 模型表达能力受限于预训练权重，而视觉测试时训练（TTT）通过输入序列上的自监督内层参数更新实现自适应混合，但其在高光谱中心像素分类中的适用性尚未被充分刻画。

Method: 提出 ViTTT-HSI：(1) 谱感知嵌入主干，用光谱一维卷积提取有序波段信息，并在不降低空间分辨率的前提下构造空间 token；(2) 堆叠两个 ViT3 风格 TTT 编码块，执行以 patch 为条件的 token mixing，并通过自监督内层更新调整混合参数；(3) 分类阶段融合中心像素特征与邻域平均特征。在 Indian Pines、Pavia University、Salinas、Houston 2013 上，以 10 个随机种子和 1%/5% 训练比例进行评估，并对 TTT 内层更新、光谱主干、特征融合分别做消融。

Result: 四个数据集平均总体精度分别为 97.6390%、98.8753%、99.3292%、98.4283%。消融显示 TTT 内层更新在 Indian Pines 上贡献显著、在 Pavia University 上贡献较小且为正；光谱主干与特征融合的相对收益依数据集而异。

Conclusion: 结果证明以 patch 为条件的视觉 TTT 可用于光谱-空间高光谱分类，内层自适应机制是主要增益来源；但整体仍是遥感领域内的架构适配与基准测度，缺乏跨域泛化、实时性或开源验证等更强证据。

Abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification requires the representation of contiguous spectral signatures and spatial context under limited labeled supervision. Vision test-time training (TTT) offers an alternative to fixed-weight token mixing by performing self-supervised inner-model updates on the input sequence, but its application to center-pixel HSI classification remains insufficiently characterized. We present ViTTT-HSI, a spectral-spatial adaptation of the vision test-time training (ViT3) architecture. A spectral-aware embedding stem extracts ordered-band information using spectral convolution and forms spatial tokens without reducing their spatial resolution. Two ViT3-based TTT encoder blocks perform patch-conditioned token mixing, followed by the fusion of center-pixel and neighborhood-average features for classification. We evaluate the framework on Indian Pines, Pavia University, Salinas, and Houston 2013 using ten random seeds and dataset-specific training fractions of 1% or 5%. The mean overall accuracies are 97.6390%, 98.8753%, 99.3292%, and 98.4283%, respectively. Ablations reveal a substantial contribution from the TTT inner update on Indian Pines and a smaller positive contribution on Pavia University, while the relative benefits of the spectral stem and feature fusion depend on the dataset. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using patch-conditioned vision TTT for spectral--spatial HSI classification and highlight the role of the inner adaptation mechanism.

</details>


### [520] [Shared-Pattern Collaborative Network for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Data Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03069)
*Chenfang Yang,Chuanzheng Gong,Feng Gao,Junyu Dong,Qian Du*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出共享模式协同网络 SPCNet，用于 HSI 与 SAR/LiDAR 多源遥感联合分类；核心是共享大核算子+动态卷积分支的 SPCB 和区域自适应模态权重分配器 RAMA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多源遥感分类方法难以同时建模异质模态间的长程上下文依赖与共享空间模式。

Method: SPCNet：Shared-Pattern Collaborative Block（SPCB）引入共享大核算子捕获跨模态公共空间结构，并用动态卷积分支获得内容自适应局部特征；Region-Adaptive Modality Allocator（RAMA）为每个空间位置分配变化的模态权重以实现可靠融合。

Result: 在 Houston2013、Augsburg、Houston2018 三个数据集上优于多种 SOTA 方法。

Conclusion: 共享空间模式建模与空间变化模态加权可有效提升异质多源遥感数据的联合分类性能。

Abstract: Multi-source remote sensing data classification has received growing attention recently. However, existing methods still struggle to jointly model long-range contextual dependencies and shared spatial patterns across heterogeneous modalities. To address this issue, we propose a Shared-Pattern Collaborative Network (SPCNet) for HSI and SAR/LiDAR joint classification. To enhance cross-modal collaborative learning, Shared-Pattern Collaborative Block (SPCB) is designed by introducing a shared large-kernel operator and a dynamic convolution branch, enabling the network to capture common spatial structures and content-adaptive local features. Furthermore, Region-Adaptive Modality Allocator (RAMA) is developed to assign spatially varying modality weights for reliable feature fusion. Experiments on Houston2013, Augsburg, and Houston2018 datasets demonstrate that SPCNet achieves superior classification performance over several state-of-the-art methods. The code will be made publicly available at this https URL

</details>


### [521] [Cross-Layer Refinement and Frequency-aware Fusion Network for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03078)
*Wenhan Xiao,Chuanzheng Gong,Feng Gao,Junyu Dong,Qian Du*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出轻量双分支CRFNet，通过跨层精炼注意力和傅里叶域频率感知互补融合提升多源遥感图像分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多源遥感图像分类可受益于光谱与结构信息的互补性，但如何提取具有判别力的跨模态特征仍是难点。

Method: 轻量双分支架构。CLRA模块在相邻层间传播选定的注意力关系并做top关系选择，逐步强化判别性空间依赖、抑制无关响应；FCF模块在傅里叶域结合频率级交互与跨模态通道注意力，并将表示转换为空域门控以选择性调制互补特征。

Result: 在Houston 2013与Augsburg数据集上稳定优于多种最新方法；代码开源。

Conclusion: 跨层注意力精炼与频域互补融合能有效提升多源遥感分类的特征判别力，且保持轻量化。

Abstract: Multi-source remote sensing image classification benefits from complementary spectral and structural information. However, identifying discriminative cross-modal features remains challenging. This letter proposes a Cross-Layer Refinement and Frequency-aware Fusion Network (CRFNet) within a lightweight dual-branch architecture. Specifically, a Cross-Layer Refinement Attention (CLRA) module propagates selected attention relationships across successive layers and employs top relation selection to progressively strengthen discriminative spatial dependencies while suppressing irrelevant responses. Furthermore, a Frequency-aware Complementary Fusion (FCF) module combines frequency-wise interactions with cross-modal channel attention in the Fourier domain. The resulting representations are then converted into spatial-domain gates to selectively modulate complementary features. Experiments on the Houston 2013 and Augsburg datasets demonstrate that the proposed CRFNet consistently outperforms several state-of-the-art methods. The codes are publicly available at this https URL

</details>


### [522] [HIVE-Diff: High Frame Rate HDR Video Reconstruction from a Single LDR Frame and Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.03465)
*Caixin Wang,Qingrui Wang,Jie Zhang,Ralph Etienne-Cummings*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: HIVE-Diff：以单个LDR参考帧+事件流重建N帧HDR视频的事件条件视频扩散框架，分解为事件引导时序生成与HDR内容补全，并用合成数据训练+师生蒸馏适配真实事件域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高帧率HDR视频在自动驾驶、科学成像中需求强烈（高速运动与极端光照共存），但传统帧相机在时间分辨率与动态范围间存在权衡；事件相机提供高速亮度变化且动态范围宽。纯事件方法缺乏绝对强度参考导致亮度/色彩漂移，混合方法多用LDR帧作锚点但仅在已有LDR时间戳做一对一重建，无法扩展时间维度。

Method: 提出"单参考HDR时间扩展"任务：由1帧LDR参考与事件流重建N帧HDR视频。构建HIVE-Diff——事件条件视频扩散框架，显式分解为（1）事件引导的时序生成、（2）HDR内容补全两条支路。针对真实配对HDR-事件数据稀缺，用合成数据训练，再以LDR-事件序列作代理监督、通过教师-学生蒸馏进行真实事件域自适应。

Result: 在合成数据集与多个真实世界数据集上验证，重建质量优于现有方法，并展现出对真实数据的鲁棒域适配能力（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

Conclusion: 单参考+事件的HDR时间扩展是可行且有价值的设定，扩散式生成先验+合成到真实的蒸馏适配可有效缓解数据稀缺与域偏移，为高速HDR成像提供新范式。

Abstract: High frame rate HDR video is important in applications such as autonomous driving and scientific imaging, where rapid motion and extreme illumination often occur simultaneously. Conventional frame cameras face a trade-off between temporal resolution and dynamic range, while event cameras provide complementary high-speed brightness-change measurements over a wide illumination range. These properties have motivated event-based HDR reconstruction, with existing methods broadly following event-only and hybrid event-frame paradigms. Event-only HDR reconstruction, however, suffers from brightness and color drift due to the lack of absolute intensity references. Hybrid event-frame methods alleviate this ambiguity using low-dynamic-range (LDR) frames as anchors, but most perform one-to-one HDR reconstruction at available LDR timestamps. In this work, we investigate single-reference HDR temporal expansion, reconstructing N HDR frames from one LDR reference and events instead of N aligned LDR observations. We develop HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that decomposes the task into event-guided temporal generation and HDR content completion. Because paired real HDR-event data are scarce, we train on synthetic data and adapt the model to real event domains using LDR-event sequences as proxy supervision with teacher-student distillation. Experiments on synthetic and multiple real-world datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction quality and robust real-data adaptation.

</details>
